An MP asked the health minister about a WHO forecast that half of Europeans could be infected with Omicron within two months, and how the government prepares, including for absenteeism and quarantine pressure. The minister said the government monitors the situation with OMT advice, has delayed the peak through lockdown, accelerated boosters, and eased quarantine rules, but gave no estimate of the total number infected.
The OMT has not given an estimate of the total number of people who are expected to go through the infection in these two months.
Het OMT heeft geen inschatting gegeven van het totaal aantal mensen dat de infectie deze twee maanden naar verwachting zal doormaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over boostervaccinaties voor Nederlanders die met AstraZeneca of Janssen gevaccineerd zijn

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked why booster vaccination for people vaccinated with AstraZeneca or Janssen was not prioritised, and whether the Health Council and EMA positions justify delay. The minister answered that the Health Council found no medical grounds for prioritising by vaccine type, that mRNA boosters are preferred, and that the booster campaign is being accelerated, while several questions about Europe-wide certificate validity were answered only in outline.
The RIVM does not have data on people belonging to a risk group and recipients of a 'waste-bin vaccine' and their vaccination status at the time of a positive test.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over data van personen die behoren tot een risicogroep en ontvangers van een «prullenbakvaccin» en de vaccinatiestatus op het moment van een positieve test.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis roept patiënten op zich niet meer te verzekeren bij Menzis en VGZ'

An MP asks the Health Minister about a hospital (HMC) urging patients not to insure with Menzis or VGZ amid contract disputes, and about the risk of unpaid care in 2022. The minister replies that negotiations are ongoing, insurers have a duty of care, most insurers will reimburse care without a contract, and that such pressure on patients is undesirable.
It is undesirable to conduct these negotiations at the expense of patients/insured persons, because I believe patients are unnecessarily and prematurely worried by this.
Het is onwenselijk om deze onderhandelingen over de rug van patiënten/verzekerden te voeren omdat ik van mening ben dat patiënten hierdoor voorbarig en nodeloos ongerust worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kuiken en Aukje de Vries over de uitvoering van de boostervaccinatiecampagne

MPs Paternotte, Kuiken and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about booster vaccination rollout: uptake numbers, speeding up the campaign, whether relatives can book appointments for elderly people, consent procedures for residents in care homes, eligibility of partners, and vaccinating the wider population. The minister answered that booster figures were provided, that relatives may book only with the person's own consent by phone, that consent practices are workable in care homes, and that the campaign follows age-based priorities per Health Council advice, with a December offensive being prepared.
I will receive the plan for this offensive at the end of this week.
Het plan voor dit offensief ontvang ik aan het eind van deze week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over de aanpak van drugscriminaliteit in Utrecht

MPs Kathmann and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about drug crime in Utrecht, including whether police capacity is sufficient and whether the government will act on the mayor's concerns. The minister said crime has fallen overall but shifted in nature, that police staffing will recover around 2024-2025, and that he will ask the Strategic Council on Undermining for advice on funding allocation and will meet the mayor.
I speak with the mayor of Utrecht regularly.
Ik spreek de burgemeester van Utrecht regelmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Woede om Ollongren die bevolking Caribisch Nederland maant korter te douchen: 'Wat een dedain''

MPs Van den Berg and Kuiken asked the Minister of the Interior whether her advice to Caribbean Netherlands residents to shower shorter and use air conditioning less, based on a Milieu Centraal survey, was appropriate given local poverty, and about renewable energy investment by utility WEB. The minister acknowledged the survey was non-representative and the wording unfortunate, said the municipalities decide how to use the tips, and said a renewables roadmap for Bonaire will be sent to parliament by January 2022.
I regret the commotion that arose over this initiative to promote awareness and possible savings in households together with the public body Bonaire and the involved agencies WEB and UNKOBON.

Ik betreur de ophef die is ontstaan over dit initiatief om samen met het openbaar lichaam Bonaire en betrokken instanties WEB en UNKOBON tot bewustwording en mogelijke besparing in huishoudens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de plannen van het Ommelander Ziekenhuis Groningen om deel te willen nemen in een zonnepark

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister whether a hospital in Groningen (OZG) should take part in a solar park, given reports it would receive a EUR 20 million donation if the park is built. The government answered that the hospital does not invest in the park, is not dependent on the donation, and that hospitals should primarily provide care, though on-site renewables are acceptable; it declined to give a financial rescue guarantee and said oversight of insurers' duty of care is with the NZa.
It is not among the tasks of a hospital to be financially involved in a solar park to be developed on third-party land.
Het behoort niet tot de taken van een ziekenhuis om financieel betrokken te zijn bij een te ontwikkelen zonnepark op gronden van derden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het manifest van Brabantse burgemeesters tegen ondermijnende criminaliteit

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about a manifesto by Brabant mayors calling for a tougher approach to undermining crime, including softdrug legalisation and prevention of youth recruitment into crime. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government shares the urgency, cites new funding and a coffeeshop-chain experiment, and disagrees with legalising softdrugs before the experiment's results are known.
I am convinced that with these we contribute to strengthening our rule of law and making the Netherlands less attractive for organised drug crime.
Ik ben ervan overtuigd dat we hiermee bijdragen aan de versteviging van onze rechtsstaat en Nederland minder aantrekkelijk maken voor georganiseerde drugscriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and BIJ1 asked about the bankruptcy of Stepwork, a major transgender care mental health provider, its impact on waiting lists and continuity of care, and what government could have done earlier. The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over internationale ontwikkelingen rond boostervaccinaties en vaccinatie van kwetsbaren

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked the Minister of Health about EU and German decisions on booster vaccinations, Janssen and AstraZeneca booster eligibility, booster age groups, children aged 5-11 and off-label use for vulnerable children, and school absence due to COVID risk. The Minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad was asked for additional advice by 2 November on boosters and on Pfizer for children, and that the Dutch child-vaccination and school-absence questions are being monitored or left to advisory and EMA processes.
I asked the Health Council on 15 October to provide additional advice on using mRNA vaccines as a booster
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 15 oktober jl. is gevraagd een aanvullend advies te geven over het inzetten van mRNA-vaccins als booster
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over minder geld voor Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster en Den Helder uit gemeentefonds

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior why Texel, Bergen, Castricum, Heerhugowaard, Beemster and Den Helder lose Municipal Fund money under the revised distribution, citing island costs, working poverty and fears of cuts to housing and schools. The reply refers the MPs to the separate letter answering the committee's questions on the revised Municipal Fund distribution proposal, so the substance is not answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de nadelige gevolgen voor Groninger en Friese gemeenten van de herverdeling van het gemeentefonds

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the proposed redistribution of the municipal fund would cut funding for Groningen and Frisian municipalities, and how she would ensure fairness and avoid harming services. The answers were not included in this document; it only refers the questions to a separate letter (Kamerstuk 35 570 B, nr. 9), so the substance of the response cannot be coded.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van de verloskamers in het Gelre Ziekenhuis te Zutphen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the delivery rooms at Gelre hospital in Zutphen, including its consultation with stakeholders, the safety of care, possible wider closures and the role of insurers. The Minister said the closure is temporary due to staff shortages, that the 45-minute access norm and regional agreements are being met, that stakeholders are being consulted, and that no decision on further closures has been taken.

In addition, on the instruction of the ROAZ and coordinated by the NAZZ-regio Zwolle bureau, a chain process has been started to make arrangements on how continuity of maternity care can be safeguarded in the future.

Daarnaast is in opdracht van het ROAZ en onder coördinatie van het bureau NAZZ-regio Zwolle een ketentraject gestart om afspraken te maken hoe de zorgcontinuïteit binnen de geboortezorg toekomstbestendig geborgd kan blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Kuiken en Van den Berg over doelgroepen die aanzienlijke moeite hebben met het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs from D66, VVD, PvdA and CDA asked the health minister which groups struggle to obtain a COVID certificate, including people vaccinated abroad, people without a BSN, and those medically unable to test, and about waiting times and access at GGD Utrecht. The minister answered that the Utrecht service is limited to non-EU vaccinees resident in the Netherlands or Dutch nationals, that solutions for other groups are being explored, and that additional locations (such as Groningen) are being prepared.
It is currently being explored whether people from this group who can make it plausible that they live in the Netherlands and do not yet have a BSN can also be helped.
Er wordt momenteel verkend of mensen uit deze groep die aannemelijk kunnen maken dat zij woonachtig zijn in Nederland en nog geen BSN hebben, ook geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Kuiken over het niet opnemen van het rotavaccin in het rijksvaccinatieprogramma ondanks het positieve advies van de Gezondheidsraad

MPs Van der Laan and Kuiken asked why the rotavirus vaccine has not been added to the national vaccination programme despite positive Health Council advice, and why the decision is deferred to a new cabinet. The state secretary answered that a definitive decision awaits the next cabinet and budget cover, that the vaccine's cost-effectiveness depends on price, and that an implementation plan will be prepared.
In my letter of 20 September I informed the House that I am positive about the Health Council's advice, but that it is up to the next cabinet to take a definitive decision based on this advice.

In mijn brief van 20 september jl. heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat ik positief sta tegenover het advies van de Gezondheidsraad, maar dat het aan het volgend kabinet is om naar aanleiding van dit advies een definitief besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Kuiken over artsen die corona ontkennen, bagatelliseren, nepnieuws verspreiden of alternatieve behandelingen aanbieden

MPs Paulusma and Kuiken asked the Health Minister about doctors and groups denying or downplaying COVID-19, spreading misinformation and offering unproven treatments, and how the IGJ supervises them. The minister condemned the rhetoric, said the IGJ has sent around fifty corrective letters and about ten warnings of possible sanctions, and that the IGJ is preparing a disciplinary complaint, while stating that the tuchtrechter's threshold for acting against doctors' public statements is high.
Over the past months the IGJ has sent roughly fifty corrective letters to doctors who gave evidently incorrect information about the coronavirus or vaccinations.
De IGJ heeft de afgelopen maanden ongeveer vijftig keer een corrigerende brief gestuurd naar artsen die evident onjuiste informatie gaven over het coronavirus of vaccinaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de gevaren voor de gezondheid van borstimplantaten

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a study finding silicone particle migration from breast implants and the risks to women's health, and asked about approval, long-term effects, a possible ban, monitoring, screening, information and insurance coverage for removal. The state secretary said the RIVM is assessing the study and a ban would be disproportionate for now, pointed to tighter EU device rules, ongoing research and reporting, and that removal is covered when medically necessary.
I have asked the RIVM to study and assess the relevant research in more detail.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd het betreffende onderzoek nader te bestuderen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer het artikel ‘Ambulances Noorden komen vaker te laat’

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister whether ambulances in the North of the Netherlands miss the 15-minute response norm, whether everyone is entitled to timely emergency care, and what will be done, with details on how often and where the norm was missed. The minister confirmed that response-time percentages fell in 2020 in most regions including the North, attributed this to COVID-19, said no signs of risk to access or quality were found, and pointed to existing action plans and earlier letters without listing individual incidents.
When an emergency department imposes a time-out, this signals to the ambulance service that the emergency department is very busy.
Wanneer een SEH een time-out instelt, is dit voor de ambulancedienst een signaal dat het erg druk is op de SEH
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan internationale eisen voor antidopingbeleid en de mogelijke sancties voor de Nederlandse Sport

MPs Van der Laan, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands fails to meet WADA's revised anti-doping code, when the government and the anti-doping authority learned of the non-compliance, and what sanctions Dutch sport could face. Minister Blokhuis answered that the independence of the Doping Appeals Committee (BND) is the remaining compliance issue, that legislation is being prepared, and that sanctions would not apply retroactively and could be contested before CAS.
I have answered the questions separately.
Ik heb de vragen afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat er mogelijk tientallen miljoenen publieke gelden voor coronatesten naar bedrijven in belastingparadijzen zouden zijn gevloeid

Two PvdA MPs asked the health and finance ministers whether public funds for COVID tests reached tax-haven companies, and whether the ministry had acted on information from two entrepreneurs. Minister De Jonge replied that there was no evidence of misuse, that invoices are checked and that the ministry did not investigate because no factual proof was provided.
This conversation gave no reason to investigate whether public money had leaked away, because no factual evidence was presented in the conversation.
Dit gesprek heeft geen aanleiding gegeven om te onderzoeken of publiek geld is weggevloeid, omdat in het gesprek geen feitelijk bewijs is overlegd.
Antwoord van de leden Kathmann, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over kleinschalige evenementen die niet door kunnen gaan wegens corona

MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why restaurants with a terrace permit may not organise small events under the COVID-19 rules, and about the economic harm and possible support. The Minister confirmed the rule (article 4.4 of the Trm) is tied to the epidemiological situation, acknowledged the business impact, said the loss of revenue from events is unclear, and pointed to the TVL support scheme and a planned supplementary scheme for night-time hospitality.
For entrepreneurs in sectors including hospitality who lose more than 30% of their income due to the corona measures, the TVL scheme is open among others.
Voor ondernemers uit onder andere de horeca die meer dan 30% van hun inkomsten missen door de coronamaatregelen staat onder meer de TVL regeling open.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wuite over de openbare bibliotheek op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Wuite asked the minister whether the public library on Bonaire, which does not meet the Wsob library law, will be improved and rehoused, including reuse of heritage buildings and tailored support. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance, agreed to form a working group and sign an intention agreement with the island government, and offered support while stressing the island's primary responsibility.
It is important for the residents of Bonaire that they can turn to a full-fledged library.
Het is belangrijk voor de inwoners van Bonaire dat zij terecht kunnen bij een volwaardige bibliotheek.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kathmann en Kuiken over het schietincident bij de ggz-locatie Parnassia

Two MPs asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers about a shooting at a mental health facility, whether the perpetrator's firearm permit had been revoked, whether such persons should be monitored, and how to protect mental health staff from violence. The government answered that the permit was withdrawn and weapons seized, that revoked-permit holders are not specifically monitored under the Firearms Act though past compulsory-care records are weighed in new applications, that no reliable violence statistics exist, and that it will work with sector partners on reporting and a police-mental health cooperation protocol.
Violence against care workers is not subject to a reporting obligation and is not recorded in a uniform way in police systems.
Geweld tegen hulpverleners is niet meldingsplichtig en wordt niet op een eenduidige manier vastgelegd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat kinderrechters alarm slaan vanwege de groeiende wachtlijsten

An MP asked the minister about reports that children's judges sound the alarm over growing waiting lists in youth care, and whether children at risk are being left without protection. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, cited inspection findings that 67% of children under a measure received timely suitable help, and committed to intervention and supervision in several regions.
The Minister for Legal Protection and I take the inspectorates' signal very seriously and intend to take steps in the regions concerned within the framework of inter-administrative supervision.

De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik nemen het signaal van de inspecties zeer serieus en zijn voornemens in de desbetreffende regio's stappen te zetten in het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op van de leden Kuiken en Kathmann inzake de mishandeling van een veertienjarig meisje

MPs Kuiken and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister how he views the assault on a 14-year-old girl, whether he will publicly condemn it and reach out to the victim, and whether a higher maximum sentence for discriminatory motive should be introduced. The minister condemns discrimination in general, declines to comment on the criminal case under investigation, and states that a statutory discriminatory-motive aggravating factor would bring clear benefits, pointing to a pending member's bill.
In the interest of the ongoing criminal investigation in this case, I cannot make further statements about it.
In het belang van het lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoek in deze casus kan ik daar verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over afschalen van bron- en contact onderzoek bij GGD GHOR

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about scaling down contact tracing (BCO) capacity at GGD GHOR amid reports of job cuts at regional services and staffing agencies. The minister said capacity will be kept for now given new variants, that GGDs must be able to perform 4,400 regular BCOs per day, and that staffing-agency contracts will be reduced from 1 July and 1 August 2021, while declining to give exact per-GGD staffing figures before 1 May.
No instruction has been given to scale down.
Er is geen opdracht gegeven om af te schalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paternotte over het gele boekje en de berichtgeving hierover op www.minvws.nl

MPs Kuiken and Paternotte asked the health minister about the legal status of the yellow vaccination booklet for international travel, its recognition abroad, and whether it can be used for COVID-19 vaccination proof. The minister answered that the booklet has official status only for yellow fever under the IHR, that other vaccination records are not governed by IHR standards, and that the EU digital certificate (DCC) with a paper version is the official COVID-19 proof, while acknowledging a late reply.
The yellow booklet has no official status for other vaccinations, in accordance with the International Health Regulations (IHR) (incl. Annex 6 and 7).
Het gele boekje heeft voor andere vaccinaties, conform de regelgeving van de International Health Regulations (IHR) (o.a. Annex 6 en 7) geen officiële status.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over extra steun voor afgelaste festivals en evenementen

Opposition MPs from the PvdA asked the government about financial support for festivals and events cancelled during COVID-19, including gaps in the guarantee scheme, NOW and TVL, and eligibility for non-EU artists. The state secretary answered that support was being extended and a supplementary allowance introduced, but gave no overview of losses and deferred some questions.
There is no overview of the precise losses you ask about.
Er is geen overzicht over de precieze verliezen waar u naar vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over besluiten die mede oorzaak zijn van het hoge aantal besmettingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about COVID-19 measures that contributed to high infection numbers, including BCO staffing, the 24/40-hour validity of tests, post-vaccination waiting periods, and the handling of the Delta variant. The minister answered that BCO capacity was reduced in the low-infection period, that the government deviated from OMT advice in places, that it published Catshuis documents for 9 July, and that a further Intra Action Review would await ongoing evaluations.
I have chosen that, after completion of vaccinations from 10 July for all vaccine types, the corresponding corona access certificates only become valid after 14 days.
Ik heb er voor gekozen om na afronding van vaccinaties vanaf 10 juli jl, voor alle type vaccins, de bijbehorende coronatoegangsbewijzen pas na 14 dagen geldig te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Ikke prikken – en de rest kan stikken'

MPs Westerveld and Kuiken asked the health minister about a report on the vaccination rollout, including why the most vulnerable were not invited first and why medical-risk invitations were delayed. The minister defended the prioritisation as based on Gezondheidsraad and OMT advice and scarce supply, and said the strategy and sequencing were discussed in parliament.
Because of the limited available quantity of vaccines, the cabinet had to make choices in the order in which people could be vaccinated.
Vanwege de beperkte beschikbare hoeveelheid vaccins heeft het kabinet keuzes moeten maken in de volgorde waarin mensen gevaccineerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de bewezen ernstige gevolgen van siliconen borstimplantaten

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about reports that breast implants cause serious harm, including whether women are adequately warned, whether the inspectorate should act, and whether routine MRI screening and removal coverage should change. The minister says she cannot verify every surgeon's counselling but points to patient information, a planned IGJ thematic inspection, a RIVM research programme, and a standing Zorginstituut position under which removal is reimbursed only for medical necessity, with no change planned for now.
It is of course not possible for me to check whether every plastic surgeon informs the woman correctly and fully, because I am not present in every treatment room.
Het is voor mij natuurlijk niet mogelijk om te controleren of elke plastisch chirurg de vrouw op de juiste wijze en volledig voorlicht, omdat ik niet aanwezig ben in iedere behandelkamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de zogenoemde mondkapjesdeal

MPs Kuiken, Paternotte and Bikker asked the Minister about the face-mask deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including stock levels, objections raised by the LCH, alternative suppliers, contacts between ministers and RGA, and advance payments. The Minister answered mostly by pointing to a forthcoming Deloitte review, shared some documents, withheld details of the other large contracts pending receipt, and committed to passing many questions to the researchers.
I will ask the research bureau to include this question in the supplementary investigation and also to address the reason why protest was lodged where this happened.
Ik zal het onderzoeksbureau vragen om deze vraag mee te nemen in het aanvullende onderzoek en dan ook in te gaan op de reden waarom er protest werd aangetekend indien dit gebeurde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over fraude met coronaverklaringen

An MP asked the health and justice ministers about fraud with forged COVID test certificates and how it is being tackled, including whether sites offering them can be taken offline and whether certification is needed. The minister acknowledged the fraud risk, said the IGJ supervises testing providers and that the Public Prosecution Service would assess concrete signals, and pointed to the EU Digital COVID Certificate as the main fix.

Fraud with test certificates is in a sense easy as long as a test result is a document without fixed form and it is not feasible for countries to verify the authenticity of a test certificate from another country.

Fraude met testverklaringen is in zekere zin eenvoudig zolang een testuitslag een vormvrij document is en het niet goed mogelijk is voor landen om de authenticiteit van een testbewijs uit een ander land vast te stellen.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Paternotte en Kuiken over het besluit het AstraZeneca-vaccin alleen in te zetten bij 60-plussers

MPs Paternotte and Kuiken asked why the government restricted AstraZeneca vaccination to people aged 60 and over, given the Health Council's risk comparison and EMA's benefit-risk conclusion, and asked about related rollout, risk and supply questions. Minister De Jonge answered at length, defending the age limit with mortality risk figures, stating that alternative vaccines were arranged for under-60s, and describing vaccine supply and donation plans.
After advice from the Health Council, the cabinet decided to use the AstraZeneca vaccine only for people aged 60 and over.
heb aangegeven heeft het kabinet na advies van de Gezondheidsraad besloten het AstraZeneca-vaccin enkel te gebruiken bij mensen van 60 jaar en ouder.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over het zonder opleiding, met een strafblad en onder valse titel verlenen van zorg

An MP asks how a youth-care director with a criminal record, no training and a misused psychotherapist title could obtain a certificate of conduct (VOG) and keep working, and what oversight failed. The government answers that the VOG was issued after a screening-profile error that is being corrected, that the inspectorate warned the director over the title, and that governance and declaration-fraud investigations are ongoing, with the inspectorate pursuing a new inspection visit.
Because the requested function combined unusually with the indicated screening profile, Justis requested the job description.
Doordat er sprake was van een ongebruikelijke combinatie van de beoogde functie en het aangegeven screeningsprofiel is de functieomschrijving door Justis opgevraagd.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over de werking van vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 bij patiënten die worden behandeld vanwege een auto-immuunziekte

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether vaccine effectiveness against COVID-19 in immunocompromised patients is adequately studied, whether drug package inserts and vaccination guidance are sufficient, and what protection will be given to these patients and unvaccinated people. The minister answered that studies via ZonMw are ongoing, that existing guidelines already address reduced vaccine response, that a booster question is under advice, and that he will keep monitoring and inform clinicians and patients, without committing to new binding measures like mask mandates or entry tests.
There are patient groups where there is a suspicion that the COVID-19 vaccination will have insufficient effect.
Er zijn patiëntgroepen waarbij het vermoeden bestaat dat de vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 onvoldoende effect zal hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Özütok en Westerveld over de blijvende tekorten voor jeugdzorg bij gemeenten

MPs Kuiken, Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the government should have resolved the chronic youth care funding shortfall at municipalities earlier, and why no extra money was provided now. The State Secretary replied that the government granted temporary funds (over EUR 1 billion for 2021 and EUR 1.314 billion for 2022), agreed savings with municipalities, committed to a reform agenda, and that a new cabinet must decide on structural funding taking the Commission of Wise Men's ruling as a weighty input.
The cabinet makes available an additional EUR 1.314 billion to municipalities in 2022 for the youth care shortfalls.
Het kabinet stelt in 2022 € 1,314 miljard extra beschikbaar aan gemeenten voor de tekorten vanwege de jeugdzorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jehova’s Getuigen proberen gespreksverslagen te bemachtigen die zijn opgemaakt in het onderzoek naar misbruik bij de Jehova’s Getuigen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether the Jehovah's Witnesses' attempts to obtain interview records from a university abuse study endanger victims' anonymity and why the organisation is pursuing them. Minister Dekker answered that participants were promised confidentiality, that a privacy impact assessment was made, that he is disappointed in the organisation's legal action, and that he sees no point in discussing the requests' motives with its leadership.

The people who reported there were informed that their information is treated confidentially and that their personal data will not be shared with the Jehovah's Witnesses community or other third parties.

De personen die zich daar hebben gemeld, zijn geïnformeerd over het feit dat hun informatie vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld en dat hun persoonsgegevens niet met de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen of andere derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Paternotte en Bikker over de mondkapjesdeal

Three MPs (Kuiken, Paternotte, Bikker) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the face mask purchase deal with Relief Goods Alliance, including overpayment, contacts with the initiators, disclosure of documents, and the role of the minister and secretary-general. The minister answered that the prices fell within the reasonable range at the time, shared a timeline of contacts and two purchase orders, but declined to publish the general conditions and deferred disclosure of the initiators' presentation to the company.
I have no objection to sharing this, but VWS is not the owner of this document.
Ik heb er geen bezwaar tegen om deze te delen, maar VWS is niet de eigenaar van dit document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht 'Faillissement van BOPEC kost overheid Bonaire € 300.000'

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about the bankruptcy of oil company BOPEC on Bonaire, its skeleton crew for safety risks, union involvement, responsibility for safety, the role of government policy, and the Bonaire public body's bridging credit. The government answered that the curator and regulators (ILT, RWS) selected the skeleton crew after a union-agreed list became unworkable, that safety responsibility lies with the licence holder and then the curator, and that the Bonaire body granted a 250,000 USD contribution consistent with the Wet FinBES.
The OLB has in the meantime committed a contribution of 250,000 dollars.
Het OLB heeft inmiddels een bijdrage van 250.000 dollar toegezegd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paulusma over het bericht dat het Zorginstituut Nederland adviseert om een nieuw medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte niet op te nemen in het basispakket vanwege de te hoge prijs van f

MPs Kuiken and Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's advice not to add the cystic fibrosis drug Kaftrio to the basic package because of Vertex's price, and about joint European negotiation, transparency and legal tools against high drug prices. The Minister replied that the Institute advised conditional inclusion (including a price reduction), that joint Benelux negotiation was not considered opportune, that new price deals for existing CFTR modulators are not yet decided, and that she is pursuing price transparency and referred to her policy letter for further measures.
Joint negotiation is complex because the agreements already made on Orkambi and Symkevi are confidential.
Anderzijds is gezamenlijk onderhandelen complex omdat de reeds gemaakte afspraken over Orkambi en Symkevi vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden leden Kuiken en Diertens over het bericht ‘Raad van State Rijkswet COHO strijdig met Statuut’

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked the State Secretary for the Interior whether the COHO Kingdom Act was checked for legal compliance with the Statute, and about its consequences if the Council of State finds it conflicts with the Statute. The State Secretary answered that legal review took place, though under time pressure and only partially, that the Council of State did not find a conflict but has doubts on some parts, and that the consequences for the country packages and financial support are still being discussed with the Caribbean countries.
The department preparing the bill is primarily responsible for a proposal, and therefore also for its legal quality.
Het departement dat het wetsvoorstel voorbereidt is primair verantwoordelijk voor een voorstel, en dus ook voor de juridische kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het intimideren van linkse politici

The MP Kuiken asked the ministers whether intimidating stickers and visits at private addresses targeting left-wing politicians are unacceptable, how many complaints have been filed, what the Data Protection Authority can do about doxing, and when an internet-bullying policy framework will be ready. Minister Grapperhaus answered that such intimidation is unacceptable, that ten complaints were filed with four still under investigation, that the Data Protection Authority can act against doxing, and that the framework was delivered in February 2021.
Aggression and intimidation are therefore completely unacceptable.
Agressie en intimidatie zijn daarom volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Hijink over het bericht 'Durfinvesteerders zien brood in tieners met lichte psychische klachten, zwaardere patiënten belanden op wachtlijst'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Hijink asked about reports that venture investors target teenagers with mild mental health complaints while severe patients face waiting lists, and about profit limits, foreign investment and the treatment of suicidal youth. The state secretary said gemeenten can set profit caps and tariffs, pointed to the planned Wibz and Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen, and reported that only a few investment firms are active in youth care.
I do not have an overview of the owners of institutions in youth mental health care.
Ik heb geen overzicht van eigenaren van instellingen in de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het artikel 'Afgewezen zorgaanbieders glippen weer binnen via de achterdeur'

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers why DJI contracted and extended Stichting OnderDak after an inspectorate found insufficient oversight, and how information-sharing between care purchasers is restricted. The minister answered that DJI knew of the inspection findings, intensified contract management, and pointed to a pending bill and the inspectorate's oversight limits.
The Public Prosecution Service, in the interest of a possible criminal investigation, does not comment on whether a criminal investigation is being conducted in a specific case.

Het Openbaar Ministerie doet in het belang van een eventueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen uitspraak over de vraag of in een specifiek geval al dan niet een strafrechtelijk onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verantwoordelijkheid van de Inspectie gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) bij meldingen over bijwerkingen van medische hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the minister how many complaints about the Essure implant reached the health inspectorate IGZ/IGJ from 2001 to 2017, what concrete steps it took and when, whether it adequately assessed the product's benefits against its risks, and whether it has adequate post-market surveillance and responsibility for handling such complaints. The minister answered with complaint figures from 2012 onward, described a chronology of consultations, Europe-wide coordination and a 2016 RIVM study, and argued that the inspectorate acted appropriately while the notified body and manufacturer carry primary responsibility.
The inspectorate continues to follow this file and is currently examining information recently obtained from research into the removal of Essure coils.
De inspectie blijft dit dossier volgen en onderzoekt momenteel informatie die recent beschikbaar is gekomen uit onderzoek naar het verwijderen van Essure-veertjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toegenomen geweldscriminaliteit onder jongeren

MP Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why the number of minors suspected of serious violent crime rose for two years running, whether this reflects better visibility, and what broader approach is planned. Minister Grapperhaus answered that juvenile crime overall is falling but that a worrying rise in serious violence is being monitored, that a fuller explanation needs further research, and that prevention, the Wapens en Jongeren action plan and neighbourhood approaches are being pursued, while committing to inform parliament before summer.
The Minister for Legal Protection will inform your House further about developments in juvenile crime before the summer.
De Minister voor Rechtsbescherming zal uw Kamer voor de zomer nader informeren over de ontwikkelingen in de jeugdcriminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de ontwikkelingen van de gezondheidssituatie op Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 hospitalisations, the call centre, vaccination capacity, reduced regular care and overload risk on Bonaire and Curaçao, and whether a negative PCR test should be required for travellers to the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered with figures, reports of resolved call-centre problems, cross-island patient transfers, and the designation of the islands as high-risk areas with testing obligations.
Talks are also being held about transferring patients to other countries in the region when local capacity proves insufficient despite joint efforts.
Ook worden gesprekken gevoerd over de overplaatsing van patiënten naar andere landen in de regio, wanneer de lokale capaciteit ondanks gezamenlijke inspanningen onvoldoende blijken te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Curaçao kan geen coronapatiënten meer opnemen, IC ligt helemaal vol'

MP Kuiken asked the health and kingdom relations ministers how the government will support Curaçao after reports that its ICU was full and it could no longer take COVID patients, and whether the navy ship Karel Doorman could be deployed. The Staatssecretaris answered by pointing to a letter on three support lines, to cross-island hospital cooperation, extra staff and equipment, and patient transfers, while stating that VWS has no authority over the Karel Doorman and that no assistance request has been made to Defence.
The Ministry of VWS has no authority over the deployment of the ZMS Karel Doorman.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen zeggenschap over de inzet van de ZMS Karel Doorman.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over misleidende informatie van fabrikanten van hartkleppen

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care about manufacturers of heart valves allegedly giving misleading size information on packaging, possible harm to patients, the roles of the IGJ and RIVM, unregistered implants and undisclosed Medtronic consultancy contracts. The Minister answers that no harm or wrongful valve sizing has been established, that existing rules and standards are adequate for now, that the IGJ saw no reason for enforcement, and that the transparency register is functioning well, while promising further talks with the IGJ and professional groups.
I will however discuss with the IGJ whether improvements to the system of standards can still be achieved.
Ik zal wel met de IGJ in gesprek gaan of er nog verbeteringen in het systeem van normen zijn te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van Ojik en Leijten over het bericht ‘Statement of the Members of the European Council’

MPs Kuiken, Van Ojik and Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the European Council's March 2021 statement to start work on modernising the EU-Turkey customs union squared with the minister's earlier remarks, and why it should not be paused given Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and moves against the HDP. The government replied that the customs union has not been decided, that discussion only starts under the positive agenda conditional on de-escalation, and that human rights and the rule of law must remain part of the EU-Turkey dialogue, with the minister having raised these concerns directly with Turkey.
The cabinet will reiterate this in relevant new discussions with colleagues.
Het kabinet zal dit bij relevante nieuwe discussies met collega’s opnieuw benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over spionage in de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that Chinese-owned Nuctech customs scanners at Rotterdam port could be used for espionage, and what security assessment was made at purchase. The government answered that risks exist, customs has commissioned an external audit of the scanner systems, and it gives no operational detail on intelligence service knowledge.
Customs is having an external audit carried out on the scanning and detection systems and related IT setup, to ensure the scanning and detection processes are arranged as securely as possible.
De Douane laat een externe audit uitvoeren op de scan- en detectiesystemen en daaraan gerelateerde IT-inrichting, om te verzekeren dat de scan- en detectieprocessen zo veilig mogelijk zijn ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Tientallen jongeren de dupe van sluiting De Hoenderloo Groep, beloofde 'passende vervolgplek' is er niet gekomen'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Kwint asked why dozens of youths from the closed Hoenderloo Groep lack a lasting placement after its closure, and whether the promised 'suitable follow-up placement' was broken. The Staatssecretaris answers that all youths had a placement on closure day, that some later placements proved unsuitable and are being addressed by Pluryn, municipalities and the inspectorate, and that the government is strengthening continuity-of-care rules.
I do not share the view of the questioners that Pluryn has broken the promise that every youth would receive a follow-up placement.
Ik deel het oordeel van de vragenstellers niet dat Pluryn de belofte heeft geschonden dat elke jongere een vervolgplek krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken en Van den Hul over de vaccinatiestrategie voor kwetsbaren

MPs Westerveld, Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the health minister about the vaccination strategy for vulnerable people, including people in voluntary quarantine, children who cannot attend school, the risk groups, and the timing of vaccinations for those with medical indications. The minister answered that the government does not track the number of people in voluntary quarantine, that schools are expected to keep in contact with vulnerable pupils and find alternative education, and that vaccination for the highest-risk groups has started with the Gezondheidsraad's advice still pending for children.
The behavioural unit does not record who is in voluntary quarantine.
Door de gedragsunit wordt niet geregistreerd wie er in vrijwillige quarantaine is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over zorgverzekeraars die ALS-patiënten op oneigenlijke gronden overhevelen naar de langdurige zorg.

MP Kuiken asks whether insurers push ALS patients into long-term care (Wlz) by challenging their indications, and whether this is financially motivated and consistent with the duty of care. The minister answers that insurers may not force a Wlz application, that palliative terminal patients keep their insurance-based care, that risk-equalisation settles costs and that the NZa is handling the complaint independently.
A health insurer cannot force a client to apply for a Wlz indication.
Een zorgverzekeraar kan een cliënt niet dwingen om een indicatie voor de Wlz aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht “ondernemingsraad Intervence: stem medewerker niet meegenomen in plan”

An MP from the Labour party asked the state secretary whether it is wise that the works council's voice was left out of the bankrupt youth-care provider Intervence's transition plan, and how staff will be involved. The minister answered that staff involvement is important, that the Zeeland municipalities and Intervence's board are responsible for informing staff, and that the takeover scenario will be reviewed by the inspectorates and the Youth Authority.
The board of Intervence is primarily responsible for timely informing and involving staff in the takeover scenario.
De bestuurder van Intervence is primair verantwoordelijk voor het tijdig informeren en betrekken van medewerkers bij het overnamescenario.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de lange wachttijden in de ggz in Groningen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health why mental health waiting times in Groningen exceed the 14-week norm, what has been done over four years, and what new steps will be taken. The State Secretary confirmed the specialised mental health waits exceed the norm, described measures such as regional taskforces, transfer mechanisms and a regional enforcement power, and said the problem is too complex for a quick fix.
I am in discussions with regions where the problem is greatest.
Ik ben in gesprek met regio's waar de problematiek het grootst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een explosieve toename hacks en datadiefstal

MP Kuiken asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the sharp rise in hacking and data theft, whether it leads to fraud, whether organisations handle personal data carefully, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) lacks capacity to act on breaches. The minister confirmed the rise, said the link to specific fraud cannot be traced, attributed carelessness partly to awareness, and stated that AP capacity is a matter of reprioritisation and that budget increases must wait for a new cabinet.
It is not possible to state whether the failure to act on reported data breaches is due to a lack of capacity.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven of het niet oppakken van gemelde datalekken te wijten is aan capaciteitsgebrek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de blijvende achterstand bij het behandelen van ernstige zedendelicten

An MP asks the Justice Minister why rape reports wait up to a year for police attention, and whether the 6-month target for sending files to the prosecutor is being met. The Minister acknowledges the problem, points to the Inspectorate report, the 15 million euro investment, staffing increases and improvement measures, but gives no guarantee on timelines and notes that the capacity is still insufficient.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het inschakelen van burgers bij de bestrijding van ondermijning

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how citizens can report signals of undermining crime, how false suspicions can be prevented, and whether a single central reporting point should be created. The Minister described existing reporting channels (police, Meld Misdaad Anoniem, municipalities, FIOD), campaigns to raise reporting willingness, and safeguards requiring suspicions to rest on facts, while rejecting the need for one central reporting point.
A suspicion must be based on facts and circumstances.
Een verdenking moet zijn gebaseerd op feiten en omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de vraag of de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland voldoende kan worden versneld

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health whether the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy could be accelerated, comparing it with other EU countries and asking about preparations, private partners and vaccine stockpiles. The minister answered that Dutch preparations target up to 2.5 million vaccinations per week from May, that private and armed-forces support is being used, and that stock levels per vaccine were reported, with AstraZeneca stock expected to be worked down within two weeks.
I expect that this high AstraZeneca stock level will be worked down within two weeks.
Ik verwacht dat deze hoge voorraadstand AstraZeneca binnen twee weken is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onderhandelingen over de politie-cao

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police unions' threatened action over the police collective labour agreement signals that pay must rise, and whether recruitment problems require better terms. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government values police work and seeks pay development following the private sector, and that the police have no general recruitment problem beyond specialist roles.
In this light, a good offer on wage development has been put forward during the negotiations with the police unions.
In dit licht is er tijdens de onderhandelingen met de politievakbonden een goed bod voor loonontwikkeling neergelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Voordewind en Kuiken over het bericht 'Achterstanden bij IND in behandeling asielaanvragen zijn groter dan gemeld bij de Tweede Kamer'

MPs Groothuizen, Voordewind and Kuiken asked whether the IND's backlog of asylum applications is larger than reported to parliament, and why repeat applications from before 1 April 2020 are not all handled by the Taskforce. The State Secretary denies that the backlog is larger, explains the Taskforce scope and the 15,350-case figure, and describes how repeat applicants are notified and scheduled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bejegening van LHBT-asielzoekers door het COA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that LGBT asylum seekers were mistreated by COA staff, including a threat with a knife and a transfer described as deportation, and whether COA staff are trained to treat them with tact. The State Secretary did not recognise the picture painted by the reports, declined to discuss individual cases, pointed to a letter of 5 March on LGBTI safety measures, and said COA residents were informed of the evening curfew before transfers.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de problemen met briefstemmen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about invalid postal votes, the expected share of invalid ballots, and whether votes with the passpass and ballot in the same envelope should still be counted despite the secrecy of the vote. The Minister said some municipal postal-vote boards found no passpass in return envelopes, outlined a procedure approved by the Electoral Council and Council of State that lets boards open the inner envelope only to check the passpass so the ballot is counted without being viewed, and sent this to municipalities.
Therefore no votes will be lost from voters who put a ballot envelope containing the passpass and ballot into their return envelope.
Daarmee gaan dus geen stemmen verloren van kiezers die in hun retourenvelop een briefstembiljetenvelop hebben gestopt met daarin de stempluspas en het briefstembiljet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over aanhoudende berichten over ongeldige briefstemmen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of large numbers of invalid postal votes in the March 2021 election, including how many were set aside, why, and whether they could still be counted. The minister said no national count of set-aside votes exists yet, that procedures and guidance have been issued, that the first 400,000 misdelivered envelopes were being redistributed to other municipalities, and that the House itself can open sealed ballot packages to investigate validity.
I therefore do not currently have figures on the total number of set-aside or invalid votes.
Ik beschik nu dus niet over cijfers over het totaalaantal terzijdeleggingen of ongeldige stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over illegale aanbieders van online kansspelen die mogelijk in aanmerking willen komen voor een vergunning

MP Kuiken asks whether illegal online gambling operators who have operated since 2019 may obtain a licence, citing the Kansspelautoriteit report estimating a 400 million euro market mostly illegal, and invokes earlier motions. The Minister says applicants' past illegal conduct is weighed on reliability, a two-year good-conduct period applies per the Postema motion, and the Ksa applies a policy rule with criteria assessed over two years and nine months before application.
An operator that has in the past actively offered illegally can remove doubt about its reliability by showing good conduct over a continuous period before the licence application.

Een aanbieder die in het verleden actief illegaal heeft aangeboden kan de twijfel over zijn betrouwbaarheid wegnemen door gedurende een aaneengesloten periode voorafgaand aan de vergunningaanvraag goed gedrag te laten zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Kerstens en Kuiken over zorgcowboys die gemeenten op kosten jagen

MPs Nijboer, Kerstens and Kuiken asked about 'zorgcowboys' moving clients across the country to the detriment of municipalities, municipal financial strain in youth care, benefits and shelter, and whether this causes social rental housing construction problems and gatekeeping of care. Minister De Jonge answered that no signals of such practices were received, pointed to COVID compensation, extra youth-care funds and the planned residence-principle reforms, and largely deferred the structural funding question to a future cabinet.
Decision-making on a structural solution in terms of adjusting the system from 2022 and the required budget will be left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over een structurele oplossing in termen van aanpassing in het stelsel vanaf 2022 en benodigd budget, zal aan een volgend kabinet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over ongeregeldheden in Urk

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about riots and arson in Urk linked to COVID-19 measures, whether the violence was unacceptable, why it escalated despite police reinforcements, and whether the mayor was supported and enough enforcement was in place. The minister condemned the violence, said enforcement is the mayor's responsibility under the municipal council, described contacts with the mayor and support networks, and said the situation had calmed.
The mayor is responsible for maintaining public order and is accountable to the municipal council for this.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de openbare orde en legt daarover verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dam over een promotiefilm voor het songfestival op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Van Dam asked whether the minister refused a drone permit for a promotional film on Bonaire for the Eurovision Song Contest and why. The minister confirmed a request was received, stated that the Luchtverkeer BES decree bars drone flights without a pilot aboard and offers no exemption, and said drone rules for the Caribbean islands are being developed with consultation.
Therefore flying a drone in the airspace above Bonaire is not permitted.
Daarom is het vliegen met een drone in het luchtruim boven Bonaire niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de toename van seksueel geweld tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked ministers whether reported rises in sexual violence during the coronavirus crisis, based on a Rutgers study, are alarming and how they relate to domestic violence, police and prosecution data, and youth sexual health. The government answered that the Rutgers study does not show an increase in sexual violence, that police and prosecution data show fewer reports in 2020, and it pointed to existing campaigns and prevention programmes for youth.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de gang van zaken rond het naar buiten brengen van het besluit over de opening van kinderopvang en basisscholen

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked why the government publicly signalled reopening of primary schools and childcare before the OMT advice existed, how the OMT reasoned, and how safe reopening and testing capacity could be ensured. Minister De Jonge answered that hope for reopening preceded the advice, that the OMT weighed social interests alongside epidemiological risk, and that extra measures and testing were planned, while declining to disclose the OMT's internal vote and not answering the question on the exact timing of measures in full detail.
To enable an open exchange of views within the OMT, no statements are made about this exchange and the discussion remains confidential.
Om een open gedachtewisseling in het OMT mogelijk te maken, worden geen uitspraken gedaan over deze gedachtewisseling en blijft de bespreking vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Verzet tegen plan Bonaire voor containerhaven'

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that a container port near Hato on Bonaire would damage a pristine reef in a marine park, and what steps it will take. The minister replied that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive council, that a further feasibility study was agreed in the convenant, that an environmental impact assessment (MER) will be required later, and that no planning study has been commissioned yet.
The decision on whether, and where, a new cargo port should be built rests with the Bonaire executive council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht 'Wat er met Ali, Samoal, Ibrahim gebeurde na hun uitzetting naar Soedan'

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Voordewind asked whether the government monitors asylum seekers deported to Sudan, whether the NISS mistreats returnees, and why deportations continued despite reports of torture. The State Secretary answered that post-return monitoring is not part of Dutch return policy, that no concrete evidence of irregularities linked to deportations was received, and that Sudan is considered safe enough for returns.
Monitoring does not form part of the Dutch return policy.
Monitoring geen deel uitmaakt van het Nederlandse terugkeerbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Eerst Assads strijder, nu asiel in Nederland’?

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether IND granted residence to Assad regime affiliates, why few 1F exclusions were applied, why prosecution has lagged behind Germany, why reports from the Syrian community went unanswered, and how victims are protected from threats. The minister declines to discuss individual cases, defends the existing 1F policy and the Team Internationale Misdrijven, admits one unanswered report due to an error, and points to existing protection measures without new commitments.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet in gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok, Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Onverwacht zwanger door nieuw koperspiraaltje'

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of unexpected pregnancies and expulsions linked to the Ballerine copper IUD, including how adverse events are reported, what risk assessment is underway, and how EU medical device rules and notified body oversight will protect patients. The Minister answered that the IGJ is analysing the reports, that a MEBI alert is planned, and that the EU MDR applying from May 2021 will tighten requirements, while acknowledging room for improvement.
Furthermore, I call on healthcare providers, manufacturers and patients to continue reporting their complaints and side effects related to medical devices through the available channels.
Verder roep ik zorgverleners, fabrikanten en patiënten op hun klachten en bijwerkingen met betrekking tot medische hulpmiddelen te blijven melden via de beschikbare kanalen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Kerstens over de zorgbonus die pas in 2023 wordt uitgekeerd

Three PvdA MPs asked why some care workers may not receive the 1,000 euro corona bonus until 2023, why small care organisations remain unclear about eligibility, and whether workers should be asked to sign repayment undertakings. The minister called waiting until 2023 unacceptable under the subsidy rules, said workers should not bear the risk of repayment, and noted most subsidies have already been paid out while directing questions to the employer and DUS-I.
Following these reports I have already told employers what the intention is and asked them to act in line with the purpose, conditions and obligations of the Subsidy Scheme.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van deze berichten reeds richting werkgevers aangegeven wat de bedoeling is en hen verzocht in lijn met het doel, de voorwaarden en de verplichtingen van de Subsidieregeling te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kuiken over crisismeldingen in de jeugd-ggz

MP Kuiken (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported rise in crisis referrals in youth mental health care, difficulty finding beds for acutely ill young people, long waiting times, and calls for structural funding. The State Secretary confirmed the rise, pointed to an ongoing survey of regions, a crisis bed app, and existing extra funds, and said a study on structural funding would be submitted to the incoming cabinet, without committing to new money now.
To get a sharper picture of the capacity and bottlenecks in specialist youth mental health care, I have agreed with the VNG to map this as quickly as possible.
Om scherper zicht op te krijgen op de capaciteit en knelpunten rondom specialistische j-ggz zorg heb ik met de VNG afgesproken om dit zo snel mogelijk in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over de bureaucratie waarmee Ranov-vergunninghouders worden tegengewerkt bij het verkrijgen van het Nederlanderschap

MPs Van Ojik, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked why Ranov permit holders who have lived in the Netherlands for decades must meet a strict document requirement to naturalise, and whether the requirement should be dropped or Ranov permits converted to asylum permits. The State Secretary answers that individual exceptions are possible, that Ranov holders were found not to need protection and can be expected to obtain documents from their country of origin, and that a new WODC study will examine problems Ranov holders experience.

The policy ensures that, in the naturalisation procedure, the personal details and current possession of a foreign nationality are as far as possible known and demonstrated for foreigners with a regular right of residence.

Het beleid borgt dat in de naturalisatieprocedure zo goed als mogelijk de persoonsgegevens en het actueel bezit van de vreemde nationaliteit bekend en aangetoond zijn van vreemdelingen met een regulier verblijfrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Geen enkel alleenstaand kind uit kamp Moria is in Nederland aangekomen’

MP Kuiken asked whether the promised relocation of unaccompanied minors from Moria has been met, given that no such child had arrived, and whether the government will take more people from Greece. The State Secretary answered that two unaccompanied minors arrived in January, declined to comment on individual cases, defended the selection of vulnerable people from several Greek locations, and said no additional relocation offer is planned.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Driejarig meisje gevonden in modder van Moria, na vermoedelijke verkrachting’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether the government shares outrage over reports of a three-year-old girl sexually assaulted in the Moria camp area, whether the new Mavrovouni camp on Lesbos falls short on safety for vulnerable people, and whether the Netherlands will take in more vulnerable people. The State Secretary answered that the government shares the concern and cites safety improvements at Mavrovouni, but says conditions still fall short of standards and that no additional resettlement offer will be made beyond the existing commitments.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional resettlement offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen die in Nederland aankwamen, waren al statushouders in Griekenland’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether only 50 of the promised 100 children and vulnerable people had arrived from Greece, whether recent arrivals already held Greek status, whether the government would meet the Moria deal, and whether it would reverse returns and act on conditions on Lesbos. The government answered that it will not make an additional relocation offer, that status holders in the Netherlands are returned to Greece as lawful under EU rules, and that conditions at Mavrovouni are better than at Moria though still needing structural improvement.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional relocation offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over stemmen per brief

An MP asked whether rising coronavirus risk at polling stations justifies widening postal voting beyond voters aged 70 and over. The minister replied that postal voting for all voters is undesirable because secrecy and freedom of the vote cannot be guaranteed as at a polling station, and that the timeline of the Electoral Act makes it unfeasible.
Postal voting for everyone is, in the government's view, undesirable.
Briefstemmen voor iedereen is naar de overtuiging van de regering onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Brandbom bij Syrisch gezin in Heerlen’

MP Kuiken asked the Justice minister about a firebomb attack on a Syrian family in Heerlen, including prior police reports, whether police and local authorities acted early, whether the family received protection, and what steps will improve neighbourhood safety. Minister Grapperhaus said local authorities hold primary responsibility, the municipality led the response with camera surveillance and temporary rehousing, a review will be started, and he declined to comment on individual police investigations.
Local liveability and safety are primarily the responsibility of the local government.
De lokale leefbaarheid en veiligheid is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van het lokale bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het onbereikbaar maken van Nederlanderschap

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why raising the naturalisation language requirement to B1 would make citizenship unreachable for many newcomers, including low-literate refugees, and what the consequences would be for voting rights and daily life. The State Secretary defended the B1 requirement as the crown on successful integration, pointed to the Z-route and the option procedure, and said the draft naturalisation test decree was still under review after consultation.
The coalition agreement states that the language requirement for both integration and naturalisation will be raised to B1 of the Common European Framework.
In het regeerakkoord is opgenomen dat zowel voor inburgering als voor naturalisatie de taaleis wordt verhoogd naar B1 van het Referentiekader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de anonimiteit van homoseksuele asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether a published article naming and photographing a rejected gay asylum-seeking couple, without clear consent, was taken down, whether consent was given, whether publication endangers them on return, and whether their asylum case will be reconsidered. The State Secretary confirmed the article was removed from the website and government channels, said consent was not unambiguous and the magazine will tighten safeguards, but declined to comment on individual cases and only generally said all relevant facts are considered.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de verder verslechterde financiële positie van jeugdzorginstelling Elker

Kuiken and Nijboer (PvdA) asked the state secretary about Elker's deteriorating finances, possible dismissals amid high sickness absence, and whether the ministry would intervene to prevent bankruptcy. The secretary answered that providers and municipalities are responsible, that continuity of care is paramount, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and municipalities are in talks, with emergency liquidity support available only under strict conditions.
In extreme cases, youth care providers can apply for temporary liquidity support under the subsidy scheme 'Continuity of crucial youth care'.
In uiterste gevallen kunnen jeugdzorgaanbieders een aanvraag indienen voor tijdelijke liquiditeitssteun op basis van de subsidieregeling «Continuïteit cruciale jeugdzorg».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de verblijfstitel voor personen tijdens de coronatijd in Nederland

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how COVID-19 travel restrictions affect the permitted stay of foreign nationals, including those with Dutch partners, and whether leniency and entry bans would be avoided. The State Secretary answered that overstay caused by COVID-19 travel restrictions counts as force majeure, that partner status is not weighed at the border, and that leniency is applied in such cases, with a reference to the long-distance relationship scheme.
An situation of force majeure arises when the foreign national can demonstrate that an earlier departure was not possible due to travel restrictions in connection with COVID-19.
Er ontstaat een overmachtssituatie wanneer de vreemdeling kan aantonen dat een eerder vertrek niet mogelijk was vanwege reisbeperkingen in het kader van COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over vervoer na overlijden bij overplaatsing naar een ander ziekenhuis
