MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether relatives of COVID-19 patients who died after transfer to another hospital face high costs for transporting the body home, and how that is communicated. The Minister said about 30 such deaths are estimated, 34 relatives applied to the Ombudsman for Funeral Services for a contribution, and insurers have shown goodwill, with the Ombudsman acting as contact point for those affected.
That is why I am willing to bear these extra costs and have got the Ombudsman for Funeral Services to act as a contact point for anyone affected.
Daarom ben ik bereid deze extra kosten te dragen en heb ik de Ombudsman voor het Uitvaartwezen bereid gevonden om als aanspreekpunt voor eventuele gedupeerden te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over sluiten van jeugdzorginstelling Intervence

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister whether they accept the closure of youth care provider Intervence in Zeeland, whether the timeline is feasible, what happens to children and staff, and what the government will do about financial mismanagement and its own role. The government answers that municipalities chose to split Intervence's youth protection work among three other providers, that care continues until transfers are complete, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and inspectorates must approve a transition plan before any irreversible steps, with the government promising interbestuurlijk toezicht if continuity is not assured.

If, according to the JA and the inspectorates, the continuity and quality of care are not secured, we will hold the municipalities to account and, where necessary, take measures within the framework of interadministrative supervision.

Als de continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg volgens de JA en de inspecties niet geborgd is, zullen wij de gemeenten daarop aanspreken en zo nodig maatregelen treffen in het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het artikel 'Kabinet gaat noodtoestand gebruiken voor avondklok'

MP Kuiken asked the Prime Minister whether the government would activate emergency powers under the Wet Buitengewone Bevoegdheden Burgerlijk Gezag for a curfew, whether this bypasses parliament, and whether parliament would be consulted. The government denied activating the act for now, explained that emergency powers are activated by royal decree followed by a bill to parliament, and committed to notifying parliament of any curfew intention unless urgency prevents it.
notification of the intention will be given to the States General, so that a exchange of views between government and States General can take place if desired
zal van het voornemen daartoe mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het seksueel misbruik van jongeren in de gehandicaptenzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked about sexual abuse of young people in disability care, citing reports that it is barely addressed, and asked about prevention measures, incident counts, reporting levels, and whether staff dismissed for abuse can move to other care jobs. The minister outlined prevention materials, the mandatory reporting duty to the inspectorate (90 reports in 2019), screening tools like VOG and the Waarschuwingsregister, and said she sees no clear sign of low reporting but will act if it exists.
Unfortunately we can never fully rule out that a situation arises in which someone moves on to work elsewhere in care after abuse has taken place.
Helaas kunnen we nooit helemaal uitsluiten dat zich een situatie voordoet waarin iemand elders in de zorg aan de slag gaat, nadat er misbruik heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een lesbische asielzoekster dreigt teruggestuurd te worden naar Nigeria.

MP Kuiken asked whether a lesbian asylum seeker threatened with return to Nigeria is at risk, whether the IND applies a 'development of orientation' process test, and whether an independent investigation will be launched into IND assessments of LGBTI claims. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges the situation is serious and LGBTI persons are a risk group, denies the IND requires a 'bewustwordingsproces', and declines an independent investigation, pointing instead to an ongoing WODC evaluation.
The WODC is currently conducting an evaluation of the credibility assessment, based on the new work instructions, of LGBT and conversion cases by the IND.
Momenteel is het WODC bezig met een evaluatie van de geloofwaardigheidsbeoordeling, aan de hand van de nieuwe werkinstructies, van lhbt- en bekeringszaken door de IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over georganiseerde criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether organised crime is shifting to the Northern seaports due to weak oversight and information positions, and what will be done to improve this. The Minister replied that the study confirmed the information position is inadequate, that the extent of organised crime there is still unclear, and listed initiatives such as information-sharing agreements, training, and specialised investigation teams.
The research showed that the extent to which organised, undermining crime occurs in the Northern seaports is still insufficiently clear.
Het onderzoek heeft uitgewezen dat de mate waarin georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit in de Noordelijke zeehavens voorkomt nog onvoldoende duidelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over herindelingsverkiezing Eemsdelta

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why proxy votes, postal and early voting were not made possible for the Eemsdelta by-election in time, and what further measures could be taken. The minister answered that the Covid-19 election law provides a basis, that increasing proxy votes from two to three was dropped in consultation with municipalities as unworkable in time, and that postal and early voting are planned only for the March 2021 national election.
In the evaluation I will pay attention to the number of proxy votes cast.
In de evaluatie zal ik aandacht schenken aan het aantal uitgebrachte volmachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Kuiken over het legaal naar Nederland reizen van partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen

MPs Sjoerdsma and Kuiken asked why partners of Dutch or EU citizens cannot travel to the Netherlands when embassies are closed, and urged measures such as cooperation with other EU embassies and digital or border-issued permits. Minister Blok replied that consular services are largely being restored, that the long-distance lovers scheme stays limited to Dutch and EU citizens, and that alternative issuance methods are incompatible with the MVV requirement.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no insight into figures on the number of partners of Dutch nationals or EU citizens who currently cannot travel.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal partners van Nederlanders of EU-onderdanen dat op dit moment niet kan reizen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Spanje scheidt migrantenkinderen van hun ouders'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether separating migrant children from their parents in Spain violates children's rights and whether the Netherlands would object at EU level. The State Secretary acknowledged that separation without good reason violates children's rights, noted Spain's DNA-verification protocol and new family accommodation, and saw no need for further EU action given Spain's measures and the Commission's proposals.
In the asylum procedure itself, children are not separated from their parents.
In de asielprocedure zelf worden kinderen niet gescheiden van de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de kosten van WOZ-bezwaren voor gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether no-cure-no-pay agencies profit from WOZ property-valuation objections while citizens gain little, and about the costs to municipalities. The minister says a WODC study is expected by end 2020, cites over EUR 12 million in cost reimbursements paid by municipalities in 2019, and states that objection procedures are already easy for citizens, with no further access measures planned for now.
The WODC study is expected to be delivered by the end of 2020.
Het onderzoek van het WODC wordt naar verwachting voor het eind van 2020 opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht 'Geheim telefoonverkeer legt ernstige corruptie bij politie bloot'

MPs Van Dam, Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about reports that EncroChat communications revealed serious police corruption, including in the Landelijke Eenheid, and about the scale, staffing, integrity measures, privacy limits and the new MIT team. The minister declined to analyse or disclose details of ongoing investigations, while describing a Team Aanpak Corruptie under the Rijksrecherche, integrity and access-control measures, a pilot for detecting abnormal data use, and the ongoing setup of the MIT.
No, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations.
Nee, ik doe geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites voor slechtzienden en slechthorenden

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked why many Dutch municipal websites still fail accessibility rules for visually and hearing-impaired users, despite earlier promises, and what enforcement the government will use. State Secretary Knops answered that the legal duty took effect on 23 September 2020, that obstacles such as lack of knowledge and resources explain non-compliance, that dedicated accessibility teams will be deployed, and that formal supervision will follow the Wet digitale overheid, which is still before the Senate.

To have all government organisations publish an accessibility statement as quickly as possible, all municipalities, water boards, provinces and national government organisations without a valid statement will be approached in the coming months by government accessibility teams and the Digitoegankelijk expertise centre.

Om zo snel mogelijk alsnog alle overheidsorganisaties een toegankelijkheids-verklaring te laten publiceren, worden in elk geval de komende maanden alle gemeenten, waterschappen, provincies en rijksoverheidsorganisaties zonder een (geldige) verklaring benaderd door toegankelijkheidsteams van de overheid en het expertisecentrum Digitoegankelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verblijfstitel voor personen tijdens de coronatijd in Nederland zonder visumplicht

An MP asked how the Dutch government legalises stays beyond the 90/180-day visa-free limit for non-visa-required foreigners stuck in the Netherlands during COVID-19, and why EU and IND websites appear to differ. The State Secretary answered that the IND no longer extends stays or grants permits, that overstays are tolerated only where departure is genuinely impossible, and that such persons may face an entry ban on exit.
Because of Covid-19, however, the policy choice has been made not to extend stays by issuing a residence annotation sticker, nor to grant a residence permit.
Wegens Covid-19 is echter de beleidskeuze gemaakt om het verblijf niet meer middels het afgeven van een sticker verblijfsaantekening te verlengen, noch een verblijfsvergunning te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over de trage afhandeling van letselschadezaken door verzekeraars

MPs asked the minister for Legal Protection whether self-regulation by insurers in personal injury claims has failed and whether the government will tighten rules, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal. The minister acknowledged the problem and attributed delays largely to necessary case complexity, but rejected legislation, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal, pointing instead to the Letselschade Raad's keurmerk and other industry measures.
Legally anchoring and tightening the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, as well as imposing sanctions for non-compliance with that code, do not fit well with this approach.
Het wettelijk verankeren en aanscherpen van de Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, alsmede het stellen van sancties op het niet-naleven van die gedragscode, verhouden zich daarmee niet goed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een afgeschermde mailinglist voor pedoseksuelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a closed mailing list for paedophiles could be used to plan offences, and whether freedom of expression can be overridden in such cases and whether justice authorities may examine its content. The minister said such expression is punishable if it constitutes a criminal offence, that this is under investigation by the prosecution service, and that no substantive statements can be made about ongoing investigations.
No substantive statements are made about ongoing investigations by the prosecution service.
Over lopende onderzoeken van het OM worden geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Diertens over de besmettingen met COVID 19 in het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

MPs Kuiken and Diertens asked about COVID-19 infections in the Caribbean Kingdom, including Sint Eustatius' quarantine exemptions for essential workers, Aruba's and Bonaire's healthcare capacity and testing, the use of Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman, and mandatory testing for visitors to Bonaire. The government answered that exemptions are limited to essential work under strict protocols, that support to Aruba and Bonaire has been provided, and that a legal basis for mandatory test certificates for Caribbean Netherlands is being considered.
I am currently considering whether it is desirable to provide, for the Caribbean Netherlands only, a legal basis for requiring visitors to the islands to present a test result.
Ik beraad mij nu over de wenselijkheid om alleen voor Caribisch Nederland te voorzien in een wettelijke basis voor het verplicht overleggen van een testresultaat aan bezoekers van de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een door COVID getroffen vluchtelingenkampen

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary about calls to evacuate COVID-19-hit refugee camps in Greece, including whether overcrowding and poor hygiene raise infection risk and whether the Netherlands would contribute to large-scale evacuation. The government acknowledged the risk, described Dutch support (a hospitainer, relocations to the mainland, a cooperation on unaccompanied minors) and largely answered by describing Greek and EU measures without committing to evacuation.
The cabinet has informed your House on several occasions about the conditions and the measures taken by the Greek government to prevent an outbreak of COVID-19 among migrants on the islands.

Het kabinet heeft uw Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de omstandigheden en de maatregelen die door de Griekse overheid zijn getroffen om de uitbraak van COVID-19 onder de migranten op de eilanden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Kuiken over een BIGregistratie voor personen die een opleiding hebben genoten op een van de eilanden van Caribisch Nederland

MPs Bosman and Kuiken asked whether nursing diplomas from the Caribbean Netherlands are recognised in Europe, whether nurses from there can get BIG registration, and how to treat these diplomas as equivalent. The minister confirmed that the Bonaire nursing programme is equivalent to the Dutch mbo-4 programme and announced a practical workaround for Bonaire diploma holders, with the issue to be addressed in a future BIG amendment.
I intend to apply a practical approach, ahead of a definitive legal arrangement, to the diplomas issued by Fundashon Mariadal
Ik ben voornemens om, vooruitlopend op een definitieve wettelijke regeling, een praktische werkwijze te hanteren met betrekking tot de door Fundashon Mariadal afgegeven diploma's
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het sluiten van de COVID-19 kliniek op Lesbos

An MP asked the Dutch government whether a COVID-19 clinic run by MSF on Lesbos was closed by Greek authorities while Dutch officials were arranging a replacement hospital container, and what Dutch funds were spent. The government answered that the container was donated at Greek request in April, the choice of location was Greek responsibility, there is no causal link to the MSF closure, and the container was damaged in the Moria fires and is currently out of use.

The cabinet therefore has no indications to suppose that there is a causal link between the acceptance of the donation of the hospital container in April by the national authorities and the closure of the MSF clinic in July by the local authorities.

Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat er een causaal verband bestaat tussen het aanvaarden van de schenking van de hospitainer in april jl. door de nationale autoriteiten en de sluiting van de kliniek van MSF in juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Eerste coronabesmetting vastgesteld in Grieks vluchtelingenkamp Moria'

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the COVID-19 outbreak in the Moria refugee camp on Lesbos, including medical care, the need for evacuation, and taking in minors. The government answered that it supports Greece with medical aid and transfers of vulnerable migrants, and that it will take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 family migrants with children, while avoiding a commitment to broader action.
Given the exceptional situation on Lesbos, the cabinet has decided to offer the Greek government to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.
Gelet op de uitzonderlijke situatie op Lesbos heeft het kabinet besloten de Griekse overheid aan te bieden om 50 amv en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Branden in Grieks opvangkamp Moria, migranten gevlucht'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security, on behalf of the foreign ministers, how the government would respond to the fire that destroyed much of the Moria migrant camp on Lesbos, including evacuation, child reception, a new medical clinic and contact with Greece. The government answered that it offered support to Greece, pledged EUR 1 million to UNICEF's response, agreed to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 family migrants, and is pressing for an integrated EU response.

In addition to this humanitarian contribution, the cabinet has decided, in response to this exceptional and tragic situation, to offer the Greek government to take in 50 unaccompanied minor foreigners and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.

Naast deze humanitaire bijdrage heeft het kabinet in reactie op deze uitzonderlijke en tragische situatie besloten de Griekse overheid aan te bieden om 50 alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (amv) en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Legal Protection and Foreign Affairs why Insiya, abducted to India, has not been returned to her mother despite court rulings, what steps the Netherlands has taken, and whether the minister has raised the case with India. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said Dutch court rulings cannot be enforced in India and the case is raised diplomatically, and declined to detail pending Indian proceedings without parties' consent.
I can and may only inform you about proceedings pending between parties in India with the consent of the parties involved.
Over in India aanhangige procedures tussen partijen kan en mag ik u alleen met toestemming van betrokken partijen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over een incident in een AZC waarbij een lesbische vrouw met kokend water werd overgoten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an incident in an asylum centre where a lesbian woman was scalded with boiling water, whether she received proper medical care and aftercare, whether LHBTI asylum seekers face higher risk and why no data exists, what protections exist, and whether a separate centre should be created. The State Secretary said the case was handled correctly and the victim got immediate care, that no LHBTI-specific incident figures are recorded, describes existing protection measures, and rejected separate LHBTI accommodation.
I cannot go into detail on the specific circumstances of the individual case.
Ik kan niet gedetailleerd ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over internationale drugshandel per post

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag ask about the growing international trade in hard drugs by post, foreign complaints about Dutch mail shipments, the scale of detections, enforcement gaps, and whether sender identification or opening powers should be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus answers that data are limited, customs pilots show positive results, public-private cooperation is being mapped, and a planned reform would let investigators open parcels without a rechter-commissaris.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be authorised to independently seize postal parcels and then open them and examine the contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat VWS maaltijdbezorgers onder druk zet om de corona-app te gebruiken

An MP asked whether the Health Ministry pressuring meal delivery workers to use the CoronaMelder app violates the Tijdelijke wet notificatieapplicatie's ban on indirect obligation via employers. The minister admits the ministry's email should not have suggested asking couriers to download the app, stresses that use must remain voluntary, and says such conduct could be a criminal offence for which the courts would decide.
Although this email was written with the best intentions, the suggestion to 'ask couriers to download the app' should not have been made.
Hoewel deze mail met de beste bedoelingen is geschreven, had de suggestie om «bezorgers te vragen de app te downloaden» niet gedaan mogen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Kuiken  over voorwaarden van noodsteun en de brief aan de Kamercommissie KR (11 augustus 2020) over het ontwerp consensus rijkswet houdende regels omtrent de instelling van de

Two MPs (Diertens, Kuiken) asked the Dutch State Secretary for Kingdom Relations about the conditions attached to emergency liquidity aid for Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the draft Rijkswet establishing the Caribbean Reform Entity (CHE), including its budget-law, autonomy and legitimacy implications. The answers were delivered by letter to the Chamber, referring to the state of affairs of the third aid tranche and the draft Rijkswet rather than answering each question individually.
Question 1: Have you taken note of reports of dissatisfaction over the emergency aid and the CHE?
Vraag 1 Heeft u kennisgenomen van berichten over de onvrede over de totstandkoming van de noodsteun en de CHE?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opkomende criminaliteit en toenemende kansenongelijkheid in achterstandswijken

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about rising crime and inequality of opportunity in deprived neighbourhoods, including Zaandam, and whether an integrated approach like Rotterdam-Zuid would be extended. The government acknowledged the problems, pointed to prevention programmes and the Interbestuurlijk Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid, but gave no new budget and said the approach is still being explored with municipalities.
In this cabinet period, as I indicated in my letter of 18 June 2020, the further development of the preventive approach to undermining crime will be linked to this exploration.

In deze kabinetsperiode zal, zoals ik aangaf in mijn brief d.d. 18 juni 2020, voor de verdere uitwerking van de preventieve aanpak van ondermijnende criminaliteit bij deze verkenning worden aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vervolgingsbeleid bij verbaal geweld tegen publieke dienstverleners

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the prosecution policy for verbal and physical threats against public service workers, including why many such cases are dropped and whether the legal definition of threat hinders prosecution. The Minister says the Openbaar Ministerie assessed the case and found prosecution not feasible, gives the breakdown of dismissal grounds, and states the legal definition of threat does not in general stand in the way of prosecution, so no amendment is planned.
In general, reports of threats of physical violence are given priority.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat meldingen van bedreiging met fysiek geweld met voorrang worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het onderzoek naar een statushouder in Bernheze

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about an independent review of a refugee (statushouder) in Bernheze, including gaps in the national matching system, the municipality's limited information on the person's medical problems, and whether municipalities can request transfer. The State Secretary called the incident regrettable, said information sharing was limited by medical confidentiality, pointed to ongoing consultation with COA, the VNG and municipalities, and noted that inter-municipal transfer is already possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het lekken van data van slachtoffers van mensenhandel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the leak of personal data of human trafficking victims and smuggling signals held by the COA, and how affected people are protected and whether their asylum status is affected. The State Secretary confirmed the leak, described the data involved and the COA's notification efforts, and said that trafficking victims' residence status and ongoing asylum cases will be assessed individually, with consultation between COA, IND and the prosecution ongoing.
For ongoing asylum applications, consultation is currently taking place between the COA and the IND to assess what consequences this may have.
Voor lopende asielaanvragen geldt dat momenteel overleg plaatsvindt tussen het COA en de IND om te inventariseren welke gevolgen dit mogelijk heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bergkamp en Kuiken over gedwongen gescheiden lange-afstandskoppels door corona

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked whether the government would relax the COVID-19 entry ban for long-distance unmarried partners, including a Danish-style exception, and clarified entry rules for EU citizens' non-EU partners and the online information. The minister answered that a temporary scheme for long-distance partners, in force since 27 July 2020, was introduced within health limits, that a marriage certificate is not the only way to prove a relationship, and that he will check the government online information.

In a letter of 16 July 2020 I informed your House that the cabinet, within the health frameworks relating to Covid-19, found a possibility to arrive at a temporary adjusted scheme for partners in long-distance relationships.

Bij brief van 16 juli 2020 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat het kabinet, binnen de gezondheidskaders met betrekking tot Covid-19, een mogelijkheid heeft gevonden om te komen tot een tijdelijke aangepaste regeling voor geliefden in een langeafstandsrelatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een landelijk cold cases team

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a national cold case team should be created, why cold case capacity differs per region and why media attention influences which old cases are reopened. Minister Grapperhaus answered that each police unit has a structural cold case facility with no fixed size, that about 1700 cold cases exist, that selection criteria are being reviewed, and that media attention is not a formal criterion for opening cases.

In addition, I informed you by letter of 24 February that the Public Prosecution Service and the police have found that the current cold case criteria leave too much room for interpretation, and that they will examine this year whether and how these selection criteria can be adjusted.

Daarnaast heb ik u per brief van 24 februari jl. bericht dat het OM en de politie hebben geconstateerd dat de huidige criteria voor cold cases te veel ruimte laten voor interpretatie en dat ze dit jaar gaan onderzoeken of en hoe deze selectiecriteria aangepast kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de uitzending van Argos over ritueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about an Argos broadcast on ritual abuse, including whether the LEBZ receives such reports, why an advisory working group's recommendation was not followed, whether new research is needed, and whether a helpline like Sektesignaal should be restored. The minister answered that ritual abuse cannot be excluded but prior investigations found no supporting evidence, that the LEBZ has handled about 25 such cases with no prosecutions, that the consultation obligation was lifted in 2016, that no new research is planned, and that Sektesignaal's role is now covered by other partners.
Since a new Directive in 2016 this obligation no longer applies, given the very small number of reported cases with aspects of ritual abuse.
Sinds een nieuwe Aanwijzing in 2016 geldt deze verplichting niet meer gezien het zeer geringe aantal aangifte van zaken met aspecten van ritueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht over een grote Duitse zaak van kindermisbruik

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch suspects or Dutch justice authorities are involved in a large German child sexual abuse case, and what the Netherlands does against international networks. The minister answered that no Dutch suspects are known, Dutch authorities are not involved, and described existing international police cooperation and a liaison officer appointed since November 2019.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the police have received no signals about this case from the German authorities.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de politie hebben over deze zaak geen signalen ontvangen van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het voortdurende mishandeling van jonge turnsters

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the ministers about reported abuse of young gymnasts in Dutch gymnastics and what the government would do, including on the independence of the reporting point, the top-sport culture, statute of limitations, and criminal reporting. The minister answered that an independent study on the scope of boundary-crossing behaviour in gym sport is funded and due around end 2020, that the CVSN and ISR provide independence and disciplinary oversight, that the limitation period was already extended, and that the outcomes will be followed up.
For that reason, the Ministry of VWS is funding an independent study into the nature, scope and approach of boundary-crossing behaviour in gymnastics and gym sport.
Om die reden financiert het Ministerie van VWS een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aard, omvang en aanpak van grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de turn- en gymsport
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen in Brabant

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about hazardous-goods trains through Brabant, including tanker volumes exceeding agreed risk ceilings and why routing powers were not used. The State Secretary acknowledged ceiling exceedances, argued there is no unsafe situation since statutory safety norms are met, and pointed to the Robust Basisnet programme, the Betuweroute third track and existing quarterly public data.
Exceeding these risk ceilings does not in itself mean there is an unsafe situation.
Het overschrijden van deze risicoplafonds betekent alleen niet dat er sprake is van een onveilige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over afspraken met Griekenland over de opvang van minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the timing, locations, guardianship arrangements, and sustainability of the Netherlands' agreement with Greece to house unaccompanied minor asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that the MoU confirms existing agreements, that about 48 shelter places are being prepared near Athens with Dutch and Greek partners, and that guardianship and integration support will be developed, without committing to relocating children to the Netherlands.
I will continue to keep your House informed periodically about the further progress.
Over de verdere voortgang zal ik uw Kamer op periodieke basis blijven informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over de aangeboden petitie/brandbrief draf- en rensport

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked the ministers whether there is sound justification to keep banning trotting and racing selection trials, given a tested protocol, outdoor activities, no spectators and permission elsewhere in Europe, and whether the ban can be lifted soon. Minister Schouten answered that the planned easing of measures from 1 July removes any medical reasons to ban races, including selection trials, and that she sees no need for further action now.
With the announced easing of measures from 1 July, there are no longer any medical-substantive reasons to prohibit races.
Met de aangekondigde versoepeling van maatregelen per 1 juli zijn er geen medisch-inhoudelijke redenen meer om wedstrijden te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over Jehova’s getuigen

Kuiken (PvdA) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report on manipulation within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether the closed culture undermines trust that abuse is taken seriously, and whether members who criticise, marry civilly or are shut out can be protected. The Minister said abuse handling is covered by a separate forthcoming letter, that the government has no view on how the community handles other misconduct, and that existing criminal law (coercion, threats, child abduction) already offers sufficient means to intervene.
There are therefore sufficient legal possibilities to intervene.
Er zijn daarmee voldoende wettelijke mogelijkheden om te kunnen ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat zwangere Afrikaanse vrouwen uit asielopvang verdwenen zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that pregnant African women disappeared from asylum reception centres, including whether 25 had gone missing and whether trafficking was suspected. The State Secretary confirmed that 961 people of Nigerian origin left with unknown destination in 2019, promised a phenomenon study on trafficking signals, and said that departures are the residents' own choice while sharing that protection measures exist.
In November 2019 COA issued signals about pregnant women of African origin who leave with unknown destination.
Het COA heeft in november 2019 signalen afgegeven over zwangere vrouwen van Afrikaanse komaf die met onbekende bestemming vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over drugssmokkel op zee

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked the Justice, Agriculture and Transport ministers about drug smuggling by fishing vessels, including subsidies, detection odds, licence withdrawal and Bibob screening. The government acknowledged the financial pressure link, said subsidies should exclude convicted fishers while EU rules limit this, and promised investigations into licence withdrawal and Bibob use while noting limited data on detection.
The Minister of LNV will investigate what options exist to exclude fishers who have committed criminal offences from these funds.
De Minister van LNV zal onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om vissers die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd uit te sluiten van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over corona onder bewoners azc Sneek

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the relocation of infected and quarantined residents of the Sneek asylum centre to Zoutkamp, notified residents, protective measures and whether residents could refuse mixing with infected people. The government answered that the relocation was decided jointly by GGD, Veiligheidsregio and COA to stop the spread, that residents were informed by COA staff, and that protective measures and information were provided, while largely referring back to its answer on question 7 for the mixing question.

Following the test results, in consultation between GGD Fryslân, Veiligheidsregio Fryslân and COA it was decided to relocate infected persons, their family members and those belonging to their housing unit.

Naar aanleiding van de testuitslagen is in afstemming tussen GGD Fryslân, Veiligheidsregio Fryslân en het COA besloten om besmette personen, hun gezinsleden en degenen die tot hun wooneenheid behoren over te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why the Hoenderloo College is closing by 1 August 2020, whether Pluryn is meeting its duty of care, and whether the ministers can intervene or place the foundation under curatorship. The ministers replied that the closure date is only a target, the institution closes only once every young person has a suitable follow-up placement, the inspectorate is monitoring this and has tightened supervision, and curatorship of a private foundation is not possible outside bankruptcy.
It has been agreed, however, that the Hoenderloo Group will only close once a suitable and sustainable follow-up place has been found for every young person.
Afgesproken is, echter, dat de Hoenderloo Groep pas sluit als er voor iedere jongere een passende en duurzame vervolgplek is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een gevaarlijke situatie in asielzoekerscentra door tekort aan hulpmiddelen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether asylum reception centres lack protective equipment and quarantine places, and what is being done about it, plus questions on an internal COA survey and infection and sick-leave figures. The State Secretary answered that COA staff follow RIVM guidance, a mask order was delivered in late April, some centres have limited quarantine space, the survey findings are summarised, and figures on infections are given.
I am closely monitoring the situation at the COA locations and have every confidence that the measures taken are currently adequate.
Ik volg de situatie op de COA-locaties nauwgezet en heb er alle vertrouwen in dat de getroffen maatregelen op dit moment adequaat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over gemeenten die in geldnood dreigen te komen

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether municipalities face financial distress from COVID-19 revenue losses and how they could absorb it, and whether the government would help. State Secretary Knops replied that compensation measures were agreed with local governments, no liquidity problems are known, a regiegroep is assessing the costs, and the accres is frozen for 2020-2021.
The number of municipalities under preventive enhanced supervision in 2020 is still limited and does not deviate strongly from the figures of the past ten years.
Het aantal gemeenten dat in 2020 onder verscherpt toezicht staat (preventief) is nog beperkt en wijkt niet sterk af van de aantallen van de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de voorgenomen stelselwijziging in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether the VNG's proposed voluntary Norm for Client-Side Commissioning (NvO) on youth care regional cooperation is sufficient, whether municipal self-regulation can provide clarity and steering, and whether structural extra funding and an arbitration committee are adequate. The Minister answers that the NvO aligns with government plans, that a bill strengthening regional cooperation is being prepared for internet consultation in summer, that a study on structural funding results at end 2020, and that the VNG's expert team rejected legal limits on the youth care entitlement.
The cabinet has a bill in preparation. It aims, among other things, to strengthen regional cooperation.
Het kabinet heeft een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding. Deze ziet onder meer op het versterken van regionale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about the financial distress of the Hoenderloo Groep (Pluryn), the sale of its property, the number of youths without a suitable placement, and whether ministry oversight is adequate. The minister answered that Pluryn is responsible for its own finances and that the Youth Authority monitors them, that about 18 youths still lack a lasting placement with closure targeted for 1 August 2020, and that the state cannot place a youth care provider under curatorship.
Youth care providers are themselves responsible for their business operations.
Jeugdhulpaanbieders zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over de vergoedingen van de inrichting van de privévertrekken van paleis Huis ten Bosch

Two MPs (Kuiken, Sneller) asked the Prime Minister whether the state or the King paid for furnishing the private quarters of Huis ten Bosch, and whether the B-component of the King's allowance should be evaluated every five years as the Court of Audit recommended. The government answered that the state covers renovation and basic furnishing, the King bears extra costs beyond the standard, the B-component is adjusted through indexation, and it sees no need for new measures, while withholding details of the King's own contribution citing privacy and Article 41 of the Constitution.
On this, given Article 41 of the Constitution and for reasons of protecting personal privacy, I cannot go into further detail.
Hierop kan ik, gelet op artikel 41 Grondwet en om redenen van bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over partners van slachtoffers in de rechtszaal

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether partners or relatives of crime victims may attend court hearings during the COVID-19 measures, and whether the government will consult the judiciary about allowing them. The minister answered that victims may bring one companion, that a further close relative is admitted when the building's health rules allow, and that no further consultation with the judiciary is needed.
Should I find that the approach nonetheless causes problems in practice, I will not fail to raise this point in my weekly consultation with the Council for the Judiciary.

Mocht ik constateren dat de werkwijze in de praktijk toch tot problemen leidt, dan zal ik niet nalaten dit punt ter sprake te brengen in het wekelijks overleg dat ik heb met de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Leeuwarden stopt met inkoop van specialistische hulp voor vrouwen in opvang voor 43 gemeenten

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the minister about Leeuwarden ending its role as national purchaser of specialist women's shelter care for 43 municipalities, and whether this threatens care continuity and signals an unsustainable system. The minister answered that responsibility lies with municipalities under the Wmo2015, the Leeuwarden contract runs to 31 December 2020, the VNG and centre municipalities are arranging an orderly handover, and he sees no reason for national action at this point.
It is up to municipalities to set quality requirements for this provision and, based on those requirements, to decide which organisation to contract the care to.
Het is daarmee aan gemeenten om eisen te stellen aan de kwaliteit van deze voorziening en – op basis van deze eisen – te beslissen bij welke organisatie zij deze zorg beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over het optreden van de Griekse grenspolitie en de gewonden en de dood van een migrant

MPs Voordewind, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Greek border police fired live rounds at migrants near the Turkish border on 4 March, leaving six wounded and one Pakistani man dead, and asked for investigations and clarification. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greek authorities deny using live fire, and that the government expects border actions to respect international law, pointing to existing complaint routes rather than committing to new action.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the situation at the Greek-Turkish border in early March and the reports about it.

Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de genoemde situatie begin maart aan de Grieks-Turkse grens en de berichten daaromtrent te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over "arbeidsmigranten met corona"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked the ministers about COVID-19 risks for migrant workers, including dismissals, working while sick, Labour Inspectorate complaints and returns home. The minister replied that employers must keep workers safe, reported 1,210 corona complaints (169 about migrant workers) with 109 investigated, and described an interdepartmental taskforce and EU guidance on free movement.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises compliance with the Working Conditions Act.
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Arbowet.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het in brand steken van C2000 masten

An MP asked whether arson attacks on C2000 emergency radio masts had disrupted 112 access, threatened the network, and what protection was planned for the 525 masts. The government said 112 remained reachable, C2000 impact was limited, the most critical masts would be secured first over roughly three months, but withheld specific security measures for reasons of security.
For security reasons, I will not go into the specific protective measures.
Vanuit veiligheidsoogpunt ga ik niet in op de specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kuik over zelfmoordpreventie ten tijde van corona

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about suicide prevention during the coronavirus crisis, including whether research into the impact on suicides is under way, whether the crisis could increase suicides, whether 113 Zelfmoordpreventie has enough resources, and the status of the national suicide prevention agenda. The government answered that monitoring is ongoing via a weekly commission, several studies are underway coordinated by ZonMw, contact with 113 is active with an update promised before the 8 June debate, and a new national agenda will be sent by October 2020.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of my contact with 113 Suicide Prevention in the letter I will send to the House ahead of the consultation meeting on 8 June.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van mijn contact met 113 Zelfmoordpreventie in de brief die ik voor het notaoverleg op 8 juni aanstaande naar de Kamer zal sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een toename van geweld door verwarde personen

An MP asked whether violence by people with psychological problems has increased during the coronavirus crisis, its causes, and the status of a Trimbos Institute study. The government answered that no increase in violence by this group can be established, though police reports of disturbances involving confused persons have risen, and it promised to share forthcoming research results with parliament.
As soon as the results of these studies are available, I will share them with the House.
Zodra de opbrengsten van deze onderzoeken beschikbaar zijn zal ik deze met Uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Kuik en Kuiken over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

MPs asked the government about the consequences of the COVID-19 crisis for people in prostitution, including unregistered workers without income support, bed-bath-bread shelter, exit programmes, police raids, and online advertising for physical services. The minister answered that sex workers can access existing support schemes and municipal shelters, that a ban on prostitution applies under the emergency ordinance, that exit demand has not yet grown substantially, and that the ordinance may be amended to address online advertising.
Such possibilities are currently being examined.
Op dit moment worden zulke mogelijkheden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de definitieve sluiting van Het Poortje

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the government about the definitive closure of Het Poortje youth institution in Groningen, including a claimed EUR 3.5 million deficit, dismissals, and whether youth care in Groningen and Drenthe remains adequate. Minister De Jonge answered that Elker will close its Groningen Jeugdzorg Plus location but continue closed youth care in smaller settings without forced dismissals, that regions are satisfied with places, and that no emergency plan is needed.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs has informed me that it will organise closed youth care differently.
Elker Jeugdhulp & onderwijs heeft mij gemeld dat zij de gesloten jeugdhulp anders gaan organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van locaties Hoenderloo en Deelen van jeugdzorgaanbieder Pluryn

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the closure of Pluryn's Hoenderloo and Deelen youth care locations, including whether the 'Klein Hoenderloo' rescue plan was seriously considered, the inspectorate's findings on quality and management, and placement of affected youths. The Minister answers that the rescue plan was assessed by all stakeholders as insufficiently certain, alternatives were explored, the IGJ supports the closure decision, and it will monitor placements of affected youths with monthly visits.
I proceed on the basis that a suitable follow-up will be found for every child.
Ik ga er hiermee vanuit dat voor ieder kind een passend vervolg komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de Hoenderloo-groep

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, the sale of its site, whether Pluryn properly assessed a takeover plan, the role of the municipal council, and uncertainty for parents and youths about alternative placements. The Minister answered that Pluryn must sell property to restore finances, that the municipality will discuss the spatial framework with the council, that Pluryn and the IGJ will oversee transfers before August 2020, and that parents' intention statements are a careful procedure.
I supervise that Pluryn sets up a tight (decision-making) process with municipalities and care offices to achieve (financial) recovery and become a future-proof organisation.
Ik zie erop toe dat Pluryn een strak (besluitvormings)proces inricht met gemeenten en zorgkantoren om tot (financieel) herstel te komen en een toekomstbestendige organisatie te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Bergkamp en Van Nispen over duivelsuitdrijving bij kinderen en andere misstanden binnen religieuze gemeenschappen

MPs asked whether exorcism practices against children in religious communities, including alleged sexual abuse and threats, are harmful and criminal, and how oversight, reporting and independent research could be strengthened. The minister agreed such practices can harm children and may be criminal, pointed to Veilig Thuis and the police for oversight, declined a separate national study, and said he would consider a constitutional-law angle on restricting religious freedom by statute.

Given the extensive research agenda of the WODC and the number of studies still in the queue, I do not consider it desirable to start a separate study into the nature and extent of exorcisms in the Netherlands.

Antwoord 7 Ik acht het – mede gezien de omvangrijke onderzoeksagenda van het WODC en de hoeveelheid onderzoeken die nog in de wachtrij staan – niet wenselijk om een separaat onderzoek naar de aard en omvang van duivelsuitdrijvingen in Nederland op te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de beveiliging van tbs-klinieken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the security of tbs clinics, following a report that Kijvelanden would now always check staff after an escape, and whether the rules on staff screening are followed in practice. The minister confirmed the 1-in-25 field norm for staff checks, pointed to inspection and DJI audits showing compliance, and declined to tighten security at other clinics for now, citing ongoing sector improvement efforts and a new addendum with the sector.
Yes, this is shown by investigations periodically carried out by the IJenV and DJI into security in FPCs.
Ja, dit blijkt uit onderzoeken die periodiek door de IJenV en DJI naar de veiligheid in FPC's zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de glasplaten in het rijkskantoor Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior about dangerous glass panels at the Rijnstraat 8 government building in The Hague, including whether staff and passers-by are safe and why the panels have not all been replaced. The State Secretary replied that a temporary management plan keeps people safe, that TNO found nickel-sulphide inclusions likely caused breakages but no full explanation, and that a decision on permanent replacement will follow on 2 June 2020 with the contractor PoortCentraal held to account.
I have held PoortCentraal to account for its contractual responsibility for a safe and undisturbed building, without additional management measures.
Ik heb PoortCentraal aangesproken op haar contractuele verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ongestoord te gebruiken gebouw, zonder aanvullende beheersmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over criminaliteit onder asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported rise in crime by asylum seekers in 2019 and why it is not being tackled, including whether criminal asylum seekers from safe countries should leave and whether a secret report would be shared. The State Secretary confirmed a 27 percent rise in registered offences, said the cause needs further WODC research, outlined existing enforcement measures, and noted the press report concerned a draft.
I have therefore asked the WODC to conduct further research into this.
Ik heb het WODC daarom gevraagd om hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het falend terugkeerbeleid

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the failing return policy: whether Morocco's readmission of 52 rejected asylum seekers was undermined by inability to locate them, whether pressure measures in the coalition agreement are futile, how many cases involve disappearance, how many rejected asylum seekers remain, and whether subsidised return-training projects are effective. The government answered that Morocco's cooperation is insufficient, that about 40 nationality confirmations in 2019 concerned persons already out of view and about 420 disappeared after confirmation, that it seeks longer detention possibilities under EU rules, that a study on the number of irregular residents is underway, and that the subsidy scheme will be evaluated.
I would have preferred that they had still been available for return to Morocco, but as you know, there are considerable limits to the possibilities of placing someone in detention.
Ik had liever gezien dat ze nog beschikbaar waren geweest voor terugkeer naar Marokko, maar zoals u bekend, zitten er de nodige beperkingen aan de mogelijkheden om iemand in bewaring te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het testen van politieagenten op corona

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether police officers, boa's and enforcement staff know they can be tested for COVID-19 after work incidents, whether testing is available without a spitting or coughing incident, and whether GGD capacity suffices. The minister answered that information is provided through internal channels, that testing is possible after a work incident or with symptoms on advice of the occupational doctor, that testing is being broadened from 18 May and 1 June, and that GGD capacity is sufficient.

That is why it has been agreed that professionals in enforcement and supervision (including police officers, boa's and other enforcers) can also be tested if a work incident (spitting, coughing, resuscitation, fight or forcible arrest) has possibly exposed them to infection.

Daarom is afgesproken dat professionals in handhaving en toezicht (waaronder o.a. agenten, boa’s en andere handhavers) ook getest kunnen worden als zij door een incident tijdens het werk (spugen, hoesten, reanimatie, vechtpartij of aanhouding met geweld) een mogelijke besmetting hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Gemeentelijke websites vaak beperkt toegankelijk’

Two MPs asked the ministers about the accessibility of municipal websites for visually and hearing-impaired people, after a report that about two-thirds remain inaccessible. State Secretary Knops answered that a new legal duty to publish accessibility statements applies from 23 September 2020, that municipal councils and provinces handle supervision with existing legal tools, and that he will urge municipalities to improve, referring to the helpdesk and existing communication.
I will hold municipalities and other authorities to their responsibility.
Ik zal gemeenten en andere overheden aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het niet kunnen vervolgen van Syriëgangers

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether a court's refusal to continue prosecuting a Syria returnee who is not in the Netherlands means serious crimes go unpunished, and whether government policy on repatriation will change. The government answered that the court has postponed its decision to 2 June 2020, that courts judge each case on its circumstances, and that it is studying the effects of the ruling and will inform the House if policy changes.
If the current policy changes, the House will be informed about this.
Indien verandering van het huidige beleid plaatsvindt, zal de Kamer hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over gevaarlijke honden

Two MPs asked whether a mayor can neutralise a dangerous dog and whether a mayor may have a biting dog euthanised, and whether a dog-keeping ban should be created for owners of repeatedly aggressive dogs. The government answers that mayors have existing powers under the Gemeentewet, local bylaws and bestuursdwang, that euthanasia is only possible in extreme cases after seizure, and that a standalone dog-keeping ban is being prepared with the Justice Minister.
In addition, a bill is being prepared with the Minister of Justice and Security to introduce a dog-keeping ban as a standalone measure.
In aanvulling hierop wordt in samenwerking met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid een wetsvoorstel voorbereid waarmee een houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de onveilige situatie voor homo’s en transgenders in Iran

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government had correctly assessed the safety of gay and transgender people in Iran, and whether it had used relevant reports and a letter from 6Rang in its country report. The State Secretary answered that the country report relies on source-verified information, that a supplementary analysis confirmed the March 2019 assessment and found no essential change, and that there is no reason to revise the policy, with a further update planned for 2021.
The conclusion of the investigation is that the situation as described in the March 2019 country report is confirmed.
De conclusie van het onderzoek is dat de situatie zoals deze beschreven is in het ambtsbericht van maart 2019 bevestigd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘het ontbreken van een meldpunt voor slachtoffers en familieleden van sektes’

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why the Sektesignaal reporting point for cult victims was discontinued, and whether it would be restored. The minister denied that victims are poorly served, stated that Sektesignaal was only a referral service, commissioned a WODC study, and refused to restore the reporting point.
Following the Van Nispen motion, I have asked the WODC to conduct a study examining whether ending the subsidy to Sektesignaal has created a gap in the available instruments.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Van Nispen heb ik het WODC verzocht een onderzoek uit te voeren waarbij bezien wordt of het beëindigen van de subsidie aan Sektesignaal heeft geleid tot een lacune

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Wilders, Buitenweg, Futselaar, Kuiken, Van der Graaf, Ouwehand, Van Otterloo, Azarkan, Stoffer, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de mogelijke inzet van apps in het ka

Thirteen MPs asked the ministers about the possible use of contact-tracing apps in the COVID-19 'test, trace and stay home' policy, covering their purpose, effectiveness, privacy, source code, cybersecurity and accessibility. The government answered by referring to its separate COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249) rather than answering the questions directly.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 249 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verkoop van nazi-boeken op Bol.com

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Bol.com's sale of Nazi-era books (by Streicher, Rosenberg, Himmler) is unacceptable, whether it is punishable, whether a complaint was filed, and whether the Jewish community should be consulted. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the sale is highly undesirable, that criminal liability depends on case-by-case assessment, that a complaint was filed against Bol.com and the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that he consulted the Central Jewish Consultation.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether prosecution will follow.
Het is aan het OM om te beslissen of er tot vervolging wordt over gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over ‘sekswerkers die tussen wal en schip vallen door de coronacrisis’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security whether sex workers outside the Tozo and WW schemes, such as opt-in workers and EU nationals, are left without income during the coronavirus crisis, and asked about protection, municipal coordination and the shift to online platforms. The government answered that these groups may qualify for social assistance under conditions, pointed to the ban on contact occupations in the emergency ordinances, and said it is in contact with the VNG.
In addition, I am in contact with the VNG to see how we can jointly move municipalities, where necessary, to assist sex workers experiencing problems due to the coronavirus.
Daarnaast ben ik in contact met de VNG om te bezien hoe wij gezamenlijk gemeenten waar nodig kunnen bewegen om sekswerkers die problemen ondervinden door het coronavirus, tegemoet te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Kuiken over het artikel ‘Burgemeesters roepen na gewelddadig weekeinde op tot messenverbod voor minderjarigen’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about mayors' calls for a knife ban for minors after violent incidents, including the effectiveness of the ban on certain knives, licence numbers, consultations with police and mayors, and whether the ban on carrying knives should be tightened. The Minister said effectiveness cannot be measured, reported seven knife-collector exemptions and three refusals, defended the existing general carrying prohibition, and promised to inform parliament of the consultation outcomes in spring.
As promised during the aforementioned question hour and in the letter of 3 February, I will inform your House of the outcomes in the spring.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het genoemde vragenuur en in de brief van 3 februari informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Bosman over het bericht ‘Lagere ticketprijzen tussen eilanden laten nog wel even op zich wachten’

MPs Kuiken and Bosman asked why no concrete measures had been taken on the expert group's advice to partly compensate inter-island ticket prices in the Caribbean Netherlands, and when measures would follow. The government answered that a proposal is being developed with the Caribbean islands and ministries, to be tested for legal, financial and organisational feasibility, but it cannot yet give a timeline.
Therefore, at this stage it cannot yet be stated within what timeframe measures can be taken.
Er kan daarom in dit stadium nog niet aangegeven worden binnen welke termijn er maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht 'Turkije zet grenzen open: Syriërs naar Europa'

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey would open its borders to Syrians heading for Europe, including Dutch diplomatic action on Idlib, the future of EU-Turkey support, and conditions on the Greek islands. The government answered that it considers this unacceptable, sees no signs of large-scale border crossings, supports enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement, and outlined EU and bilateral aid to Greece and humanitarian funding.
It is highly undesirable that people are used in this way for political purposes.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat mensen op deze manier worden ingezet voor politieke doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over corona en de vele andere levensbedreigende risico’s in vluchtelingenkampen op Griekse eilanden

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government shares concern about COVID-19 and other life-threatening conditions in Greek island migrant camps, and whether it will take in unaccompanied children from there. The State Secretary says the government shares the concerns, lists Greek and EU measures and humanitarian support, and rejects ad hoc relocation of unaccompanied minors as a structural solution, while favouring structural improvements.
The government does not consider the ad hoc admission of unaccompanied minors a structural solution.
Het ad hoc opnemen van AMV's vindt het kabinet geen structurele oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over antisemitische uitingen tijdens Ajax-PSV

MPs Kerstens, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Health ministers about antisemitic chants at the Ajax-PSV match, whether they are punishable, why the match was not stopped, whether stadium bans will follow, and the status of the anti-racism action plan. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the chants were condemned, PSV stewards intervened, one person was handed to police and the public prosecutor is reviewing the file, and that the KNVB and partners are implementing the action plan including a persoonsgerichte aanpak and a smart-technology challenge.
No report is known to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Er is geen aangifte bekend bij het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens, Van Dijk, Moorlag en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het Coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party (PvdA) asked the ministers of health, social affairs, economic affairs and the state secretary of justice about IC bed capacity, care for budget holders, immigration detention during the coronavirus crisis, temporary worker and self-employed income support, Schiphol security staff conditions, childcare leave and state support for firms. The minister answered most questions substantively, describing measures and plans, while declining to commit to a fixed IC bed scenario beyond referring to earlier letters and saying the 40-hour norm and PBM supplies were still under review.
I refer you to that for brevity.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kerstens en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

PvdA MPs asked the health ministers how far the Netherlands follows WHO advice on testing for COVID-19, whether test kits, staff, laboratory capacity and protective equipment are sufficient, and how ICU capacity, public information and distancing rules are handled. The minister answered that testing is targeted due to global shortages under a national guideline with a taskforce, that protective equipment is distributed under a central procurement and regional distribution structure, and that information is clear and updated, while largely restating existing policy and referring to a separate Kamerbrief for ICU capacity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over digitale besluitvorming in gemeenten en provincies

MP Kuiken asked whether councils and provincial assemblies should be allowed to take legally valid decisions digitally during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether legislation would be proposed. The minister said physical meetings are the default, digital deliberation is possible but voting requires a physical meeting, and a temporary statutory exception for digital council decision-making is being prepared and will be sent to parliament soon.
However, I am of the view that a temporary exception must be made in these exceptional circumstances, provided that the public nature of council meetings is preserved
Ik ben echter van mening dat daar in deze uitzonderlijke omstandigheden een tijdelijke uitzondering op moet komen, mits de openbaarheid van raadsvergaderingen behouden blijft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de erkenning van een Nederlands huwelijk in het buitenland

An MP asked whether a marriage converted from a registered partnership is recognised abroad, and how Dutch citizens abroad can obtain an effective marriage without a cumbersome dissolution procedure. The minister confirmed that some countries do not recognise such conversions, explained that a Dutch-law conversion is available and that an international marriage extract can be requested, and promised to improve public information and ask the civil registry commission for guidance.
I will ask the NVvB whether all municipalities are willing to place this link on their websites.
