Ik zal bij de NVvB vragen of alle gemeenten deze link op hun website willen plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de risico’s voor en van nieuwe asielzoekers

An MP from the PvdA asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether new asylum seekers, during the COVID-19 measures, receive no help at all from IND or COA, whether some may have fled dangerous conditions, and how their health risks and need for basic humanitarian aid are weighed. The State Secretary confirms that new asylum applications are suspended, that only registration and security checks take place, and that an emergency shelter is being set up while existing COA reception continues until 6 April.
At the same time, work is under way to set up an emergency shelter location where people who cannot currently enter the asylum process can find accommodation and basic facilities.
Tegelijk wordt gewerkt aan de inrichting van een noodonderdaklocatie waar mensen, die nu niet kunnen instromen in het asielproces, onderdak en basale voorzieningen kunnen vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink en Van der Staaij over de mogelijke doorstart van de Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld, Agema, Hijink and Van der Staaij asked the Minister of Health about the Hoenderloo Groep closure, his contacts with parents, steps toward a possible restart and its consistency with the Chamber's motion. The Minister replied that he visited the site, held talks with Pluryn, gemeenten and the IGJ, asked KPMG to test restart plans, and that Pluryn has offered placements for all youths while the IGJ oversees the transfer process.
I informed your House on 20 February 2020 about this, in line with my commitment in the committee debate on financial problems at youth care institutions and the Hijink et al. motion.
Ik heb uw Kamer, conform mijn toezegging in het AO «financiële problemen bij diverse jeugdzorginstellingen» en motie Hijink cs, hierover op 20 februari 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Nispen, Kuiken en Van der Graaf over het onderzoekverloop naar de dood van Dascha Graafsma

MPs asked how the second opinion on the cause of Dascha Graafsma's death was set up, how bias was prevented, whether lessons would lead to rule changes, and what the government would do about the family's complaints. The minister answered that a separate police unit runs the forensic second opinion, reviewed by uninvolved prosecutors, that no rule changes are planned, and that the OM apologised and will keep communicating openly.
The OM and police have apologised for earlier communication that too firmly concluded this case was a suicide.
Het OM en politie hebben excuses gemaakt voor eerdere communicatie waarin te stellig werd geconcludeerd dat in deze zaak sprake was van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vernieuwde communicatienetwerk C2000

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister about problems with the renewed C2000 emergency radio network after its migration, including poor reachability, a brief outage in Noord-Holland, and whether safety was adequately planned for. The minister acknowledged start-up problems and a short outage caused by human error, said they were being addressed by a support team and updates, and that full settling of the network will take some time.
As time goes on, the remaining bottlenecks to be resolved will decrease in number and impact until a regular management situation arises.
Naarmate de tijd vordert nemen de nog in te regelen knelpunten in aantal en qua impact af totdat een reguliere beheersituatie ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de veiligheid in de gevangenis van Lelystad in gevaar is

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported rises in prison incidents, staffing shortages, mega-prisons, and whether multi-person cells and isolation cells remain workable. The minister replied that total incidents have fallen, that serious violence against staff prompted a further DJI review due before summer 2020, that staffing is being addressed through recruitment, and that multi-person cell use and isolation placements remain appropriate.
I have asked DJI to conduct further research into this.
Ik heb DJI gevraagd hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het personeelstekort in jeugdgevangenissen

MPs Van den Berge, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages in youth detention centres, including juveniles being temporarily placed in a women's prison, closures, turnover, sick leave and the Juvaid incident. The Minister answered that the problem is staff shortage rather than a lack of beds, detailed staffing and absence figures, and described the Ter Peel arrangement and measures taken at Juvaid.
I am aware of that. Should there be cause to inform you, I will do so.
Ik ben daarvan op de hoogte. Mocht er aanleiding zijn u te informeren, dan zal ik dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het COA asielzoekers, die slachtoffer zijn van een zedendelict, afraadt aangifte te doen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked whether COA advised asylum seekers who were victims of sexual offences, including gay victims, against filing police reports, and how often such victims report. The State Secretary replied that COA encourages reporting, that it has no evidence of such advice beyond the media report, that no internal investigation exists, and that police and COA hold no central figures on this.
COA encourages residents to file police reports and provides support where needed.
Het COA stimuleert bewoners om aangifte te doen en biedt waar nodig ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de aanpak van seksuele intimidatie in het openbaar vervoer

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice Minister about sexual harassment on public transport, its prevalence, treatment of offenders to prevent escalation, and whether revising the sex-offence provisions of the Criminal Code would address this. The minister answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers last year (likely incomplete), that early treatment via existing criminal-law tools and risk assessment is available, and that a new criminal offence for sexual intimidation in public space is planned, with an evaluation of earlier measures due in spring 2020.

In my letter to the House of 22 May 2019, I therefore announced, also on behalf of the Minister for Legal Protection, my intention to include sexual intimidation in the Criminal Code as a new criminal offence.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer van 22 mei 2019 heb ik dan ook, mede namens de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming, mijn voornemen aangekondigd om seksuele intimidatie in het Wetboek van Strafrecht als nieuwe strafbaarstelling op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onbetrouwbare hondengeurtesten

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether reports of unreliable, non-blind dog scent tests by Twente police handlers warrant invalidating pre-1997 scent tests, reopening convictions, and commissioning research. The minister answered that earlier investigations found non-blind testing by one group, that pre-1997 testing was not standardised so further research was not opportune, that revision is for the Supreme Court, and that no new research is planned since scent tests have not been used as evidence since 2011.

As indicated in that answer, for closed criminal cases the decision on the validity of evidence is reserved for the Supreme Court, which under article 457(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure decides on applications for revision.

Zoals aangegeven in die beantwoording, is ten aanzien van afgesloten strafzaken de beslissing omtrent geldigheid van bewijsmiddelen voorbehouden aan de Hoge Raad, die op grond van artikel 457, eerste lid, 1 van het Wetboek van Strafvordering beslist op aanvragen tot herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken inzake de invloed van criminelen op het amateurvoetbal

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about criminal influence in amateur football, including whether reported signals in 70 clubs understate the problem, whether sponsors should need a VOG, whether municipalities should routinely apply the Bibob test, and the KNVB's role. The minister said a national study will be carried out with the Minister of Medical Care and Sport, declined to make VOG mandatory, left Bibob use to municipalities' discretion, and pointed to KNVB rules and prevention support.
To properly map this problem, I will, together with the Minister of Medical Care and Sport, carry out research into the interference of criminals in sports associations.
Om deze problematiek goed in kaart te brengen ga ik samen met de Minister van Medische Zorg en Sport onderzoek doen naar de inmenging van criminelen bij sportverenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jeugdzorg het kabinet verzoekt twee IS-kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether youth care had requested repatriation of two IS-linked children from Syria, how the government responded, and what happens to them and to other Dutch children in Syrian camps. The government confirmed receipt of a letter from a Dutch child protection organisation on 15 October, said it is in close contact with that organisation, but declined to disclose steps taken, citing no diplomatic presence and restraint on individual cases.
Beyond that, the cabinet cannot currently provide information on the steps being taken to implement this request.
Voor het overige geldt dat het kabinet op dit moment geen mededelingen kan doen over de stappen die worden gezet ter uitvoering van dit verzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul en Bergkamp over de gemeentelijke basisadministratie voor kinderen van transgenders

MPs asked whether a transgender parent's gender change should also be reflected in their child's birth certificate and what children can do about the discrepancy with the BRP. The minister replied that the birth certificate is not amended after a parent's change, that the BRP may show the parent's new first name, and pointed to documentary and BRP-based ways to show the link.
Following these parliamentary questions, the government website information has been expanded to address these options.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is in de informatie op de website van de rijksoverheid aandacht besteed aan deze mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kuiken over de structurele problemen in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether youth care problems amount to a structurally failing system, why parents are turned away by municipalities, and why providers face non-cost-covering tariffs, and whether plans have been properly coordinated with VNG and parliament. The Minister replies that more money has been allocated, a non-binding regional cooperation model and a future AMvB on realistic tariffs are planned, with a concrete plan promised for March 2020.
As promised during the committee meeting of 18 November, I will come up with a plan in early March 2020 on how we want to improve the organisation of youth care in the short and longer term.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het WGO van 18 november jl., kom ik begin maart 2020 met een plan hoe we de organisatie van de jeugdhulp willen verbeteren op korte en langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over een voormalige vruchtbaarheidskliniek in Oosterbeek

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about a former fertility clinic in Oosterbeek where a doctor may have fathered around 150 children, asking about the legal framework of the 1970s-80s, whether affected children can find their donor, and what the ministers will do to help. The Minister replied that no specific donor-registration law existed before 2004 and no evidence shows the clinic was illegal then, and that missing clinic records mean donors cannot be traced, so the only option left is free registration in the Fiom KID-DNA databank.
The administration of this fertility clinic is missing, so it is not possible to determine from it which donors donated at this clinic.
De administratie van deze vruchtbaarheidskliniek ontbreekt, zodat het niet mogelijk is op basis daarvan te achterhalen welke donoren in deze kliniek hebben gedoneerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nog volstrekt onhoudbare en verslechtende situatie op vluchtelingenkampen op Lesbos

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deteriorating conditions in the Moria camp on Lesbos and whether this amounts to a humanitarian disaster requiring urgent aid. The government acknowledges the poor and worsening conditions, describes its support via blankets, experts and EU funds, and points to Greek asylum reforms as the lasting solution.
The cabinet shares your concerns about the reception conditions on the Greek islands.
Het kabinet deelt uw zorgen over de opvangomstandigheden op de Griekse eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over schrijnende omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen op Lesbos

The MP asked why conditions in the Lesbos refugee camp remain unacceptable after a fatal stabbing and what the government will do with European partners to bring rapid structural improvements. The State Secretary agreed the situation is alarming, said Greece must take responsibility for structural reforms while the Netherlands keeps pressing and supporting, and pointed to new Greek asylum legislation without giving a firm timeline.
Greece must nevertheless itself take responsibility for carrying out these structural improvements.
Griekenland dient evenwel zelf verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor het doorvoeren van deze structurele verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de volstrekt onhoudbare situatie op vluchtelingenkampen op Lesbos

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the reported unliveable conditions in the Lesbos camps, including children's rights, and what concrete steps the EU and the Netherlands would take. The government shares the concern, says Greece must take responsibility and that the Netherlands offers support, and notes Greece's request to relocate up to 2,500 unaccompanied minors, which it is considering while opposing a new relocation round in principle.
The Netherlands consistently presses for this, at official and political level, bilaterally and within the EU.
Nederland dringt daar voortdurend op aan, op ambtelijk en politiek niveau, bilateraal en in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het sluiten van speciale unit voor LHBTQ-asielzoekers in Ter Apel

An MP asked the State Secretary whether COA is closing a protected unit for LGBTQ asylum seekers in Ter Apel, why, and how their safety will be ensured. The State Secretary replied that COA does not place vulnerable groups together as a rule, that placement is primarily logistical with individual safety measures, and declined to create protected accommodation or meet LGBT Asylum Support.
COA looks at what is needed in each individual case and ensures a safe place.
Het COA bekijkt per individueel geval wat nodig is en draagt zorg voor een veilige plek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jeugdzorgaanbieders naar de rechter stappen vanwege tariefverlagingen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about youth care providers suing municipalities in The Hague region over steep tariff cuts, questioning whether cuts of around 40% were real and whether quality care and provider continuity could survive. The Minister answered that most tariffs actually rose, that a court ruled partly for the providers and found the region had not shown its tariffs reflected costs, and that a reasonable-price AMvB and a liquidity subsidy scheme are being prepared while municipalities remain responsible for their own obligations.
That is why the Minister for Legal Protection and I announced in our letter to the House of 7 November 2019 an AMvB on reasonable prices for the Youth Act.

Dit is de reden dat de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming en ik in de Tweede Kamerbrief «over het bericht dat jeugdzorgaanbieders naar de rechter stappen vanwege tariefverlagingen» van 7 november 2019 een AMvB reële prijs voor de Jeugdwet hebben aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de sluiting van arrestantencellen in de politiebureaus van Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede en Tiel

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether closing police custody cells in Doetinchem, Deventer, Ede and Tiel would reduce police availability for emergency response and whether a separate transport service should be created first. Minister Grapperhaus answered that spoedmeldingen take priority, that the cell closures are under impact analysis with the local authorities and a final decision is expected in spring 2020, and that he does not consider a separate transport service a precondition, though it may be a flanking measure.
In spring 2020 a final decision will be submitted to the board of the Oost-Nederland police unit.
In het voorjaar van 2020 zal een definitief besluit aan het bestuur in de eenheid Oost-Nederland worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over verslavende games voor minderjarigen

An MP asked the Minister whether addictive game elements, loot boxes and rising youth gaming addiction should be banned for minors, and whether that conflicts with the ban on minors in gambling. The Minister shares concern about gambling elements in games, notes that only loot boxes that are gambling under the Wok are prohibited and enforced by the Ksa, points to PEGI self-regulation, and promises to discuss strengthening PEGI with NICAM.
I share the view that it is undesirable for minors to be exposed in games to elements that can carry a risk of addiction.
Ik deel de mening dat het ongewenst is dat minderjarigen in games kunnen worden blootgesteld aan elementen die een verslavingsrisico met zich mee kunnen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in Al-Hol

Two Labour MPs asked the government about security and child welfare in the Al-Hol camp for IS-affiliated women and children, including Dutch nationals, after reports that Kurdish forces were losing control there. The government answered that it received no Kurdish warning, that it cannot give precise figures or child health information because it has no diplomatic presence in northeast Syria, that it is concerned about escape risks from Turkish operations and has raised this with allies, and that it is not changing its policy against actively repatriating children.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat zorginstelling Pluryn kinderen die specialistische hulp nodig hebben weigert

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth care provider Pluryn is refusing children needing specialist help, its financial difficulties, a recovery plan shifting to residential care, and staff workload. The Minister answered that Pluryn says no acute cases are refused, that funding is a municipal matter, that no subsidy clawback is currently planned, and that the Minister monitors the situation as system steward while pointing to broader reform and labour-market measures.
Municipalities have a duty to provide youth care and are responsible for the availability of appropriate youth care.
Gemeenten hebben een jeugdhulpplicht en zijn verantwoordelijk voor de beschikbaarheid van passende jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de situatie in het kamp Al-Hol in Syrisch Koerdistan

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked about the situation in Al-Hol camp, the repatriation of Dutch IS women and children (including a court order to make efforts for their return) and Iraq's reported demands for payment to prosecute foreign fighters. The government referred to earlier letters, said the detention orders cannot currently be carried out safely, stated it is seeking solutions with Schengen partners including prosecution in the region, and said it is too early to discuss compensation for Iraq.
The examination of the possibility of executing the detention orders issued by the Rotterdam court is ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid van de uitvoering van de bevelen gevangenneming van de rechtbank van Rotterdam duurt voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tientallen jeugdzorgorganisaties failliet dreigen te gaan

An MP asks the health minister whether dozens of youth care providers face bankruptcy, whether this threatens children's care, and whether the government will act, including on a motion for research into 'too big to fail' youth care organisations. The minister says providers and municipalities are primarily responsible, that the Youth Authority can mediate and escalate to the ministry if continuity of crucial care is at risk, and that an investigation found 40% of providers have a high financial risk, with further research planned.
Involvement from VWS is normally not necessary and not at issue in that case.
Bemoeienis vanuit VWS is daarbij normaal gesproken niet nodig en niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tientallen jeugdzorgorganisaties failliet dreigen te gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the conditions for emergency liquidity support to youth care providers at risk of bankruptcy, the budget source of the EUR 3 million support given to Juzt, and why support is given case by case rather than structurally. The minister answered that providers are primarily responsible, that VWS will intervene only in exceptional cases under strict conditions, that a EUR 20 million subsidy scheme is forthcoming, and that structural reform of youth care is being pursued separately.
Ahead of this subsidy scheme, in the specific case of youth care provider Juzt, EUR 3 million in liquidity support has been granted.
Vooruitlopend op deze subsidieregeling is in het specifieke geval van jeugdhulpaanbieder Juzt € 3 miljoen liquiditeitssteun toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een teamchef van de politie Leiden die naar huis is gestuurd

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a police team chief in Leiden was sent home for criticising racism and bullying within the police, and whether the police can accept public criticism on discrimination. The Minister replied that the chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the leadership welcomes criticism, and listed internal channels for reporting misconduct, including a new complaints committee and an ombudsman function.
The police leadership has informed me that the team chief has not been placed on non-active duty.
De korpsleiding heeft mij gemeld dat de teamchef niet op non-actief is gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over de administratieve lasten in de zorg die blijven stijgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why administrative burdens in care keep rising, how the (Ont)Regel de Zorg programme will deliver relief, and whether overhead in youth and social care is avoidable. The minister acknowledged the rise, said the programme must become more effective, committed to intensified local and national action and an in-depth KPMG study, but declined to commission a data-based mapping of coordination processes.
That is why we are currently carrying out an in-depth study on insight into the spending of youth care funds.
Daarom voeren we op dit moment een diepteonderzoek «inzicht in besteding jeugdzorgmiddelen» uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar oorzaken van langlopende letselschadezaken

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen and Kuiken asked why the University of Utrecht study into causes of long-running personal injury claims is delayed, and whether its independence is compromised given the involvement of the Letselschade Raad, insurers and QCPP. The minister attributes the delay to the broad design, privacy preparation, and insurer response rates, and defends the study's independence and balanced steering committee.
There are no reasons for me to doubt the independence and objectivity of the commissioning party.
Er zijn voor mij geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid en objectiviteit van de opdrachtgever.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van den Berge en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Minister Dekker kan teloorgang sociale advocatuur niets schelen; NOvA blijft weg uit topberaad’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how to react to the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) withdrawing from the top-level consultation on legal aid reform, which it called pointless, and why trust had collapsed. The minister regrets the NOvA's decision, says the door stays open, explains that no extra budget was provided in line with the coalition agreement, and points to a governance review by Bureau Gateway, inviting the NOvA back to talks.
I have invited the NOvA to resume talks in the short term.
Ik heb de NOvA uitgenodigd om op korte termijn weer in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat wederom een jeugdzorginstelling sluit vanwege financiële problemen

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government's May 2019 measures on financial problems at youth care providers are sufficient, after another youth care institution closed. The minister says gemeenten and the Jeugdautoriteit are responsible, describes an early warning instrument and a EUR 20 million liquidity facility, and declines to adopt the MP's motion on an investigation, though it promises an analysis by the Jeugdautoriteit.
I closely follow developments from my role as system steward.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend vanuit mijn rol als stelselverantwoordelijke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over jonge kinderen die worden blootgesteld aan gewelddadige beelden in gamehallen

An MP asked whether children as young as nine are exposed to violent games in gaming halls without supervision, and why these halls do not follow the age-classification rules that cinemas and shops follow. The minister answered that co-regulation applies, that article 240a of the Criminal Code makes it an offence to show harmful images to minors, and that inspections by Agentschap Telecom found gaming halls falling short, leading to industry talks, awareness work and tighter risk-based controls.
Second, I will work through the Nicam to raise awareness in the sector of the importance of protecting young people from harmful images.
Ten tweede zal ik via het Nicam bij de branche inzetten op bewustwording van het belang van bescherming van jongeren tegen schadelijk beeldmateriaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een meisje zelfmoord pleegde na het niet-bestaande telefoonnummer ‘113’ te bellen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a Winschoten case in which a girl who called the non-existent number 113 for suicide help took her own life, asking about sympathy, the misleading 113 name, the timeline of talks on reassigning the number, the 144 comparison, and free access to the helpline. The State Secretary expressed sympathy, explained the history and reasoning behind the number issue, and deferred the detailed answers to a same-day letter to parliament, while outlining that 1-1-3 could be made available subject to conditions and a three-month process.
Together with the Minister of Justice and Security we will investigate the possibilities, risks and appropriate conditions for making this number available.
Samen met de Minister van JenV zullen wij onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden, de risico's en passende voorwaarden zijn bij het beschikbaar maken van dit nummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een kwart van de ggz-instellingen 2018 afsloten met rode cijfers

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that a quarter of mental health (ggz) institutions closed 2018 in the red, and whether unpaid care, labour shortages and cost-driven incentives threaten access to care. The state secretary answered that contracting disputes can go to court or the complaints committee, that the NZa monitors insurers' duty of care, and that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord addresses the issues, expressing hope that early 2019 results are improving.
Should a conflict arise in contracting between a care provider and an insurer or municipality, the parties can submit it to the court.
Mocht er bij de contractering overigens een conflict ontstaan tussen een zorgaanbieder en een verzekeraar of gemeente, dan kunnen partijen dat aan de rechter voorleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘bewijs voor bemoeienis proces Wilders, PVV leider overweegt stappen’

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the 2014 decision to prosecute Geert Wilders was a provisional rather than final decision, and whether the ministry or its predecessor influenced it. The minister explained that a 'voorgenomen' decision is standard before a suspect is heard, and that the former minister had no formal instruction and no evident opinion on prosecution before the decision was announced.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht  ‘Topambtenaren eisten harde aanpak in proces tegen 'kwaadaardige' Wilders’

MPs Kuiken, Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether ministry officials improperly advised the public prosecution service (OM) on prosecuting Wilders, citing reports that officials urged a tough approach and wanted to read the requisitoir in advance. Minister Grapperhaus largely refers to earlier answers and a letter sending documents to the Chamber, while stating the College of procurators-general must provide information the minister needs.
I refer you to my answer to questions 1 through 6 today on the questions from members Groothuizen and Van Nispen about the involvement of the Ministry of Justice and Security in the Wilders case.

Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 tot en met 6 van heden op de vragen van de leden Groothuizen (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) over bemoeienis van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de inbeslagname van twee wietplanten voor medicinale cannabis

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether patients may keep up to five cannabis plants for medicinal use after police seized two plants from an elderly man, and whether the policy on cannabis is unclear. The government answered that medicinal cannabis is available via pharmacies on prescription, home cultivation remains prohibited (five plants or fewer are low enforcement priority but seizures still happen), no change is planned, and the cannabis experiment will inform future policy.
The possession and cultivation of cannabis plants for one's own medicinal use is prohibited.
Het bezit en het telen van cannabisplanten voor eigen medicinaal gebruik is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het onterecht stoppen van huurtoeslag aan statushouders

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked why housing allowance is stopped and reclaimed for statushouder families when a baby is born, and asked for compensation and a fix. The government answers that the allowance is restored retroactively once the child's residence permit is granted, that the problem stems from legal eligibility requirements rather than automatic database linking, and promises to examine options with other ministers and report in spring 2020.
Even in the case of an initially late application for a residence permit, there is ultimately no loss of housing allowance.
Zelfs bij een in eerste instantie te late aanvraag van een verblijfstitel is er dus uiteindelijk geen verlies aan huurtoeslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de sluiting van een Pro Persona-locatie in Ede

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about the reported closure of a Pro Persona mental health location in Ede, its effects on patients, waiting lists, and other locations. The State Secretary replied that the provider is responsible for its finances, that a phased reduction of beds in Ede (over one to two years) is being explored rather than an immediate closure, that care continuity is assured, and that regulators (NZa, IGJ) monitor the situation, while declining to answer questions about other providers.
I cannot answer this question. It is the responsibility of care providers themselves to take timely measures to address financial problems.
Ik kan deze vraag niet beantwoorden. Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders zelf om tijdig maatregelen te nemen om financiële problemen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het faillissement van GGZ-instelling Vincere Groep

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of addiction and mental health provider Vincere Groep, including effects on patients, staff, waiting lists and causes. The State Secretary answered that the curator handles care transfer and causes, that IGJ and NZa supervise continuity of care, and that the provider was responsible for its own finances, while committing to no concrete new action beyond monitoring.
It is up to the curator of Vincere Groep to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy.
Het is aan de curator van de Vincere Groep om onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken van het faillissement.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Duitse kinderen uit Syrië door Duitsland

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Dutch ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the government knew in advance of Germany's repatriation of children from Syria, how many Dutch children remain in Syrian camps, and why the Netherlands does not repatriate them. The ministers answered that the Netherlands was not informed beforehand, that active repatriation is not government policy except possibly for orphans, that about 85 children with a Dutch link are in SDF camps, and that the government will study the return of orphans.
It is unknown how many Dutch children are currently in Syrian camps.
Het is onbekend hoeveel Nederlandse kinderen zich momenteel in Syrische kampen bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Honderden ouderen in Caribisch Nederland hebben nauwelijks te eten'

Kuiken (PvdA) asked the ministers about a report by the National Ombudsman finding that hundreds of elderly people in Caribbean Netherlands have barely enough food, asking whether the conditions are unacceptable, whether the government will act on the recommendations, the proposed Caribbean table, how the poverty threshold relates to elderly living conditions, what measures will be taken, and whether child poverty will be investigated. The ministers acknowledge the difficult situation, say they will discuss the findings with the Ombudsman, list income and cost-of-living measures already taken or planned, commit to annual monitoring, and point to a forthcoming UNICEF-based letter on children's rights.
The cabinet considers the National Ombudsman's point about looking more broadly than only the income of the elderly valuable.
Het kabinet vindt het aandachtspunt van de Nationale ombudsman om breder te kijken dan alleen het inkomen van ouderen waardevol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kuiken over het bericht 'Limburg absolute koploper in verstrekken betaalde klussen aan oud-politici'

MPs Özütok and Kuiken asked the Interior Minister about reports that Limburg province awarded paid assignments to former politicians more than all other provinces combined, and about procurement, integrity and transparency concerns. The minister answered that the province reports no violation of EU or internal procurement rules beyond one 2017 internal-rule deviation, that the commissioner of the King's ambtsbericht was requested, and that the minister will review integrity rules for former office-holders with the provincial associations and advise more careful procurement practice.
I will inform the college of provincial executive of this finding in a letter.
Ik zal het college van gedeputeerde staten van deze bevinding in een brief op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de positie van een slachtoffer in een lopende zedenzaak

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the treatment of victims in sexual offence cases, including how victims for the Inspectorate's study were selected and how a forensic psychiatric clinic handled internal checks after a rape by a patient on leave. The Minister explains a random sample of 130 victims was drawn, that no standard investigation of tbs patients is done after nearby offences unless there are indications, and that the clinic conducted an internal incident investigation which was halted once an external suspect was arrested.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security informed me that it drew a random sample in a scientifically sound manner to select the victims.
de Inspectie) heeft mij geïnformeerd dat zij op wetenschappelijk verantwoorde wijze een a-selectieve steekproef heeft getrokken om de slachtoffers te selecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het afbranden van monument Haarendael

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about a fire that destroyed the listed Haarendael estate, including its cause, whether the owner failed to protect it, and whether long-term neglect of maintenance is acceptable. The minister answered that the cause is still under investigation, that the owner had no effective protective measures and the building was left vacant, and that she agrees long-term neglect of monuments is undesirable and promotes regular maintenance.
Technical investigation into the cause of the fire is still being carried out.
Technisch onderzoek naar de oorzaak van de brand wordt nog uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over Nederlandse kinderen die vastzitten in Syrische opvangkampen.

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers about Dutch children held in Syrian camps, including how many have trauma, what support they receive, and whether the government will bring them home. The government answered that at least 85 such children are in Kurdish-run camps, that aid agencies decide where help goes, and that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children, while promising care and a multidisciplinary team for children who return.

Government policy, as confirmed in the Minister of Justice and Security's letter to the House of 21 February 2019, is still that the Netherlands does not help travellers leave unsafe areas in Syria and Iraq.

Het kabinetsbeleid, zoals ook bevestigd in de brief van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid aan uw Kamer van 21 februari 2019, is nog steeds dat Nederland uitreizigers niet helpt bij het verlaten van onveilig gebied in Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

An MP asked the government about sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners, including the status of a victim-reporting campaign, numbers of reports and prosecutions, whether tantra massage should be licensed or regulated, and the handling of a reported case at The New Tantra. The minister answered that tantra massage is not a protected profession, the health inspectorate found no jurisdiction, licensing is only required for commercial sexual services, and no further regulation is planned, while a victim-reporting campaign starts in November 2019.
I currently see no reason to regulate the profession of tantra massage practitioner by law.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding om het beroep van tantramasseur wettelijk te reguleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het schrappen van zware jeugdzorg voordat alternatieve, dan wel ambulante jeugdzorg beschikbaar is

An MP asks the minister whether plans by sixteen municipalities to cut specialist youth care beds in 2020, before alternative ambulant care is in place, threaten continuity of care and how the minister will guarantee it. The minister says municipalities bear a statutory duty to ensure continuity, that the Ondersteuningsteam Zorg voor de Jeugd is looking at reaching agreement, that he sees no reason yet for action, and that he has no signals of similar cuts elsewhere.
Municipalities have a statutory duty to provide youth care.
Gemeenten zijn hebben een wettelijk vastgelegde jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevaarlijke situatie na spontaan springen van ramen bij ministeries Rijnstraat 8

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked about window breakages at the Rijnstraat 8 government building, the safety risks, costs, and whether the building is fit for purpose. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies with the contractor PoortCentraal, that wind-speed closures and inspections were introduced, that a root-cause study is pending, and that costs to the state are about 600,000 euro.
Your House has not been separately informed.
Uw Kamer is niet separaat geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat advocaten stoppen met het verlenen van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand vanwege te lage tarieven

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that criminal lawyers are quitting subsidised legal aid because fees are too low, and whether the government will act on falling lawyer numbers. The minister said the decline in registered criminal lawyers is mainly due to lawyers failing registration requirements and fewer legal-aid assignments, but acknowledged the signals and committed to a reform of the legal aid system within budget limits.
Access to justice will remain the starting point under a revised legal aid system as well.
Toegang tot het recht zal ook onder een herzien stelsel van rechtsbijstand het uitgangspunt blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden en Kuiken over het bericht 'Relatie zorgfraude en terrorisme onderzocht'

Two MPs asked whether suspicious financial transactions linked to care fraud, and a possible link with terrorism financing, were detected and acted upon by the FIU-Nederland, including how many transactions there were and whether earlier years were investigated. The minister replied that over 1,300 unusual transactions related to care fraud were reported in 2018, that many remain under investigation so no concrete figures are yet available, and that no further retrospective investigation is planned.
As a result, no concrete statements can yet be made about the number of transactions declared suspicious by the FIU-Nederland that may be related to care fraud, or the amount involved.

Hierdoor kunnen er nog geen concrete uitspraken worden gedaan over het aantal door de FIU-Nederland verdacht verklaarde transacties dat mogelijk te relateren is aan zorgfraude alsmede het bedrag dat daarmee gemoeid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het wegpesten van een transgenderstel in Heerlen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government whether local authorities and police have enough tools to stop harassment of LGBTI people, as in the Heerlen case of a transgender couple who moved out, and whether further action or consultation is planned. The minister answered that existing tools are sufficient, that Heerlen used a range of measures including an area ban, and that no additional instruments or consultation are needed, while pointing to the existing Action Plan.
Yes, local administrators and police have sufficient powers to address and tackle persons who harass LGBTI people to the point of driving them out.
Ja, de lokale bestuurders en politie beschikken over voldoende mogelijkheden om personen, die LHBTI's lastig vallen tot wegpesten aan toe, aan te spreken en aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een tekort aan politieagenten in Brabant

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police staff shortages in Brabant, including wijkagenten being redeployed to emergency response and whether this undermines the statutory neighbourhood-officer norm. The minister acknowledged temporary pressure, said the norm is unaffected because the formation is unchanged, and pointed to incoming recruits and extra funding without committing to new structural measures.
By temporarily deploying neighbourhood officers differently, the composition of a unit's establishment is not changed.
Door het tijdelijk anders inzetten van wijkagenten wordt de samenstelling van de formatie van een eenheid niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de humanitaire noodsituatie waarin vluchtelingen in Libië verkeren

MPs asked the government about the humanitarian crisis facing migrants in Libyan detention centres near the conflict zone, including reports of an airstrike on the Tajoura centre, forced labour, and whether the Netherlands would evacuate migrants or offer asylum. The minister answered that the centres are unsafe, that Libya's GNA government agreed to close three centres including Tajoura, that Nederland supports IOM/UNHCR evacuations and ETM resettlement from Niger, but that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission route like Italy's and direct evacuation to the Netherlands is not possible.
The Netherlands has no admission on humanitarian grounds, unlike Italy. Direct evacuation from Libya to the Netherlands is therefore not among the possibilities.
Nederland kent geen toegang op humanitaire gronden, zoals Italië. Directe evacuatie vanuit Libië naar Nederland behoort dan ook niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het ongevraagd ontvangen van seksueel getinte afbeeldingen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether unsolicited sending of sexually explicit images ('dickpics') is criminal, how many complaints were filed, and whether police would investigate single cases. The minister confirmed such sending can fall under article 240 Sr. and related provisions, said complaint numbers are not recorded, and stated that all sexual offence reports are taken seriously but prioritised case by case, with child abuse given precedence.
Unsolicited sending of sexually explicit images to adults, which are offensive to the decency of persons, is not recorded as such by the police.

Het ongevraagd toesturen van seksueel getinte afbeeldingen naar volwassenen, die aanstootgevend zijn voor de eerbaarheid van personen (zoals dergelijke afbeelding) wordt bij de politie niet als zodanig bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de baby en peuter van een Nederlandse vader die zich zonder ouders in een kamp in Noord-Syrië bevinden

Two MPs from the PvdA ask about two young children of a Dutch jihadist without parents in a camp in northern Syria, including their health, why they were not brought back, and whether consular help can be requested. The government says it cannot comment on individual cases, denies diplomats visited the camp, distinguishes this case from the French repatriation, and notes consular assistance requires a request from the Dutch national or their representative.
As you know, the cabinet cannot go into individual cases in more detail.
Zoals u weet kan het kabinet hier niet nader ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Kuiken over het illegaal aanbieden van op Nederlanders gerichte online kansspelen

An MP asks whether illegal online gambling operators targeting the Dutch market should be excluded from licences, and how the two-year cooling-off period for licence applicants works. The minister confirms the government will refuse illegal operators actively targeting the Dutch market, explains the two-year good-conduct period, and says the Kansspelautoriteit has published a draft policy rule with indicators and a Bibob check.
I indeed maintain the position that I want to exclude illegal providers that continue to actively target the Dutch market.
Ik blijf inderdaad bij het standpunt dat ik illegale aanbieders die zich actief op de Nederlandse markt blijven richten wil weren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de politie niet diverser wordt

The MP asks why police attrition among officers with a migration background is high and whether police culture and handling of discrimination complaints contribute, and what will be done to make the force more diverse. The minister agrees diversity improves effectiveness, reports low overall attrition with migrant-background exit share below their intake share, says exit interviews are being developed and discrimination complaints are not recorded, and lists culture measures and recruitment steps including a 25% target.
It cannot currently be determined whether the handling of discrimination complaints is a reason for leaving the organisation.
Het is nu niet te achterhalen of de omgang met klachten over discriminatie een reden voor het verlaten van de organisatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over een onderzoek naar de veiligheid van constructies in publieke gebouwen

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked whether public buildings are regularly checked for structural safety, why wind loads are not studied, and how the findings of the 2016 football stadium safety audit were followed up. The minister replied that building owners and municipalities are responsible, that no mandatory periodic inspection exists, that targeted inspection duties are used for specific building types, and that the stadium audit was discussed with clubs and municipalities without new specific standards.
At this moment it is still unclear what caused the collapse of the roof of the AZ stadium.
Op dit moment is nog onduidelijk wat de oorzaak is geweest van het instorten van het dak van het AZ-stadion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat criminelen amateurvoetbalclubs infiltreren

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that criminals are infiltrating amateur football clubs, including their motives, what clubs and local authorities can require from sponsors (such as certificates of conduct and Bibob screening), and whether Bibob can be extended. The minister answered that criminal motives vary, pointed to existing tools and guidance, said he will discuss the findings and a related motion with the health and sport minister, but left the clubs and municipalities largely responsible for vetting sponsors.
I will discuss the findings of the study commissioned by the Taskforce Brabant Zeeland with my colleague at VWS, though these are not yet available.
Ik zal met mijn ambtgenoot van VWS de uitkomsten van het onderzoek dat in opdracht van de Taskforce Brabant Zeeland is uitgevoerd – die overigens thans nog niet beschikbaar zijn – bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

The MP Kuiken asks whether a psychiatric disorder should be presumed for the most serious rapists so that TBS can be imposed without a forensic PJ report, and whether this would resolve the problem of suspects refusing observation. The minister answers that not every rapist has a disorder, that the EUR report advises against presumption as disproportionate, and that the government is pursuing other measures to reduce refusals and their effect.
I have committed to mapping, together with the Public Prosecution Service, the practice of carrying out PJ reports in serious sexual offence cases.
Ik heb daarbij toegezegd dat ik met het Openbaar Ministerie de praktijk van het uitvoeren van PJ-rapportages bij ernstige zedenzaken in kaart zal brengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over tbs voor verkrachters

An MP asks whether a legal rule should require a rape court to consider TBS (compulsory psychiatric treatment) for the most serious rape cases, unless the suspect proves no psychiatric disorder, and asks for a study of this with results before year-end. The minister refers to the answer to earlier Kamervragen rather than addressing the proposal directly.
For the answer to this question I refer you to the answer to questions 3 and 4 of the parliamentary questions submitted on 28 May 2019.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en 4 van de Kamervragen ingezonden op 28 mei 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council  of Europe’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether Hungary's treatment of asylum seekers, reported as food deprivation, also breaches international law such as the Refugee Convention, whether this has been raised in other fora, and whether Hungary has a duty of care and what aid options exist. The government answered that parts of Hungarian asylum policy conflict with international obligations, that the Commission has started infringement procedures and the Article 7 process covers fundamental rights, that it will keep raising concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and that it awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before further steps, with no specific aid discussed in the Council of Europe.
The cabinet awaits the outcomes of the infringement procedures before taking any new steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van de inbreukprocedures af alvorens nieuwe stappen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de oprichting van een nieuwe motorclub vanuit de gevangenis

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a detained man could found a new motorcycle club from prison, what formalities and communication means he had, and whether the number of motorclubs has risen. The minister answered that founding an association is permitted within legal limits, that no registration exists in the trade register, that the inmate was disciplined for unauthorised media contact, and that the 2018 gang progress report will be sent to parliament once received.
Inquiry at the trade register on 26 June 2019 shows that no registration under the name "Hardliners" has in any case been made in the trade register.
Uit navraag op 26 juni 2019 bij het handelsregister blijkt dat in het handelsregister in ieder geval geen inschrijving is gedaan onder de naam «Hardliners».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat jonge vrouwen die Saoedi-Arabië ontvluchten om een gedwongen huwelijk en seksueel misbruik te voorkomen

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister and justice state secretary about reports that two young Saudi women fleeing forced marriage were refused boarding in Georgia, whether they would be admitted, and what the government was doing on Saudi women's rights. The minister said the reports could not be confirmed, no visa application was made, asylum for such women runs only through UNHCR resettlement, and that Nederland repeatedly raises women's rights bilaterally and in the EU and UN.
Because of the small numbers, it is not possible for privacy and technical reasons to state what the asylum motives are.
Vanwege de kleine aantallen is het om privacy technische redenen niet mogelijk aan te geven wat de asielmotieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de dood van een Nederlands echtpaar in de Caribische zee

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the death of a Dutch couple at sea near Colombia, including whether the families are kept informed, whether capacity and Colombian cooperation are adequate, and the role of the Dutch liaison officer. The minister answered that families are kept regularly informed, that the investigation team has sufficient capacity, that Colombian execution times are not exceptionally long, and that cooperation is of good quality.
The investigation team regularly and continuously keeps the next of kin informed of the status of the criminal investigation.
Het onderzoeksteam houdt de nabestaanden regelmatig en doorlopend op de hoogte van de stand van zaken van het strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jeugdzorg niet langer verantwoord is

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth care in Twente is no longer responsible, and whether the government will act on regional deficits and the risk that money concerns overshadow care quality. The Minister acknowledges shortages, points to €1.02 billion extra for municipalities, bilateral agreements with the VNG, further research, and procurement support, while stating extra money alone will not solve the problems.
For this reason, the cabinet and the VNG have simultaneously made administrative agreements to make the youth care system function better, more effectively and more efficiently.
Daarom hebben het kabinet en de VNG gelijktijdig bestuurlijke afspraken gemaakt om het jeugdhulpstelsel beter, effectiever en efficiënter te laten functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Overheidsalmanak staat bol van de fouten'

An MP asked about press reports that the government's online almanac contains many errors and omissions in data on councillors and provincial members, and whether it should be freely accessible and accurate. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, attributed the errors to data supplied by the VNG and provinces, agreed that the almanac must be complete and accurate, and promised to contact those bodies and add editorial capacity.
I will contact the VNG and the provinces concerned about improving the supply of data.
Ik zal contact opnemen met de VNG en met de betrokken provincies over een verbetering van de aanlevering van gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de verkoop van nazipropaganda via internet

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether selling Nazi propaganda online is prohibited and whether it promotes antisemitism and extremist circulation. The minister answered that such sales may fall under article 137e of the Penal Code but must be judged case by case under case law, and that the Public Prosecution Service will act under its discrimination guidelines where appropriate.
Where appropriate, the Public Prosecution Service will act in accordance with the discrimination guidelines when such material is distributed.
In voorkomende gevallen zal het Openbaar Ministerie bij de verspreiding van dergelijk materiaal conform de aanwijzing discriminatie 5 optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de aanhoudende problemen bij jeugdzorginstelling Juzt

An MP asks the health minister about persistent problems at youth care institution Juzt, including a threatened penalty and whether the relocated youth group is housed in a suitable, safe location. The minister explains the inspectorate imposed a last under penalty, that the group moved to a new house on 27 June, and that the inspectorate found it compliant on 4 July, with the order to be lifted soon.
The IGJ has closely monitored the situation and had various options to force the care provider to deliver good care.
De IGJ heeft de situatie nauwgezet in de gaten gehouden en had verschillende mogelijkheden om de zorgaanbieder te dwingen goede zorg te verlenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het online bestellen van wapens en drugs

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether weapons and drugs can be ordered easily online, whether the government knew of this, and what it will do about parcel checks and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the problem, said parcel legitimation is not warranted, pointed to the EU firearms directive and a forthcoming letter and action programme, but gave no concrete new measures.
This investigation by the Inside programme maker gives no reason to reconsider the identification requirement for sending postal parcels.
Dit onderzoek van de programmamaker van Inside geeft geen aanleiding om legitimatieplicht bij het versturen van postpakketten te heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het terughalen van Nederlandse kinderen uit Syrië

Two PvdA MPs asked whether MIVD staff or Dutch diplomats regularly visit the Al-Roj camp in Syria to prepare repatriation, how often delegations have visited, and whether the Netherlands prepares for returning children and their parents. The ministers declined to comment publicly on intelligence service methods, called the report of biweekly diplomatic visits incorrect, and stated that returnees will be brought back in a controlled manner for prosecution while children are treated as victims and childcare plans are ready.
No public statements are made about the working methods of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over de werkwijze van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked how much of the earlier co-financing budget for drug waste clean-up remained unspent, whether private owners should be compensated for clean-up costs, and what the government will do to provide structural funding. The government answered that EUR 1.2 million remained unspent and is available to provinces, that EUR 1 million per year is now structurally reserved for 2019-2024, and that responsibility for clean-up lies with regional and local authorities, with private owners to be compensated where they bear no fault.
The cabinet now makes available structurally another EUR 1 million per year for 2019 to 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het vergoeden van kosten voor het opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked whether innocent private landowners should not have to pay for clearing drug waste dumped on their land, following a Council of State ruling, and what consequences the government draws. The Staatssecretaris replied that regional and local authorities are primarily responsible, notes provincial subsidy schemes, and announces a structural 1 million euro per year from 2019 to 2024 so that private owners are fully compensated for direct clean-up costs and municipalities partly compensated.

The cabinet now makes available structurally another 1 million euro per year for 2019 through 2024 from the Ministry of Justice and Security budget to (co)finance the direct costs of clearing drug dumps.

Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 miljoen per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid om de directe kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen te kunnen (co)financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over nieuwe bezuinigingen en dreigende sluitingen van justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether savings on youth detention institutions, possibly including closures, were being considered, and questioned the timing, capacity forecasts and consultation of the regions. The Minister replied that a reorganisation towards smaller and specialist facilities is set out in a letter of 28 June 2019, that the reforms fit the coalition agreement, that current occupancy forecasts show no short-term capacity shortage, and that a debate with the House is welcome.
The decision-making has been sent to you with my letter of 28 June 2019. I am happy to debate this with your House.
De besluitvorming heb ik u met mijn brief van 28 juni 2019 toegezonden. Ik ga hierover graag met uw Kamer in debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de Nederlandse drugsaanpak

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Dutch drug approach is still adequate against organised crime, whether a research commission on regulation or legalisation should be set up, and whether prevention should be strengthened. The minister answered that the approach is reviewed regularly, rejected a new research commission on hard drugs given the international consensus, and pointed to an ongoing cannabis experiment and new prevention measures.
Establishing a committee to conduct research as proposed is therefore not, in my view, appropriate.
Het in het leven roepen van een commissie die onderzoek gaat doen zoals wordt voorgesteld, acht ik dan ook niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council of Europe’

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the ministers whether the government was aware of, and shocked by, the Council of Europe Commissioner's report on Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food, and whether it had raised this with Hungary or the EU. The government answered that it knows the report, shares the concerns, raises them bilaterally and in the EU, notes Commission infringement procedures, and supports a formal Article 7 dialogue with Hungary.
The cabinet will continue to raise the concerns both bilaterally and at European level with the Hungarian authorities.
Het kabinet blijft de zorgen in zowel bilateraal als Europees verband uitspreken richting de Hongaarse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over een Europees beroepsverbod

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked whether foreign occupational bans can be used in Bibob integrity screening, whether stakeholders can force a Bibob check and challenge refusals in court, and whether improper animal treatment can factor into environmental permit decisions. The minister answered that foreign criminal and administrative sanctions can be considered in Bibob screening, that initiating a Bibob check is discretionary and not appealable, and that animal welfare falls outside environmental protection but criminal animal offences can ground a permit refusal.
Whether or not to apply the Bibob Act is a discretionary power of the administrative body concerned.
Het al dan niet toepassen van de Wet Bibob is een discretionaire bevoegdheid van het betreffende bestuursorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VVD en CDA zien geen heil in terughalen IS-kinderen’

MPs Ploumen, Kuiken and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about the situation of Dutch IS women and children held in Syrian camps, their ability to reach Dutch consulates, the Red Cross offer to bring children to Erbil, and calls for an international tribunal. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult jihadist travellers and their children, that conditions in Al-Hol are very poor, and that it is working on options for prosecution with international partners while stating no tribunal has yet been agreed.
The cabinet sees the children in this matter first and foremost as victims.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen in deze kwestie in de eerste plaats als slachtoffer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de plaatsing van ex-gedetineerden in een woonwijk in Arnhem

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about placing ex-prisoners and forensic clients in an Arnhem residential flat without prior consultation with the municipality and residents. The minister confirmed five forensic clients were placed by DJI, acknowledged poor contact with the municipality, and committed to making municipal contact a contractual obligation and to ongoing engagement with the municipality and residents.
To ensure that care providers actively and regularly engage with municipalities, this will henceforth be included as an obligation in the contracts between DJI and forensic institutions.

Om ervoor te zorgen dat zorgaanbieders actief en regelmatig in contact treden met gemeenten zal dit voortaan als verplichting opgenomen worden in de contracten tussen DJI en de forensische instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dissidenten uit Hongkong krijgen voor het eerst asiel in Duitsland’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign and justice ministers about Hong Kong's proposed extradition law to China, its risks for Dutch citizens and firms, and German asylum grants to Hong Kong dissidents. The government said it had raised concerns with Hong Kong's leader and the EU, that the law was suspended, and that asylum decisions do not reflect on the rule of law in the country of origin.
The cabinet will closely follow developments and, if necessary, consider what the consequences should be for cooperation with Hong Kong on the surrender of fugitive offenders.

Het kabinet zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en zal zo nodig bezien wat de eventuele gevolgen zouden moeten zijn voor de samenwerking met Hongkong op het gebied van overlevering van voortvluchtige delinquenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VN: 1.500 migranten in levensgevaar in Libië’

Four MPs asked the government about reports that about 1,500 migrants held in detention centres south of Tripoli were in danger from fighting, and about the evacuation of detainees, reports of forced participation in the conflict, and possible Dutch action. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is following the situation closely, supports UNHCR and IOM evacuations and resettlement via the Emergency Transit Mechanism, is considering additional funding, and says forced use of civilians in fighting would violate international humanitarian law, while the forced-participation reports were not confirmed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht dat Facebook toch in de fout gaat met politieke advertenties uit het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked whether Facebook still lets foreign actors place political ads targeting other countries despite its transparency pledges, and whether self-regulation should give way to legislation. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government lacks power to enforce full ad transparency, and promised an inventory of existing rules and expert consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Alsof het journaal in het Frans wordt voorgelezen’

Two MPs asked whether the government had noticed reports that deaf and hard-of-hearing people could not follow broadcast news, and whether sign-language interpreters would be used in live crisis communication. The ministers confirmed awareness and said a plan of action to improve crisis communication for vulnerable groups, including sign-language interpreting, would be sent to parliament after the summer.
For the concrete elaboration we are drawing up a plan of action, in line with the request of the House of Representatives.
Voor de concrete uitwerking maken we een plan van aanpak, conform het verzoek van de Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jongeren die grensoverschrijdend gedrag vertonen niet worden behandeld

MP Kuiken asked whether a national overview exists of young people with risky behaviour who go untreated, despite court orders, and whether the government will act on municipalities' funding requests. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that waiting lists are being tackled regionally, and that extra funds for youth care were allocated, with a progress report promised.
To ensure that rulings on this component are actually carried out, the Youth Act obliges municipalities to deploy the youth assistance that a judge deems necessary.
Om te verzekeren dat vonnissen op dit onderdeel daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd, verplicht de Jeugdwet gemeenten de jeugdhulp die een rechter nodig acht, in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over advocaten die de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten wordt geweigerd

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether US entry bans against lawyers defending terrorism suspects could deter Dutch lawyers, and whether the minister would consult the US ambassador. The minister agreed lawyers must practise freely, said US entry decisions are sovereign and based on many criteria, and reported that US authorities referred to general policy and would not address individual cases; the government will keep monitoring the situation.
Lawyers must be free in the exercise of their profession, given the important role they play in realising the right of suspects to a fair trial.
