Advocaten moeten vrij zijn in de uitoefening van hun beroep, gelet op de belangrijke rol die zij spelen in de verwezenlijking van het recht van verdachten op een eerlijk proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about budget cuts and job losses at youth care provider Elker – het Poortje in Groningen and Drenthe, and the risks for suicidal and vulnerable youths. The minister answered that a mediation process is ongoing under the support team OZJ, that municipalities hold the youth care duty, and that the Jeugdautoriteit and a dispute committee exist, with a 20 million euro liquidity facility, but gave no concrete rescue plan or contingency document.
Municipalities are responsible for youth care and have a youth care duty.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de jeugdhulp en hebben een jeugdhulpplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over de brandbrief van de Raad van Toezicht van jeugdzorginstelling Elker – het Poortje

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the minister about the board of Elker – het Poortje's warning that youth care institutions can no longer provide good care, and about financial shortfalls and lack of coordination in the youth care transition. The minister acknowledged the signals, pointed to a mediation track with regional bodies, extra municipal funding and the Jeugdautoriteit, but did not commit to a new concrete intervention beyond monitoring.
It is a worrying signal and it has my explicit attention.
Het is een zorgelijk signaal en het heeft nadrukkelijk mijn aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over betere samenwerking tussen banken in de strijd tegen witwassen

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about bank customer due diligence against money laundering, whether banks must check prior banks for new clients, and whether they may share information on suspected launderers, plus the idea of a blacklist for convicted launderers. The minister explained the Wwft duties, said banks may share limited transaction information but not account or mortgage data, and said a review of data sharing and a register of high-risk clients is underway, with results in a plan of action.

I am examining not only the legal (im)possibilities and the added value for the effectiveness of customer due diligence and transaction monitoring, but also the proportionality and desirability of the information exchange.

Ik onderzoek niet alleen de juridische (on)mogelijkheden en de toegevoegde waarde voor de effectiviteit van het cliëntenonderzoek en de transactiemonitoring, maar ook de proportionaliteit en wenselijkheid van de informatie-uitwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het feit dat het aantal jeugdzorg klachten in Den Haag is verdubbeld

An MP asks the minister about the doubling of youth care complaints handled by the Hague youth ombudsman, under-reporting by vulnerable youth, waiting lists, administrative burden and whether the Hague municipality will be engaged. The minister says the rise may reflect growing awareness of the ombudsman, plans to lower barriers and tackle waiting times regionally, and that the issues are not specific to The Hague.
I believe the threshold for approaching the Youth Ombudsman should be as low as possible.
Ik vind dat de drempel richting de Jeugdombudsman zo laag mogelijk moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de Deventer moordzaak

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the status of the Supreme Court's review of the Deventer murder case, whether a CD-ROM of police material was newly available, and what consequences irregularities in past police investigations could have. Minister Grapperhaus described the procedural history and ongoing DNA research, said the handling of evidence carriers was outside the review's scope, and stated that consequences for officials depend on circumstances and that the Supreme Court decides whether irregularities amount to a novum.
It is for the Supreme Court to assess whether there are irregularities and whether these must be treated as a novum.
Het is aan de Hoge Raad om te beoordelen of sprake is van onregelmatigheden en of die als novum moeten worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Dochtertje van Nederlandse Syriëganger overleden in vluchtelingenkamp’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about reports that a Dutch Syria-returnee's young daughter died in the Al Hol camp, the camp conditions, and whether Dutch women and children would be brought back. The ministers acknowledged the dire humanitarian conditions and the child deaths, but said the Netherlands does not actively repatriate its nationals from Syria, separating children from parents is undesirable and legally complex, and consular assistance is only given if they report to a Dutch mission in the region.
The Netherlands takes no action aimed at or supporting the active repatriation of Dutch travellers to Syria.
Nederland onderneemt geen actie gericht op of ondersteunend aan het actief terughalen van Nederlandse uitreizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de AIVD niet langer gegevens met Oostenrijk deelt

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of the Interior whether Austria's BVT had left the Club de Berne, whether the AIVD's cooperation with Austria was affected, whether Dutch government composition or Russian ties should limit intelligence sharing, and whether the Netherlands lobbied against BVT cooperation. The Minister repeatedly answered by citing the statutory risk-weighing procedure under the Wiv 2017 and declined to discuss the specific arrangements with foreign services publicly.
The AIVD and MIVD do not make public statements about the precise arrangement of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de hulp aan achterblijvers van vermiste personen in het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether families of people missing abroad should receive better and more standardised help, including a 24-hour help desk, and whether it is absurd that they are advised to crowdfund searches. The minister answered that the local authorities bear primary responsibility, that the ministry keeps families informed via a contact person, and that a dedicated search fund would undermine local responsibility, so the government will not set one up.
By setting up a search fund and creating the impression that the Dutch government can and wants to take over a case, that responsibility is actually undermined and undesirable effects can arise.

Door het instellen van een fonds voor opsporing en de indruk te wekken dat de Nederlandse overheid een zaak kan en wil overnemen, wordt die verantwoordelijkheid juist ontkracht en kunnen ongewenste effecten ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het misbruikschandaal bij ProDemos

An MP asked the ministers about a sexual abuse scandal at ProDemos, a publicly funded democracy-education foundation, including whether the organisation had taken proper steps, whether an independent inquiry was warranted, and how former staff were supported and protected in deciding whether to file complaints. The minister reported the dismissal of a leader, internal and external investigations, aftercare offers, and an independent committee under Tjibbe Joustra to report before the summer recess.
I am of the view that everyone should feel free to file a complaint, without fear of repercussions.
Ik ben van mening dat eenieder zich vrij moet voelen om aangifte te doen, zonder angst voor repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de diensten van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about secret contracts between legal expenses insurers and subcontracted firms, and whether insured persons receive adequate legal aid given low fixed fees and outsourcing. The minister described existing supervision by AFM and DNB, self-regulation and complaint routes, said quality of legal aid is essential in the new system, and noted case law on free choice of lawyer without addressing specifics of the reports.
Administrative supervision of legal expenses insurers is carried out by the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het bestuursrechtelijk toezicht op rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars vindt plaats door de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat tarieven in de jeugd-ggz niet kostendekkend zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether youth mental health care tariffs fail to cover costs, with a majority of providers reporting losses averaging 3%, and what steps will address it. The minister replied that tariffs are a matter for municipalities and providers in a decentralised system, pointed to existing support bodies, a dispute committee and a Youth Authority, and said he takes the issue seriously without committing to new measures.
Providers' executives are primarily responsible for the management of their organisations.
Bestuurders van aanbieders zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor de bedrijfsvoering van hun organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over meldingen van bedreiging door journalisten

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked whether journalists find it hard to file complaints about threats and violence, and how many reports and complaints were made. The minister replied that a 2018 accord with police and prosecutors gives journalists priority protection, that complaints are indicatively counted at about 21 in 2018, and that the government will not comment on individual cases.
These figures are indicative, because the police do not record the victim's profession.
Deze cijfers zijn indicatief, omdat de politie het beroep van het slachtoffer niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over een zwartboek waaruit blijkt dat verzekeraars letselschadezaken niet altijd goed afhandelen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked about a Radar black book showing insurers do not always handle personal injury claims properly under the GBL code, and proposed statutory deadlines, sanctions, an independent tribunal and easier court access. The minister said a University of Utrecht study is under way, that the Tuchtraad already exists, that deelgeschillen procedures are available, and that responsibility is shared between two ministries, promising to decide on measures after the study results.
Based on the outcomes of the University of Utrecht study, I will engage with the various stakeholders involved.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van voornoemd onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht zal ik in gesprek gaan met de verschillende betrokken stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over onveiligheid in woonzorginstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about safety problems and weak oversight in supported-housing institutions housing ex-offenders and former TBS patients, following local media reports. The minister answered that municipalities supervise Wmo-funded supported housing, the IGJ and Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid have limited roles, no national picture is planned, and the government will send a forensic-expertise study and publish municipal oversight reports.
I do not have a national registration of the actual use by municipalities of the enforcement instruments available to them.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijke registratie van het feitelijke gebruik door gemeenten van het hun ter beschikking staande handhavingsinstrumentarium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over het bericht dat 28 Gelderse gemeenten kampen met grote tekorten op de jeugdzorg

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked whether the minister shares concern that 28 Gelderland municipalities face large youth care deficits, whether children's care is at risk, and whether municipalities are adequately compensated. The minister acknowledges the signals, points to municipalities' statutory youth care duty and the council's oversight role, and refers to the ongoing 'Onderzoek Jeugd' that will turn signals into facts before deciding on measures.
Municipalities have the youth care obligation. This means they must offer timely and appropriate help to children who need it.
Gemeenten hebben de jeugdhulpplicht. Dit houdt in dat zij kinderen die dit nodig hebben tijdig passende hulp moeten bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Moorlag en Nijboer over meer banen in Oost-Groningen

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers whether the Opiumwet's ban on industrial use of hemp tops, which blocks CBD extraction at HempFlax in Oost-Groningen, should be relaxed to create jobs, and how Germany regulates this. The minister answered that the law only exempts fibre hemp for fibre or seed, that the juridical options are still being explored, and that talks with the businesses will follow.
At this moment I am exploring the legal possibilities.
Op dit moment ben ik de juridische mogelijkheden aan het verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Kerstens en Gijs van Dijk over zich ADO-supporters noemende personen die onder ander het monument De Dokwerker in Amsterdam hebben beklad

MPs Kuiken, Kerstens and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about ADO Den Haag supporters who defaced the De Dokwerker monument in Amsterdam, including criminal investigation, camera footage, administrative measures, stadium bans and antisemitism in sport. The government answered that a report was filed and is with the Public Prosecution Service, declined to discuss the investigation or evidence, pointed to the mayor's powers and the KNVB's private-law stadium bans, and described existing anti-discrimination policy in football.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag, Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over de gevolgen van het faillissement van Intertoys

MPs Moorlag, Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that the owner of bankrupt Intertoys, as a pledge-holding creditor, would be paid ahead of other creditors, whether this shifts business risk onto the tax authority, UWV and staff, and how workers would be helped. The minister said the specific case is for the curator and courts, explained generally how pledges give priority, said the matter is being examined in the bankruptcy law review, and described UWV information sessions and support for workers.
It is not for me to comment on a specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op een specifieke praktijksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht over legitimatieplicht voor verzenders van postpakketten

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about a proposed identification requirement for senders of parcels, following a Taskforce Brabant-Zeeland call, and whether existing measures against drug trafficking via post are adequate. The Minister answers that existing measures (drug-dog checks, sensing, public-private cooperation with PostNL and other carriers) are part of an integrated approach, and that an ID requirement is not proportionate given parcel volumes, privacy and administrative burden.
Given the total volume of parcel post, the intrusion on privacy and the increase in administrative burden, we consider an identification requirement not proportionate to combat drug crime.

Een legitimatieplicht achten wij gelet op het totale volume aan pakketpost, de inbreuk op de privacy en de verzwaring van de administratieve lasten niet proportioneel om drugscriminaliteit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over de verzending van drugs via brievenpost

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked whether the government knows how much drugs are mailed from the Netherlands by letter post, whether Dutch businesses and individuals are being misused as senders, whether the Postinterventieteam acts on letter post, and how innocent recipients can avoid being treated as suspects. The Minister answered that volumes are unknown and being studied with partners, that letter post is not structurally checked, that interventions such as taking down darknet sites are desirable, and that people receiving unsolicited drugs should report them to police.
The cabinet is considering with its partners whether the nature and scale can be mapped.
Het kabinet bekijkt met de partners of de aard en omvang in kaart is te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het faillissement van PTSS-kliniek Psytrec

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the bankruptcy of PTSD clinic Psytrec, its effect on waiting times and treatment continuity, and what steps would protect patients. The State Secretary reported that a takeover (doorstart) was possible, that staff would largely be offered contracts, and that the IGJ and NZa were monitoring care and patient information.
In the case of Psytrec, it has since become known that a takeover (doorstart) can take place.
In het geval van Psytrec is inmiddels bekend geworden dat er een doorstart kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Kabinet komt afspraken hervestiging kwetsbare vluchtelingen niet meer na'

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about reports that the cabinet would not honour resettlement commitments for vulnerable refugees, including a shortfall of 610 against 750 selected in 2018 and whether this breaks agreements. The State Secretary answered that resettlement is voluntary, that the shortfall in 2018 will not be compensated, that the claimed backlog is based on a misreading of arrival versus selection figures, that UNHCR expressed concern, and that the national quota of 500 per year is maintained.
Resettlement is a humanitarian programme that countries carry out on a voluntary basis; it is not an obligation.
Hervestiging is een humanitair programma dat landen op vrijwillige basis uitvoeren, het betreft geen verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onveiligheid in asielzoekerscentra

An MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security about violence and threats against staff in asylum reception centres, prompted by a union's alarm, and whether the problem is structural and whether those responsible are mainly from safe countries. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, points to incident registration and an Inspectorate report, and describes existing and planned measures without committing to new concrete steps.
In April I will inform your House about the status of these recommendations.
In april zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de status hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gedeeltelijk onder curatele plaatsen van Zeeuwse jeugdzorginstelling

An MP asks the minister how the Zeeland youth care provider Intervence came into serious financial trouble, how it affects clients, and what is being done to protect children. The minister answers that municipalities and Intervence reached agreements in February 2019, that no youths are reported to be in danger, and that an early-warning method and a dispute committee are being set up.
The municipalities have the legal duty to ensure that sufficient youth protection and youth probation is always available.
De gemeenten hebben de wettelijke plicht ervoor te zorgen dat er altijd voldoende jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opening van een gemeenteraadsvergadering met een gebed

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about municipal council meetings opened with a prayer, including municipalities whose rules seem to make the prayer mandatory. The Minister says the prayer is not compulsory in practice, will send municipalities a letter clarifying church-state separation and asking them to state explicitly in their rules rules of procedure that participation is not obligatory.

I will therefore ask municipalities, through the letter announced in my answer to question 2, to make explicit in their rules of procedure, where the official prayer is included, that there is no obligation to deliver the official prayer or to take part in it.

Ik zal daarom gemeenten via de in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 aangekondigde brief verzoeken om indien het ambtsgebed is opgenomen in het reglement van orde te expliciteren dat geen sprake is van een verplichting om het ambtsgebed uit te spreken dan wel er aan deel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Notarissen staken jarenlang kadastergeld in eigen zak’

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked about reports that notaries charged clients for cadastral fees and levies never actually incurred, and whether this is widespread, unlawful, and whether clients should be refunded. The Minister replied that the disciplinary judge has ruled on the conduct without imposing a sanction, that no structural problem is known so no estimate can be made, that the matter is for the civil court on undue payment, and that the bar association has urged notaries to compensate clients, which the Minister supports.
It is for the disciplinary judge to assess the conduct of a (candidate) notary and to impose measures where appropriate.
Het is aan de tuchtrechter om te oordelen over het handelen van een (kandidaat-)notaris en eventueel maatregelen op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat een uitgezette asielzoeker in Bahrein levenslang kreeg

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the deteriorating human rights situation in Bahrain, and reports that a deported asylum seeker received a life sentence there, should change asylum policy toward Bahrainis and whether the discretionary power should have been used. State Secretary Harbers answered that the IND takes the worsened situation into account in individual asylum assessments, that refoulement is excluded where a real risk exists, and that the discretionary power was not applicable because protection law governs such cases.
I refer you to my answer to question 2.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over zwijgcontract in de jeugdbescherming

An MP asked whether a gag contract in youth protection prevented a victim from reporting abuse, whether pleegzorg screening and gag-contract bans would be pursued, and whether investigations into a silence culture were planned. The minister answered that the contract did not prevent reporting, that such contracts are undesirable and a legal change is being considered, that screening improvements are underway, and that no further investigation into a silence culture is currently warranted.
Concluding such a contract between a victim and a youth institution is something I consider very undesirable.
Het afsluiten van een dergelijk contract tussen een slachtoffer en een jeugdinstelling vind ik zeer ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een uitleg van de Bibob-toets

An MP asks whether municipalities should be able to refuse environmental building permits under the Bibob integrity test when applicants commit criminal offences during construction, following a Council of State ruling that such offences are not a ground for refusal. The Minister replies that the legislator intended the ground to cover offences connected to the building activities, that the ruling distinguishes these from use of the finished building, and that no legislative change is planned while case law develops.
In view of the above, I see no reason to amend the law and will await further developments in case law.
Gelet op het bovenstaande zie ik geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen en wacht ik de verdere ontwikkelingen in de jurisprudentie af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gebrekkige toegang tot ggz

MP Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Health about long mental health waiting times, misleading information on the Kiezen in de ggz website, crisis-care admissions caused by delayed treatment, and patients being referred back and forth, and whether the shortage of supply explains the 88,500 people on waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that the website reflects retrospective waits and that the NZa monitors providers, that crisis admissions cannot be attributed to delayed care, that patients can contact insurers and the NZa, and that a workforce and waiting-time action plan with progress reports to parliament is in progress.
I have no insight into the percentage that ends up there because they did not receive the right care in time.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het percentage dat daar terecht komt doordat zij niet tijdig de juiste zorg hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat jongeren vaak ten onrechte worden opgesloten in isoleercellen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that young people are often wrongly isolated in seclusion cells and whether staff shortages and the isolation practice harm them. The Minister says the ambition to stop coerced seclusion is in place, that an IGJ inspection project and a nulmeting are underway, and that isolation may be used only as a last resort and never to punish, committing to further monitoring and funding for alternative models.

To prevent harmful and traumatising effects of coerced seclusion, last April I set the ambition, together with municipalities and youth care providers in the Zorg voor de Jeugd programme, to stop coerced seclusion.

Om schadelijke en traumatiserende effecten van gedwongen afzonderen te voorkomen, heb ik april vorig jaar – samen met gemeenten en jeugdhulpinstellingen, in het programma Zorg voor de Jeugd – de ambitie neergelegd om te stoppen met gedwongen afzonderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Westerveld over het opstappen van jeugdzorginstelling topman vanwege financiële problemen

MPs Kuiken and Westerveld asked the Minister of Health about the departure of the top manager of youth care provider Juzt over financial problems, including when the ministry learned of the problems, the planned relocation of youths from Lievenshove, staff reductions, and measures against sector-wide financial distress. The minister answered that the ministry was informed in 2016, that the region and Juzt are negotiating, that relocation is delayed by costs and closure is set for mid-April, and that new oversight and mediation bodies have been set up in response to the sector's financial strain.
I am closely following developments and, as the system's responsible minister, I am keeping a very close eye on the situation.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend en houd als stelselverantwoordelijke nadrukkelijk een vinger aan de pols.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Recordaantal migranten: Griekenland bezwijkt opnieuw onder grote toestroom’

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of record migrant arrivals in Greece, the CPT's criticism of camp conditions, and whether Europe should relocate people from the Greek islands. The State Secretary answered that the government urges Greece and the Commission for structural solutions via faster asylum and return procedures, rejects further transfers or relocations as a fix, and sees some improvements in Greek camp conditions.
More transfers to the mainland or new efforts to relocate asylum seekers from Greece do not contribute to that.
Meer transfers naar het vasteland of nieuwe inspanningen om asielzoekers vanuit Griekenland te herplaatsen, dragen daar niet aan bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het plegen van identiteitsfraude

MPs Nijboer and Kuiken asked how easy it still is to commit identity fraud, how banks verify identity when opening accounts and granting credit, and whether remote and outsourced checks are adequately supervised. The minister explained the Wwft verification rules, DNB's supervision and the fraud-prevention initiatives, but gave no commitment to new measures.
DNB supervises banks' compliance with the Wwft and has named preventing institutions' involvement in financial-economic crime as a priority of its supervision.

De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wwft door banken, en heeft het voorkomen van betrokkenheid van instellingen bij financieel-economische criminaliteit benoemd als speerpunt van haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het onderzoek van de gemeente Maastricht naar eigen ambtenaren

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether a municipality may monitor employees' email, what remedies staff have if monitored or wrongly accused, whether union and works council members have extra protection, and whether breach of confidentiality is criminal. The minister answers that monitoring is allowed under GDPR conditions with prior notice (or retrospective notice for covert checks), points to internal complaints, ombudsman, Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts, and says the municipality is responsible for deciding on investigations and reports.
The Court based this judgment among other things on the fact that the employer had failed to inform the employee in advance of the nature and extent of the monitoring to be carried out.
Het Hof baseerde dit oordeel onder meer op het feit dat de werkgever in gebreke was gebleven de werknemer vooraf in te lichten over de aard en de omvang van de uit te voeren controle
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van sektes in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice Minister about dangers and abuses in sects in the Netherlands, citing a 2013 WODC study and a newspaper report calling for government action. The minister answered that recent data show 76 dossiers in 2017, that the existing instruments are adequate, and that no new legislation or intensified policy is needed.
I consider these instruments adequate and therefore see no reason to tighten the legislation or intensify policy on abuses in sects.
Ik beschouw dit instrumentarium als toereikend en zie daarom geen reden om de wetgeving aan te scherpen of het beleid inzake misstanden bij sekten te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over het bericht dat koningin Maxima in Argentinië de belasting zou hebben ontdoken

MPs Kuiken and Sneller asked the Prime Minister whether Queen Máxima underpaid tax in Argentina by understating the value of real estate, and whether royals have an exemplary role. Prime Minister Rutte answered that such investments fall within the private sphere protected by articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution, that the public interest is not affected where laws are followed, and gave no substantive confirmation or denial.
This advice clarifies concretely, among other things, that investments in real estate abroad belong to the private sphere and that reporting on them does not in itself detract from that.

Deze voorlichting maakt in concrete zin onder meer duidelijk dat investeringen in onroerend goed in het buitenland behoren tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer en dat berichtgeving hierover daaraan op zichzelf niet afdoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de IND nauwelijks asielaanvragen van oorlogsvluchtelingen behandelt

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the IND rarely processes asylum applications from war refugees, whether this is deliberate deterrence, and what waiting times are. The State Secretary answered that war refugees are not a registered category, that priority goes to Dublin and safe-country cases, that waiting times are tracked only as processing times, and that extra staff are being recruited to shorten delays.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in nagelsalons

MPs Kuiken and Gijs van Dijk asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about abuses in nail salons, including the National Rapporteur's call for more investigation, victims' reluctance to report, and police and Inspectorate capacity. The government answered by listing the 'Samen tegen mensenhandel' programme measures, reduced reporting barriers, and additional funding for the Inspectorate, while noting few signals have reached the authorities.
In addition, the Inspectorate SZW will receive a national human trafficking expert who will form the link between the investigative service and chain partners.
Bovendien krijgt de Inspectie SZW een landelijke expert mensenhandel die de verbinding vormt tussen de opsporingsdienst en ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het feit dat slachtoffers van seksueel geweld die een beroep doen op het Centrum Seksueel Geweld daarvoor hun eigen risico moeten aanspreken

Two PvdA MPs asked why sexual violence victims using Centrum Seksueel Geweld must pay their Zvw deductible and whether this deters reporting. The government confirms the deductible applies to medical care, points to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven compensation and a planned one-year temporary arrangement to reimburse the deductible in the acute phase, but does not abolish the deductible.
The deductible does not relate to the criminal law aspect of sexual violence, but to the provision of care.
Het eigen risico heeft geen betrekking op het strafrechtelijk aspect van seksueel geweld, maar op de zorgverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht "IND huurt onderbetaalde krachten in"

Two PvdA MPs asked why temporary staff hired via agencies at the IND are paid less than permanent colleagues doing the same work, and whether this will be remedied and enforced in future tenders. The minister answered that the Waadi equal-pay rule applies but can be set aside by collective agreement, that pay is a matter between the agency and the worker, that the IND requires compliance via the framework contract, and that no extra conditions are considered necessary.
In case of underpayment, the employee can of course claim the back pay from the employer (in this case the staffing agency).
In geval van onderbetaling kan de werknemer uiteraard bij de werkgever (in dit geval het detacheringsbureau) dat achterstallig loon vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toename van psychiatrische problematiek in de jeugdzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising psychiatric problems in youth care, including suicides, transfers of young people to closed youth care, constant re-placement, specialist versus generalist care under tendering, and staff overload. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to ongoing research, IGJ supervision, regional expert teams, efforts to recruit foster families and a procurement approach, and promised further steps on placements and workload.
I will continue to put this on the agenda and push all involved parties to stop, or reduce, the re-placement of children placed out of home.
Ik zal dit blijven agenderen en aanjagen richting alle betrokken partijen om het doorverhuizen van uit huisgeplaatste kinderen te stoppen/terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over grensoverschrijdende oefening in verband met een kernongeval

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether cross-border exercises with Germany were needed after a fire at a fuel fabrication plant near the Emsland nuclear plant, whether information to residents was adequate, and whether border crisis plans address cross-border issues. The state secretary answered that the fire posed no risk to the nuclear plant or the Dutch population, that cross-border exercises take place regularly with a major GEDEX exercise planned for 2020, and that the crisis plan is being updated with cross-border liaisons.
Both good information provision and cross-border exercises by emergency services and other involved bodies are of great importance.
Zowel goede informatievoorziening als ook grensoverschrijdende oefening van hulpdiensten en andere betrokken instanties is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht dat 270 containers overboord geslagen zijn bij de Waddeneilanden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked ministers about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, including causes, health and environmental risks, liability of the shipowner, cooperation, lashing rules, container tracking and crisis coordination. The minister answered that causes are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and foreign authorities, that the shipowner has been held liable and must clean up, that regional safety authorities coordinate the response, and that container chipping would need international agreement.
The cause of the containers going overboard is not yet known and is the subject of investigation by, among others, the Public Prosecution Service.
De oorzaak van het overboord slaan van de containers is nog niet bekend en onderwerp van onderzoek door o.a. het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de opening van een gemeenteraadsvergadering met een gebed

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a Tholen council rule requiring the chair to say a prayer at the opening of meetings breaches church-state separation, and whether it should be annulled. The minister agreed the mandatory wording conflicts with that principle, noted the council has since changed the rule to a prayer before the opening, and saw no reason to annul it.
I share the views of my predecessor on the relationship between the official prayer and the principle of separation of church and state
Ik deel de opvattingen van mijn ambtsvoorganger over de verhouding tussen het ambtsgebed en het beginsel van de scheiding van kerk en staat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de rechter de Belgische overheid heeft opgedragen kinderen uit Syrië terug te halen

Two MPs (Ploumen and Kuiken, PvdA) asked the foreign minister about a Brussels court order for Belgium to repatriate six children from Syria, and whether Dutch policy and cooperation with Belgium should change. The minister answered that the Netherlands does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, that consular assistance is discretionary, and that the government will keep monitoring developments.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de aanpak van nepnieuws

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about the EU disinformation site EUvsDisinfo no longer covering Dutch media, the reported Facebook approval of fake political ads, dialogue with Facebook and other platforms, measures against foreign state-driven political ads, and sanctions for fake ads. The minister replied that the site's approach was adjusted, that Facebook and other firms have committed to the Code of Practice on disinformation which the government will monitor, that research on social media effects will report around summer 2019, and that sanctions exist only where Dutch law is broken since free expression is constitutionally protected.
No minutes were made of the conversations.
Van de gesprekken zijn geen verslagen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het met nepnieuws beïnvloeden van verkiezingen

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about EU and Dutch efforts against fake news influencing elections, including platform accountability after a case of a cameraman running a fake news operation on Facebook. The minister said the threat is real but no concrete signals exist for the Netherlands, and that the government relies on the EU Code of Practice on disinformation and monitoring, rejecting binding regulation for now.
The cabinet will critically monitor the implementation of the code of conduct.
Het kabinet zal de uitvoering van de gedragscode kritisch volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de training van politieagenten op het gebied van geweld tegen vrouwen

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police training on violence against women, domestic violence statistics, ex-partner stalking and whether new approaches are needed. The minister answered that police training on domestic violence is being intensified in 2019-2020, that the Veiligheidsagenda and the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme address the issue, and that reliable stalking figures cannot be given because registrations are not unambiguous.
This means that police registrations of harassment by (ex-)partners are not always unambiguous and it is not possible to provide reliable figures on this phenomenon.
Dit maakt dat de registraties van de politie over het lastigvallen door (ex-)partners niet altijd eenduidig zijn en het niet mogelijk is om betrouwbare cijfers op dit fenomeen te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het Oxfam rapport over vluchtelingenopvangkampen in Griekenland

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked about the Oxfam report on Greek refugee camps, including a death from cold, the lack of medical screening of vulnerable people, and contacts with EU partners. The State Secretary answered that Greece remains responsible, that the Netherlands repeatedly raises the issue with Greece and the Commission, and that it will be on the agenda of his next visit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over een misbruikdrama in de atletiekwereld

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked why a 2009 report of boundary-crossing conduct by an athletics coach led to no investigation, whether the athletics federation should have reported to police, whether criminal complaints were filed, and whether tuchtrecht rulings should feed into criminal prosecution and VOG screening. The minister said the police-led investigation covers the earlier report and cannot be discussed, that criminal law takes precedence over disciplinary law, that the Centrum Seksueel Geweld and Slachtofferhulp can help victims, and that linking sports disciplinary lists to the VOG is not desirable.
To get a good picture of the matters at issue, the police investigation team led by the Public Prosecution Service gathers as much relevant information as possible.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de zaken die spelen en gespeeld hebben, vergaart het onderzoeksteam van politie onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) zoveel mogelijk relevante informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de afwezigheid van de IND in rechtszaken

An MP asked why the immigration service IND is often absent from court hearings on rejected asylum seekers, whether this harms due process, and what will be done to restore attendance. The State Secretary answered that IND attends only part of hearings due to high workload, that written submissions keep proceedings going, and that IND is recruiting about 35 extra staff to be present at nearly all hearings by year end.
The IND has now started a recruitment process aimed at having enough staff recruited, trained and onboarded by end 2019 to attend all hearings again.
De IND is inmiddels een wervingstraject gestart, dat erop gericht is om eind 2019 weer voldoende mensen te hebben geworven, opgeleid en ingewerkt om bij alle zittingen te kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over het bericht dat criminelen misbruik maken van pakketbezorgers PostNL

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked about reports that criminals exploit PostNL parcel delivery, the cooperation with police, prosecutors and tax authorities, intimidation of couriers, unlicensed courier firms, and whether subcontractor pay drives violations. The government describes the PIT team and seizures, notes the RIEC pilot, says licensing thresholds stay unchanged and that PostNL and subcontractors set their own terms, while liability for wage violations exists under existing law.
No information is given about further outcomes of this approach or follow-up in individual cases.
Over verdere uitkomsten van deze werkwijze en opvolging daarvan in individuele gevallen worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bewapening van boa’s bij Oud en Nieuw

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether municipal enforcement officers (boa's) face growing insecurity during New Year's Eve when local fireworks-free zones are enforced, and what protects them. The minister acknowledges unsafe situations can arise, says no central data is kept, leaves enforcement and risk assessment to local authorities, and points to an announced independent evaluation and the Veilige Publieke Taak approach.
Data on the (un)safety of boa's, whether or not in relation to local fireworks-free zones, is not kept centrally.
Gegevens omtrent de (on)veiligheid van boa’s, al dan niet in relatie tot lokale vuurwerkvrije zones, worden niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het benoemen van een “burgerlid” in een commissie van een gemeenteraad

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities may impose extra requirements on citizen members of council committees, whether a council vote can block such an appointment, and how this fits the VNG model and the Bodegraven-Reeuwijk regulation. The minister answered that the Gemeentewet sets no requirements for non-councillors, councils may set their own, a vote may block a candidate, the Crown cannot annul such an internal appointment, and the council itself must judge consistency with its regulations.
It is an autonomous competence of the council to decide, by regulation, whether or not to formulate appointment requirements for non-councillors.
Het is een autonome bevoegdheid van de raad om bij verordening al dan niet benoemingsvereisten te formuleren voor niet-raadsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gevangen gezette vluchtelingenreddingswerkers in Griekenland

An MP asked whether Greek rescue workers Sarah Mardini, Sean Binder and Nassos Karakitsos were detained without legal grounds, whether this is acceptable, and whether the Dutch government would raise concerns with Greek counterparts. The government answered that the four ERCI members were released on bail on 4 December, that it does not intervene in Greek legal proceedings, and that it sees no reason to contact Greek or other European colleagues.
The Netherlands does not intervene in the Greek legal process.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de Griekse rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het beëindigen van buitenlandse financiering van politieke partijen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether foreign financing of Dutch political parties will be restricted, given earlier promises and a 2016 motion, and how this compares with EU countries. The minister answered that measures will be announced in the cabinet response to the Veling committee report, with a bill to follow, and that the lack of agreement among parties is not the cause of the delay.
In the cabinet response to the report of the Veling committee I will address these measures.
In de kabinetsreactie op het rapport van de commissie-Veling zal ik op deze maatregelen ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over ‘nepadvertenties op Facebook die onze democratie ondermijnen’

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about fake political ads on Facebook that could undermine democracy, following a Brandpunt report. The minister said she knows of no specific examples, pointed to Facebook's ad review, transparency tools and planned political ad archive, and noted she cannot guarantee such ads will not recur.
Facebook has committed to me to create an archive for political advertisements, which will also contain all removed political advertisements and advertisements that were only briefly visible.
Facebook heeft mij toegezegd een archief voor politieke advertenties te maken, dat ook alle verwijderde politieke advertenties zal bevatten en de advertenties die maar kort zichtbaar zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de capaciteit ten behoeve van het oplossen van cold cases

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the number and handling of cold cases, the regional disparity in how they are pursued, the role of the missing persons bureau, and whether a national cold case team is needed. The minister reports about 1,774 cold cases, says prioritisation is a local matter and each unit has at least 3 FTE for cold cases, and rejects a national team as undesirable.
Prioritising the pursuit of criminal investigations, including cold cases, is reserved for the local competent authority, the Public Prosecution Service, in consultation with the police.
Het prioriteren van het oppakken van opsporingsonderzoeken, waaronder cold cases, is voorbehouden aan het lokale bevoegd gezag, het Openbaar Ministerie, in afstemming met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over verdwenen minderjarige asielzoekers

An MP asks the State Secretary why the number of unaccompanied minor asylum seekers disappearing from reception has roughly doubled, whether they risk criminal exploitation or trafficking, where they go, and whether foster care could prevent disappearances. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, notes that protective measures were taken and that disappearances fell in 2017 and 2018 partly due to a changed nationality mix, says it is unknown where most leaving minors go, and defers the foster care question until the new reception model evaluation is complete.
Unfortunately it still happens that children leave reception without the government knowing where these children are going.
Helaas komt het nog steeds voor dat kinderen de opvang verlaten zonder dat de overheid weet waar deze kinderen naartoe gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over loverboypraktijken in jeugdinstellingen

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers about alleged loverboy practices in youth institutions, including a suspect formerly employed by Hoenderloo Groep and unsafe situations at several facilities. The government answered that the criminal case is pending, that the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care is investigating the signals and monitoring Juzt, and that it has no other current signals beyond these institutions, while the national rapporteur reports on trafficking and a programme against trafficking is forthcoming.
Because the case is still before the court, I cannot make further statements about this case.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is, kan ik over deze zaak geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘bedrijven die DNA-materiaal van hun cliënten met anderen delen’

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether companies that obtain clients' DNA for ancestry research may share it with third parties such as pharmaceutical firms, and what remedies citizens have. The minister answered that such sharing requires explicit consent for a specific purpose, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority supervises compliance, and that existing information for citizens is sufficient, so no new measures are planned.
Only when a person gives explicit consent for the disclosure of their special (genetic) data to another company may that person's special personal data be shared.

Alleen wanneer een persoon uitdrukkelijke toestemming geeft voor het verstrekken van zijn of haar bijzondere (genetische) gegevens aan een ander bedrijf, mogen de bijzondere persoonsgegevens van deze persoon gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether sexual abuse by tantra massage practitioners persists and what authorities are doing about it, including reports, prosecutions, municipal permit requirements and enforcement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that sexual abuse is unacceptable, municipalities can enforce permit rules, a victim awareness campaign is planned, and provided limited figures while stating that specific data on prosecutions for tantra abuse is not registered.
Furthermore, I do not have information on the number of prosecutions or criminal sanctions, as cases of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs are not specifically registered.

Verder beschik ik niet over informatie ten aanzien van het aantal gevallen van vervolging of strafrechtelijke sancties aangezien er niet specifiek wordt geregistreerd op gevallen van seksueel misbruik door tantramasseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een verwoestende nieuwe drug in webshops te koop is

Two PvdA MPs asked whether phenibut, a highly addictive substance sold as a food supplement in webshops, could be bought by minors and why it is not banned under the Opium Act. The State Secretary for Health answered that minors cannot be excluded from access, that a CAM risk study is underway with results expected this year, and that measures including a possible ban will be considered afterwards.
Based on the research results and the CAM advice, I will consider measures to take, such as a possible ban.
Op basis van de onderzoeksresultaten en het advies van het CAM zal ik mij beraden op te treffen maatregelen, zoals een eventueel verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over Albanese migranten die bij de gemeente Moerdijk in vrachtwagen klimmen

MPs Kuiken and Van Dijk asked about Albanian migrants climbing into trucks near Moerdijk bound for England, and about the mayor's plea for help. The State Secretary described the involved agencies, possible offences and removal procedures, said an inter-agency framework was being prepared, and promised to meet the mayor.
I will myself, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, enter into consultation with the mayor of Moerdijk.
Ik zal zelf eveneens, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, in overleg treden met de burgemeester van Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de wijze waarop een aangifte van een verkrachting is behandeld door de politie

MP Kuiken asked the Justice Minister how police handled a rape complaint in the Hoorn sex case, including victim treatment, whether victims are pressured not to report, and whether interrogators approach victims with suspicion. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss the individual case, pointed to existing police and prosecution instructions and an Inspectorate investigation under way, and listed planned victim-protection measures.
I cannot go into this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Kuiken over de uitzending van Brandpunt+ over eenzame jongeren

MPs Raemakers and Kuiken asked the health minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on loneliness among young people, including whether the action programme 'Eén tegen eenzaamheid' neglects young people, the causes and risks, municipal and youth-care responses, suicide trends and an LHBTI project. The minister answered that the programme focuses on older people for substantive reasons, acknowledged that loneliness among young people is a taboo and a social problem, outlined preventive and youth-care measures, and declined to set up a separate action programme for young people.
I am not planning to draw up an action programme for loneliness among young people as well.
Ik ben niet voornemens om ook voor eenzaamheid onder jongeren een actieprogramma op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over courtsiding en matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the Justice Minister about courtsiding (information gathering at tennis courts for betting) and its links to matchfixing, and whether illegal gambling is facilitated. The government answered that courtsiding has declined internationally, Dutch tournaments have tightened enforcement, the Kansspelautoriteit does not act against it as it is not illegal gambling, and it points to a pending online gambling bill with match-manipulation safeguards.
Given the international decline of the problem and the fact that the tennis organisations' approach works, there is currently no reason to research the nature and scale of courtsiding.

Gezien de internationale afname van de problematiek en het feit dat de aanpak van tennisorganisaties werkt, is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van «courtsiding».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Peters over een aanbesteding jeugdbescherming en de jeugdreclassering in Noord-Holland

MPs Kuiken and Peters asked the minister about a failed open-house tender for youth protection and youth probation in 25 Noord-Holland municipalities, the risk to continuity of care, and time-recording demands. The minister answered that the open-house procedure is ongoing so no conclusions can yet be drawn, that municipalities are responsible for securing provision while the ministry monitors the situation and will intervene if needed, and that the ministry will raise time-recording requirements with municipalities.

If municipalities and institutions still fail to reach agreement together, so that the availability of youth protection and youth probation is jeopardised, we will take the steps necessary to secure availability.

In het geval dat de gemeenten en de instellingen er toch gezamenlijk niet uitkomen, waardoor de beschikbaarheid van jeugdbescherming en jeugdreclassering in het gedrang komt, zullen we die stappen zetten die nodig zijn om alsnog de beschikbaarheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over seksuele uitbuiting in een jeugdzorginstelling

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked about sexual exploitation of girls in a closed youth care institution in Zetten and whether the inspectorate's assessment framework is adequate. The minister said the case is before court, that the inspectorates have requested an in-depth independent investigation by the foundation, and that the framework will be reflected on after that investigation.
The inspectorates want to be informed about the facts and any shortcomings in the care provided to the young people concerned.
De inspecties willen geïnformeerd worden over de feiten en eventuele tekortkomingen in de hulp aan zowel de betreffende jeugdigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Gijs van Dijk over het filmpje op Twitter inzake Achmea Rechtsbijstand

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Twitter video showing the minister endorsing Achmea legal insurance, asking about commercial interest, sponsorship, and the link to reform of subsidised legal aid. The minister denied any Achmea involvement or advertising, said the visit was to inform himself, and promised to inform parliament soon on the reform of legal aid.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I attach great importance to being broadly informed on various fields by different parties.
Als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming hecht ik groot belang aan het mij breed laten informeren op diverse terreinen door verschillende partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht 'Opvang op Griekse eilanden kraakt'

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked about reports that reception conditions on Greek islands are inhumane, including child suicide attempts, and about EU monitoring and asylum procedure reform. The Dutch state secretary acknowledged the concerns, attributed problems mainly to overcrowding and slow asylum procedures, described EU and Dutch support and new Greek asylum law, but said no exact figures on child suicide attempts were available and opposed transfers to the mainland as a long-term solution.
Inquiries have revealed that no exact figures on suicide attempts can be obtained.
Navraag heeft geleerd dat geen exacte cijfers over pogingen tot zelfmoord zijn te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het achterhouden van een rapport van de CTIVD

MP Kuiken asks Minister Ollongren whether the CTIVD report on intelligence oversight was deliberately held back until after the advisory referendum on the Wiv, and whether foreign-service consultation was the only reason for the delay. The minister denies any link to the referendum, says the delay was caused by the time needed to consult foreign services on full publication, and states that the report mainly concerns the old Wiv 2002.

The decision to make the report fully public, against the wishes of foreign services, and the careful consultation that this required, was for me the only reason not to send the report to the House before the advisory referendum.

Het besluit om het rapport, tegen de wens van buitenlandse diensten in, integraal openbaar te maken en de zorgvuldige afstemming die daarvoor nodig was, was voor mij de enige reden om het rapport niet voorafgaand aan het raadgevend referendum aan de Kamer te doen toekomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris in hoger beroep is gegaan in de zaak van Lili en Howick en daarmee het advies van de Raad voor kind

MPs asked why the State Secretary appealed the Lili and Howick ruling and disregarded Raad voor de Kinderbescherming conditions, and whether removal of supervised children without achieved goals is responsible. The State Secretary answered that asylum law under the CJEU M'Bodj judgment excludes these socio-economic circumstances from Article 3 ECHR, that the Raad van State ruled in his favour, that the children may now stay after events of 8 September 2018, and that the RvdK, IND and DT&V cooperate while each applies its own context.

The circumstances invoked in this case, namely that the goals formulated by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming have not yet been achieved, cannot and may not, according to this case law of the Court of Justice, lead to asylum status.

De aangevoerde omstandigheden in deze zaak, erin gelegen dat de door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming geformuleerde doelen nog niet zijn bereikt, kunnen en mogen volgens deze jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie niet leiden tot een asielstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Afghanistan

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the State Secretary about deportations of Afghan families with minor children, the compatibility with children's rights, recognition rates across EU states, and the number of families in return procedures. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the deportation endangered the family, defended the policy change and the Afghan recognition rate, and said unaccompanied minors are not returned where no family or adequate care is available.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over de negatieve gevolgen van uitzetting naar Armenië voor de PTSS-klachten van Howick en Lili

MPs Van Ojik, Kuiken and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the IND adequately investigated the PTSD complaints of children Howick and Lili and their deportation to Armenia, and whether deportation should be halted pending new investigation. The Staatssecretaris declined to address individual medical circumstances, citing privacy of special personal data, and confirmed no irreversible steps had yet been taken.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual and personal aspects in public answers to parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is ga ik in openbare beantwoording van Kamervragen niet in op individuele en persoonlijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kuiken over het bericht 'ING treft miljoenenschikking met OM in witwaszaken' (Herdruk)

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about ING's record 775 million euro settlement with the Public Prosecution Service over money laundering, including how the amount was set, why prosecution was avoided, and whether individuals and the bank's leadership face consequences. The ministers answered that the settlement combined a 665 million fine with 100 million in disgorgement, that the OM chose a transaction for its enforceable compliance measures under DNB supervision, and that individual criminal liability could not be established, while the bank's supervisory board has announced personnel consequences at board level.
The OM therefore attributes the criminal offences to the organisation as a whole.
Het OM rekent de strafbare feiten dan ook toe aan de organisatie als geheel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de afname van het aantal duikteams bij de brandweer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the halving of fire brigade diving teams in fifteen years endangers lives on the water, and whether every safety region should have a diving team. The minister replied that no clear link can be drawn, that the number of teams is a regional matter for safety region boards, and that he sees no reason to change the rules or act.
It is up to the board of a safety region to determine whether additional measures are needed.
Het is aan het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio om te bepalen of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het bericht dat de Koerden Nederlandse vrouwen naar IS-gebied terugsturen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked whether Kurdish authorities are sending Dutch women and children back to IS-held territory and what the government will do to prevent this. Minister Grapperhaus said such reports could not be confirmed, that the government does not actively pursue repatriation from Syria and Iraq given diplomatic and security considerations, and that contact with Kurdish authorities via their Benelux representation has been ongoing.
This weighing leads the cabinet not to actively pursue the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze afweging leidt ertoe dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over seksueel misbruik binnen de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen

Four MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether at least five victims had filed reports of sexual abuse within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether these reports warrant further investigation, how police and prosecutors handle them, whether Jehovah's Witnesses can invoke the clergy testimony privilege, and whether internal instructions to store abuse allegations in sealed envelopes comply with the GDPR. The minister confirmed the reports, said an ongoing criminal investigation prevents further comment, stated the prosecution has nationwide oversight, said the testimony privilege belongs to individuals not organisations and will be considered in the review of extending the reporting duty, and referred the GDPR question to the independent Data Protection Authority.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation, which may result in prosecution and trial.
Er is sprake van lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat kan resulteren in vervolging en berechting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Justice Minister whether the government would actively seek the return of Dutch women and their children held in Kurdish camps in Syria, including after arrest warrants were issued for three women. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children, citing child welfare alongside security, diplomatic and regional considerations, and only passed the warrants to local authorities.
The cabinet does not actively pursue the return of adult travellers and their minor children.
Het kabinet zet niet actief in op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over de terugkeer van het alcoholslot

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether the government will reconsider reintroducing the alcohol lock after the Council of State and Supreme Court rulings, and whether it will amend the law to do so. The ministers answered that the alcohol lock under administrative law is no longer feasible, that placing it in criminal law was examined and found costly and rarely applicable, and that they will not re-investigate or legislate now but await the results of the Alcoholmeter pilot.
The rulings mean that the alcohol lock programme as it was arranged is no longer possible, and that any new programme must take these rulings into account.
De uitspraken betekenen dat het ASP zoals dat was geregeld niet meer mogelijk is en dat bij het ontwerp van een nieuw ASP rekening met deze uitspraken moet worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de schietincidenten in Delft

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a series of shootings and grenade intimidation against Delft hospitality businesses, including whether there is a trend, extortion, sufficient investigative capacity, and tools available to mayors. The minister confirmed the seriousness of the crimes, said the cases are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, and left operational and local safety measures to the mayor, police and prosecutors.
The cases are currently still under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
De zaken zijn momenteel nog in onderzoek bij het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat twee derde van 150 populaire websites de privacywet overtreedt

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that two-thirds of 150 popular websites breach privacy law, and about the regulators' priorities, the Tax Administration's delay in complying with the GDPR, and whether government bodies should lead by example. The minister said regulators set their own priorities, that the Data Protection Authority is adequately resourced, that the Tax Administration has reached a basic compliance level with a plan to finish, and that government bodies must comply like any other organisation.
It is therefore not for me to pass judgment on the Data Protection Authority's priority setting.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de prioriteitstelling van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het asielbeleid voor LHBTI’s

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary about IND asylum assessment of LGBTI applicants, including reliance on a 'self-acceptance' criterion and the treatment of photographic and witness evidence. The State Secretary said the emphasis on awareness and self-acceptance will be dropped, that sexually explicit imagery cannot be used but other imagery can, and that open questioning will be emphasised, though he could not say how many refusals rest on the criterion.
The IND does not record whether an asylum application is rejected on grounds of (lack of credibility of) sexual orientation.
De IND registreert niet of een asielverzoek wordt afgewezen op grond van (ongeloofwaardigheid van) seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over matchfixing in het tennis

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether a Belgian match-fixing investigation in tennis involves Dutch suspects, whether Dutch and Belgian authorities are in contact, and whether the Kansspelautoriteit or prosecutors will investigate Dutch parties. The minister confirmed contact with Belgian authorities via the Public Prosecution Service, said he cannot comment on foreign investigations, and explained that the Ksa only supervises detection and reporting of suspicious bets, with signals assessed for criminal investigation without confirming any ongoing investigations.
Each signal is also examined, as usual, for possible leads for criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
Elk signaal wordt daarnaast – zoals gebruikelijk – onderzocht op mogelijke aanknopingspunten voor strafrechtelijk onderzoek door het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het terugsturen van vrouwen en kinderen naar IS-gebied

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that Syrian Kurds were sending detained jihadi brides and their children back to IS-held territory, and whether Belgian intelligence had shared information and whether Dutch women and children were affected. The minister said the signals could not yet be confirmed, that European intelligence services cooperate and share information on travellers where necessary, but that he could not discuss specific cases.
I cannot go into specific cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Kuiken over het bericht dat informatie van de Kamer van Koophandel gebruikt wordt voor reclamedoeleinden

MPs Moorlag and Kuiken asked why the Chamber of Commerce (KvK) sells business register data that companies are obliged to provide, which is then used for targeted advertising, and what protections businesses have. The State Secretary answered that the register's public nature requires disclosure, that recipients bear their own privacy-law responsibility, and pointed to the Non Mailing Indicator, the Bel-me-niet register and ongoing exploration of extending protections, but committed only to continued contact with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
The KvK is currently investigating the possibilities to extend the NMI to email and telephone.
De KvK onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden om de NMI uit te breiden naar e-mail en telefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over het lot van Nederlandse IS-kinderen

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the whereabouts and safety of Dutch children of IS members, including reports that some may be moved back into IS territory. The minister answered that at least 145 such children remain in the conflict zone and at least 30 elsewhere in the region, that contact with Kurdish authorities is structural but not formal with the groups running the camps, and that the government does not actively pursue repatriation of adult travellers and their children while continuing to monitor the situation.
This weighing leads to the cabinet not actively pursuing the repatriation of adult travellers and their minor children from Syria and Iraq.
Deze weging leidt ertoe dat dat het kabinet niet actief inzet op het terughalen van volwassen uitreizigers en hun minderjarige kinderen uit Syrië en Irak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bescherming van kroongetuigen en hun familie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether protection capacity for crown witnesses, their families and threatened local officials is sufficient, and what will be done to ensure optimal protection. The minister answered that capacity is under pressure, that protection is tailored and proportionate and full safety cannot be guaranteed, and that he has commissioned studies to optimise witness protection.

As also reported in the letter to parliament of 5 June, capacity is under pressure, due to on the one hand many security assignments and on the other a capacity shortage at the Dutch Royal and Diplomatic Protection Service (DKDB).

Zoals ook in de kamerbrief 3 d.d. 5 juni gemeld staat de capaciteit onder druk, door enerzijds veel beveiligingsopdrachten en anderzijds een capaciteitstekort bij de Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatieke Beveiliging (DKDB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat het bedrijf van familie van een in opspraak geraakte OM-topman

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the public prosecution service contracted for eight years with a company run by relatives of a senior prosecutor under scrutiny, and about that prosecutor's role and integrity. The minister confirmed a contract with a firm employing relatives of a College member created an appearance of conflict of interest, said it should not have happened, and deferred detailed answers until an independent commission reports.
The College has informed me that this should not have happened.
Het College heeft mij laten weten dat dit niet had mogen gebeuren.
