Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de uitzetting van de in de Hoornse zedenzaak voor verkrachting veroordeelde Mohamed M.

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deportation of Mohamed M., convicted of rape in the Hoorn case, including the status of withdrawing his residence permit, detention, measures to keep him away from his victim, and whether he had been declared undesirable. The State Secretary answered that the IND began withdrawal in August 2017, the permit was withdrawn in November 2017, a later asylum application delayed removal, and he was deported to Mogadishu on 25 May 2018 with a 10-year entry ban instead of an undesirability declaration, which is not legally possible.
On 25 May 2018 the person concerned was successfully deported to Mogadishu.
Op 25 mei 2018 is betrokkene succesvol uitgezet naar Mogadishu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they would confront Facebook over reported privacy breaches, where citizens can complain, whether the Dutch data protection authority is investigating, and whether stricter oversight is warranted. The minister answered that Facebook must comply with privacy law, that the AP handles complaints and has wider powers from 25 May 2018, that an AP investigation concerns another matter while it is in contact with the UK regulator, and that the EU working party has made social media a key priority, and committed to discussing responsibility with Facebook and other providers.
I will engage with Facebook and other providers to remind them once again of their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government would contact Facebook after reports that data of about 89,000 Dutch users reached Cambridge Analytica, how affected users could trace their data, and whether government should inform the public about privacy risks. The minister answered that the Dutch DPA and EU regulators supervise Facebook under the GDPR, that the minister will talk with Facebook about its responsibility, explained the access and erasure rights, and said that the GDPR information duties and government guidance cover the risks.
I will engage in discussion with Facebook and other providers to point them once again to their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het investeren van afgepakt crimineel geld in wijken

The MP asked whether confiscated criminal assets should be returned to neighbourhoods, as suggested by the Rotterdam mayor, and whether data sharing rules should be widened to fight undermining crime. The minister rejects earmarking confiscated assets for neighbourhoods, citing selective enforcement and budget-process concerns, while pointing to a new 100 million euro undermining fund and planned legislation on information sharing.
Confiscated criminal assets should, in the first instance and where possible, be returned to the victims.
Afgepakt crimineel vermogen dient in eerste instantie, indien mogelijk, terug te worden gegeven aan de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de continuïteit van onderwijs van asielkinderen door de sluiting van het AZC Goes

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the State Secretary and Minister whether the closure of the Goes asylum reception centre, and the forced relocation of families with school-age children, was communicated in time and whether education continuity is protected. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a justified capacity decision, that schools and parents were informed promptly, and that COA plans relocations during school holidays to protect continuity, without committing to a new meeting with COA.
However, I do not consider this to outweigh the (societal) costs of maintaining too many reception places.
Ik vind dit echter niet opwegen tegen de (maatschappelijke) kosten die gepaard gaan met het in stand houden van teveel opvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de politie tips niet kan gebruiken

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police tip-form technical problems meant tips and attachments were lost, and whether this was widespread and fixed. The minister replied that there were no technical faults, that the single case arose from a staff member not following the download protocol, and that the system cannot lose files, with renewed attention to working agreements promised.
In the case mentioned, an employee did not follow the download protocol and requested that the form be emailed.
In het genoemde geval heeft een medewerker het downloadprotocol niet gevolgd en verzocht om het formulier te mailen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het afnemen van bloed van een overleden potentieel verdachte

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether blood can be taken from a deceased potential suspect of a fatal traffic incident so that surviving victims and relatives can get answers, and whether legislation prevents or permits this. The minister referred to an earlier answer and said the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure is examining whether examinations of deceased suspects or victims, such as autopsy, body scans or DNA sampling, can be explicitly allowed under set conditions.
That examination could consist, for example, of an autopsy, a body scan, taking cell material for DNA research or a dental examination.
Dat onderzoek kan bijvoorbeeld uit een sectie, een scan van het lichaam, het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek of een gebitsonderzoek bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat een crimineel op proefverlof zijn enkelband doorknipt en zware misdrijven kon begaan

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a case in which a person on conditional release cut off his ankle monitor and committed serious crimes, and about how many wearers cut their bands, whether conditional release rules should be tightened, and how sabotage is followed up. The minister answered that the monitor is a control tool, that the judge decides on revocation, that the monitor is not meant to replace detention, and described the follow-up protocol, while declining to speculate on the judge's decision and not centrally recording how many wearers reoffend.
It is not centrally recorded how often suspects and convicted persons who have been ordered to wear an ankle monitor commit an offence.
Er wordt niet centraal geregistreerd hoe vaak verdachten en veroordeelden aan wie het dragen van een enkelband is opgelegd een misdrijf plegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over onveiligheid in een woonwijk in Rosmalen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about shootings in a Rosmalen residential area, prior police signals, how residents are involved in local crime prevention, and how to increase crime reporting. The minister declined to comment on the specific case due to an ongoing criminal investigation, pointed to municipal responsibility and existing citizen reporting channels, and referred to the regeerakkoord goal of raising reporting rates without specific new measures.
Regarding the case mentioned in the reporting, there is an ongoing (criminal) investigation.
Ten aanzien van de in de berichtgeving genoemde casus is sprake van een lopend (strafrechtelijk) onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de veiligheid van vrouwen op het internet

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about online safety for women, including whether complaints about sexism and threats to social media are recorded, whether platforms remove content as in France, whether platforms should proactively remove such content, and whether France's online sexual intimidation offence should be introduced in Dutch law. The Minister said such figures are not recorded, that the Netherlands lacks comparable removal data, that platforms bear responsibility under the voluntary Notice and Take Down code, and that a separate offence for misuse of sexual imagery will be proposed while the wider sex-offence review continues.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over het bericht dat de Noorse gevangenen verdwijnen uit Veenhuizen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection what the government will do to keep Norgerhaven prison open after Norway stopped leasing it, and how job security and the regional prison policy in the regulation will be handled. The Minister answered that the decision is still being weighed against total detention capacity, that a vision on prisons will be sent before the summer recess, and that a personnel convenant on job security was signed.
Although I want to dispel this uncertainty as quickly as possible, I cannot yet provide clarity on the precise consequences of this decision for the capacity of Norgerhaven.
Hoewel ik deze onrust zo snel mogelijk wil wegnemen, kan ik op dit moment nog geen duidelijkheid verschaffen over de precieze gevolgen van deze beslissing voor de capaciteit van Norgerhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het rapport van de CTIVD over de AIVD en het gebrek aan privacy bij informatie-uitwisseling

An MP asked why the minister did not inform parliament or the public about a CTIVD report on the AIVD's unlawful sharing of information with other services before the referendum on the new intelligence act, and whether the report changes views on that law. The minister replied that the report was sent within the statutory six-week period, that it concerns the current law, and that it does not cast the new Wiv2017 in a different light.
The report, including the policy response, was sent to the House shortly after the deadline on Wednesday 28 March.
Het rapport, inclusief beleidsreactie, heb ik kort na de deadline op woensdag 28 maart naar de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het schorsen van verdachte lokale bestuurders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether suspected local politicians in Roermond and Brunssum harm local government, whether the minister should be able to suspend them during criminal proceedings, and what legal tools exist to annul such appointments. The minister acknowledged the damage to trust, explained that councils can dismiss aldermen and that the minister is studying broader grounds for suspension and disqualification, and noted annulment of an alderman's appointment has never occurred, promising a letter on integrity measures.

I will, as also announced in my letter, examine in consultation with the Minister of Justice and Security what the possibilities are to broaden the grounds for disenfranchisement and the ban on exercising an administrative function.

Ik zal, zoals eveneens in mijn brief aangekondigd, mede in overleg met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, nagaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de grondslagen voor ontzetting uit het kiesrecht en het verbod op het uitoefenen van een bestuurlijke functie te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een veroordeelde pedofiel die in detentie een boek over zijn slachtoffer kon schrijven

An MP asked the Justice Minister how a convicted child abuser could write a book about his victim while in detention and whether this should be prevented. The minister said the manuscript left prison improperly via a released inmate, that supervision measures were then imposed, and that no new legal ban is needed given existing civil and criminal remedies.
The manuscript should have been sent by the inmate through the institution's post.
Het manuscript had door de gedetineerde verzonden moeten worden met de post via de inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over locatiebepalingen bij 112 meldingen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Apple's planned support for Advanced Mobile Location would change 112 emergency location, why the Dutch system is not yet complete while neighbouring countries have location via Android ELS, why no EENA subsidy was applied for, and what privacy considerations apply. The minister answered that AML will be implemented, preferably in 2018, subject to technical preconditions and mobile operator cooperation, that the police will carry out a Data Protection Impact Assessment, and that the subsidy scheme did not fit Dutch needs.
Processing of personal data will, also after the introduction of AML, have to take place in line with the laws and regulations on the protection of personal data.
Verwerking van persoonsgegevens zal, ook na de invoering van AML, dienen te geschieden in lijn met de wet- en regelgeving omtrent bescherming van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over gestolen data van Übergebruikers

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the theft of data of 174,000 Dutch Über users, including whether companies must report breaches and whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' investigation outcome will be shared. The minister answered that breach reporting duties under the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens apply, that the regulator can enforce them, and that the regulator will publish its findings on its own initiative.
The report is currently being investigated.
De melding wordt op dit moment onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de ontvoering van Insiya naar India

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the abduction of a child to India, the content and enforceability of an Indian family court ruling, what the Dutch government is doing to speed up the child's return, and the status of the criminal case against the father. The government answered that the Indian ruling is not public and concerns parental rights rather than the abduction, that the Foreign Ministry and embassy press for return and have raised the case at high level, and that the criminal case is pending before the court so it will not comment further.
From the start of the case, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has maintained close contact with Insiya's mother about the status of the case and the possible return of Insiya to the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt vanaf het begin van de zaak nauw contact met de moeder van Insiya over de stand van zaken en de mogelijke terugkeer van Insiya naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de Amsterdamse politie niet toekomt aan het opsporen van grote drugsbazen

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Amsterdam police lack capacity to pursue major drug traffickers, given reports that most of its resources go to liquidations and radicalisation or terrorism cases. The minister said deployment is set locally, acknowledged the capacity pressure, and pointed to 267 million euros in extra structural police funding and a planned review of deployment before summer.
The deployment of police is determined by the local authority and can best be assessed there.
De inzet van politie wordt door het lokale gezag bepaald en kan daar ook het beste worden ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over achterstanden bij de digitalisering van de rechtspraak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about delays and extra costs in digitising the judiciary (KEI programme), their causes, and whether budget contributions must rise. The minister confirmed the delays (about one year for asylum and detention cases, further delays for other procedures), attributed them mainly to an over-optimistic 2014 estimate, and said extra costs would be covered from reserves for 2018 with the longer-term responsibility lying with the judiciary, to be clarified in spring.
I expect to be able to give a first assessment of the further shaping of digitisation in the spring.
Ik verwacht in het voorjaar een eerste oordeel te kunnen geven over de verdere vormgeving van de digitalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Henk Kuipers begint een eigen videorubriek’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kuiken asked whether a detained suspect starting his own video column, 'Vraag het Henk', was acceptable under the Penitentiary Principles Act and whether he had permission to contact the media. The Minister replied that contact with media requires the prison director's permission, that a request for an own video column is not likely to be granted, and that no such request had been received, so unauthorised contact could lead to restrictions.
For all contacts with the media, detainees must request permission from the director of the institution.
Voor alle contacten met de media geldt dat gedetineerden toestemming aan de directeur van de inrichting dienen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van rechts-extremisme

An MP asked the Ministers of Interior and Justice whether the prosecutor had pursued an Erkenbrand visitor's statements under criminal provisions on group insult and incitement, whether a complaint had been filed, and whether AIVD informs political parties about candidates posing a threat to the democratic legal order. The Minister replied that a complaint is not known to the OM, that further investigation is for the prosecutor to decide independently, and that AIVD can inform a party chair via an official report, without commenting on individual cases.
The OM is, however, not aware of a complaint, so further (investigative) research is in principle not called for.
Het OM is echter niet bekend met een aangifte, zodat nader (opsporings)onderzoek in beginsel niet in de rede ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over de recente geweldsgolf in Breda en de roep om extra rechercheurs

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about a wave of violence in Breda and calls for 250 extra detectives, including whether unresolved serious cases and the lack of police capacity are acceptable. Minister Grapperhaus said the government is investing in police capacity, that €100 million from the coalition agreement has been released, and that a review of police deployment and a flexibility agenda are underway, without addressing the 250-detective figure or the budget adequacy directly.
The first 100 million from the coalition agreement has already been released at my initiative.
De eerste 100 miljoen uit het Regeerakkoord is op mijn instignatie nu al vrijgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het opleggen van bestuursverboden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a person repeatedly involved in bankruptcy fraud can keep founding new companies, how many civil and criminal director bans have been imposed, and whether bans are effective. The Minister said the current screening and civil ban regime is in place, that bans take time to become final, and that criminal bans were imposed in a limited number of cases, while declining to comment on the individual case.
In 2016 and 2017, a total of 256 civil cases on director liability were decided by the district courts.
In 2016 en 2017 zijn bij de rechtbanken in totaal 256 civiele zaken over bestuurdersaansprakelijkheid afgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, Groothuizen en Kuiken over de uitzettingen van afgewezen asielzoekers naar Soedan

Four MPs asked whether the Netherlands should investigate the fate of Sudanese asylum seekers deported to Sudan after Belgium opened an inquiry into alleged torture of deportees, whether Sudanese diplomats played a role in deportations, and whether they gather information on asylum seekers in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State refused to start an own investigation or pause deportations, arguing the Dutch situation differs from Belgium's and no concrete signal of irregularities was received, and denied knowledge of diplomats gathering information.

The investigation started by the Belgian government into statements from some Sudanese foreigners expelled by Belgium is for me no reason to conduct an independent investigation into deportation to Sudan or to suspend return to Sudan.

Het onderzoek dat de Belgische regering is gestart naar de verklaring van enkele door België uitgezette Sudanese vreemdelingen vormt voor mij geen reden om een eigenstandig onderzoek te doen naar uitzetting naar Sudan dan wel om terugkeer naar Sudan op te schorten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de 'Hoornse zedenzaak'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the Hoorn sexual-assault complaint was not handled promptly, why the suspect was not arrested sooner, why no neighbourhood investigation was held, and whether witnesses who concealed evidence would be prosecuted. The Minister declined detailed answers citing privacy and criminal-procedure reasons, acknowledged police shortcomings per the Inspectorate's findings, and committed to a study of obstacles victims face when reporting crimes.
The protection of the victim's personal privacy stands in the way of a concrete answer to your question.
De bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van het slachtoffer staat concrete beantwoording van uw vraag in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het opinieartikel ‘Wordt het niet tijd om Nederland iets ruimer te zien dan de Randstad? Kabinet, ik bied u Zuid Limburg’

PvdA MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about an opinion piece urging a broader view of the Netherlands beyond the Randstad, with Zuid-Limburg as a TriState growth region. The minister responds that the government will look beyond the Randstad, that regions bear primary responsibility for spatial development, and that cross-border action and the National Environmental Vision will be pursued, with an update to parliament promised in spring 2018.
The State Secretary of BZK will inform the House of Representatives in more detail on progress in spring 2018.
De Staatssecretaris van BZK zal in het voorjaar van 2018 de Tweede Kamer over de voortgang hieromtrent nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de zaak Julio Poch

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the acquittal of former pilot Julio Poch in Argentina after eight years of pretrial detention, including whether Dutch authorities' information-sharing contributed to his detention and what consular support and extradition options exist. The government declined to judge the foreign ruling, said Dutch information sharing was a legal duty under mutual legal assistance rules, described consular support, and confirmed Dutch law does not allow extradition of its own nationals to Argentina.
The provisions on providing legal assistance in the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Convention against Torture require that such assistance be provided as broadly as possible.

Uit de bepalingen omtrent het verlenen van rechtshulp in het Wetboek van Strafvordering en uit het Verdrag tegen Foltering volgt dat dergelijke rechtshulp in zo ruim mogelijk mate verleend moest worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gevaar van rechts-extremisme

An MP from the Labour party asked the Interior Minister about the threat posed by the far-right group Erkenbrand, its aim of a white ethnostate, possible criminality of racist remarks by its visitors, and infiltration of political parties. The minister answered that Erkenbrand fits the AIVD definition of far-right extremism, that existing radicalisation policy suffices, that the remarks may be punishable but no complaint has been filed, and that individual party membership is a matter for the parties.
I do not make any statements about possible individual cases.
Over eventuele individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over naming and shaming op internet

An MP asked the Justice Minister what legal options victims of online shaming have to get videos removed and to pursue those who post them, and whether Dutch law protects better than Swedish law. The minister answered that criminal law (privacy and defamation offences), civil portrait-right claims and GDPR complaints to the Data Protection Authority are available, with platform takedown and a proposed prosecutorial removal order as practical tools, and that Dutch protection is comparable to Sweden.
The computer crime III bill, pending before the Senate, expands the public prosecutor's powers.
Het wetsvoorstel computercriminaliteit III, dat aanhangig is bij de Eerste Kamer, vergroot de mogelijkheden van de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de “achterdeurproblematiek” van coffeeshops

An MP from the Labour party asked the Justice Minister whether the court ruling not to sentence a coffeeshop owner, despite finding him guilty of possessing large quantities of cannabis, exposes the paradox of tolerating sales while the supply side ('back door') remains illegal, and whether legislation is needed. The Minister answered that the ruling does not change enforcement or law, that he does not intend to amend the law, and pointed to planned government-backed experiments with regulated supply to coffeeshops, to be evaluated afterward.
I do not intend to amend the law.
Ik ben niet voornemens de wet te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de behandeling van Faisal S, een homoseksuele asielzoeker die dreigde te worden uitgezet naar Pakistan

An MP asks the State Secretary about the treatment of a gay Pakistani asylum seeker, including reports of naked detention, arrest by non-police officers at a COA centre, late lawyer involvement, and whether the asylum claim should be granted. The State Secretary declines to discuss individual cases, says asylum claims from Pakistan are assessed on their merits, and rejects an independent complaints committee while promising to review IND credibility assessment practice with interest groups.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de blokkade van een demonstratie

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about a blockade that prevented a permitted demonstration against Zwarte Piet in Dokkum from proceeding, and whether ministers had signalled understanding for it. The minister replied that the mayor is the competent authority under the Wom, that no cabinet member judged the mayor's decisions, that the prosecution investigation is ongoing, and that she would consult mayors and the VNG on the public-order criterion.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is still ongoing, and nothing further can be reported on this at present.
Het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie loopt nog, daarover kan op dit moment verder niets worden gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over kindermisbruik op Aruba

MPs Kuiken and Dijksma asked why a 2015 motion calling for a joint Kingdom approach to child abuse on Aruba has not yet produced one, and whether a delay is acceptable. The state secretary cited Aruba's own responsibility, the postponed Kingdom working conference to March 2018, and ongoing interisland child-rights initiatives, but made no new binding commitment.
For Aruba, the approach to domestic violence and child abuse is a responsibility of the country itself.
Voor Aruba geldt dat de aanpak van huiselijk geweld en kindermishandeling een verantwoordelijkheid is van het land zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over digitale verkrachting

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether coercing sexual acts online, including digital rape, is punishable in the Netherlands, how this compares with Swedish law, and whether a separate digital rape offence will be introduced. The Minister replied that coercing online sexual acts can fall under assault, child sexual offences or child pornography provisions but not under rape as currently defined, that Dutch jurisdiction applies when acts are committed from the Netherlands, and that a modernisation of the sex offences law is being prepared with a consultation expected in 2018.
Within my ministry a bill to modernise the sex offences legislation is in preparation.
Binnen mijn ministerie is een wetsvoorstel tot modernisering van de zedenwetgeving in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de zorg voor kinderen van ouders in detentie

An MP asks the Justice Minister why children of detained parents still lack information, support and care despite earlier commitments, and who is responsible. The Minister acknowledges the problem, lists measures taken since 2012 (child check, digital post, extended visits, pilots), says responsibility is shared with the Health Ministry, and largely accepts the Children's Ombudsman's recommendations, while declining some and referring others to the relevant bodies.
I will therefore work on film and other information material specifically for children with a parent in detention, to give them a better picture of where their parents are and what to expect.
Ik zal dan ook inzetten op film en ander informatiemateriaal speciaal voor kinderen met een ouder in detentie, om hun een beter beeld te geven waar hun ouders verblijven en wat ze kunnen verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma over het pleidooi van gemeenten om meer soorten van de wietproef toe te staan

The MPs asked whether the government would allow several kinds of cannabis cultivation experiments as municipalities requested, rather than only one centrally supplied model, and whether they would consult the VNG. The minister said the experiments are still being designed in consultation with partners including municipalities and an independent evaluation committee, and aimed to submit the legislation in the second quarter of 2018.
We aim to submit the necessary legislation and regulations to your House in the second quarter of 2018.
Wij streven ernaar om de benodigde wet- en regelgeving in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de strafrechtelijke aanpak van matchfixing

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether matchfixing should be made explicitly criminal, given evidence problems reported by prosecutors. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors have managed with existing law, that the Openbaar Ministerie will explore whether a separate offence adds value, and that a reporting duty and any sanction will be studied before further steps are taken.
The Public Prosecution Service will examine whether a separate criminal offence of matchfixing adds value to the current legal instruments for acting against fraud in sport.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat bekijken of zelfstandige strafbaarstelling van matchfixing meerwaarde heeft ten aanzien van het huidig wettelijk instrumentarium om op te treden tegen fraude in de sport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ploumen over integriteit van het lokaal bestuur in Limburg

MPs Kuiken and Ploumen asked the Minister of Interior whether the appointment of a controversial alderman in Brunssum, which the mayor and the Limburg commissioner of the King considered a threat to governability, was acceptable and what tools mayors and commissioners have when integrity is at stake. The Minister said she had requested an official report, appointed an acting mayor with a mandate to restore relations, and promised to report by Q1 2018 on whether the legal toolkit should be expanded.
I aim to inform your House further on this in the first quarter of 2018.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2018 nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over aangiftes na misbruik door tantramasseurs

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about reports of sexual abuse by people posing as tantra masseurs, whether victims are reliably able to file complaints, how many reports the private Meldpunt Tantra Misbruik received, and whether municipalities can require licences for tantra massage. The minister condemned such abuse, explained victims can report to police or Centra voor Seksueel Geweld, described the police intake procedure, said the number of reports to the private platform is unknown, and noted most municipalities already require licences for sex-related services.
I will not go into the individual case.
Ik ga niet in op de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de aanpak van ondermijning

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice and Security about low reporting by entrepreneurs of signs of undermining crime and how to involve businesses in the integrated approach. Minister Grapperhaus answered that entrepreneurs weigh costs and benefits before reporting, pointed to existing research, and committed to broader rollout of Ondernemers Alert meetings and continued public-private cooperation.
I will ensure a broader rollout of these meetings via the PVOs.
Ik ga zorgen voor een bredere uitrol van deze bijeenkomsten via de PVO’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over de stijging van het aantal aangiften voor seksueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the Justice Minister about the rise in reports of sexual abuse following the #MeToo movement, whether police capacity is sufficient, and about low conviction numbers. The minister answered that reports and contacts rose in part, that police capacity is adequate, and that the link to #MeToo cannot be determined, and clarified conviction figures while disputing the one-in-eight statistic.
It cannot be determined how many reports, complaints and cases are directly related to the #MeToo movement.
Het is niet te duiden hoeveel meldingen, aangiften en zaken direct verband houden met de #MeToo-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about staffing shortages, a 'spam box' for urgent missing-person alerts, and the handling of missing-person cases at the Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen. The minister denied that alerts were late or sent to a spam box, said the bureau was always reachable and cases were assessed by police officers, and did not track how often urgent cases went unreported to the bureau.
It is not tracked in how many cases no report of an urgent disappearance was made to the LBVP.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden in hoeveel gevallen er geen melding van een urgente vermissing bij het LBVP is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over mediation in het strafrecht

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the 81.2% success rate of criminal mediation is a success and whether mediation should be continued and expanded. The Minister called the results favourable but noted the small number of referrals and said no firm conclusions on recidivism or court burden can yet be drawn; he referred to budget answers on further funding.
Compared with the total inflow of criminal cases (non-canton) at the district courts, namely 106,250 cases, the number of referrals is very limited.
Vergeleken met de totale instroom aan strafzaken (niet-kanton) bij de rechtbanken, te weten 106.250 zaken, is het aantal verwijzingen zeer beperkt te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over opgelegde straffen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a study finding that courts impose lower sentences than prosecutors demand in organised crime cases, largely because of partial acquittals and long case durations. The minister agreed with the findings, pointed to ongoing efforts to shorten case duration, declined a separate quality study of case files, and said a national sentencing database is a judiciary decision, with the judiciary exploring one.
The Council for the Judiciary has informed the Minister for Legal Protection that it is currently examining the possibilities of creating its own national database for sentencing.
De Raad voor de Rechtspraak heeft de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming bericht dat zij op dit moment de mogelijkheden onderzoekt om te komen tot een eigen landelijke databank voor de straftoemeting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de achterstanden bij de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked about delays and incomplete case files in appeals from the Zeeland-West-Brabant district court, including possible breaches of the reasonable-time right and sentence reductions. The Minister acknowledged the problems, said the 80 percent figure reflected an earlier snapshot, pointed to measures taken by the court and appeal court, and saw no need for further consultation or action now.
The Council for the Judiciary has indicated that such data cannot be derived from the systems.
Antwoord 2 De Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr) heeft aangegeven dat dergelijke gegevens niet uit de systemen kunnen worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onveiligheid van 'Internet of Things' in Nederland

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Justice and Security why Dutch smart-home devices score poorly on security, whether the government knew of the risks, what it will do to reduce them, and whether police records and expertise cover IoT-related hacking. The minister answered that a roadmap for secure hardware and software will be sent to parliament in spring 2018, that awareness campaigns and EUR 95 million for cybersecurity are being used, and that police records do not separately register IoT-device exploitation.

To promote better security of IoT devices, the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate, in consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security and other departments and private parties, is drawing up a roadmap for secure hardware and software.

Om te bevorderen dat IoT-apparaten beter worden beveiligd, stelt het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat in samenspraak met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en andere departementen en private partijen een roadmap veilige hard- en software op.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groothuizen over een gebrek aan capaciteit en kwaliteit bij het Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen

MPs Kuiken and Groothuizen asked the Minister about reports of understaffing and lack of expertise at the national police's Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen, including late alerts, a spam mailbox for urgent reports, and whether an independent investigation is needed. The Minister answers only by referring to a separate letter on improving missing-persons procedures, without addressing the individual questions.

The written questions from MPs Kuiken (PvdA) and Groothuizen (D66), question number 2017Z08797, have been answered by way of the letter 'Approach to bottlenecks in the missing persons process at the police'.

Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kuiken (PvdA) en Groothuizen (D66), vraagnummer 2017Z08797 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Aanpak knelpunten in het proces vermissingen bij de politie» (Kamerstuk 29 628, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over pesticide die schadelijk zijn voor baby’s

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether a Nature study linking pesticide exposure to premature births and birth defects applies to the Netherlands, and whether Dutch research and protective measures are planned. The minister answered that she had taken note of the study and referred all substantive questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents near agricultural fields.
I refer you to my letter on the status of research into the effects of crop protection products on residents living near agricultural fields.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief met onderwerp: Stand van zaken van het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor omwonenden van agrarische percelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het raadplegen van de informatie over de formatie op rijksoverheid.nl

An MP asked why the archive of the Rutte-III coalition formation was not available on rijksoverheid.nl despite a promise of access, and asked about transparency of lobbying. The minister replied that about 1,500 formation documents were published on kabinetsformatie2017.nl on 15 November 2017 with personal data made unreadable, and that the government supports greater openness and will consult on the Open Overheid initiative.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Kuiken over de opvang van vluchtelingen in Turkije op basis van de Turkijedeal

MPs Buitenweg and Kuiken asked whether Turkey's treatment of migrants returned from Greece under the EU-Turkey deal, as described in a VU report, meets refugee law obligations, and what follow-up is planned. The government rejects the report's conclusions, says all migrants can apply for asylum in Turkey and that only a small share of non-Syrians have applied, and it will not take new steps beyond existing EU monitoring and support.
The cabinet reaches different conclusions than the Vrije Universiteit study commissioned by VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Het kabinet komt tot andere conclusies dan het onderzoek van de Vrije Universiteit dat is opgesteld in opdracht van VluchtelingenWerk Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Militairen mishandeld bij ontgroeningsritueel’

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked the State Secretary of Defence about reports of soldiers being abused during initiation rituals at the Schaarsbergen barracks, the union's call to abolish such rituals, and related reporting, measures, complaint channels, drugs use and prosecution. The government answered that a domestic investigation was conducted with prosecutor consent, rights-related measures were taken, an independent external inquiry is underway, and that it sees no reason to change prosecution policy.
The way reports and reporters are handled is part of the independent external investigation.
De wijze waarop met meldingen en melders wordt omgegaan maakt deel uit van het onafhankelijk externe onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het alarmerend bericht over door mest verontreinigd grondwater

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands should adopt German and French programmes requiring organic farming in drinking-water protection areas, and whether cost-benefit studies should be mandatory. The minister answers that the Dutch Delta approach and a nitrate action programme with tailored plans for 40 drinking-water intakes already address this, and that new mandatory cost-benefit studies are unnecessary.
Having new cost-benefit studies carried out (mandatorily) is therefore not necessary.
Het (verplicht) laten uitvoeren van nieuwe kosten-batenstudies is dus niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dam over gerechtelijke secties die noodgedwongen in België worden uitgevoerd

MPs Kuiken and Van Dam asked the Justice Minister about autopsies of suspected crime victims being carried out in Belgium because of a staffing shortage at the Netherlands Forensic Institute after a forensic pathologist died. The minister defended the arrangement as a professional, temporary solution with the Antwerp University Hospital, consistent with prior policy, and declined to say the Chamber should have been informed beforehand.
I assess it as a good solution by the NFI to enter into constructive cooperation with Belgian experts.
Ik beoordeel het als een goede oplossing van het NFI om een constructieve samenwerking met Belgische deskundigen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het helpen van slachtoffers van kinderporno

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about research into victims of child pornography, whether a webcrawler could be deployed to remove such material, and whether victims are informed so they can claim compensation. The minister pointed to existing victim-support research, said a webcrawler is being assessed for inclusion in a plan due end 2017, and explained that victims are notified case by case, with the victim's wishes decisive.
Currently it is being examined what the possibilities are for deploying such a webcrawler and to what extent it adds value to existing investigation methods.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn voor het inzetten van een dergelijke webcrawler en in hoeverre dit toegevoegde waarde heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over The Hague Security Delta

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about public funding to The Hague Security Delta, its influence on senior officials, and possible improper use of public money. The minister answered that the one-off 500,000 euro start-up subsidy was accounted for and met its conditions, that HSD is a public-private platform with no duty to contact senior officials, and that no improper conduct is apparent.
There are no agreements between HSD and the Ministry of Security and Justice about contacts with senior officials.
Er zijn geen afspraken tussen HSD en het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie over contacten met hoge ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Buitenweg over Amber Alert en de inzet bij jong volwassenen

MPs Kuiken and Buitenweg asked whether the AMBER Alert system could be extended to life-threatening disappearances of young adults and whether the minister would take steps to do so. The minister answered that current criteria cover only children under 18, that extension has legal, financial and operational consequences, and that a broader review of alerting tools is underway without committing to expansion.
I will ask the police to examine your question and the consequences of your request further in conjunction with the tender.
Ik zal de politie vragen om uw vraag en de gevolgen van uw verzoek nader te onderzoeken in combinatie met de aanbesteding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken  over uitputting van de landbouwgrond

An MP from the Labour party asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that agricultural soil is being depleted, including the claim that doing nothing is harmful to farming. The minister acknowledged the global degradation concern, said the Carpay report's steenmeel claims lack scientific support, and deferred concrete soil policy to a future cabinet, promising only to recommend that it consider the UN findings.
As part of the soil strategy still to be developed, I will recommend that the new cabinet take the outcomes of the Global Land Outlook into account.
In het kader van de nog te ontwikkelen bodemstrategie zal ik het nieuwe kabinet aanbevelen om de uitkomsten van de Global Land Outlook mee te nemen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het overdragen van sociale media data van gewone Nederlanders aan de Amerikaanse overheid, de Muslimban en de onderhandelingen over de Amerikaanse "preclearance"

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked about US handling of Dutch travellers' social media data, refusals of entry to dual nationals and Dutch citizens, the Muslim travel ban, and preclearance negotiations at Schiphol. The government answered that it is not actively informed when entry is refused, that the EU PNR court opinion does not affect US data exchange, and that preclearance talks continue under Dutch, EU and international law including human rights.
The Dutch government is not actively informed when Dutch nationals are denied entry to the US.
De Nederlandse regering wordt niet actief geïnformeerd indien Nederlanders de toegang tot de VS is ontzegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Toorenburg over de werking van de Wet Damocles

MPs Kuiken and Van Toorenburg asked whether a Raad van State ruling of 30 August 2017 deviates from case law on closing homes under the Damocles law (Opiumwet art. 13b), and whether finding drugs in a home remains sufficient grounds for closure. The minister answered that the ruling confirms existing case law: a trade-sized quantity suffices for a presumption of sale, the burden shifts to the resident, and closure powers are unaffected.
This ruling does not deviate from existing case law.
Deze uitspraak wijkt niet af van de bestaande jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Berg over de aanbesteding fotografie in relatie tot de naleving van het clusterverbod

MPs Kuiken and Van den Berg asked the Prime Minister about the non-public tender for photography services, how selection criteria protect small firms and freelancers, and the current contracts with about 30 freelance photographers. The Prime Minister confirmed a two-stage non-public EU tender, explained that 101 firms applied and 40 contracts are planned from March 2018, and gave total spending of 2.935 million euros while withholding per-photographer turnover as commercially confidential.
The turnover per photographer concerns commercially confidential information.
De omzet per fotograaf betreft commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over gebrekkig onderwijs t.a.v. sexting

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why pupils report little sexting education and how schools' teaching on sexting, sexual diversity and media matches the 'Seks onder je 25ste' findings. The ministers pointed to Inspectorate reports showing schools address sexual education variably, to Mediawijzer.net and curriculum reform, and gave no new concrete commitments beyond ongoing efforts.
The full report 'Seks onder je 25ste' has not yet been made public; that will happen in the autumn.
Het volledige rapport «Seks onder je 25 ste » is nog niet openbaar gemaakt; dat gebeurt in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de explosieven in woonwijken

An MP asked how hundreds of kilos of WWII explosives could be stored under a permit, what conditions apply, and whether emergency services knew of them. The government answered that a 2012 exemption covered a collection of WWII munition, that no permit existed for phosphorus, artillery or hand grenades, and that emergency services were not told of permit holders as a standing practice.
I cannot say exactly what was found because this is part of the criminal investigation.
Over wat precies is aangetroffen kan ik geen mededelingen doen omdat dit onderdeel is van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hijink over de plannen van postbedrijf Sandd

Two MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister whether he had long held postal firm Sandd's plans to deliver post cheaper than PostNL, whether those plans threaten postal workers' pay and conditions under the Tijdelijk Besluit Postbezorgers, what labour criteria apply when appointing a Universal Postal Service provider, and whether Sandd complies with the 80% permanent-contract rule. The minister confirmed receiving Sandd's information memorandum in November 2016, said arbeidsvoorwaarden rules apply and flexibility is needed, left compliance monitoring to the ACM, and noted that terminating the existing government contract is legally difficult.
It is therefore not for me to make a statement on this.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het alarmerend bericht over door mest verontreinigd grondwater

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that manure is contaminating groundwater used for drinking water, including exceedances at 89 abstraction points and who is responsible for protection and remedies. The government answered that agricultural nitrate is the main cause, that the provinces and Minister of Infrastructure and Environment share responsibility, and that a tailored, non-statutory approach with water companies and farmers is planned, with a review by 1 January 2019 and possible further measures.

If insufficient progress has been made by 1 January 2019, the responsible governments (central government and provinces) will jointly consider which necessary measures to take to resolve manure-related problems at drinking water abstraction points.

Indien op 1 januari 2019 onvoldoende voortgang is bereikt, dan zullen de verantwoordelijke overheden (Rijk en provincies) in samenwerking bezien welke noodzakelijke maatregelen genomen worden om mestgerelateerde knelpunten in de drinkwaterwinningen op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat malware mogelijk energiebedrijven kan platleggen

An MP asked the ministers whether the Industroyer malware, reported by ESET, could disrupt Dutch energy companies given similar equipment and protocols, and what the government role is in protecting vital infrastructure. The government answered that intrusion is a prerequisite, that responsibility lies primarily with companies under Elektriciteitswet and Gaswet with ACM supervision, that the NCSC advises vital providers, and that the NIS directive implementation bill was in consultation.
Government and vital organisations work together in the Netherlands to protect vital infrastructure.
Overheid en vitale organisaties werken in Nederland samen aan de bescherming van de vitale infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat kinderen van zeven jaar slachtoffer zijn van sekschantage

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that seven-year-old children are victims of sextortion, including whether Dutch figures exist, how children and parents are informed, how perpetrators are traced, and whether a response to a Europol report will be sent. The minister answered that sextortion is not registered as a separate phenomenon so no figures can be given, described existing prevention and police efforts, explained the investigation approach, and saw no reason for a policy response to the Europol report.
Sextortion is not registered as a separate phenomenon in police systems. For that reason I cannot give you the requested figures.
Sextortion wordt niet als apart fenomeen in de politiesystemen geregistreerd. Om die reden kan ik u het gevraagde cijfermatige inzicht niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de problemen op en rond de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about the Haringvlietbridge problems, including motorists dismantling a barrier during a power outage, the response time for faults, and recent incidents. The minister defended the response times, condemned the barrier removal as dangerous, and reported repairs and inspections of the bridge's expansion joints and structure.
Following this incident, Rijkswaterstaat is making additional working agreements with contractors so they can reach the location faster in case of congestion.
Wel maakt Rijkswaterstaat naar aanleiding van dit incident aanvullende werkafspraken met aannemers om hen, in geval van file, sneller op locatie te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over een varkenshouder met beroepsverbod in Duitsland die in Nederland uit mag breiden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a pig farmer barred from practising in Germany for animal cruelty who may expand a Dutch megastable, and about the inspection history of his Dutch farms. The State Secretary said the NVWA inspected the farms repeatedly, with several warnings and one fine, that the German ban cannot by itself block an environmental permit, and that criminal courts, not administrative bodies, decide on practice bans in the Netherlands.
A practice ban imposed on an entrepreneur in another country cannot in itself be grounds for refusing an environmental permit requested by that entrepreneur.
Een beroepsverbod dat een ondernemer in een ander land is opgelegd, kan op zichzelf geen grond zijn voor het weigeren van een omgevingsvergunning die door deze ondernemer is aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat Brabantse criminelen in buitengebieden vrij spel zouden hebben

An MP asked the ministers whether they agreed with researchers that municipal anti-crime action in rural areas of Brabant rarely leads to concrete steps, and about their proposed solutions. The minister said the WODC study shows growing awareness and institutional anchoring but a fragile, information-poor cycle in smaller municipalities, and announced extra funding for RIEC/LIEC, public-private cooperation and support for political office holders while leaving effectiveness of local measures to local authorities.
The assessment of that is primarily a matter for the local authorities.
De beoordeling daarvan is primair aan de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het boetebeleid voor onverzekerde auto’s

An MP asked ministers about fines for uninsured cars, including fines after suspension lapses, the legality of indefinite suspension, and debt collection and imprisonment for those unable to pay. The government said suspension is meant to be temporary, described existing prevention measures and a changed approach to imprisonment-for-debt requests, and promised to report back on the outcomes of consultations.
It is not known what the personal motives are of all owners of suspended vehicles in the Netherlands for whether or not to extend the suspension.
Het is niet bekend wat de persoonlijke motieven zijn van alle eigenaren van geschorste voertuigen in Nederland om de schorsing wel of niet te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de stijging van het aantal naaktfoto's en filmpjes van jongeren

MP Kuiken asked the Education and Justice ministers about the rise in sexting among youth, the normalisation of the practice, the lack of education on it, and when new sex-crime legislation would arrive. The government replied that schools must teach sexuality and resilience, that new sexting programmes and a barrier model are being developed, that the panel figures are not recognised, and that a bill is expected for consultation in summer 2017.
It is expected that a bill modernising sex-crime legislation will be ready for consultation in the summer of this year.
Naar verwachting zal een wetsvoorstel tot modernisering van de zedenwetgeving in de zomer van dit jaar gereed zijn voor consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over ernstige gezondheidsklachten bij medewerkers van het AZC in Ter Apel

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked the State Secretary and Health Minister about health complaints among COA staff at the Ter Apel asylum centre, including calls for deeper investigation and doubts about soil research. The State Secretary answered that 17 staff are currently on sick leave, that an independent commission of external experts has been set up to investigate the causes, and that soil studies found no contamination capable of causing the complaints.
The COA board has decided to set up an independent investigation committee with external experts.
Het bestuur van het COA heeft besloten tot het instellen van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie met externe deskundigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het uitzetten van homoseksuele asielzoekers naar Irak

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why gay asylum seekers from Iraq are being deported and whether IND assessment of sexual orientation is fair. The government defends its prima facie policy and the existing IND working instruction, rejects changing the burden of proof or creating a binding external commission, and does not commit to new action.
I do not share the view of the chairman of LGBT Asylum Support.
Ik deel de mening van de voorzitter van LGBT Asylum Support niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over ontwikkelingen rondom het Road Package van de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers about the European Commission's Road Package on road transport, including fears of social dumping, worse working conditions for truck drivers, and whether the Netherlands will press for tighter cabotage rules and action against letterbox companies. The minister replied that the Commission's proposals were not yet published (expected 31 May), so their content could not yet be assessed, and pointed to a 2014 joint ministerial declaration calling for better implementation of EU law; the answer to the cabotage and Road Alliance questions is largely pending.
Only then will it be possible for me to assess the content of the proposals.
Het is voor mij dan pas mogelijk om de inhoud van de voorstellen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester om een huis te sluiten

MP Kuiken asked whether a mayor should be able to close a home when its occupation causes public order disturbance, and whether the law should be amended after the Echt-Susteren Bandidos case, where the Council of State ruled the closure unlawful. Minister Blok defended the mayor's efforts, said the closure power under Article 174a Municipal Act is narrow due to fundamental rights and that other measures were available, and declined to propose a legislative change.
From my answers to questions 2 to 5 it follows that I am not considering a legislative amendment following this case.
Uit mijn antwoorden op vraag 2 t/m 5 blijkt dat ik naar aanleiding van deze casus geen wetswijziging overweeg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Leenders en Kuiken over balkons in Breda, die ook zonder belasting af zouden kunnen breken

MPs asked whether balconies of 160 flats in Breda could collapse without warning, the risks to residents, and whether mandatory inspections for gallery flats should extend to balconies. The minister said the defect was a too-deep reinforcement placement, the corporation acted promptly by closing balconies, the risk was judged small, and he sees no reason to extend the inspection duty, leaving enforcement to municipalities.
I therefore see no reason at this time to extend this inspection obligation.
Ik zie daarom thans geen aanleiding om deze onderzoeksplicht uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kuiken over het bericht dat een Brabantse amateurvoetbalclub vier voetballertjes heeft weggestuurd omdat ze te weinig lootjes hebben verkocht

MPs Van Dekken and Kuiken asked the minister whether an amateur football club was right to expel four children for not selling enough lottery tickets, whether minors can be obliged to sell tickets, and what legal recourse parents have. The minister answered that the club has since reconciled with the parents and the children are welcome back, that clubs may impose obligations on members via their statutes, and that members may appeal a royement internally and then to the civil courts.
A royement can only be imposed if the member acts in breach of the association's statutes, regulations or decisions, or if the association is unreasonably harmed.
Een royement kan alleen worden uitgesproken als het lid in strijd handelt met de statuten, reglementen of besluiten van de vereniging of de vereniging op onredelijke wijze benadeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over het bericht "Spoedoverleg over zakkenrollende asielzoekers"

PvdA MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary about a mayor's call for faster deportation of asylum seekers from safe countries who commit pickpocketing and other offences, and whether these offenders work in organised groups. The State Secretary answered that such persons should be rejected and removed quickly, that local authorities act and detain offenders, that organised-group cooperation could not be established, and referred to letters of 17 November and 13 December for the measures taken.
I share your view that persons who invoke the asylum procedure and related facilities on improper grounds should be rejected as quickly as possible and then leave the Netherlands.

Ik deel uw mening dat personen die op oneigenlijke gronden een beroep doen op de asielprocedure en de daarbij behorende voorzieningen, zo snel mogelijk moeten worden afgewezen en vervolgens Nederland moeten verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Schendingen mensenrechten bij opvang vluchtelingen Italië'

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary whether the human rights abuses against migrants in Italian reception and hotspot facilities reported by Amnesty International were caused by EU pressure, what controls exist, and whether they affect relocation arrangements. The government answered that UNHCR, IOM, the European Commission and Italian authorities did not recognise the allegations, that EU registration rules and a fingerprinting guideline apply, and that the findings do not change the hotspot approach or relocation agreements.
I have had inquiries made accordingly, but I have received no signals from the various parties involved that confirm this conclusion.
Ik heb me navenant laten informeren, maar van de diverse betrokken partijen geen signalen gekregen die deze conclusie bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Hongaarse regering vluchtelingen mishandelt en hen maandenlang zonder redenen opsluit

MPs Maij and Kuiken asked the government about reports that Hungary abuses and arbitrarily detains refugees, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government called the reports worrying, said Hungary must respect European and international obligations, noted that the Commission has opened an infringement procedure whose outcome is expected in September 2017, and referred to its earlier assessment instead of a separate one.

The cabinet's position that the treatment of refugees must be in line with European treaties and agreements, including the European Convention on Human Rights, the European acquis and international refugee law, remains unchanged.

Het kabinetsstandpunt dat de behandeling van vluchtelingen in lijn moet zijn met Europese verdragen en afspraken, waaronder het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en het Europese acquis, evenals internationaal vluchtelingenrecht, blijft onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Gesthuizen, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over de brand in het vreemdelingendetentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about a fire at the Rotterdam immigration detention centre, including the lack of aftercare, isolation and searches of detainees, the non-central unlocking of doors, and why the Inspectorate did not investigate earlier. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will investigate the events, expected to finish by late November 2016, and will report to parliament afterwards, and that it has now decided to open a further inquiry since the Amnesty account covers different facts.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the course of events surrounding the fire.
Inspectie VenJ) zal onderzoek verrichten naar de gang van zaken rond de brand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kuiken over de vestiging van een asielzoekerscentrum in Maastricht

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the sale and lease of a Maastricht property for an asylum centre, reportedly linked to a suspect owner, showed integrity risks and whether the COA should have checked the buyer's integrity under the Bibob Act. The minister acknowledged factual inaccuracies in the press report, said the government should be restrained in such deals and that integrity checks are warranted, explained that the COA ran a notarial check finding no link to the owner, and noted the COA lacks Bibob powers but a change is being prepared.
The Minister of Justice and Security is currently examining how the Bibob authority for the COA can be realised in the short term by amending the Bibob Decree.
Momenteel beziet de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie hoe de Bibob-bevoegdheid voor het COA, door middel van een aanpassing van het Besluit Bibob, op korte termijn kan worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over kindermisbruik in Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

Two MPs asked the government about reports of rising child and women abuse in Greek refugee camps, the Red Cross's role, and what Netherlands and the EU will do to protect residents and deport perpetrators. The minister said Greece is responsible, the issue was raised with Greek authorities and at EU level, EU funding has been given to improve camps, and the Greek government denies abuse reports were filed, without giving exact figures.
The Greek government is responsible for the reception of migrants, in line with European legislation and international law.
De Griekse overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de opvang van migranten, in lijn met Europese wetgeving en het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘Kinderen verdwenen uit azc Ter Apel; verdachten kinderuitbuiting opgepakt’

MPs Kuiken and Van Dekken asked about reports that children had disappeared from the Ter Apel asylum centre and that suspects in child exploitation were arrested, asking about the children's status, Dublin procedures, and police tracing and European cooperation. The minister confirmed awareness of the arrests but declined to discuss the individual children on privacy and safety grounds, stated no links were seen to other disappearances, and referred to an earlier answer for tracing and cooperation measures.
For reasons of privacy and the safety of the young people, I will not go into the individual circumstances of this case.
Omwille van de privacy en de veiligheid van de jongeren ga ik niet in op de individuele omstandigheden in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Maij en Marcouch over het bericht “Frontman Pegida Nederland jaagt in Bulgarije op vluchtelingen”

MPs Kuiken, Maij and Marcouch asked whether a Dutch Pegida frontman hunting refugees in Bulgaria is a matter for private citizens, whether his conduct is punishable, whether a private army is criminal, and whether a passport ban could apply. The minister replied that border control is for the competent authorities, he has no knowledge beyond media reports, Dutch criminal law may apply extraterritorially under article 7 Sr, and he sees no current grounds for passport revocation.
I am not aware of the activities of the Dutch man mentioned in the report, other than what emerges from media coverage.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de activiteiten van de in het bericht genoemde Nederlandse man, anders dan uit de berichtgeving in de media naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat asielkinderen wegkwijnen in grootschalige opvang

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that unaccompanied minor asylum seekers in large-scale reception centres receive too little psychological care, face substance use, and see their guardians only briefly, and about measures to improve reception and prevent disappearances. The State Secretary answered that care is available via the centre's health clinic, that a verbal improvement plan from COA has been reviewed by the Inspectorates, and that the government will inform parliament before summer recess.

At the General Consultation of 26 May I committed to inform your House before the 2016 summer recess about the measures COA has taken to improve the quality of protected reception for unaccompanied minors.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg van 26 mei jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor het zomerreces 2016 uw Kamer te informeren over de door het COA doorgevoerde maatregelen om de kwaliteit te verbeteren van de beschermde opvang voor amv's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Gesthuizen, Kuiken, Voortman en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat opvang wordt geweigerd aan (zieke) vreemdelingen die bereid zijn om het land te verlaten

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary whether asylum seekers willing to leave the Netherlands are being refused shelter at Ter Apel, including sick ones, and why the buitenschuld regime and the motions on voluntary return and bed-bad-brood arrangements are not reflected. The state secretary denied the premise, explained that shelter is conditional on demonstrated active cooperation with return, and stated that medically necessary care is available with a possible deferral of departure under article 64 Vw.
It is generally correct that not all foreigners who request shelter at the VBL are actually admitted to the VBL.
Het is in algemene zin juist dat niet alle vreemdelingen die verzoeken om onderdak in de VBL daadwerkelijk tot de VBL worden toegelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Yücel en Volp over het bericht dat Syrische kindbruiden in Nederland uit beeld dreigen te raken

MPs Kuiken, Yücel and Volp asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Syrian child brides risk disappearing from view in the Netherlands, including whether children are vanishing from reception centres and how COA and Nidos protect them. The State Secretary answered that no reports of disappearances of married minor girls are known, that one minor entered wrongly under a residence permit, and described existing monitoring and guardianship arrangements, while a separate investigation into other vanished youths is ongoing.
The National Public Prosecution Service has therefore started an investigation into these young people following signals from COA and Nidos.
Het Landelijk Parket van het OM is dan ook naar aanleiding van de signalen van het COA en Nidos een onderzoek gestart naar deze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat er een voedseltekort is in het vluchtelingenkamp op Lesbos

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of a food shortage at the Lesbos refugee camp, the humane implementation of the EU-Turkey deal, Commission measures to make the overcrowded Moria camp livable, and attention to vulnerable people and children. The answer refers the MP to a letter on the reporting and does not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Kuiken (PvdA), question number 2016Z07174, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the reporting on food shortage in refugee camp Lesbos'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA), vraagnummer 2016Z07174 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie over de berichtgeving over voedseltekort in vluchtelingenkamp Lesbos, (Kamerstuk 32 317, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ypma over het rapport ‘Wachten op je toekomst’ over asielkinderen in de noodopvang

MPs Kuiken and Ypma asked the state secretaries about the Children's Ombudsman report on asylum children in emergency shelters, including living conditions, forced relocations, access to mental health care, school continuity and support for schools. The government replied that conditions are acceptable given the high pressure on reception, that relocations cannot be fully avoided, that the IGZ is examining health care for foreigners, and that OCW will report later on school registration and school-attendance figures.
I believe the number of relocations of families with children and unaccompanied children should be kept as limited as possible.
Ik vind dat het aantal verhuisbewegingen van gezinnen met kinderen en alleenstaande kinderen zo beperkt mogelijk zou moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Marcouch en Servaes over het bericht dat Eritrese intimidatie in Nederland zich uit breidt

PvdA MPs asked whether Eritrean regime-linked intimidation and extortion of diaspora members in the Netherlands is known, what action is taken, and whether the Eritrean embassy was confronted and funds traced. The minister answered that the government knows of the reports, has not found evidence of Eritrean support to Al-Shabaab, held a warning meeting with the Eritrean ambassador, and that police and prosecutors investigate concrete suspicions of crimes, while no overview of incidents exists.
There is no overview of the number of incidents in relation to the Eritrean regime.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal incidenten in relatie tot het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Volp over het bericht van Europol over minstens 10 duizend vermiste vluchtelingenkinderen

MPs Kuiken and Volp asked the State Secretary about a reported Europol claim that over 10,000 refugee children have gone missing after registration, and what the government is doing to monitor and protect them. The State Secretary said the figure is unverified, outlined EU and national measures including SIS alerts and a new coordination platform, and described procedures for unaccompanied minors who leave care, while committing to propose further SIS-based steps to the EU.
Europol has indicated that it is not an official Europol report.
Europol heeft aangegeven dat het niet om een officieel bericht van Europol gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de oproep van burgemeesters om kleinschalige opvang van asielzoekers zelf te regelen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether small-scale asylum reception could be left to mayors, whether small locations are not feasible, and whether small municipalities could experiment with integration. The State Secretary said small locations suit recognised refugees, that the government cannot refuse any location given urgent capacity needs, and that COA and OTAV will support municipalities' new initiatives.
Given the asylum inflow and the urgent need for reception capacity, I am not in a position to refuse locations.
