Gelet op de asielinstroom en de dringende behoefte aan opvangcapaciteit bevind ik mij niet in de luxepositie om locaties te kunnen weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Volp over het bericht dat uit Eritrea gevluchte vrouwen mogelijk zijn gedwongen tot seks rondom een bezoek aan de Eritrees-orthodoxe kerk

MPs Kuiken and Volp asked the State Secretary about reports that Eritrean women and minors may have been coerced into sex around visits to an Eritrean Orthodox church in Rotterdam, and about COA's response, protection, reporting and victim support. The State Secretary answered that COA reported signals to police and EMM, took preventive measures and that police/prosecutors found no complaints or suspected offences so far, while noting that the signals' seriousness cannot be assessed.

The National Prosecutor's Office will explore the possibilities to examine the signals of possible abuses within the Eritrean community in the Netherlands at national level and in a multidisciplinary way.

Het Landelijk Parket van het OM zal de mogelijkheden verkennen om de signalen van mogelijke misstanden binnen de Eritrese gemeenschap in Nederland op landelijk niveau en op multidisciplinaire wijze nader te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over het mogelijk strafbaar stellen van vrijwilligerswerk ten behoeve van asielzoekers op Griekse eilanden

Two MPs asked whether a leaked EU Council draft on migrant smuggling would criminalise NGOs and volunteers helping asylum seekers on Greek islands, and whether the Netherlands would act against such criminalisation. The State Secretary replied that the draft conclusions contain no new legislation, do not criminalise humanitarian volunteers, and that existing EU law allows member states an exemption clause for humanitarian assistance, with no further action needed.
The accusation that the Council Conclusions on migrant smuggling lead to the criminalisation of NGOs and volunteers is incorrect.
Het verwijt dat de Raadsconclusies inzake mensensmokkel tot criminalisering van NGO’s en vrijwilligers leidt is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het rapport van het College van de Rechten voor de Mens over de situatie in Heumensoord

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the CRM report on the Heumensoord asylum shelter, including protection of LGBT and vulnerable residents, small-scale locations, boredom and stress, unclear procedures and whether the report's recommendations would be adopted. The State Secretary said discrimination is not tolerated, pointed to planned information on tougher measures and COA dialogue, noted measures already taken on safety and activities, and said he would study the recommendations while the Inspectorate had been asked to examine shelter risks.
I consider it important that organisations such as the CRM and the National Ombudsman critically review matters, and I will study the recommendations to see what we can learn from them.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat organisaties zoals het CRM en de Nationale ombudsman kritisch meekijken en ik zal de aanbevelingen bestuderen om te bezien wat we hiervan kunnen leren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over een dreigend tekort van menskracht bij de GGD door de toestroom van vluchtelingen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked whether the influx of refugees will cause a staff shortage at the GGD public health services and what the government will do to prevent it. The Secretary of State said the staffing impact is hard to predict, that municipalities are responsible for adequate GGD capacity, and that a working group with the VNG was set up to address the issues.
As a result, it cannot be stated in advance whether a staff shortage will arise at the GGDs.
Daardoor is het op voorhand niet aan te geven of er zich een tekort aan menskracht bij GGD'en gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Kuiken over de berichten dat veel vluchtelingenkinderen nog steeds geen onderwijs ontvangen

MPs Ypma and Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that many refugee children still receive no schooling, including unclear demand data, trauma support, NT2 teacher shortages and communication on funding. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained the three-month reception norm, promised data linkage with the Justice ministry, and outlined measures such as accountmanagers, teacher retraining and a progress report before summer 2016.
I have committed to informing you by 1 April 2016 about the number of asylum-seeker youths in school in the Netherlands.
Ik heb u toegezegd om u voor 1 april 2016 te informeren over het aantal asielzoekersjongeren op school in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kuiken over de moeilijke positie van LHBT in de asielopvang

MPs Gesthuizen and Kuiken asked about a reported suicide attempt by a gay asylum seeker in Alphen aan den Rijn linked to LHBT insecurity, reports of abuse of LHBT residents in reception centres, low reporting of crimes, and whether separate shelter or a dedicated contact person should be provided. The Secretary of State said the resident was moved at his own request, rejected a separate inquiry, said discrimination is not tolerated and the COA will pursue perpetrators, declined separate categorical shelter and a dedicated LHBT contact person, and promised a letter by March 2016 on stricter enforcement plus a study meeting to improve information on rights and reporting.
I therefore see no reason to have a further investigation carried out into the circumstances.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om een nader onderzoek te laten doen naar de toedracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over het bericht dat bestuurders in de buurt meetellen bij de planning van asielzoekerscentra

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked whether officials at the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf were right to check which local administrators live near a possible asylum site, and why. The minister answered that COA, not the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, is responsible for finding locations, that the wording in the email suggests such considerations can and may not matter, and that COA does not use a social map and no sites were rejected on this basis; the answers to earlier questions were referred to.
The wording of the email, as reported in the Algemeen Dagblad, creates the suggestion that the presence of administrators could make a difference. That cannot and may not be the case.
Het taalgebruik uit de e-mail, zoals gemeld in het Algemeen Dagblad, wekt de suggestie dat de aanwezigheid van bestuurders verschil kan maken. Dat kan en mag niet het geval zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de penibele situatie van gestrande migranten bij de Griekse grensplaats Idomeni

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about stranded migrants at Idomeni on the Greek-Macedonian border, including lack of shelter, whether a closed Greek camp could be reopened, and EU hotspot implementation. The government answered that it monitors the fluid situation, the camp has reopened, Dutch humanitarian funding has been provided, and it is working on hotspots and coordination within the EU.
The cabinet is attentive to the situation in Idomeni, which is very fluid, and follows developments closely.
Het kabinet heeft aandacht voor de situatie in Idomeni, die zeer fluïde is, en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de situatie van LHBT’ers in het AZC in Alphen aan den Rijn

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked the State Secretary about bedreigingen and harassment of LGBT asylum seekers in the Alphen aan den Rijn reception centre, the threshold for 'acute emergency' relocation, sanctions on perpetrators, and why no complaints were filed. The State Secretary answered that victims can be moved on request, perpetrators are sanctioned, COA encourages complaints but the group declined to file, and the hunger-strike protocol is adequate.
I want to emphasise that if the safety of a resident is at stake, COA arranges other housing, if the victim wishes so.
Ik wil benadrukken dat, als de veiligheid van een bewoner in het geding is, door het COA andere huisvesting geregeld wordt, als het slachtoffer dat wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de detentie en deportatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the state secretary about reports by Amnesty International of detention and deportation of Syrian and Iraqi refugees by Turkey, including chaining and mistreatment, and whether the EU-Turkey action plan funds such centres and whether Turkey's geographic limitation breaches the Refugee Convention. The government answered that it is aware of the reports, the EU delegation in Ankara has asked Turkish authorities for an investigation, it will await that investigation before judging legal compliance, EU support in the past funded some detention centres, and it does not share the view that Turkey's geographic limitation justifies the returns.

The EU delegation in Ankara is in close contact with the Turkish authorities and Amnesty International to clarify the abuses described in the report, and has asked the Turkish authorities to launch an investigation.

De EU-delegatie in Ankara staat in nauw contact met de Turkse autoriteiten en Amnesty International om opheldering te krijgen over de in het rapport beschreven misstanden en heeft de Turkse autoriteiten verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de mogelijke oprichting van een ‘mini-Schengen’ zone

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reported plans for a 'mini-Schengen' zone, including its cause, progress, design and the EU decision-making process. The State Secretary answered that the high asylum influx is straining Schengen, that informal talks with similarly pressured countries are ongoing on border control and returns, and that the matter will be discussed at the 4 December JHA Council and reported on through the usual agendas.
As usual, I will inform you of European developments via the annotated agendas and reports of the JHA Council.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal ik u informeren over de Europese ontwikkelingen via de geannoteerde agenda's en verslagen van de JBZ-raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de migratiestroom vanuit het Rifgebied

MP Kuiken asked the government about reports of thousands of young Moroccans from the Rif attempting to reach Greece and claiming Syrian refugee status, and whether this strains the asylum system and whether root causes and identification should be addressed. The State Secretary acknowledged the reports, described EU hotspot registration and Frontex/EASO support, explained the IND's nationality checks, and said root-cause action with Morocco was pursued through the Valletta summit and partnerships, without any binding new commitment.
If the foreigner has submitted no documents or a false document, or there are otherwise signs that the stated nationality should be doubted, this is grounds for further investigation.

Heeft de vreemdeling geen documenten of een vals document overgelegd, of zijn er anderszins signalen dat getwijfeld moet worden aan de gestelde nationaliteit, dan is dit aanleiding om nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kuiken over de mogelijkheid tot het inzetten van mensenrechtenambassadeurs op AZC’s

MPs Yücel and Kuiken asked whether human rights ambassadors could be deployed in asylum centres to explain Dutch fundamental values, after reports of threats to religious freedom and safety for vulnerable residents. Minister Asscher answered that COA receives such signals, applies rules on religious practice and discrimination, provides civic information, and is discussing with organisations how to expand this, including the VON proposal.
COA therefore willingly enters into discussion with VON to explore the possible contribution these human rights ambassadors could make.
Het COA gaat daarom graag het gesprek aan met VON om te bespreken welke mogelijke bijdrage de genoemde mensenrechtenambassadeurs kunnen leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Yücel over de veiligheid van Lesbische, Homoseksuele, Biseksuele en Transgender (LHBT) asielzoekers in opvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Yücel asked about reports of threats and bullying against LHBT asylum seekers in reception centres and whether protective measures such as separate housing or a trusted person are planned. The State Secretary answered that incidents were few before the surge in arrivals, that COA staff are trained to act as trusted persons, and that separate LHBT housing is not desirable.
I consider it important that all COA staff in the reception centres have sufficient skills to act as a trusted person and therefore see no added value in a separate trusted person.

Ik vind het van belang dat alle COA medewerkers in de opvang voldoende vaardigheden hebben om als vertrouwenspersoon op te treden en zie daarmee geen meerwaarde in een afzonderlijke vertrouwenspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over de gebrekkige doorstroming van statushouders in Arnhem

MPs Kuiken and De Vries asked why suitable rental homes in Arnhem remain empty while no refugees with status are placed there, and whether bureaucracy is the cause. The State Secretary disputes that no status holders can be found, notes 40 of 132 lack a citizen service number due to registration backlogs managed by municipalities, and announces a registration 'BRP-straat' and a support team for municipalities.
Due to the high inflow of asylum seekers a backlog has arisen, and municipalities are suffering from it.
Door de hoge instroom van asielzoekers is hierbij een achterstand ontstaan en daar hebben gemeenten last van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over Syrische kindbruiden in asielzoekerscentra

The MP asks about Syrian child brides arriving at asylum centres, whether there is a tolerance policy on recognising such marriages, and about reproductive care, child trafficking and FGM in asylum centres. The State Secretary denies a tolerance policy, says the minimum recognition age is being raised to 18 by a bill, describes existing protection and reporting arrangements, and declines a new study on sexual health access.
FGM is not separately registered in the systems of the IND and COA.
FGM wordt niet apart geregistreerd in de systemen van IND en COA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de toegang tot seksuele gezondheidszorg in asielzoekerscentra

An MP asked the State Secretary about reproductive and sexual health access in asylum reception centres, minors' safety, forced marriage, FGM, and whether a national study should be launched. The State Secretary answered that existing arrangements are adequate and declined to commission a new study.
I therefore see no reason to have research carried out on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om hier onderzoek naar te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen in Hongarije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister about degrading conditions for refugees in Hungary, including police food-throwing, detention conditions, and whether the Netherlands should stop Dublin transfers there. The government answered that the situation is worrying, that Dublin transfers remain possible under individual case review by the IND and courts, that the Commission is monitoring Hungary, and that it has raised concerns bilaterally.
From the above it appears that individual Dublin procedures contain sufficient safeguards to carefully examine the admissibility of the transfer.
Uit het vorenstaande blijkt dat er in een individuele Dublinprocedure voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de toelaatbaarheid van de overdracht zorgvuldig te toetsten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat het verplichte basisexamen inburgering gezinshereniging ‘onmogelijk of uiterst moeilijk’ maakt

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the State Secretary whether the mandatory civic integration exam for family reunification, as held by the EU Court of Justice to make reunification impossible or extremely difficult, breaches EU law, and how the government will respond on the hardship clause and exam costs. Minister Asscher answered that the Council of State will decide the case after the summer, that the government will set its position afterwards, and that it is not opportune to make policy choices ahead of that outcome.
I do not consider it opportune to make a policy choice in advance of the outcome of this procedure.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om vooruitlopend op de uitkomst van deze procedure een beleidskeuze te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rebel en Kuiken over de ruim 3.300 alleenstaande kinderen die de afgelopen maanden de Middellandse Zee overstaken

MPs Rebel and Kuiken asked about the over 3,300 unaccompanied children who crossed the Mediterranean in 2015, including monitoring, reception, NGO involvement and EU action against trafficking. The State Secretary acknowledged the vulnerability, pointed to EU directives and shelter arrangements, and to EU migration agenda steps, but did not provide figures on trafficking victims and placed tracing of family members with individual member states.
I am not aware of how many cases involve victims of human trafficking.
Mij is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen het gaat om slachtoffers van mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de kritiek van de Nationale Ombudsman op het medisch adviseren door het Bureau Medische Advisering over vreemdelingen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how the government will respond to the National Ombudsman's criticism of the Bureau Medische Advisering's medical advice on foreign nationals, including whether it will adopt a more critical approach and check availability of treatment in countries of origin. The State Secretary says he will study the report and send a written response before the summer recess, stresses professional conduct of staff, and promises to inform parliament by May 2015 about the international comparative research on access to care in countries of origin.
For now I want to emphasise that the staff of the Immigration and Naturalisation Service and the Bureau Medical Advice carry out their duties as a matter of course professionally and conscientiously.

Voor nu hecht ik eraan te benadrukken dat de medewerkers van de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst en het Bureau Medische Advisering hun taken vanzelfsprekend professioneel en consciëntieus uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de intentieverklaring die is gesloten met België om de samenwerking op immigratiebeleid uit te breiden

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Netherlands-Belgium letter of intent on migration cooperation, including the Europe route for family migration, resettlement, and the EASO asylum pilot. The State Secretary answered that cooperation focuses on implementing agencies, that the government will raise the Europe route abuse with the Commission, and that the EASO pilot ran in Den Bosch.
The Netherlands wants to examine together with Belgium what options exist to make it harder to use the Europe route.
Nederland wil samen met België onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om het gebruik maken van de Europaroute moeilijker te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken en Maij over het bericht dat Griekenland 300.000 migranten zou willen laten doorreizen naar de rest van de EU

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether Greece would issue travel documents to 300,000 to 500,000 migrants, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The government said no such formal announcement had been made, called any such move unacceptable, reminded Greece of its EU obligations, and described EU support and Dutch contributions.
The cabinet considers the statements by this Greek official about opening the borders unacceptable.
De door deze Griekse bewindspersoon gedane uitspraken over het openstellen van de grenzen acht het kabinet onacceptabel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over het terugvorderen van uitgekeerde toeslagen vanwege het samenwonen met een vreemdeling zonder rechtmatig verblijf

Two MPs asked the State Secretaries whether a Council of State ruling means people in special circumstances no longer automatically lose benefits when a partner without lawful residence lives with them, and what the ruling's scope and practical consequences are. The government answered that the ruling is limited to the specific facts of that individual case, that it changes no policy or practice at the Tax Authority, and that it is consistent with earlier rulings.
The scope of this ruling is limited to this individual case, because it is based on the specific facts and circumstances of the case, from which no general conclusion can be drawn.

De reikwijdte van deze uitspraak is beperkt tot dit individuele geval omdat die gebaseerd is op de specifieke feiten en omstandigheden van het geval waaraan geen algemene conclusie kan worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over (ver)bouwplannen voor de huisvesting van asielzoekers

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether local and regional firms could be given a chance in building and renovating asylum reception centres, and whether the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and COA could draft tenders allowing local participation. The state secretary replied that COA is responsible for works, that local involvement is encouraged within procurement rules (including a 10 percent regional sourcing requirement in framework contracts), and that mandatory local preference would breach tender rules.
Mandatory use of local or regional companies conflicts with procurement rules because it leads to distortion of competition.
Het verplicht gebruik maken van lokale of regionale bedrijven is strijdig met de aanbestedingsregels omdat dit leidt tot concurrentievervalsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nareis van meerderjarige kinderen van vluchtelingen

An MP asked the State Secretary about the family reunification policy for adult unmarried children of refugees, including how the 'more than normal emotional dependency' test is applied and how many children have been unable to join their families. The State Secretary confirmed the policy is intentionally more generous than the EU directive requires, explained the individual IND assessment and a 2014 adjustment for children who lived with parents, but could not provide numbers because the IND system no longer separates these cases.
The answer to the above questions requires intensive and time-consuming individual file research.
Antwoord 5 Het antwoord op bovenstaande vragen vergt intensief en tijdrovend individueel dossieronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat TenneT een tracé voor hoogspanningskabels plotseling verlegt

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked why TenneT's planned 380kV cable route between Roosendaal and Tilburg was moved from the northern to the southern alignment and when the planning procedures would proceed. Minister Kamp answered that the northern route was dropped because four-circuit connections are unacceptable for grid security and international obligations, that the new route will be optimised with local stakeholders, and that formal procedures are expected in autumn 2017.
The new planned route must first be technically elaborated in consultation with regional parties and optimised where necessary and possible.
Het nieuwe voorgenomen tracé moet eerst in overleg met de regionale partijen technisch uitgewerkt worden en waar nodig/mogelijk worden geoptimaliseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het besluitmoratorium voor vluchtelingen uit Irak

MPs Voordewind and Kuiken asked whether the decision moratorium for Iraqi asylum applications leaves vulnerable minorities waiting up to 18 months, how family reunification is affected, how long the moratorium lasts, and what the IND can still decide individually. State Secretary Teeven answered that the moratorium only allows the IND to postpone decisions, that individual cases with clear risk can still be granted, that minority groups are assessed on their merits, and that the moratorium lasts six months with a possible single six-month extension.
The decision moratorium has been set for a period of six months. After this period I will consider whether there is reason to extend the moratorium once by six months.
Het besluitmoratorium is ingesteld voor de duur van zes maanden. Na afloop van deze termijn zal ik bezien of er aanleiding is het moratorium eenmalig met zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over de integratie van vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van de Integratiebarometer van Vluchtelingenwerk

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the poor labour-market and poverty outcomes of refugees shown in the Vluchtelingenwerk Integratiebarometer 2014, and whether current integration instruments and municipal support are adequate. The government acknowledges the weak outcomes, points to language, education and recognition gaps and to Somali refugees doing worst, and cites new labour-market orientation in civic integration from January 2015, but makes no concrete new commitments.
The civic integration policy was recently changed and needs time to prove itself.
Het inburgeringsbeleid is recent gewijzigd en heeft tijd nodig om zich te bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt over langdurige vreemdelingenbewaring zonder bijstand van een advocaat

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked the State Secretary about a detainee who spent 182 days in immigration detention without contact with a lawyer. The State Secretary said detainees are assigned a state-paid duty lawyer, courts review detention automatically at 28 days and six months, and the lawyer concerned was reprimanded by the disciplinary board while the new supervision regime is being strengthened.
This is laid down in the Vreemdelingenwet in line with the European Return Directive.
Dit is conform de Europese Terugkeerrichtlijn vastgelegd in de Vreemdelingenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over extra maatregelen tegen autodiefstal

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked about a news report on car theft, rising theft numbers, police priority, a ban on sale of key duplicators and car-theft electronics, ANPR camera privacy rules, and online sale of moped tuning kits. The minister denied a rise in thefts, said a sales ban is legally hard to justify under proportionality and EU law, noted a pending bill allowing 28-day retention of ANPR passage data, and offered to consult the trade on other options.
A sales ban is very difficult if it cannot be shown that these systems have no other use than carrying out criminal activities.
Een verkoopverbod is erg lastig als niet kan worden aangetoond dat er geen enkel ander nut is voor dit soort systemen dan het uitoefenen van criminele activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat de rechters bij de Raad van State zelden de kant van de vluchteling kiezen

MP Kuiken asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that Council of State judges rarely side with asylum seekers, including criticism of deferential and marginal review and unmotivated rulings. The State Secretary rejected the portrayal, defended the scope of judicial review and the summary-decision power under Article 91(2) Vreemdelingenwet, and committed only to a forthcoming bill implementing the EU Procedures Directive's full ex nunc review.
I do not recognise the picture of the Council of State's Administrative Jurisdiction Division painted by Prof. Spijkerboer.
Het door prof. mr. Spijkerboer geschetste beeld van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Schouw over de opvang van Nederlandse kinderen in gezinsopvanglocaties

MPs Kuiken and Schouw asked why two Dutch children and their Guinean mother were held for twenty months in a restrictive family locations despite having Dutch nationality, and whether more such cases exist. The State Secretary acknowledged the children's Dutch nationality was insufficiently recognised, said about ten Dutch children currently stay in such locations on a voluntary basis, and committed to finding alternative accommodation.
In the case referred to in question 1, the court ruled that this measure was therefore wrongly imposed on the two children.
In de casus waarover het bericht van vraag 1 gaat, heeft de rechter bepaald dat deze maatregel derhalve ten onrechte aan de twee kinderen is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de mogelijkheden om extra opvanglocaties voor asielzoekers te vinden

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how municipalities and residents could be encouraged to accept extra temporary asylum reception locations, and what the current figures are. The State Secretary answered that COA is using existing and new locations, that municipal cooperation is essential, and that a platform has been set up with VNG to speed up housing of permit holders.
COA responded to the unexpectedly higher inflow by making optimal use of existing spaces at existing locations.
Het COA heeft gereageerd op de onverwachte hogere instroom door op bestaande locaties optimaal gebruik te maken van de bestaande ruimten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het advies van de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage over het ‘Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad Airport’

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about the Commissie m.e.r. advice that the environmental impact report for the Lelystad Airport decision is incomplete, including the late nature-feasibility study, noise exposure in new neighbourhoods and handling of objections. The state secretary partly disagreed with the advice, explained the timing of the feasibility study, agreed to supplement noise data for route variants, and said objections will be documented and published after the Raad van State advice.

At the Commission's request, to complete the comparison material between the route variants, the picture of the number of people disturbed by noise and sleep disturbance for the other route variants will also be supplemented.

Op verzoek van de Commissie wordt om het vergelijkingsmateriaal tussen de verschillende routevarianten compleet te maken, ook het beeld van het aantal geluidgehinderden en slaapverstoring bij de overige routevarianten aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden bij de luchtvaartmaatschappij Norwegian Air Shuttle

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Irish-registered Norwegian Air structure, Irish oversight of its operations, and Dutch measures to protect jobs and fair competition. The State Secretary said the matter is under EU discussion, the US decision is pending, and pointed to an EU social-partner study due at year end and a sector employment plan.
As long as there is no decision on this, I do not consider it advisable to comment on the statements mentioned.
Zolang hierover nog geen uitsluitsel is vind ik het niet raadzaam om commentaar te geven over de genoemde uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Jacobi en Kuiken over de plannen voor ontwikkeling van het KNSF-terrein in Muiden

PvdA MPs asked the minister about the draft zoning plan for the former KNSF site in Muiden, including very high building heights, its effect on the Kruitbos nature area, the EUR 376 million damage claim, and Schiphol flight path and Stelling van Amsterdam implications. The minister answered that zoning is the municipality's responsibility and that the Council of State is the appeal forum, while stating that nature agreements are upheld and that the damage claims are frozen pending the plan becoming final.
Under the Spatial Planning Act (Wro), it is the municipality's responsibility to adopt zoning plans for 'good spatial planning'.
Op grond van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening (Wro) is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om bestemmingsplannen vast te stellen ten behoeve van «een goede ruimtelijke ordening».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘vergrijzing transport levert baankansen op’

MPs Kuiken and Jadnanansing asked about logistics sector labour shortages, whether school leavers are choosing logistics careers, and whether enough workers are being recruited and retrained. The government answered that the sector itself must attract workers, pointed to a sector plan with 30 million euro of training measures and 1,250 extra driver trainees, and said vacancies are not above average.
It is up to the sector itself to present itself as an attractive employer and to entice young people to choose a career in logistics.
Het is aan de sector zelf om zich een aantrekkelijk werkgever te tonen en jongeren te verleiden om te kiezen voor een carrière in de logistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister about road safety on the A15 after fatal and serious truck crashes, the high casualty count over ten years, and when measures would be taken. The minister answered that risk on the A15 is below average for motorways, announced a local traffic detection system, extra traffic inspectors, a planned overtaking ban for trucks and improved road markings.
Following research, as promised during the MIRT debate in autumn 2013, I have decided to install a local traffic detection system on the Deil towards Valburg road section.
Na onderzoek, zoals toegezegd bij de behandeling van het MIRT in het najaar van 2013, heb ik besloten om een locaal filedetectiesysteem te plaatsen op het weggedeelte Deil richting Valburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat weinig leerlingen slagen bij beginnende rijscholen

MP Kuiken asked the minister about reports that few pupils pass at new driving schools, the growth in driving school numbers, and whether the government will improve oversight of driving school quality. The minister answered that quality rests mainly on instructor requirements and market forces, announced a planned role for the Inspectorate (ILT) in supervising WRM instructor passes after a 2016 law change, and declined an ondernemersstage.
For this a change of the WRM is necessary, which is expected to be ready in 2016.
Hiervoor is een wijziging van de WRM noodzakelijk, die na verwachting in 2016 gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over de verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 bij Lemmer

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked the minister about congestion at A6 exit 17 near Lemmer in the tourist season and whether it creates unsafe situations, and whether temporary measures are planned. The minister answered that no structural congestion or unsafe situation is evident, no temporary measures are planned, and the province of Fryslân is studying N359 ring road improvements with Rijkswaterstaat involved.
As previously indicated, there is currently no unsafe traffic situation on the A6 at Lemmer.
Zoals eerder aangegeven is er op dit moment geen sprake van een verkeersonveilige situatie op de A6 ter hoogte bij Lemmer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Raad van State een streep heeft gezet door de bouw van 700 woningen bij Schiphol

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether the Council of State's ruling blocking 700 homes near Schiphol affects future housing plans and the airport, and whether support was sought before the zoning plan was adopted. The state secretary answered that the municipalities bear responsibility for weighing aircraft noise in zoning decisions, that the ruling does not affect airport use, and that Haarlemmermeer ran a broad participation process linked to the A9 relocation.
This concerns the responsibility of the relevant municipalities to seek support and ensure a sound weighing of interests.
Het betreft hier de verantwoordelijkheid van betreffende gemeenten om draagvlak te zoeken en te zorgen voor een goede afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Öztürk over de sluiting van vrachtwagenparkeerplaats Traffic Port in Venlo

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister why the free truck parking area Traffic Port in Venlo is being closed, given its use by 150 to 500 trucks daily, and how the resulting nuisance and unsafe situations will be prevented. The minister answered that the lease will not be renewed and no longer fits the SecureLane market-transition model, that about 100 alternative night-time spaces exist nearby with signposting from 1 April 2014, and that keeping the site open is not an option.
As I indicated in my answer to questions 1, 2 and 3, keeping TrafficPort open is not an option.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op de vragen 1 2 en 3 heb aangegeven is het openhouden van TrafficPort geen optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het besluit van Philip Morris om 90% van het personeel van haar fabriek in Bergen op Zoom te ontslaan

Two MPs asked ministers how they judge Philip Morris's plan to dismiss 90% of its Bergen op Zoom workforce, whether they will act quickly, and whether reshoring and a mobility centre are being pursued. The minister answered that the decision is a commercial one, that the ministry has contacted the firm, that a mobility centre financed by Philip Morris is being prepared, and that a regional economic strengthening plan and a study of reshoring will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het plan van het Zweedse verpakkingsbedrijf Tetra Pak om zijn fabriek in Moerdijk eind dit jaar te sluiten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about Tetra Pak's plan to close its Moerdijk factory, questioning the decision given strong 2013 results and asking what tools exist to keep investment in Dutch plants. The minister answers that the closure is a business decision the government cannot intervene in, lists existing innovation and investment subsidy instruments, and says the company is supporting affected workers through a social plan and talks with potential buyers of staff.
The plan to close the Moerdijk factory at the end of 2014 is based on business and strategic choices. The government cannot intervene in those.
Het voornemen om de fabriek in Moerdijk eind 2014 te sluiten is gebaseerd op bedrijfsmatige- en strategische keuzes. Daar kan de overheid niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over het nemen van onomkeerbare maatregelen bij sluis Eefde

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked why a rook colony at lock Eefde is being relocated and irreversible measures taken before the new lock chamber decision and zoning plan are final, and whether the relocation could wait. The minister answered that a Flora and Fauna Act exemption was granted, no objection was filed, no irreversible steps will be taken before the zoning plan is adopted, and relocation must start before the next breeding season.
Moreover, no irreversible measures will be taken pursuant to the exemption before the zoning plan has been adopted.
Overigens worden er ter uitvoering van de ontheffing geen onomkeerbare maatregelen genomen voordat het bestemmingsplan is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de begrenzing van auto’s tot de derde versnelling

An MP asked the minister whether cars limited to first to third gear escape APK inspection, road tax and licence requirements, and what should be done. The minister answers that such vehicles qualify as limited-speed motor vehicles (MMBS) only if they meet strict conditions, that roughly 300 are deregistered yearly with no data on misuse, and that the T-rijbewijs from 2015 and a planned category review will close the gap.
The number of drivers who use these vehicles not for agricultural purposes but to evade the APK and road tax is not known.
Het aantal bestuurders dat deze voertuigen niet voor agrarische doeleinden gebruikt, maar hiermee de APK en wegenbelasting omzeilt is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de Duitse plannen om tol te heffen op buitenlandse auto’s

An MP asked the government about Germany's planned vignette for foreign passenger cars, its economic impact on the Netherlands, level-playing-field concerns and contacts with the German minister. The minister answered that the plan is not yet concrete, that the Commission will scrutinise it for non-discrimination, and that the Dutch concerns were raised with the German minister.
As long as there are no concrete plans from the German government, I cannot assess the consequences for the Netherlands.
Zolang er geen concrete plannen zijn van de Duitse regering, kan ik de gevolgen voor Nederland niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over drankrijders die toch hun rijbewijs mochten behouden

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked whether some police regions failed for years to report drunk and asocial drivers to the CBR, endangering road safety. The minister denies police negligence, attributes the rise in reports in 2012 to improved automation and information, and says no structural problems remain.
In my view there has been no negligence on the part of the police.
Er is naar mijn mening geen sprake geweest van verzuim door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Fokke over uitbuiting van werknemers die werken aan de A2-tunnel in Maastricht

MPs from the PvdA asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about exploitation of foreign workers on the A2 tunnel project in Maastricht, and about whether public bodies should screen contractors and prevent unfair competition. The minister says the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, an expert committee found likely violations of the Bouw cao, and he points to planned chain liability and a study on displacement, while rejecting a change to selection criteria and the Rijkswaterstaat procurement role.
Now that there is a report from the expert committee, it is becoming clearer what is going on.
Nu er een rapport ligt van de expertcommissie wordt inzichtelijker wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about three Council of State rulings on imposing the alcohol-interlock programme on truck drivers, the status of the exploration of interlocks in lorries, and when the Chamber would be informed. The minister confirms the rulings were noted, says the exploration is completed, and promises to inform the Chamber before the 30 January 2014 committee meeting.
I intend to inform you as soon as possible, and at the latest before the scheduled committee meeting of 30 January 2014.
Ik ben voornemens u zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren, doch uiterlijk voor het geplande AO van 30 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Albert de Vries over stremmingen op het Zeeuwse deel van de A58

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether closures on the Zeeland stretch of the A58 after accidents last too long and whether Zeeland is effectively cut off. The minister denies that closures are longer than elsewhere, explains existing incident procedures and detour routes, and offers only to consult road managers on improving traffic flow, rejecting the suggested crossover measures as ineffective.
I am willing to consult with the road managers on whether traffic flow on the detour routes during an incident can be improved.
Ik ben bereid om met de medewegbeheerders te overleggen of de doorstroming op de omleidingsroutes tijdens een incident bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht in de Telegraaf dat ‘luchtvaartmaatschappijen massaal de compensatieregeling ontwijken’

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about reports that airlines widely evade the flight compensation rule, including a Consumentenbond finding that 95% of compensation claims are initially rejected, and about a SEO study linked to a claimed 10 million euro figure. The state secretary said the Consumentenbond study is not available to the government, that consumers can complain to the ILT, that the SEO study uses scenario assumptions and does not support the 10 million figure, and gave no new action.
The underlying research is not publicly available and I have also not obtained it in any other way.
Het onderliggende onderzoek is niet publiek beschikbaar en heb ik ook niet op andere wijze verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Rebel over het alcoholslot

MPs Kuiken and Rebel asked about reports that a drink-driver escaped punishment through the alcohol-lock programme, the Judiciary's use of sentencing guidelines, technical reliability of alcohol locks, and whether the programme evaluation could be brought forward. The government said the judiciary, not the Council for the Judiciary, sets the guidelines, that no case data are kept, that technical faults are rare, and that the evaluation runs to end 2014 with the full period to 2022, and it did not meet the deadline for answering before the budget debate.
Unfortunately, this deadline was not met.
Deze termijn is helaas niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jan Vos over een dreigend tekort aan laadpalen voor elektrische auto's

MPs Kuiken and Jan Vos asked the state secretary and the minister of Economic Affairs about a looming shortage of public charging points for electric cars, including projected car numbers, charging infrastructure, and municipal support. Minister Kamp answered that around 20,000 EVs are expected by end 2013, that charging infrastructure will grow under the 'ladder van laden' approach, and that an agreement with stakeholders is expected by year end.
The hope and expectation is that this agreement can be signed before the end of this year.
De hoop en verwachting is dat deze afspraak voor eind van dit jaar kan worden ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de nieuwe sluiskolk in de Twentekanalen bij Eefde

An MP asked the minister about the Commission for EIA's preliminary criticism of placing the new lock chamber at Eefde on the northern side, and whether a middle-northern alternative should be studied as a full option. The minister acknowledged the preliminary advice, said Rijkswaterstaat is preparing a supplement to the planMER, and declined to pre-empt the final advice, rejecting a second opinion and promising to compare the sites in that supplement.
I will await the final assessment advice of the Commission for EIA before responding.
Ik wacht het definitieve toetsingsadvies van de commissie m.e.r. af alvorens te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over recidive na educatieve verkeersveiligheidsmaatregelen

An MP asked the ministers whether a quarter of motorists who must follow a traffic behaviour course re-offend within two years, and what recidivism rate is acceptable, and asked about the WODC evaluation, the longer-term recidivism and other offence types. The minister states the government aims for the lowest possible recidivism, notes the WODC figures (about 13% and 14% same-type reoffending, nearly 25% combined), says the EMG has been revised, and that longer-term data will come in 2016 and 2021 with ongoing optimisation of the measures.
I strive for recidivism percentages that are as low as possible.
Ik streef naar zo laag mogelijke recidivepercentages.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de verkeersveiligheid op de A15

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about the many accidents on the A15 motorway and what could improve road safety there. The minister attributed the accidents to diverse causes, outlined measures such as road markings, local traffic detection and lane-overtaking changes, and said matrix signalling was not cost-effective.
To improve road safety, Rijkswaterstaat is examining the possibility of applying chevron stripes on the road surface.
Om de verkeersveiligheid te verbeteren onderzoekt Rijkswaterstaat de mogelijkheid om zogenaamde chevronstrepen op het wegdek aan te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de onveiligheid van Provinciale wegen

An MP asked the minister whether provincial roads should have 3.30m lanes rather than 2.75m for safety, whether a star-rating system like the national roads would help, and what steps will be taken to improve safety on provincial roads. The minister answered that wider lanes may be safer at 80 km/h if drivers do not speed, that EuroRAP ratings are being piloted for provincial roads, and that road safety on these roads is primarily the responsibility of provinces and municipalities.
Improving road safety on 80 km/h roads is the responsibility of the relevant road manager, mainly municipalities and provinces.
Het verbeteren van verkeersveiligheid op 80 km/uur wegen is de verantwoordelijkheid van de desbetreffende wegbeheerder, dit zijn vooral gemeenten en provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de constructieve veiligheid van de landtunnel in de A4 bij Schiedam

An MP asked the minister whether she knows of the criticism by the former structural reviewer of the A4 Schiedam land tunnel, what actions were taken, whether independent research will be done, and what risks motorists face. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat, the contractor and an independent expert checked the design, the municipality concluded structural safety is not at issue, and no risk to motorists exists.
Rijkswaterstaat informed Mr De Kanter about these investigations and their results.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft de heer De Kanter geïnformeerd over deze onderzoeken en over de resultaten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en De Boer over de aanpak van illegale taxi’s en aanbieders van illegale taxidiensten op internet

Two MPs asked how the government tackles illegal taxi services offered online, including via Facebook, and how many such operators were contacted, warned or sanctioned. The state secretary agreed these services should be tackled, said the size of the illegal market cannot be measured, and described ILT warning letters (about 60 in 2013) and proceedings, but gave no figures on sanctions or seized cars.
Seizure of cars is generally carried out by the police. The number of cars of unlicensed drivers seized on the order of the Public Prosecutor is not separately registered.
In beslagname van auto’s gebeurt in de regel door de politie. Het aantal op last van de Officier van Justitie in beslag genomen auto’s van snorders wordt niet apart geregistreerd.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het ontslag van de top van de KLM Flight Academy (ingezonden 4 juni 2013).

An MP asked the state secretary about the departure of the KLM Flight Academy's top management, the problems at the academy, the timing and scope of the internal safety-culture review, and planned follow-up actions. The state secretary said the ILT received notice of an internal review and an interim director, that the review concerns safety culture and finances after two fatal US training accidents, and that further ILT action depends on the review results and the NTSB investigation.
Which additional actions, if deemed necessary, will be taken by KLM Flight Academy and KLM can only be determined after the internal review has been completed.
Welke en indien nodig bevonden aanvullende acties daartoe zullen worden ingezet door de KLM flight Academy en KLM kan pas worden bepaald nadat het interne onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de mogelijke privatisering van de luchtverkeersleiding

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary whether he agreed that partial privatisation of the monopolistic air traffic control provider LVNL, which bears heavy responsibility for aviation safety, is unwise, and what the aviation sector thinks of it. The state secretary answered that the CEO spoke in a personal capacity, that privatisation is not current government policy, that the internal organisational form should stay open pending Single European Sky considerations, and that the aviation parties broadly agree on the themes.
Partially privatising Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland is currently not cabinet policy.
Het (gedeeltelijk) privatiseren van de Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland is op dit moment geen Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de opleiding van heftruckchauffeurs

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister whether forklift training is of poor quality and whether minimum standards, certification or legal obligations are needed given many forklift accidents. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the signals but said no widespread problem was reported, relied on employers and industry bodies (including a quality-criteria handbook), and only committed to raising the issue with sector organisations.
However, the ministry has not received signals that the mentioned problems with forklift training are widespread.
Het ministerie heeft echter geen signalen ontvangen dat de genoemde problemen met heftruckopleidingen wijdverbreid zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken, Jan Vos en Mei Li Vos over het onderzoek van de Europese Commissie (EC) naar een vermeend Europees oliekartel

MPs Kuiken, Jan Vos and Mei Li Vos asked the minister of Economic Affairs about the European Commission's investigation into a suspected European oil cartel, including its evidence, duration, scope, Dutch consumer harm, and the role of the ACM competition authority. The minister replied that the Commission has been very restrained and gave no concrete evidence beyond its press release, that the ACM can assist and must decide independently whether to investigate, and summarized Germany's Bundeskartellamt fuel-market study.
Because of the importance of the investigation, the European Commission is very restrained in giving statements that touch on the content of its investigations.
Vanwege het onderzoeksbelang is de Europee Commissie zeer terughoudend in het geven van mededelingen die de inhoud van haar onderzoeken raken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hamer over rijopleidingen en het opleiden van rijinstructeurs door het UWV

MPs Kuiken and Hamer asked about high dropout from UWV-funded driving instructor training, selection of trainees, recovery of training costs, a bankruptcy that disrupted 255 trainees, and how many have been trained. The government answered that dropout is in line with average re-integration training, selection followed protocol, cost recovery occurs in some cases via sanctions, affected trainees were placed in other training, and only 144 of 391 tracks ended in placement.
The number of dropouts from the driving instructor training does not differ from the average dropout rate for training within the re-integration of benefit recipients.
Het aantal uitvallers bij de opleiding rijinstructeur wijkt niet af van de gemiddelde uitval bij de opleidingen in het kader van de re-integratie van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over giftige gassen in vliegtuigen

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked the state secretary whether the Zembla broadcast on toxic gases in aircraft cabins and cockpits warranted further investigation, what was done after the 2010 broadcast, and whether the issue would be raised internationally. The government answered that EASA is primarily responsible, that prior inquiries found no grounds for new rules, that REACH analysis of TCP is scheduled for 2014, and that EASA will report semi-annually and Parliament will be informed of developments.
I note that various parties continue to want to be kept informed about developments regarding TCP.
Ik constateer dat er bij diverse partijen behoefte blijft om op de hoogte te blijven over de ontwikkelingen in het kader van TCP.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over misstanden bij rijscholen

An MP asked the minister about abuses at driving schools, including UWV training of instructors, transparency and oversight of driving school quality, which bodies tackle abuses, a complaints desk, and a new industry organisation. The minister answered that the market is free, that the CBR publishes pass rates, that tax, police, IBKI and ACM handle parts of the problem, and that complaints and a new industry body are matters for the branch itself.
I am of the opinion that a complaints desk for aggrieved students is a matter for the driving school branch itself.
Ik ben van menig dat een klachtenmeldpunt voor gedupeerde cursisten een zaak is van de rijschoolbranche zelf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes, Kuiken en Albert De Vries over het bericht “actie ANWB tegen tolvignet België

MPs asked the government about Belgium's planned toll vignette for Belgian roads, its effects on cross-border workers and Zeeland residents, and whether the minister had raised it with Belgium. The minister confirmed the plans for 2016, said the vignette would add costs but be manageable, and reported talks with Flemish and Benelux counterparts, promising to report further developments.
If this consultation shows that further developments on the vignette can be reported, I will of course inform you of them.
Mocht uit dit overleg blijken dat er nadere ontwikkelingen rond het vignet gemeld kunnen worden, dan zal ik u daarvan uiteraard op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Kuiken over het niet vernietigen van een bouwvergunning voor een geitenstal in Landerd (Noord-Brabant)

Three PvdA MPs asked why the Crown did not annul the municipality of Landerd's building permit for a goat barn despite the province of Noord-Brabant's request, and whether the expansion should be allowed on public health grounds. The minister replied that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, so annulment under the Constitution's Article 132 could not be applied, and that the decision takes no position on the desirability of the expansion or the provincial building freeze.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de vergoeding van luchtvaartmaatschappijen aan passagiers bij vertraging

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about airlines not compensating passengers for delays after a 2013 CJEU ruling, and about stricter sanctions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said airlines state they respect the ruling and the inspectorate sees this in practice, and announced fines as a new sanction regime.
For that reason, I already announced a change to the sanctions regime in my letter of 27 February 2013.
Om die reden heb ik bij brief van 27 februari 2013 reeds een wijziging van het sanctieregime aangekondigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de werking van het in-car alarmeringssysteem eCall, waarover bij hulpdiensten onduidelijkheid heerst

An MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether fire and emergency services are prepared for the in-car eCall system, whether it links directly to the 112 centres, whether 112 notifications will rise, and whether eCall triggers on every accident. The minister replied that no EU obligation exists yet, that the 112 responsibility lies with the Security and Justice ministry, that a direct 112 link is used in the HeERO project, that notifications will be limited initially, and that eCall will trigger only on serious crashes.
I would point out that responsibility for receiving and handling eCall emergency calls ("112 notifications") rests with my colleague at the Ministry of Security and Justice.

Ik wil u overigens aangeven dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontvangen en afhandelen van eCall noodoproepen («112-meldingen») bij mijn collega van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie berust.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over mogelijke onveiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether defects reported on the Turkish Airlines aircraft before the 2009 crash went unrepaired, and how the Inspectorate (ILT) checks defect reporting, inspection frequency and sanctions. The government denied unrepaired defects, said all reported defects are repaired, described the inspection regime and said sanctions for such findings target airlines.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over mogelijke onveiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether defects in aircraft are noticed but not reported or repaired, whether financial pressure on airlines could cause this, and whether an independent investigation or logbook checks would be undertaken. The state secretary said inspections find no evidence of unreported defects, that oversight cannot guarantee full compliance, and that no independent investigation or logbook check is warranted at present unless inspection outcomes give cause.
At airlines, everything is aimed at addressing possible problems as quickly as possible.
Bij luchtvaartmaatschappijen is alles erop gericht mogelijke problemen zo snel mogelijk aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Fokke over de berichtgeving dat het gebruik van statische verkeersmodellen zou kunnen leiden tot verkeerde beleidskeuzes

MPs Kuiken and Fokke asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about press reports that static traffic models could lead to wrong policy choices, and whether dynamic models should be used instead. The minister answered that static models underpin environmental measures for road projects and noise/air programmes, that dynamic models are used for traffic management and road design details, and that static models are more accurate for future traffic volumes while dynamic models are more accurate for flow details.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Kuiken over het niet afnemen van criminele winsten van henneptelers

MPs Recourt and Kuiken asked why the Public Prosecution Service reduced confiscation claims against cannabis growers in Breda, whether this reflected backlogs or poor case files, and how many other prosecutors have weak confiscation. Minister Opstelten answered that the claims were lowered because initial calculations of illegal gains were too high, denied backlog or horse-trading motives, and said no further investigation was needed, promising a 2012 target of 49 million euros which he expects to meet.
In the relevant cases the adjustments were necessary because the initial calculation of the confiscation amount was too high.
In de desbetreffende zaken waren de aanpassingen noodzakelijk door een te hoge initiële berekening van het ontnemingsbedrag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht ‘Weg-verbreding leeglopende A9 stuit op kritiek”

An MP asked the minister whether widening the A9 from four to ten lanes is still needed given falling traffic, and asked for a new cost-benefit analysis. The minister said traffic fell mainly due to a shift to the parallel A10, forecasts still expect growth to 2030, no new CPB study is needed, and the Amsterdam Zuidoost tunnel design has changed with an equivalent effect on the environment.
I attach importance to decisions taken with public support being implemented in line with the advice of the Elverding committee, and additional research is not needed for that.
Ik hecht eraan met draagvlak genomen besluiten uit te voeren conform de adviezen van de commissie Elverding en een aanvullend onderzoek is daarvoor niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over de onveilige situaties als gevolg van de inzet van niet gekwalificeerde Poolse en Hongaarse chauffeurs bij transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Wolbert and Kuiken asked the minister about unqualified Polish and Hungarian drivers transporting dangerous goods, following a ZEMBLA broadcast alleging certificates were bought without training. The minister replied that certificate oversight lies with the country of origin, that the ILT checks certificates and fines violations, and that the issue will be raised with member states and the Commission.
I am also willing to raise this issue with the member states concerned and the European Commission.
Ik ben ook bereid deze kwestie bij de betrokken lidstaten en de Europese Commissie aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over de staat van de Politieacademie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister about the Police Academy's deficit, its governance and budget approval, exam backlogs, examiner withdrawals and external training purchases by police forces. The minister answered that the supervisory board did not approve the 2012 budget over a financing risk, that a financial and operational audit and an improvement plan were ordered, that exam backlogs were largely cleared by August 2012, and that a Rekenkamer investigation was not warranted.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over budget voor wijkenaanpak voor de wijk Kalsdonk in Roosendaal

An MP asked whether national funds were given to Roosendaal for the Kalsdonk neighbourhood, what they aim at, and how residents' concerns about youth nuisance, drug dealing and benefit fraud were being handled. The minister confirmed EUR 1 million for a socio-economic programme plus EUR 100,000 for resident budgets, said monitoring is primarily by the municipal council with yearly progress reports to parliament, and said the municipality is responsible and no further national involvement is planned.
Tackling the problems is primarily a responsibility of the municipality.
De aanpak van de problematiek is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Kuiken over problemen bij de opleiding tot ambulancebroeder

MPs Jadnanansing and Kuiken asked why the sector requested the medical first-responder training but now cannot or will not offer enough internship places, and what will be done for students. The minister says student intake was reduced from 90 to 75, legal embedding of graduates' powers is under discussion with the sector, and the programme was added to the Stagefonds to fund internship places.
This is being discussed with the Ministry of Health, the universities of applied sciences, the hospitals and the ambulance sector, with the aim of resolving it as soon as possible.
Daarover wordt met het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, de hogescholen, de ziekenhuizen en de ambulancesector gesproken, met als doel op zo kort mogelijke termijn
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken met betrekking tot het niet langer in beslag nemen van scooters

An MP (PvdA) asked why police no longer seize tampered mopeds on a second offence, and requested seizure figures and enforcement intensity per region. The minister said the change only concerns registration-document impoundment to reduce administrative workload, that direct seizure still applies in dangerous cases or repeat offences within two years, and that the police and prosecution do not keep the requested statistics.
The police and the public prosecution service do not keep statistics on the reason for seizure, the number of scooters seized, or the eventual outcome.
Politie en OM houden geen statistieken bij van de aanleiding tot inbeslagname, het aantal in beslag genomen scooters en de uiteindelijke afloop.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over btw-heffing in de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg

MP Kuiken asks the health minister about a regional tax inspector's decision to treat cooperation and coordination funding in integrated primary care as VAT-liable, and whether this affects insurers and GPs. The minister refers to the Finance ministry's parallel answer, says current law and case law leave the inspector little choice, and states that talks with the state secretary of Finance on adjusting VAT treatment have started, with the Chamber to be informed.

As indicated in the answers to Ms Leijten's questions, the State Secretary for Finance is examining together with me and in consultation with the sector whether there are possibilities to adjust the VAT levy on the services concerned.

Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen van mevrouw Leijten is aangegeven, beziet de staatssecretaris van Financiën samen met mij en in overleg met de betrokken sector of er mogelijkheden zijn de btw-heffing ten aanzien van de in het geding zijnde diensten aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de commissie-Alders over selectiviteit op Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary about the Alders commission on selectivity at Schiphol, arguing it includes only KLM and questioning tariffs, competition and the slow relocation of airlines. The state secretary replied that the commission only tests how the shared vision on selectivity is applied, that KLM's role as home carrier justifies its place, and that no change to the commission's composition is needed.
For the formulated assignment to the commission chaired by Mr Alders, I refer you to the appendix.
Voor de geformuleerde opdracht aan de ingestelde commissie onder voorzitterschap van de heer Alders verwijs ik u naar de bijlage.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het gebruik van de Buitenveldertbaan

MP Kuiken asked about the use of the Buitenveldertbaan at Schiphol, whether it is used more than agreed under strict preferential runway use, and how transparent and enforceable the system is. The State Secretary replied that no maximum runway movements were agreed, that the 2011 figure of about 41,000 movements falls within the forecast range, that the new norms system is being evaluated and enforceability tested, and that the old enforcement points should not be retained as a back-up.
No agreements were made on a maximum number of landings or take-offs on a particular runway, so also not for the Buitenveldertbaan.
Er zijn geen afspraken gemaakt over het maximum aantal landingen of starts op een bepaalde baan, dus ook niet voor de Buitenveldertbaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de hoge administratievelastendruk bij fysiotherapeuten

An MP asked the health minister about the heavy administrative burden on physiotherapists, including whether insurers demand excessive patient data and whether this threatens patient confidentiality. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said insurers need clear criteria and some data for contracting and claim checks, noted automation can reduce the burden, and referred to earlier questions for the privacy issue.
Health insurers have a statutory duty to purchase care and to pay attention to the quality of the care they purchase.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een wettelijke plicht om zorg in te kopen en daarbij aandacht te besteden aan de kwaliteit van de zorg die zij inkopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het convenant ‘Uitvoering Havenvisie 2030’

An MP asked whether the Blankenburg tunnel is named as a required accessibility action in the Port Vision 2030 covenant the minister signed, and whether signing it is appropriate given the project is controversial. The minister replied that the tunnel is not named in the covenant, that the Rijk keeps the right to take differing positions on individual action points, and refused to withdraw the signature.
I will comply with that and will of course form my own judgement on it.
Ik zal daaraan voldoen en mij daar natuurlijk ook een oordeel over vormen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de Rotterdamsebaan

An MP asked the minister why the planned capacity of the Rotterdamsebaan was reduced from about 70,000 to 38,000 vehicles per day, and questioned weaving sections, budget feasibility, traffic reduction points and disclosure of the cost-benefit analysis. The minister attributed the reduction to inadequate absorption on the urban network, affirmed space and feasibility, and said the cost-benefit analysis is for the municipality and Stadsgewest to publish, as a regional/local project.
It is up to the municipality of The Hague and the Stadsgewest Haaglanden to publish it or not.
Het is aan de gemeente Den Haag en het Stadsgewest Haaglanden om deze al dan niet te publiceren.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de nieuwe sluis bij IJmuiden

MP Kuiken asked why the replacement of the Noordersluis at IJmuiden should be brought forward ten years, what economic justification exists, and whether Amsterdam can credibly pursue intercontinental container handling without harming Rotterdam. The minister answers that the early investment is a regional wish with costs borne by the region under a 2009 covenant, that a cost-benefit analysis supports it in two of three growth scenarios, and that container growth in Amsterdam is expected to be complementary to Rotterdam.
Given the agreed cost distribution, the MIRT projects up to 2020 therefore suffer no hindrance from the earlier construction of a new sea lock at IJmuiden.
Gezien de overeengekomen kostenverdeling ondervinden de MIRT-projecten tot 2020 dus geen enkele hinder van de eerdere aanleg van een nieuwe zeesluis in IJmuiden.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de MIRT-Verkenning Haaglanden c.q. de A4 Passage en Poorters & Inprikkers

An MP asked the minister for detailed traffic intensities and I/C ratios on Haaglanden road segments under the A4 Passage scenarios, plus questions on weaving sections, calamity scenarios, and model consistency. The minister referred to existing reports, declined exact I/C figures as spurious precision, deferred calamity analysis to the planning phase, and promised an integrated traffic analysis by 1 September 2012.
Exact I/C figures would suggest false precision.
Exacte I/C-cijfers zouden een schijnnauwkeurigheid suggereren.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de A13/16 en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding

An MP asked the minister for projected traffic intensities and I/C ratios on A13 and nearby junctions if the A13/16 link and Blankenburg tunnel were built. The minister replied with counts of road sections below the 0.9 congestion threshold under two scenarios and listed the sections at or above 0.9 in an annex.
With my letter of 19 June 2012 I already informed the House about the traffic calculations made for the A13/16 and the New Western Scheldt Crossing.
Met mijn brief van 19 juni 2012 (IENM/BSK-2012/94964) heb ik de Kamer reeds geïnformeerd over de gemaakte verkeersberekeningen voor de A13/16 en de Nieuwe Westelijke Oeververbinding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de status van MIRT-projecten

MP Kuiken asked the minister for a schematic overview of all MIRT and Infrastructure Fund projects by phase, budget, contracted amounts and prioritisation, with a 1 September 2012 reference date, and a reply by 16 August 2012. The minister refers to the MIRT projectenboek 2013 and the 2013 budget for the information, and declines to give a preview before then.
You will receive the information you requested in and with the 2013 budget. I do not wish to anticipate this now.
U ontvangt de door u gevraagde informatie in en bij de begroting 2013. Ik wil hier nu geen voorschot op nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de angst bij zorgmedewerkers om aangifte te doen

An MP asks the ministers of Justice and of Health whether healthcare workers fear reporting violence because their names are disclosed, and about the handling of reports filed under personnel numbers and why this is absent from the action plan. The Minister replies that anonymous or personnel-number reporting is possible, that a scheme for reporting on personnel numbers across the public sector is being developed, and that a letter with details will follow in September.

During the general consultations on safe working in healthcare of 23 May 2012 and on the safe public task of 5 June 2012 I promised that a scheme will be introduced enabling reporting under a personnel number.

Tijdens de algemeen overleggen veilig werken in de zorg van 23 mei 2012 en veilige publieke taak van 5 juni 2012 heb ik toegezegd dat er een regeling komt die het mogelijk maakt aangifte op nummer te doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over het vrijgeven van de tarieven in de mondzorg en het bericht dat tandartsen helemaal niet willen concurreren

An MP asks the minister about a report that dentists are unwilling to compete, including reluctance to place a crown for one-off patients under the free-tariff experiment in dental care. The minister says patients must be free to switch dentists and finds the consumer survey findings disappointing.
More freedom of choice for the patient is one of the objectives of the experiment.
Meer keuzevrijheid voor de patiënt is één van de doelstellingen van het experiment.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de A13-A16

An MP from the PvdA asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about traffic forecasts, tolling, congestion, the Terbregseplein tunnel options, environmental effects and air and noise limits for the A13/A16 motorway project. The minister answered that no congestion is expected on the affected routes, that a tunnel option was weighed against a fly-over, and that the government will meet legal air and noise standards.
From this it may be concluded that there are no routes on which congestion arises as a result of the construction of the A13/16.
Hieruit mag geconcludeerd worden, dat er geen trajecten zijn waarop ten gevolge van aanleg A13/16 congestie ontstaat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Groot over de berichtgeving over een eventuele verhoging van de kilometervergoeding

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Finance whether he knew of reports on raising the mileage allowance from 19 to 24 cents per km, what the budget effect would be, and whether he would seriously consider the ANWB's smart travel budget alternative. The state secretary confirmed awareness, stated a 5-cent increase would cost about 500 million euro in forgone revenue, and said he was positive about B50 plans but that the budget agreement now puts the emphasis on fiscal consolidation.
A rise in the tax-free mileage allowance of 5 cents results in a budgetary loss of about 500 million.
Een stijging van de onbelaste kilometervergoeding met 5 cent heeft een budgettaire derving van circa 500 miljoen als gevolg.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken over compensatie aan passagiers bij vertraging luchtvaart

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked whether airlines that refuse compensation for delays over three hours, cancellations or overbooking act unlawfully under EU Regulation 261/2004 and the Sturgeon ruling, and whether the state will enforce it. The state secretary answers that the Sturgeon ruling is binding, that the inspectorate enforces it but has paused new sanctions pending test cases and preliminary questions to the European Court, and that complaints are normally handled within six months.
For failing to comply with the Sturgeon ruling, the inspectorate has imposed a penalty order on each of four Dutch airlines.
Voor het niet naleven van het Sturgeon-arrest heeft de inspectie vier Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen elk een last onder dwangsom opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over vermeende kartelafspraken
