MP Kuiken asked the government about alleged cartel arrangements among oil companies on petrol prices, including a German investigation, whether it extends to the Netherlands, signs of cartel formation in Dutch fuel sales, and steps to lower pump prices. The minister said the German probe is limited to Germany, that NMa has no findings of cartel conduct in the Dutch market but will not comment on ongoing probes, that pricing patterns are for the NMa to assess, and listed tax and crude price factors and a planned tender-information measure.
It is for the NMa to assess whether patterns or conduct in the market point to possible cartel arrangements between the oil companies.
Het is aan de NMa om te beoordelen of patronen of gedragingen in de markt duiden op mogelijke kartelafspraken tussen de oliemaatschappijen.
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over belangen van huisartsen in de tabaksindustrie

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister about reports that the pension fund for GPs invests in the tobacco industry, whether the government knew of it, how much is invested, and whether this undermines doctors' credibility in fighting smoking. The minister replied that monitoring individual pension fund investments is not the government's task, that DNB supervises without disclosing fund-level data, and that investing in legal tobacco producers gives no reason for measures.
The law prohibits DNB from disclosing data on individual funds to me.
De wet verbiedt daarbij dat DNB gegevens over individuele fondsen aan mij kenbaar maakt.
Antwoord vragen Van der Veen en Kuiken over het feit dat tandartspatiënten te veel hebben betaald voor implantaten

PvdA MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister whether dental patients overpaid for implants because dentists did not pass on manufacturer discounts, and about related pricing, oversight and market concerns. The minister referred to earlier answers on the same questions, said prices for dental materials in the Netherlands are not clearly higher than in comparable countries, and reported no formal complaints about counterfeit products.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions on this matter from MPs Van Gerven and Leijten.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen terzake van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over het wegpesten van overspannen agenten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police forces push out officers suffering from PTSD, and whether the minister recognises the signals, sees friction between legal and medical aspects of PTSD, and shares the need for uniform policy. The minister referred to earlier answers on the related questions, said he wants a uniform approach across the police with a registration guideline and implementing rules in preparation, and announced a further research project on PTSD as an occupational illness.
Yes, I want the Dutch police to have a uniform approach to this kind of issue.
Ja, ik wil dat Politie Nederland een eenduidige aanpak heeft voor dit soort kwesties.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de juistheid van de verkeersveiligheidcijfers

An MP asked the minister whether the VIA road-safety statistics per municipality are reliable and how they differ from the ministry's figures, and asked her to comment on VIA's conclusions about speeding and unsafe municipalities. The minister said the ministry has no municipal breakdown of serious injuries, that the VIA differences stem from a different selection and an uplift factor, that she cannot judge VIA's conclusions, and that the ministry still considers its own picture of road safety accurate, launching a speed-limit campaign.
I cannot give a judgement on VIA's conclusions, because I do not have a breakdown of the number of seriously injured road users by municipality.
Over de conclusies van VIA kan ik geen oordeel geven, omdat ik niet over een uitsplitsing beschik van het aantal ernstig verkeersgewonden naar gemeenten
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over duidelijke, eenduidige en vindbare informatie over tekortschietende behandelaren

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister why psychotherapist Van Steijn, struck off as psychotherapist for malpractice, still appears as a health psychologist in the BIG register, and how IGZ and CIBG handled information and timing. The minister acknowledged the gap, said the law from 1 July 2012 will record such restrictions in the register, and said the IGZ dossier review will be awaited with results expected after the summer.

I share that view. The Act of 7 November 2011 amending the Individual Health Care Professions Act will require that restrictive orders issued by the IGZ are recorded in the BIG register from 1 July 2012.
Ik deel die mening. De Wet van 7 november 2011, houdende wijziging van de Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg
Antwoord vragen Bouwmeester en Kuiken over lange reistijd bij low budget vliegmaatschappijen

Two MPs asked whether low-cost airlines misleadingly advertise airports as central to the capital while the transport from those airports is long and costly, and whether this breaches consumer protection and creates unfair competition. The minister says the Consumentenautoriteit and courts can judge misleading advertising under Dutch civil code rules and the travel industry code, and that the Consumentenautoriteit has sufficient powers and means to act.
I leave the judgement on whether these specific cases involve misleading or unfair commercial practices to the supervisory authority and the courts.
Ik laat het oordeel of er in deze concrete gevallen sprake is van misleiding of een oneerlijke handelspraktijk over aan de toezichthouder en de rechter.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over de forse rekening die patiënten ontvangen door vrije tarieven in de mondzorg

An MP asked the health minister whether patients face high dental bills under free pricing, whether a consumer federation's finding that tandartsen charge more than insurers reimburse for most treatments is accurate, and what action will be taken. The minister said she relies on the NZa market scans, which show most prices within the conversion bandwidth, and that she maintains no co-payments within the basic package, with the NZa monitor due in June.
While I appreciate the various publications, I am primarily guided by the reports of the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
Met waardering die ik voor de diverse publicaties heb, laat ik mij primair leiden door de rapportages van de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa).
Antwoord vragen Kuiken met betrekking tot de aanrijdtijden in de gemeente Zundert

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police response times in Zundert, which allegedly exceeded the norm frequently in 2011, and whether the police would be closer to citizens and whether the minister would consult the mayor and force manager. The minister confirmed the figures, said the district as a whole meets the 15-minute norm, attributed most overruns to second or third-instance calls and the timing of the meldkamer, described a night-time and 24-hour emergency car in the area, and said force capacity allocation is the responsibility of the Regionaal College and the mayor rather than the minister.
Allocating police capacity within a regional force is a responsibility of the Regionaal College and the authority, not of the Minister of Security and Justice.

Het indelen van capaciteit bij de politie binnen een regiokorps is een verantwoordelijkheid van het Regionaal College en het gezag en geen verantwoordelijkheid van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over het beheer van belangrijke politiespullen

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a former police officer who kept police equipment after leaving service, and about how police administer issued and returned equipment. The minister said the former officer returned the items, that equipment administration is kept per force without a national protocol, and that the national police reform will simplify and standardise administration.
I consider it important to properly administer important police equipment within the new police organisation in order to prevent societal risks.
Ik acht het van belang om binnen de nieuwe politieorganisatie belangrijke politiespullen goed te administreren om maatschappelijke risico's te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marouch over het sluiten van de helft van de politiebureaus in Amsterdam

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the minister whether half of Amsterdam's police stations would close under the national police reorganisation and how this squares with promises of local presence and accessibility. The minister said plans were not yet fixed, that the national police will stay rooted locally, that online reporting is being expanded, and that accessibility is a matter of ongoing discussion with the local authority.
Statements about the possible closure of neighbourhood police stations are premature in relation to the national police.
Uitspraken over het mogelijk sluiten van wijkbureaus zijn prematuur in relatie tot de nationale politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch over problemen bij de vorming van de nationale politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Justice Minister about problems in forming the national police, including a technocratic approach, planning delays, local discretion, centralisation of support services and leadership. The minister rejects the technocracy claim, says the implementation and realisation plans will only be adopted after the law is published, and promises ongoing consultation and communication.
I have promised your House not to take irreversible steps before parliamentary approval of the bill.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten voor parlementaire goedkeuring van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken en Marcouch over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet door de politie

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported widespread violations of the Working Time Act by the police, including whether this amounts to overwork of officers and whether exemptions for special police units are being pursued. The Minister answered that about 180,000 violations were counted in the first half of 2011, that the problem is serious but not proof of systematic overwork given compensation rules, and that part of the issue lies in police pay regulations to be addressed in CAO negotiations, with a letter on the Inspectorate report promised.
The number the Telegraaf describes is therefore its own conclusion.
Het aantal dat de Telegraaf beschrijft, is daarmee een eigen conclusie.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over een dreigend tekort aan gediplomeerde technisch rechercheurs met kenmerk

MP Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a looming shortage of certified forensic technical detectives, including reports of backlogs in examinations at the Police Academy and EU rules on forensic expertise. The Minister replied that backlog agreements exist for all exams, that 2012 examinations are planned with no mandatory certifications at risk, and that EU impacts are not yet known pending an action plan due June 2013.
As I indicated in my answers to the parliamentary questions of 6 January 2012, agreements have been made on clearing backlogs in examinations at the Police Academy.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op de Kamervragen van 6 januari 2012 heb aangegeven, zijn er afspraken gemaakt over het wegwerken van achterstanden in de examinering bij de Politieacademie.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over problemen bij de examinering in het politieonderwijs

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the minister about exam chaos at the Police Academy, including whether budget cuts caused a shortage of examiners, delays for students, and whether unions had warned in advance. The minister replied that the shift to a new system of police staff serving as examiners within working hours caused a temporary shortage, delaying some exams with priority for final-year students, and that backlogs will be cleared by 1 August 2012.
I have agreed with the Police Academy's executive board that all backlogs will be resolved by 1 August 2012 at the latest.
Met het college van bestuur van de politieacademie afgesproken, dat alle achterstanden uiterlijk 1 augustus 2012 zullen zijn opgelost.
Antwoord vragen Berndsen en Kuiken over het bericht dat ‘politie getraumatiseerde agenten in de steek laat’

MPs Berndsen and Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a RTL report that police forces do not recognise or treat officers' psychological trauma, including court cases against officers and differing approaches to PTSD as an occupational illness. The Minister said the report troubled him, pointed to the Professional Resilience programme, and said he has asked police forces to apply one nationally uniform approach based on objective medical criteria and the NCvB registration guideline, with a further study announced.
I have therefore asked the force managers to conform to the registration guideline of the Dutch Centre for Occupational Diseases (NCvB) on PTSD.
Ik heb de korpsbeheerders daarom verzocht om zich te conformeren aan de registratierichtlijn van het Nederlands Centrum voor Beroepsziekten (NCvB) betreffende PTSS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat wijkverpleegkundigen goedkoper en beter zijn dan verpleeghuiszorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether research showing district nurses are cheaper and better than nursing-home care (44.7% lower costs in a comparison) holds, and whether more district nurses should be deployed. The state secretary answered that the 44.7% figure rests on a single-client financial comparison that cannot support general conclusions, that the NPCF/V&VN, ZonMw and BMC findings are broadly consistent, and that the NZa will issue a feasibility review before deciding on financing.
It should be clear that no general conclusions can be drawn from this.
Het moge duidelijk zijn dat hieruit geen algemene conclusies getrokken kunnen worden.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over maximumtarieven in de tandheelkundige zorg (ingezonden 19 december 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether insurers setting maximum dental fee reimbursements effectively replace the NZa in setting dental prices, whether this removes free pricing, and whether higher costs will be passed to insured persons via premiums and reduced basic care. The minister rejects that insurers are taking over the NZa's role, says the NZa's first estimate is a limited average price rise, declines to give an overview of current maximum reimbursements because they are in flux, and states she has no say over insurer premiums and does not intend to restrict basic dental care.
I prefer to inform you at a later time once the maximum reimbursements have stabilised more.
Ik geef er de voorkeur aan om u op een later tijdstip nader te informeren als de maximumvergoedingen meer gestabiliseerd zijn.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over falend toezicht door de IGZ (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the health minister whether, after a UMCG case where the IGZ failed to act, she would reconsider the PvdA's earlier call for independent investigation of the IGZ and have the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid conduct it. The minister answered that she will commission an external audit of the IGZ's organisation to check whether it can carry out its new supervisory vision, reporting to parliament in summer, but declined to assign the review to the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid.

To keep a close watch on whether the IGZ organisation is robust enough to carry out the supervisory vision and whether its processes and systems are sufficiently designed for this, I will have the IGZ organisation externally audited.

Om goed de vinger aan de pols te houden of de organisatie van de IGZ robuust genoeg is om de toezichtvisie uit te voeren en of de processen en systemen hierop voldoende zijn berekend, zal ik extern de organisatie van de IGZ laten doorlichten.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het ontbreken van goede mondzorg voor veel verpleeghuisbewoners (ingezonden 5 december

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about poor oral care in nursing homes, citing research that residents' teeth are rarely brushed and asking about inspection, training, and AWBZ spending. The state secretary acknowledged the risks, pointed to a guideline and training modules, said the Inspectorate may give attention to oral care in a short series of visits, and said spending data and effects of free-market dental tariffs are not yet known.
The inspectorate intends to give oral care extra attention as a specific theme in a short series of visits.
De inspectie is voornemens om mondzorg als specifiek thema in een korte serie bezoeken extra aandacht te geven.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een onderzoek naar het functioneren van het politiekorps Limburg-Zuid (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a visitation report finding that police force Limburg-Zuid was intellectually limited, including the chief's remarks about citizen dissatisfaction, its neighbourhood policing, internal accountability culture, and how visitations are used. The State Secretary answered that the chief's remarks were unfortunate but not meant as stated, that neighbourhood policing is adequate, that improvement initiatives are underway, and that visitation reports are routinely received.
I always receive the reports of the external visitation committee, together with the results of the force investigation and the police board's view on the visitation report.
Ik krijg de rapporten van de externe visitatiecommissie, samen met de resultaten van het korpsonderzoek en de visie van de korpsbeheerder op het visitatierapport altijd aangeboden.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Kuiken over het geven van een taakstraf na mishandeling agent

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why a Utrecht man who struck a police officer received a partly suspended 40-hour community service sentence, and whether the prosecution's demand was adequate. The minister said the prosecution had itself judged a partly unconditional prison sentence more appropriate, that it has appealed, and that a local group-based approach to the Terwijde neighbourhood is underway.
On reflection, according to the Public Prosecution Service, demanding a (partly) unconditional prison sentence would have been appropriate.
Bij nader inzien had volgens het Openbaar Ministerie het eisen van een (deels) onvoorwaardelijke gevangenisstraf in de rede gelegen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de wantoestanden bij het Landelijk Expertise Centrum Diversiteit (LECD) (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported crisis and misconduct at the police diversity centre LECD, including staff departures and whether the centre can contribute to police diversity. The minister said an independent investigation led by Marijnen is due by 1 March 2012 and would then inform parliament, restated the diversity policy framework, and referred back to that answer for the remaining questions.
The Police Academy is having an independent investigation carried out into the situation reported on by the programme Nieuwsuur.
De Politieacademie laat een onafhankelijk onderzoek verrichten naar de situatie waarover het programma Nieuwsuur heeft bericht.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een gerechtelijke uitspraak ten aanzien van ernstige woonoverlast en

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a court ruling on serious nuisance between neighbours and the use of cameras, and how government supports victims and equips municipalities. The ministers answered that the ruling is consistent with existing views on private camera surveillance, that existing instruments suffice, and that the CCV will be asked to add the case to its handbook and continue expert meetings.
I will, however, bring the court ruling to the attention of the Centre for Crime Prevention and Safety (CCV).
Wel zal ik de uitspraak van de rechter onder de aandacht brengen van het Centrum voor Criminaliteitspreventie en Veiligheid (CCV).
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verplichting dat tandartsen een factuur van tandtechniek moeten tonen (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

MP Kuiken asked the health minister why the NZa did not adopt her directive requiring dentists to show a technician invoice to patients, and instead only requires it on request, and whether the minister will force dentists to show it. Minister Schippers replied that she left the technical implementation to the NZa, that the NZa's operationalisation stays within her intent after consulting providers, insurers and the Consumentenbond, and that she will not change the rule.
I did not inform the House because there is no conflict between the NZa's interpretation and the intent of the condition I set.
Ik heb de Kamer niet geïnformeerd omdat geen sprake is van strijdigheid tussen de interpretatie van de NZa en de intentie van de door mij gestelde randvoorwaarde.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het schrappen van 300 voltijdbanen door het Amphia Ziekenhuis in Breda en Oosterhout (ingezonden 18 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about Amphia hospital's plan to cut 300 full-time jobs linked to market pressures, and whether this threatens care quality and staffing. The minister responded that the hospital is being proactive, that the required efficiency cut is mild (3.3% per year), and that care quality oversight is well organised, without addressing staffing levels in substance.
I nowhere read that cuts are made only or mainly to personnel.
Ik lees nergens dat er alleen of hoofdzakelijk op personeel wordt bezuinigd.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over misleidende voorlichting door SOS-arts (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP asks the health minister whether the SOS-arts organisation misleadingly presents itself as a provider of GP care, whether the NZa's 'care on call' policy rule allows basic doctors to deliver such care, and what this means for GP posts and access to care. The minister answers that the website wording is incorrect and has been agreed to be changed, that the NZa will monitor access and conduct a sector scan in 2012, and that quality requirements are enforced by the inspectorate.
I therefore note that the announcement on the SOS-arts website is not correct.
Ik constateer derhalve dat de aankondiging op de Website van SOS-arts niet correct is.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tussentijdse verzwaring van opleidingen voor MBO-deeltijdleerlingen (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

MPs Çelik and Kuiken asked the education minister whether MBO part-time courses were being made harder mid-course by adding mandatory subjects like mathematics ahead of centrally set exams. The minister called such mid-course additions undesirable, denied that the change stems from the 2013–2014 central exams, and pointed students to the institution's complaints procedure and the Ombudslijn mbo.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het anoniem aangifte doen doo

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked whether healthcare workers can file anonymous reports (aangifte) of violence, including by using staff numbers, and whether this should be rolled out nationally. The minister answered that the existing OM options suffice, staff-number reports are possible only exceptionally, and anonymity cannot always be guaranteed given defendants' rights to test testimony.
Because this concerns an exception to general policy, I do not wish to speak of a nationwide rollout.
Omdat het gaat om een uitzondering op het algemene beleid wil ik echter niet van een landelijke uitrol spreken.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over gevangene die in Breda wordt vergeten na een ziekenhuisbezoek (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice why a prisoner was left behind at a hospital in Breda after an operation, whether the blame for escape was unjust, and how often escapes during hospital visits occur. The state secretary answered that the prisoner left the hospital on his own without waiting for escort, was placed in isolation for two weeks, that two escapes during hospital visits occurred in 2011 so far, and that such incidents are discussed nationally to learn lessons.
If incidents like this still occur, I consider it important that lessons are drawn across the sector.
Indien zich toch incidenten zoals deze voordoen vind ik het belangrijk dat hier sectorbreed lering uit wordt getrokken.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toelaten van buitenlandse artsen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the health minister about the BIG-register entry of a British-qualified paediatrician, whether recent rule changes exclude such doctors on nationality grounds, and about the shortage of paediatricians. The minister replies that the shortened procedure was dropped because EU law no longer allowed it for non-EEA diploma holders, that the decision concerns the diploma origin rather than nationality, and that assessment procedures should be client-friendly and as short as possible.
Recognition of professional qualifications is not about the nationality of the doctor but about the origin of the medical diploma.
Bij de erkenning van de beroepskwalificaties gaat het niet om de nationaliteit van de arts, maar om de herkomst van het artsdiploma.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de afwezigheid van een vacature voor medewerker dieren politie bij het KLPD (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a KLPD vacancy page said no vacancy could be filled because the duties of animal police were unknown, and whether 500 animal police staff were needed. The minister acknowledged the website text was outdated and replaced, stated no open applications were received, and said animal police is a priority within the operational strength available for all police tasks.
The text on the KLPD website is outdated and has since been replaced by a current text.
De tekst op de website van het KLPD is achterhaald en inmiddels vervangen door een actuele tekst.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de fysieke en mentale weerbaarheid van politieagenten (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Berndsen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police officers' physical and mental resilience, including officers not intervening in risky situations, training, fear of being held accountable for force, rostering, and support for injured officers. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's concerns stem from 2009 and are being checked, that an action programme with a 32-hour training element per officer is planned for completion by 2014, and that rostering and medal policy are being examined.
I expect that by 2014 all police officers can have been trained in the new way.
Ik verwacht dat in 2014 alle politieambtenaren op de nieuwe wijze getraind kunnen zijn

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het alleen inzetten van «animalcops» voor huisdieren (ingezonden 7 o

MPs Kuiken and Van Dekken asked whether the 500 animal cops (dierenpolitie) would be deployed only for pet abuse and not for agricultural animals, and questioned whether this justified such capacity given other priorities. The minister replied that the dierenpolitie focuses mainly on animal abuse and neglect, that inspectorates keep responsibility for farm animals, and that police capacity covers all national priorities with monitoring planned.
On 24 October I sent your House the dierenpolitie memorandum, the animal enforcement cooperation covenant and the animal assistance covenant.
Op 24 oktober zond ik uw Kamer de nota dierenpolitie, het convenant samenwerking dierenhandhaving en het convenant dierenhulpverlening.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de dreigende leegloop van de politieacademies (ingezonden 14 september 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police trainees' salaries were cut by 18-22% from July 2011, possibly discouraging enrolment and increasing dropout, and how this fits with recruitment targets. The minister answered that the cut follows from the 2010 package deal with police unions, was foreseeable through recruitment information, may cause limited pay differences where korpsen apply maatwerk, and that police remain attractive and recruitment targets are being pursued.
To the extent that other differences have arisen within the korpsen, I have again pointed out to the korpsen that remuneration must take place in accordance with the applicable regulations.
Voor zover er binnen de korpsen andersoortige verschillen zijn ontstaan heb ik de korpsen er nogmaals op gewezen dat de salariëring conform de geldende regelgeving moet plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over hoge tandartskosten (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about high dental costs, including the expected price rises after dental prices were liberalised on 1 January 2012, the lack of patient information on technical material costs, and price differences from implant materials. The minister said the NZa will monitor prices during the experiment, sees no need for extra measures beyond the existing quote obligation, and points to insurance policy terms for reimbursement information.
During the experiment with free price setting, the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa) will closely monitor price developments in dental care and report to me.
Tijdens het experiment met de vrije prijsvorming zal de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) de prijsontwikkeling in de mondzorg gedegen monitoren en mij daarover rapporteren.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toekomstige beloning van de huidige korpschefs (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether high police officers who lose their top posts keep their pay under the new national police, and how this relates to regional chiefs earning less. The minister replied that these officials keep pay through the police legal-status safety net but not all allowances, that a new, simpler and more modest pay arrangement for the police top is being negotiated, and that the reorganisation will reduce top management.
I will have to enter into negotiations with the police unions for this. It is my intention to considerably simplify and moderate that new policy.
Ik zal hiervoor in onderhandeling moeten treden met de politiebonden. Het is mijn voornemen om dat nieuwe beleid aanzienlijk te vereenvoudigen en te versoberen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, welzijn en Sport over de manier waarop 12 000 extra handen aan het bed komen (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary how the 12,000 extra care workers would be realised, monitored and financed, and whether the funds would reach frontline care rather than risk reserves or management, plus questions on training, care culture and staff qualifications. The state secretary answered that a convenant with insurers and employers sets the target, progress will be tracked via the labour-market research programme with annual reporting, funds flow through regular contracting under which care offices can intervene, and training and culture change are left largely to institutions.
On progress I will inform your House annually in the labour market letter.
Over de voortgang zal ik uw Kamer jaarlijks in de arbeidsmarktbrief informeren.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geweld tegen de politie (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Interior about rising violence against police, police use of firearms, calls to widen police force powers, and EU comparisons. The minister answered that victimisation has stayed high with a shift from physical violence to intimidation, that firearm use with injury has not increased, that no broader force powers are needed, and that EU countries are broadly similar.
Although there is no national registration of police firearm use, research shows that police firearm use resulting in injury has not increased.
Hoewel er geen landelijke registratie is van het vuurwapengebruik door de politie blijkt uit onderzoek 3 dat het vuurwapengebruik – met letsel tot gevolg – door de politie niet is toegenomen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Bredase aanbesteding van hulp in de huishouding in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteu

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport about Breda's price-focused tender for home help under the Wmo, including job losses, continuity of care, lower pay for new staff, and alfacheques. The state secretary said the municipality may set quality requirements and let the market price services, pointed to the staff-transfer clause and the VVT collective agreement, and found no reason for concern about alfacheques.
I am closely following the developments in Breda.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen in Breda nauwgezet.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uitgestelde behandelingen door hoge tandartskosten (ingezonden 2 september 2011).

MP Kuiken asks the health minister about reports that high dental costs and thin insurance cause people to postpone crowns, bridges and implants, and about the effects, price setting and government role. The minister says patients are primarily responsible for dental care and can insure themselves, that lab material prices fall outside the Wmg and are set by the dental technology industry, and that the government kept the free youth dental package.
I am not aware to what extent people postpone dental treatments because of high tariffs.
Het is mij niet bekend in hoeverre mensen tandheelkundige behandelingen vanwege hoge tarieven uitstellen.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het anoniem melden van misstanden door zorgpersoneel aan de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ing

MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister about the underreporting of patient-safety incidents by hospital staff and whether anonymous complaints should be investigated individually by the IGZ inspectorate. The minister acknowledged underreporting, pointed to existing hospital reporting systems and the whistleblower scheme, and said the IGZ investigates anonymous reports only when serious risk is suspected, otherwise using them to detect structural problems.
In all other cases, anonymous reports are primarily used to identify patterns pointing to structural shortcomings in healthcare.
In alle andere gevallen worden anonieme meldingen primair gebruikt om patronen te herkennen die wijzen op structurele tekortkomingen in de zorg.

Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de korting op het huisartsenbudget na overschrijding bij de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

MP Kuiken asks the minister how the €70 million overrun on integrated primary care in 2010 was calculated, whether the €35 million clawback via the GP tariffs is fair and delays integrated care, and why GP budgets are cut while hospital and specialist overruns are largely spared. The minister defends the calculation from CVZ data, argues GPs account for most of the integrated care spending, says the clawback is necessary given fiscal pressure, and promises to show integrated primary care as a separate budget line from the 2012 budget.
However, integrated primary care will from now on no longer be presented as part of the GP framework.
Wel zal voortaan de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg niet als onderdeel van het huisartsenkader worden weergegeven.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bedreigen en wegpesten van een lesbisch stel uit Haarlem (ingezonden 8 aug

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Education, Culture and Science about the threats and harassment of a lesbian couple in Haarlem, including whether police had been contacted over 20 times, whether such relocations are common, and whether a specific police code and a hate-crimes provision should be introduced. The minister answered that police recorded reports, six complaints were filed, two cases were sent to the prosecutor, and the municipality's mediation failed, while the government opposed a separate hate-crimes article and pointed to existing sentencing guidelines and planned measures.
There are however no concrete figures available showing how often this occurs.
Er zijn evenwel geen concrete cijfers beschikbaar waaruit blijkt hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stranden van de ketenzorg (ingezonden augustus 2011).

An MP asks the health minister how to respond to reports that contracting of chronic care (ketenzorg) by care groups is stalling with insurers, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledges problems with COPD and VRM contracting, says she regards integrated care as important, will decide on ending the transitional dual-funding period after a 2012 evaluation, and notes no current cost data are available.
Based in part on that evaluation, I will decide whether or not to end the transitional situation.
Mede op basis van die evaluatie zal ik een besluit nemen over het al dan niet eindigen van de overgangssituatie.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en van Dam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de verminderde bereikbaarheid van alarmnummer 112 en het niet functioneren van C2000 in de regio Rotterdam (ingezonden 2

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reduced reachability of emergency number 112 and failure of the C2000 network in the Rotterdam region on 27 July 2011. The minister answered that 112 itself remained reachable, the outage affected KPN customers in two safety regions, the cause is under investigation, and the Inspectorate was asked to examine the telecom infrastructure.

Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het stopzetten van het onderzoeksprogramma Politie en Wetenschap en de toekomst van het wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar

Two MPs from the Labour party asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he plans to end the independent Police and Science research programme and move its work into the Police Academy and WODC, and about the budget and independence of police research. The Minister denied ending the programme outright, said he will replace the Commission with an independent Police Knowledge Council, keep independent allocation of research funds, and stressed the research budget will follow demonstrated need without a cut as the primary aim.
My proposal is to merge the Police and Science Commission into a new independent Police Knowledge Council.
Mijn voorstel is om de Commissie Politie en Wetenschap op te laten gaan in een nieuwe onafhankelijke Politiekennisraad.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het waarborgen van de veiligheid bij het opstellen van dekkings- en spreidingsplannen voor de brandweer en de keuze voo

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch ask the Minister of Security and Justice how safety is guaranteed when fire service coverage and dispersal plans are drawn up, including variable vehicle crewing and deviations from response times. The minister replies that no single national model yet exists, that regions remain responsible for deviations, and that an IOOV study on actual response times will report by end 2011.
To get a picture of response times in the Netherlands, a study of actual response times and their (administrative) deviations will be carried out on behalf of my Ministry and the Security Council.

Om een beeld te krijgen van de opkomsttijden in Nederland komt er, in opdracht van mijn Ministerie en het veiligheidsberaad, een onderzoek naar de daadwerkelijk gerealiseerde opkomsttijden en de (bestuurlijke) afwijking hiervan.
Vragen van de leden Arib en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over toegenomen gebitsverwaarlozing onder peuters en kleuters (ingezonden 23 mei 2011).

MPs Arib and Kuiken asked the health minister about rising tooth decay among toddlers and young children, including reports of 700 children in the Utrecht region under anaesthesia for dental treatment, and whether cuts by municipal health services contributed. The minister called it a worrying trend, stressed parents' primary responsibility, pointed to existing coverage, new dental guidelines and prevention codes, said no waiting-list figures are held, saw no evidence that GGD cuts played a role, and promised further inventories and first results of a study.
I do not have such figures.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke cijfers.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over medische dossiers op mobiele telefoons (ingezonden 19 mei 2011).

An MP asked the health minister whether patient-portal systems like Medlook, which offer medical records on the internet and mobile phones as an alternative to the EPD, comply with the WGBO and Wbp, how their security and patient information are overseen, and whether the privacy regulator reassessed Medlook after 2001. The minister answered that Wbp applies given identifiability, the CBP supervises compliance, providers must meet current security standards, and the CBP has not reassessed Medlook since 2001, leaving that to the CBP.
The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises compliance with the Wbp, and supervision of Medlook's compliance falls under that.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt toezicht op de naleving van de Wbp, daar valt het toezicht op de naleving door Medlook onder.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dementiezorg betere opleiding vergt (ingezonden 18 april 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister whether dementia care institutions prioritise small-scale housing over staff training, and whether budget cuts are lowering staff education levels, and how this fits the government's plans to invest in elderly care. The state secretary denied a known causal link, pointed to ongoing Nivel research due end 2011 and to government investment in long-term care staffing and training.
A study is currently under way, partly at the request of the House of Representatives, into the education level of care staff and the quality of care in nursing and residential homes.
Momenteel is, mede vanuit een vraag van de Tweede Kamer, een onderzoek gaande naar het opleidingsniveau van zorgpersoneel en de kwaliteit van zorgverlening in verzorgings- en verpleeghuizen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het in dienst nemen van oudere politieagenten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether physical entry requirements for police recruits should differ by age, following a report recommending an older police force. The minister said no age differentiation currently exists, that the Police Academy is analysing age-differentiated norm times for the physical test due for introduction around summer 2011, and that other selection criteria apply equally to all candidates.
The objective is to introduce the new norm times for the physical motor test around the summer.
Doelstelling is om de nieuwe normtijden voor het fysiek motorisch onderzoek rond de zomer in te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het schrappen van brandweerwagens (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the reduction of fire engines and volunteer firefighters in the Midden- and West-Brabant safety region, and whether this follows from a national coverage plan. The minister answered that the reduction results from a regional risk profile and coverage plan approved by the regional board, that response times stay within legal norms, and that the government is not responsible for the operational decisions.
The board of the MWB safety region will make choices and decisions on substantive grounds.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio MWB zal op inhoudelijke gronden keuzen maken en besluiten nemen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over risico’s door uitzendkrachten op ambulances (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the health minister about risks from temp agency staff and unqualified nurses driving ambulances, including whether response-time norms are affected. The minister said AZN sees adequate training safeguards, RAV services are responsible for staffing, unqualified staff are not permitted, and the IGZ has been asked to stay alert without a dedicated investigation yet.
I have asked the IGZ to be extra alert in the coming period to signals from the field or sector that may point to deficient care or risks that norms and agreements are not being met.

Ik heb aan de IGZ gevraagd om in de komende periode extra alert te zijn op signalen uit het veld of de sector die kunnen wijzen op tekortschietende zorg of risico’s dat normen en afspraken niet worden gehaald.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport inzake het functioneren van een vaatchirurg (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Van der Veen asked the health minister why the inspectorate had not yet referred vascular surgeon H to the disciplinary tribunal, and what happened to the commitment to push for a European blacklist of dysfunctional doctors. The minister replied that the inspectorate would decide on measures by end April 2011 after its investigation, and that European efforts for such a list have not yet succeeded due to system differences and privacy concerns, with the issue to be raised again at an EU health council.
Based on the findings and a still-to-be-held conversation with the vascular surgeon himself, the IGZ will determine by end April 2011 whether, and if so which, measures are appropriate.
Op basis van de bevindingen en een nog te houden gesprek met de vaatchirurg zelf, bepaalt de IGZ voor eind april 2011 of, en zo ja welke, maatregelen passend zijn.

Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problematiek van autistische kinderen en kinderen met een laag IQ (ingezon

MPs Bouwmeester and Kuiken asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about autistic youths and youths with low IQ in contact with police and detention, including whether better recognition, diagnosis and tailored police approaches are needed and how to prevent recidivism and fragmented care. The minister answered that recognition training helps but cannot be shown to prevent such incidents, that police do not develop policy for specific disorders, and that municipalities will be responsible for integrated, preventive care under decentralisation.
No policy is being made for specific disorders or limitations.
Er wordt geen beleid gemaakt voor specifieke stoornissen of beperkingen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet werken van het politiecommunicatiesysteem C2000 (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the C2000 police communication mast on the Essenburgsingel in Rotterdam is still not fully working, whether it is needed at that location, and whether that creates unsafe situations in the city centre. The minister replied that the mast has been operational since November 2009 and covers the Blijdorp area, that the antenna for the city centre is not yet switched on (expected in May), that no equivalent alternative locations exist, and that the central-city coverage improvement requires a package of technical measures.
Given the location of the other installed antenna sites, no alternative locations are available for this site that would provide equivalent coverage for the Rotterdam city centre.

Er zijn – gezien de locatie van de overige geplaatste opstelpunten – geen alternatieve locaties voor dit opstelpunt beschikbaar die een gelijkwaardige dekking voor de binnenstad van Rotterdam opleveren.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problemen bij de beheerder van elektronische patiëntendossiers (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

The MP asks the minister about the bankruptcy of ICT firm InfoTechnology, which manages 1.5 to 2 million electronic patient records, covering continuity, data loss, privacy, tax authority knowledge, and certification. The minister answers that continuity is adequately safeguarded, that contractual arrangements are the healthcare providers' responsibility, that no guarantees against bankruptcy are possible, and that Nictiz is studying contractual continuity requirements.
As said, this is the responsibility of the healthcare provider itself.
Zoals gezegd is dit de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder zelf.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de administratieve lasten van commercieel getinte Wob-verzoeken (ingez

MPs Kuiken and Heijnen asked whether commercial FOI (Wob) requests drain scarce police capacity and what the government would do about it. The minister said he has no overview of Wob request purposes, that the Wob lacks a proportionality test, and promised a letter on curbing abuse and reducing police workload.
As previously promised to the House, I will send you a letter shortly with proposals to prevent improper use of the Wob.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer toegezegd, stuur ik u op korte termijn een brief met daarin voorstellen om oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdovingen door tandartsen (ingezonden 20 december 2010).

MP Kuiken asked the health minister about a TV report showing patients were often not informed of anaesthetic side effects by dentists and that medical histories were not reliably taken, and asked about data, WGBO compliance, drug choice and inspection. The minister agreed this is worrying, pointed to inspection of anamnesis, promised to explore mandatory signage in waiting rooms on dentists' qualifications, and said inspection capacity is being expanded.
After consultation with the Inspector-General, I have decided to expand the inspectorate's capacity for this care domain.
Heb ik na overleg met de Inspecteur-Generaal besloten de capaciteit bij de inspectie voor dit zorgdomein uit te breiden.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toegenomen geneesmiddelengebruik onder kinderen en jongeren (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

MPs Van der Veen and Kuiken asked the health minister about rising prescription medicine use among children and young people, its guidelines, medical training, and industry responsibility for paediatric research. The minister called the rise partly positive, said the Inspectorate may be asked to investigate diagnosis, left guidelines to professional groups, noted paediatric drug research programmes, and committed to set up a ZonMw programme.
I am considering asking the Health Care Inspectorate to carry out targeted research in this area.
Ik overweeg om de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg te vragen op dit terrein gericht onderzoek te gaan doen.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch, Recourt en Kuiken (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over onbevoegde hulpofficieren bij de politie (ingezonden 18 november 2010).

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about unauthorised police auxiliary officers (hulpofficieren) and the damage to police authority, causes, consequences for criminal cases and evidence. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained certification lapses and procedural causes, reported five criminal investigations, and explained that consequences for cases depend on circumstances and that the inventory is still ongoing.
It is necessary to first await the outcomes of the national inventory by the police before this question can be answered.
Het is noodzakelijk om eerst de uitkomsten van de landelijke inventarisatie door de politie af te wachten voordat op deze vraag antwoord kan worden gegeven.
Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over ontwikkelingen nieuwe zeeverkeerscentrale (Ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

Two MPs asked the minister about preparations for a new sea traffic control centre on Terschelling and the risks of removing human lookouts at lighthouses. The state secretary confirmed that human observation at the Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog lighthouses will be retained after the centre opens and that no decisions on lighthouse staffing will be taken before a promised evaluation is discussed in parliament.
Therefore I hereby undertake that human observation at both lighthouses (Terschelling and Schiermonnikoog) will be retained, even after the Wadden Sea sea traffic control centre is in operation.
Daarom zeg ik u hierbij toe dat het menselijk oog op beide vuurtorens (Terschelling en Schiermonnikoog) behouden blijft, ook nadat de zeeverkeerscentrale Waddenzee in werking is.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over zelfmoord onder politieagenten (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about rising psychosocial complaints and suicides among police officers, and whether mental resilience problems are linked to leadership and staffing. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to a national resilience programme, cooperation with Defence on a mental shield, further research into suicides, and a commitment to maximum operational strength.
At this moment I do not yet have insight into the extent of the problem.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen inzicht in de omvang van het probleem.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toegankelijkheid van privacygevoelige informatie voor derden, waaronder particuliere recherchebureaus (ingezonden 2 n

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how easily private investigators and others can obtain privacy-sensitive information, and whether government agencies commission such methods. The state secretary replied that government officials using such methods would commit crimes, that private actors face criminal and data-protection rules rather than the Code of Criminal Procedure, and that the Data Protection Authority provides guidance and awareness-raising.
Vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het wegpesten van homo’s (ingezonden 25 oktober 2010).

MPs Marcouch and Kuiken asked the Minister of Security and Justice about harassment and violence against gay people, including forced relocation of victims, low reporting and clearance rates, school safety, and whether the mayor of Utrecht used group liability or undercover tools. The minister replied that the government protects victims and pursues perpetrators, that evidentiary problems limit prosecutions, that no national clearance data exist yet, and that police actions in the Utrecht case were sufficient, while promising a letter on reporting policy.
I will re-examine willingness to report and the possibility of (limited) anonymous reporting with the relevant parties, such as municipalities (VNG) and the police.
Ik zal de aangiftebereidheid en de mogelijkheid om (beperkt) anoniem aangifte te doen met de relevante spelers, zoals gemeenten (VNG) en politie, nog eens tegen het licht houden.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de toename van de inzet van gemeentelijke toezichthouders (ingezonden 2 november 2010).

MP Kuiken asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether municipalities increasingly deploy their own enforcement officers in place of police, and asks about the scale, costs and spread of this trend, plus related questions on uniforms, equipment, information sharing and police core tasks. The minister says municipalities have their own enforcement responsibility, denies a transfer of police tasks, promises a letter with exploration results and gives partial information on capacity while stating that costs cannot yet be reliably reported.
Within the exploration, not enough municipalities were able to separate the costs they incur for supervision and enforcement from other safety-related costs.
Binnen de verkenning waren niet voldoende gemeenten in staat om de kosten die zij maken voor toezicht en handhaving los te koppelen van andere kosten met betrekking tot veiligheid.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over geweldsincidenten in Eindhoven (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two Labour MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about drug-related violence in Eindhoven, whether it is a wider problem, whether police capacity and the new budget system will help, whether coffeeshops should grow their own cannabis, and whether fragmented governance caused the situation. The minister answered that he shares the concern, set up a multi-agency Taskforce, stressed an integrated approach with RIEC's, said the new budget allocation is not yet quantified, and rejected supply controls and coffeeshop home-growing as solutions.
Specifically for the Brabant situation, a Taskforce has been set up that will ensure the administrative and judicial approach to organised crime there is intensified immediately.
Specifiek voor de Brabantse situatie is een Taskforce ingesteld die ervoor zal zorgen dat de bestuurlijke en justitiële aanpak van de georganiseerde misdaad aldaar per direct wordt geïntensiveerd.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wolbert (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over geweld tegen verpleegkundigen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Wolbert asked ministers about a survey showing high levels of aggression against nurses, what hospitals do to train staff and share best practice, why nurses may leave, and why threatened nurses often do not file police reports. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Arbo law, the Veilige Zorg project, a planned Expertisecentrum VPT, and an information brochure to encourage reporting.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over flitspalen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Dijksma asked whether new digital speed cameras can detect modern motorcycles, whether the government knew of the problem when buying them, and whether it would consult Flemish authorities and keep enforcing motorcycle speed limits. The minister answered that all vehicles including the newest motorcycles can be detected, that detection is monitored with suppliers, and that a separate motorcycle safety action plan has been sent to parliament.
Yes, the newest generation of motorcycles can also be detected by the new digital speed cameras.
Antwoord 2 Nee, ook de nieuwste generatie motoren kan herkend worden door nieuwe – digitale – flitspalen.

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Van Dekken en Kuiken (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de brandveiligheid van veestallen (ingezo

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the 2010 report on barn fires, its high number of fires and animal deaths, and whether a fire-safety action plan and specific Bouwbesluit requirements would follow. The state secretary replied that he shares concern, that talks with the Dierenbescherming and LTO are ongoing, and that possible follow-up actions will be announced by year-end.
It is expected that you will be informed at the end of this year about possible follow-up actions that should contribute to better and more prevention of barn fires.
Naar verwachting zult u aan het einde van dit jaar worden geïnformeerd over de mogelijke vervolgacties die moeten bijdragen aan het meer en beter voorkomen van brand in stallen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de effecten van het verspreiden van politieberichten (ingezonden 13 september 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Recourt asked whether police broadcasts about escapees and tips from the Groep Opsporing Onttrekkingen hamper investigations and whether policy should change. The ministers acknowledged that tips can slow searches and rejected a policy change, noting the Openbaar Ministerie's recent guideline, while separating investigative appeals from public-awareness information.
There is no reason to change the policy.
Er is geen aanleiding het beleid te wijzigen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Recourt beiden (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over onderzoek naar het privéleven van politici, het optreden van particuliere ond

Two PvdA MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about private investigators who looked into politicians' private lives, the clients behind them, and whether the government was involved or enforcement was adequate. The minister said such research is not per se unlawful, that a 2003 criminal probe found only summary notes and no client identities, that prosecution of clients depended on evidence (five suspects were discharged on professional secrecy grounds), and that supervision of these agencies is handled by police and the privacy regulator.
The Public Prosecution Service therefore does not hold information that could lead to identifying the client(s) of the research into politicians' private lives.
Het Openbaar Ministerie beschikt derhalve niet over informatie die kan leiden tot identificatie van de opdrachtgever(s) van het onderzoek naar het privéleven van politici.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken, Recourt en Spekman (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over het opslaan van gestolen of gevaarlijke goederen in professionele opslagplaatsen (i

PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers whether professional storage firms are a hub for stolen or hazardous goods and whether investigative and fire services have enough access to them. The minister said there is no evidence of structural use by criminals, sees no need for a national inquiry or a new inspection power, considers entry without suspicion undesirable for privacy reasons, and rejects extra liability for landlords.
In my view, investigative bodies would intrude too far into citizens' private lives if they could enter and search storage rooms without cause.
Naar mijn mening treden onderzoeksinstanties in te grote mate in de persoonlijke levenssfeer van burgers als er zonder aanleiding opslagruimtes kunnen worden betreden en doorzocht.
Vragen van het lid Kuiken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geweld tegen brandweervrijwilligers (ingezonden 13 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the State Secretary about reported rising violence against volunteer firefighters, the inconsistent data, low subsidy uptake and whether volunteer numbers are falling. The minister acknowledges high victimisation rates, admits no national registration exists, lists coordination and prevention measures, and says volunteer numbers have risen since 2008.
National registration of aggression and violence against firefighters is not available either at the employer and police reporting level or at the police complaint level.
Landelijke registratie van agressie en geweld tegen brandweerlieden is noch bij werkgever en politie op meldingsniveau noch bij de politie op aangifteniveau beschikbaar.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de minister van Landbouw, Natuurbeheer en Voedselkwaliteit over bestrijding van natuurbranden (i

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked whether nature management conflicts with fire prevention and suppression, following criticism from fire services that current forest management increases the risk of large fires. The minister answered that the relation is complex: the shift from conifer to broadleaf forest has reduced fire risk, road closures may hamper firefighting, and relevant studies (NIFV, IOOV) are ongoing with conclusions pending.
No central registration is available of the state of maintenance of firebreaks in forest and nature areas in the Netherlands.
Er is geen centrale registratie beschikbaar van de staat van onderhoud van brandgangen in bos- en natuurterreinen in Nederland.
Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP) en Kuiken (PvdA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over overlast van arbeidsmigranten op bungalowpark Patersven te Zundert (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

MPs Karabulut and Kuiken asked the minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration about nuisance caused by migrant workers housed at the Patersven bungalow park in Zundert, and about enforcement, inspections, legalisation and housing standards. The minister answered that the park's owners' association and the municipality are primarily responsible, that a VROM-Inspectie investigation is not opportune, and that a migrant-worker practice team could be discussed with the parties.
An investigation by the VROM-Inspectie is not something I consider opportune. The municipality is in the first instance responsible for such an investigation.
Een onderzoek door de VROM-Inspectie acht ik niet opportuun. De gemeente is in eerste instantie verantwoordelijk voor een dergelijk onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over berichtgeving dat de AIVD aangeeft dat universiteiten op

Two MPs asked the ministers of Education and of the Interior whether they had noted AIVD warnings that universities should watch for foreign students possibly spying, and how universities could detect such espionage. The minister answered that the government takes the AIVD signal seriously and is formulating a response, that the AIVD has consulted universities, that identifying espionage is not a core university task, and that the response will address follow-up on the report's recommendations.
The cabinet takes this signal from the AIVD report 'Vulnerability Analysis Espionage' and the Ministry of the Interior seriously and is therefore formulating a response to this report.

Het kabinet neemt dit signaal uit het rapport «Kwetsbaarheidsanalyse Spionage» van de AIVD en het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties serieus en is dan ook bezig met het formuleren van een reactie op dit rapport.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over bestrijding van natuurbranden (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Heijnen asked the Minister of Interior about the firefighting of nature fires, including whether the brigades are equipped, whether volunteers and Defence can help, and whether there is a shortage of material. The state secretary answered that risk-calculation methods are unsuitable and a new model is being studied, that the Inspectorate will investigate preparedness and material shortages with a report expected in autumn 2010, and that Defence can be requested for military assistance.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over het wegpesten van een homostel uit hun huis (ingezonden 15 juni

MPs Kuiken and Spekman asked ministers whether harassment and nuisance against a gay couple in Leidsche Rijn, Utrecht, which led them to move out, should be tackled more strictly, whether existing legal instruments suffice, and what steps Utrecht has taken. The government answered that municipalities, police and justice are jointly responding, that the covert nature of the conduct makes evidence hard to gather, and that a new nuisance handbook and expanded powers for mayors are available.
It is regrettable that matters have escalated to the point where the victims feel compelled to move out.
Het is te betreuren dat het zo hoog is opgelopen dat de gedupeerden zich genoodzaakt voelen te gaan verhuizen.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over het gebruik van het kentekenregistratiesysteem ANPR voor strafrechtelijk onderzoek (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MPs Recourt and Kuiken asked the Minister of Justice about a Leeuwarden appeal court ruling that ANPR plate-scanning data retained as 'no hits' could not be used as criminal evidence, and whether the court's limits should be followed. The minister said court rulings must be respected, that police no longer keep no-hit data, and that a bill will be submitted after the summer recess to allow limited retention for criminal investigation, with the Cbp to be consulted.
Naturally, every judicial ruling must be respected.
Vanzelfsprekend dient ieder rechterlijk oordeel in acht te worden genomen.

Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het vernietigen van een samenscholingsverbod door de Hoge Raad (ingezonden 24 juni 2

MPs Kuiken and Spekman asked ministers about the Supreme Court annulling a Utrecht public-assembly ban appeal on a procedural error and whether this affects enforcement. The government answered that the appeal was declared inadmissible due to a clerical error, that no new policy is planned, that the local ban enforcement continues, and that a new group-ban power will be introduced by the pending law.
Unfortunately there has been a mistake.
Er is helaas sprake geweest van een vergissing.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over geweld tegen deelnemers aan een anti-Israëldemonstratie (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Van Dam and Kuiken asked the Minister of Interior about police violence against participants in an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague and about an incident involving a woman in a headscarf. The minister answered that the demonstration departed from agreed conditions, that police used force after protesters tried to break a riot-police line, and that the involved suspects had disappeared while an investigation is ongoing.
The police repeatedly ordered the demonstrators not to advance further onto the Buitenhof, but demonstrators nonetheless tried to break a riot-police (ME) line.
De politie heeft diverse malen de demonstranten gevorderd niet verder het Buitenhof op te lopen, maar toch trachtten demonstranten een ME-linie te doorbreken.

m: Motie van het lid Van Otterloo over integrale regie om de doorstroom op de woningmarkt te bevorderen
Asks the government to take integrated lead over coordinating housing so that suitable, affordable homes become available for diverse groups and spread across the country.
requests the government to take integral lead and coordinate so that sufficient suitable and affordable homes become available for diverse groups of homeseekers, spread evenly across the country

verzoekt de regering, integraal de regie te nemen en zo te coördineren dat voor de diverse groepen woningzoekenden en evenredig verspreid over het land voldoende geschikte en betaalbare woningen beschikbaar komen
Amendement van het lid Van Otterloo over instemmingsrecht voor de Eerste Kamer

the Second and First Chamber always both have the right of prior review and the right of consent
de Tweede en Eerste Kamer altijd beiden het recht van voorhang, en beiden het recht van instemming hebben

Asks government to thoroughly justify proportionality whenever continuing or introducing COVID-19 measures.
requests the government to always thoroughly justify proportionality when continuing measures
verzoekt de regering, proportionaliteit altijd uitvoerig te onderbouwen bij voortzetting van maatregelen

Asks the government to ensure that future drastic COVID-19 measures always require consent from both the House and the Senate, except in very exceptional situations.
