to create the possibility of distinguishing between staff who do and do not have contact with children
de mogelijkheid te creëren om een onderscheid te maken tussen personeel dat wel en personeel dat niet in contact staat met kinderen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen  over het artikel Nieuwe zaak spermadonor is topje van de ijsberg, groot onderzoek nodig

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of further cases of doctors using their own sperm and whether the Wdkb framework prevents mass donation; the Minister answered that such cases are morally wrong, that current rules and controls make it nearly impossible today, that the number of past cases cannot be determined, and that private and online donors cannot be monitored. The Minister also declined further independent research and promised only support and information for donor children and parents, plus a central cap of 12 families per donor under the pending bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Werner, De Neef en Tellegen over het toezicht van de gemeenten op de zorg

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the state secretary about municipal supervision of care after reports that municipal oversight under the Wmo 2015 is failing, including staffing, coordination with national inspectorates, handling of reports, staff qualifications and fraud. The state secretary acknowledged the concerns, said municipalities have wide discretion and that a study on Wmo supervision is underway with a follow-up letter promised before 1 June 2022, while several answers referred to existing cooperation arrangements and noted that national data was unavailable.
That is why my predecessor decided to commission a study into the functioning of Wmo supervision.
Daarom heeft mijn ambtsvoorganger besloten een onderzoek in te stellen naar het functioneren van het Wmo-toezicht
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Westerveld, Hijink, Kuiken, Agema, Tellegen, Bikker, Van der Laan en Werner over bescherming medische gegevens in de intensieve kindzorg

MPs asked whether insurers sharing medical data of chronically ill children with third parties for efficiency checks, without parental consent, complies with GDPR article 9, and whether a consent requirement is needed. The minister answered that insurers remain controllers responsible for processors, that the AVG applies, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises compliance, and that no consent requirement is planned.
It is not for me to assess a specific data processing operation. That is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van een specifieke gegevensverwerking. Dit is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'Wij geven passende zorg zonder dat de gemeente iets hoeft te doen'

An MP asks whether the Omgevingswet will restrict the permit-free construction of care dwellings (mantelzorgwoningen) on a relative's land, and whether municipalities will be required to allow them. The minister says the current rules are carried over unchanged, that no municipalities are known to restrict them, and that an instructieregel is not yet needed; instead local pilots on caregiver access are planned.
It is my preference to wait for developments in municipal practice and later assess whether national steering on this point is needed.
Het heeft mijn voorkeur de ontwikkelingen in de gemeentelijke praktijk af te wachten en later te bezien of er op dit punt van rijkswege sturing nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'Zij moest naar België voor de abortus van haar ernstig gehandicapte kind, omdat artsen verzwegen dat het ook in Nederland kon'

An MP from the VVD asks the Health Minister why Dutch women with severely disabled fetuses must go to Belgium for late abortion, why few late terminations are reported in the Netherlands, and whether doctors fear prosecution. The minister answers that Dutch law provides legal safeguards, that the reporting gap partly reflects differing gestational age definitions, that the commission was expanded, and that he will await the 2022 evaluation before acting.
I will await the results of the evaluation of the LZA/LP Regulation, because then I can possibly take targeted action in consultation with the professional group.
Ik zal de resultaten van de evaluatie van de Regeling LAZ/LP afwachten, omdat ik dan eventueel gericht actie kan ondernemen in samenspraak met de beroepsgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel: ‘Krimpen voert inkomenstoets Wmo in’

MP Tellegen asked the Minister of Health whether the municipality of Krimpen aan den IJssel's income test for domestic help under the Wmo, and similar moves by Leusden, are lawful and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says these municipal measures conflict with the Wmo 2015, that income policy is a national responsibility, and that he has demanded compliance by 15 October and will consider escalation under interbestuurlijk toezicht.
In my role as system manager I am obliged to hold municipalities to account when they continue their policy and do not keep within the frameworks of the Wmo 2015.
Vanuit mijn rol als systeemverantwoordelijke ben ik genoodzaakt om gemeenten hierop aan te spreken, wanneer zij hun beleid doorzetten en zich niet aan de kaders van de Wmo 2015 houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel 'De 28-jarige Marjolein had spijt van de Laatste-Wil-pil. Justitie doet nu onderzoek naar haar zaak'

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about a case in which a 28-year-old woman who regretted using a lethal substance supplied by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil died, and about related court cases, mental health care, information access and contacts with the cooperative. The minister answered that a civil case against the state is pending with no date set, that a criminal investigation has been opened and cannot be discussed, that mental health policy is under review pending a new cabinet, and that the ministry has withheld the substance's name and declined a request for a test-garden arrangement.
However, regarding the criminal investigation started by the public prosecutor of the The Hague parquet, I cannot make any further statements because of the importance of the investigation.
Over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat door de officier van justitie van het parket Den Haag is gestart kan ik echter vanwege het belang van het onderzoek verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Sociaal sekswerker hunkert naar erkenning: ‘Mensen met een beperking hebben ook behoeften en fantasieën”

MPs Wiersma and Tellegen asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a report on social sex work for people with disabilities, asking whether it should be recognised as normal work, whether it is regulated, and whether municipalities are responsible. The State Secretary answered that sex work is a legitimate profession, that no data on users exist, that social sex work is not a municipal care responsibility under the Wmo, and that a research study on intimacy and sexuality for people with disabilities will be commissioned.
Such an overview is not available, because such data are not registered.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet voorhanden, omdat dergelijke gegevens niet geregistreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Ziekenhuis hoeft identiteit zaaddonor niet prijs te geven’

MP Tellegen asks the minister how a Gelderland court ruling that a hospital cannot be forced to disclose a sperm donor's identity fits the donor law's balancing test, and whether the law should be changed to protect donor children's right to know their biological father. The minister says a court ruling is awaited in a second case, that a legal amendment for formerly known donors who later chose anonymity may follow, and reports on the status of the register of donor confidentiality declarations.
Depending on the ruling, I am willing to initiate a legislative amendment.
Afhankelijk van de uitspraak ben ik bereid een wetswijziging te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘Grapperhaus blokkeert benoeming van rechter in euthanasiecommissie‘

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that Minister Grapperhaus blocked the appointment of a judge to the euthanasia review committee, and whether this was a first, on what grounds, and what follow-up is planned. The ministers confirmed a prior non-appointment in 2007, declined to give the reasons citing privacy of candidates, said appeal lies only to the civil court, and refused to share the motivation with the House beyond the confidential letter to the committee chair.

Regarding the preparation and motivation of decisions on proposed candidate members, as usual, no substantive statements are made in the interest of protecting the privacy of those involved in appointment procedures.

Over de voorbereiding en motivering van beslissingen ten aanzien van voorgedragen kandidaat-leden worden, zoals gebruikelijk, in het belang van de bescherming van de privacy van de betrokkenen bij benoemingsprocedures geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'Ook homo’s mogen bloedplasma doneren, verhoogd risico ondervangen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Medical Care about news that men who have sex with men (MSM) may now donate blood plasma, and why the risk is now managed, and questioned whether donor selection based on sexual orientation is discriminatory. The Minister answered that Sanquin's plasma product portfolio changed so that pathogen reduction allows MSM plasma to be used safely, with a four-month deferral from start of 2021, and that RIVM is studying a shift to individual risk behaviour as the criterion.
I consider it a step in the right direction that men who have sex with men (MSM) will soon be eligible to donate blood plasma.
Ik vind het een stap in de goede richting dat mannen die seks hebben met mannen (MSM) binnenkort toch in aanmerking komen voor het doneren van bloedplasma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel ‘De nood is groot: 22 procent stijging in aantal verzoeken om euthanasie’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a reported 22% rise in euthanasia requests, the withdrawal of 5% of requests by treating physicians, doubts among doctors about complex cases such as dementia and psychiatric conditions, and growing waiting lists at the Expertisecentrum Euthanasie. The minister answered that the rise follows a long-term trend linked to ageing and other factors, that physicians are free to accept or refer requests, and that training modules will be made broadly available with a progress letter promised before summer.
I am currently investigating, together with the professional groups and the Expertise Centre, how the Expertise Centre's training offer can be made available to all general practitioners.
Ik onderzoek momenteel samen met de beroepsgroepen en het Expertisecentrum hoe het scholingsaanbod van het Expertisecentrum beschikbaar kan komen voor alle huisartsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het artikel ‘Nabestaanden houden steeds vaker orgaandonatie tegen’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that relatives increasingly block organ donation even when the deceased registered consent, and about the planned active donor registration law. The minister acknowledged the 2019 decline in transplants, defended the role of relatives as a considered decision, and said the quality standard and training will protect the donor's wishes.
The starting point is the wish of the deceased, and this should be carried out as far as possible.
Uitgangspunt is de wens van de overledene en deze dient zoveel mogelijk uitgevoerd te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Toetsingscommissies euthanasie gaan meer naar de context kijken’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Tellegen asked about reports that euthanasia review committees will look more at context, and about a proposal to let the Supreme Court rule on euthanasia law questions directly. The government said it is examining allowing cassation in the interest of the law against RTE rulings, is studying ways to protect doctors from lengthy criminal proceedings, and that talks with stakeholders have already taken place, with a substantive letter promised this autumn.
Your House has been promised that this proposal will be examined.
Aan uw Kamer is toegezegd dat dit voorstel wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Nederland gidsland bij doneren organen: unieke regeling na euthanasie gaat de wereld over’

MP Tellegen asked the minister about the Dutch euthanasia-organ donation guideline, its delayed delivery to parliament, how it will reach doctors and patients, the share of euthanasia patients who could donate, and a home-sedation-then-hospital procedure. The minister answered that the guideline is delayed to Q4 2019, will be distributed via professional networks and a foundation leaflet, estimates about 10% of euthanasia patients could be potential donors, and says the donation procedure must not compromise euthanasia care standards.
Therefore I cannot send the guideline to your House earlier than the fourth quarter.
Daarom kan ik niet eerder dan het vierde kwartaal de richtlijn aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'De jacht op het 'zelfdodingspoeder' gaat door, maar nu ondergronds'

MP Tellegen asks the health minister about reports that people seek a suicide agent illegally and about a survey by the Coöperatie Laatste Wil. The minister calls the cooperative's earlier plans undesirable, says suicide should be prevented, points to the Wtl as the legal framework, and announces a study into people wishing to end life outside that framework.
That is why I have started a study into the size and circumstances of this group.
Daarom heb ik een onderzoek naar de omvang en omstandigheden van deze groep gestart
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Oproep minister aan 18-jarige zegt niets over automatisch donorschap’

An MP asked why a letter to 18-year-olds about organ donation did not mention that from 1 July 2020 non-registration means automatic donor status, and why it was not linked to the ongoing campaign on the new donor law. The minister answered that the letter was tested before the campaign message was finalised, that neutral information on the new law is the policy, and that non-registered people will be contacted personally before 1 July 2020.

Everyone who is still not registered in the Donor Register on 1 July 2020 will then be personally written to with a request to register and informed of the consequence of not registering one's own choice.

Daarnaast wordt iedereen die op 1 juli 2020 nog niet geregistreerd staat in het Donorregister daarna persoonlijke aangeschreven met het verzoek zich te registreren en geïnformeerd wat de consequentie is van het niet registreren van een eigen keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Aantal euthanasiegevallen daalt voor het eerst in jaren’

An MP asks the health minister whether doctors are becoming more reluctant to perform euthanasia out of fear of prosecution, and about waiting lists at the Levenseindekliniek and the study into rising euthanasia numbers. The minister answers that the reluctance is known but not investigated, that the Public Prosecution Service's independent role is defended, that capacity is largely adequate, and that a study will report in spring 2020.
Whether this is actually the case has not been investigated.
Of dit feitelijk ook zo is, is niet onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Arts te lang in onzekerheid na euthanasie’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister how the statutory six-week deadline for euthanasia review committees will be enforced, given delays, and what can be done to reduce doctors' uncertainty, including a proposal for a second psychiatric opinion. The minister acknowledged rising review times, described efficiency measures and a shorter opinion letter, and said the second-opinion proposal fits Supreme Court case law.
In 2017 the average processing time rose from 37 days to 52 days.
In 2017 is de afdoeningtermijn gestegen van gemiddeld 37 dagen naar 52 dagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'By 2019, the first bionic kidney wil discard the need for dialysis'

An MP asked the health minister about a report on a bionic kidney that could replace dialysis and what the Netherlands is doing on artificial organs, including whether they could shorten transplant waiting lists and reduce organ trafficking. The minister described Dutch initiatives (portable artificial kidney, artificial pancreas), said such devices would not replace transplants soon, and said research funding is a matter for other ministers.
Stimulating research and innovation falls under the responsibility of the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate (EZK) and of Education, Culture and Science (OCW).
Het stimuleren van onderzoek en innovatie valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ministers van Economische Zaken en Klimaat (EZK) en Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht 'Verbod embryo’s kweken niet houdbaar'

Tellegen (VVD) and Dijkstra (D66) asked the Health Minister about calls by European doctors' associations to legalise creating human embryos for research and about the implications for patients if the ban remains. The minister said the coalition parties hold differing views, that a broad ethical debate must come first, and that the government will pursue alternative stem-cell research instead.
The cabinet will stimulate this discussion and at the same time focus on innovative stem cell research.
Het kabinet zal deze discussie stimuleren en tegelijkertijd inzetten op innovatief stamcelonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Steeds meer mensen willen euthanasie, kliniek kan de vraag niet aan’

An MP asked the health minister about reports of growing demand for euthanasia that the Levenseindekliniek cannot meet, including waiting lists, declining physician objections, and rising complex requests. The minister confirmed the rising request figures, said the causes of waiting lists are unclear, and stressed that physicians keep their own choice and pressure on them is not allowed, promising to discuss knowledge of the euthanasia law with parties.
There are no national figures on complex euthanasia requests that physicians could or would not take on.
Er zijn geen landelijke cijfers over complexe euthanasieverzoeken die artsen niet in behandeling konden of wilden nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Tellegen over het bericht 'Politie begint tóch met stopformulieren'

Two MPs asked whether the Den Haag police are joining a national pilot requiring officers to record why they stop people, how it works, and whether the government still opposes stop forms. The Minister says the pilot uses the MEOS app to log checks in the police system, runs December 2017 to May 2018 across nine teams, that stop forms remain excluded, and that results will be reported before autumn 2018.
I will inform your House before autumn 2018 about the outcomes of the pilots.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor het najaar van 2018 informeren over de uitkomsten van de pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen, Visser, Van Helvert en Van Toorenburg over paspoortcontroles door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs from VVD and CDA asked whether airlines must check passengers' identity on intra-Schengen flights, how responsibilities are divided, and how the EU PNR directive would help detect terrorists. The minister explained that border checks are a KMar task only at external borders, that airlines may but need not perform conformity checks, and that PNR implementation (deadline 25 May 2018) and a feasibility study on mandatory conformity checks are the planned responses.
Figures on how many airlines check the identity of their passengers are not kept.
Cijfers over hoeveel luchtvaartmaatschappijen de identiteit van hun passagiers controleren worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Azmani over het bericht ‘Omstreden alFitrah legt 1,7 miljoen euro op tafel en koopt pand alsnog’

MPs Tellegen and Azmani asked the government about reports that the contested alFitrah organisation bought a building with 1.7 million euros, and about its financial transparency, Kuwaiti funding and possible sanctions. The minister said the funds came via a Dutch company, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that transparency measures such as a foundations publication duty are being examined, and that the municipality of Utrecht uses the three-track approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht dat de helft van de gemeenten nauwelijks iets doet tegen radicalisering

An MP asked whether the government is aware that half of municipalities, especially small and medium-sized ones, do little against radicalisation, and how it will embed the national counter-terrorism policy locally. The minister acknowledges uneven municipal activity, points to regional structures, versterkingsgelden, and national training and support (ROR, ESS), and promises to report on use of funds in response to a motion.

Like the VNG, I consider it important that at regional level the problem is mapped, knowledge and expertise are in order, and cooperation structures exist through which signals can come in and be followed up.

Wel vind ik het, evenals de VNG, van belang dat op regionaal niveau de problematiek in kaart is gebracht, kennis en kunde op orde is en samenwerkingsverbanden en structuren bestaan waarbij bijvoorbeeld signalen kunnen binnenkomen en worden opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Tellegen over het bericht 'In je blootje op Dumpert'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about online sharing of intimate images without consent (horizontal privacy violations, sextortion) and whether platforms like Dumpert and Facebook can be compelled to release perpetrators' identities. The Minister noted existing legal tools, the pending computer crime III bill, a voluntary Notice and Take Down code, the Dutch DPA's role, and that identity release from Facebook Ireland requires a legal basis or civil suit.
I therefore cannot provide insight into the scale of sextortion.
Ik kan dus geen inzage geven in de omvang van sekschantage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Ten Broeke over het bericht 'honderden zeeschepen van de radar'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and Security and of Foreign Affairs about reports that hundreds of ships enter Dutch waters each month after switching off their GPS/AIS signals, and about controls on such vessels. Minister Blok answered that the Coast Guard monitors the North Sea around the clock, cannot confirm the report's claims, uses risk profiling and information-led intervention, and sees no problems with ship registration.
The Coast Guard does not have the research data on which Windward based its conclusions and therefore cannot confirm such a statement.
De Kustwacht beschikt niet over de onderzoeksgegevens waarop Windward haar conclusies heeft gebaseerd en kan derhalve een dergelijke uitspraak niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Tellegen over het aanhouden van een veroordeelde terrorist op de vliegbasis Volkel

MPs Van den Bosch and Tellegen (VVD) asked the Defence and Justice ministers how a convicted terrorist gained access to Volkel air base, whether screening was done, why he was released, and whether access rules will be tightened. The government answered only by referring to an earlier letter (Kamerstuk 34 550-X, nr. 91) answering a related request, without giving substantive answers in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de Nationale Reddingsvloot

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about financing for the National Rescue Fleet (Reddingsbrigade Nederland) after 2016 and whether safety regions had diverted funds. The minister replied that he urged the Security Council to find a funding solution, that safety regions are responsible for water rescue capacity, and that a one-off 2016 contribution was granted while talks continue.
I have invited the Security Council to consult on this before the end of May.
Ik heb het Veiligheidsberaad uitgenodigd om hierover voor eind mei in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Tellegen over het bericht "Asielzoekers randden 18-jarige aan tijdens stapnacht

MPs Van Miltenburg and Tellegen asked the government how it responds to reports of sexual assaults on a young woman by asylum seekers, how victims are supported and given copies of reports, and whether police register and prosecute such assaults. The minister answered that all sexual offences are condemned and pursued, victims receive support through Slachtofferhulp Nederland and forthcoming sexual violence centres, and police and prosecutors treat all reports without distinguishing by origin of offenders.
I see no reason to change this approach as a result of the events in Cologne.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze werkwijze als gevolg van de gebeurtenissen in Keulen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Teeven over de bewapening van politie en marechaussee

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Defence about heavier arming of police and Royal Marechaussee in light of the terror threat, and about staffing and training. The government replied that equipment and armament are set per situation based on threat assessment, that the Marechaussee can carry out its core tasks though capacity is tight, and that extra staff is being recruited.
Should it become apparent that the performance of the Marechaussee's core tasks is at risk, the desirability and possibility of new additional measures will of course be reassessed.

Mocht blijken dat de uitvoering van de kerntaken van de Kmar in het geding komt, dan zullen de wenselijkheid en de mogelijkheid van nieuwe aanvullende maatregelen vanzelfsprekend opnieuw worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en De Boer over het artikel: 'Duitse agent gewond na steekincident op station Landgraaf'

MPs Tellegen and De Boer asked about a stabbing of a German conductor/agent at Landgraaf station and the rail-safety measures for cross-border and regional transport. The State Secretary reported on the agreed deployment of 20-22 area police officers and NS double staffing, and said responsibility for tackling aggression on public transport is shared and that a new security approach is being discussed with operators.
I am working on an integrated approach to the problem of aggression in public transport, together with the ministries of Justice and Security and the Interior and the public transport parties.
Ik werk aan een integrale aanpak van de problematiek van agressie in het OV, samen met de departementen van VenJ en BZK en de OV- partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Weer politiebezoek aan burger om anti-AZC uitlatingen op twitter’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether police visits to citizens over critical tweets about an asylum reception centre are correct, what risk to public order was seen, and whether such visits should stop. The Minister confirms that police may contact people over social media signals as part of normal policing under local authority, says there was no public order risk in this case, and sees no reason to change the practice.
Actively contacting the persons concerned by the neighbourhood officer following such social media signals is one of the options for this and belongs to normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de wijkagent met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen op social media is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en behoort tot het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Tellegen over de berichtgeving dat de politie in Zweden kennis over de achtergrond van daders van aanrandingen niet naar buiten heeft gebracht

MPs Keijzer and Tellegen asked whether situations like the Cologne New Year's assaults had occurred in the Netherlands, what the National Police's policy is on publicising incidents that could cause social unrest, and whether police transparently report the origin of perpetrators of group sex crimes and theft. The Minister answered that there are no signals of such incidents in the Netherlands, that disclosure is the responsibility of the local authority and/or Public Prosecution Service, and that police record suspects' birthplace and nationality and inform the competent local authority.
Disclosure of incidents and reports falls under the responsibility of the local authority and/or the Public Prosecution Service.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag en/of het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'We zijn een schietschijf voor terroristen', marechaussee bij Tweede Kamer klaagt over klein pistool’

Tellegen (VVD) asked whether the Koninklijke Marechaussee is adequately armed to resist terrorist attacks at sites it guards, including the Tweede Kamer, and how it scales up in emergencies. The minister answered that armament is set per threat-based security concept, regularly reviewed and adjusted with the NCTV and local authorities, but declined to give details of equipment or escalation as this would reveal working methods.
I cannot provide details on the precise equipment, including armament, because this would give insight into the working methods of the Royal Marechaussee.
Over de precieze uitrusting, inclusief de bewapening, kan ik geen mededelingen doen, omdat dit inzicht geeft in de werkwijze van de Koninklijke Marechaussee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Tellegen over het bericht "Financiële sector let te weinig op terrorisme, zegt DNB"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Tellegen asked the Finance and Justice Ministers about DNB's finding that the financial sector pays too little attention to terrorism financing, and about the effectiveness of the Wwft, its gaps and EU/international plans. The Minister said the effectiveness of the measures cannot be quantified, acknowledged DNB's concerns, pointed to ongoing supervision, the FEC project and EU/FATF discussions, but gave no firm new legislative commitments.
Because it concerns sensitive information, this information will probably not be made publicly available.
Omdat het gevoelige informatie betreft, zal deze informatie waarschijnlijk niet publiek ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Tellegen over het bericht ‘terrorist sprak in moskee’

Two VVD MPs asked why authorities were not informed about a convicted terrorist speaking at a mosque in Geleen, and what the government would do against mosque boards inviting such speakers, including whether mosques should be closed and whether a blacklist of hate preachers is appropriate. The government declined to discuss specifics of information sharing, said mosque boards inviting speakers with intolerant messages is unacceptable, pointed to criminal prosecution and the local triangle, and said no blacklist exists but an alerting list maintained by the NCTV for visa assessment.
No statements can be made publicly about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Tellegen over de berichten ‘Aangifte doen na aanranding zo makkelijk nog niet’ en ‘Onbegrip over verplichte bedenktijd bij aangifte aanranding’

VVD MPs Van Ark and Tellegen asked whether the mandatory reflection period offered to victims of sexual offences before filing a report, and related protection and anonymity questions, deter reporting. Minister Van der Steur answered that the reflection period is optional and flexible, that victims can file immediately if they wish, that the police inform victims about procedure, and that protection and anonymity options exist but full anonymity toward a known suspect is impractical.
It is not a procedural requirement before a report can be filed.
Het gaat niet om een procedurele verplichting alvorens aangifte gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘Politieleiding te vaag over gebruik geweld’ en het bericht ‘Bond: schietende agent moet standaard verdachte zijn’

An MP asked whether police officers are uncertain when they may use force under the Ambtsinstructie, whether force used outside those rules can still be justified, and whether officers who shoot should be treated as suspects or tried in a special court. The Minister says the rules are the outer limit, justification depends on the facts and is for the courts to judge, and the questions on suspect status, disciplinary law and a specialised court will be addressed in an ongoing review, with a letter to parliament promised before the 2016 budget debate.
In the short term, and in any case before the budget debate for my ministry for 2016, I will inform your House of my intentions on this matter.
Op korte termijn – en in ieder geval voor de behandeling van de begroting van mijn ministerie voor het jaar 2016 – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn voornemens hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Tellegen en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Verkeershufters worden minder vaak gepakt”

Three VVD MPs asked whether speed trajectory controls are justified for environmental goals (CO2, fine dust, noise) and how their boetes and effects are documented, given reports that traffic offenders are caught less often. The minister answered that the purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the posted speed limit, that environmental and safety considerations shape the limits themselves, and gave a fine table for 2010–2014 and noise-cost figures.
The purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the applicable speed limit.
Het doel van trajectcontroles is naleving van de geldende snelheidslimiet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht ‘112-app kan bellen met meldkamer’

Tellegen (VVD) asked the minister whether the SOS Alarm app suggests cooperation with the national 112 emergency line, whether it creates false security, and whether a government-recognised 112 app with location tracing and images should be pursued. The minister answered that SOS Alarm is a private initiative, that 112 remains the official channel, that the initiator was asked to avoid appearing governmental, and that voice calls currently offer guarantees data apps lack, while app-based location and images are considered for the new Landelijke Meldkamerorganisatie.
I have pointed out to the initiator of the SOS Alarm app the potential safety risks of its manner of communicating about the app.
Ik heb de initiatiefnemer van de SOS Alarm app gewezen op de potentiële veiligheidsrisico’s die zijn wijze van communiceren over de SOS Alarm app met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Potters over het bericht dat de invloed van ultraorthodoxe moslims in Nederlandse moskeeën toeneemt

MPs Tellegen and Potters asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about reports that ultra-orthodox Muslim influence in Dutch mosques is growing, and how mosque boards could better resist radical influences and prevent salafist ideas spreading among Dutch-speaking preachers. The minister answered that the government is religiously neutral but combats active intolerance in concrete cases, that a NCTV/AIVD analysis of salafism will follow after the summer, and that the AIVD has observed increasingly audible intolerant voices.
Within a democracy, all persons and groups are bound by the applicable frameworks of the democratic legal order.
Binnen een democratie zijn alle personen en groepen gehouden aan de geldende kaders van de democratische rechtsorde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht 'Schietende agent moet niet berecht worden als burger'

MP Tellegen (VVD) asked whether an officer who uses firearms in an emergency is treated as a suspect when casualties result, and what safeguards exist against officers being treated as criminals in court. The Minister explains that prosecution decisions are taken by the chief prosecutor, subject to review by the Adviescommissie politieel vuurwapengebruik, that courts first assess whether the offence is met and then whether the Ambtsinstructie was followed, and describes support available to officers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over verkeershufters die minder vaak worden gepakt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers why traffic offenders are caught less often, and whether this undermines the effectiveness of the beginner-driver and repeat-offender measures and road safety. The minister attributes the decline mainly to reduced traffic during the economic crisis and the abolition of ticket quotas, states that stopping offenders remains important but that no effectiveness-of-stop research exists, and reports on the status of enforcement experiments and speed camera systems, promising to monitor the experiments.
After that period, all final results will be mapped out and decisions will be taken on any further steps to be taken.
Na afloop van die periode zullen alle eindresultaten in kaart worden gebracht en beslissingen worden genomen over eventuele te zetten verdere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Levenseindekliniek niet blij met ‘gebrek aan nuance’ bij toetsing’

MPs Dijkstra and Tellegen asked the Health Minister about a report that the euthanasia clinic objected to the 'onzorgvuldig' label used by review committees even where only procedural shortcomings existed, and about whether doctors can demonstrate no alternative treatment was possible. The minister acknowledged that the terminology can create a non-nuanced picture, said it would be discussed with the committees, explained the review process and the referral to the IGZ and Public Prosecution Service, and said a forthcoming code of practice will clarify how the care criteria are applied.
I will therefore discuss the use of this terminology in a periodic consultation with the Rte.
Ik zal daarom in een periodieke overleg met de Rte het gebruik van deze terminologie bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over het bericht ‘Schrik na drie steekpartijen op school in week’

MPs Tellegen and Straus asked the state secretary and justice minister about school stabbings and rising reported weapon possession among pupils, including its causes, the types of weapons, and measures to curb it. The government answered that it is addressing weapon possession through school safety policy, checklists and the Convenant Veilige School, but that the monitor cannot confirm an objective rise in weapon possession, which may reflect stricter reporting and zero-tolerance policy.
I will also have the checklist for introducing weapon possession controls at schools updated.
Ook laat ik de «checklist invoering controle op wapenbezit scholen» actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Tellegen over geen donatie na euthanasie

An MP asks the health minister about the legal framework, the draft guideline and the Radboud hospital's refusal to cooperate in combining euthanasia with organ donation, and the potential donor pool. The minister explains the two separate procedures, says the guideline is a field initiative still under review, states the hospitals were willing to proceed and no information on the donor potential is available.
No, I have no insight into that.
Nee, daar heb ik geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Sabotage Belgische kerncentrale Doel mogelijk terreurdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether the reported sabotage of the Belgian Doel nuclear plant was a possible terrorist act, how it assesses security near the Dutch border, whether it has contacted Belgian counterparts, and whether Dutch nuclear plants need a security review. The minister answered that cooperation with Belgium is intensive and that Dutch nuclear installations meet existing rules, declined to disclose intelligence-level information, and saw no need for a new review.
I do not make public statements about the knowledge level of the Dutch security services.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over het kennisniveau van de Nederlandse veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Tellegen over het gebruik van verkeersdata

MPs Visser and Tellegen (VVD) asked about sharing traffic data by road managers and about warning systems for approaching emergency services. The minister says the national data databank and Beter Benutten projects improve data quality, that a radio-warning trial was not scaled up, and that no regulatory barriers exist so no new legislation is planned.
There are no regulatory barriers to applying such technologies.
Er liggen geen belemmeringen op het gebied van wet- en regelgeving voor het toepassen van dergelijke technieken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van ’t Wout over het bericht dat ouderen vaker slachtoffer zijn van geweld

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Health about a CBS report showing a rise in violence against elderly people, its causes, and whether additional measures to protect older people are planned. The government said the causes are unclear, pointed to ongoing action plans, prevention campaigns and a care-sector warning register, and said police and prosecutors do not record elder abuse specifically so no sentencing figures can be given.
The police and the public prosecution service do not record specifically on elder abuse.
Politie en het openbaar ministerie registreren niet specifiek op ouderenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Visser over benzinedieven

MPs Tellegen and Visser asked whether police fail to catch fuel thieves because paper reports are not entered in the national digital system, and what measures are being taken. The Minister of Security and Justice said paper reports are not automatically recorded, that pomphouders are encouraged to use the digital reporting facility, that camera footage upload will be possible by year-end, and that the database contains repeat offenders.
Therefore, before the end of this year, the digital reporting facility will offer the option to upload images that support the report and may help with the investigation.

Daarom wordt nog voor het einde van dit jaar binnen de digitale aangiftefaciliteit de mogelijkheid geboden om beelden te uploaden die de aangifte ondersteunen en die behulpzaam kunnen zijn bij de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over EU-wetgeving medische DNA-tests

MP Tellegen asks about EU regulation of medical DNA tests and whether consumers can be adequately protected from misinterpreting results. Minister Schippers answers that the EU in-vitro diagnostics regulation is still under negotiation, that Netherlands supports letting member states set national requirements for supplying genetic tests but opposes medical-ethical requirements at EU level, and that a Health Council advisory report is expected by year-end.
The Netherlands can support a provision that gives member states the option to set additional national requirements for the supply of genetic tests.
Nederland kan wel een bepaling steunen die lidstaten de mogelijkheid geeft om nationaal aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de aflevering van genetische testen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Straus over de effecten van Voor- en vroegschoolse educatie (VVE)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Education about a Radboud University study finding little effect of early childhood education (VVE), its relation to the Inspectorate's critical 2013 report, whether quality will improve, and measurability and segregation issues. The state secretary disputes the study's conclusion as not supported (no baseline or control group, quality still lagging 2007-2011), promises a progress report in November and a 'pre-cool' cohort study in 2015, and declines to tighten effectiveness scrutiny.
The conclusion that VVE has hardly any effect cannot be drawn on the basis of the report mentioned.
De conclusie dat vve nauwelijks effect heeft kan op basis van het genoemde rapport niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de invoering van NIPT

An MP asked the health minister about the rollout of non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT), including who qualifies as high-risk, whether a foreign lab offers it without a licence, and how it is funded abroad. The minister answered that NIPT is limited to women with an increased risk after a positive combination test, that the Inspectorate is being consulted on the foreign lab, and that the Health Council will be asked to advise on the whole prenatal screening chain.
I have made the funding available for this. Dutch care providers cooperating with this foreign laboratory are possibly violating the Wbo.
Ik heb de financiering hiervoor ter beschikking gesteld. Nederlandse zorgaanbieders die samenwerken met dit buitenlandse laboratorium overtreden hiermee mogelijk de Wbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het niet-uitvoeren van verplichte inspecties bij kinderopvang

Tellegen (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the roughly 7.3% of childcare centres not inspected as legally required, and whether municipal inspection and staffing shortfalls were due to too little central funding. Minister Asscher answered that municipal inspection has improved, that funding is sufficient, and that planning tools, a best-practice guide and improvement trajectories are being introduced, with an evaluation and a fuller report to follow.
I dispute the picture that the current supervision is not in order.
Ik bestrijd het beeld dat het huidige toezicht niet op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over de uitzending “Undercover in Nederland” over hulp bij zelfdoding

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about a TV programme showing a De Einder counsellor advising on assisted suicide, and about the scale of such advice and referral practices. The minister said the Public Prosecution Service is investigating and that suicidal people often do not reach care, but gave no figures on De Einder's advice or its link to suicides and declined to discuss the ongoing OM investigation.
Regarding ongoing investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements in the interest of the investigation.
Over lopende onderzoeken van het OM kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Rutte over inenten op de kinderopvang

Two VVD MPs asked whether childcare centres may refuse unvaccinated children and what can be done about unvaccinated children in childcare. Minister Asscher answered that there is no legal basis for a blanket refusal, that refusal is only justified case by case under proportionality rules judged by the College voor de rechten van de mens or courts, and that the sector will discuss the matter with RIVM.
There is no legal basis for a blanket refusal to admit unvaccinated children to childcare facilities.
Er is geen juridische basis voor een algehele weigering om niet ingeënte kinderen toe te laten tot kinderopvangvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Tellegen over het bericht dat de kinderbijslag niet mag worden verlaagd in het buitenland

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Tellegen (VVD) asked the Social Affairs minister how the government would respond to a court ruling that the residence-country principle cannot lower child benefit for children living in Morocco, whether it would appeal, how other EU states export child benefit, the state of treaty talks with Morocco, and whether export of child benefit outside the EU should be stopped. The minister confirmed appeals in the Moroccan and Egyptian cases, described other states' practices, said the Morocco talks had not yet produced results, and committed to pursuing a bill ending export to 14 non-EU countries.
The Netherlands' aim is to amend the treaty so that export of child benefits to Morocco stops entirely.
Inzet van Nederland is om het verdrag zodanig aan te passen dat de export van kinderbijslagen naar Marokko geheel stopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over euthanasie bij kinderen

MP Tellegen asked the Health Minister about Belgium loosening its age limit for euthanasia, the gap in Dutch rules for children aged 1 to 12, and how many such children may be left without an option. The minister answered that Dutch rules set the minimum age at 12 with safeguards, that the gap is being addressed by supporting a specialist advisory point for paediatric end-of-life care, and that no data exist on unfiled requests.
No data are kept on requests that were not submitted.
Er worden geen gegevens bijgehouden van niet ingediende verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over visiedocument kwaliteit gastouderopvang

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a quality vision document for childminding (gastouderopvang) and why its quality standards are lower than for day-care centres and out-of-school care. The minister welcomed the sector's initiative, explained the smaller training requirements by the small scale of childminding, and announced a quality measurement and a language/interaction training subsidy.
In preparation for this quality survey, a valid and reliable measurement instrument will be developed in 2014 to map the pedagogical quality of childminding.
In aanloop naar deze kwaliteitspeiling zal in 2014 een valide en betrouwbaar meetinstrument worden ontwikkeld waarmee de pedagogische kwaliteit van de gastouderopvang in kaart kan worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Oosten en Tellegen over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a baby house with a foundling chamber in Dordrecht, including whether leaving a newborn there is punishable, whether the initiator could be prosecuted for incitement, quality and supervision criteria, and comparisons with other countries. The government answered that leaving a newborn in such a chamber is punishable, that the baby house conflicts with the Criminal Code and children's rights, and that existing confidential-birth and temporary-care options remain the proper route.
Answering the question about quality criteria and supervision for such a baby house is therefore not relevant.
Beantwoording van de vraag naar kwaliteitscriteria en toezicht voor een dergelijk babyhuis is daarom niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tellegen over de overtijdbehandeling door een huisarts

A VVD MP asked the health minister whether home-based or GP-administered medical termination of early pregnancy could reduce abortions, illegal online pills and the feared shortage of abortion doctors. The minister answered that about 16,000 early treatments occur yearly, that data on users are not recorded, that GP-provided pills would not lower the number of abortions, and that GP care could meet the legal requirements but would not solve illegal online purchases or a current shortage.
These data are not known. In the context of the woman's anonymity, such questions are not asked during intake and are not recorded.
Deze gegevens zijn niet bekend. In het kader van de anonimiteit van de vrouw worden dergelijke vragen niet gesteld tijdens de intake en ook niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Tellegen over nieuwe regels voor orgaandonatie in Denemarken

MP Tellegen (VVD) asked the health minister about a Danish case in which a family was approached for organ donation consent after a misdiagnosis, and whether a similar case could occur in the Netherlands under current or proposed law. Minister Schippers answered that misdiagnosis cannot be prevented by law, that consent may only be requested after death under both systems, and that she contacted the Danish ministry for information.
Making an incorrect diagnosis cannot be prevented by any law; medicine remains human work.
Het stellen van een onjuiste diagnose is met geen enkele wet te voorkomen, geneeskunde blijft mensenwerk.
