Asks the government to investigate a central, independent complaints commission for veterans and their families and include it in the Kaderwet Veteranen.
requests the government to examine the desirability of a central, independent and expert complaints commission for veterans
verzoekt de regering de wenselijkheid van een centrale, onafhankelijke en deskundige klachtencommissie voor veteranen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Eijsink, Van Bommel en Belhaj over het gebruik van een door Nederland gefinancierd mortuarium in Afghanistan als jongensbordeel

MPs asked whether the government knew that a mortuary it helped fund near Kamp Holland in Tarin Kowt, Afghanistan, was used as a brothel for boys (bacha bazi), when it was discovered, and what measures followed. The government answered that it had no information during ISAF that the building was misused, learned of it from the Brandpunt broadcast, raised child abuse with local leaders regularly, and confirmed it financed the mortuary (about EUR 15,000) in 2008.
During the ISAF mission the cabinet had no information showing that the mortuary was being used for other purposes.
Het kabinet beschikte gedurende de ISAF-missie niet over informatie waaruit bleek dat het mortuarium voor andere doeleinden werd gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het de Günal-Gezer en Eijsink over het artikel ‘Onrust op fregat’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Dutch contribution to NATO surveillance in the Aegean, aimed at people-smuggling networks, should be labelled a 'mission' rather than an 'activity', and whether that labelling carries financial consequences for crews. The minister answered that the deployment falls within the existing task package of standing NATO maritime groups, so it is classed as an activity, that crew receive the normal overtime compensation, and that financial considerations played no role; she declined to re-label it.
The deployment in the Aegean Sea falls within the existing task package of the standing NATO maritime groups.
De inzet in de Egeïsche Zee past binnen het bestaande takenpakket van de staande Navo-vlootverbanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Eijsink over Bescherming scholen en universiteiten tegen militair gebruik tijdens gewapend conflict

MPs Servaes and Eijsink asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about implementing guidelines protecting schools and universities from military use in armed conflict, and about the #WatchOurSchools campaign. The government answered that Dutch forces already follow the spirit of the guidelines through humanitarian law training, though they are not part of Rules of Engagement, and that Nederland has urged other states to endorse the Safe Schools initiative and recorded 52 supporting countries.
The guidelines are not part of the Rules of Engagement (ROEs) for operations, as ROEs are not a suitable instrument for including provisions of the law of armed conflict.
De richtlijnen maken geen deel uit van de Rules of Engagement (ROE's) voor operaties, aangezien ROE's geen geschikt instrument zijn voor het opnemen van oorlogsrechtelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Eijsink over kindermisbruik in Afghanistan

MPs Hachchi and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about reports that US soldiers were told to ignore child sexual abuse (bacha bazi) in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch troops were trained and guided on it. The minister acknowledged the practice conflicts with human rights, said Defence was unaware of it at the 2002 start and has no specific guidelines, relying on general ethics training, a pragmatic ban on minors at Dutch bases, and post-mission care.
Defence lacks the information needed to fully assess the American case.
Het ontbreekt Defensie aan informatie om de Amerikaanse casuïstiek volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Eijsink over de samenwerking met milities die kindsoldaten inzetten

MPs Van Laar and Eijsink asked the ministers about Dutch cooperation with militias that deploy child soldiers in the fight against IS, including whether Dutch forces work with Iraqi militias and what can be done to end child deployment. The government answered that it does not cooperate with parties using child soldiers, that its Iraq training targets Iraqi Special Operations Forces and Peshmerga rather than militias, and that it will keep raising human rights with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities and support education for children.
The Netherlands does not cooperate with parties that deploy child soldiers.
Nederland werkt niet samen met partijen die kindsoldaten inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eijsink over het artikel ‘Forse kritiek op direct ontslag drugsmilitair’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a military court ruling that criticised the immediate dismissal of a soldier for drug use linked to deployment-related psychological problems, and whether the zero-tolerance policy would be revised. The minister said Defence has appealed the ruling and will not discuss the individual case, that drugs and soldiers do not mix, and set out the exceptions to dismissal (first softdrug use without service link, or medical unfitness).
Defence has indeed lodged an appeal against the ruling. I will therefore not go into this individual case, which is part of a legal procedure.
Defensie heeft inderdaad hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de uitspraak. Ik ga daarom niet in op deze individuele casus die onderdeel is van een juridische procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink naar aanleiding van het bericht dat militairen met een buitenlandse partner naar de rechter stappen

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that military personnel with foreign partners are taking legal action over partner screening, and about a planned arrangement for suspended personnel. The minister said defence-wide information on partner screening has been given and will be repeated, and referred to a letter of 13 February 2015 for the details of the arrangement.
With my letter of 13 February (Parliamentary paper 34000-X, no. 66) I informed the House of Representatives about the arrangement.
Met mijn brief van 13 februari jl. (Kamerstuk 34000-X, nr. 66 ) heb ik de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Kerstens over het gebruik van PX-10 door Defensie

Two MPs (Eijsink and Kerstens, PvdA) asked the Minister of Defence why the Ministry kept using PX-10 despite known health risks since 1976, why Parliament was not informed earlier, and what measures would follow an EenVandaag broadcast. The Minister answered that documentation dates from 1980, phasing out occurred 1981–1996, Parliament was informed 2008–2011, internal documents were already public, and the RIVM independently handles any counter-expertise, while personnel can contact helplines.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over diefstal van geheime legerstukken

MPs asked why Parliament was not informed in time about the November 2013 theft of secret military documents from a car, and what follow-up was taken on the related procurement. The Defence Minister answered that the theft was reported internally and to police, suppliers were informed, staff were re-instructed, and the procurement is ongoing and unaffected by the theft.
The theft took place on 27 November 2013.
De diefstal heeft plaatsgehad op 27 november 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Eijsink over Russische oorlogsschepen en bommenwerpers in de buurt van Nederland

MPs Knops and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about Russian warships and bombers near Dutch waters in 2014, including escorts by the Royal Netherlands Navy and the frequency of Russian bomber flights. The minister answered that the escorts and passages were routine or within international waters, that Russian bomber flights do not violate Dutch airspace, and listed past bomber patrol dates since 2007 while acknowledging a rise in assertive Russian behaviour.
Exact details of the actions taken by NATO are classified and cannot be included in this answer.
Exacte gegevens over de acties die door de Navo zijn genomen, zijn gerubriceerd en kunnen niet in dit antwoord worden verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi, Knops en Eijsink over het voornemen van de marineleiding om tweedehands helikopters aan te schaffen

Three MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the naval leadership plans to buy second-hand helicopters amid a helicopter shortage linked to NH90 problems, and what the financing, risks and training implications would be. The minister answered that the headline was incorrect, that the statements came from the naval officers' association chair rather than naval leadership, that no purchase is planned, and that compensating measures focus on extending existing Cougar helicopters and using other countries' helicopters.
The headline above the report is not correct.
De kop boven het bericht is niet juist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Eijsink over berichten met betrekking tot de beëindiging van de treinkaping bij De Punt

MPs Recourt and Eijsink asked whether reports that the FBI assumed the Moluccans would be liquidated during the 1977 De Punt train hijacking, and that the FBI persuaded the marines, are known and whether the review underway includes these archival materials. The minister confirmed knowledge of the reports, said they are part of the ongoing review, and stated the working group found the information known to it insofar as relevant, with three external experts assessing completeness.
As I informed your House by letter of 1 April 2014, I asked three external experts to assess the working group's work for care and completeness.
Zoals ik uw Kamer heb laten weten bij brief van 1 april 2014 2 heb ik drie externe deskundigen verzocht het werk van de werkgroep te beoordelen op zorgvuldigheid en volledigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over aparte berechting voor Veteranen

MP Eijsink (PvdA) asked the Ministers of Defence and of Security and Justice whether veterans with service-related trauma should be tried in a separate court, and about statistics, sentencing options, detention care, and reclassering supervision for veterans. The government answered that no statistics are held, that a 2011 study found veterans less often involved in criminal incidents, that ordinary courts already consider psychological conditions and can impose treatment conditions, that detention offers screening and forensic care, and that no special court or special reclassering regime is needed.
I consider the alignment of reclassering supervision with the perpetrator's personal circumstances sufficient and see no reason for improvement or adjustment of reclassering supervision.
Ik acht de afstemming van het reclasseringstoezicht op de persoon van de dader voldoende en zie geen aanleiding tot verbetering of aanpassing van het reclasseringstoezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het artikel ‘Militair te snel dupe valse aangifte’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about suspending and dismissing soldiers before criminal investigations conclude, withdrawing security clearances (VGB) without completed prosecutions, and compensation for wrongful suspension or dismissal, as well as domestic violence in military families. The Minister answered that dismissal follows an internal investigation that is suspended while criminal proceedings run, that suspension is an order measure fully reversed if no dismissal follows, that VGB is withdrawn only after a relevant conviction with appeal rights, and that no policy change is needed.

Only after the investigation is completed and has led to a conviction for a criminal offence as referred to in the policy rule on judicial antecedents in security screenings, can the decision be taken to withdraw the VGB.

Pas nadat het onderzoek is voltooid en heeft geleid tot een veroordeling vanwege een strafbaar feit zoals bedoeld in de beleidsregeling justitiële antecedenten bij veiligheidsonderzoeken, kan het besluit worden genomen de VGB in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over hulp aan veteranen met PTSS

An MP asked the Minister of Defence about a game-based and virtual reality treatment for veterans with PTSD, including whether a Dutch game should be developed. The minister answered that VR is used in chronic PTSD treatment with 28 sessions so far, and that an effectiveness study started in 2010 will guide any decision on developing a game.
That is why I am having research carried out into the effectiveness of this innovative treatment for patients with PTSD.
Daarom laat ik onderzoek uitvoeren naar de effectiviteit van deze innovatieve behandeling voor patiënten met PTSS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de inlichtingenvergaring in Burum naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Nieuwsuur op 13 januari 2014

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence and Interior ministers about signals intelligence activities at Burum after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, including US equipment, oversight, and payments. The minister replied that Inmarsat provides commercial telecom services under Dutch law supervised by the Agentschap Telecom, that AIVD and MIVD have no indications of intelligence activity at Burum, and gave general answers on cooperation with partner services and US Government Network questions.
No public statements can be made about the partner services.
Over de partnerdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Eijsink en Albert de Vries over de rapportage ‘Munitiestortplaats Oosterschelde is “tikkende tijdbom”

MPs Jacobi, Eijsink and Albert de Vries asked the ministers whether the WWII munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde pose a danger to people and nature, and whether new research is needed after a media report called it a ticking time bomb. The Minister of Defence answered that TNO research shows spontaneous detonation is practically impossible and that environmental effects are not demonstrated, while monthly water and mussel monitoring will be carried out in 2014 and Parliament will be informed of results if needed.
In 2014 the water quality above the former munitions dumping site will be measured monthly.
In 2014 wordt de waterkwaliteit boven de voormalige munitiestortplaats maandelijks gemeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht ‘Geheime dienst wijst legerliefjes af’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Defence personnel may only have relationships with partners from countries with which the MIVD or AIVD cooperates, how security clearance criteria work, and whether the policy breaches the right to family life under article 8 ECHR. The minister answered that partners are checked in security investigations, that the College voor de Rechten van de Mens found an objective justification for the policy, and that in September 2010 to December 2012 five clearances were withdrawn and 25 refused due to insufficient data from time abroad.
If the security investigation yields insufficient data on the (partner of the) (prospective) position-of-trust holder, an assessment is not possible.
Indien het veiligheidsonderzoek onvoldoende gegevens oplevert over de (partner van) de (aspirant)vertrouwensfunctionaris, is een beoordeling niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink over de afwijzing van het herzieningsverzoek van dienstweigeraars Nederlands-Indië

An MP asked whether Dutch courts' 2013 rulings on Indonesia-era conscientious objectors imply that political bodies should consider rehabilitating them, and whether their convictions and rehabilitation can be reconsidered. The minister answered that such assessments belong to politics, that the military deployment had democratic legitimacy and the law then provided for conscientious objection, and that reassessing individual conduct by today's standards would not be careful, so no further rehabilitation mechanism is planned.
I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against contemporary norms and with present-day knowledge.
Ik acht het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Günal-Gezer over het bericht ‘Militairen bij het grof vuil gezet’

MPs Eijsink and Günal-Gezer asked the Defence Minister about a report that soldiers were dismissed by standard letter during reorganisation, and whether personal contact and aftercare were ensured. The minister answered that dismissal follows a long, personal guidance process, that standard letters are used because their text is nearly identical, and that aftercare is guaranteed for 18 months and beyond.
Since the text of such a letter, arising from the legal position, is almost always identical, Defence uses standard dismissal letters automatically generated by the Dienstencentrum Human Resources.

Aangezien de uit de rechtspositie voortvloeiende tekst van een dergelijke brief in vrijwel alle gevallen identiek is hanteert Defensie standaard ontslagbrieven die automatisch worden opgesteld door het Dienstencentrum Human Resources ( DC HR ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de (mogelijke) inhuur van private bedrijven of particulieren door de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence Minister about outsourcing of military work to private firms and individuals, including a full overview of contractors, staffing figures, legal frameworks applicable to civilian contractors, and whether they may do more than government personnel. The minister said a complete overview is not readily available, provided a 2011 list of the top 100 contractors and an external-hire expenditure table (about 2.3 percent of wage bill), and stated that civilian contractors are not hired to perform work that law forbids the military to outsource.
A complete overview is not directly available and would be very extensive.
Een compleet overzicht is niet direct beschikbaar en zou zeer omvangrijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eijsink over het bericht ‘Chinese hackers stelen ontwerp JSF en Patriot-raket’

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Chinese hackers stole designs of the JSF fighter and Patriot missile, and about the consequences and measures taken. The minister declined to comment on US measures, said the F-35's operational data is highly classified and not internet-accessible, and that the MIVD works with partners to counter digital espionage, without committing to a specific new step.
For security reasons, the US Department of Defense does not comment on reports of possible infiltration of its computer systems.
Het Amerikaanse ministerie van Defensie gaat om veiligheidsredenen niet in op berichten over mogelijke infiltraties van hun computersystemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Segers over de rol van de geestelijk verzorgers bij reorganisaties

MPs Eijsink and Segers asked the Defence Minister about the role of military chaplains during reorganisation, including support for soldiers dismissed as a result. The minister acknowledged the chaplains' importance, said chaplain posts stay unchanged until 1 January 2016 with a review ongoing, and explained that dismissed personnel are followed and supported through an external placement organisation.
For the period after 1 January 2016, a study is underway.
Voor de periode na 1 januari 2016 is een onderzoek gaande.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Oosenbrug en Eijsink over het Mandiant Intelligence Center-rapport over massale cyber-spionage in de Verenigde Staten door een groep hackers (APT1) in Shanghai

MPs Bonis, Oosenbrug and Eijsink asked whether the government would act on the Mandiant report on Chinese state-linked cyber-espionage (APT1) against firms in English-speaking countries, including possible targeting of Dutch firms, and on contacts with China and EU/UN action. The government answered that it lacks conclusive proof but the report fits the known threat picture, described existing AIVD/MIVD/NCSC measures and EU-China contacts, and said it will keep raising cyber-espionage internationally without committing to a new specific step.
We do not have conclusive evidence for this conclusion.
Wij beschikken voor deze conclusie niet over sluitend bewijs.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Eijsink over het bericht “van de heer I.A. betreffende activiteiten die hij in Afghanistan voor Defensie zou hebben verricht”

MPs Van Bommel and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister whether a civilian, I.A., was involved in supplying weapons to Dutch soldiers in Afghanistan, and whether he was offered a 500,000 euro settlement with a limited validity period. The minister confirmed awareness of the claims but declined to discuss operational MIVD matters or individual cases in public, referring to an earlier letter.
I cannot make any public statements about operational matters concerning the MIVD.
Over operationele zaken betreffende de MIVD kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Eijsink over het bericht dat de Hydrografische Dienst de verschijning van de 1800-serie kaarten opschort

Two MPs asked whether suspending the spring publication of the 1800-series nautical charts endangers navigation safety and whether digital publication is possible. The government answered that safety is not compromised because free online notices to mariners keep charts current, that budget cuts and Northsea traffic-scheme changes justify ending the annual spring edition, and that a new system may enable digital editions.
The budget cuts at Defence also affect the processing and production capacity of the Hydrographic Service.
De bezuinigingen bij Defensie treffen ook de verwerking- en productiecapaciteit van de Dienst der Hydrografie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink over het militair strafproces

MP Eijsink asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice and the Minister of Defence whether officer-counsels (officier-raadsman) in military criminal proceedings can be justified given their limited legal training, and whether this compromises fair trial rights under Salduz and the ECHR. The government answered that officers receive about one week of military criminal law training, that the modality functions satisfactorily, and that suspects may waive the right to a lawyer, so no unfair trial arises.
I have no indication that the training in practice fails to lead to adequate qualification.
Mij is niet gebleken dat het onderricht in de praktijk niet leidt tot een afdoende kwalificatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink mer over het militaire strafproces

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Justice whether officier-raadsmen (military officers acting as defence counsel) can provide adequate legal defence in military criminal proceedings, and whether they should be replaced by lawyers. The state secretary rejected abolishing the role, explaining that officier-raadsmen give free assistance in minor cases, receive training, and must act with functional independence, while noting Salduz-related access to counsel is guaranteed via lawyers and the military bar.
No record is kept of this.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Eijsink over het artikel “Defensie wisselt technici duur in”

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Defence is dismissing technically trained staff while recruiting external technicians with bonuses, and how many staff will leave by rank and unit. The minister answered that the reorganisation numbers are not yet known, explained that the numerus fixus instrument explains the mismatch, and confirmed that staff and headquarters will be cut by 30 percent.
It is therefore not yet known how many technically trained staff the defence organisation will have to leave.
Het is nog dus nog niet bekend hoeveel technisch geschoolde medewerkers de defensieorganisatie zullen moeten verlaten.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Recourt over de rechtsmacht over militairen die koopvaardijschepen tegen piraten beschermen

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether Dutch military protection teams on merchant ships could be prosecuted by other states, who holds jurisdiction in different maritime zones, and whether SOFAs are needed. The government answered that UNCLOS gives clear jurisdiction, Dutch flag vessels remain under Dutch criminal law, the Dutch prosecutor reviews any use of force, and there is no criminal immunity.
There is no question of criminal immunity.
Van strafrechtelijke immuniteit is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Eijsink over de bestrijding van drugssmokkel via Schiphol

MPs Marcouch and Eijsink asked whether the Schiphol team combining Customs and Marechaussee officers is effective against drug smuggling and whether it is being dismantled. The minister denied plans to split the teams, said the integrated approach will be extended, and promised to inform parliament once an ongoing review of the team's functioning is complete.
Once the review is completed, I will inform your House of the outcomes and the consequences for the Schiphol team.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond, informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en de consequenties hiervan voor het Schipholteam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Wolbert over het bericht “Defensie in zee met USG voor reorganisatie”

MPs Eijsink and Wolbert asked the Defence minister about the outsourcing of job placement for surplus Defence staff to USG People, including why SMEs and reintegration firms were not involved. The minister answered that the tender followed EU rules with quality and price criteria, that Defence is responsible for work-to-work support and works with various firms including SMEs, and that results will become visible in 2013.
The public tender for the placement organisation contract was carried out in accordance with European directives.
De openbare aanbesteding van het contract voor de bemiddelingsorganisatie is volgens de Europese richtlijnen uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Hamer over het bericht ‘Minder kinderbijslag militairen buitenland’

MPs Eijsink and Hamer asked whether Dutch soldiers stationed abroad with their families are harmed by the new country-of-residence principle reducing child benefit, and whether they should be compensated. The minister replied that child benefit is now set at the cost level of the child's country of residence, that the law was not intended to target soldiers, and that no increase in the foreign allowance is planned.
The purpose is to prevent benefits paid outside the Netherlands from diverging from local standards.
Doel hiervan is te voorkomen dat uitkeringen die buiten Nederland worden verstrekt, met lokale maatstaven uit de pas lopen.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Eijsink over het besluit van Canada zich terug te trekken uit het AWACS-programma

Two PvdA MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Canada's withdrawal from the NATO AWACS programme, its reasons, the effect on the Netherlands, and whether the Netherlands would reconsider its own participation. The minister answered that Canada cited a strategic defence review and budget cuts, that no other partners are known to be considering withdrawal, that financial consequences are still under discussion, and that ending Dutch participation is not on the agenda.
Ending the Dutch participation in the AWACS programme is not on the agenda.
Beëindiging van de Nederlandse deelneming in het AWACS-programma is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over het bericht  ‘Afluisterproject splijt AIVD en MIVD’

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked whether the intelligence services AIVD and MIVD obstruct each other in intercepting foreign satellite and radio communications and how cooperation within the National Sigint Organisation would be improved. The minister replied that cooperation has been intensified since 2007, that the services are forming a joint Sigint-Cyber unit to optimise support and use of technical expertise, and that the processing of intercepted communications is under review.
The joint MIVD-AIVD research teams are examples of this.
De gezamenlijke MIVD-AIVD onderzoeksteams zijn hier voorbeelden van.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over de integriteitskwestie rond luitenant-kolonel Marcel de Haas

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence Minister about the integrity dispute involving Lt-Col Marcel de Haas, including alleged structural problems in job allocation, calls for external personnel officers, a criminal investigation, and an external integrity oversight body. The minister replied that the commission's inquiry was thorough and partly substantiated the complaints, but rejected structural problems, criminal referral, and an external oversight body, citing existing appeal and reporting channels.
I do not share the view that there are structural problems in Defence's personnel policy, including in job allocation.
Ik deel de mening niet dat er bij Defensie sprake is van structurele problemen met het personeelsbeleid,ook niet bij de functietoewijzing.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Jasper van Dijk en Eijsink over zelfdoding onder veteranen

MPs Bosman, Van Dijk and Eijsink asked the Defence minister whether suicide among veterans is tracked and whether a higher suicide rate among Balkan veterans is suspected. The minister answered that only CBS records causes of death without veteran status, that a RIVM study found no significant excess suicide among Balkan veterans, and that Defence is studying periodic CBS-based research and may include veteran suicide data in the Veteranennota from 2013.
Defence is studying whether it is possible to carry out periodic research into suicide among veterans based on CBS information.
Defensie bestudeert of het mogelijk is om aan de hand van de informatie van het CBS periodiek onderzoek uit te voeren naar zelfdoding bij veteranen.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink en Jasper van Dijk over het de verlaging van de prestatie-eisen van de F-35 Joint Strike Fighter

MPs Eijsink and Van Dijk asked whether the Defence Minister knew of a Pentagon proposal to lower F-35 performance requirements, whether this was discussed at the JROC and JPO, and whether a new candidate comparison for replacing the F-16 would follow. The minister confirmed prior information, said the 590 nautical mile range requirement was not lowered but the flight profile was adjusted to meet it, and ruled out a new candidate comparison.
Contrary to what the article suggests, during the JROC meeting the range performance requirement for the F-35A of 590 nautical miles was not lowered.
In tegenstelling tot wat het artikel suggereert, is tijdens de JROC-bijeenkomst de prestatie-eis over het vliegbereik van de F-35A van 590 zeemijlen niet verlaagd.
Antwoord vragen  Leden Eijsink, Hachchi en van Dijk over het bericht 'Defensie krijgt export-admiraal'

MPs Eijsink, Hachchi and Van Dijk asked the Defence Minister what mandate the new 'export admiral' would have, whether this blurs independence and integrity given the role's links to defence industry exports, and how it relates to EL&I export promotion and export control. The minister answered that the vice-admiral mainly coordinates property, materiel disposal and supports exports without representing companies, that EL&I remains responsible for export licences, and that existing EL&I export consultations continue.
PCDS Nagtegaal will not act as a representative of companies, so conflict of interest does not arise.
PCDS Nagtegaal zal niet optreden als vertegenwoordiger van bedrijven, dus belangenverstrengeling is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink naar aanleiding van de perspublicatie ‘DutchAero grijpt naast mammoetorder JSF’

An MP asked the minister about press reports that Dutch Aero would lose a large F-35 engine order, the size of the revenue forecast and investments, job losses, and whether individual firms' figures can be disclosed. The minister says the F136 engine forecast was about 750 million dollars, declines to give company-level forecasts, investments or revenue breakdowns citing commercial confidentiality, and gives partial updates such as 15 jobs and a promise to report on contracts in the next annual report.
The breakdown by individual company of that total revenue expectation, specifically for the F136 engine, I will not disclose because of commercial confidentiality.
De uitsplitsing naar individuele bedrijven van die totale omzetverwachting en specifiek ten aanzien van de F136-motor maak ik vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink, Hachchi, Jasper van Dijk en El Fassed over het bericht ‘JSF duurder door uitstel aankopen VS’

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether and how the government was informed of the US Pentagon's decision to delay 179 F-35 deliveries over five years, and how information flow through the JSF Program Office had improved. The minister answered that the US notified the Netherlands in January 2012, that the JPO was not responsible for the US order schedule, that he had raised timely information with the JPO director, and that financial effects would be reported to the Chamber by 1 June 2012.

The Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is responsible for the development and future further development of the F-35, contract signing, ongoing production of the F-35 aircraft and preparation of maintenance.
