qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over opnemen van Palestijnse patiënten uit Gaza

MPs Bamenga, Paternotte and Paulusma (D66) asked why the Netherlands has not admitted any Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment, while many Western European countries have, and whether this breaches international obligations, including the ICJ ruling and the WHO appeals. The government answers that it prioritises regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support for medical evacuations, cites funding amounts, and says it will continue pressing Israel to allow more evacuations, without committing to bring patients to the Netherlands.
The cabinet focuses on treating seriously ill patients in the region.
Het kabinet zet in op behandeling van ernstig zieke patiënten in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over medische evacuaties uit Gaza

D66 MPs asked the government to release a study by two former ambassadors on medical evacuations from Gaza, to explain why the Netherlands does not take patients while many European states do, and to take in a contingent of patients. The government refused to share the study, said it prioritises support for care in the region over evacuation to the Netherlands, and listed financial contributions and a contact point for medical professionals.
The exploration discussed during the RDINEV is confidential and will not be shared with your House to protect the unity of Cabinet policy.
De verkenning die tijdens de RDINEV werd besproken is vertrouwelijk, en wordt niet met uw Kamer gedeeld ter bescherming van de eenheid van Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het rapport van het WODC over huwelijksdwang, achterlating en vrouwelijke genitale verminking

MP Dobbe asked the government about the WODC report 'Over Grenzen' on preventive protection orders for forced marriage, abandonment and FGM, including whether it will adopt the report's recommendations, criminalise glorification of FGM, and exempt reconstructive surgery from the deductible. The State Secretary says the report will be answered in a policy response later this year, that glorification and incitement of FGM are already partly punishable with an implementing bill pending, and that a research extension exempting reconstructive surgery from the deductible is underway until 2027.
In this policy response all conclusions and recommendations will be addressed in more detail.
In deze beleidsreactie zal op alle conclusies en aanbevelingen nader worden ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht dat een 100-jarige vrouw een woning vindt na drie jaar op straat te hebben geleefd in Tilburg

MP El Abassi asked ministers about reports that a 100-year-old woman lived on the street in Tilburg for three years, and whether this exposed failures in the safety net for elderly people. The state secretary answered that the woman did not live on the street but stayed with family in Morocco after leaving in 2022, that no national figures on homeless elderly exist, and that municipalities are responsible, so no mandatory reporting structure is planned.
Based on this case, I see no reason to impose on municipalities, in this decentralised system, an obligation to set up an active signalling structure and a national reporting point.
Op basis van deze casus zie ik geen reden om in dit gedecentraliseerde stelsel gemeenten een verplichting op te leggen tot een actieve signaleringsstructuur en een landelijk meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Six Dijkstra over het datalek van medische en persoonlijke gegevens bij het laboratorium van Clinical Diagnostics in Rijswijk

MPs Hertzberger and Six-Dijkstra asked how a hack at the Clinical Diagnostics laboratory exposed medical data of about half a million Dutch citizens, when the government was informed, why the breach was not disclosed sooner, and what minimum data security standards apply. The state secretary answered that independent investigations by BVO NL, the AP and the IGJ are underway, gave a timeline of notifications, stated that the cooperation with the laboratory was suspended, and largely deferred the detailed questions on data minimisation, certification and other laboratories to those ongoing investigations.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) has launched an independent investigation into the exact scope and cause of this hack.
Bevolkingsonderzoek Nederland (BVO NL) heeft een onafhankelijk onderzoek ingesteld naar de exacte omvang en de oorzaak van deze hack.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Paulusma en Bamenga over een mogelijk naderend staakt-het-vuren in Gaza

MPs from D66 asked the government about a possible Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation model, medical evacuations and dual-use restrictions on prosthetics. The minister answered that Nederland demands unhindered humanitarian access through UN-led channels, rejects the GHF model, and will support medical capacity in the region and the WHO, but does not consider evacuation to the Netherlands desirable at present.
The cabinet cannot verify these figures.
Het kabinet kan deze cijfers niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht 'Huidkanker is snelst toenemende vorm van kanker in Nederland'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the rising incidence of skin cancer, the adequacy of prevention measures, and whether prevention should be a policy priority. The State Secretary answered that the Voorkom Huidkanker campaign runs until 2025 with no structural funding yet, that EU sunscreen standards are being revised with Dutch involvement, and that skin cancer prevention is now part of the national prevention strategy pending evaluation.
At this moment there are no structural funds available.
Op dit moment zijn er geen structurele middelen beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Danëlle Jansen over het Ichthus College in Veenendaal, dat een speciale rookplek op het schoolterrein heeft ingericht voor leerlingen met toestemming van hun ouders en een rookpas, terwijl

MP Danëlle Jansen asked the State Secretary for Health about a Veenendaal school that set up a designated smoking spot for pupils with parental consent and a smoking pass despite the nationwide ban on smoking on school grounds since 1 August 2020. The State Secretary said breaking the law is not the solution, that schools must enforce the ban, pointed to support tools and NVWA inspections, and reported that a few warnings and fines were issued to secondary schools in 2024, while promising to keep monitoring signals.
Under the law, schools are required to introduce, designate and enforce the smoking ban across the entire school grounds.
Het is volgens de wet verplicht voor een school het rookverbod op het gehele schoolterrein in te stellen, aan te duiden en te handhaven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht dat op 16 mei 2025 de Algemene Leden Vergadering van het College Adviserend Tandartsen (CAT) heeft besloten de vereniging na 76 jaar op te heffen

An MP asked the health minister about the dissolution of the College Adviserend Tandartsen (CAT) after 76 years, and whether dental treatment assessment for insurance is independent and uniform now that the CAT is gone. The minister said the CAT was a members' association, that insurers' in-house dental advisers still assess claims, that no signals of unjustified differences were known, and that insurers are setting up a knowledge centre, with uniformity guaranteed via assessment guidelines and complaints to SKGZ.
It is not for the Minister of VWS to judge how health insurers organise their advisory functions.
Het is niet aan de Minister van VWS om een oordeel te hebben over de wijze waarop zorgverzekeraars hun advisering inrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Daniëlle Jansen over de documentaire ‘Crowdfunding: vloek of zegen?’ gemaakt door Omroep Gelderland

MPs Tielen and Daniëlle Jansen asked the health minister about a documentary on crowdfunding for stem cell therapy in MS, the status of a promised review of when the therapy can be covered, why other countries use it more, how many patients go abroad, and whether it is clear to patients who qualifies. The minister answered that the Zorginstituut covers the therapy only for very active RRMS since December 2022, that an evaluation with safeguards is ongoing, that it does not track patients going abroad, and that the Zorginstituut can re-assess if new evidence emerges.
It is unknown how many MS patients have gone abroad for stem cell therapy and how many of them were cured after this therapy.
Het is onbekend hoeveel MS-patiënten naar het buitenland zijn gegaan om stamceltherapie te ondergaan en hoeveel van hen zijn genezen na deze therapie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht dat supermarkten alcohol dubbel zo vaak in de aanbieding hebben als vier jaar geleden

MP Danielle Jansen asked about reports that supermarkets doubled alcohol promotions between 2020 and 2024, the failure of self-regulation to curb alcohol marketing reaching youth, and micro-influencer and student-targeted alcohol promotion, asking whether regulation should be tightened. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the rise, pointed to the amended advertising code and monitoring by the RCC and STIVA, and said he will await the Monitor Kidsmarketing and include measures in a forthcoming prevention strategy without committing to new legislation now.
I am currently working on a coherent prevention strategy that includes preventing problematic alcohol use, and parties such as the CBL are being asked to contribute.
Ik werk op dit moment aan een samenhangende preventiestrategie waarin het voorkomen van problematisch alcoholgebruik wordt meegenomen en partijen als het CBL worden gevraagd hieraan bij te dragen.

Antwoord op vragen van het het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Hoe lager de sociaaleconomische positie en hoe groter de reisafstand, des te kleiner de kans op het gebruik van geavanceerde oncologische behandelingen

An MP asked the Health Minister how to address inequality in access to advanced cancer treatment, such as Durvalumab, linked to socioeconomic position and travel distance, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the inequality, points to existing reduction policies, regional oncology networks and the ongoing volume-norm process under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, but gives no regional breakdown and no new concrete measures beyond these existing plans.
I think it is important that everyone in the Netherlands has equal access to good care, including the broad accessibility of oncology care.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat iedereen in Nederland gelijkwaardige toegang heeft tot goede zorg, inclusief de brede toegankelijkheid van de oncologische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht 'Ambulance met spoed steeds langer onderweg: 'In ons dorp bijna nooit op tijd''

An MP asks the Health Minister about reports that ambulances, especially in border regions, are taking longer to reach emergencies, and about cross-border ambulance use and AI for dispatch. The minister acknowledges regional differences, cites the 97%-within-12-minutes regulatory norm and sector data, says cross-border ambulance use is not counted, and commits to talks with insurers and the ambulance sector on improvement measures.
I will therefore enter into talks with Zorgverzekeraars Nederland and Ambulancezorg Nederland about which improvement measures have already been taken and which can still be taken.
Ik ga daarom in gesprek met Zorgverzekeraars Nederland en Ambulancezorg Nederland met de vraag welke verbetermaatregelen inmiddels genomen zijn, en nog genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars falen bij inkoopbeleid geneesmiddelen'

An NSC MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that health insurers prefer a costlier anastrozole product packaged in Italy without a barcode, and whether CBG and IGJ approval and insurers' procurement policy compromise safety. The Minister answers that a temporary deviating packaging was approved to prevent a critical shortage, that safety quality requirements are met, and that insurers' preferred-product choices reflect confidential price deals, while declining to tighten insurer rules.
Health insurers sometimes choose an apparently more expensive medicine as the preferred drug because of confidential price agreements with suppliers.
Zorgverzekeraars kiezen soms een ogenschijnlijk duurder geneesmiddel als preferent middel vanwege vertrouwelijke prijsafspraken met leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht van apotheker Daan Boellen over het door Coöperatie VGZ aanwijzen van het dure Molaxole als het preferente merk voor macrogol

An MP asked the health minister about a pharmacist's report that VGZ designated the more expensive Molaxole as preferred macrogol despite cheaper generics and possible supply problems, and asked about secret price agreements, transparency, and oversight. The minister answered that the confidential couvert price makes Molaxole cheaper for the insurer, supply is confirmed, the NZa supervises preferential policy with no signals received, and she sees no reason to require disclosure of price agreements.
Such price agreements are not transparent, because suppliers, due to national and international competitive disadvantages, do not want the prices insurers pay to be made public.

Dergelijke prijsafspraken zijn niet transparant, omdat leveranciers vanwege nationale en internationale concurrentiële nadelen niet willen dat de prijzen die de zorgverzekeraars betalen bekend worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht ‘Meer ziekenhuizen in financiële problemen, bedreigt uitvoering Zorgakkoord’

An MP asked the health minister about hospitals' financial problems and the risk to the Integrated Care Agreement (IZA), including remedies, regional access and insurer roles. The minister answered that hospitals bear primary responsibility, pointed to planned budget-based funding for acute care, multi-year insurer contracts and a supplementary care agreement, but gave few concrete figures on effectiveness and deferred several points.
With the supplementary care and welfare agreement I want to make agreements with the IZA parties on a more targeted use of the transformation funds.
Met het aanvullend zorg- en welzijnsakkoord wil ik met de IZA- partijen afspraken maken over een gerichtere inzet van de transformatiemiddelen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Palmen, Ceder en White n.a.v. Beleidsreactie ACOI-rapport over de openbaarheid van de Bijlmervliegramp-stukken en het feit dat openbaarheid jaren op zich laat wachten door vertra

MPs Jansen, Palmen, Ceder and White asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Bijlmer air disaster archive remains largely closed years after the 2023 motion and why the government is commissioning external studies before acting on the ACOI recommendations. The minister defends the sequencing as driven by scarce expertise and procedure, outlines timelines and planned studies, and says access to the audio material was delayed by equipment and digitisation needs.
The aim is to have the study on recommendation 4 completed in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is het onderzoek naar aanbeveling 4 in het eerste kwartaal van 2025 gereed te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over oververhitting

An MP asked the minister about the health risk heat poses to seniors in homes that overheat in summer, the number of non-compliant homes, protective measures, and information for residents. The minister acknowledged seniors as a heat-risk group, listed national and local heat measures and information channels, but said there are no specific plans to speed up home adaptation and gave no estimate of non-compliant dwellings.
No, there are no specific policy plans to adapt homes more quickly to heat stress.
Nee, er zijn geen specifieke beleidsplannen om huizen sneller aan te passen aan hittestress.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruyning en Jansen over het bericht ‘Zorg Curaçao op instorten: 'Rekening is onvermijdelijk voor Nederland'

MPs Bruyning and Jansen asked the State Secretaries about reports that the Curaçao Medical Center faces financial collapse and what it means for the Netherlands, including loans, support, and patient impact. The answers state Curaçao is responsible for healthcare, no request for aid has been received, Curaçao plans an additional ANG 253 million for 2025-2028, and several questions are answered as lacking information.
Healthcare is a country matter and therefore falls under the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Gezondheidszorg is een landsaangelegenheid en valt dus onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het bericht “Onderzoek: Hoe Nederland zijn vaccinkennis grotendeels ontmantelde. ‘Je gaat toch ook de brandweer niet verkopen?’”

An MP asked the health minister whether the Netherlands holds 20 million smallpox vaccines, their expiry date, and whether the ministry knows its stocks, following a report on dismantling vaccine knowledge. The minister confirmed about 20 million first-generation smallpox vaccines, said they are periodically retested and their shelf life extended, enclosed the package insert, and confirmed the ministry knows its stocks.
Yes, there are approximately 20 million first-generation smallpox vaccines.
Ja, er zijn ongeveer 20 miljoen eerste generatie pokkenvaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het artikel “Studenten vinden drugs gebruiken de normaalste zaak van de wereld”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about an article on normalisation of drug use among students, trends in hard-drug use and treatment among young people, and related policy gaps. The State Secretary answers that drug use is not normal, cites monitoring data showing rising hard-drug use among 18-35 year olds and rising youth treatment numbers, acknowledges missing data on overall harms, and promises a letter in autumn on drug policy.
I am concerned about drug use among young people and young adults.
Ik maak mij zorgen over het drugsgebruik onder jongeren en jongvolwassenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het bericht ‘Wat nou smaakjesverbod? Nepsigaret met menthol en fruit op de markt dankzij ‘truc’ van tabakgigant

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether the nicotine-containing, tobacco-free Levia sticks from Philip Morris circumvent tobacco rules, excise taxes and the flavour ban, and whether the law should be tightened. The government answered that Levia falls under the pending bill on nicotine products without tobacco, that a flavour ban is being prepared, that excise rules will be revised in 2025, and that a RIVM risk assessment has been commissioned, while declining to commit to a total ban for now.
I have instructed the RIVM to carry out a risk assessment for these new products.
Ik heb het RIVM de opdracht gegeven een risicobeoordeling voor deze nieuwe producten uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over het rapport ‘Nederlandse jongeren weten te weinig over risico’s vapen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a UNICEF report showing young people know too little about vaping risks and back a ban on vapes and cigarettes, asking about prevention, the stalled motion for a disposable-vape ban, international obstacles, the Smokefree Generation goal, excise increases and retail-point limits. The State Secretary answered that prevention efforts exist but more action is needed, that a national vape ban is legally blocked by the EU Tobacco Products Directive, that no structural excise increase is planned, and that no licensing scheme for retailers will be introduced, while promising to inform parliament on further steps.
I am considering the further steps I want to take to curb e-cigarette use.
Op dit moment ben ik mij aan het beraden op de verdere stappen die ik wil zetten om het e-sigaretgebruik terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Daniëlle Jansen over het aanblijvend, groot tekort aan salbutamol aerosol

MP Daniëlle Jansen asked the Minister for Medical Care about the persistent large shortage of salbutamol aerosol, including alternatives, stock, causes, EU coordination, insurer roles and IGJ powers. The minister answered that stock is insufficient, a shortage order was issued, alternatives exist depending on the patient, and broad measures such as a national critical medicines list (publication planned June 2024) and additional Meldpunt funding are being pursued, while not guaranteeing availability.
Ik ben onlangs in gesprek geweest met LAN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Daniëlle Jansen over de berichten inzake het diabetesmedicijn Ozempic

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the rising off-label prescribing of Ozempic for weight loss, its shortages, IGJ enforcement of advertising and prescribing rules, and whether the Advertising Code Commission can review newspaper promotion. The minister answered that the IGJ enforces the Medicines Act, that promotion of Ozempic for weight loss likely breaches the rules, and that no instruction to the IGJ is needed, while declining to tighten off-label prescribing in general.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to give an instruction on this.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet nodig hierop een aanwijzing te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Krul over het evenement ‘Navigating Nicotine Regulation: Insights from Sweden’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Business Sweden event in Parliament on nicotine regulation, with speakers linked to the tobacco and nicotine industry, and whether it breaches FCTC Article 5.3. The State Secretary opposed the event, said Dutch snus and nicotine pouch policy will be maintained, but stated that the House itself is responsible for its contacts with the tobacco industry.
I trust that members of the House will hold each other to account when there is contact with the tobacco industry.
Ik vertrouw erop dat Kamerleden elkaar aanspreken wanneer sprake is van contact met de tabaksindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Welzijn over het artikel ‘Zeker negen gezondheidscentra in conflict met commerciële huisbaas'

MPs Jansen and Welzijn asked the minister about reports that health centres are in conflict with commercial landlords over maintenance costs and rent increases, and whether this threatens access to care. The minister said the lease terms are unknown, that practices are primarily responsible for their own housing, that commercial leasing can be acceptable, and that he will provide an updated housing guidance by end 2024 without committing to structural measures.
The content of the lease in this case is not known to me, so I cannot go into this specific case substantively.
De inhoud van de huurovereenkomst in deze casus is mij niet bekend, dus ik kan niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Daniëlle Jansen over de vacaturetekst “PhD-kandidaat: Vroegtijdig des- en misinformatie identificeren op sociale media” bij het RIVM

MPs Six Dijkstra and Daniëlle Jansen asked the Minister of Health whether a RIVM PhD vacancy on early detection of dis- and misinformation on social media, using AI, would involve unlawful tracking or processing of citizens' data and how the methods and algorithms would be made public. The minister answered that RIVM is independent, that implementation is outside the PhD scope, that legal bases and a DPIA would be considered if personal data are processed, and that results and methods will be published in open-access papers.
Any implementation of the method to be developed is not part of this PhD research.
Een eventuele implementatie van de te ontwikkelen methode is geen onderdeel van dit promotieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Joseph over het bericht 'Long covid is lichamelijk en 'zit niet tussen de oren', toont onderzoek aan'

MPs Daniëlle Jansen and Joseph asked the Minister of Health whether long COVID has a physical cause, whether complex multi-organ care should be concentrated in expertise centres under the Integraal Zorgakkoord, and how funding, work reintegration and policy effectiveness are handled. The Minister answered that research is ongoing, that care organisation is primarily up to care providers and insurers, that no specific concentration was agreed in the IZA, and that he will facilitate talks and hold a conference, without committing to new structural measures.
It is primarily up to the care parties themselves to organise good care around the patient together.
Het is primair aan de zorgpartijen zelf om met elkaar goede zorg rondom de patiënt te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Daniëlle Jansen en Van Hijum over de verkoop van vaccinontwikkelaar Intravacc met FDI BioSciences BV

Two MPs asked the health minister about the sale of vaccine developer Intravacc to FDI BioSciences BV, including whether the state should keep vaccine development as a public task and how Dutch self-sufficiency and jobs would be safeguarded. The minister confirmed the share sale is agreed subject to conditions, argued that market parties can play the vaccine role, defended the sale, pointed to CEPI and HERA and a no-resale clause, and refused to reverse the decision.
No, I am not willing to do so given the possible financial and legal consequences.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid gezien de mogelijke financiële en juridische gevolgen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van Van Houwelingen over het medeondertekenen door de minister van Defensie van de beantwoording op vragen van het lid Dekker

An FVD MP asked the Minister of VWS for all messages exchanged between VWS and Defence about Defence co-signing the answers to Dekker's questions on NATO obligations. The Defence Minister answered that officials disagreed on which ministry should primarily answer, and gave a description of the exchange rather than the messages themselves, citing the need for free official deliberation.
For that reason I provide a description of the exchange of views that took place
Om die reden geef ik een beschrijving van de uitwisseling van inzichten die heeft plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister whether VWS uses Palantir software and whether it shares data with the 'Raffinaderij' program or other Palantir-related initiatives. The minister answered that VWS does not use Palantir, that the Raffinaderij falls outside the VWS domain, and referred the MP to answers given by the Justice and Security Minister.
Regarding the so-called 'Raffinaderij', this is a programme that falls outside the domain of VWS.
Ten aanzien van de zogenoemde «Raffinaderij» geldt dat dit een programma betreft dat buiten het domein van VWS valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over de kansen en risico’s van het gebruik van AI in de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the risks of AI in healthcare, including reports of clinicians losing skills (deskilling) and whether AI could replace one radiologist in breast cancer screening. The minister acknowledges both opportunities and risks, points to training, inspectorate oversight and AI-literacy duties, and says AI in breast screening is being prepared for use around 2028 with no change to recall intervals.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for choosing and safely deploying AI applications within their organisation.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de keuze voor en veilige inzet van AI toepassingen binnen hun organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government is adequately protecting residents from pesticides after a court ruling that the regulator Ctgb and the legislator failed to shield neighbours of lily farms, and what concrete steps will follow. The State Secretary rejected the claim of failure, pointed to the strict EU authorisation framework, ongoing SPARK research, planned spray-zone guidance and an information point for residents, and gave no new binding commitment beyond reintroducing the pesticides bill.
I do not share the view that the legislator or the Ctgb have failed in protecting residents.
Ik deel niet de opvatting dat de wetgever of het Ctgb steken hebben laten vallen in de bescherming van bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het gebrek aan verbetering van de positie van mensen met fibromyalgie

An MP asks why fibromyalgia patients have seen little improvement despite parliamentary motions and the Health Council advice. The minister responds that the motions were executed, the Zorginstituut found insufficient evidence for physiotherapy coverage, research prioritisation and clinical guidelines lie with professional bodies, and lists ongoing guideline work and a SZW protocol for hard-to-objectify conditions.
In the autumn, the Minister of SZW will inform the House about the actions taken to implement the motion.
In het najaar informeert de Minister van SZW de Kamer over de acties ter uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het artikel 'Afname van het aantal zzp’ers in thuiszorg en kinderopvang door strenger optreden tegen schijnzelfstandigheid’

MPs El Abassi asked the Minister of VWS about reports of a sharp fall in self-employed workers in home care and childcare after stricter enforcement against bogus self-employment, and about shortage and quality risks. The minister replied that the enforcement moratorium was lifted without changing rules, that exact figures on exits versus transitions to employment are not yet available (expected this autumn), and that the sector is responsible for continuity while government supports the transition to employment contracts.
Currently no figures are available on the share of self-employed workers, within the percentages mentioned in the article, who left the sector or moved to an employment contract.
Momenteel zijn nog geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aandeel zzp’ers, binnen de in het artikel genoemde percentages, dat de sector heeft verlaten dan wel is overgestapt naar een dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel ‘Prijs medicijnen omhoog door eis Trump’

An SP MP asked the health minister about US pressure on drug prices and its effects on availability and affordability in the Netherlands, including transparency of pharmaceutical pricing and the possibility of joint EU procurement. The minister answered that effects are still unclear, outlined existing price-control instruments and ongoing work on a new reimbursement system, said confidential price agreements are accepted for access reasons, and committed to inform parliament once more is known.
I value better insight into development costs, pricing and the negotiated and actually paid prices for medicines, but I cannot enforce this.
Ik hecht waarde aan beter inzicht in de ontwikkelkosten, prijsstelling en de onderhandelde en werkelijk betaalde prijzen voor geneesmiddelen, maar kan deze niet afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het artikel ‘Acute zorg in Nederland kraakt onder een tekort aan personeel’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the acute care unit at Zuyderland hospital in Sittard-Geleen, rising emergency department stops, consequences for patients and regional equality of care. The minister answers that the closure is due to staff shortages, that regional partners and the inspectorate are monitoring, and that the government is preparing regulation and a handreiking on closing acute care, while stating it is not responsible for individual ward decisions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht ‘Ouderen onnodige lang in het ziekenhuis’

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the health minister about a report that elderly patients stay in hospital unnecessarily long, and about related staffing, funding and care-organisation issues. The ministers answered that they are working with partners on primary care, care coordination, short-term care and a national framework for nursing-home admission, while denying that bureaucratic or financial barriers are the main cause and rejecting a reversal of Wlz budget cuts.
It is important that elderly people receive appropriate care and that a (too long) stay in hospital is prevented.
Het is belangrijk dat ouderen passende zorg ontvangen en dat een (te lang) verblijf in het ziekenhuis voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten  over het artikel 'Zuyderland 21,5 miljoen euro in de plus'

An MP asks the health minister about Zuyderland's 21.5 million euro profit and whether it is compatible with staff shortages and downgrading of care in Heerlen, and whether the profit use should be independently investigated. The minister says hospitals may retain profits but not distribute them, the accounts are public, rejects an independent investigation and says the decisions on care location are the hospital's and insurer's responsibility, promising a handreiking on regional dialogue and information on the NZa reports in September.
I am not willing to do that.
Hier ben ik niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over farmapiraterij en medicijnkaping

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why she does not actively demand transparency on pharma investments, press for lower prices, or take a firmer political stance on drug pricing and profit margins. The Minister answered that the development costs are not decisive in price negotiations, that she is working on societal-acceptability criteria (MAUG) with advisory bodies, and that she has limited ability to steer company profits given their international scope.
I cannot steer the level of company profits, mainly because these are international companies active worldwide.
Ik kan niet sturen op de hoogte van bedrijfswinsten, met name omdat het gaat om internationale bedrijven die wereldwijd actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht '10 miljard euro aan zorggeld in zak criminelen, slechts handjevol fraudeurs vervolgd: 'Om te huilen''

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about a newspaper report claiming 10 billion euros of care funds ends up with criminals and few fraudsters are prosecuted, asking about prosecution numbers, recovery of funds, enforcement capacity and further measures. The minister disputes the press figures as incorrect, says the 10 billion is an unsubstantiated estimate, describes prosecution priorities and capacity constraints, and lists recent and planned anti-fraud measures.
There are no figures available on this.
Er zijn daarover geen cijfers voor handen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de recente opleving in de overnamemarkt van tandartsketens

MP Dijk (SP) asks the Minister of Health about the 2025 revival of dental chain takeovers by private equity, citing risks to care quality, continuity, patient trust and supervision. The Minister answers that EY research finds no proven quality difference, that private equity can help continuity but financial motives are undesirable, points to the Wibz bill, NZa merger-control tightening, and says ACM cannot yet review series of small takeovers below thresholds, with a bill promised by end-2025.
I am working closely with the NZa to ensure that supervision of these obligations and conditions takes proper shape.
Ik werk nauw samen met de NZa om te zorgen dat het toezicht ten aanzien van deze verplichtingen en randvoorwaarden op een juiste manier vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Joseph over het artikel ‘Datahack bij laboratorium veel groter, deel gegevens op dark web’

An MP (BBB) asked the Minister and State Secretary of Health about a data hack at laboratory Clinical Diagnostics, with records of about 485,000 cervical screening participants and other patients possibly exposed and some data on the dark web, and about delayed reporting, oversight, and trust in screening. The State Secretary answered that the breach affects about 230,000 additional people, that the AP and IGJ have opened investigations, that the lab has been suspended, and that the Cyberbeveiligingswet will strengthen obligations for care providers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de casus van Ymere en Philadelphia en de Stimuleringsregeling Zorggeschikte Woningen

MP Westerveld asks why the Ymere and Philadelphia application for the care-suitable housing subsidy (SGZW) was rejected, given housing shortages and a Chamber motion to widen the scheme to older people with intellectual disabilities, and whether the rules were clearly communicated. The State Secretary answers that the applicants knew the requirement that construction must not have started (needed for state-aid reasons under a DAEB agreement) was not met, that the rejected application cannot be revived retroactively, and that no further options exist within the scheme, while pointing to the broadened scheme and care-provider duties.
Ymere and Philadelphia also submitted an application in this new round.
Ymere en Philadelphia hebben ook in deze nieuwe ronde een aanvraag ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Rates of succesful conceptions according to COVID-19 vaccination status: Data from the Czech Republic'

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Health about a Czech study linking COVID-19 vaccination to lower rates of successful conceptions, and whether pregnancy-related informed consent and further research should follow. The state secretary answered that the study did not adjust for confounders, that no scientific evidence shows vaccination lowers pregnancy chances, and that existing safety research is considered sufficient, so no additional study or new warnings are planned.
There is currently no scientific evidence that COVID-19 vaccination lowers the chance of a successful pregnancy.
Er is op dit moment geen wetenschappelijk bewijs dat COVID-19-vaccinatie de kans op een succesvolle zwangerschap verlaagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het uitvoeren van aangenomen voorstellen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why she should carry out motions adopted by the House, including on private equity, Zuyderland hospital departments, specialist employment, Heerlen birth care, and care budget cuts. The Minister replied that motions are taken seriously and implemented where feasible, but that hospitals decide their own service provision, and that unfunded motions cannot be implemented without cover.
Motions adopted by the House of Representatives carry significant weight.
Moties die zijn aangenomen door de Tweede Kamer hebben een belangrijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘VWS floot Zorginstituut terug bij programma Uitkomstgerichte zorg’ van Zorgvisie

An MP asks the minister why the Uitkomstgerichte zorg programme stalled after responsibility was placed with the sector, whether the Zorginstituut's enforcement powers were needed, and what lessons follow. The minister acknowledges delays and draagvlak tensions, notes the Zorginstituut retains its legal instruments, and commits to more government steering, extra AZWA agreements and a review of the Zorginstituut's quality tasks.
At the same time I see that more government steering is needed to speed up comparable programmes.
Tegelijkertijd zie ik dat meer regie vanuit de overheid nodig is om vaart te maken bij vergelijkbare programma's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen 'NAVO-verplichtingen' met betrekking tot 'pandemische paraatheid'

An FvD MP asks the health minister why her predecessor repeatedly described NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness as binding, and how and when she was informed of such NATO goals. The minister replies that no NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness exist, that NATO asks allies to make health care crisis-ready, and that the cabinet is politically committed to NATO agreements; she also admits the answers could not be given within three weeks.
As also indicated in an earlier answer to questions from MP Van Houwelingen, there are no NATO obligations regarding pandemic preparedness.
Zoals ook aangegeven in een eerdere beantwoording van vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen 4 , zijn er geen NAVO-verplichtingen met betrekking tot pandemische paraatheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de effectiviteit van mRNA vaccins

The MP asks whether the US health ministry has said mRNA vaccines pose more risk than benefit and cancelled 22 mRNA vaccine projects, and whether Dutch mRNA COVID-19 vaccines are currently safe and effective. The state secretary confirms the US statements accurately reflect the video, declines to comment on US policy, and states that the Dutch COVID-19 vaccines are safe and effective per global scientific consensus.
I am not a commentator nor a political interpreter and will therefore not comment on the views and policy of the US Department of Health.
Ik ben geen commentator noch politiek duider en ga de standpunten en het beleid van het Amerikaanse Ministerie van Volksgezondheid dan ook niet becommentariëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht ‘na Erasmus onderzoek maakt farmabedrijf oud medicijn onbetaalbaar’

An SP MP asks the health minister about reports that Egetis raised the price of an old drug (tiratricol) after Erasmus MC research, including how many Dutch children use it, price limits, Erasmus MC's royalties, public control over medicine pricing, and patient involvement. The minister says the drug is not yet reimbursed, defers pricing and reimbursement to the Zorginstituut, notes ACM enforcement powers, and says broader pricing advice is pending, while declining to comment on the investment claims.
I have no insight into what investments the firm has specifically made or still needs to make to bring this medicine to the market everywhere.
Ik heb geen inzicht in welke investeringen de firma precies heeft gedaan of nog moet doen om dit geneesmiddel overal op de markt te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het behoud van ziekenhuiszorg in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

The SP MP Dobbe asked whether the minister's earlier answers mean that the hospitals in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen will keep full IC, SEH and acute obstetric care and that their plans will not reduce care, and what the hospitals' restructuring plans mean for the Terneuzen daughter centre. The minister answers that no decisions have been taken, that the hospitals must communicate transparently after consultation, and that national politics does not decide which care a hospital offers.
As also indicated in earlier letters, national politics is not about which care a hospital offers.
Zoals ook in eerdere brieven 2 3 is aangegeven, gaat de landelijke politiek niet over welke zorg een ziekenhuis aanbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Ondanks crisisjaar bij ZorgSaam werd top organisatie maximaal beloond’

An SP MP asked the health minister how bonuses and severance pay for former ZorgSaam board members could be maximal while care in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen was being scaled back. The minister answered that the board pay is set under the WNT norms, that pay stopped after the 2024 departures, and that no care is being cut.
The remuneration of these board members stopped after their departure in 2024.
De bezoldiging van deze bestuurders is na hun vertrek in 2024 gestopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht dat chronisch zieken worden opgejaagd door vooringenomen controles van de Belastingdienst

Opposition MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked whether Tax Authority checks on deductions for specific healthcare costs profile chronically ill people with low incomes as high-risk, and how many people must repay amounts wrongly claimed. The State Secretary answered that checks target errors rather than fraud, that the authority does not profile on chronic illness, and that a simplification review of the regulation is underway.
Because of the importance for supervision, I cannot say exactly how the automated selection instruments work.
Vanwege het belang voor het toezicht kan ik niet precies zeggen hoe de geautomatiseerde selectie-instrumenten werken

m: Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over extra middelen voor activiteiten op het terrein van vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging
Asks the government to provide extra funds via OHCHR for freedom of religion work and to inform the House in advance of how this will be implemented.
requests the cabinet to inform the House in advance of how this will be implemented
verzoekt het kabinet, de Kamer vooraf te informeren over hoe hieraan uitvoering zal worden gegeven
Motie van het lid Van Helvert c.s. over de bewijsgaring van mensenrechtenschendingen
Asks the cabinet to intensify efforts against impunity for human rights abuses abroad, including UN investigation and evidence-gathering in Syria, Yemen, Libya and Myanmar.
requests the cabinet to intensify efforts to combat impunity
verzoekt het kabinet, de inzet op het tegengaan van straffeloosheid te intensiveren
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over steun verwerven voor een moratorium op wapenleveranties aan Turkije
Asks the government to seek EU support for a moratorium on arms supplies to Turkey that could be used in conflicts in Nagorno-Karabakh, Libya or Syria.
requests the government to actively seek support within the EU for a moratorium on supplying weapons to Turkey
verzoekt de regering, binnen de EU actief steun te verwerven voor een moratorium op het leveren van wapens aan Turkije
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de capaciteit vergroten van de opvang voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel
Motion asking the government to expand shelter capacity for victims of human trafficking with specialised support and to inform the House on implementation.
Motie van het lid Van Helvert c.s. over onafhankelijke waarnemers in Nagorno-Karabach
Asks the government to work with EU partners to send independent observers to Nagorno-Karabakh via the EU, OSCE or UN.
requests the government to work with other EU member states to ensure independent observers are sent to Nagorno-Karabakh
verzoekt de regering, er samen met andere lidstaten van de Europese Unie op in te zetten dat er onafhankelijke waarnemers naar Nagorno-Karabach afgevaardigd worden
Amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. over middelen voor het gebruik van nieuwe technologieën

Amendement van het lid Van Helvert c.s. over middelen voor government-to-government samenwerking gericht op capaciteitsopbouw en kennisdeling

This amendment aims to increase the apparatus budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to strengthen the Dutch embassy network.

This amendment aims to create room to open an embassy in Yerevan, Armenia

Amendement van het lid Koopmans c.s. over intensiveren van de strijd tegen uithuwelijking en achterlating
Shifts 0.1 million euros within the foreign ministry budget from consular information systems to consular assistance to intensify the fight against forced marriage and abandonment.
This amendment aims to intensify the fight against forced marriage and abandonment.
Dit amendement beoogt de strijd tegen uithuwelijking en achterlating te intensiveren.

Amendement van de leden Sjoerdsma en Koopmans over het verhogen van het apparaatsbudget

This amendment aims to increase the operating budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to strengthen the Dutch embassy network.

to work very intensively on the release of Mr Memis
zeer intensief werk te maken van de vrijlating van de heer Memis

immediately be given the opportunity to return to the Netherlands
onmiddellijk in de gelegenheid worden gesteld terug te keren naar Nederland

Asks the government not to raise passport fees for Dutch citizens abroad beyond the statutory surcharge and to examine lowering those costs.
not to raise now the price for applying for and renewing passports for Dutch citizens abroad

requests the government to give priority, not only nationally but also at EU level, to the readmission of rejected asylum seekers

Motion asks government to expand experiments with external service providers for travel documents, digitise services and explore mobile fingerprint devices, reporting to the House.
to inform the House before summer 2019 about all possibilities and impossibilities
de Kamer nog voor de zomer van 2019 te informeren over het geheel aan mogelijkheden en onmogelijkheden
