Asks the Speaker to establish a parliamentary contact group with the United States Congress this calendar year.
requests the Speaker to establish the United States contact group this calendar year
verzoekt de Voorzitter, om nog dit kalenderjaar de contactgroep Verenigde Staten op te richten
Motie van de leden Van der Staaij en Koopmans over versterken van de "eigen" financiering van maatschappelijke organisaties
Asks the government to examine how civil society organisations subsidised by the Foreign Affairs Minister can strengthen their own financing, possibly by revising subsidy frameworks.
requests the government to examine how the own financing of civil society organisations receiving subsidies from the Foreign Affairs Minister can be strengthened
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de «eigen» financiering van maatschappelijke organisaties die subsidie ontvangen van de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken versterkt kan worden

Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koopmans en Kuiken ter vervanging van nr. 16 over strafverhoging bij belediging openbaar lichaam en openbare instelling en geen klachtvereiste bij bestuurders e

Retains insult penalties for public bodies and officials while removing the complaint requirement for certain officials and members of representative bodies and dropping the penalty increase for them.
At the same time the amendment abolishes the one-third penalty increase for members of representative bodies.
Tegelijkertijd schaft het amendement de strafverhoging van eenderde ten aanzien van leden van algemeen vertegenwoordigende organen af.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koopmans en Kuiken ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het intact laten van de huidige artikelen 267, onderdelen 1 en 2, en 279

Restores criminal liability for insulting Dutch public officials and public bodies, removes the complaint requirement for them, and keeps the existing insult offence in place apart from the foreign head of government.

Therefore the amendment provides that, apart from removing the criminal offence of insulting the head or a member of the government of a friendly state, the current rules of article 267 of the Criminal Code remain and the complaint requirement does not apply to the persons named in article 267.

Daarom regelt het amendement dat, behalve het schrappen van de strafbaarstelling van belediging van het hoofd of een lid van de regering van een bevriende staat, de huidige regels van artikel 267 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht in stand blijven en dat het klachtvereiste niet geldt voor de in artikel 267 genoemde personen.
Motie van het lid Koopmans c.s. over het technisch voorzitten door niet-raadsleden
Asks the government to submit a bill before summer recess amending the Gemeentewet so that council committees can be technically chaired by non-councillors.
requests the government to submit before summer recess a bill amending the Municipalities Act allowing council committees to be technically chaired by non-councillors

verzoekt de regering, nog voor het zomerreces een wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Gemeentewet in te dienen, die het mogelijk maakt dat raadscommissies ook door niet-raadsleden technisch kunnen worden voorgezeten
Motie van het lid Koopmans c.s. over hulpvaardige handhaving
Asks the government to urge the Data Protection Authority to prioritise guidance and help over enforcement for non-deliberate violations while regulations are still unclear.
requests the government to bring this position explicitly to the attention of the Data Protection Authority
verzoekt de regering, dit standpunt uitdrukkelijk onder de aandacht van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens te brengen
Amendement van het lid Van Dam c.s. over drie collegeleden van de AP
Makes the Dutch Data Protection Authority college always consist of three members instead of up to three.
This amendment provides that the College of the Dutch Data Protection Authority always consists of three members: the chair and two other members.
Dit amendement regelt dat het College van de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) altijd bestaat uit drie leden: de voorzitter en twee andere leden.
Motie van het lid Koopmans c.s. over ervaringen en voornemens inzake de AVG
Asks the government to report within six months of the GDPR taking effect on experiences and plans for several data protection issues, possibly with new legislation.
requests the government to inform the Chamber within six months of the regulation and implementing act taking effect about experiences with and its intentions regarding
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer binnen een halfjaar na inwerkingtreding van de verordening en de uitvoeringswet te berichten over de ervaringen met, en haar voornemens inzake
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koopmans en Kuiken ter vervanging van nr. 10 over uitbreiding van artikelen 267 en 279 met de Koning
Extends the special criminal protection against insult, currently given to officials, to the King, his spouse, the presumptive successor and the Regent.
It would be better if the King, his spouse, the presumptive successor, his spouse or the Regent were treated in the same way as a judge
Het ware beter als de Koning, de echtgenoot van de Koning, de vermoedelijke opvolger van de Koning, diens echtgenoot, of de Regent op dezelfde wijze worden behandeld als een rechter
Amendement van de leden Koopmans en Kuiken over het intact laten van de huidige artikelen 267, onderdelen 1 en 2, en 279

Amendment keeps the current criminal offence of insulting Dutch public authority, public bodies and institutions intact, removing the proposed differentiation between civil servant types and dropping the repeal of the Caribbean-Netherlands equivalent.
Therefore the amendment provides that the criminalisation of insulting Dutch public authority, public bodies and public institutions remains intact.
Daarom regelt het amendement dat de strafbaarstelling van belediging van het (Nederlandse) openbaar gezag, openbare lichamen en openbare instellingen intact blijft.
Amendement van het lid Koopmans over het intact laten van artikel 267, onderdelen 1 en 2, en uitbreiding daarvan met de Koning
Removes the criminal offence of insulting foreign heads or members of government but keeps the other insult protections of article 267 and extends them to the King and heirs.
Therefore the amendment provides that the criminal offence of insulting the head or a member of the government of a friendly state is removed
Daarom regelt het amendement dat de strafbaarstelling van belediging van het hoofd of een lid van de regering van een bevriende staat wordt geschrapt
Motie van het lid Koopmans over het Protocol na vier jaar evalueren

Asks the government to evaluate, after four years, the operation of the advisory opinions under Protocol 16 to the European Convention on Human Rights and whether this justifies terminating the Protocol.
requests the government to evaluate the operation of the Protocol after four years from entry into force
verzoekt de regering, de werking van het Protocol na een periode van vier jaar na inwerkingtreding te evalueren
Amendement van het lid Koopmans over waarborging van de democratische rechtstaat
Changes the constitutional principle so the Constitution guarantees fundamental rights and the democratic constitutional state, reordering the terms and merging democracy and rule of law.
This amendment provides that the general constitutional provision states that the Constitution guarantees fundamental rights and the democratic constitutional state.
Dit amendement regelt dat de in de Grondwet in te voegen algemene bepaling behelst dat de Grondwet de grondrechten en de democratische rechtsstaat waarborgt
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over de rechtszaak bij het Internationaal Gerechtshof tegen Myanmar over mogelijke genocide tegen de Rohingya

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Nederland's role in the ICJ genocide case against Myanmar and whether the Netherlands should start its own case, request disclosure of filings, or ensure the Rohingya are heard. The minister declines to start a separate case, declines to request disclosure, notes the Rohingya have no standing under the rules, and says no withdrawal by Gambia is indicated.
I am therefore not willing to consider this step without a request to that effect from Gambia, because that would not be in the interest of the progress of the case.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid deze stap te overwegen zonder verzoek daartoe van Gambia, want dat zou niet in het belang zijn van de voortgang van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Postma over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans and Postma asked the Justice minister about the delayed implementation of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij (armed protection of Dutch merchant ships against piracy), including the status of the repair bill, ILT preparations, stakeholder engagement, the 2022 deadline and extending coverage to the Gulf of Guinea. The minister replied that the repair bill and draft decree will be submitted shortly, ILT is preparing enforcement and extra testing is planned, stakeholders are consulted regularly, the target remains entry into force this year but the new cabinet must decide, and that armed guards cannot help in coastal waters so Gulf of Guinea coverage remains under review alongside EU initiatives.
It is my aim to submit the Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij to the Council of Ministers this month and to submit it to your House as soon as possible thereafter.
Het is mijn streven het Reparatiewetsvoorstel bescherming koopvaardij nog deze maand ter behandeling aan te bieden bij de ministerraad en zo spoedig mogelijk daarna in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op van het lid Koopmans over nieuwe technologie en wapenbeheersing

Rep. Koopmans (VVD) asked the Foreign Minister to confirm the government's ambition under the 2019 Koopmans motion to lead on a binding treaty on new weapons technologies, and what concrete steps were taken since October 2020 and planned for this year. The minister answered that the Netherlands will act as a driver of international rules, outlining EU, NATO, space, drone, autonomous weapons and biosecurity initiatives and a planned 2021 conference, while no initiative has been fixed yet.
The Cabinet intends to organise an international conference in 2021 on the responsible use of new technologies and to launch an initiative towards arms control.

Het Kabinet is voornemens in 2021 een internationale conferentie te organiseren over het verantwoord gebruik van nieuwe technologieën en daarbij een initiatief te lanceren om te komen tot wapenbeheersing
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over het artikel ‘The GRU's MH17 Disinformation Operations Part 1: The Bonanza Media Project’

MPs Koopmans and Van Wijngaarden asked the ministers about a Bellingcat article on GRU disinformation operations linked to MH17, including legal options, a possible espionage offence, and mandatory registration of foreign influence agents. The government called such foreign interference undesirable, said it is preparing a new espionage offence, and considered mandatory registration not clearly effective or proportionate, favouring awareness-raising instead.
The cabinet has established that an additional criminal offence is desirable and will examine how to give it shape and then start a legislative process.
Het kabinet heeft vastgesteld dat een aanvullende strafbaarstelling wenselijk is en zal onderzoeken op welke wijze daaraan vorm kan worden gegeven en vervolgens een wetstraject opstarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Koerden gaan Syrische vrouwen en kinderen vrijlaten uit Al Hol kamp'

MPs Koopmans and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked about reports that Kurdish authorities would release Syrian women and children from Al Hol camp, and about the handling of Dutch jihadist returnees, including local prosecution, citizenship revocation, and repatriation. The ministers answered that about 40 Dutch fighters remain in Syria, outlined prosecution options in the region and in the Netherlands, and committed to informing parliament before any repatriation decisions.
The cabinet will involve the House in advance, in line with the motion, if there are plans to bring back Syria fighters or their wives or children.
Het kabinet zal de de Kamer conform de motie vooraf betrekken als er voornemens zijn ten aanzien van terughalen van Syriëgangers, hun vrouwen of kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het artikel ‘Behind China’s Decade of European Deals, State Investors Evade Notice’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese state investors evade notice in European deals, including in the Netherlands. The ministers acknowledge close Chinese state involvement and state risks to national security, outlining a planned investment screening law (Toetsing Economie en Veiligheid) and EU FDI screening regulation, but give no concrete findings on specific Chinese investments.
The cabinet is currently working on establishing a system of investment screening.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan de totstandkoming van een stelsel van investeringstoetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Wijngaarden over de nieuwe veiligheidswet die de autoriteiten in Beijing opgelegd hebben aan Hong Kong

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Beijing-imposed national security law for Hong Kong, its effects on freedoms and judicial independence, and whether the extradition treaty with Hong Kong should be reconsidered. The government condemned the law's effects on autonomy and rule of law, and announced it would suspend the extradition treaty with Hong Kong as part of coordinated EU action.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht 'China krijgt voor het eerst militair voet aan de grond in Europa'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that China gained a first military foothold in Europe through cooperation with Serbia, and about consequences for the balance of power and Serbia's NATO partnership. The minister answered that he cannot confirm the reports, sees no clear effect on European security, and sees no direct Dutch role while monitoring Chinese military ambitions.
Because I have no information of my own about the systems the cited article says were acquired, and no information beyond that article, I see no direct role for the Netherlands at this time.

Omdat ik geen eigen informatie heb over de systemen die volgens het aangehaalde artikel zouden zijn aangeschaft en ik ook geen andere informatie tot mijn beschikking heb dan het betreffende artikel, zie ik op dit moment geen directe rol voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Koopmans en Middendorp over het bericht dat honderden Chinezen hun valse identiteit ‘herstelden’ bij gemeenten

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that hundreds of Chinese nationals 'restored' false identities through municipalities, covering detection, document verification, nationality consequences, limitation periods and sanctions. The State Secretary answered at length, describing existing procedures and safeguards, rejecting several proposed legal changes, and committing only to approach Chinese authorities if useful.
It is not possible to answer this question using data from the BRP.
Het is niet mogelijk om met behulp van gegevens uit de BRP deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over inzake de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked about delays in the entry into force of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij against piracy, the date, consultation with the maritime sector, a task force, the 48-hour response period for the Coast Guard, and including the Gulf of Guinea. Minister Grapperhaus replied that entry into force is now expected by 1 January 2022 at the latest, that existing coordination is sufficient without a new task force, and that the Gulf of Guinea could be explored while noting that naval protection under the VPD-first principle would be needed.

Based on current insights and taking into account the fixed dates for entry into force of legislation (1 January or 1 July), the cabinet assumes that the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij will enter into force by 1 January 2022 at the latest.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten en rekening houdend met de vaste data van inwerkingtreding van wet- en regelgeving (1 januari, dan wel 1 juli), gaat het kabinet er vanuit dat inwerkingtreding van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij uiterlijk per 1 januari 2022 zal plaatsvinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Duizenden Nederlandse zeelieden nog langer vast op zee door visa-chaos’ en ‘Gestrande zeelieden vormen een dreiging voor de wereldeconomie’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure ministers about reports that thousands of Dutch seafarers were stranded at sea because of visa problems, including the visa policy, EU coordination, visa on arrival at Schiphol, and why non-Dutch-flagged ships are excluded. The government acknowledged the welfare problem, described capacity increases at consulates in Manila, Moscow and Jakarta and the priority given to Dutch-flagged ships, and said it would keep monitoring and raise the issue at IMO, ILO and EU level.
This subject therefore has the full attention of the cabinet and has also been raised by the Netherlands with the IMO, ILO and the EU.
Dit onderwerp heeft dan ook de volle aandacht van het kabinet en is tevens door Nederland geadresseerd bij IMO, ILO en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Koopmans en Wiersma over het artikel ‘Marokkaanse Nederlanders bevrijd ons van de dubbele nationaliteit’

MPs from the VVD asked the government how it responds to Moroccan-Dutch citizens who want to renounce dual nationality, whether Morocco's diaspora institutions interfere in the Netherlands, and what practical help and EU position apply. The ministers answer that renunciation rights should be respected abroad, that foreign interference is handled under the 2018 unwanted-interference approach, and that the Moroccan and Turkish nationality rules are the responsibility of those states.
There can be no question of undesired influence on the individual lives of Dutch nationals and the choices they make.
Er kan geen sprake zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding op de individuele levens van Nederlanders en de keuzes die zij maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid. The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Koopmans over de gezondheidszorg in Afrikaanse landen om een uitbraak van het coronavirus het hoofd te bieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign trade/development and foreign affairs ministers about the capacity of African health systems to handle COVID-19, the economic and political risks, the scope for development budgets, and whether European aid should be coordinated. The ministers answered that health systems are weak and the crisis is severe, that Netherlands has allocated EUR 100 million largely via multilateral organisations, and that a Team Europe coordinated approach is pursued.
The cabinet does not yet have a complete picture of the funds available from other EU member states; the European Commission is working on an overview.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment nog geen compleet beeld van beschikbare middelen van andere EU-lidstaten; de Europese Commissie werkt aan een overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het ‘EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024’

MP Koopmans (VVD) asks the Foreign Minister about the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024, questioning its priorities, its placement of basic rights and religious freedom, and its links to climate activism and other policy areas. Minister Blok defends the plan as broad and consistent with Dutch policy, agrees religious freedom should feature more prominently, and rejects separating climate and human rights policy while denying EU subsidy of climate activists under the plan.
The cabinet agrees with you that the right not to believe or to change one's faith should be expressed more strongly in the action plan.
Het kabinet is met u van oordeel dat het recht om niet te geloven of van geloof te veranderen sterker tot uiting zou moeten komen in het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Koopmans over het bericht  ‘U.S. can’t continue’ tolerating Russian ‘noncompliance’ on Open Skies, Esper says’

MPs Bosman and Koopmans asked whether Defence Minister Esper's concerns about Russian non-compliance with the Open Skies treaty had been shared with allies and whether the Netherlands shares them and is acting on them. Minister Blok answered that the US concerns were raised bilaterally, in NATO and the OSCE, that the Netherlands shares them, has raised them with Moscow and in the OSCC, and has pressed for compliance and the treaty's value without joining any formal joint pressure beyond NATO questionnaires.
The Netherlands, like the US, is of the view that all parties must comply with the obligations under the treaty.
Nederland is net als de VS van mening dat alle partijen zich aan de verplichtingen onder het verdrag dienen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Aantal ontvoeringen in West-Afrikaanse Golf van Guinee groeit hard’

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about rising kidnappings and piracy in the Gulf of Guinea and why the Merchant Shipping Protection Act, passed in 2019, has not yet entered into force. The minister explained the delay (implementing regulations, consultation, and a small statutory amendment needed) and said he aims for entry into force in 2021.
I aim for the act (including the amending act) and the underlying subordinate regulations to enter into force as soon as possible in 2021.
Ik streef naar inwerkingtreding van de wet (inclusief de Wijzigingswet) en de onderliggende lagere regelgeving zo spoedig mogelijk in 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over de berichten 'Nederlandse bedrijven geraakt door VS-sancties tegen Nord Stream 2' en 'Allseas trekt zich terug uit Oostzee, Russen bouwen omstreden gaspijpleidin

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that US sanctions targeting Nord Stream 2 hit Dutch firms such as Allseas, and what the government would do to protect them. The minister said the cabinet considers the US sanctions undesirable, has raised this with US counterparts and will keep doing so, and is in close contact with the EU and business, but is not considering countermeasures such as a Special Purpose Vehicle.
The cabinet considers these sanctions undesirable, given the consequences for business in the Netherlands and other EU member states.
Het kabinet acht deze sancties onwenselijk, vanwege de gevolgen voor het bedrijfsleven in Nederland en andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Koopmans, Sjoerdsma en Krol over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2020 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2020 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising violence in Africa, China's church closures and the role of faith-based actors. The minister acknowledged serious concern, described existing programmes and diplomatic efforts, and committed to continued engagement without introducing new measures.

The cabinet shares your great concern about the trend identified by Open Doors of an increasing number of persecutions of Christians on the basis of their religion and the increasing number of attacks on churches and Christian buildings.

Het kabinet deelt uw grote zorg over de door Open Doors gesignaleerde trend van een toenemend aantal vervolgingen van christenen op basis van hun religie en het toenemend aantal aanvallen op kerken en christelijke gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Koopmans over het artikel “NY Times: ‘Rotterdamse geneticus gebruikte mogelijk onder dwang verkregen bloedmonsters van Oeigoeren’”

MPs Wiersma and Koopmans asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a New York Times report that a Rotterdam geneticist may have used blood samples from Uyghurs obtained under coercion, and about Chinese ministry funding of Dutch research, including oversight of such funding and its risks. The minister answered that the government does not monitor foreign funding flows or the use of research results, that institutions must manage risks and be transparent about donations, that the Erasmus MC height study had ethical approval, and that the government is examining broader knowledge-security measures.
My ministry has no insight into funding flows for scientific research originating from foreign governments.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in financieringsstromen voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek afkomstig van buitenlandse overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het berechten van Nederlandse Syrië-gangers door de Koerdische autoriteiten in Noord-Syrië

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether they would support local trials of Dutch jihadists by Kurdish authorities in northern Syria, including financial and legal support and detention facilities. The government said it is exploring regional prosecution with international partners but is reluctant to deal with non-state Kurdish authorities, offers only indirect support through UNITAD and IIIM, and will not fund local detention centres.

The cabinet is reluctant to make agreements or cooperate with non-state entities that actually exercise authority over an area where the government in question effectively no longer exercises authority.

Het kabinet is terughoudend met het maken van afspraken of samenwerken met niet-statelijke entiteiten die feitelijk gezag uitoefenen over een gebied waar de betreffende regering effectief geen gezag meer uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over onderhandelingen in het kader van de Group of Governmental Experts bij de Conventie voor Conventionele Wapens

MP Koopmans asked the minister how the government follows up on the motion calling for a broad treaty or binding rules on new potential weapons of mass destruction such as drones and killer robots, and what initiatives were taken with partners. The minister answered that the government is reluctant to label new technologies as weapons of mass destruction, stresses that existing international law applies to autonomous weapons, and describes its work in the GGE LAWS on meaningful human control and guiding principles.
The cabinet categorically rejects the development and use of fully autonomous weapons systems in advance.
Het kabinet verwerpt op voorhand de ontwikkeling en het gebruik van volledig autonome wapensystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht “Iran gaat nieuwe centrifuges ontwikkelen om uranium te verrijken”

An MP asks the minister about Iran's reported new centrifuges, French plans to compensate Iran to save the nuclear deal, sanctions, and US actions. The minister says the IAEA has no political mandate, Nederland is concerned, supports EU diplomacy and INSTEX, maintains sanctions, and rejects the US maximum-pressure approach.
The Netherlands raises this regularly, bilaterally and multilaterally, most recently on 10 September at the IAEA Board of Governors and on 16 September during the IAEA General Conference.
Nederland kaart dit met regelmaat aan, bilateraal en multilateraal, meest recent op 10 september in de Bestuursraad van het IAEA en op 16 september tijdens de General Conference van het IAEA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over de Arctische Raad

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about the failure of the Arctic Council ministerial meeting in Rovaniemi, the US Secretary of State's speech on Chinese and Russian activity in the Arctic, and Russian plans for the Northern Sea Route. The government confirmed no Ministerial Declaration was adopted, said Dutch Arctic policy would be addressed in a forthcoming letter, and gave only general or deferred answers on the substantive questions.
You will receive this letter next summer.
Deze brief zult u komende zomer ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over de dreigementen van de Iraanse president in relatie tot de nucleaire deal

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Iranian president's announced steps to reduce commitments under the JCPOA nuclear deal (including enriched uranium stockpile limits) relate to the deal and to preventing an Iranian bomb, and what tools the Netherlands would use. The minister answered that the government is concerned but that no Iranian violation has yet been reported by the IAEA, so the Netherlands and the EU will keep supporting the deal, rejecting Iran's 60-day ultimatum, and noted the Netherlands was informed by the Iranian ambassador and discussed the matter at the Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands is not a party to the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action and was therefore not directly informed of Iran's intentions.
Nederland is geen partij bij het Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action en is daarom ook niet direct op de hoogte gesteld van de Iraanse voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat Poetin paspoorten uitdeelt aan inwoners van separatistengebieden in Oost-Oekraïne

An MP asked whether Russia's accelerated issuance of Russian passports to residents of the separatist Donetsk and Luhansk regions affects their legal status, Schengen visa practice, and whether it escalates the conflict. The minister replied that EU guidance on non-recognition of Crimean Russian passports is being applied and discussed with EU partners, and that the move undermines the Minsk process, with the government pursuing a common EU response.

Following this Russian decision, the Netherlands immediately urged the European Commission to examine whether the above guidelines also apply to Russian passports issued to residents in eastern Ukraine.
Naar aanleiding van dit Russische besluit heeft Nederland er terstond bij Europese Commissie op aangedrongen na te gaan of de hierboven genoemde richtsnoeren ook van toepassing zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Koopmans over het niet tijdig ontvangen van stemdocumenten door Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Gent and Koopmans asked the ministers why Dutch citizens abroad had not received their voting documents on time for the 2019 European Parliament election, and how many ballots arrived on time. The minister answered that The Hague municipality organises the vote, that most voters received ballots by email, that postal ballots were delayed until 25 April 2019 pending Council of State rulings, and that the government aims to ease voting abroad.
The Ministry of the Interior evaluates every election and, for elections in which Dutch citizens abroad may vote, receives data from The Hague municipality on abroad-voter participation.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) evalueert elke verkiezing en ontvangt daarvoor, als het om verkiezingen gaat waarvoor Nederlanders in het buitenland kunnen stemmen, van de gemeente Den Haag gegevens over de deelname van kiezers in het buitenland aan de betreffende verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Haga over de miljardendeals van Frankrijk met China

MPs Koopmans and Van Haga asked the government about Italy's and Luxembourg's signing of China's Belt and Road memoranda and whether this undermines a common EU China policy and screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that member states may maintain bilateral ties, that the EU investment screening regulation enters into force on 19 April, and that member states remain committed to EU-level consensus on China.
EU member states are free to maintain bilateral relations with China, as the Netherlands also does.
Het staat EU-lidstaten vrij bilaterale relaties te onderhouden met China, dat doet Nederland ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Becker over de dreigementen van de Turkse Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken richting Europese toeristen die Turkije zouden verraden

MPs Koopmans and Becker asked the Foreign and Social Affairs ministers whether Turkey's interior minister threatened to detain European tourists who attend certain meetings, and what this means for Dutch citizens criticising Turkey; they also asked about Turkish weekend schools and contacts with the Turkish embassy. The government answered that it does not change its position on free expression within the rule of law, that it knows of no policy change by Turkey, and that it will inform the House on the motion-Becker implementation before summer.
The cabinet will inform the House more fully before this coming summer about the implementation of the Becker et al. motion.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer voor aanstaande zomer nader informeren over de uitvoering van de motie Becker c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Egyptische ambassade het Couperushuis in Den Haag in verval laat

MPs Aartsen and Koopmans asked whether foreign embassies in The Hague are letting monumental buildings, including the Egyptian embassy at the Couperushuis, fall into disrepair, and what can be done given diplomatic inviolability. The minister answered that the municipality supervises upkeep, that the ministry escalates via diplomatic channels and recall as a last resort, that the Egyptian embassy has explained its steps and trust in a positive outcome has grown, and that four embassies are still under discussion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not supervise maintenance, but addresses embassies at the municipality's request.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt geen toezicht op het onderhoud, maar spreekt op verzoek van de gemeente ambassades aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bosman over het bericht ‘Rusland: buitenlandse marineschepen niet meer zomaar langs kust Siberië‘

MPs Koopmans and Bosman asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reported Russian plans to require notification before foreign naval ships use the Northern Sea Route, and related Arctic military developments. The government said the scope of the reported measure is unknown, that notification requirements would conflict with innocent passage and freedom of navigation outside Russian internal waters, and that it will send an update on the security part of the Arctic strategy in mid-2019.
Nothing is known about the precise content and scope of the (possibly planned) measure.
Over de precieze inhoud en reikwijdte van de (mogelijk voorgenomen) maatregel is niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over de intenties van de Turkse ambassade om bij te dragen aan de integratie van de "Turkse gemeenschap" in Nederland

MPs Becker and Koopmans asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs whether the Turkish ambassador's stated aim of bringing the Turkish community together for integration is acceptable, and whether Turkish diaspora politics should be raised with Turkey. The government answered that integration policy is its own responsibility, that Turkey may maintain voluntary ties with its diaspora within the limits of the rule of law, and that it will raise concerns with Turkey if those limits are exceeded.
The Cabinet sees no role in this for diplomatic representatives of other countries.
Het Kabinet ziet hierin geen rol voor diplomatieke vertegenwoordigers van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Helvert en Koopmans over de situatie van Asia Bibi nu zij is vrijgesproken van godslastering door het Pakistaanse Hof

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the situation of Asia Bibi after her acquittal by Pakistan's Supreme Court, including efforts to secure her release, safe exit for her and her family, and protection for Christians in Pakistan. The minister answered that a review petition is pending under Pakistani procedure, that the Netherlands is pursuing quiet diplomacy with allies, offered the lawyer and family a place in the Shelter City programme, and will raise minority protection at the Foreign Affairs Council.
To the lawyer of Asia Bibi, as well as his wife and child, the cabinet has offered a place in the Shelter City programme.
Aan de advocaat van Asia Bibi, alsmede zijn echtgenote en kind, heeft het kabinet een plek in het Shelter City-programma aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Helvert, Koopmans, Voordewind en Kuzu over kerksluitingen in China

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the closure of the Sion church in Beijing, China's repression of religious minorities, and the legal basis of new restrictions on religious groups. The minister confirmed the closure as part of a broader pattern of restrictions, described the legal measures and Article 36 of the Chinese constitution, said past Dutch interventions cannot be shown to have had direct effect, and committed to keep raising the issue within the EU and at the UN General Assembly.
Raising human rights violations remains necessary according to this cabinet, if only to discourage China from continuing those violations.
Het aan de orde stellen van mensenrechtenschendingen blijft volgens dit kabinet noodzakelijk, al is het enkel om China te ontmoedigen met die schendingen door te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat de Iraanse regering de Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft ontboden

MP Koopmans asked the Foreign Minister about Iran summoning the Dutch ambassador over claims that the Netherlands harbours Iranian opposition groups, and about the response, human rights and a possible UN resolution. Minister Blok confirmed the summons, said the ASMLA branch in The Hague is not linked to the attack, pledged to raise Dutch concerns with Iran and to keep raising human rights in UN and bilateral fora.
I will convey to Iran that accusations against the Netherlands must be substantiated with evidence.
Ik zal aan Iran overbrengen dat aantijgingen aan het adres van Nederland moeten worden onderbouwd met bewijslast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht ‘Wetgeving rond internationale faillissementen is verouderd’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether Dutch rules on recognising non-EU insolvencies are outdated, how often such cases arise, and whether the Bankruptcy Act should change. The Minister says such cases are probably a few dozen per year, that courts currently decide case by case, and that he will discuss modernisation with the bankruptcy advisory group and inform parliament.
I do not have access to the precise number of bankruptcies outside the European Union that have a connection with the Netherlands
Ik heb geen beschikking over de precieze hoeveelheid faillissementen buiten de Europese Unie die een relatie hebben met Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Koopmans over de brief van de Turkse president Erdogan inzake de Turkse verkiezingen

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Koopmans asked the government about a letter from Turkish President Erdogan to Turkish voters in the Netherlands before the 2018 Turkish elections, including who supplied the address data, whether the Dutch data protection authority investigated, and whether Turkish election signs on Dutch motorways were justified. The government answered that the letter was not a literal voting instruction but was inappropriate, that address lists can be obtained in Turkey under Turkish law, that the data protection authority acted independently and the GDPR does not apply, and that local authorities handled the signs and no disclaimer will be added.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisory body that itself determines which investigations it carries out.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf bepaalt welk onderzoek zij uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over het bericht ‘Mkb kan uitzondering op nieuwe strenge privacywet wel vergeten’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about SME compliance costs and vague AVG rules, including the register obligation and data storage scope, and about the Data Protection Authority's enforcement approach. The government estimated compliance costs, pointed to existing guidance and brochures, said the register duty largely replaces the earlier notification duty, and described the AP's independent focus on education and proportionate enforcement.
The AP is an independent supervisor that makes its own supervisory choices.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die zelf haar toezichtskeuzes maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Koopmans over gebruik informatie uit het Handelsregister voor facebook-targeting

Two VVD MPs asked how Chamber of Commerce register data could be used for Facebook targeting, whether that is permitted, and whether the privacy of sole traders is affected. The Secretary of State said the register is public under the Handelsregisterwet, the KvK does not offer data for advertising purposes, privacy may be at stake, and talks with the Data Protection Authority are ongoing and confidential.
The talks between the KvK, the Data Protection Authority and EZK are still ongoing and take place in a confidential atmosphere.
De gesprekken tussen de KvK, de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens en EZK zijn nog gaande en vinden plaats in een vertrouwelijke sfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse president Erdogan campagne wil voeren in het buitenland voor de Turkse presidents- en parlementsverkiezingen in juni

VVD MPs Becker and Koopmans asked whether Erdogan would campaign abroad before the June 2018 Turkish elections, how the Netherlands would prevent such campaign visits, and whether a German-style ban on foreign politicians campaigning could be introduced. The government said Erdogan attended a rally in Sarajevo, that visits by Turkish government members are unwanted, that municipalities decide on other campaign activities, and that it will explore a general line on foreign politicians' campaigning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Jouw medicijnen worden straks misschien wel door een drone gebracht’

MPs Koopmans and Remco Dijkstra asked the ministers about news that drones may deliver medicines, and about drone innovation, timing of an integrated vision, privacy and airspace safety, miniaturised or camouflaged drones and drone swarms in private hands. The government answered that it keeps its drone policy course, that general privacy rules and EU safety regulation apply, that small camouflaged drones filming covertly may be criminal, and that swarm flights will need to meet safety requirements under forthcoming EU rules.
This cabinet maintains the course set earlier, as stated in the most recent progress letter on drone policy of 28 May 2018.
Dit kabinet houdt vast aan de eerder ingezette koers zoals verwoord in de meest recente voortgangsbrief dronebeleid van 28 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het bericht 'Gegevens huisdieren en hun baasjes op straat'

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked whether pet owners' data from pet chip databases was exposed online, whether breaches were reported to the Data Protection Authority, and how the ministry prepared affiliated bodies for GDPR. The minister replied that no sensitive data reportedly leaked, databases blocked bulk queries, one database filed a breach report, and a DPIA and processing agreements were in place.
Following the NOS finding, the databases took measures so that querying multiple chip numbers from a single IP address is now impossible.
Naar aanleiding van de constatering door de Nederlandse Omroep Stichting (NOS) hebben databanken maatregelen genomen, waardoor opvraag van meerdere chipnummers vanaf één IP adres nu onmogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht 'Gegevens miljoenen Facebook-gebruikers gestolen voor politieke reclame'

MP Koopmans asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Facebook/Cambridge Analytica data harvesting, including whether Dutch citizens were affected, how victims can check and be compensated, rules on data reuse by researchers and journalists, and government trust in Facebook for communication. The minister answered that at most about 89,000 Dutch profiles may be affected, pointed to pending collective damages legislation and the Dutch DPA's cooperation with the UK regulator, explained the GDPR conditions for scientific and journalistic reuse, and said he sees no reason to change government use of Facebook.
I will talk with Facebook and other providers to again point out their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over de berichtgeving over het proefschrift van Marlies van Eck van de Tilburg University

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a PhD thesis finding that citizens are insufficiently legally protected against computer-driven financial decisions by government, and whether computer instructions should be open to third parties or reviewed by an independent body. The State Secretary answered that existing law already requires correctable, well-reasoned decisions, that the Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur allows third parties to request source code, that an algorithms study is under way, and that no independent review body is planned.
In line with this practice, I see no reason for now to establish an independent body to assess source codes.
In lijn met deze praktijk zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om een onafhankelijke instelling in het leven te roepen voor de beoordeling van broncodes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Koopmans over "het artikel ‘gemeente Tilburg mag niet specifiek speuren naar Turkse bijstandfraudeurs’"

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Koopmans asked whether municipalities may screen welfare recipients by country of origin and pursue foreign assets after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling found Tilburg's targeting of Turkish benefit fraudsters discriminatory. The State Secretary answered that selecting on country of origin alone violates the non-discrimination rule, that municipalities should work with the IBF on cross-border fraud, and that he will promote IBF cooperation and guidance for municipalities.

The consequence of the CRvB ruling is that selecting on the basis of country of origin, as the sole factor, is contrary to the non-discrimination prohibition laid down in Article 14 ECHR and Article 1 of Protocol 12 to the ECHR.

De consequentie van de uitspraak van de CRvB is dat selecteren op basis van land van herkomst, als enkele feit, in strijd is met het discriminatieverbod zoals neergelegd in artikel 14 EVRM en artikel 1 van Protocol 12 bij het EVRM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Koopmans over het bericht 'Online burgerinspraak kan leiden tot teleurstelling in politici' en het rapport van het Rathenau instituut 'Online meebeslissen'

MPs Middendorp and Koopmans asked the government about reports on the limited impact and unrepresentative participation of online citizen consultation, and about how digital participation is shaped and improved. The minister answered that internetconsultatie.nl is the main national tool, that low awareness of the site is acknowledged and being addressed, and that a digital democracy pilot with municipalities starts in April, while broader national measures await the Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel report.
For national-level digital participation, additional measures are being considered mainly in conjunction with the publication of the report of the State Committee on the Parliamentary System.

Voor wat betreft digitale participatie op het landelijke niveau worden aanvullende maatregelen m.n. bezien in samenhang met het verschijnen van het rapport van de Staatscommissie Parlementair Stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over (partij-) politieke propaganda in en rond het stembureau

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about party-political propaganda such as foreign flags and nationalist posters in or near polling stations, and whether election rules are adequate. The minister answered that municipalities must prevent campaigning at polling stations, the current law is adequate, and voters may attend vote counts subject to the chair's order-keeping authority, without a registration procedure.
I consider the current legislation adequate.
Ik acht de huidige wetgeving toereikend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over een droneverbod vanwege privacy

An MP asked the Minister whether he knew of a proposed ban on hobby drones over privacy concerns at the Kinderdijk windmills, what privacy complaints and violations exist, how anonymous and miniaturised drones should be judged, what physical and legal means exist against privacy-violating drone flights, whether enforcement occurs, and what short-term measures can protect horizontal privacy. The Minister answered that the existing privacy rules are adequate for now, listed police drone-report figures, pointed to identification chips, geofencing and a future updated privacy handbook, and noted civil and criminal remedies.
This handbook will be updated in the first half of 2018 and adapted to the GDPR.
Deze handleiding zal in de eerste helft van 2018 worden geactualiseerd en aangepast aan de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over misstanden in Sri Lanka inzake adoptie

An MP asked the minister about malpractice in 1980s adoptions from Sri Lanka by Dutch parents, following a Zembla broadcast, including what support adoptees and parents can get and whether adoption agencies committed document fraud. The minister acknowledged the problems, described coordination with Sri Lankan authorities and Dutch bodies and a forthcoming overview of government roles, declined to judge fraud (reserved for prosecutors and courts), and said broader measures would cover other countries and periods.
I am currently having an inventory made of how the roles and responsibilities in the Netherlands were divided at that time.
Momenteel laat ik inventariseren hoe destijds de rollen en verantwoordelijkheden in Nederland waren verdeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Koopmans over het bericht “Sollicitant niet meer vogelvrij op internet.”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about an Article 29 Working Party opinion on employers screening job applicants' social media profiles, and how it fits with Dutch privacy law and UWV training. The government answered that the opinion does not change existing rules, that the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (and later the AVG) leaves room for a necessary, transparent online check, and that no contradictory signal was given.
If a profile serves a professional purpose, it may more readily be justified than a private profile.
Als er sprake is van een profiel dat een professioneel doeleinde dient, zal daar eerder sprake van kunnen zijn dan als het een privé profiel betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het artikel 'Dubieuze gluurcamera gewoon te koop via Amazon'

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a news report on a dubious hidden camera sold via Amazon, and how the spread of such devices threatens horizontal privacy. The minister said existing criminal and data protection law suffices, pointed to ongoing private-sector cooperation on preventive measures, and noted the stricter GDPR fines from May 2018, without committing to new measures.
In my view, current legislation offers sufficient possibilities to counter misuse of such equipment.
Naar mijn mening biedt de huidige wetgeving voldoende mogelijkheden om misbruik van dergelijke apparatuur tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Tellegen over het bericht 'In je blootje op Dumpert'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about online sharing of intimate images without consent (horizontal privacy violations, sextortion) and whether platforms like Dumpert and Facebook can be compelled to release perpetrators' identities. The Minister noted existing legal tools, the pending computer crime III bill, a voluntary Notice and Take Down code, the Dutch DPA's role, and that identity release from Facebook Ireland requires a legal basis or civil suit.
I therefore cannot provide insight into the scale of sextortion.
Ik kan dus geen inzage geven in de omvang van sekschantage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat er camera’s hangen in de kleedkamers van fitness keten Fit For Free

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Bruins Slot (CDA) asked whether cameras in changing rooms of fitness chain Fit For Free, even if switched off, violate privacy, and what oversight exists. The government answered that cameras in changing rooms and toilets go too far, that installed-but-unused cameras involve no personal data processing, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority handled two complaints and the cameras were removed, and that no law change is needed.
Camera surveillance in changing rooms or toilets goes too far because people would be filmed undressed.
Cameratoezicht in kleedkamers of toiletten gaat te ver omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over het bericht dat er een camera in een toilet in een café is geplaatst

MP Koopmans (VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a camera in a café toilet is permitted, how such private surveillance is enforced, what affected people can do, and whether rules should change. The minister said cameras in toilets go too far and set out conditions for private camera surveillance, that the Data Protection Authority enforces the rules, and that no change to law or enforcement is planned.
A camera in a changing booth, fitting room or toilet goes too far, because people could be filmed undressed.
Een camera in een pashokje, kleedkamer of toilet gaat te ver, omdat mensen dan ontkleed in beeld kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koopmans over verhandelbare spionagesoftware en de persoonlijke levenssfeer

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about privately traded spyware, its use against citizens and companies, oversight of spyshops, and protection of privacy. The minister said private spyware is not illegal in itself, pointed to prevention and awareness efforts and to the GDPR from May 2018, and could not guarantee protection against spyware on smartphones.
Ik kan die zekerheid niet bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Azmani en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse AK-partij weer een ronselbrief aan Nederlanders met een Turkse achtergrond heeft gestuurd

VVD MPs asked whether the Turkish AK party again sent a recruitment letter, signed by the Turkish prime minister, to Turkish-Dutch citizens about the referendum, whether it used the same address list as in 2015, and whether the government will raise this with Turkey. The minister confirmed some recipients received the letter, said it is unknown whether the 2015 address list was reused, noted Turkish parties can buy voter address lists, and said the government remains opposed to political campaigning by Turkish officials in the Netherlands.
It is not known whether the AK party used the same address list as in 2015.
Het is niet bekend of de AK-partij gebruik heeft gemaakt van hetzelfde adressenbestand als in 2015.

Amendement van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Van Weyenberg dat regelt dat de wijziging van de ketenbepaling (artikel I, onderdeel N) gelijktijdig plaatsvindt met de wijziging op ontslagrecht

Amendement van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga c.s. over een overbruggingsregeling voor kleine MKB werkgevers als het gaat om de verschuldigde transitievergoeding
Adds a transitional arrangement letting small employers (under 25 staff) exclude pre-May 2013 service years from transition payments, with conditions set by ministerial regulation and a sunset date.
conditions for calculating the employment duration may be set by regulation of the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment
kunnen onder bij regeling van Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid te bepalen voorwaarden voor de berekening van de duur van de arbeidsovereenkomst
Amendement van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Hamer over aanpassing van de bedenktermijn
Shortens the cooling-off period for employees to dissolve a termination agreement when the employer failed to inform them, from one month to three weeks.

In het wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld om de termijn van veertien dagen te verlengen naar een maand

Amendment requiring the minister to report to parliament three years after entry into force on the effectiveness of the amended chain-contract rule in labour law.
Our Minister of Social Affairs and Employment sends the States General a report three years after entry into force of article I, part N
Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zendt drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van artikel I, onderdeel N, van deze wet, aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag
Motie van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over vereenvoudiging van het grote aantal inkomensregelingen
Asks the government to examine simplifying the many income schemes, with labour participation and income support as starting points.
requests the government to examine the system of income schemes
verzoekt de regering om, het stelsel van inkomensregelingen onder de loep te nemen

Asks the government to clarify the concept of 'normal working hours' in collective agreements by formulating exact starting points, to improve certification.
requests the government to create clarity on the concept of 'normal working hours' by formulating exact starting points
verzoekt de regering om, duidelijkheid te scheppen over het begrip «normale arbeidsduur» door exacte uitgangspunten te formuleren
Motie van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Heerma over werkgelegenheidsbevorderende initiatieven
Asks the government to talk with Brabant initiatives on employment and examine how obstacles can be removed.
requests the government to enter into discussion with these initiators
verzoekt de regering om, met deze initiatiefnemers in gesprek te gaan
Motie van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Van Weyenberg over duurzame inzetbaarheid van werknemers
Asks government to talk with social partners on sustainable employability and to stop declaring collective agreements without concrete sustainable employability provisions generally binding.
also requests the government to no longer declare generally binding collective agreements that contain no concrete provisions on sustainable employability
verzoekt de regering tevens om cao's die geen concrete bepalingen bevatten over duurzame inzetbaarheid, niet meer algemeen verbindend te verklaren
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over modernisering van het avv-beleid
Asks the government to study modernising the rules on generally binding declarations of collective agreements (avv) and propose changes.
requests the government to study the future of the avv legislation before summer 2014
verzoekt de regering, voor de zomer van 2014 een onderzoek te doen naar de toekomst van de avv-wetgeving
Motie van de leden Hamer en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de groter dan voorziene vraaguitval in de kinderopvang
Asks the government to talk with the childcare sector about the unexpectedly large drop in demand, investigate structural solutions, and inform the House by the Spring Memorandum.

requests the government to discuss the consequences of the demand drop with the sector, investigate whether and how structural solutions can be reached, and inform the House about this by the Spring Memorandum at the latest

verzoekt de regering, met de sector in gesprek te gaan over de gevolgen van de vraaguitval en te onderzoeken of en hoe er tot structurele oplossingen kan worden gekomen en de Kamer hierover uiterlijk bij de Voorjaarsnota te informeren
Motie van de leden Hamer en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het aanpakken van de jeugdwerkloosheid
Motion asking the government to bring together municipalities, UWV, social partners and education to tackle youth unemployment.
calls on the government to take the lead in bringing municipalities, the UWV, social partners and education together to take action against youth unemployment
roept de regering, op om het voortouw te nemen om gemeentes, het UWV, sociale partners en het onderwijs bij elkaar te brengen om acties te ondernemen om de jeugdwerkloosheid aan te pakken
Motie van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over huwelijkse gevangenschap
Asks the government to explicitly inform the public and training modules that forced marriage detention falls under the criminal offence of forced marriage.
explicitly pay attention to the fact that forced marriage detention is also classed under the term forced marriage
expliciet aandacht te besteden aan het feit dat ook huwelijkse gevangenschap onder het begrip «huwelijksdwang» wordt geschaard

Amendement van het lid Schouw c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over het behouden van de uitzonderingsgronden op basis waarvan iemand die vrijwillig een tweede nationaliteit verkrijgt, het Nederlanderscha
Keeps the exceptions under which a person who voluntarily acquires a second nationality may retain Dutch nationality, by preserving a paragraph the bill would delete.
With this amendment this paragraph is kept intact and the exception situations remain.
Met dit amendement wordt dit lid intact gehouden en blijven de uitzonderingssituaties bestaan.
Motie Knops c.s. over het terugnemen van de eigen onderdanen
Asks the government to raise with countries that do not take back their nationals, and use sanctions if needed, to secure readmission.
to move these countries to take back their nationals
deze landen te bewegen hun onderdanen terug te nemen
Motie van Dam/Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor ongeschoolde arbeid
Asks the government not to grant work permits for unskilled labour to Bulgarians and Romanians in 2012.
requests the government not to grant work permits for unskilled labour to Bulgarians and Romanians in 2012
verzoekt de regering in 2012 geen tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor ongeschoolde arbeid te verlenen aan Bulgaren en Roemenen
Motie Sterk/Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over een sociaal leenstelsel voor migranten
Asks the government to investigate whether and how a social loan scheme for migrants from Central and Eastern European countries could be made accessible.
requests the government to examine the possibilities of whether and how a social loan scheme for migrants from CEE countries and possibly others can be made accessible
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken of en hoe een sociaal leenstelsel voor migranten uit MOE-landen en mogelijk anderen toegankelijk kan worden gemaakt
Motie Sterk/Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over een verbod op qat
Asks the government to send research on banning qat to the House quickly so a ban can be introduced and use reduced to zero.
calls on the government to send the research to the House promptly, in order to introduce a ban on qat
roept de regering op spoedig het onderzoek naar de Kamer te sturen, teneinde een verbod op qat te introduceren
Motie Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga c.s. over kinderopvang in land van herkomst
Asks the government to set up safe child care in countries of origin for unaccompanied minors, funded from development aid, with rapid return as the aim.
requests the government to realise, urgently in as many countries of origin as possible, safe child care aimed at a promising future in their own country
verzoekt de regering in zo veel mogelijk herkomstlanden met spoed een veilige kinderopvang gericht op een kansrijke toekomst in het eigen land te realiseren

Article 4:5, fourth paragraph, of the General Administrative Law Act does not apply.
Artikel 4:5, vierde lid, Algemene wet bestuursrecht is niet van toepassing.

Amendement van de leden Fritsma en Van Nieuwenhuijzen-Wijbenga dat regelt dat ook referenten kunnen worden beperkt in hun referentschap indien zij onjuiste gegevens verstrekken of gegevens achterhoude
Amends the Vreemdelingenwet so that a referent who supplied false information or withheld information that led to a prior refusal can no longer act as referent.
this referent can no longer act as referent
kan deze referent niet langer als referent optreden
Motie Dibi c.s. over aanpassing van de Remigratiewet
Asks the government to reconsider amending the Remigration Act so that return facilities apply only to first-generation migrants.
requests the government to review and take up the predecessor's proposal to amend the Remigration Act
verzoekt de regering het voorstel tot aanpassing aan de Remigratiewet van de ambtsvoorganger te bezien en in behandeling te nemen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de berichten '5G knokt om bandbreedte met levensreddend satellietstation voor schepen' en 'Reders bezorgd over ontmantelen Burum'

MPs Weverling, Remco Dijkstra and Aukje de Vries asked about reports on 5G interference with Inmarsat's Burum satellite station used for maritime emergency communications and on the station's possible dismantling, asking about consultations, alternatives, and timelines. The minister answered that an October 2023 agreement with Inmarsat to migrate emergency-traffic services to Greece secures maritime safety, while noting delays in answering and that no consultation with the province or municipality occurred.

Due to the agreement with Inmarsat, emergency, urgency and safety traffic is secured and there are no longer doubts about whether the Netherlands can sufficiently fulfil its obligations for maritime safety under international treaties.

Door de overeenstemming met Inmarsat is het nood-, spoed- en veiligheidsverkeer geborgd en zijn er geen twijfels meer over de vraag of Nederland de verplichtingen voor de veiligheid op zee onder de internationale verdragen voldoende kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Boucke over het bericht 'Milieuorganisaties vrezen dat nieuwe gasboringen oesterbank bij ‘Schier’ vernielen'

MPs De Groot and Boucke asked whether planned gas drilling north of Schier could damage an oyster restoration project and how this fits the North Sea Agreement and Natura 2000 rules. The minister answers that extensive assessments found no significant harm, that permits contain safeguards, and that definitive decision-making follows after objections are processed.
The concerns of the environmental organisations were raised in consultation responses. The consultation responses and advice will be taken into account in the definitive decision-making.
De zorgen van de milieuorganisaties zijn naar voren gebracht in inspraakreacties. De inspraakreacties en adviezen worden meegenomen bij de definitieve besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over de verlenging van het Europees Diploma voor de Oostvaardersplassen en Nationaal Park Weerribben-Wieden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government welcomes the renewed Council of Europe Diploma for the Oostvaardersplassen and Weerribben-Wieden, and whether Lelystad Airport's development endangers these Natura 2000 areas. The minister answered that the diploma is welcome, that the airport's routes avoid the areas (with minimum flight heights of 3,000 and 6,000 feet), and that the government will not commit to further action beyond the existing legal duty to protect Natura 2000 areas.

It concludes that the temporary connecting routes take place at a height of 6,000 feet and above, and that the earlier 2014 MER conclusion that there will be no damage to the natural characteristics of the Natura 2000 areas therefore does not change.

Hierin wordt geconcludeerd dat de tijdelijke aansluitroutes plaatsvinden op een hoogte van 6.000 voet en hoger, en dat de conclusie (uit het eerdere MER 2014) dat er geen sprake zal zijn van de aantasting van de natuurlijke kenmerken van de Natura 2000-gebieden daarom niet verandert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over 'De miljarden die de Rotterdamse haven misloopt door de stikstofcrisis'

An MP asked whether the nitrogen policy is sufficient to address the Rotterdam port's missed sustainable investments, how many investments were lost and how many permits granted, what nitrogen space exists, and whether Project Mainportontwikkeling Rotterdam compensation is complete. The minister acknowledged investment concerns, said the total lost investment cannot be stated because firms are reticent, pointed to a facet plan due end 2021 and to ongoing analysis of Voordelta compensation, and said permit data lies with the province.
I therefore cannot give a conclusive answer to the question of how many sustainable investments the Rotterdam port has missed due to the nitrogen problem.
Ik kan daarom geen sluitend antwoord geven op de vraag hoeveel duurzame investeringen de Rotterdamse Haven is misgelopen door de stikstofproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Dijk gaat schuiven, weilanden in Reeuwijk onder water’

MPs Valstar and Rudmer Heerema asked the government about a dike subsidence in Reeuwijk that farmers attribute to American crayfish burrowing, and about control of invasive crayfish. The minister answers that the cause is not yet established and that crayfish burrowing seems unlikely to be the main cause, that a national strategy process is underway, and that recreational or volunteer fishing for crayfish is not advisable.
According to the water manager, Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, it is currently unclear what caused this dike subsidence.
Het is volgens de waterbeheerder, het Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, op dit moment niet duidelijk wat de oorzaak is van deze dijkverzakking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Geurts over het NOS bericht ‘Intern onderzoek Rijkswaterstaat: files sluiting Haringvlietbrug veel langer dan gedacht’ en de bijbehorende kamerbrieven ‘Extra reistijd Har
