MPs De Groot and Geurts asked why the Haringvlietbrug closure causes longer delays than expected, what measures will reduce them, and why the two-lane variant and the bridge repair are not faster. The minister explains that the delay estimate was revised upward, that traffic management and enforcement were arranged quickly, and that the bridge replacement is already accelerated, while acknowledging no quick fix for the clamps exists yet.
Rijkswaterstaat aims to involve the region and stakeholders in a timely manner, depending on the nature of the works, the nuisance and urgency.
Rijkswaterstaat zet erop in om de regio en belanghebbenden al naar gelang de aard van de werkzaamheden, de hinder en urgentie steeds en tijdig te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de oorzaken van de actuele watersnood in delen van Nederland, België en Duitsland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether climate change caused the July 2021 flooding in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, and questioned flood-return-period assumptions and emissions policy. The minister confirmed a link between the extreme rainfall and climate change, said flood-probability estimates are periodically updated, and pointed to a planned policy table and the damage quick scan.
The current expectation is that extreme weather conditions and high Meuse water levels will occur more and more often.
De huidige verwachting is dat extreme weersomstandigheden en hoge waterstanden van de Maas steeds vaker zullen voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over nieuw gifschandaal in binnenvaart

MP Beckerman asked the ministers about a new phosphine gas incident on three inland vessels, prior warnings, prevention measures, who is responsible, and whether incidents with biocides have occurred. The government acknowledged the incident as unacceptable, explained the cause as non-compliance with existing rules for rail transport of fumigated cargo, and announced international proposals, a chain analysis due end-2021, and a criminal investigation led by police.
A criminal investigation is currently underway on the instruction of the Public Prosecutor, led by the national police unit.
Er loopt in opdracht van de Officier van Justitie nu een strafrechtelijk onderzoek, waarin de landelijke eenheid van de politie de regie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘mogelijk meer vluchten met besmette passagiers dan gedacht’

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the ministers whether a Canadian-data analysis (36% of July flights from Amsterdam to Canada carried an infected passenger, versus 9% in an NLR/RIVM study) reveals underestimated in-flight infection risk, and whether testing, mask and distancing rules are adequate. The minister answered that the NLR/RIVM study only covered aerosol inhalation in flight, used early-June prevalence and the original variant, that the government sees insufficient reason for stricter measures now, and that it will monitor the situation and reconsider if needed.

The cabinet currently sees insufficient reason, compared with the current policy on testing, the passenger health declaration, triage, masks on board and the quarantine declaration, to take additional measures.

Het kabinet ziet op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding ten opzichte van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van testen, de gezondheidsverklaring van de passagier, triage, mondkapjes aan boord en de verklaring van de quarantaineplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht 'Weggemaaide zeldzame orchidee laat waterschap koud'

An MP asks the ministers how a water board could mow a protected orchid, whether enforcement of the Nature Protection Act in public space is adequate, and how ecological verge management can be encouraged and staff trained. The minister says the matter falls to the province of Zeeland as competent authority, sees no structural enforcement problem, declines to mandate Kleurkeur or the national flora database, and promises to discuss training and report yearly on verge management.
It is up to the province of Zeeland to hold the water board to account on this and enforce if necessary.
Het is aan de provincie Zeeland om het Waterschap hierop aan te spreken en te handhaven indien dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Minister een lobbyfunctie heeft aanvaard

Rep. Leijten (SP) asked whether a minister taking a lobbying post, and two ministers leaving the Infrastructure ministry early for other jobs, breach the Handbook for ministers, and whether the generous transition allowance and workload should be changed. The government answered that the lobby ban is not breached, that taking such posts is the minister's own decision within legal limits, that the allowance is not meant to deter early departure and will not be trimmed, and that the Defence secretary's appointment was agreed with the Defence minister.
Accepting a position is not in conflict with the Handbook for ministers.
Het aanvaarden van een functie is niet in het strijd met het handboek voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht 'Geweld en overlast asielzoekers in ov regio Emmen: ’We zijn het spuugzat’'

PVV MPs asked whether asylum seekers in the Emmen public transport region were committing daily intimidation and violence against bus drivers, and demanded expulsion or an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed 7 reported incidents mostly over payment problems, said no police reports were filed, noted that the reported assault turned out not to be physical, and refused to expel offenders or halt asylum, citing legal rights and existing security measures.
Of those 7 incidents, according to Qbuzz no report and/or complaint was filed with the police.
Van die 7 incidenten is volgens Qbuzz geen melding en/of aangifte gedaan bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over de aanleg van een elektriciteitskabel door een kwetsbaar stuk van het Werelderfgoed Waddenzee

MPs Van Raan and Vestering (PvdD) asked the government about routing an offshore electricity cable through the vulnerable Wadden Sea World Heritage area, including Schiermonnikoog, and why the Eemshaven West route was chosen over Eemshaven East. The State Secretary answered that no route decision is final, that a second-phase environmental assessment and further studies will be completed before any irreversible steps, and that the government considers the wider energy transition and future connections in its choice.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd neem ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Bromet over het rapport 'Bescherming drinkwater bij het boren naar aardwarmte; Stille wateren in diepe gronden'

Two Green Left MPs asked the ministers about an Algemene Rekenkamer report finding drinking water sources inadequately protected against geothermal drilling, and whether rules, regional consultation, monitoring and subsidies should be strengthened. The state secretary answered that the Tijdelijk Beleidskader and the forthcoming Mijnbouwwet amendment already strengthen oversight, consultation of provinces and water boards is adequate, extra monitoring will be explored with SodM, and subsidy adjustments are being studied.
The advisory right of the decentralised governments is laid down in the Mining Act.
Het adviesrecht van de decentrale overheden is vastgelegd in de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de vrijstelling van de pensioenpremie voor gelegenheidswerkers onder druk staat

MPs Lodders and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether the pension premium exemption for short-term agricultural casual workers conflicts with equal treatment law, and what it costs employers if the exemption ends. The Secretary of State says the courts will decide, that social partners have reached a principle agreement subject to legal review, and that the ministry's role is limited to amending the compulsory affiliation scheme.
Whether the pension premium exemption for casual workers is or is not contrary to the law is ultimately a matter for the courts.
Of de vrijstelling van pensioenpremie bij gelegenheidswerkers al dan niet in strijd met de wet is, is uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht over Europese sancties bij werkloosheid boven de 5%

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about a proposed EU werkloosheidsnorm (unemployment norm) with sanctions above 5% unemployment, whether it could create jobs, its link to the budget norm, and whether it would require transfers between countries. The minister said member states, not Brussels, bear responsibility for unemployment, that the government will press for faster structural reform without copying the 3% deficit sanction mechanism, and declined to comment on hypothetical norms outside current EU policy.
I will not comment on possible consequences of norms that are currently not part of European policy or of the cabinet's position.
Ik ga niet in op eventuele gevolgen van normen die op dit moment geen deel uitmaken van het Europese beleid of van de kabinetsinzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de verhoging van het wettelijk minimumuurloon op Saba

Conservative MP Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asks why the minimum wage on Saba is raised before the CBS study is complete, why the decision was not debated in advance, and how it affects benefits, pensions and competitiveness. State Secretary Klijnsma answers that the increase follows agreed policy and ministerial authority without prior parliamentary procedure, that benefits and pensions are adjusted in line with it, and that local employers and the island government were consulted and already pay more than the new minimum.
Setting the amounts under the Wet minimumlonen BES is a ministerial power, without a prior-consultation (voorhang) procedure.
Het vaststellen van de bedragen op grond van de Wet minimumlonen BES is een ministeriële bevoegdheid, zonder voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord vragen Van Nieuwenhuizen - Wijbenga over het gesjoemel met loon door Europese bedrijven in de bouwsector

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports of European construction firms, including Strabag, allegedly cheating on wages and wage declarations in the Netherlands, and asked who enforces social premium payment, whether enforcement is adequate, and what measures will be taken. The minister said cross-border posting rules are a deliberate EU choice, that oneerlijke concurrentie must be fought, and that an integrated approach against schijnconstructies has been started and reported to parliament.
I cannot go into the way specific companies file declarations for wage and premium levies given the duty of confidentiality.
Op de wijze van aangifte doen voor de loon- en premieheffing door specifieke bedrijven kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht niet ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over "het bericht dat vakbondsleden voorgetrokken worden"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether collective agreements that give union members extra leave or training, and the legality, fairness and effect of such distinctions between members and non-members. The minister answered that unequal cao terms are a matter for private parties, that courts decide on legality, and that the SER was asked to consider the support base of cao agreements.
On the scope to make agreements that apply only to union members, a judgment can be requested from the court.
Over de ruimte om afspraken te maken die alleen gelden voor vakbondsleden kan een oordeel aan de rechter worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Heerma over het niet stopzetten van bijstandsuitkering bij voortvluchtige criminelen

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga and Heerma asked the state secretary why benefits to fugitive convicted criminals are not stopped and whether municipalities should be obliged to join the signal system. The state secretary agreed benefits should be stopped, reported rising signal counts, said joining is not mandatory but all municipalities participate, and noted that since 2013 municipalities must recover wrongly paid benefits.
Municipalities are not obliged to use the monthly report of the Inlichtingenbureau.
Gemeenten zijn niet verplicht om gebruik te maken van de maandelijkse rapportage van het Inlichtingenbureau.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen–Wijbenga en Hennis–Plasschaert over de automatische registratie van de Turkse nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (GBA)

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether children of Turkish parents are wrongly registered with dual nationality in the GBA, whether that is undesirable, and what the status is of the Basisregistratie personen amendment limiting registration of foreign nationality. The minister answered that GBA registration is declaratory, that the Turkish authorities have not yet responded to a request for clarification, and that the planned amendment concerns registration of foreign nationality rather than its determination.
As soon as I have received the Turkish response, I will inform you about it.
Zodra ik de Turkse reactie heb ontvangen, zal ik u hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Dijkhoff over misbruik van de visavrijstelling voor inwoners van Balkan-landen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about asylum applications from Western Balkan nationals since visa liberalisation, whether they are economic migrants, and whether alternatives to ending visa-free travel exist. The minister gave asylum figures by country (2012 unavailable due to the INDiGO system), said most applications are unfounded, and described the EU emergency brake and a joint letter to the Commission asking for measures against abuse.
For 2012 I do not have the requested data available per country.
Voor 2012 heb ik de gevraagde gegevens per land niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de mishandeling van een Oegandese Gaypride bezoeker

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether suspects in the assault of an Ugandan Gay Pride visitor had been arrested, whether they belonged to a Ugandan party, their nationality, whether a doubled prosecution demand applies for discriminatory assault, and what measures will be taken against homophobia imported from other countries. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing so no details can be shared, that the Discrimination Directive would apply with a 50% or 100% increase in the demand if the case is prosecuted, and that discriminatory expression and violence are punishable regardless of the convictions behind them.
This investigation is still ongoing, which is why I make no further statements about it.
Dit onderzoek loopt nog, reden waarom ik daar verder geen mededelingen over doe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over advocaten die geadviseerd worden hoe zij om dienen te gaan met de nieuwe verscherpte regels voor gezinsmigratie

An MP asked the minister whether FORUM's planned course advising lawyers on the new stricter family migration rules should be funded from its subsidy, and whether subsidy conditions should change. The minister answered that the course is financed from participants' fees, the immigration programme line is not subsidised, and FORUM distanced itself from an unfortunate online announcement.
The 'Immigration and Citizenship' programme line is neither directly nor indirectly subsidised by me.
De programmalijn «Immigratie en Burgerschap» wordt direct noch indirect door mij gesubsidieerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Nieuwenhuizen over de cijfers van Eurostat waaruit is gebleken dat Nederland ruim twee keer zoveel asielaanvragen inwilligt dan het gemiddelde van Europese lidstaten

An MP from the VVD asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum why Eurostat figures show the Netherlands grants asylum at more than twice the EU average, and how that squares with a common EU system. The minister answered that a detailed case comparison is not possible with the available data, pointed to the Dutch short procedure for hopeless claims as a likely factor, said Dutch harmonisation efforts continue, and noted the gap with the EU average narrowed from 25 to 18 percentage points between 2008 and 2011.
I will also ask the European Commission to investigate the underlying reasons for the differences between member states' grant rates.
Ik zal daarnaast de Europese Commissie vragen onderzoek te doen naar de onderliggende redenen van de verschillen tussen de inwilligingspercentages van de lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat Europa de deur open zet voor meer buurlanden

An MP asked the immigration minister about EU mobility partnerships with neighbouring countries, including whether the Netherlands is involved, whether visa facilitation risks Dutch immigration policy, and how enforceable readmission and border commitments are. The government answered that partnerships are always tied to readmission agreements, that visa facilitation does not ease entry for poor migrants, and that breaches would be addressed through a Joint Readmission Committee and possibly suspension of visa facilitation.
Should this not lead to a result, that will be grounds for the Netherlands to press for suspension or termination of the visa facilitation linked to the mobility partnership.

Mocht dit niet tot resultaat leiden, dan zal dat grond zijn voor Nederland om in te zetten op het opschorten of beëindigen van de eventueel aan het mobiliteitspartnerschap gekoppelde visumfacilitatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga (VVD) over het bericht dat Belgische artsen frauderen met dossiers van asielzoekers

An MP asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether he knew of reports that Belgian doctors and psychologists committed fraud with asylum seekers' medical files, whether similar cases occur in the Netherlands, and whether lying asylum seekers and involved doctors should face revocation, expulsion and enforcement. The minister confirmed the report, described the BMA's critical assessment and possible independent expert referral without giving Dutch cases, and said permits can be revoked for false information while doctors fall under disciplinary law.
When an alien has provided incorrect information or withheld relevant information that led to granting a permit, the residence permit can be revoked.
Wanneer een vreemdeling onjuiste gegevens heeft verstrekt of gegevens heeft achtergehouden die hebben geleid tot vergunningverlening kan de verblijfsvergunning worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de marechaussee bijna de helft van de illegalen laat lopen

An MP asked the minister whether the Royal Marechaussee lets nearly half of detected illegal residents go without knowing what happened to them, and whether those cases were followed up. The minister denied the 45% figure, explained the outcomes (detention, self-departure, handover to Belgium or Germany) and said all cases are registered.

Vragen van de leden Lucas, Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (allen VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over studiefinanciering voor studenten u

MPs asked how many foreign students who also count as migrant workers receive study finance, the EU basis for the rule, other social provisions open to them, how hours worked are checked, and whether the eligibility threshold can be tightened. The state secretary reported a rising share of migrant-worker students among EU students, cited EU law and the Dutch 32-hour monthly norm checked by DUO, and announced raising the norm to 56 hours from next year.
I intend to implement this tightening with effect from next calendar year.
Ik ben voornemens deze aanscherping met ingang van volgend kalenderjaar door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Antwoord vragen Knops en Van Nieuwenhuizen over een hek op de grens tussen Griekenland en Turkije om de toestroom van illegale immigranten tegen te gaan

MPs Knops and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether Greece is building a fence on the Turkish border to curb illegal immigration, about its cost, EU funding refusal, Frontex and EASO support, and cooperation with Turkey on readmission. The minister confirmed construction, said the fence has at most a local and temporary effect, and described Dutch and EU support and ongoing talks with Turkey, without any strong commitments.
The fence may have a local effect, so that the inflow of illegal migrants through that part of Greece's external border with Turkey will decrease, possibly only temporarily.
Het hek heeft mogelijk een plaatselijk effect waardoor de instroom van illegale migranten, en dan mogelijk tijdelijk, via dat deel van de buitengrens van Griekenland met Turkije zal afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.

Vragen van de leden Knops (CDA) en Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de Iraakse regering die niet langer wil meewerken aan gedwongen terugkeer van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers uit Ned

MPs Knops (CDA) and Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) asked why Iraq no longer cooperates with forced return of rejected asylum seekers from the Netherlands and other EU states, and what the government will do about it. The minister says Iraq now requires a travel document for forced return, is in talks with Iraqi authorities, notes Denmark, Norway and the UK have return MoUs, and will press Iraq diplomatically and consider sanctions if needed.
I have spoken with the Iraqi ambassador in the Netherlands about the situation that has arisen and about possibilities to carry out forced return of undocumented aliens.
Ik heb met de Iraakse ambassadeur in Nederland gesproken over de ontstane situatie en over mogelijkheden om de gedwongen terugkeer van ongedocumenteerde vreemdelingen te effectueren.
Vragen van het lid van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat gemeenten opvang bieden aan illegalen (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

An MP asked the Immigration Minister about reports that municipalities continue to shelter undocumented migrants despite a 2007 agreement ending emergency shelter by 2010, and what action will be taken. The minister acknowledged some municipalities keep emergency shelter in their coalition programmes, said he regularly discusses it with the VNG and the DT&V, and listed national measures while urging municipalities to refer cases to the DT&V rather than announcing sanctions.
I maintain that providing structural emergency shelter by municipalities or social organisations is undesirable and unnecessary.
Ik blijf van mening dat het bieden van structurele noodopvang door gemeenten of maatschappelijke organisaties onwenselijk en onnodig is.
Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Dijkhoff (beiden VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over problemen met het visumvrije verkeer met Bosnië-Herzegovina (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the immigration minister about asylum applications from Bosnia-Herzegovina, the EU visa-monitoring arrangements with the Western Balkans, and whether the visa-free regime could be reversed. The government answered that asylum applications from Bosnia-Herzegovina have not risen disproportionately in the Netherlands, that the monitoring arrangements are sufficiently respected, and that the visa-free regime is reversible, while the emergency-brake amendment to the EU visa regulation is not yet finalised.
The cabinet is of the view that the agreements made are sufficiently being complied with.
Het kabinet is van mening dat de gemaakte afspraken voldoende worden nageleefd.

Vragen van de leden De Liefde en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de subsidiëring van gescheiden zwemmen (ingezon

VVD MPs asked the ministers why the Amsterdam swim club De Waterlelie received subsidy for gender-segregated swimming under the KNZB's Swim2Gether project, and whether such integration-hindering activities would be ended. The government acknowledged that segregated swimming with state subsidy sends an unintegrative message, said the subsidies had already ended, and listed the other sports organisations that had received similar funding.
By offering segregated swimming with government support, a message is sent that it is accepted in the Netherlands that men and women should not come into contact with each other while swimming.

Door gescheiden zwemmen aan te bieden met overheidssteun wordt een boodschap afgegeven dat het in Nederland geaccepteerd is dat mannen en vrouwen tijdens het zwemmen niet met elkaar in contact horen te komen.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over onderzoek van de GGD naar vermeende kindermishandeling bij de weekendlessen in een Tilburgse moskee (ingezonde

An MP asked the minister whether the GGD had been tasked to investigate alleged child abuse at weekend classes in a Tilburg mosque, and why Tilburg and Amsterdam were not chosen for the GGD study. The minister answered that a misunderstanding had arisen between two separate studies, explained the criteria for city selection, and said the GGD study continues with results expected in late 2011.
Apparently a misunderstanding arose because two studies were confused with each other.
Er is kennelijk een misverstand ontstaan doordat er twee onderzoeken door elkaar zijn gehaald.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de ministers van Immigratie en Asiel en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een proactieve informatie en communicatiestrategie van de EU op het terrein van arbeidsmigr

MP Van Nieuwenhuizen asked the ministers whether the EU Commission should run a proactive communication strategy promoting labour migration from non-EU countries and whether the Netherlands should oppose it and any EU funding for it. The minister replied that member states decide on admission of third-country workers, that labour migration should follow domestic and EU labour supply, and that he would raise objections with the Commission, while seeing a possible EU role only for highly skilled migration.
Yes, in my contacts with the European Commission I will point out the undesirability of a proactive information and communication strategy by the European Commission using European funds.
Ja, in mijn contacten met de Europese Commissie zal ik wijzen op de onwenselijkheid van een proactieve informatie- en communicatiestrategie door de Europese commissie met de inzet van Europees geld.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Van der Burg (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over subsidieverstrekking aan

Two VVD MPs asked whether ZonMw, partly funded by VWS, should subsidise the Opvoedmix.nl website, which gives Islamic parenting advice they consider integration-hindering, and what steps would follow. The state secretary answered that ZonMw funds projects under criteria agreed in advance, that it has asked ZonMw and the project to review the 'Islam and upbringing' section with the aim of better matching mainstream parenting practice, and that no comparable religion-based sites with government funding are known.

Following the questions, I have asked ZonMw to critically review, together with the project implementer, the specific 'Islam and upbringing' section and, where necessary, ask the implementer to better align the texts with mainstream parenting practice.

Naar aanleiding van de gestelde vragen heb ik ZonMw gevraagd om samen met de projectuitvoerder kritisch de specifieke rubriek «islam en opvoeding» door te nemen en de uitvoerder waar nodig te vragen teksten beter te laten aansluiten bij de gangbare opvoedpraktijk.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over problemen rondom het burgerlijk huwelijk (i

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether civil registrars may marry couples already religiously wed, how a legal ban could work, and how to ensure couples understand the ceremony. The minister answered that religious ceremonies have no legal effect, a statutory ban would be counterproductive, and registrars must be satisfied couples understand, with interpreters arranged if needed.
Giving formal status to an earlier religious ceremony would undermine the principle that the Netherlands recognises only civil marriage.
Het geven van een formele status aan een eerdere religieuze plechtigheid zou afbreuk doen aan het uitgangspunt dat Nederland alleen het burgerlijk huwelijk kent.
Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het bericht dat illegale vreemdelingen geld wordt geboden om te vertrekken (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

An MP asks whether the Dienst Terugkeer & Vertrek (DT&V) has discretion to pay departure allowances to rejected asylum seekers, what criteria and maximum amounts apply, and whether this risks arbitrariness or pull effects compared with IOM assistance. The minister answers that payments are case-by-case maxi-benefit arrangements (highest about €5,600, average about €840), that IOM support is primary and more generous, and that no pull effect is expected.
The highest financial contribution given to an individual foreigner amounts to approximately €5,600.
De hoogste financiële bijdrage die aan een individuele vreemdeling is verstrekt, bedraagt circa € 5 600,–.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Bosman (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat het conceptwetsvoorstel Rijkswet Personenverkee

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the draft Rijkswet Personenverkeer had been shelved and why it must be withdrawn and renegotiated, given Curaçao's reluctance and the need for reciprocity. The minister confirmed a new approach in close consultation with the Caribbean countries, with the aim of informing the Tweede Kamer by year-end.
My aim is to inform the House of Representatives by the end of the year about the main lines of a regulation.
Mijn streven is om de Tweede Kamer eind van het jaar te informeren over de hoofdlijnen van een regeling.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de herplaatsing van een handenweigerende docent aan de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether the Hogeschool van Amsterdam was right to reinstate a teacher who refused to shake hands with women, whether other public bodies had similar policies, and what the cost of an external adviser was. The minister answered that the school board is responsible and bound by equal treatment law, that the board found reinstatement unworkable so the contract will be terminated, that the school is not a public-law body, and that the cost of the adviser is unknown to him.
It is the authority and duty of the executive board to find a solution for the situation that has arisen.
Het is de bevoegdheid en de taak van het college van bestuur een oplossing te vinden voor de ontstane situatie.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verzoek van Eurocommissaris Malmström Eritrese vluchtelinge

Two VVD MPs asked the Immigration minister and State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether the Netherlands would accept Eritrean refugees in North Africa proposed for EU relocation by Commissioner Malmström, and whether this made FRONTEX redundant. The government answered that resettlement would only occur within the Dutch quota with priority on regional reception and return, and that it supports regional aid through UNHCR, IOM and the Red Cross.
Only insofar as this fits within the Dutch quota for invited refugees (resettlement).
Uitsluitend voor zover dit past binnen het Nederlandse quotum voor uitgenodigde vluchtelingen (hervestiging).

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizenen Ten Broeke(beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over Turkse kritiek op het Nederlandse imm

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen and Ten Broeke asked the ministers about Turkish criticism of Dutch immigration and integration policy, Turkish government interference, Turkish visa fees, minority rights in Turkey, and EU accession. The government rejected the interference claims, said it raised fee reductions and minority rights with Ankara, and treated the integration issue as bilateral.
The Netherlands itself determines the integration conditions for migrants.
Nederland bepaalt zelf de integratievoorwaarden voor migranten.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie dat een in Europa geboren kind de ouders een verblijfsrecht geeft (ingezonden 9 maar

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether a Court of Justice ruling that a child born in Europe gives its parents a right of residence lets parents of EU-national minors automatically live and work in that country, and what the consequences are for migration, Schengen and asylum procedures. The minister refers to a letter sent the same day and to answers to earlier questions, and states that residence conditions are for member states to set, that Dutch nationality is not obtained by birth in such a case, and that children like those in the case do not meet the three-year admission requirement.
For the answers to these questions I refer to the aforementioned letter to your House of today and to the answers to the questions from MP Fritsma (PVV).
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar de eerdergenoemde brief aan uw Kamer van heden en de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Fritsma (PVV)

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Azmani (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het rapport van de Universiteit Utrecht en de Vrije

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Social Affairs about the Utrecht/VU report on Diyanet, the Turkish state religious authority, including whether Turkish imams in the Netherlands are employed by Diyanet, whether Diyanet links to Gülen movement activities exist, and whether subsidies to Diyanet-linked organisations should stop. The minister answered that the government holds no data on imams or mosques, that a foreign state's contacts with its nationals should be voluntary, that no Diyanet-Gülen cooperation was found, and that no subsidies go to integration-obstructing organisations.
The central government keeps no figures on the number of mosques in the Netherlands and has no insight into the number of imams or the type of employment they have.
De Rijksoverheid houdt geen cijfers bij van het aantal moskeeën in Nederland en heeft ook geen zicht op het aantal imams en het soort dienstverband dat zij hebben.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat criminele vreemdelingen met valse paspoorten moeiteloos kunnen onderduiken in

An MP asks the ministers whether false passports can easily be used to abuse the asylum procedure, whether checks were bypassed, and how many abuse cases exist in asylum and regular procedures. The government answers that the false passport was caught at entry, around twenty to thirty asylum permits were revoked in 2009-2010 for incorrect information, and no figures exist for regular-procedure cases.
Figures on the number of rejections due to submitting a false passport are not available.
Cijfers over het aantal afwijzingen wegens het overleggen van een vals paspoort zijn niet voorhanden.

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Dijkhoff (beiden VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel en de staatsecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichtgeving dat de ICCO jarenlang asielzoekers heeft meegenom

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about press reports that ICCO staff had for years brought asylum seekers to the Netherlands, including the number of cases, government knowledge, subsidy use and repayment. The state secretary answered that ICCO denied knowledge of such practices and had demanded rectification, gave the approximate annual subsidy, agreed that such selection by an aid organisation is undesirable, and referred back to the answer on the earlier questions for the remaining points.
ICCO has indicated that it is not aware of practices such as those mentioned in the articles you cite.
ICCO heeft aangegeven niet bekend te zijn met praktijken zoals die worden genoemd in de door u aangehaalde artikelen.

Vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de beslissing van de Raad van State dat illegalen niet meer aan de grens mogen worden aangehouden (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister for Immigration and Asylum about the Council of State ruling that border checks on irregular migrants near the Belgian and German borders are unlawful, and about compensation awarded to a detained migrant. The minister confirms the ruling limits Marechaussee immigration powers near the borders, says a legal basis for such checks will be provided quickly through an amendment to the Vreemdelingenbesluit, and sends a letter to parliament on the consequences.
It follows from the ruling that checks near the border with Belgium and Germany based on article 50 of the Vw2000 and A3/2.4 of the Vreemdelingencirculaire 2000 are unlawful.
Uit de uitspraak volgt dat controles nabij de grens met België en Duitsland die zijn gebaseerd op artikel 50 van de Vw2000 en A3/2.4 van de Vreemdelingencirculaire 2000 onrechtmatig zijn.

Vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de jihadwebsite Ansar Al Mujahideen (ingezonden 1

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen asked whether Dutch Islamist extremists run, fund and host the jihadist website Ansar Al Mujahideen and related sites, whether Dutch persons co-produce the magazine Inspire, and what action the government will take. The minister answered that jihadist websites generally target Western youth, that he has no information showing increasing Dutch operation or involvement, that he cannot publicly discuss specific Dutch involvement and will brief the intelligence committee, and that both sites have since gone offline.
In public I cannot make statements about the involvement of Dutch nationals or details of other kinds in relation to the specific websites
In het openbaar kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de betrokkenheid van Nederlanders of details van andere aard in relatie tot de specifieke websites

Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Ten Broeke (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het uitstel van toetreding van Roemenië en Bulgarije tot het Schengen-verdrag (ing

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Romania and Bulgaria were ready for Schengen accession in 2011, given shortcomings in EU reports on organised crime, corruption and border control, and whether the Netherlands would press with France for a delay and a structural link to the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism. The government answered that it would seek to delay accession until the Commission's summer 2011 report and tie approval to strict criteria, while judging a legal link to the CVM unfeasible and planning to oppose new CVMs for future entrants.
The Netherlands will work to ensure that new EU entrants are not again subject to a CVM like the one now in place for Bulgaria and Romania.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat voor nieuwe EU-toetreders niet opnieuw een CVM, zoals dat nu bestaat voor Bulgarije en Roemenië, worden ingesteld

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Sterk (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Spekman (PvdA), Schouw (D66), Van Klaveren (PVV), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel ov

MPs from several parties asked the immigration minister about a Stichting Gave survey reporting discrimination and threats against Christians and ex-Muslims in asylum centres, and about COA rules, reporting, police complaints, a confidential contact point and detention or revocation of asylum for perpetrators. The minister answered that the survey was methodologically flawed and small, that COA records show only three incidents between Muslims and Christians in two years, that complaints channels already exist, and that a separate confidential contact person is unnecessary; he declined to add a new study or automatic asylum revocation.
The COA will address this survey in the regular consultation with Stichting Gave.
Het COA zal in het reguliere overleg met Stichting Gave aandacht besteden aan deze peiling.

Vragen van de leden De Rouwe (CDA), Van Nieuwenhuizen (VVD), Samsom (PvdA) en Sharpe (PVV) aan de minister van Financiën over mogelijke significante verhoging transfertarieven (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

MPs from CDA, VVD, PvdA and PVV asked the Finance Minister about a possible significant rise in Schiphol transfer tariffs and whether this breached earlier commitments to freeze tariffs. The minister, as shareholder, answered that the limited tariff increase is consistent with Schiphol's commitments, deferred questions on network quality to the state secretary, and said he has no formal control over tariffs or the consultation process.
As a shareholder, I do not decide on Schiphol's tariffs.
Als aandeelhouder ga ik niet over de tarieven van Schiphol.

Vragen van de leden van Nieuwenhuizen en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over mogelijke windfall profits in de energie-intensieve indust

MPs Nieuwenhuizen and Neppérus asked the ministers about a Nera critique of a CE Delft study on whether energy-intensive industry gained windfall profits from free ETS allowances, and whether the government still stands by its position. The minister disagrees with Nera's critique, sees no reason to revise the position that allowance costs were passed through, and says the report does not change the Dutch stance on carbon leakage lists.
I see no reason to revise my position.
Ik zie geen reden om mijn standpunt te herzien.

Vragen van de leden van Nieuwenhuizen en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de hinder die luchthaven Schiphol ondervindt van ganzen (ingezonde

MPs Nieuwenhuizen and Lodders asked whether bird strikes with geese at Schiphol had doubled, how Noord-Holland manages goose control, and whether the province should be pressed to tighten policy. The minister answered that only six goose strikes occurred in five years, that preventive measures are necessary and under review, and that any tightening would be discussed in the national bird-strike steering group.
Yes, I share that concern. The preventive measures being taken are all necessary.
Ja, ik deel die zorg. De preventieve maatregelen die genomen worden zijn alle nodig.
Vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen en Hennis-Plasschaert (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over Europese richtsnoeren staatssteun zeehavens (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

Two VVD MPs asked the transport minister whether he knows the European Commission has delayed its draft state aid guidelines for seaports and whether he will press for swift adoption in the Transport Council and directly with the Commission. The minister confirmed the delay, said he has repeatedly raised it with the Commissioner and will do so while in office, and announced that officials will brief DG Competition and a joint Dutch-German position is being prepared.
On several occasions I have raised with the Commissioner the failure to produce the guidelines.
Verschillende malen heb ik de Commissaris aangesproken op het uitblijven van de richtsnoeren.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Profronde van Noord-Holland blaast alles af bij gebrek aan politiebegeleiding'

MPs Heerema and others asked whether cycling races are being cancelled for lack of police escorts and what legal rules prevent races without full police escort. The minister answered that no races were cancelled solely for lack of police motorcycle escorts, that no legal rule bars races without police escort, and that an experiment with trained civilian traffic marshals is being examined given existing legal limits.
There is no legal rule that prevents the passage of races without police escort.
Er bestaat geen wettelijke regel die de doorgang van koersen zonder politiebegeleiding verhindert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de documenten behorend bij het besluit op het Wob-verzoek inzake Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS)-melding Lelystad Airport d.d. 16 juli 2021

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the nitrogen calculations for the Lelystad Airport PAS notification, which appeared to be wrong, still permit legalisation, whether the errors were culpable, and why the ministry pursued the notification despite unresolved questions. The Minister answered that the notification meets the legalisation criteria, that the competent authority presumes good faith, that verification is still ongoing so no conclusions can yet be drawn, and that the 'top priority' label was an internal civil-servant qualification.
It is not advisable to make statements in advance about the outcomes of the legalisation process.
Het is niet verstandig om vooruitlopend hierop uitspraken te doen over de uitkomsten van het legalisatieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het geven van ‘topprioriteit’ aan de legalisatie van de stik stofvergunning van Lelystad Airport

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asks whether giving 'top priority' to legalising Lelystad Airport's nitrogen permit crowds out nitrogen space for housing and agriculture, and presses on the 43 MW heat-content assumption in the emissions modelling, the handling of an Arcadis memo and the timing of disclosures to parliament. The minister answers that the aviation share of nitrogen deposition is small, that the 'top priority' label was an internal civil-servant term, that the heat-content choice reflects the OPS model's limits, and that the Chamber was informed of relevant developments.
It is the task of civil servants to advise the minister concerned on possible courses of action in a specific file.
Het is de taak van ambtenaren om de betrokken bewindspersoon te adviseren over mogelijke handelingsopties in een specifiek dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wuite over het artikel 'Rapport over Caribische luchtvaart al twee jaar in onderste la ministerie I&W'

Two MPs from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about a report on Caribbean aviation connectivity that had reportedly sat unactioned at the ministry, and about the status of recommendations, Winair support, the ferry tender and alternatives. The minister confirmed dunne routes exist, said the Winair state-participation evaluation is complete but still being discussed with departments and will be sent to parliament later, and said he is exploring a public service obligation and easing airline establishment rules.
The evaluation, including the follow-up being given to it, is currently being discussed with the most involved departments. Once this is completed I will send you the evaluation and policy response.

De evaluatie, inclusief de opvolging die daaraan wordt gegeven wordt momenteel met de meest betrokken departementen besproken. Zodra dit is afgerond zal ik u de evaluatie en beleidsreactie doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de aanpak van de N50, tussen Zwolle en Kampen (v.v.)

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the N50 between Zwolle and Kampen has not been widened despite repeated motions and serious accidents, and what measures will improve safety. The minister answers that the project was cut in 2013 for budget reasons, is now stalled by nitrogen rules, that safety measures and a motion-based study are underway, and that answers could not be given by the requested date.

At present, the consequences of the cabinet decision on the maximum calculation distance for nitrogen calculations for the planning and capacity needs of this project and other projects are being mapped.

Op dit moment wordt in beeld gebracht wat de gevolgen van het kabinetsbesluit over de maximale rekenafstand bij stikstofberekeningen zijn voor de planning en capaciteitsbehoefte van dit project en andere projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over de brief ‘Beperkingen op de Haringvlietbrug voor het wegverkeer en de scheepvaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Haringvlietbridge restrictions had been tested for safety and lifespan, what monitoring applies, what alternatives and market involvement were considered, and whether budget shortfalls for maintenance are a factor. The minister answered that speed was cut to 50 km/h to reduce vibrations, weekly inspections will monitor the bridge, no solution yet exists for the clamps, and the wider maintenance budget shortfall will likely cause similar situations at other bridges.
The monitoring will take place through weekly inspections of the bridge.
De monitoring zal door wekelijkse inspecties van de brug plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de snelheidsverlaging op de Haringvlietbrug

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the 50 km/h speed limit and lane restriction on the Haringvlietbrug, asking about alternatives, reopening lanes and speeding for the bridge's replacement. The minister said two lanes per direction have reopened, a widening and a faster replacement are planned, and alternatives are being considered and tested.
Rijkswaterstaat is doing everything it can to carry out the replacement as quickly as possible.
Rijkswaterstaat doet er alles aan om de vervanging zo snel mogelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de problemen veroorzaakt door werk aan de Haringvlietbrug

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why warnings about the Haringvlietbridge from 2017 were not acted on in time, what alternatives were considered, who will compensate transport-sector losses, and whether other bridges are at risk. The minister replied that signals were addressed with temporary reinforcements and that replacement is planned from 2023, that alternatives were assessed but rejected or unresolved, that compensation claims are possible under existing policy, and that other bridges are considered not directly affected though aging infrastructure will pose more such situations.
The approach to the bridge was subsequently included in the Replacement and Renovation programme and the planning phase was started.
Vervolgens is de aanpak van de brug opgenomen in het programma Vervanging en Renovatie en is gestart met de planfase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de jarenlange afsluiting van rijbanen op de Haringvlietbrug

An MP asked the minister about long-running lane closures on the Haringvlietbrug, the resulting traffic disruption, the failed clamp repairs since 2017, compensation for employers, possible acceleration of renovation and funding for infrastructure maintenance. The minister acknowledged the disruption, described the mitigation measures and the planning, and said compensation claims are assessed under existing policy, while maintenance funding gaps are for the next cabinet to address.
The design of the new clamps came about in 2017 from an expert meeting of Rijkswaterstaat with various contractors and engineering firms.
Het ontwerp van de nieuwe klemmen is in 2017 tot stand gekomen uit een expertmeeting van Rijkswaterstaat met verschillende aannemers en ingenieursbureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Aviation Is as Sustainable Now as It Will Be in Your Lifetime’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Bloomberg opinion piece claiming aviation biofuels are not truly sustainable, including whether the term Sustainable Aviation Fuel is misleading, whether 10% lower-emission fuels count, and whether biofuels with higher volumetric fuel use raise emissions. The Minister rejects the article's claims, defends the SAF terminology and the RED-based definition, argues that energy density of SAF is nearly equal to kerosene, and states a commitment to push for a European blending obligation.
For this reason, I will actively work to introduce a European blending obligation.
Om deze reden zal ik mij actief inzetten voor de invoering van een Europese bijmengverplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Gemeenten slaan alarm om volledige afsluiting A12: Ernstige gevolgen voor verkeer'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Rijkswaterstaat chose a nine-day full closure of the A12 motorway, its traffic effects, consultation with municipalities, and compensation for businesses. The minister answered in detail on the rationale, consultation with the region and stakeholders, alternatives considered, and commitments to inform parliament, while stating that the 'Staat van de Infrastructuur' will show planned works per region.
For this reason, the State of the Infrastructure, which the House will receive in December, will make clearer which large-scale works are planned per region.
Daarom zal bij de Staat van de Infrastructuur, die uw Kamer in december a.s. zal ontvangen, beter inzichtelijk worden gemaakt welke grootschalige werkzaamheden per regio gepland staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Hagen over het bericht ‘IJzeretende bacterie gevonden in Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of an iron-eating bacterium in the Ghent-Terneuzen canal, its risks to ships and dams, whether it has reached the Dutch side, and whether the canal should be closed. The minister answered that no damage on the Dutch side is known yet, that Rijkswaterstaat will inspect locations with results expected in October, and that closure is not an option, while cooperation with Flanders on the cause is ongoing.
Rijkswaterstaat will participate in the investigation announced by Flanders and carry out targeted inspections itself.
Rijkswaterstaat zal participeren in het onderzoek dat Vlaanderen heeft aangekondigd en zelf gerichte inspecties uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Madlener over de achterstand bij het CBR

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the backlog of driving exams at the CBR, its waiting times, the effect on road safety, exemptions for drivers over 75, driving school standards and whether a second exam body should be allowed. The minister replies that a taskforce targets reducing reservation times to 7 weeks by end 2022, that the backlog is due to lockdowns and not a threat to road safety, and that stricter driving school rules and a second exam organisation are not planned.
Due to the lockdowns, the CBR had to temporarily halt its services.
Door de lockdowns heeft het CBR zijn dienstverlening tijdelijk moeten staken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel ‘Spoelt granuliet toch weer weg? Wethouder wil verklaring van Rijkswaterstaat’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that granulite is washing up at the Moleneindse Waard lake near Dreumel, questioning the depth of the layer, its circular-economy status, and long-term environmental effects. The government replies that granulite meets the soil quality standards, that Arcadis is reviewing whether the actual situation matches its report, and that the Chamber will be informed once that assessment is complete.
Once the assessment is ready (expected in the autumn), I will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra de beoordeling gereed is (naar verwachting in de herfst), zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Bontrup weigerde steekproeven granuliet op eigen terrein’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister why Bontrup refused soil sampling of granulite, why the parliament was not informed, and why parts of the Arcadis review were altered or deleted. The state secretary answers that the government requested sampling but Bontrup declined, that Arcadis judged sampling no longer necessary, that the textual changes were Arcadis's own decision after a fact-check, and that no new investigation or stoppage of granulite use is planned.
Arcadis, as an independent and expert bureau, concluded that given the results of the research carried out, the need for sampling at Bontrup's production site was no longer present.

Arcadis heeft als onafhankelijk en deskundig bureau geconcludeerd dat – gezien de resultaten van het uitgevoerde onderzoek – de noodzaak voor bemonstering op de productielocatie van Bontrup niet meer aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Rutte doctrine in het granulietdossier

An MP asked why earlier written questions on granulite contamination remained unanswered, and why the minister refused substantive response to a committee request citing ongoing court proceedings. The government apologised for delay, said the documents are part of a pending lawsuit so substantive comment is not appropriate now, and promised to inform parliament of the outcome after the case.
A substantive response to your House is, as is customary with documents that are before the court, not appropriate at this time.
Een inhoudelijke reactie naar uw Kamer is, zoals te doen gebruikelijk met stukken «die onder de rechter zijn», daarom nu niet gepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en De Groot over het bericht ‘Chemelot mag 14.000 kilo microplastics per jaar in de Maas lozen’

MPs De Groot and Hagen (D66) asked whether the water permit allowing Chemelot to discharge about 14,040 kg of microplastics per year into the Maas is compatible with environmental and health protection, the precautionary principle, the Water Framework Directive and BBT, and how oversight works. The minister answers that the permit is the competence of the Limburg water board, that a research obligation with a report due January 2024 was included, and mostly refers back to earlier answers, committing to no new concrete action.
The competent authority is responsible for supervising the permits issued.
Het bevoegd gezag is verantwoordelijk voor het houden van toezicht op de afgegeven vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Verdachte chauffeur dodelijk ongeval Waalhaven reed eerder motoragent en fietsster aan’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and De Groot asked about reports that the suspect driver in a fatal Waalhaven crash had earlier struck a police motorcycle officer and a cyclist, and about prosecution, traffic-law classification, recidivism and police motorcycle safety. The Minister said the criminal investigation is ongoing and gave limited details, noting one earlier conviction, one case dismissed, and that police motorcycle training and evaluation are in place.
As there is an ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter in particular.
Aangezien er sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan ik over deze kwestie in het bijzonder geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Aukje de Vries over het incident Testcoronanu BV en de ernstige tekortkoming in de informatiebeveiliging

MPs Rajkowski and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers about the Testcoronanu BV data breach, affected travellers, the audit of the provider's security and the vetting of test providers before connection to CoronaCheck. Minister De Jonge answered that 17,638 people had appointments, that the provider is investigating whether others accessed the database, and that the ministry checks pentest reports before connection, but declined to share the providers' DPIAs and pentest reports.
However, I cannot commit to also sharing with your House the DPIAs and pentest reports submitted by the test provider.
Ik kan echter niet toezeggen dat ook de door de testaanbieder aangeleverde DPIA’s en pentestrapportages met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over de verkeersondersteuning bij wielerwegwedstrijden

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether police shortages threaten cycling road races, whether volunteer or certified motorcycle traffic marshals could replace police escorts, whether a legal status for the race caravan is being considered, and about the timeline for measures. The ministers answer that police are willing to help find solutions, that a package of no-regret measures is being implemented with evaluation by the end of 2022, and that a study into the tolerated practice of traffic rule violations will be started.
The preparations for the study into the tolerated situation regarding traffic rule violations during cycling races will be started as soon as possible.
De voorbereidingen voor het onderzoek naar de gedoogsituatie omtrent verkeersregels tijdens wielerwedstrijden zetten we zo spoedig mogelijk in gang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over testaanbieders die alsnog geld vragen voor een reizigerstest of te laat een uitslag doorgeven

An MP asked the government about private COVID test providers charging for travel tests or delivering results late, and about contractual deadlines, customer service and enforcement. The minister answered that contracts require results within 24 hours for PCR and 3 hours for antigen tests, that enforcement occurs via complaints and possible non-payment, and that a standard contract will be provided.
Test providers that do not deliver the test result on time or at all must offer an appropriate solution to the traveller concerned.
Indien testaanbieders de testuitslag, niet op tijd of niet leveren moeten zij een passende oplossing bieden aan de betreffende reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Winair bungelt aan randje faillissement'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Rudmer Heerema asked the ministers about the risks of a Winair bankruptcy for connectivity to Saba and Sint Eustatius, the financial exposure of the Netherlands, support requests, and the governance of the state shareholding. The minister answered that Winair is the only scheduled carrier to those islands, that the Netherlands has only a hypothecary loan secured on the hangar, that a steunverzoek is under review with the primary responsibility resting with Sint Maarten, and that the shareholding is being evaluated with a letter promised later this year.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform your House.
Zodra daarover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about inadequate compensation for homeowners harmed by works on the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, and whether this resembles the childcare benefits and Groningen gas-extraction affairs. The minister replied that the Rijk has no control over the canal, that the province is responsible for the compensation scheme and related procedures, and declined to take a substantive position or any role beyond expressing regret.
Because the central government has no control over this canal, I cannot give a substantive judgement on the situation.
Omdat het Rijk geen zeggenschap heeft over dit kanaal, kan ik geen inhoudelijk oordeel geven over de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Economie groeit niet door uitbreiding Schiphol, het kost alleen maar geld: nieuw onderzoek legt bom onder plannen’ van EenVandaag

An MP asked the minister whether a CE Delft cost-benefit analysis showing possible welfare losses from further Schiphol growth should prompt a reconsideration of aviation policy, and whether the government would write a shrinkage-oriented aviation note. The minister replied that CE Delft's assumptions deviate in places from the newly published guidelines, declined to write an alternative aviation note, and said the Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050 already provides clarity on growth limits.
The advice to those preparing welfare analyses and cost-benefit analyses on aviation development is to follow the recommendations in this guideline.
Het advies aan opstellers van welvaartsanalyses en MKBA’s die gaan over de ontwikkeling van de luchtvaart is om de aanbevelingen uit deze werkwijzer te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de wateroverlast in Limburg

An MP asked the government about end-June flooding in Limburg (Eygelshoven, Meerssen), whether it shares the cause of the mid-July disaster, and whether victims and entrepreneurs can get compensation when insurers do not pay. The minister answered that the June rains are not comparable to the July disaster, that the Wts does not apply, that no separate fund is planned, and that loss of turnover is excluded from Wts compensation but the government will discuss it with the region, pointing to the NOW 4 wage subsidy.
The cabinet does however want to discuss this with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives, paying attention to proportionality, feasibility and precedent.
Het kabinet wil evenwel het gesprek hierover met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers voeren, waarbij ook aandacht is voor proportionaliteit, uitvoerbaarheid en precedentwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over verzekeraars die wateroverlastschade van ondernemers in Valkenburg niet vergoeden

MP Ploumen asked ministers whether they would compensate Valkenburg business owners whose flood damage is not covered by their insurers, and whether they would press insurers such as Lloyd's to pay. The government answered that it is in contact with the insurers' association, that the Wts disaster compensation scheme can cover damage that is not reasonably insurable, that Lloyd's is mapping its exposure and will report back, and that other schemes are being examined.
Lloyd's will inform the Minister of Finance about the progress of this process.
Lloyd’s zal de Minister van Financiën informeren over de voortgang van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over tegemoetkoming gedupeerden wateroverlastschade Limburg

An MP asked the ministers whether flood victims in Limburg, many not sure their insurer will pay, should get generous support under the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen regardless of water source, and when the scheme's details and advance payments would be clarified. The minister answered that the Wts was declared applicable, that flood damage from the Maas is not reasonably insurable for private persons so they can claim compensation, that the RVO opened a damage reporting form on 9 August, and that advance payments were deferred because they would slow down assessments, with a regulation to follow as soon as possible.
The cabinet decided to declare the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) applicable to the disaster in Limburg.
Het kabinet heeft besloten om de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) van toepassing te verklaren op de ramp in Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht ‘Fietspad ‘wordt gevaarlijk’ door nieuwe elektrische voertuigen’

MP Eppink asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she shares concerns from Veilig Verkeer Nederland and the Fietsersbond that the new light electric vehicle framework makes cycle paths unsafe for traditional cyclists, and what concrete consultation took place. The minister replies that safety was central, that stakeholders including these groups were consulted, and that further research on local customisation and cycle-path crowding will be shared by early next year.
Further research is being conducted into the possibilities and any necessity for local customisation regarding the position on the road.
Er wordt nog nader onderzoek gedaan naar de mogelijkheden en eventuele noodzaak voor lokaal maatwerk ten aanzien van de plaats op de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht ‘Kan zonnebrand koraal aantasten?’

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that sunscreen chemicals harm coral, the Bonaire ban on oxybenzone-containing products, and whether Dutch waters are polluted by UV filters. The minister acknowledged the Bonaire motion and the need for regulation, said UV-filter levels in Dutch surface water were below reporting limits, noted monitoring around the BES islands is planned, and pointed to ongoing EU REACH assessments of octinoxate and oxybenzone without committing to new national measures.
A monitoring programme around the BES islands is currently being prepared and will likely start in 2022.
Op dit moment wordt een monitoringsprogramma rond de BES-eilanden voorbereid dat waarschijnlijk in 2022 van start kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bontenbal over mogelijke extra kosten bij snelladers voor automobilisten

MPs Geurts and Bontenbal asked whether drivers at DC fast chargers receive less energy than they pay for, and whether a legal framework is needed for metering. The State Secretary replied that energy loss is priced in, consumer rules already apply, and she will push for harmonised EU metrology rules and consider national rules once international standards exist.
I suggest the next cabinet consider, once there is international agreement on the requirements, whether it is possible and desirable to anchor them in national regulation in advance.

Ik geef het volgende kabinet in overweging om, zodra er internationale overeenstemming is over de te stellen eisen, te bezien of het mogelijk en wenselijk is deze alvast in nationale regelgeving te verankeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over ’de uitruil van geluidsruimte tussen kleine en grote luchtvaart op Groningen Airport Eelde’

An MP asked whether the Groningen Airport Eelde noise-allowance conversion regulation, which exchanged noise room between small and large aviation, could be challenged in court and whether it could increase noise and nitrogen emissions. The minister answered that the conversion was a one-to-one transposition with no new legal effects, so no appeal is open, that the total noise room is unchanged, and that a new airport decision will be appealable.

Given that the conversion regulation was a one-to-one transposition of the use provisions of the designation decision, producing no new legal effects, the RBML law provides that no objection procedure or appeal to the administrative court is open against it.

Gezien het feit dat de omzettingsregeling daarmee een één op één omzetting van de gebruiksbepalingen van het aanwijzingsbesluit betrof waaruit geen nieuwe rechtsgevolgen voortvloeiden is in de wet RBML bepaald dat tegen de omzettingsregeling geen mogelijkheid van een bezwaarschriftprocedure of een beroep op de bestuursrechter openstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Minhas over het bericht ‘Chauffeurs balen van uitblijven oplossing voor onveilige bussen: Gemeenten en provincies blijven maar naar elkaar verwijzen’

MPs Wiersma and Minhas asked about reports that public transport between Emmen and Ter Apel remains unsafe due to nuisance by asylum seekers and that municipalities and provinces refer responsibility to each other. The government answers that incidents, mostly fare-payment problems, have fallen sharply since 2019 thanks to measures such as steward deployment, a pilot for a regional travel ban, and a 1 million euro municipal budget, while it does not register residence status of those involved.
The police and transport operators do not record the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Smeulders over de funderingsproblematiek in Friesland en over het artikel 'Provincie Fryslân gaat huiseigenaren betrekken bij oplossen funderingsschade'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about foundation damage in Friesland caused by lowered water tables in peat meadow areas, and about the responsibility, legal framework and lack of data on affected homes. The minister explained that water boards and municipalities bear care duties, that compensation depends on whether a water-level change is lawful and natural subsidence, that no research on the specific problem exists, and that the cabinet's response to the advisory report was sent to the House.
No research is currently being carried out to map this specific problem.
Er wordt op dit moment geen onderzoek uitgevoerd om deze specifieke problematiek in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘EU-leiders willen sancties tegen Wit-Rusland en eisen vrijlating Protasevitsj’

MPs Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would go further than the EU's announced measures against Belarus after the forced landing and arrest of Roman Protasevich, including sanctions on state firms, diplomats, airlines and airspace. The minister answered that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions, sectoral sanctions, a flight ban on Belarusian airlines, and that Dutch law was amended, while further national unilateral measures were judged ineffective.
The cabinet cannot share information on the total number of Belarusian diplomats accredited in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan geen informatie delen over het totaalaantal Belarussische diplomaten dat in Nederland geaccrediteerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Vaarweg naar Stellendam gevaarlijk voor schepen: ‘Hier kunnen doden vallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Slijkgat shipping channel to Stellendam is silting up and dangerous for boats, and why this has not been fixed despite an accident in April. The minister answered that there is no current danger, that the channel can silt up quickly under high river discharge, that Rijkswaterstaat dredges and re-buoys it and will look at faster communication to recreational shipping, and that responsibility for the 5.5 m depth is shared between Rijkswaterstaat and the Port of Rotterdam under an agreement.
Rijkswaterstaat will look at whether communication can be sped up and/or recreational shipping better informed in advance about the unpredictability of the Slijkgat.
Rijkswaterstaat bekijkt of de communicatie nog kan worden versneld en/of de scheepvaart, met name de recreatievaart, vooraf beter geïnformeerd kan worden over de grilligheid van het Slijkgat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over rechterlijk ingrijpen in het waterbeheer
