An MP from JA21 asked whether the courts could force a water crisis after the nitrogen crisis, whether the minister would prevent litigation by action groups, and whether the collective action right should be curtailed. The minister answered that the Water Framework Directive exemptions make court risk low before 2027, that action groups have the same rights as citizens, and that the courts are responsible for reviewing implementation.
I see no reason to amend the collective action right.
Ik zie geen aanleiding het collectieve actierecht bij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel van Zembla 'Ministerie lakt opnieuw stukken weg in Wob-documenten over granuliet'

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister about Zembla reporting that the ministry redacted documents on granulite under the Wob, including the weakening of a previously released passage and a claim that a document was wrongly marked out of scope. The state secretary answers that the redactions were justified under Wob exemptions, admits one part of a document was missed due to a work-allocation error, and promises a review of the objection and an independent investigation.

The part of the document declared 'out of scope' and not covered by the Rijkswaterstaat Wob decision will be assessed on substance as soon as possible and, expected at the decision on the objection, made as public as possible.

Het gedeelte van het document dat «buiten scope» is verklaard en niet in het Wob-besluit van Rijkswaterstaat betrokken is, zal zo snel mogelijk inhoudelijk worden beoordeeld en bij de eerst mogelijke gelegenheid, dat is naar verwachting de beslissing op bezwaar tegen het besluit van de bestuurskern van IenW, zoveel mogelijk openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Edgar Mulder over de brandstofprijzen in Nederland

PVV MPs Madlener and Mulder asked the ministers why Dutch fuel prices are among the highest in the world, whether this harms purchasing power and border-region businesses, whether it creates dangerous cross-border jerrycan transport, and whether fuel taxes will be cut. The government answered that Dutch prices are high mainly due to world oil market supply and demand, acknowledged possible purchasing-power effects, found no evidence of rule-breaking on jerrycan limits, and said it has no plans to lower fuel taxes.
The cabinet does not intend to lower taxes on fuels.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de belastingen op brandstoffen te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Kinderklimaatakkoord

An MP asked ministers about the Children's Climate Agreement, its proposals (dike and dune strengthening, eating less meat, replacing felled trees), rising meat consumption and forest loss, and what further measures will be taken. The state secretary answers that the government is willing to meet the children's delegation, points to existing climate and nature policy and youth consultation, and says further tree-planting ambitions are for a future cabinet to decide.
Are you willing to talk with the delegation coming to The Hague to present the Children's Climate Agreement to national politics?
Bent u bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de afvaardiging die naar Den Haag komt om het Kinderklimaatakkoord aan te bieden aan de landelijke politiek?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zandwinning uit de Waddenzee

An MP asked the government about sand extraction from the Wadden Sea, including whether it harms the sandbar structure, how much sand is dredged, and whether sand from the North Sea is needed to offset subsidence from gas and salt mining. The minister answered that extraction at maintenance dredging ends in 2022, that dredged sand will instead be dumped in designated spots, and that mining subsidence is compensated by North Sea sand supplements under licence conditions.
From 2022 no more sand may be extracted from the Wadden Sea system during fairway maintenance.
Per 2022 mag er geen zand meer aan het waddensysteem worden onttrokken bij vaargeulonderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'Lawaai vliegbasis nadert de (pijn)grens'

An MP asks the government about reports that F-35 jet noise, especially low-frequency noise, exceeds that of the F-16 and is not blocked by existing home insulation, and about environmental, consultation and transparency concerns around the airspace redesign and enlarged military training area in northern Netherlands. The government disputes the comparison as methodologically flawed, says noise monitoring and a study are underway, notes the F-35 noise table is classified by the US, and limits its commitments to further study within the existing consultation process.
The noise table of the F-35 is still classified as such by the US government.
De geluidstabel van de F-35 is nog als geclassificeerd bestempeld door de Amerikaanse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over kapotte bruggen in Groningen

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about damaged bridges in Groningen, including causes of ship collisions, a history of incidents, and repair timelines. The minister gave substantive answers on incident causes, planned safety measures, and rebuilding timelines, but declined to state causes pending a police investigation and deferred some timing questions to ongoing procedures and regional consultations.
I cannot yet make statements about the cause of the collision pending the ongoing police investigation.
Over de oorzaak van de aanvaring kan ik nog geen uitspraken doen in afwachting van het lopende politieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het artikel 'Vogels overleven vlucht langs nieuwe windmolens Tweede Maasvlakte gegarandeerd dankzij deze radar'

PVV MPs Madlener and Kops asked the ministers about a planned wind park on the Tweede Maasvlakte, its bird and bat impacts, the loss of beach and kitesurfing amenity, and costs of stoppages. The minister answered that impacts were assessed under the Nature Protection Act, mitigation including a bird radar and bat shutdowns applies, the municipality consulted on kitesurfing, and Eneco bears stoppage costs.
The effectiveness of the radar system will be further investigated in the coming years.
De effectiviteit van het radarsysteem zal de komende jaren nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ziek worden door luchtvervuiling

An MP asked the ministers whether the government will act on children's health harm from air pollution, including around Tata Steel in IJmuiden, and on oversight and enforcement of industrial emissions. The state secretary answered that the Clean Air Accord targets 50% health gain by 2030, that monitoring and enforcement lie largely with the province and environmental services, and that a plan on the VTH enforcement advisory report will follow from the next cabinet.
It is up to the competent authorities and environmental services to ensure, in their permitting, that emissions remain within the norms
Het is aan de bevoegde gezagen en omgevingsdiensten om in hun vergunningverlening er op toe te zien dat uitstoot binnen de normen blijft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Nederland raakt met landbouw-innovaties achter op China’

MPs Valstar and Van Campen asked whether Dutch agricultural biotechnology (CRISPR-Cas) is falling behind China and the US due to outdated EU rules, and what the government is doing to relax EU GMO regulation for plants. The ministers answered that CRISPR-Cas patent publications are lower in Europe, that the Commission study confirms current GMO rules need adapting, that the Netherlands is lobbying for a derogation, though the EU has not granted one.

The cabinet will continue to stress the urgency of this subject and continue to advocate for future-proof European regulation that leaves sufficient room for innovation while safeguarding human and environmental safety.

Het kabinet zal de urgentie van dit onderwerp blijven benadrukken en blijven pleiten voor toekomstbestendige Europese regelgeving die voldoende ruimte biedt voor innovatie en tegelijkertijd de veiligheid voor mens en milieu borgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de budgetstop voor beheer en onderhoud projecten

MP Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of a budget stop halting maintenance contracts, their effect on the construction sector, and the existence of unusable infrastructure due to deferred maintenance. The minister denied any budget stop, said the maintenance budget for 2021 is higher than before with a central check on commitments, and listed bridges and locks with temporary restrictions attributed to technical reasons rather than a direct causal link to deferred maintenance.
There is no question of a budget stop.
Er is geen sprake van een budgetstop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het alarm rond het beheer en onderhoud van wegen

Deputy Geurts (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about alarm reports that funding for road and waterway maintenance had run out, putting jobs at risk, and about deferred maintenance on bridges and provincial and municipal budget cuts. The minister denied that funds for new orders had run out or that work had been stopped, said maintenance budgets for 2021 to 2023 are higher, acknowledged a growing maintenance backlog with budget moved forward, and left municipal and provincial decisions to those authorities.
No, the money for new orders has not run out.
Nee, het geld voor nieuwe opdrachten is niet op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Criminelen infiltreren in rederijen in de Rotterdamse haven'

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports of criminals infiltrating shipping companies in the Rotterdam port, including corruption, drop-off smuggling methods, information sharing, staffing of the drugs investigation teams and cooperation with Latin America. Minister Grapperhaus answered at length, describing existing public-private cooperation, an integrated plan under preparation, a WODC study on corruption risks, and information-sharing reforms, while stating that some measures lie outside his or other bodies' powers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Alarm Bouwend Nederland: Belgische gatenweg dreigt'

MPs Peter de Groot and Michon-Derkzen asked the minister about reports of a looming infrastructure maintenance shortfall, bridge and lock disruptions, and municipal budget cuts. The minister disputed the amounts cited, explained budget shifts and maintenance plans, described the status of closures and storms-related outages, and pointed to the next cabinet for longer-term funding decisions.
I do not recognise the amounts mentioned.
De genoemde bedragen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht dat het metropakket MRA een serieuze optie is voor financiering uit Nationaal Groeifonds

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the Amsterdam metropolitan package (extending the North/South line and closing the ring line) was a serious option for Nationaal Groeifonds funding, including housing numbers, port land use, social housing shares and land revenues. The government answered in detail on the proposal, its costs, housing figures and port policy, reserving 1.5 billion euros for the North/South line extension but declining to calculate some counterfactuals and leaving the exact land-revenue effects undetermined.
For the reason given above, this calculation cannot be made.
Om de reden die hiervoor werd gegeven is deze berekening niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Bouchallikh, Grinwis, Van Raan en De Hoop over de minicargovluchten die worden uitgevoerd tussen Luik en Maastricht

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about mini cargo flights between Liège and Maastricht, including how many occurred, whether the minister still opposes them for environmental reasons, and whether a ban like France's is legally possible. The minister confirmed seven repositioning flights since January (six by Astral Aviation), said the EU framework lacks room for national bans, and promised to monitor France's case and raise the issue in revising EU Regulation 1008/2008.

A concrete legal basis for temporarily banning such flights due to serious environmental problems is absent from Dutch legislation and, given their cross-border nature, could not be unilaterally established by the Netherlands.

Een concrete wettelijke grondslag voor het tijdelijk verbieden van dergelijke vluchten wegens ernstige milieuproblemen ontbreekt in de Nederlandse wetgeving en zou gelet op het grensoverschrijdend karakter niet eenzijdig door Nederland vastgesteld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Varen door de Bruse sluizen vraagt planning: al vijf maanden beperkingen door kapotte brug’

MPs Geurts and Van den Berg asked the minister about the months-long closure of the Grevelingen bascule bridge near Bruinisse, its causes, traffic delays, maintenance backlog and the reopening date. The minister answered in detail, confirming the bridge reopened on 13 May 2021, explaining that technical control-system faults caused the delay and that the budget came from existing maintenance funds.
During testing in 2020 we established that faults could occur simultaneously in two components that act as each other's back-up.
Bij testen in 2020 hebben we vastgesteld dat het mogelijk is dat er tegelijk storingen kunnen optreden in twee onderdelen die als elkaars «back up» functioneren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Paternotte, Hagen, Boucke, Grinwis en Ceder over niet-EU-familieleden van expats, die geen toegang hebben tot Nederland

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked whether non-EU family members of expats and residents are barred from entering the Netherlands under the EU entry ban and Dutch flight bans, whether this breaches Article 8 ECHR, and whether exceptions can be made for Suriname and other regions. The government answered that family of Dutch residents with residence permits are exempt, that individual exceptions exist for urgent family reasons, that the flight bans were lifted on 1 June 2021, and that generic exceptions for first- and second-degree relatives were not desirable.
The cabinet notes that the right to private and family life in Article 8 ECHR does not constitute an absolute right of access to the Netherlands.
Daarbij merkt het kabinet op dat het in artikel 8 EVRM opgenomen recht op privé en familieleven geen absoluut recht tot toegang tot Nederland behelst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over achterstallig onderhoud aan sluizen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Sint-Andries lock being out of service, its deferred maintenance, and whether preventive inspections are needed. The minister confirmed the closure and component replacement, acknowledged elevated risk of future unplanned closures, and agreed preventive maintenance is necessary, while not committing to specific new measures.
Wear of (parts of) the lock has progressed faster in recent years than expected, creating a real risk that components of the Sint-Andries lock will break down.
Slijtage van (onderdelen van) de sluis is de afgelopen jaren sneller gegaan dan verwacht en hierdoor ontstaat er een reëel risico op het defect raken van onderdelen van de sluis St. Andries.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hagen over het bericht dat Duitsland reisbeperkingen instelt voor het Verenigd Koninkrijk vanwege de opmars van de Indiase virusvariant B.1617

MPs Paternotte and Hagen asked about Germany's travel restrictions on the UK over the Indian B.1617 variant, the adequacy of contact tracing and genomic surveillance, and whether further measures are needed. Minister De Jonge replied that the RIVM advises no additional measures now, that surveillance meets ECDC norms with about 1500 sequences weekly, and that the RIVM will keep monitoring.

At my request, the RIVM will continue to closely monitor the situation and will advise me, both on request and unsolicited, if additional measures for travellers from the UK turn out to be needed at a later time.

Op mijn verzoek blijft het RIVM de situatie nauwgezet monitoren, waarbij zij mij gevraagd en ongevraagd zal adviseren indien aanvullende maatregelen voor reizigers uit het VK op een later moment alsnog nodig blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het artikel van EénVandaag over de plannen voor een verplichte snelheidsbegrenzer

PVV MP Madlener asked the Infrastructure Minister whether the EU-mandated intelligent speed assistant would restrict drivers' freedom, whether Dutch studies exist, and whether the Netherlands would oppose the rule. The minister replied that it is a warning-based driver-assist system that can be switched off, not a physical speed limiter, that no Dutch studies are planned, and that no objection will be lodged.
This system makes clear what the local speed limit is and gives a warning signal when the limit is exceeded.
Dit systeem maakt duidelijk wat de lokale snelheidslimiet is en geeft een waarschuwingssignaal wanneer de limiet overschreden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Alkaya over het bericht dat ProRail Spoorwerkers jarenlang heeft blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkend kwartsstof

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure how ProRail and the labour inspectorate allowed rail workers to be exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for years, and what will be done about enforcement, compensation and immediate remedies. The ministers answered that the inspectorate was aware of the risk since 2008, that ProRail and contractors acknowledged duty-of-care failures, that an inspectorate investigation into ProRail is ongoing, and that a compensation scheme for occupational disease victims is being prepared.
The Inspectorate SZW has started an investigation into ProRail's compliance in its role as employer and client and is in discussion with ProRail about improvements in its safety and health policy.

De Inspectie SZW is een onderzoek gestart naar de naleving door ProRail in haar rol als werkgever en als opdrachtgever en is met ProRail in gesprek over verbeteringen in het veiligheids- en gezondheidsbeleid van ProRail.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied en de impactanalyse

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers about the Wadden Sea implementation programme, the impact analysis, and several related projects and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that economic sectors are secured in the agenda, the impact analysis will be broader than socio-economic effects, and the programme and impact analysis will be discussed with Parliament before the summer and in the October debate.
On the outcome of that discussion I will inform your House by letter.
Over de uitkomst van de bespreking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over het bericht “Schip verliest containers bij Ameland”

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the loss of containers from the Baltic Tern near Ameland, including whether the Coast Guard advised against the northern route and whether the government will strengthen intervention powers. The minister answered that containers were recovered, that the Coast Guard does not warn ships from German waters, that 12 of 14 large container ships followed the northern-route advice, and that further steps on IMO measures and intervention powers will be discussed in a progress report.
I have also spoken personally with my German and Danish colleagues.
Ik heb ook zelf met mijn Duitse en Deense collega gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Vrachtschip verliest ten noorden van Ameland vijf containers'

An MP from D66 asked the minister, after the Baltic Tern lost five containers north of Ameland, why the Coast Guard has not yet been given binding guidance powers, whether contingency plans exist, and how Germany and Denmark were engaged. The minister answered that route guidance is complex and requires international coordination, that the Coast Guard lacks capacity to warn feeders, that an inspection and criminal investigation are underway, and that a progress letter will follow before the 2 June hearing.
The instrument of traffic guidance is far-reaching and complex, and requires international coordination.
Het instrument van verkeersbegeleiding is ingrijpend en complex, en vraagt om internationale afstemming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Bij recycling van asfalt komt veel te veel kankerverwekkend benzeen vrij'

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether asphalt plants routinely exceed the benzene emission limit, how long this has been known, why enforcement has been lacking, and what action will be taken. The Staatssecretaris answered that 10 of 29 active plants exceed the limit, 11 have no benzene data, enforcement varies by competent authority, the industry is researching reduction, and the current limit remains valid with a promised update to the Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Bij recycling van asfalt komt veel te veel kankerverwekkend benzeen vrij’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that benzene emissions from asphalt plants exceed limits, the health risks, enforcement by competent authorities, and calls for relaxed norms. The government answered that 10 of 29 active plants exceed the emission limit, that exposure at ground level has not exceeded the EU limit, that competent authorities are enforcing, and that it will inform parliament after an industry study.

It is important that the competent authority has emission data so that it becomes clear whether there is an exceedance situation and on the basis of which follow-up steps can be determined by the competent authority.

Het is van belang dat bevoegd gezag over emissiegegevens beschikt zodat duidelijk wordt of sprake is van een overschrijdingssituatie en op basis waarvan vervolgstappen kunnen worden bepaald door bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the ministers whether the government would honour the House's controversial declaration on Lelystad Airport and refrain from irreversible steps, including continuing the permit procedure, given the statutory decision deadline. Minister Schouten answered that the permit is a legally required individual procedure separate from political decision-making, that the deadline is an order term but binding and cannot be suspended, and that she will not pause the procedure.
A controversial declaration by the House of Representatives does not constitute grounds for me to invoke force majeure in the case of this permit application.
Een controversieel-verklaring door de Tweede Kamer vormt geen grond om mij te mogen beroepen op overmacht in het geval van deze vergunningaanvraag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Palland over Nederlandse (midden en klein-)bedrijven meer laten profiteren van grote overheidsaanbestedingen zoals de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk

CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat ensured that the Afsluitdijk renovation contract, awarded to Levvel, would use innovative Dutch small and medium enterprises and avoid leakage of money abroad (e.g. Chinese valve products). The minister answered that the contract was tendered as a whole for integrality, that EU procurement law prevents mandating product origin, and that a large share of investment benefits the Dutch economy, though exact figures are withheld for competition reasons.
I cannot make precise figures public for reasons of competition.
Precieze cijfers kan ik uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken en De Groot over het ILT-onderzoeksrapport Stichting Waternet

Two D66 MPs asked the minister how she assesses the ILT finding of an elevated, hard-to-quantify cyber risk to drinking water at Waternet, whether that risk is acceptable under intensified supervision, what will speed up remedies, whether governance is examined, and what other steps are taken. The minister answered that Waternet was placed under intensified ILT supervision, submitted an improvement plan, that the ILT will monitor it, and that responsibility for risk acceptance primarily lies with Waternet's board and the municipality of Amsterdam.
It is now up to the ILT to actively monitor the implementation of the improvement plan within the framework of intensified supervision.
Het is nu aan de ILT om in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht de uitvoering van het verbeterplan actief te bewaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Gijs van Dijk over het krantenbericht van het Eindhovens Dagblad dat een aquaduct bij Oirschot ruim 100 miljoen euro goedkoper is dan Rijkswaterstaat eerder voorrekende

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report by IPV Delft, commissioned by the municipality of Oirschot, claiming an aqueduct alternative to the A58 viaduct would cost about 100 million euros less than Rijkswaterstaat estimated. The minister answered that the compared figures were wrong, explained the differing assumptions on engineering costs, risk reserves and VAT, and declined to reopen the decision or enter new talks.
No new facts have come to light in the studies that give me reason to enter into discussion with the regional administrators about this or to reconsider my earlier decision.

Er zijn uit de onderzoeken geen nieuwe feiten op tafel gekomen die voor mij aanleiding zijn om hierover het gesprek met de regionale bestuurders aan te gaan en tot heroverweging van mijn eerdere besluit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht dat er meer fietsers zijn omgekomen in het coronajaar

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why cyclist fatalities rose in 2020 despite less traffic, and what measures will address e-bike and older-cyclist risks. The minister answered that no single explanation exists yet, pointed to SWOV analyses due at year's end, and described road-safety funding, protocols and older-cyclist programmes, promising to involve local authorities in a new national road-safety action plan.
A single unambiguous explanation cannot yet be given.
Een eenduidige verklaring is nu nog niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boswijk over lozingen van de chemische industrie op het oppervlaktewater

An MP asked the minister about chemical industry discharges of emerging substances into surface water, including who monitors them, whether a national overview exists, and whether economic motives override risk norms. The minister answered that permitting authorities handle oversight regionally, monitoring is intensive, and emissions are assessed via BBT, cost-effectiveness and immission tests.
A single overview for the whole of the Netherlands is not available and is also not necessary, because this can be addressed well at regional level.
Eén overzicht voor heel Nederland is niet voor handen en ook niet nodig omdat hier regionaal goed invulling aan kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Miljoenenbonus topman Air France KLM, ondanks recordverlies en staatssteun’

MPs Heinen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether a large bonus for the Air France-KLM chief, despite record losses and state aid, conflicts with state-aid conditions and their own letters suspending bonuses. Minister Hoekstra answered that the bonus is not linked to arranging wage support, that bonuses are unacceptable in this crisis, that the suspension applies to KLM as recipient, and that the European Commission must enforce the Temporary Framework, with the Economic Affairs minister to probe for possible further tightening.
I have informed the company that I am not happy with the suggestion created and that this gives an incorrect picture.
Ik heb aan de onderneming laten weten niet gelukkig te zijn met de gewekte suggestie en dat dit een onjuist beeld geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Tata Steel overtreedt opnieuw milieuregels: loost zonder vergunning kwik in het riool'

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked about press reports that Tata Steel discharged mercury into the sewer without a permit, and about an Omgevingsdienst letter demanding incomplete emissions data. The minister replied that the data are still under assessment by the competent authority, that the discharge is not expected to cause additional harm, and that the company must supply missing data within set deadlines.
I will inform you as soon as a judgement has been made on this.
Ik zal u informeren zodra hierover geoordeeld is.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Raan over de activiteiten van de KLM Flight Academy (KFA)

MP Van Raan asked about the rise in training flights at Groningen Airport Eelde in 2020 by the KLM Flight Academy, its turnover, NOW wage subsidy receipt of EUR 1.56 million, noise and environmental effects. The minister confirmed the 23% rise in movements, largely from training flights merged with Martinair, said turnover is booked per student progress and cannot be shown separately as it is confidential, and stated operations stay within noise limits and opening hours enforced by the ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het uitblijven van branchespecifieke coronasteun voor de bruine vloot

An MP asked the government about the lack of sector-specific corona support for the traditional sailing ship (bruine vloot) sector, including delays in a promised 15 million euro scheme and wrongly assigned SBI codes forcing repeated objections. The state secretary answered that existing TVL/TOGS support fits these businesses, that the new scheme aims to open in June, and that RVO.nl is speeding up objection handling.
By May at the latest, the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Climate, and Social Affairs and Employment will come with a proposal on what the support will look like in the third quarter.
Uiterlijk in mei komen de Ministers van Financiën, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid met een voorstel hoe de steun eruit zal zien in het derde kwartaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Ook in coronatijd ernstige incidenten, zoals bijna-botsingen, op Schiphol. Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid: ‘Ernst onvoldoende duidelijk’

An MP asked the minister about rising runway incursions and aborted take-offs at Schiphol in 2020 despite lower traffic, and about the safety warnings from the Dutch Safety Board. The minister said the high incursion count was largely one January 2020 event, reported that the wider OvV recommendations are being followed up with an evaluation planned later this year, and committed to informing parliament of the OvV investigation outcome.
I will inform you about the outcomes of the OvV investigation.
Over de uitkomsten van het OvV onderzoek zal ik u informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vliegverboden en de coronasituatie in India en Zuid-Amerika

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about travel bans and the COVID situation in India and South America, including whether the B.1.617 variant justified a flight ban on India. The minister answered that the RIVM advised no ban on India for now, that the list of banned countries is reviewed regularly, and that the government is preparing mandatory quarantine for travellers from very high-risk areas.
The RIVM has also recently indicated that it currently sees no reason to advise imposing a flight ban.
Het RIVM heeft ook recent aangegeven op dit moment geen aanleiding te zien om te adviseren een vliegverbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over watergebruik in datacenters

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about water use by data centres, including whether dikes must be raised, permitting, discharge rules and drinking water use for cooling. The minister answered that the Wieringermeer dike meets the legal norm, that the permitting authority and discharge rules are set out, and that she does not find national legislation on data centre water use necessary, while committing to a national drinking water policy exploration.
There is no information available on cooling water use for specific data centres in North Holland.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over gebruik van koelwater voor specifieke datacenters in Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de noodzaak van een progressieve vliegbelasting voor veelvliegers

An MP asked the government about introducing a progressive flight tax for frequent flyers, citing a report on elite flying and public support. The State Secretary answered that the current per-passenger tax already charges frequent flyers more, and that a frequent-flyer levy raises implementation and privacy problems, so the government did not commit to such a tax.
The cabinet is aware that not everyone in the Netherlands flies equally.
Het kabinet is zich ervan bewust dat niet iedereen in Nederland evenveel vliegt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodrijden van een wolvin door drukte in natuurgebieden

An MP asked whether recreational pressure, low-flying military helicopters and deer culling on the Veluwe disturb wolves, and whether speed limits or bans should be imposed to protect wolves and otters. The minister answered that disturbance only arises when visitors break conduct rules, that the Veluwe helicopter flights are judged not to disturb wolves, and that speed limits are a local road-manager matter, while promising no new protective measures for the wolf habitat.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Reddingsbrigade Nederland maakt zich ernstige zorgen over start zomerseizoen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Ministers of Medical Care and Infrastructure about the Reddingsbrigade's concerns over lifeguard preparation for summer and the impact of pool closures on children's swimming lessons. The Minister answered that swimming lessons for children up to 12 have resumed, that the Reddingsbrigade may now train if commissioned by safety regions, and that a meeting with the brigade has taken place.
This conversation has now taken place and the Reddingsbrigade has the opportunity to practise and provide training in the context of water safety.
Inmiddels heeft dit gesprek plaatsgevonden en heeft de Reddingsbrigade de mogelijkheid om te oefenen en opleidingen te verzorgen in het kader van de waterveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het maatregelenpakket voor rijexamens

MP Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the CBR's package of measures to reduce driving exam backlogs, including doubts about the backlog estimate, limited consultation with driving schools, possible scrapping of intermediate tests and fear-of-failure exams, raising the exam age, and the low pass rates of some schools. The Minister replied that the CBR has already added examiners and overtime, that further measures will be decided end of May depending on pass rates, and that the CBR is pursuing quality improvement and information campaigns while keeping stronger measures as a last resort.
A decision on additional measures (such as the possible temporary scrapping of the intermediate test) will be taken by the CBR at the end of May.
Een besluit over aanvullende maatregelen (zoals het eventueel tijdelijk schrappen van de tussentijdse toets) zal het CBR eind mei nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Bromet, Kröger en Buitenweg over misstanden in de transportsector

MPs asked whether TLN and PostNL tried to influence a study into criminal abuse and labour exploitation in the transport sector, and what the government will do with its findings. The minister answered that TLN commissioned the study, that the ministry only co-sat on the steering group and held a subsidy, that the methodology was judged sound, and that a cabinet response will follow in spring.
I will study the outcomes and discuss them with TLN and the Minister of SZW, among others.
Ik ga de uitkomsten bestuderen en onder meer met TLN en de Minister van SZW bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel 'Datacenters brengen levering drinkwater Noord-Holland in gevaar’.

An MP asked the minister whether data centres using drinking water for cooling endanger water supply and pollute water in North Holland, and whether an environmental impact assessment should be required for them. The minister replied that the share of drinking water used for cooling is small (0.6%), that the regional water board regulates discharges with permit limits, and that existing environmental assessment rules are sufficient without amendment.
Regarding the discharge of chemicals by data centres, I currently see no reason for additional research.
Voor wat betreft de lozing van chemicaliën door datacenters, zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor extra onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot en Diertens (beiden D66) over de berichten ‘Verzet tegen nieuwe vrachthaven Bonaire, aanleg zou ‘ecocide’ zijn’ en het bericht ‘conservebonaire.org opposes Hato port’

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that a proposed new cargo port on Bonaire would harm the coral reef, its financing, environmental impact assessment, and transparency. The minister answered that no decision to build a port has been taken, that feasibility studies and an MER are still pending and will be shared later, and that the island council (Bestuurscollege) is responsible for the decision.
For now, there is no decision to build a new cargo port (location).
Vooralsnog is er geen sprake van een besluit tot het bouwen van een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bouwprojecten op Bonaire

An MP asked ministers about planned port and fuel-pier construction on Bonaire that could destroy coral and whether permits, enforcement, financing, cruise tourism and waste management were adequately handled. The government answered that no construction has begun, that existing environmental and maritime procedures apply and can be appealed, and that a feasibility and cost-benefit study and the Bonaire Brandstof Terminals company will follow.
These procedures are public, have objection and appeal possibilities and can go to the administrative court.
Deze procedures zijn openbaar, kennen bezwaar en beroepsmogelijkheden en een gang naar de bestuursrechter.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de klacht tegen Nederland die de Nederlandse Vereniging Omwonenden Windturbines op 9 november 2015 heeft ingediend bij het Compliance Committee van het Verdrag van Aarhus va

MP Van Gerven asks why the Aarhus Compliance Committee has still not decided, nearly five and a half years after a complaint against the Netherlands over public participation, and what the consequences of a ruling would be for citizen consultation rules in the AWB and Omgevingswet. The government says it cannot explain the delay since the committee controls its own working methods, declines to assess possible consequences before a decision, denies legal uncertainty, and sees no means to press the committee to speed up.
Unfortunately it is not possible to inform you of the reason for the absence of a decision, since the Aarhus Compliance Committee is responsible for its own work organisation and methods.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om u te informeren over de reden van het uitblijven van een beslissing, aangezien het Aarhus nalevingscomité over zijn eigen werkindeling en -methoden gaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over de artikelen ‘Nieuw onderzoek 'probleemkanaal' Almelo-De Haandrik:’Provincie was grip van begin af aan kwijt’ en ‘Provincie: rapport naar probleemkanaal Almelo-De Haa

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Deltares and Van Baars reports on damage to homes caused by deepening the Almelo-De Haandrik canal, about who is responsible for compensation and whether the Rijk has a role. The Minister answered that the canal is a provincial waterway, that the Rijk has no role in the project or its compensation, and that the province is responsible for the necessary steps.
The Almelo-De Haandrik canal is a provincial waterway for which the province carries out waterway management.
Het kanaal Almelo-De Haandrik is een provinciale vaarweg waar de provincie het vaarwegbeheer uitvoert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over werkzaamheden onder Europese aanbestedingsregels bij Schiphol

D66 MP Van Weyenberg asked ministers whether Schiphol's security tendering under EU rules, with contracts of at least four years and a change of providers in December 2020, shifts the collapse in passenger-related demand onto security firms who cannot claim the NOW wage subsidy, and whether Schiphol as a state-owned company should take responsibility. The ministers answered that Schiphol handled the tender and rebalancing under EU rules, that the NOW wage subsidy does not cover staff not on the payroll and the firms' eligibility rules apply, and that Schiphol says security remains adequately guaranteed and works with the firms to manage capacity risks.
Schiphol tenders the work under the European procurement rules and thereby takes responsibility for properly tendering the security work at Schiphol, as may be expected of a state-owned company.

Schiphol besteedt de werkzaamheden aan via de Europese aanbestedingsregels en neemt daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid voor het juist aanbesteden van de beveiligingswerkzaamheden op Schiphol zoals van een staatsdeelneming mag worden verwacht.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht 'Bossche bedrijf AVI werd eerder op de vingers getikt voor branden'

An MP asked the minister about repeated smouldering fires at the AVI recycling company in Den Bosch, including the 9 March 2021 fire that closed COVID test sites and sent schoolchildren home, and whether enforcement had been adequate and an independent inquiry warranted. The state secretary answered that the province and environmental service have enforcement responsibility, outlined the enforcement history including an enforced penalty order still in force, and said the province is investigating the stored waste quantities during the fire.
It is the responsibility of the competent authority to provide an adequate permit and to enforce it.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bevoegd gezag om te voorzien in een adequate vergunning en deze te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht 'Besluitvorming genetische gemodificeerde gewassen in impasse door gebrek aan politieke daadkracht'

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure about a dissertation claiming EU GMO authorisation is deadlocked, and about import versus cultivation rules, CRISPR-Cas9, and their motion on biotechnology regulation. The ministers largely agreed EU procedures are slow and costly, said Dutch policy pushes for modernised rules, and pointed to an ongoing European Commission study due by 30 April 2021 without committing to a concrete new step.

The Netherlands is working to put the application and authorisation of new breeding techniques, such as CRISPR-Cas9, on the European agenda, provided species boundaries are not crossed and safety for humans, animals and the environment is guaranteed.

Nederland zet zich in op het Europees agenderen van de toepassing en toelating van nieuwe veredelingstechnieken, zoals CRISPR-Cas9, mits daarbij geen soortengrenzen worden overschreden en veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger, Moorlag, Schonis en Van Esch over het vervangen van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de aangenomen motie-Laçin c.s. (Kamerstuk 35570-A, nr. 30)

MPs asked the minister about the replacement of the Paddepoelsterbrug in Groningen, including whether agreements for a low movable bridge still stand after a 2021 motion. The minister said talks with residents and stakeholders continue, that a 2020 MIRT agreement provides for a fixed bridge at 9.10 metres with ramps and a €8.6 million federal contribution, and that the agreement is on hold pending the motion, while defending the drawbacks of a low bridge.
After concluding an administrative agreement, I will transfer the financial resources and implementation by the municipality of Groningen can begin.
Na het sluiten van een bestuursovereenkomst zal ik de financiële middelen overdragen en kan de uitvoering door de gemeente Groningen beginnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Waterbedrijven willen tarieven kunnen verhogen’

Dutch MP Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about drinking water companies wanting to raise tariffs and seeing the WACC profit cap as an obstacle to investment. The minister said tariffs must be cost-covering, that the ILT is researching the companies' financial situation and planned investments, and that a WACC extension power has been added to the Drinkwaterwet as a short-term safeguard, with longer-term solutions to be developed with the sector.
Once this investigation is completed, I will inform your House about it.
Zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Esch over het bericht 'Bewoners op achterstand gezet in strijd tegen verbreding A27: ‘Hoort niet zo in een democratie’

MPs asked whether the A27/A12 Utrecht route decision was taken without updated traffic and nitrogen analyses, without the Commission for EIA's full review, and whether the Crisis- and Recovery Act's limits on local government appeals are compatible with democracy. The minister declined to discuss the substance because an appeal is pending, defended the procedure and the Act's restriction on decentralised appeals, and pointed to the publicly available reports.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing, I cannot go into the substance of the decision towards your House.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt, kan ik richting uw Kamer niet op de inhoud van het besluit ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht “Milieuramp in de Berkel: Friesland Campina vervuilde, het Waterschap betaalde”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether Waterschap Rijn en IJssel should have borne less of the costs of a pipeline breach polluting the Berkel, given that FrieslandCampina was the polluter, and questioned possible favouritism linked to agricultural seats on the water board. The minister answered that the water board, as owner of the pipeline, carries primary responsibility, that TNO found several causes all partly attributable to the parties so no single polluter can be named, and that no agricultural influence is evident.
The water board has the autonomous authority to weigh the cost allocation itself.
Het waterschap heeft de autonome bevoegdheid om zelf een afweging te maken over de kostenverdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kuiken over het dubbele testbeleid voor vliegreizen

MPs from D66 and PvdA asked the ministers about the double testing regime for flights into the Netherlands, including data on positive tests, crew testing, quarantine compliance, airport test availability and EU coordination. The government answered that it holds no data on positive tests before departure, said compliance and crew results are not registered or are low, and maintained that pre-departure testing is more effective, while committing to extend the rapid test validity to 24 hours.
The cabinet has no data on the number of travellers who tested positive with a PCR test before they wanted to travel to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft geen data over aantallen reizigers die positief zijn getest met een PCR-test voordat zij naar Nederland wilden afreizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Het zoet en zuur van 'verkenner' Van Geel bij Maastricht Airport'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper article on the advice of an independent explorer for Maastricht Airport, covering cargo versus passenger flights, runway length, cargo volume forecasts, night closure, and the airport's viability. The minister answered that the province of Limburg, as owner, will decide the airport's future and any new licence application, that the ministry will not comment prematurely, and that night closure will remain for noise reasons.

Your House was previously informed about the reason for not continuing the procedure of the Maastricht Airport Decision, which would have allowed use of the full available runway length of 2,750 metres.

Uw Kamer is eerder geïnformeerd over de aanleiding om de procedure van het Luchthavenbesluit Maastricht, waarmee het gebruik van de volledige beschikbare baanlengte van 2.750 meter mogelijk werd gemaakt, niet voort te zetten
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de verloren brokstukken van een Boeing 747-400

An MP asked the minister about a Boeing 747-400 that lost debris and a burning engine after leaving Maastricht Aachen Airport, including damage, causes, investigation and prior vortex damage incidents. The minister said the Dutch Safety Board (OvV) and the police are investigating, the OvV will publish its report, and vortex damage incidents at the airport are being monitored via the regional consultation committee.
If the report gives cause for a response, I will share it with your House as soon as possible.
Wanneer het rapport aanleiding geeft voor een reactie zal ik deze zo spoedig als mogelijk met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘Vallende brokstukken in Meerssen: vliegt de luchtvaart te lang door met oude toestellen?’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about recent aircraft debris incidents involving Boeing aircraft, the age of cargo planes, and whether the government will act on fleet age and safety. The minister answered that investigations by the Dutch Safety Board and US authorities are pending, no increasing trend is observed, and no additional measures are currently warranted.
Pending the completion of the investigations by the NTSB and the OvV respectively, I cannot say anything about possible parallels.
Vooruitlopend op de afronding van de onderzoeken door respectievelijk de NTSB en de OvV kan ik niets zeggen over eventuele paralellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de boete voor een kapitein na een grote olielekkage in de Rotterdamse haven

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why a captain was fined only 1,000 euros after a major oil spill in the Rotterdam port, and about liability, sentencing and environmental criminal law. The minister answered that the courts decide sentencing, that the shipowner's liability-limitation request was rejected and is pending before the Supreme Court, and that work on speeding up environmental enforcement is underway, without committing to new criminal-law measures.
I do not intervene in the decision of the criminal judge.
Ik treed niet in de beslissing van de strafrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Dam over een promotiefilm voor het songfestival op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Van Dam asked whether the minister refused a drone permit for a promotional film on Bonaire for the Eurovision Song Contest and why. The minister confirmed a request was received, stated that the Luchtverkeer BES decree bars drone flights without a pilot aboard and offers no exemption, and said drone rules for the Caribbean islands are being developed with consultation.
Therefore flying a drone in the airspace above Bonaire is not permitted.
Daarom is het vliegen met een drone in het luchtruim boven Bonaire niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Hijink over het bericht ‘KLM to resume SA flights to Amsterdam’

Two MPs asked whether KLM was resuming flights from South Africa to Amsterdam despite the travel ban and whether the government would act against it. The minister said airlines decide commercially, KLM screens passengers for exemptions, six passenger flights ran in late February, and airlines must check travellers' test results, with regional safety authorities checking on arrival.
It is up to the airlines themselves to assess whether flights to destinations under a flight ban are commercially attractive based on the estimated number of exempt cases.

Het is aan de luchtvaartmaatschappijen zelf om te beoordelen of vluchten naar bestemmingen waarvoor een vliegverbod geldt, commercieel interessant zijn op basis van het geschatte aantal uitzonderingsgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Aukje de Vries en Veldman over de problematiek rondom bemanningswisselingen en vaccinatie van zeevarenden

MPs from the VVD asked about crew changes and vaccination of seafarers, including test requirements at foreign airports, the feasibility of arrival testing, vaccine rollout delays such as in the Philippines, and private vaccination options. The minister acknowledged the difficulties, extended the antigen test validity to 24 hours, and said the RIVM is examining how seafarers can access existing vaccination routes, without committing to new parliamentary reporting.
I will inform your House when there are new developments regarding the points above.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren op het moment dat er met betrekking tot bovenstaande punten nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bruins over de relatie tussen het programma Luchtruimherziening en de routes voor luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asks whether the minister's earlier commitments that existing routes, including Lelystad Airport's connecting routes and IJsselmeer routes, are not a starting point in the airspace redesign still hold, and whether alternatives must be examined in the environmental impact assessment. The minister confirms the commitments but states that the B+ routes are not a starting point, that current routes remain the basis for the MER update, and that alternatives will be assessed in the later planning phase if effects warrant.
In the airspace redesign, the local departure and approach routes (B+) and the connecting routes are not a starting point for the design.
In de luchtruimherziening zijn de lokale vertrek- en naderingsroutes (B+) en de aansluitroutes namelijk geen uitgangspunt voor het ontwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de FNV met stakingen dreigt op Schiphol

MPs Laçin (SP) asked the ministers whether they would respond to FNV threats of strikes at Schiphol, the number of ground handlers, wage competition, living wages and the motion on social establishment requirements. The minister answered that strikes are a legal right, that a study into social establishment requirements and handler numbers is underway with results expected in spring, and that wages and contracts are primarily the responsibility of companies and collective bargaining partners.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the study.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Leiding Waternet probeert verantwoordelijkheid voor digitaal wanbeleid te lozen'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Accenture, Waternet's long-time IT consultant, and a later IT architect produced reviews of Waternet's digital security that lacked independence and found serious weaknesses. The Minister declined to judge the advisers' independence, said the ILT inspection is examining Waternet's governance and drinking-water aspects and is expected to report in March 2021, and deferred questions on the EUR 28 million digitalisation spending to Waternet and its board.
From my system responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge the engagement of advisers by Waternet and the Foundation board.
Vanuit mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid past het mij niet een oordeel te geven over het inschakelen van adviseurs door Waternet en het Stichtingsbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over blootstelling van werknemers aan vervuilde en schadelijke lucht op luchthaven Schiphol

Two MPs (Lacin and Van Kent, SP) asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Social Affairs about workers' exposure to jet exhaust and ultrafine particles at Schiphol, including use of Copenhagen-style push-back, single-engine taxiing, an inspectorate review, and worker involvement in the measurement programme. The ministers answered that employers are responsible for protective measures, that TNO's measurement programme was delayed by Covid-19 and will start in Q2 2021 with a worker sounding board, and that they decline to adopt the Danish approach or to ask the Inspectorate to investigate now.

The measurement programme that TNO, in consultation with RIVM, formulated on the basis of scientific insights and considerations, will be presented and discussed in this sounding board before the measurements are carried out.

Het meetprogramma dat TNO in overleg met het RIVM op basis van wetenschappelijke inzichten en afwegingen heeft geformuleerd, wordt vóór de metingen uitgevoerd in deze klankbordgroep gepresenteerd en besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht dat Maersk 24 Nederlandse werknemers op straat zet

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked ministers about Maersk removing 24 Dutch seafarers' ships from the Dutch flag and whether the company was replacing them with cheaper foreign workers. The minister regrets the reflagging but says it is an internal company matter, that the flag state governs crew conditions, and that social dumping through flag choice would be regarded as undesirable, while declining to comment on the union agreement or intervene with Maersk.
Since this concerns individual company policy, it is not for me to form a judgement on this choice.
Aangezien het hier om individueel bedrijfsbeleid gaat, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel over deze keuze te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de mogelijke aanleg van een containerhaven op Bonaire

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reported plans for a container port near Hato on Bonaire, including environmental impacts, alternatives, coral reef protection and whether a planning study had been commissioned. The minister answered that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive board, that the ministry assists with further study, that no planning study has been commissioned yet, and that environmental assessment will follow later.
The decision whether a new cargo port (location) should actually be built, and if so where, rests with the Bonaire Executive Council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel uit Nieuwsblad Transport d.d. 14 januari 2021 “Helpende hand voor rood-wit-blauw”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about declining Dutch flag popularity, fleet growth and decline, Maersk reflagging to Liberia, and plans for a maritime authority. The minister answered that the flag is a quality flag, that a fiscal evaluation is underway, that a transition toward a maritime authority will be decided after summer 2021, and that the answers are given in full, but without concrete new commitments beyond those plans.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over het artikel 'Nederland liet dieselsjoemelaars onterecht gaan'

An MP asked the government about a Follow the Money report that the Netherlands wrongly let diesel 'cheat' vehicles pass, and about the implications of a 2020 EU Court of Justice ruling on defeat devices. The government answered that the ruling tightens the rules, that the RDW is reviewing approvals and past investigations against it, that reopening cases will be communicated if needed, and that it will push for stricter EU emission standards.
If reopening of the investigations proves necessary, I will inform your House of this.
Indien heropening van de onderzoeken noodzakelijk is, zal ik uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht 'Verzet tegen plan Bonaire voor containerhaven'

An MP asked whether the government shares concerns that a container port near Hato on Bonaire would damage a pristine reef in a marine park, and what steps it will take. The minister replied that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive council, that a further feasibility study was agreed in the convenant, that an environmental impact assessment (MER) will be required later, and that no planning study has been commissioned yet.
The decision on whether, and where, a new cargo port should be built rests with the Bonaire executive council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber inzake worteldoeken in Nederlandse rivieren,

An MP asked the minister about geotextile root cloth in Dutch rivers, its fragmentation into microplastics, unregistered non-functional material, and alternatives. The minister acknowledged the concern, said geotextile is needed for durable bank protection, that biobased alternatives are unsuitable, that loose material is removed under existing contracts, and declined a dedicated cleanup project or new register.
Rijkswaterstaat's contractors inspect the banks in accordance with the agreements made.
Opdrachtnemers van Rijkswaterstaat inspecteren de oevers, conform de gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de achterstanden bij het CBR voor rijexamens

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the backlog of about 600,000 driving exams at the CBR after the lockdowns, including proposals to lower failure rates, flexible rescheduling and extra staff. The minister answered that the CBR has a task force, has restarted practical exams, allows schools flexible cancellation and rescheduling until 2 April, is recruiting 100 extra examiners, and will periodically inform parliament on reservation times, but gave no concrete plan yet.
As I indicated in the aforementioned letter to the House, all of the CBR's reservation measures prior to the lockdowns had already for some time been within the KPI.
Zoals ik in voornoemde Kamerbrief heb laten weten, waren alle reserveringsmaatregelen van het CBR voorafgaande aan de lockdowns al geruime tijd binnen de KPI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de artikelen 'CBR neemt weer motorexamens af' en 'CBR moet 600.000 examens inhalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the CBR driving test agency must catch up on about 610,000 exams after COVID lockdowns, and about the implications for motorcycle exams and waiting times. The minister confirmed the backlog, said motorcycle practical exams can resume safely outdoors, and said concrete measures will be sent to parliament once agreed with the CBR.
As I wrote in my letter to the House of Representatives of 16 February, I am currently consulting with the CBR about their proposals.
Zoals ik in mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 16 februari heb geschreven, ben ik op dit moment in overleg met het CBR over hun voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Laçin over het feit dat duizenden chauffeurs op dit moment stranden bij de grenzen van Duitsland, Tsjechië en Oostenrijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about thousands of truck drivers stranded at the German, Czech and Austrian borders due to COVID-19 travel restrictions, and what was being done to resolve it and prevent recurrence. The minister answered that the government is concerned, is pursuing EU-level 'green lanes' for freight, has contacts with the sector and neighbouring governments, and that the number of stranded Dutch drivers is hard to estimate, pointing stranded Dutch nationals to the foreign ministry's consular help.
The cabinet was surprised by the decision on border restrictions from Germany, Slovakia, Czechia and Austria and finds the inconvenience truck drivers experience very unpleasant.

Het kabinet is verrast door het besluit over de beperkingen aan de grenzen van Duitsland, Slowakije, Tsjechië en Oostenrijk en vindt de hinder die vrachtwagenchauffeurs daardoor ondervinden bijzonder vervelend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het gebruik van vervuilde grond voor de aanleg van de Perkpolder

An MP asks the minister about contaminated thermally cleaned soil used in the Perkpolder dike, including its origin, whether the cleaning was complete, and why the Westdijk was remediated but Perkpolder was not. The minister confirms that Deltares found substances above standards, says the origin cannot be traced to a specific batch, and states RIVM finds no unacceptable risk for now, with a final decision on measures still pending.
Tracing a specific exceedance in the Perkpolder dike back to a batch of material offered for cleaning is therefore, in my expectation, not possible.
Het herleiden van een specifieke overschrijding in de Perkpolderdijk naar een partij materiaal die voor reiniging is aangeboden, is daardoor naar mijn verwachting niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de kap van essen in het Markiezenbos langs de A27

An MP asked the minister whether felling ash trees in the Markiezenbos along the A27 is linked to the Utrecht ring road route decision, which is still subject to an appeal and was declared controversial by parliament. The minister answered that the felling concerns dead and diseased trees for traffic safety and is separate from the route decision and the appeal procedure.
These works are separate from the route decision and the appeal procedure.
Deze werkzaamheden staan los van het tracébesluit en de beroepsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vattenfall mag in de Maas doorgaan met massaal vermalen van vissen'

D66 MPs Schonis and De Groot asked about fish mortality at Vattenfall's Maas hydropower plants (Lith, Linne), eel survival, the legal footing of the 10% mortality norm after a Council of State ruling, and Rijkswaterstaat's remedies. The minister acknowledged substantial eel and smolt mortality, said the 10% norm can no longer be applied without legal anchoring after the Council of State ruling, and committed to restoring the permit framework and reporting to parliament by June 2021.
Unlike before, however, the Council of State has in a recent ruling held that the 10% norm can no longer be applied without further legal anchoring.
Anders dan voorheen heeft de Raad van State in een recente uitspraak echter geoordeeld dat die 10%-norm niet meer zonder nadere juridische verankering gehanteerd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over opslag van nucleair afval net over de grens

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would raise with Germany the concerns of residents near the border about possible nuclear waste storage in salt caverns in Emsland, and how Dutch citizens and authorities can take part in German siting decisions. The state secretary answered that Germany has no concrete plans yet, that Dutch citizens would be informed and have participation rights under the Espoo Convention if a border-near site is considered, and that a Rathenau-led participatory process is underway in the Netherlands.
I consider it important that Dutch citizens also have a say in decision-making on a German final repository if it were to be located near the Dutch border.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook Nederlandse burgers inspraak hebben bij besluitvorming over een Duitse eindberging als die in de buurt van de grens met Nederland zou komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van den Berg over de beperkte capaciteiten voor vrachtwagenchauffeurs tijdens de avondklok

CDA MPs Postma and Van den Berg asked whether truck drivers' facilities such as fuel stations, toilets and warm food can stay open during the evening curfew, and how the minister views this. The minister answered that sanitary facilities and fuel stations may stay open, shop opening hours were moved forward, warm drinks may be served at fuel stations since 12 February, and a study on truck parking conditions is under way.
Once the study is complete, I will inform the House of its outcomes and the conclusions I draw from it.
Zodra het onderzoek gereed is, zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten en de conclusies die ik eraan verbind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

MPs asked why answers to earlier questions on the brown fleet (historic sailing charter vessels) aid of 15 million euro were delayed and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The government answered that aid through the existing TVL scheme is being expanded, a separate subsidy scheme is being prepared, and a timeline will follow later, without a firm date.
I will inform the House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Geurts over de berichten 'Polders tijdelijk onder water om Zeeland veilig te houden' en 'Ontpolderen is niet dé oplossing'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports proposing temporarily flooding polders in Zeeland to protect the region, including who funded the NIOZ study, farmland loss, compensation for farmers, and whether the government will implement the plan. The minister replied that the concept was commissioned and financed by WNF, that it is only one option to be explored within a long-term sea-level rise knowledge programme, and that no decision to implement it has been taken.
For now, this concept of 'double dikes', as one of several concepts and plans, will be included in the Sea Level Rise Knowledge Programme.
Voorlopig wordt dit concept van «dubbele dijken», als één van de concepten en plannen, meegenomen binnen het Kennisprogramma Zeespiegelstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over de kosten die Transavia in rekening brengt aan consumenten die hun vlucht willen omboeken

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Transavia's rebooking fees (up to €35 per flight) penalise passengers who follow travel advice, and whether the Flex package and the 2020 advice changes justify this. The minister answered that fees reflect Transavia's business decision, that many destinations were orange rather than yellow, that the government urged people not to travel, and that the minister has no plans to push Transavia for flexibility.
Transavia makes a business-economic assessment to charge passengers who want to rebook their flight.
Transavia maakt een bedrijfseconomische afweging om kosten in rekening te brengen aan passagiers die hun vlucht willen omboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht "Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend"

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers why the EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet is complex and slow, and when shipowners will get clarity. The government answered that generic COVID support has been extended and that a separate subsidy for unique maintenance and operating costs of historic ships is being developed, with timing to be set with RVO.nl.
I will inform your House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over registratie geluidsoverlast

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how aircraft and rail noise complaints are registered, who handles them, and why a small group of repeat complainers accounts for very many complaints. The minister answered in detail on registration channels, roles of BAS, ProRail, ILT and the ministry, trends, and noise measures, and promised a Schiphol noise-reduction plan.
That is why I have asked Schiphol and LVNL to draw up a noise-reduction implementation plan to continuously limit the nuisance residents experience.
Daarom heb ik aan Schiphol en LVNL gevraagd om een uitvoeringsplan hinderreductie op te stellen voor de voortdurende beperking van hinder die bewoners ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat de kosten van het havengeld voor sommige binnenvaartschippers meer dan verdubbeld zijn

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that new port dues in Twente more than doubled costs for some inland shippers, including some serving medical logistics, and asked whether the government would intervene or investigate other municipalities. The minister acknowledged the reports, said costs vary by operator and that the change is favourable for some, declined to judge the cost increase generally, and said municipalities are responsible for their own port policy and will evaluate the scheme in Q2 2021 without the minister taking further action.
No, the municipalities are after all competent to conduct independent policy.
Nee, de gemeenten zijn immers bevoegd om zelfstandig beleid te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de nieuwe Bob-campagne in België om rijden onder invloed tegen te gaan.

An MP asked the ministers about a Belgian drink-driving campaign in which intoxicated drivers receive a keyring bearing the name of a child killed in a crash, and whether it could be adopted in the Netherlands with more alcohol checks. The minister said the Belgian action is a private add-on to the regular campaign, that no evaluation is planned, that the idea will be considered in the next campaign strategy with a letter to parliament after the summer, and that Dutch enforcement already intensifies alcohol checks during campaign periods.
I will include the idea and its evaluation in the strategy determination for the coming version of the BOB campaign to see whether it is a good idea to do this in the Netherlands too.
Ik zal het idee en de evaluatie hiervan meenemen bij de strategiebepaling voor de komende versie van de BOB-Campagne om te kijken of het een goed idee is dit ook in Nederland te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Zonne-eilanden in IJsselmeer als mogelijke energiebron'

MPs Bromet and Van der Lee asked the ministers about a proposal for solar islands on the IJsselmeer, the route map for solar on water, the Agenda IJsselmeergebied 2050, and the Wieringerhoek MIRT project that excluded energy generation. The minister answered that a route map was sent to parliament, a pilot pre-study is ordered, the Wieringerhoek scope will be assessed at the planuitwerkingsfase, and more clarity is expected in 2021 and autumn 2021.
In addition, Rijkswaterstaat has been commissioned to carry out a pre-study for a pilot with floating solar panels on the IJsselmeer.
Daarnaast is opdracht gegeven aan Rijkswaterstaat tot een pre-verkenning voor een pilot met drijvende zonnepanelen op het IJsselmeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over PLEV’s

Van Haga (FvD) asked the minister about legalising personal light electric vehicles (PLEVs) such as e-steps, including the choice of the German over the Belgian model, safety, public transport use and the TNO study. The minister answered that the Dutch approval framework follows the German model for safety reasons, that PLEVs get a separate, evaluated approval route, and that a new framework will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess, the elaborated policy framework will be sent to your House.
Vóór het zomerreces zal het uitgewerkte beleidskader naar uw Kamer worden verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over besmetting aan boord van vliegtuigen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about in-flight COVID-19 transmission on a Dubai to Auckland flight, the role of APUs and masks, and the status of the NLR/RIVM study. The minister acknowledged that some measures were not fully applied on the flight, explained APU use and mask exceptions, pointed to layered measures and new flight bans, and said the study report is expected around March.
The aviation committee debate of 4 February has been postponed.
Het AO Luchtvaart van 4 februari jl. is uitgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over luchtvaart en corona

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the minister about RIVM sewage monitoring at Schiphol for coronavirus, why the data is not public, flight passenger numbers from the UK and South Africa, and refusals of non-Schengen arrivals.
