The minister answered that the Schiphol sampling continues but is not published because it cannot be compared with municipal sites, that passenger data and refusal statistics are provided, and that some data (variant testing, nationality of all travellers) is unavailable.
Schiphol cannot provide country-specific passenger figures because the information is highly competitively sensitive.
Schiphol kan, in verband met de zeer concurrentiegevoelige aard van de informatie, geen landenspecifieke cijfers over passagiersaantallen verschaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Amhaouch over de hypothecaire lening aan Winair

Two CDA MPs asked whether Winair's financial problems stem only from COVID-19, what conditions attach to the state-backed mortgage loan, whether competing routes and the state's 7.95% shareholding affect the decision, and what happened to recommendations on subsidising inter-island flights. The government answered that the loan followed a economic and political assessment, carries conditions such as no dividends and minimum daily flights, and was needed to keep Saba and Sint Eustatius connected, while stating that the wider connectivity question remains under review.
The results of Phase B contain commercially sensitive information; these will be shared confidentially with the House.
De uitkomsten van Fase B bevatten bedrijfsgevoelige informatie; deze worden vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'VK scherpt inreisregels aan'

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister how the Netherlands would prevent spread of the new Brazilian COVID-19 variant, including flight numbers from affected areas, rapid tests before departure and quarantine compliance. The minister answered that flight bans were imposed on the UK, South Africa, Brazil and other countries, that travellers need negative PCR or rapid test results, that a quarantine obligation is being examined, and that Schiphol flights from Brazil were zero per day while Portugal averaged three.
The cabinet is currently examining whether a quarantine obligation can be introduced.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel of er een quarantaineplicht kan worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over reizen tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked ministers why travel advice for Curaçao and other Caribbean and Canary Island destinations seemed inconsistent with the Prime Minister's call not to travel abroad, and why airlines were promoting trips. The ministers answered that a worldwide orange travel advice now applies, that airlines and tour operators agreed to limit package holidays and add PCR and rapid testing requirements, and that testing of arriving travellers is being assessed for capacity.
On 15 December 2020 the travel advice was adjusted worldwide to orange.
Op 15 december 2020 is het reisadvies wereldwijd aangepast naar oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asks the government about Maastricht Aachen Airport growth, noise in Limburg quiet areas, and conflicting studies on tourism impacts, and asks whether the growth doctrine influenced commissioned research. The minister answers that the province of Limburg is responsible for quiet areas and for MAA's future, that the independent advice is pending, and that he does not take positions on the Breda and Ecorys studies, while also replying on the air-freight levy report and rejecting a growth doctrine.

Since I am not the commissioning party for either study and there is no formal application for an airport decision yet that I must consider, I do not think it is appropriate to make statements about either study.

Aangezien ik geen opdrachtgever ben van beide onderzoeken en er nog geen formele aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit ligt waarover ik mij moet buigen acht ik het niet opportuun om uitspraken te doen over beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de brief 'Agenda voor het Waddengebied 2050' d.d. 11 december 2020

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about the Waddenagenda 2050, including how the VVD/CDA motion on protecting economic sectors (agriculture, potato seed sector, fisheries, harbours, tourism) is reflected, the impact analysis, the signing of the declaration of agreement, consultation outcomes, and the balance between ecology and economy. The ministers answered that the impact analysis will run parallel to the implementation programme, sectors will be involved via the Omgevingsberaad, consultation led to a strengthened landbouw section, and a site visit is desired but not yet scheduled.

As indicated in the letter of 11 December 2020, in line with this motion, a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with drafting the Implementation Programme so that effects on ecology and economy can be weighed in balance.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 11 december 2020 1 wordt, in lijn met deze motie 2 , parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied 2021–2026 (Uitvoeringsprogramma) gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op ecologie en economie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de stikstofberekeningen voor Lelystad Airport

The ChristenUnie MP Bruins asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about errors in the nitrogen deposition calculations for road traffic in the Lelystad Airport environmental impact assessments (MER 2014 and 2018) and the PAS notification of May 2019, including omitted road connections, wrong emission inputs and whether the notification was lawful. The minister acknowledges the calculation errors (1 MW heat content, NO2 instead of NOx, very low emission inputs), argues they had no consequences for the procedure because the PAS already reserved room for road traffic, and states the notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under the regular procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Laçin, Van Raan en Stoffer over de stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport

MPs asked whether the 2014 nitrogen calculations for Lelystad Airport were wrong, why a high heat content was used, and whether the 2015 airport decision and 2019 PAS notification should be voided. The minister acknowledges calculation errors, says the PAS notification was made in good faith and will be legalised under a verification procedure, and promises to share the project-specific assessment later.
As reported in the letter to parliament of 3 December, I will share the project-specific assessment with the House once it is completed.
Antwoord 3 Zoals gemeld in de Kamerbrief van 3 december 5 zal ik de project specifieke beoordeling met de Kamer delen zodra deze is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over boetes voor te zwaar beladen grensoverschrijdend vrachtverkeer

CDA MPs Postma and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fines for overweight cross-border trucks in Selfkant, Germany, and the resulting cost and emissions burden. The minister replied that EU rules cap trucks at 40 tonnes, that member states may allow higher weights domestically but Germany does not, and that the government sees no need to lobby Germany or act beyond EU law.
No, Germany abides by European legislation.
Nee, Duitsland houdt zich aan de Europese wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

Three VVD MPs asked why their earlier questions on the EUR 15 million aid scheme for the charter 'brown fleet' shipping operators remain unanswered, why the scheme is delayed, and when operators will receive funds. The item is a notice that the questions were answered during the 26 January 2021 model question hour, with the answers not reproduced in this text.

The written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini (all VVD) on the report 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Bruine vloot op de waakvlam - verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about a news report that distributing the 15 million euro support scheme for the brown fleet (historic Dutch cargo vessels) is complicated and time-consuming, asking why, how it will be resolved, timing before 1 December, bank cooperation, the effect of the earlier inspection postponement, future options such as field labs, and whether money reaches entrepreneurs rather than administration. The answer, from the State Secretary, is a short referral noting the questions were answered in the 26 January 2021 model question hour and cited in a newspaper report, without substantive answers in this document.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini on the report on the brown fleet and the 15 million euro distribution were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend» zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het artikel ‘Pollutionwatch: fine particles affect lungs of those near airports’

An MP asked the government about a study on ultrafine particles near Schiphol, why its results were not shared with parliament, and what follow-up is planned. The minister answered that the interim report was sent to parliament in June 2019, that the study covers short-term exposure only, and that final reports are expected at end 2021.

By letter of 27 June 2019, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, on behalf of the Minister, sent parliament an interim report of the RIVM study on ultrafine particles at Schiphol.

337 ) heeft de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat mede namens de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat een tussenrapportage van het «RIVM-onderzoek ultrafijn stof Schiphol» aan de Kamer aangeboden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries, Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Onrust bij pachters van buitendijks land achter Waddenzeedijk’ en ‘Rijkscommissie: Waddengebied moet Nationaal Landschapspark worden’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about unrest among tenant farmers over the Wadden Sea dike plans and a national committee's proposal to make the Wadden region a National Landscape Park, including consultation with stakeholders and the absence of an impact analysis. The minister answered that dike reinforcement is being planned with stakeholders in phases, that the committee's advice is still being discussed with the parties concerned, and that a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with the Wadden implementation programme.
In parallel with drafting the implementation programme, a broad impact analysis will be started, in line with the Dijkstra and Geurts motion, to weigh the effects on economy and ecology in balance.

Antwoord 14 Parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma zal, in lijn met de motie Dijkstra en Geurts 8 , worden gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op economie en ecologie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Dik-Faber over de plaatsing van windmolens binnen een gebied in de gemeente Haarlem dat gereguleerd is door het Luchthavenindelingsbesluit

MPs Bruins and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why wind turbines near Schiphol in Haarlem are restricted under the airport zoning decree, while a taller KPN mast stands nearby, and urged a waiver. The minister answered that aviation safety rules (ICAO, LIB Schiphol) limit turbine heights, the ILT gave a negative advice, and the height restrictions will be maintained.
No, the current height restriction rules in the LIB Schiphol will be maintained.
Nee, de huidige regels voor hoogtebeperkingen in het LIB Schiphol worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht waarin wordt gewaarschuwd voor interferentie van de nieuwe 5G frequentieband met de frequentieband voor altimeters in de burgerluchtvaart

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported interference between US 5G bands and aviation radio altimeters, including whether more research and extra measures are needed. The minister replied that the Dutch 3.5 GHz band is further from the altimeter band than in the US, that no evidence of a safety risk exists, and that the government follows international research and European rollouts closely.
I have no indication that there is a potential danger to aviation safety.
Concluderend heb ik geen aanwijzingen dat er een potentieel gevaar is voor de vliegveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de BSO-bus

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat about a BSO bus that caught fire near a childcare centre, whether the RDW tested fire safety, whether the test documents will be shared, and whether the type approval will be reconsidered and the investigation made independent. The minister said the RDW type approval does not cover fire safety, that investigations by insurers, the manufacturer and inspectorates are ongoing, and that no immediate intervention is currently deemed necessary.
A fire safety test is not part of this.
Een toetsing op brandveiligheid maakt hier geen deel van uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de bij dodelijk ongeval verwoeste trike die weer veilig is bevonden door de RDW

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a trike destroyed in a fatal crash and later re-certified by the RDW shows that re-inspection standards for crash-damaged vehicles are adequate, and whether the RDW-website will show past driving bans. The Minister answered that RDW re-inspection checks handling, braking and safety systems, that a modernisation project is underway with a framework expected in Q1 2021, and that a change to the registration regulation to show past driving bans is due in H1 2021, expected to be operational by early 2022.
Essential to all this is that the RDW must in all cases learn as quickly as possible of every vehicle that has become a damaged vehicle, so that a driving ban can be imposed.

Essentieel bij dit alles is dat de RDW in alle gevallen zo spoedig mogelijk kennis moet hebben van elk voertuig dat een schadevoertuig is geworden, zodat een verbod voor het rijden op de weg kan worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht in Nieuwsblad Transport over Mautclaim

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the minister whether the government supports about 600 Dutch firms reclaiming excess German truck toll for 2017, whether Dutch exposure to similar CJEU-linked claims exists, and how TLN's no-cure-no-pay claims arrangement is viewed. The minister answered that the claims are a matter between firms and the German state, that the German court must still rule, that no consequences for the Netherlands are expected because enforcement costs were excluded from the tariff calculation, and that the arrangement is for individual firms to use.
I cannot interfere in any possible legal proceedings.
Ik kan me niet mengen in eventuele gerechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het inzichtelijk maken en heroverwegen van alle trajectcontroles in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for a full overview of all active traffic-section (trajectcontrole) speed cameras in the Netherlands, showing fine revenue and effects on road safety, and whether all such systems should be reconsidered. The government provided fine revenue per section for 2018 and 2019, explained that the cameras aim at speed compliance rather than revenue, and declined to reconsider them, citing their contribution to compliance and the difficulty of isolating road-safety effects.
Precisely stating the number of traffic accidents and casualties before and after introduction of these traffic-section controls would require extensive separate research.
Het precies aangeven van het aantal verkeersongevallen en -slachtoffers vóór en ná invoering van deze trajectcontroles zou een uitgebreid separaat onderzoek vergen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Stel je voor dat je op kantoor werkt, eet én slaapt: dat is wat een chauffeur door corona elke dag moet doen'

MPs Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that truck drivers, due to COVID restrictions, cannot get a warm meal or proper sanitary facilities and must live in their cabs. The minister said extended cab stays are undesirable, rejected reopening roadside restaurants for drivers as unwise now, and pointed to ongoing dialogue with the petition initiators and unions and to campaigns on sanitation.
As I indicated above, relaxing the rules by opening roadside restaurants to professional drivers is currently not sensible.
Zoals ik hierboven aangeef, is een versoepeling in de vorm van het openstellen van wegrestaurants voor beroepschauffeurs momenteel niet verstandig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gijs van Dijk, Stoffer en Van Raan over stikstofberekeningen

MPs asked the minister about a 2014 review by Arcadis and NLR of nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport, including the review's findings, its commissioning, and the NLR role, with documents to be shared within a week. The minister answered that the concept memo was attached, that flagged points were corrected in a June 2014 addendum, that the commissioning contract is withheld as commercially confidential, and that new project-specific assessments will be done with updated models.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over opnieuw containers in de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported container losses from the Munich Maersk into the Wadden Sea, including cargo, the shipping company's disclosure to the coastguard, and warnings to fishers and island mayors. The minister answered that the Dutch and German coastguards were informed, the German coastguard found no containers, the shipper reported no losses, and a warning to mariners was issued, while declining to say what the ship was carrying because it did not sail in Dutch waters.
Since the ship did not sail in Dutch waters, I have no information about the cargo loading of the ship.
Aangezien het schip niet in Nederlandse wateren heeft gevaren, heb ik geen informatie over de belading van het schip.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over containers overboord in Duitse deel van de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about reports that around 200 containers fell overboard in the German North Sea, including their scale, consequences for the Dutch Wadden islands, coordination with Germany, and shipping safety. The minister answered that German Coast Guard searches found no containers, the shipowner denied any loss, there are no consequences for the Wadden islands or shipping safety, and coordination with German authorities took place.
The German Coast Guard found no containers or floating cargo after investigation.
De Duitse Kustwacht heeft na onderzoek geen containers of drijvende lading aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht dat er wederom honderden containers overboord zijn geslagen in de Noordzee

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of container loss in the North Sea, including the route taken, expected environmental damage, action against the shipowner, and a trilateral summit on closing the southern Wadden route. The minister replied that no containers were found, the ship followed no advised route with no storm warning, no environmental damage occurred, and that contact with German and Danish counterparts would be offered while warning against high expectations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over berichten dat opnieuw een containerramp heeft plaatsgevonden bij de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of a possible container loss near the Wadden Sea, including whether reporting duties, route restrictions, contingency plans and insurance were being addressed. The minister answered that no containers were found, the shipowner denied any loss, and that IMO, EU and contingency-plan actions will follow, with several answers deferring to later reports.
Subsequently no containers were found, and the shipowner of the Munich Maersk indicated that it had not lost any containers.
Er zijn vervolgens geen containers aangetroffen en de reder van de Munich Maersk heeft aangegeven geen containers te zijn verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma, Geurts en Von Martels over de kosten van kentekens van trekkers

MPs Postma, Geurts and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the RDW plans to charge far more than the promised maximum of €61 per new agricultural vehicle for identification and registration, and whether the RDW will be instructed to cap costs and introduce accelerated registration. The Minister acknowledges the sector's surprise, explains the cost structure, and proposes a transition period until 1 July 2021 with conversion-method registration and work toward accelerated registration, but does not commit to instructing the RDW on a €61 cap.
I have therefore entered into discussions with the RDW and the sector to reach an appropriate and swift solution in light of the law's entry into force on 1 January 2021.
Ik ben daarom samen met de RDW en de sector in gesprek gegaan om te komen tot een passende en snelle oplossing in het licht van de inwerkingtreding van de wet per 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de kosten voor kentekening van landbouwmachines

Stoffer (SGP) asked the minister about RDW fees for identifying and registering new agricultural machines, which exceed earlier communicated costs, and why versnelde inschrijving is not yet available. The minister acknowledges the sector's surprise and regret about the unclear costs, explains the cost structure, and introduces a transition period until 1 July 2021 with a conversion method and work on accelerated registration.
I regret that these costs were not explicitly shared with your House during the legislative process.
Ik betreur dat deze kosten tijdens het wetstraject niet expliciet met uw Kamer zijn gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bouali over het bericht '5 things to know about Post-Brexit aviation'

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the effects of a no-deal Brexit on aviation, including emergency measures, route permits, border checks and a possible return to the 1946 bilateral air agreement. The minister answered that an EU emergency measure would serve as the fallback, that a bilateral agreement is not currently needed, and that several matters remain undecided.
It is not precisely clear what Minister Shapps means by his remark about 'sensible additional flexibilities' and I do not want to anticipate this at this stage.
Het is niet precies duidelijk wat Minister Shapps met zijn opmerking over «sensible additional flexibilities» bedoelt en ik wil daar in dit stadium ook niet op vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de thuiswerken en wegverkeer

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why road traffic remained heavy despite the call to work from home, and how working-from-home and flexible work by employers were progressing. The minister answered that traffic had partly recovered to 70-80% of pre-crisis levels, that home working is a major factor but not for all workers, and that a regional employer approach with provinces, municipalities and business groups is underway, while declining to answer the last question in time for the MIRT committee meeting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Snelle douane helpt luchtvaart uit Corona’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Infrastructure about press reports on US preclearance at Schiphol, including the timeline of talks, economic benefits, and the process to implement it. The government replied that negotiations continue with Dutch sovereignty conditions maintained, the bilateral treaty must be concluded and then submitted to parliament, and the timing depends on negotiations and parliamentary process.
Only after the bilateral treaty negotiations are fully concluded can the treaty be signed. Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Pas nadat de bilaterale verdragsonderhandelingen volledig zijn afgerond, kan het verdrag ondertekend worden. Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de poging van Twente Airport om zonder vergunning zeer zware vliegtuigen te laten vertrekken

MP Van Raan asked the government about Twente Airport's attempt to operate very heavy aircraft without a permit, including whether the ILT granted an exemption under pressure and whether the airport repeatedly pushes regulatory limits. The minister answered that the ILT granted a one-off exemption for six Lufthansa aircraft under additional safety conditions, denied any influence from litigation threats or the airport's business plan, and said the ILT will tighten oversight of the airport.
The ILT is intensifying its attention on the airport because, based on the facts described, it has found that the airport repeatedly seeks the limits of the rules.

De ILT verscherpt haar aandacht voor de luchthaven, omdat zij op basis van de hiervoor beschreven feiten en omstandigheden heeft geconstateerd dat de luchthaven telkens de grenzen van de regels opzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Amhaouch en Postma over het bericht 'Onbegrip bij provincie over weigering Rijk om informatie voor stikstofaanpak te delen'

CDA MPs asked the agriculture minister why the national government refuses to share nitrogen-related farm data with provinces on privacy grounds, and whether this delays regional nitrogen plans, and asked about a study focusing on peak-polluting farms. The minister answered that privacy-sensitive data is not essential, that provinces already hold much of the information, that work on an alternative data-access solution is ongoing, and that the study reflects only one part of the broader approach.
I am working with RVO and BIJ12 (on behalf of the provinces) on an alternative solution to make the last part of the relevant information accessible to the provinces.
Ik werk samen met RVO en BIJ12 (namens de provincies) aan een alternatieve oplossing om het laatste deel van de relevante informatie toegankelijk te maken voor de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two CDA MPs asked why noise-barrier construction along the A79 at Valkenburg cannot be combined with planned road maintenance, and when residents will get clarity. The minister answered that barriers await the final noise-remediation plan (draft mid-2021, final early 2022, possible appeal), that maintenance cannot be delayed, and that barriers should be complete by 2027.

Only once the noise remediation plan Zuid-Nederland phase 2 (MJPG) is definitively adopted and irrevocable is there certainty about the noise barriers and other measures along the A79 at Goudenrood and Vroenhof.

Pas op het moment dat het geluidsaneringsplan Zuid-Nederland fase 2 (MJPG) definitief is vastgesteld en onherroepelijk is, is er zekerheid over de te realiseren geluidsschermen en andere maatregelen langs de A79 bij Goudenrood en Vroenhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de mogelijkheid tot sneltesten op Schiphol

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the government about testing at Schiphol airport, including implementing the motion on comprehensive airport testing, discouraging air travel to risk areas, introducing rapid tests and a Dutch-style mandatory testing model, and charging travellers for tests. The minister answered that mandatory negative tests for necessary travel from risk areas are planned, that testing on day 5 after arrival is being examined, and that rapid tests cannot yet be validated for asymptomatic testing, while the Israeli gargle test is still under evaluation.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Paternotte en Pia Dijkstra over de kabinetsreactie op het 73e OMT COVID-19 advies en de berichten over het testbeleid van Duitsland en Frankrijk, respectievelijk het bericht over

MPs from D66 asked the health and infrastructure ministers about testing of travellers from high-risk countries, airport contact tracing, air cargo capacity and pricing for vaccine distribution, and EU vaccine negotiations. The ministers answered that testing and quarantine measures are being developed, that contact tracing follows RIVM guidance, and that logistics preparations and EU negotiations are ongoing, but declined to answer each question separately.
Unfortunately, this has not proven possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Renovatie van de Afsluitdijk loopt flinke vertraging op door problemen met spuisluizen

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister about delays in the Afsluitdijk renovation caused by sluice problems, including completion timing, the bike path, extra costs and road traffic impact. The minister said completion is expected in 2025 but planning is not yet fixed, bike bridges cannot be widened, extra costs are still under negotiation with the contractor, and traffic will face longer hindrance.
Unfortunately that is not yet possible at this moment, because we are still in discussion with the contractor about it.
Helaas is dat op dit moment nog niet mogelijk, omdat we hier nog over in gesprek zijn met de aannemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het Internationaal Certificaat voor Pleziervaartuigen (ICP)

An MP asked the minister about misuse of the Dutch ICP pleasure-craft certificate by criminals and foreigners to evade tax, and whether a lighter alternative to the zeebrief could be introduced. The minister agreed misuse is unacceptable, promised tighter application checks and an end to issuing ICPs to non-Dutch non-residents from 2021, and said the ICP cannot be used for tax evasion since it is not an official registration, while keeping the certificate itself and exploring alternatives only for countries that do not accept it.
To counter misuse, I have been in consultation with the associations that issue the ICP and the police since May of this year on tightening the procedures.
Om misbruik tegen te gaan ben ik met de bonden die het ICP afgeven en de politie sinds mei van dit jaar in overleg over een aanscherping van de procedures.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over de berichten ‘Nederlands vaardocument gebruikt bij grootschalige drugssmokkel’ en ‘Nederlandse schepen aan ketting in Italië door omstreden bootpaspoort’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the ministers whether the Dutch ICP pleasure-craft certificate is facilitating international drug smuggling and what registration reforms are planned. The minister acknowledged misuse of the ICP, said procedures will be tightened via a new convenant from 1 January 2021, and said a broader boat-ownership registration needs further study with the Justice ministry.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van den Berg, Palland, Postma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Keuringsinstantie DCI Joure (NKIP) in Chinese handen'

MPs from the CDA asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Economic Affairs ministers whether the Dutch yacht certification body DCI Joure, which became fully Chinese-owned in November 2019, poses risks, whether the takeover could have been screened, and what monitoring applies. The government answered that the takeover falls outside existing investment screening, that accreditation by the RvA and supervision by the ILT ensure quality and independence, and that it sees no national security risk.
The cabinet establishes that there are no risks to national security from the takeover of this body, which oversees the quality of pleasure craft.
Het kabinet stelt vast dat er voor de nationale veiligheid geen risico’s zijn bij de overname van deze instantie, die toeziet op de kwaliteit van plezierjachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Bromet over het artikel 'NAM wil productiewater Schoonebeek injecteren in Drentse gasvelden'

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about NAM's plan to inject produced water from Schoonebeek into Drenthe gas fields, including cross-border risks and the lack of direct information to the German municipality of Emlichheim. The minister answered that no cross-border risks are currently expected, that the municipality was informed via documents but not actively involved under the bilateral framework, and that risks will be examined in an MER and permit process overseen by SodM.
For the planned injection in the Schoonebeek region there are currently no cross-border environmental effects.
Bij de voorgenomen injectie in de regio Schoonebeek is er op dit moment geen sprake van grensoverschrijdende milieugevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'ASV: Kade Kanaleneiland Utrecht geteisterd door inbrekers'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about repeated break-ins at the Kanaleneiland quay in Utrecht, the number of incidents, prevention measures and whether Rijkswaterstaat owns the quay. The minister answered that police and municipality hold primary responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat owns only the sheet-pile structure and anchors, and offered to help find solutions without committing to a concrete new step.
Rijkswaterstaat itself has no data on the number of break-ins and has requested the data from the municipality.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft zelf geen gegevens over het aantal inbraken en heeft de gegevens opgevraagd bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Twente Airport sluit akkoord met Inspectie over vertrek 747’s: zo min mogelijk brandstof aan boord’

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's (ILT) dispute with Twente Airport over permitting departures of six Lufthansa widebody aircraft, and the roles, safety rules and resolution involved. The minister answered that ILT could not approve permanent certificate changes because the airport lacked required infrastructure, that the issue was resolved with a one-off package of safety requirements, and that no court intervention was needed.
The ILT, the licensing authority, cannot agree to this because Twente Airport does not meet international laws and regulations on several points.
De ILT, vergunningverlener, kan hier niet mee instemmen, omdat Twente Airport op enkele onderdelen niet voldoet aan internationale wet- en regelgeving
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Is er nog leven voor VDL Nedcar na 2023 nu BMW afhaakt’

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked the government whether it had contacts with VDL Nedcar, BMW or the German government about BMW ending its contract, which ministries are involved in finding a solution, and whether an integral action plan for the region will be made. Minister Wiebes answered that contacts with VDL Nedcar and BMW took place at high level, no contact with the German government occurred on the contract, several ministries and NFIA help find new clients, and a regional development package with funding and road projects is being pursued.
The cabinet is generally reticent about publishing information on the content of specific contacts with businesses.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het publiceren van informatie over de inhoud van specifieke contacten met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over vrachtwagenchauffeurs die hun cabine niet meer uitkomen

SP MPs asked whether truck drivers confined to their cabins during COVID measures lack humane conditions, such as access to toilets and showers, and what structural fix the government will provide. The State Secretary answered that employers must cover rest facilities, that the government relies on calls to petrol stations and rest areas to keep sanitary facilities open, and that talks with the sector are ongoing, without committing to a structural solution.
In addition, the Ministry of IenW keeps a close watch on industry organisations, so that any signals about the availability of sanitary facilities for drivers can be picked up in time.
Daarnaast houdt het Ministerie van IenW de vinger aan de pols bij brancheorganisaties, om eventuele signalen over de beschikbaarheid van sanitair voor chauffeurs tijdig op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Laçin over onvoldoende mogelijkheden voor de politie om verkeershufters aan te pakken

MPs Van Nispen and Laçin asked how police could better catch extreme-speed drivers who post their offences online, including more trajectory controls, a speed limiter, platform takedowns and wider investigative powers. The minister said enforcement has been stepped up and trajectory controls are being installed on N-roads, but admitted investigation from video alone is hard and said that making Article 5a Wvw a provisional-detention offence is being prepared in a draft omnibus bill.
I expect the bill can be submitted to the Council of State for advice early next year.
Ik verwacht dat het wetsvoorstel naar verwachting begin volgend jaar ter advisering aan de Raad van State kan worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Leiding Waternet verzwijgt vernietigende veiligheidstest'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Waternet did not inform the ILT of a critical penetration test, whether the board was informed, and whether the incident was reported to the NCSC. The minister answered that the ILT was not informed before publication, that it would have been appropriate to inform it, that an ILT investigation is underway, and that pen-tests are not reportable under the Wbni.

However, given the current circumstances, it would have been appropriate for the ILT to have been informed in good time by Waternet, even though there was at that time no legal obligation or specific request from the ILT to do so.

Het was echter, gegeven de actuele omstandigheden, passend geweest als de ILT tijdig was ingelicht door Waternet, ook al was er op dat moment geen wettelijke verplichting of concreet verzoek vanuit de ILT om dat te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Renovatie Afsluitdijk duurt door fout zeker 3 jaar langer, valt duurder uit'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported error in the Afsluitdijk renovation that delays the project by about three years and raises its cost, including the cause, traffic impacts, mitigation and extra funding. The minister explained that a combination of low water levels with high waves was omitted from the design inputs, said traffic and cycling disruption will last longer, and said the extra budget is still under negotiation with the contractor, with details expected in spring.
I expect to be able to give you more clarity on this next spring.
Naar verwachting kan ik u hierover komend voorjaar meer duidelijkheid geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Laçin over de toekomst van Groningen Airport Eelde

MPs Van Raan and Laçin asked whether the Minister knows of Groningen Airport Eelde's weak traffic and financial position and whether the state will provide six to eight million euro per year, and about closure procedures. The Minister said the government sees airports as independent enterprises, structural state contributions do not fit aviation policy, no formal request was received, and shareholders must first decide on the airport's future; closure would require changes to regulations and the Aviation Act.
The cabinet sees airports as independent enterprises that are themselves responsible for financing their activities.
Het kabinet ziet luchthavens als zelfstandige ondernemingen die zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor de bekostiging van hun activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over 1 miljoen verzakkende huizen door bodemdaling

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and of Infrastructure about the risk that up to a million homes sink due to land subsidence, the costs, who bears them, and what policy exists. The government answered that owners bear foundation repair costs, that municipalities and water boards manage groundwater with limited ability to prevent further sinking, and listed existing funding and support programmes without committing to new measures.
Enquiries with the provincial, water board and municipal associations show that it is not possible to provide this overview in full detail within the set deadline.
Uit navraag bij de koepels van provincies, waterschappen en gemeenten blijkt dat het niet mogelijk is om dit overzicht op de gestelde termijn «en detail» te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onmenselijke situatie voor bemanningen op zeeschepen, levering van vitale goederen loopt gevaar’.

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that about 300,000 seafarers worldwide were stranded by COVID-19 crew-change restrictions, how many were Dutch, why crew changes still failed after a motion and a July letter, and which steps were taken since. The minister acknowledged the problem, said about 75% of overdue Dutch-flag crew changes had occurred, attributed the obstacles mainly to other countries' national measures, and listed expanded visa processing and diplomatic efforts, without committing to new binding measures.
Not being able to change crews on time potentially has a major impact on the well-being and physical health of seafarers.
Het niet – tijdig – kunnen aflossen heeft potentieel een grote impact op het welbevinden en de fysieke gezondheid van zeevarenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en De Groot over het bericht ‘Fundering van 1 miljoen huizen bedreigd door laag grondwaterpeil’

MPs Van Eijs and De Groot (D66) asked about a report that about 1 million homes risk foundation damage from low groundwater, and about the responsibilities of water boards, farmers, municipalities and the state. The Minister answered that the damage estimate is per owner and largely modest, that government supports owners through viewers, funding funds and knowledge centres, and that owners are responsible for their foundations, while referring several questions to other levels and ministries.
This problem does not primarily lie with the water boards.
Deze problematiek ligt niet primair bij de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofcrisis doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that road widening could continue despite the nitrogen crisis because of a calculation method that cuts off dispersion at 5 km, and about differences between the SRM2 and OPS models. The minister acknowledged the model differences, defended the 5 km cut-off as technically justified and consistent with past practice, said lawyers are closely involved in preparing decisions on the seven remaining MIRT road projects, and did not commit to new external legal advice.
In preparing the decisions on the MIRT road projects, lawyers are and will be closely involved.
Bij de voorbereiding van de besluiten over de MIRT-wegenprojecten zijn en worden juristen nauw betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the 2019 national speed reduction to 100 km/h was modelled without a 5 km cut-off while the 2011 speed increase to 130 km/h used a 3 km cut-off, calling this an accounting trick. The minister answered that the models differ for justified reasons, that the freed nitrogen space is not a saving, and that backdating speed changes to manufacture headroom is neither legally nor ecologically an option.
Raising speed on sections where 130 km/h did not yet apply, but was eventually foreseen, was treated under the PAS as an autonomous development.

Het verhogen van de snelheid op trajecten waar destijds nog geen 130 km/uur gold als maximumsnelheid, maar waar dit (uiteindelijk) wel was voorzien, werd in het PAS beschouwd als een autonome ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Zonder schoolreisjes en evenementen gaan de touringcarbedrijven ten onder'

An MP asked the minister about reports that touring coach companies face collapse without school trips and events, asking about sector size, government contact, survival measures and fallback use of coaches. The government confirmed the sector's size and revenue, described intensified contact during the pandemic, pointed to generic support schemes and said sector-specific aid is a cabinet-wide trade-off, while the market governs the sector.
Questions from individual touring coach entrepreneurs were also answered by email or letter, and on 17 June the State Secretary of EZK personally received a petition from the touring coach sector.

Ook zijn vragen van individuele touringcarondernemers beantwoord via e-mail of per brief en heeft de Staatssecretaris van EZK op 17 juni persoonlijk een petitie in ontvangst genomen van de touringcarbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Archief deltapionier verkwanseld’

An MP asked whether most of deltapioneer Johan van Veen's Delta Works reports had gone missing and whether they could be found and made available. The minister answered that about two-thirds of the collection was preserved, transferred to the National Archives in 2005 and catalogued in 2020, that many reports were digitised, and that the ministry stays in contact with private parties holding the rest.
Besides the National Archives, the Zeeland Archives and the library of Delft University of Technology also hold material by Johan van Veen.
Naast het Nationaal Archief bevatten bijvoorbeeld ook het Zeeuws archief en de bibliotheek van de Technische Universiteit Delft materiaal van Johan van Veen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Uitbaggeren van het Westgat is weer nodig’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Westgat channel near Lauwersoog needs dredging, whether it was last dredged in 2018, how maintenance is planned, and whether the Wadden accessibility motion requires action. The minister answers that the 2018 dredging was a one-off pilot paid for by regional parties rather than Rijkswaterstaat, that there is no regular dredging, that sand from the Westgat cannot serve coastal nourishment, and that the economic effects will be assessed in a final evaluation in 2021.
There is no question of regular dredging of the Westgat.
Er is geen sprake van regulier baggeren van het Westgat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Brenk en Laçin over de piek in legionellabesmettingen

MPs Van Brenk and Laçin asked the minister about a July 2020 peak in Legionella infections, whether the RIVM's weather explanation was sound, and whether the government would fund research, campaigns and clinician awareness. The minister answered that the peak is linked to weather conditions, that no common source cluster was found, and that existing prevention and testing guidance is adequate, while committing to continued monitoring and expanded source-tracing.
There are no indications that Legionella infections are being overlooked more often at this time.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat legionellabesmettingen in deze tijd vaker over het hoofd worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

Three ChristenUnie MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management when decisions on seven MIRT road projects would be taken, how much nitrogen space they need under the Hordijk commission's advice, and whether decisions can be postponed until parliament debates that advice. The minister gave the planning status of the seven projects, said AERIUS remains the basis for permitting, and committed to informing parliament on AERIUS development by next summer, while stating the government aims to realise the projects quickly under a motion.
On the further development of AERIUS, the House will be informed before next summer.
Over de doorontwikkeling van AERIUS wordt de Kamer voor de zomer van volgend jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Restanten Paddepoelsterbrug zijn definitief verwijderd’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why no temporary replacement for the collided Paddepoelsterbrug bridge has been provided, why the removal was communicated without a solution for residents, why shipping is prioritised, what contact exists with residents, and when a definitive plan will be presented. The minister answered that a modular temporary bridge is unsafe, that the removal was needed for navigation safety, that contact with residents has been regular though slow at first, and that a structural decision will be taken at the MIRT consultation on 26 November.
I consider it important to first discuss these with the administrative partners.
Ik vind het belangrijk om deze eerst met de bestuurlijke partners te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de voorzieningen voor beroepschauffeurs

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the closure of road-side restaurant kitchens during the COVID-19 measures had been weighed against the impact on professional truck drivers, who may lack hot meals and toilets. The minister answered that takeaway service is an exception to the closure, that restaurants and fuel stations are urged to keep sanitary facilities open, and that the ministry is in contact with the sector and will act on any signals.
I am keeping a close eye on the goods transport sector, so that action can be taken if there are signals that drivers can no longer carry out their work responsibly.
Ik houd een vinger aan de pols bij de goederenvervoersector, om actie te kunnen ondernemen bij eventuele signalen dat chauffeurs hun werk niet meer op een verantwoorde manier kunnen uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het tekort aan luchtverkeersleiders op Eindhoven Airport en Groningen Eelde Airport

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked the minister about air traffic controller shortages at Eindhoven, Groningen Eelde and Maastricht airports, and about accelerating integration of military and civilian air traffic control. The minister acknowledged staffing shortages and outlined recruitment and harmonisation steps, but declined to speed up integration and said reassignment of controllers to other airports is not currently feasible.
Accelerating the full integration, planned for the third quarter of 2023, is not possible given the scale and necessary care of the integration process.
Een versnelling van de volledige integratie, die voorzien is in het derde kwartaal van 2023, is niet mogelijk gegeven de omvang en noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid van het integratie proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Flinke weerstand akkerbouw tegen Waddenagenda'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about farmers' and arable growers' opposition to the draft Wadden Agenda 2050, including their involvement, consequences for arable farming, and Natura 2000 links. The minister answers that LTO and nature groups were involved, that the agenda sets no land-use changes, and that talks with the agricultural sector and a Waddenbrief before the 5 November debate will follow.
The Ministries of IenW and LNV will enter into talks with the land and arable farming sector about the sector's position in the Agenda.
Het Ministerie van IenW en van LNV gaan in gesprek gaan met de land- en akkerbouwsector over de positie van de sector in de Agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de  leden Remco Dijkstra en Weverling over berichten rond de actie van Greenpeace om de Doggersbank te beschermen door het storten van stenen

MPs Dijkstra and Weverling asked the ministers about Greenpeace dumping rocks on the Dogger Bank in the North Sea, its legal status, possible sanctions, and effects on fishers and the North Sea Agreement talks. The minister says the action is rejected, the stones were dumped in British waters so Dutch law does not apply, the Dutch prosecutor is considering an investigation, and Greenpeace has pledged to stay in the talks.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that it is considering whether there is reason to conduct a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten te bekijken of er aanleiding is om strafrechtelijk onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Belhaj en De Groot over munitiedumps in de Deltawateren en Noordzeekust

Three D66 MPs asked the government about the munitions dump in the Oosterschelde and North Sea sites, including the risks, monitoring, clean-up or capping costs, and whether a dedicated management fund exists. The government answered that research results will be sent to parliament in 2021, that monitoring shows no danger, that no clean-up or capping is planned under current assessments, and that only existing monitoring budgets are available.
The results will then be submitted to your House in 2021.
De resultaten worden dan in 2021 aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de staat van de Waddenecologie

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about invasive alien species in the Wadden Sea, their ecological and economic risks, climate change effects, and the Waddenvereniging's criticism of the Wadden 2050 agenda. The minister answered that monitoring and a trilateral action plan are in place, that no specific species currently cause concern, and that climate and ecosystem measures will follow in the implementation programme, while noting no dedicated budget for exotic-species research in the agenda.
On my own initiative, I spoke with the director of the Waddenvereniging last summer.
Op mijn initiatief heb ik afgelopen zomer gesproken met de directeur van de Waddenvereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Kwart van alle auto-ongelukken  gebeurt tijdens de eerste drie minuten'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about research showing many car accidents occur in the first minutes of a trip, and about insurer data, telematics-based premiums, data sharing and phone distraction measures. The minister answered that the MONO campaign and the Strategic Road Safety Plan address distraction, and that insurer data initiatives such as a Road Safety Data Taskforce are being explored, without committing to new binding measures.
That is why I, as mentioned in answer 2, am focusing on the MONO campaign, whose essence is that a driver is Undisturbed On the Road.
Daarom zet ik – zoals vermeld in antwoord 2 – in op de MONO-campagne waarbij de essentie is dat een bestuurder Ongestoord Onderweg is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Postma en Omtzigt over de toepassing van het tonnageregime voor de offshoresector

MPs Mulder, Postma and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch tonnage tax regime is stricter than in other EU countries, whether it covers vessels used to build offshore wind farms, and what this means for cost and competitiveness. The government answered that the Dutch regime is stricter on some points (e.g. Denmark allows construction-vessel profits), that wind-farm operation profits are excluded, that transport vessels to offshore parks can qualify, and that it will await an evaluation due in early 2021 before deciding on any change.
The cabinet wants to await the aforementioned evaluation before making statements on the desirability and design of any possible adjustment to the tonnage regime.
Het kabinet wil de hiervoor genoemde evaluatie afwachten, alvorens uitspraken te doen over de wenselijkheid en vormgeving van een eventuele aanpassing van de tonnageregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over drie studies over besmettingen aan boord van het vliegtuig

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked the minister about three studies on COVID-19 transmission aboard aircraft and whether they justify concern, pre-flight screening and whether RIVM's literature review will be shared. The minister replied that the cases date from before the sector's measures, that existing protocols and RIVM advice remain in place, that testing cannot be mandated under current law, and that a literature report will be shared around mid-October.
I will inform your House about this.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over NEMA (National Emission Model for Agriculture) en AERIUS Calculator

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how they will ease the ecology-economy tension in nitrogen policy, whether the AERIUS Calculator's methods (SRM-2 for roads with a 5 km cut-off versus OPS for other sources) are defensible, and about monitoring, permit numbers and building-phase exemptions. The minister replied that the calculator remains the best available tool, that the government is studying a scientifically based distance or deposition threshold with RIVM, that the meter network will be expanded, and that exact permit and housing figures are not centrally recorded or depend on future emissions.
I consider it important that competent authorities base their permit decisions on the best available method, and that is the AERIUS Calculator.
Ik vind het van belang dat bevoegde gezagen bij hun vergunningverlening uitgaan van de best beschikbare methode en dat is AERIUS Calculator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de gemaakte kosten voor Lelystad Airport

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister to confirm costs of Lelystad Airport, the Schiphol dividend effect, government spending on information and advocacy, and subsidies to pro-airport bodies such as the Lelystad Airportkrant and a foundation supporting the airport. The minister answers that the costs were shared with Follow the Money, that dividend impact cannot be determined ex post, that the Lelystad Airportkrant and the foundation receive no ministry funding, and that the public is informed objectively.
I cannot make any statements about that.
Daarover kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Problemen met afsluitingen door vrachtwagens nog steeds niet op orde: tunnels elf keer per dag dicht'

An MP asked the minister about recurring closures of Noord-Holland tunnels (Velsertunnel, Coentunnel) caused by overheight trucks, including causes, costs, fines, delays and remedies. The minister explained that height detection is set above the legal 4-metre limit, reported closure durations, said Rijkswaterstaat checks and fines some trucks but police issue most fines and no cost data exist, and described signage and photo boards as measures.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have the current data of the police.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over de actuele gegevens van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over de stikstofberekeningen 2014 Lelystad Airport

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the 2014 nitrogen deposition calculations for Lelystad Airport's environmental impact report (MER) were corrected, covering routes, study area, time units, deposition summation and software. The minister answered in detail, attributing the discrepancies to a units error, an enlarged study area, a summation error on a computer system, and stating that the corrected deposition is at most 0.4 mol/ha/year and that the result files have been made public under the Wob.
This correction led to an increase in emissions by a factor of 5 (rounded).
Dit herstel heeft geleid tot een toename van de emissies met een factor 5 (afgerond).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Postma en Stoffer over het bericht 'Zonder meer asfalt staan we straks stil'

MPs Dijkstra, Postma and Stoffer asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a press report warning that road investment is needed, covering population growth, traffic trends since COVID-19, cost-benefit figures, MIRT budget allocation, freight corridors and the National Growth Fund. The Minister answered substantively on most points, stressing that all modes are needed, that the road budget to 2030 is largely committed, and that new road projects would need extra funding; the Minister did not recognise the cost-benefit figures cited in the article.
Investment decisions are taken together with the region via the Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Your House is involved in this through the Algemene Overleggen MIRT and Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Investeringsbeslissingen worden samen met de regio genomen via de Bestuurlijke Overleggen MIRT. Uw Kamer wordt hierbij betrokken in de Algemene Overleggen MIRT en Nota Overleggen MIRT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de APK-vrijstelling voor voertuigen van 50 jaar of ouder

The MP asked when the MOT (APK) exemption for vehicles aged 50 or older takes effect, how many vehicles it covers, and whether the RDW is ready to implement it. The minister answered that the exemption is set to take effect on 1 January 2021 through an amended Besluit voertuigen, that about 68,000 vehicles will be exempt, and that the RDW has the implementation under way.
Publication of the decree is planned for the end of October, with the intended date of entry into force being 1 January 2021.
De publicatie van het besluit is voorzien voor eind oktober, met als beoogde inwerkingtredingsdatum 1 januari 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over geen airco’s in snikhete vrachtwagencabines

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether it is acceptable that truck drivers must sleep in extremely hot cabins without air conditioning, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the problem but says air conditioning is primarily a matter for employers and employees, points to an energy investment deduction and to ILT enforcement of rest-time rules, and does not commit to new measures.
It is up to the employer to ensure that drivers can rest under the right conditions.
Het is aan de werkgever om ervoor te zorgen dat chauffeurs onder de juiste omstandigheden kunnen rusten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Sloten bij Reusel en Someren vervuild; inspectie bezoekt boeren'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked why reports of suspected manure fraud in Brabant, including high nitrogen and phosphorus in ditches, were not taken seriously, how reports are registered and handled across agencies, and whether farmers should be asked to report anonymously. The minister defends the earlier position that soil samples are not conclusive evidence, describes the reporting channels, case volumes and handling times, and points to the area-based enforcement approach, without committing to an external review or a farmer reporting campaign.
I currently see no reason for an external investigation into how reports of fraud are recorded and processed.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar de wijze van opname en verwerking van signalen van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Verbreden snelwegen kan ondanks stikstofverbindingen doorgaan dankzij ‘rekentruc’ kabinet’

An MP asks whether widening motorways can proceed under nitrogen rules given a claim that traffic emissions beyond 5 km are excluded, and whether the 100 km/h speed-limit reduction is double-counted and attributed to nature. The minister replies that SRM2 with a 5 km maximum range is used for project calculations, that long-range emissions are captured in national monitoring, that the 30% nature allocation is a policy starting point, and that the government will proceed with existing legal frameworks while legal staff are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de oorzaken van droogte en de gevolgen voor natuur

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about drought causes, including drainage for agriculture, daytime irrigation, and effects on nature and Natura 2000 areas. The minister denied that drought is simply a policy failure, acknowledged agricultural drainage as one cause among several, and committed to an inventory of groundwater abstractions and area-based approaches.
The water boards and Rijkswaterstaat cannot state how many cubic metres that was in that period.
De waterschappen en Rijkswaterstaat kunnen niet aangeven hoeveel kubieke meter dat in die periode geweest is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over ammoniumnitraat

A GroenLinks MP asked the Infrastructure and Water Management ministry about a ship carrying 7,009 tonnes of ammonium nitrate moored in Rotterdam's Merwehaven, including whether it met limits, why it called at Rotterdam, and why the Yara site is not listed as explosive on the risk map. The state secretary answered that the cargo was a non-explosive oxidising substance, that the ship and packaging met legal requirements, that sea transport is governed by the IMDG code, and that no changes to port planning policy were planned.
The ship in question and the packaging complied with the statutory requirements.
Het desbetreffende schip en de verpakking voldeed aan de wettelijke voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Brenk over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast in Sluiskil

An MP from 50PLUS asked why the Stichting Wateroverlast Sluiskil received no timely replies to its letters about water nuisance from the Ghent-Terneuzen canal, and what action would be taken. The minister acknowledged the delays, said Rijkswaterstaat will meet the foundation and the municipality, but stated that the canal's water level is set by a treaty unchanged since the 1960s and that no further maintenance measures are available or planned.
Rijkswaterstaat invites the foundation for a conversation.
Rijkswaterstaat nodigt de stichting uit voor een gesprek.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Nijkerken-de Haan en Ziengs over het bericht dat het rijbewijs van een gehandicapte chauffeur is ingenomen

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the CBR refused to renew the driving licence of a disabled professional driver who had held one for 31 years, and whether a coulance scheme should exist for such cases. The minister acknowledged the impact, cited the expert assessment and a 2003 CBR policy note requiring two-handed control, rejected a general coulance scheme on road-safety grounds, and said the case was with the CBR without committing to contact it.
A general coulance scheme based on positive past indications is not justified from a road-safety perspective, because past indications do not necessarily say anything about future fitness to drive.

Een algemene coulanceregeling op basis van positieve indicaties uit het verleden is vanuit het oogpunt van de verkeersveiligheid niet verantwoord omdat indicaties uit het verleden niet noodzakelijk iets zeggen over de rijgeschiktheid in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het bericht ‘Oudere chauffeur komt tot stilstand door dictaat Brussel’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the letter informing older professional drivers about the expiring Code 95 requirement had not yet been sent less than six weeks before the change, and whether earlier action would have avoided extra costs and driver surprise. The minister answered that the letter was delayed by the timing decision on the law's entry into force, that entry into force has been moved to 1 December 2020 at the sector's request, that the CBR had been tasked with preparing a helpdesk, and that the letter would be sent to drivers in the week of 29 September.
The letter to drivers will be sent in the week of 29 September.
De brief aan chauffeurs zal in de week van 29 september worden verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de gerenoveerde en afbladderende Waalbrug

An MP asked the minister why the renovated Waalbrug in Nijmegen is still peeling and whether repainting can be brought forward, given residents' disappointment after eighteen months of works. The minister answered that chromium-6 found during the works raised costs to 70-80 million euros, so repainting was postponed about ten years, with inspections in the meantime and coordination with the municipality.

Because research showed the Waalbrug remains structurally safe for 10 more years without preservation of the arch structure, and because the costs of removing chromium-6 are high, I have decided to postpone this work.

Omdat uit onderzoek is gebleken dat de Waalbrug zonder conservering van de boogconstructie nog 10 jaar constructief veilig is én omdat de kosten van het verwijderen van chroom-6 hoog zijn, heb ik besloten deze werkzaamheden uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Paternotte over overschrijdingen van de geluidsnormen bij Schiphol

MPs Kröger and Paternotte asked the minister why Schiphol exceeded noise norms in 2019 under the new standards, whether enforcement is possible, and how the new regime will be legally anchored. The minister answered that exceedances at 6 of 35 enforcement points stem from strict preferential runway use under the new regime, that the ILT will not sanction such exceedances, and that legal anchoring awaits environmental and nature assessments.
Enforcement of the rules and limit values of the NNHS as such is only possible after they are legally anchored in the LVB.
Handhaving van de regels en grenswaarden van het NNHS als zodanig is pas mogelijk na wettelijke verankering daarvan in het LVB.

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het bericht 'Duitsland spoort veel besmettingen op', 'Van nieuwe Duitse virusdragers werd 40% besmet in het buitenland'

MPs Kröger and Renkema asked the health minister about the share of new Dutch infections acquired abroad, why Schiphol testing is limited to daytime hours and a daily cap, and whether overland travellers and other airports are tested. The minister answered that about 5 to 12 percent of recent cases had a travel history, that the Schiphol testing trial was running at a limited scale and is being evaluated by RIVM, and that future testing decisions will follow those results.
Based on the results from RIVM, we will consider how to proceed with testing incoming travellers at airports.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van het RIVM zullen we bezien hoe we verder gaan met het testen van inkomende reizigers op luchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Coronacrisis helpt Minister van Nieuwenhuizen van rekeningrijden af'

MP Schonis (D66) asked the minister whether he was aware of a report that the Covid crisis was helping him avoid road pricing, and how this squared with the Klimaatakkoord commitment to study pay-per-use variants. The minister confirmed the commitment, said telework agreements with employers could reduce congestion, and said the study of three pay-per-use variants is ongoing with an interim report due in autumn 2020.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform the House of Representatives about this in autumn 2020.
De Staatsecretaris van Financiën zal de Tweede Kamer hierover in het najaar van 2020 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het handhaven van de aangepaste maximumsnelheid op snelwegen

An MP asked the minister whether the lowered 100 km/h motorway speed limit is being complied with, whether enforcement has changed, and whether the expected nitrogen reduction is booked despite possible higher overtaking. The minister replied that offence figures show no clear rise compared with 2019, enforcement is unchanged with existing resources, and the nitrogen calculation uses representative driving behaviour, with the reduction booked on expected traffic rather than actual compliance.
The caveat to be made is that the lowering of the maximum speed coincides with a change in traffic intensities due to the COVID-19 measures.
De kanttekening die hierbij gemaakt dient te worden is dat de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid samenvalt met een verandering van de verkeersintensiteiten als gevolg van de COVID-19 maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Sloop dreigt voor onafgebouwd testcentrum getijde-energie bij de Grevelingendam’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the unfinished tidal energy test centre at the Grevelingendam should be revived given its innovation potential, and whether the permit withdrawal could be postponed. The minister answered that the sector offers limited innovation potential, a market scan will show by 31 December 2020 whether a new party will complete the centre, and otherwise Rijkswaterstaat will demolish it so sluicing can resume.
By 31 December 2020 it will be known whether there is interest and under what conditions parties want to participate.
Uiterlijk 31 december 2020 zal bekend zijn of er belangstelling is en onder welke voorwaarden partijen willen instappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het bericht: ‘EV’s zorgen in 2030 voor 1.400 extra zwaargewonden’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press claims that EVs will cause 1,400 extra seriously injured road victims by 2030, and whether registration and road safety policy account for this. The minister says the underlying report was not made available, that current crash data cannot support firm conclusions about EVs, that EVs are as safe as combustion cars and that no extra measures in the Road Safety Plan are needed.
The underlying report was requested but not made available by the researchers.
Het achterliggende rapport is opgevraagd, maar niet beschikbaar gesteld door de onderzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over een verschillend btw-tarief op verschillende vormen van educatie

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked why VAT rates differ across forms of education (music, sport, driving lessons) and how other EU states treat them. The Secretary of State explained that VAT rules follow EU directive obligations and CJEU case law, with discretion only over reduced rates, and that driving lessons fall under the standard 21% rate.
The Netherlands has no policy room to unilaterally deviate from applicable European rules as far as mandatory exemptions are concerned.
Nederland heeft geen beleidsruimte eenzijdig van die geldende Europese regelgeving af te wijken voor zover het gaat om verplichte vrijstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het soms weigeren van het dragen van mondkapjes door passagiers van vliegtuigen en vooral de gevolgen daarvan

An MP asked the minister about passengers refusing to wear face masks on flights, the consequences for delays, fines, and the possibility of a blacklist for disruptive passengers. The minister confirmed refusal can be grounds for denial of boarding or removal, that prosecution with a typical 300 euro settlement applies, and that sharing blacklists between airlines is being pursued step by step subject to privacy approval.
Inquiries with the airlines show that this situation occurs sporadically.
