Navraag bij de luchtvaartmaatschappijen leert dat deze situatie sporadisch voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, De Groot en Verhoeven over verlengen certificaten voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the ministers whether the brown fleet of historic sailing ships, facing low revenue and costs from extended safety certificates during COVID-19, deserves more help and further postponement of certificate inspections. The government answered that EUR 15 million has been made available to secure the fleet, that existing schemes also apply, and that inspections need not be postponed further, while leaving room to reconsider extensions case by case.
With the additional EUR 15 million now made available, it is moreover not expected that entrepreneurs will still choose to postpone inspections.
Met de aanvullende € 15 miljoen die nu beschikbaar is gesteld, is het bovendien niet te verwachten dat ondernemers er nog voor zullen kiezen om keuringen uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het actief ontmoedigen van onnodige reizen naar risicogebieden

Green MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the government how it will discourage unnecessary travel to COVID-19 risk areas, including ticket advertising and the Schiphol test lane's capacity. The ministers answered that travellers bear responsibility for their choices, orange advice is in place, a Schiphol testing study is under way with results expected mid-September, and airlines were urged to stop promoting travel to orange areas.
It is the responsibility of the traveller themselves to weigh whether a trip is necessary or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de reiziger zelf om de afweging te maken of een reis noodzakelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over “het bericht dat er zeven gewonden zijn gevallen bij een ernstig ongeluk met een camper en drie auto’s op de N50 bij Kampen”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid widening is delayed, citing a serious crash and accusing the government of slow road safety action due to nitrogen concerns. The minister confirmed the widening's planned 2023 opening, said nitrogen study may only cause limited delay, pointed to road safety programmes, but declined to accelerate the project.
In the first quarter of 2021 I intend to adopt a draft route decision to widen the N50 Kampen-Kampen Zuid to 2x2 lanes as well.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2021 wil ik een ontwerpTracébesluit nemen om de N50 Kampen-Kampen Zuid eveneens te verbreden naar 2x2 rijstroken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Postma over valetparkeerbedrijven n.a.v. de uitzending van ‘MAX Vakantieman’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about valet parking company abuses after a TV broadcast and whether police, prosecutors, certification schemes and a licensing system could address them. The minister answered that there is a coordinated local approach around Schiphol, that civil and traffic-fine rules apply, and that a national licensing scheme would be too burdensome for now.
Complaints against valet parking companies are not registered separately in police systems.
Aangiftes tegen valetparkingbedrijven worden niet apart geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Dam over het toenemende verzet tegen geluidsoverlast door motorrijders

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about rising public opposition to motorcycle noise, including enforcement, noise limits, foreign rules, flash cameras, seizure powers, and municipal authority to close roads. The government answered that it will study noise-reduction options, that enforcement and existing noise norms apply, and that municipalities may temporarily close roads to motorcycles if the traffic-law interests are served and the balancing is proportionate.
The Ministry of IenW will start a study into options to reduce noise nuisance from motorcycles.
Vanuit het Ministerie van IenW zal een onderzoek starten naar de mogelijkheden om geluidoverlast door motorfietsen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het verband tussen luchtvervuiling en het infectierisico van COVID-19

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether air pollution raises COVID-19 infection risk and what research and measures would follow, citing World Bank and Harvard studies. The state secretary answered that the studies are only ecological signals without proof of causation, that human-to-human transmission drives spread, and that research on air quality and COVID-19 is being scoped with RIVM before decisions are taken.
RIVM has been asked to carry out an exploration of research options on the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderijen en COVID-19.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijksta over het bericht dat mensensmokkel via visserij een ‘blinde vlek’

MPs Becker and Dijkstra asked the government about an Inspectorate report finding that maritime smuggling via fishing and leisure boats is a blind spot, including gaps in risk information, staffing, systems and cooperation. The State Secretary answered that current risk assessments show limited risks, that controls continue, and that improvements such as joint risk analyses, system modernisation and training are being explored or pursued.
Following the findings of the inspection report, the KMar and ZHP are currently exploring options to strengthen their intensive cooperation.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het inspectierapport verkennen de KMar en ZHP momenteel de mogelijkheden om de intensieve samenwerking te versterken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de reactie van de kinderopvangsector om het besluit tot aanwijzing van de Stint als bijzondere bromfiets aan te houden totdat een risico-inventarisatie door de Stichting Wetens

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why approval of the Stint after-school bus is delayed while SWOV finalises its safety risk assessment, and whether alternatives for childcare transport are equally assessed. The minister answered that the SWOV assessment is binding and proceeds on the agreed policy framework, that the methodology is nearly ready, that alternatives are the existing transport options, and that a decision is aimed for in autumn rather than before the new school year.
This assessment by SWOV is binding for a decision on the application.
Deze beoordeling door de SWOV is bindend voor een besluit over de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Brug bij Grave dicht voor tientonners door roest op klinknagels’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of the Thompson bridge at Grave to heavy vehicles due to rust, including repair timing, costs, diversion impacts, communication with stakeholders, other bridges at risk, and financial shortfalls. The minister answered that repairs will take 6 to 9 months, costs are not yet known, a major renovation or replacement is planned around 2028, and an indicative maintenance shortfall of 1 to 1.4 billion euro per year will be clarified at the end of 2020.
The exact costs cannot yet be stated at this time.
De exacte kosten zijn op dit moment nog niet aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het stijgend aantal besmettingen met COVID-19 i.r.t. terugkerende vluchten

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure about rising COVID-19 infections linked to returning flights, including how many infected travellers came from which regions, whether there is insight into flights' contribution, whether arriving travellers with symptoms are tested, whether fellow passengers are tested, and what measures would follow if infections keep rising. The government answered that flight-linked cases appear to be a limited share of total new infections, that testing and symptom checks at airports exist, that close contacts are traced, and that a quarantine obligation for travellers from high-risk areas is being prepared through a change to the Public Health Act.
The reason for the trip is not passed on to the GGD.
De reden van de reis wordt niet doorgegeven aan de GGD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Op 38 vluchten op Schiphol passagiers met corona'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that 38 flights to Schiphol carried passengers with COVID-19, including how cases were identified, how contacts are notified, whether origin countries are informed, and how the motion on flight restrictions is being implemented. The ministers largely answered by pointing to GGD contact tracing protocols, withheld flight details to avoid unnecessary public concern, and deferred on the motion and on flight-necessity judgments.
The House will be informed by letter soon about the implementation of this motion.
Over de uitvoering van deze motie wordt uw Kamer spoedig per brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over terugkerende vluchten met besmette reizigers

An MP asked ministers whether returning flights carrying travellers infected with COVID-19 from outbreak areas were adequately monitored, including quarantine and testing, and whether the policy on flying would be reconsidered. The ministers answered that no fellow passengers were infected, that quarantine for travellers from high-risk areas is being legally arranged, and that the general aviation policy would not change beyond offering airport testing.
Therefore, it is also desirable for travellers coming from a high-risk area to have the possibility of imposing a quarantine obligation merely because the traveller comes from such an unsafe area.

Derhalve is het ook voor reizigers die uit een hoog risicogebied komen, wenselijk om de mogelijkheid te hebben om een quarantaineplicht op te leggen vanwege het enkele feit dat de reiziger uit een dergelijk onveilig gebied komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over 'Bocht in geul naar Ameland blijft om natuur'

Three VVD MPs asked why the Reegeul-Oost bend cut to shorten the Ameland ferry route was abandoned, what alternatives were weighed, and what is being done to reduce ferry delays. The minister answers that a Nature Conservation Act permit cannot be granted because the works would permanently damage the priority habitat 'permanently submerged sandbanks', that the Vloedgeul cut was lawful because it followed a natural channel course, and that other Open Plan Process measures are implemented and monitored, with a longer-term study starting this autumn.

This means that realising the Reegeul-Oost bend cut is not feasible under nature legislation, because the conservation status of this habitat type is at stake and a permit under the Nature Conservation Act therefore cannot be issued.

Dit betekent dat de realisatie van de bochtafsnijding Reegeul-Oost vanuit natuurwetgeving niet haalbaar is omdat de staat van instandhouding van dit habitattype in het geding komt en een vergunning in het kader van de Wet Natuurbescherming daarom niet kan worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over waterplantenproblematiek op de Randmeren en Zuidelijk IJsselmeergebied

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat bears responsibility, given past water management measures that promoted aquatic plant growth, for plant overgrowth obstructing recreational boating and swimming on the Randmeren and southern IJsselmeer beyond the fairway, and about the basis for the 10% mowing limit and the cooperation process. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible only for the fairways of national waterways and designated recreational channels, that responsibility elsewhere lies with regional authorities and the recreation sector, and that a working group and pilots are being run.

On that basis, Rijkswaterstaat is responsible for reducing nuisance from aquatic plants only insofar as it concerns the fairway of the national waterways and certain fairways designated for recreational boating.

Op basis daarvan is Rijkswaterstaat verantwoordelijk voor het verminderen van overlast door waterplanten voor zover het de vaargeul van de rijksvaarwegen en bepaalde voor de recreatietoervaart aangewezen vaargeulen betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ’Groningen Airport Eelde soms dicht door tekort luchtverkeersleiders’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister whether Groningen Airport Eelde is sometimes closed due to a shortage of air traffic controllers, whether a medical flight was cancelled, and how controller capacity is distributed across airports. The minister denies closures and cancellations on the ground, acknowledges tight staffing at GAE and Maastricht, and says LVNL has adequate staff during official opening hours and will keep monitoring the situation.
That is not correct. Air Traffic Control Netherlands (LVNL) makes agreements with Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) and other parties concerned about the services provided at the airport.
Dat klopt niet. Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL) maakt samen met Groningen Airport Eelde (GAE) en andere betrokken partijen afspraken over de dienstverlening op de luchthaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de mogelijke contradictie tussen uitspraken van de Minister van I&W en een stelling van Corendon over het reisadvies 'code oranje'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Corendon's claim that Dutch health insurance covers medical costs abroad regardless of an orange travel advice contradicts the minister's earlier statement, and about the government's stance on flights to orange-advice destinations and on a discouragement campaign. The minister answered that orange advice means non-essential travel is discouraged, that insurers usually cover care abroad up to Dutch tariffs but travel insurance and orange or red advice may affect coverage, and that a discouragement campaign for flying in general is not considered necessary since orange advice already discourages risk destinations.
Generally the health insurer reimburses care costs abroad up to the Dutch tariff.
Doorgaans vergoedt de zorgverzekeraar zorgkosten in het buitenland tot aan het Nederlandse tarief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het omwisselen van rijbewijzen in de nieuwsbrief van de Stichting Nederlanders Buiten Nederland

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Dutch resident in France whose licence, exchanged from a non-EU (Indonesian) licence, could not be re-exchanged, and how many others may be affected and whether EU acceptance rules will be synchronised. The minister confirmed the case, estimated that about 1.4% of Dutch licences carry the non-EU annotation without knowing how many are affected, said the RDW will inform holders on its website, and said the issue has been raised with the European Commission seeking more harmonisation in the upcoming directive review.
I have asked the RDW to inform licence holders via its website about the possibility that an exchanged licence will not in all cases be accepted in other EU countries.
Ik heb de RDW gevraagd om rijbewijshouders via haar website te informeren over de mogelijkheid dat een omgewisseld rijbewijs in andere EU-landen niet in alle gevallen wordt geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de verruiming van de sluis bij Kornwerderzand

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about excessive dredging of the Boontjes channel near Kornwerderzand, a possible further deepening requested by Harlingen, and whether a study and cost-benefit analysis would be done. The minister confirmed the dredging volumes exceeded forecasts, said further deepening is not currently planned, and committed to extend the agreement to 2022 with additional economic, morphological and ecological research.
I am therefore having research carried out into the causes of this and its longer-term effects.
Ik laat daarom onderzoek doen naar de oorzaken hiervan en effecten op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de ballonvaartsector

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the balloon aviation sector, which has been shut down during the coronavirus crisis, including support schemes for small commercial aviation, the NOTAM restrictions, and the difference in corona rules between general and small commercial aviation. The minister answered that balloon firms can use generic schemes and Tozo, that a budget for balloon aviation is being worked out, that the NOTAM exception was lifted on 10 July 2020, and that differences reflect sector-specific protocols.
Due to the easing measures the cabinet adopted on 10 July, balloon pilots can fly under the established protocols and the exceptional position has been lifted.
Door de versoepelingsmaatregelen die het kabinet heeft genomen op 10 juli jl. kunnen de ballonvaarders volgens de vastgestelde protocollen varen en is de uitzonderingspositie opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het protocol Veilig Zorgvervoer

Two 50PLUS MPs asked why scootmobiles were excluded from care transport under the sector protocol 'Veilig Zorgvervoer', citing extra contact moments and reduced mobility. The Minister explained the exclusion was a temporary safety measure to limit contact, noted that scootmobiles were allowed again from 1 July 2020, and said the protocol is a living document.
Owing to the easing of corona measures from 1 July 2020, the sector protocol for care transport now allows scootmobiles to be taken again in care transport, including the regiotaxi.

Mede door de versoepeling van coronamaatregelen per 1 juli 2020 is in het sectorprotocol voor zorgvervoer opgenomen dat scootmobielen weer in het zorgvervoer, waaronder de regiotaxi, meegenomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Helvert over inzake de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Koopmans (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked about delays in the entry into force of the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij against piracy, the date, consultation with the maritime sector, a task force, the 48-hour response period for the Coast Guard, and including the Gulf of Guinea. Minister Grapperhaus replied that entry into force is now expected by 1 January 2022 at the latest, that existing coordination is sufficient without a new task force, and that the Gulf of Guinea could be explored while noting that naval protection under the VPD-first principle would be needed.

Based on current insights and taking into account the fixed dates for entry into force of legislation (1 January or 1 July), the cabinet assumes that the Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij will enter into force by 1 January 2022 at the latest.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten en rekening houdend met de vaste data van inwerkingtreding van wet- en regelgeving (1 januari, dan wel 1 juli), gaat het kabinet er vanuit dat inwerkingtreding van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij uiterlijk per 1 januari 2022 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Miljoenentekort voor geplaagde Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht'

A VVD MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported EUR 92 million shortfall on the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht, whether the national government would contribute more, and whether it should condition funding on road speed and tunnel variants. The minister replied that the project is a municipal responsibility under a 2010 fixed national contribution, that no further national funding is planned for the extra local integration measures, and that the choice of solution rests with Utrecht.
The financial justification of the different variants and the current shortfalls on the measures fall under the responsibility of the municipality.
De financiële onderbouwing van de verschillende varianten en de huidige tekorten op de maatregelen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Baudet over de uitgestelde verbreding van de N35

An MP asks the minister why the widening of the N35 road to two lanes each way is delayed, what the timeline is, and what action will follow letters from regional bodies urging urgency. The minister says the province's widening plan is not automatically the most efficient option, that talks with the province will take place before the autumn MIRT meeting, and that no commitment on the timing or the solution can yet be given.
Based on the outcomes of the study, I will in the coming months engage in discussion with the province to discuss the conclusions and see what follow-up steps may be possible.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek ga ik de komende maanden het gesprek met de provincie aan om de conclusies te bespreken en om te zien wat er eventueel voor vervolgstappen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over uitbuiting van Uber-chauffeurs

MP Gijs van Dijk asks the ministers whether Uber drivers are exploited, whether they are employees entitled to labour law and the taxi CAO, whether the Tax Authority has examined bogus self-employment in taxis, and whether municipalities can limit the number of taxis. The government answers that employment status is for courts to decide case by case, that the Tax Authority does not publish sector-specific findings or disclose individual cases, and that municipalities have existing instruments; it commits to a pilot giving municipal enforcers some Wp2000 powers and to further talks, but declines to comment on individual cases.
Whether in individual cases such as those described in the question there is entrepreneurship, I cannot assess; that is for the courts.
Of in individuele gevallen zoals in de vraag wordt geschetst, sprake is van ondernemerschap, kan ik niet beoordelen, dat is aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het meten van luchtkwaliteit nabij drukke wegen in de bebouwde kom

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Dutch air-quality monitoring near busy urban roads, which measures beyond 10 metres from the kerb, conflicts with the EEA interpretation of the EU Air Quality Directive, and what measures follow. The government answered that Dutch monitoring is lawful under the Wet milieubeheer and Rbl, that no limit exceedances occur at the cited locations so no measures are required, and that the Schone Lucht Akkoord pursues further health gains.
At the same time, I do not consider that this statement conflicts with the interpretation of the Air Quality Directive.
Daarbij ben ik niet van mening dat deze uitspraak strijdig is met de interpretatie van de Richtlijn luchtkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Diertens en Kröger over niet-essentiële reizen naar risicogebieden tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Kröger asked why Dutch nationals may still travel for holidays to non-EU risk areas while residents of those countries cannot enter the Netherlands, and how the travel advice and quarantine recommendation are enforced. The minister answered that the entry ban was lifted for 15 countries from 1 July, that holiday travel is treated as non-essential but the decision is left to the traveller under the principle of own responsibility, and that enforcement relies on airlines and border checks while quarantine advice cannot be enforced.
Quarantine at home after visiting a risk area is indeed an urgent recommendation and in that sense cannot be enforced.
Thuisquarantaine na bezoek aan een risicogebied is inderdaad een dringend advies en is in die zin niet handhaafbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Duizenden Nederlandse zeelieden nog langer vast op zee door visa-chaos’ en ‘Gestrande zeelieden vormen een dreiging voor de wereldeconomie’

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure ministers about reports that thousands of Dutch seafarers were stranded at sea because of visa problems, including the visa policy, EU coordination, visa on arrival at Schiphol, and why non-Dutch-flagged ships are excluded. The government acknowledged the welfare problem, described capacity increases at consulates in Manila, Moscow and Jakarta and the priority given to Dutch-flagged ships, and said it would keep monitoring and raise the issue at IMO, ILO and EU level.
This subject therefore has the full attention of the cabinet and has also been raised by the Netherlands with the IMO, ILO and the EU.
Dit onderwerp heeft dan ook de volle aandacht van het kabinet en is tevens door Nederland geadresseerd bij IMO, ILO en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Moorlag over drugssmokkel op zee

MPs Kuiken and Moorlag asked the Justice, Agriculture and Transport ministers about drug smuggling by fishing vessels, including subsidies, detection odds, licence withdrawal and Bibob screening. The government acknowledged the financial pressure link, said subsidies should exclude convicted fishers while EU rules limit this, and promised investigations into licence withdrawal and Bibob use while noting limited data on detection.
The Minister of LNV will investigate what options exist to exclude fishers who have committed criminal offences from these funds.
De Minister van LNV zal onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om vissers die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd uit te sluiten van deze middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte en Kröger over het rapport Evaluatie stikstofberekeningen Lelystad Airport (advies 3456) van de Commissie voor de m.e.r. d.d. 31 maart 2020

Three MPs asked the ministers whether AERIUS applies SRM2 to road traffic deposition and OPS to other sectors, and why SRM2 is cut off at 5 km, given the Commission's evaluation and TNO's 2015 audit. The minister confirmed the SRM2/OPS split and defended the 5 km cut-off as consistent with the NSL tool and past Raad van State acceptance, while promising a broader cabinet response after the summer.

The cabinet will come after the summer with a more extensive substantive cabinet response to both the final advice of the Nitrogen Problem Advisory Committee and the final report of the Nitrogen Measurement and Calculation Advisory Committee.

Het kabinet komt na de zomer met een uitgebreidere inhoudelijke kabinetsreactie op zowel het eindadvies van het Adviescollege Stikstofproblematiek als het eindrapport van het Adviescollege Meten en Berekenen Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het besluit om de ILT te verzoeken tot handhaving Verordening (EG) 261/2004 passagiersrechten luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether the government's instruction to the ILT not to enforce EU passenger refund rules for COVID-era flight vouchers, and the planned withdrawal of that instruction, leaves consumers exposed to delayed refunds and airline insolvency. The minister answered that the instruction is withdrawn so the ILT resumes enforcing Regulation 261/2004, that the ILT can act against systematic non-compliance but not individual refund delays, and that the government has lobbied the European Commission for an EU guarantee on vouchers.
With this, the ILT will again enforce Regulation (EC) 261/2004.
Daarmee gaat de ILT de Verordening (EG) 261/2004 weer handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over veiligheidsmaatregelen voor vliegtuigpassagiers en -personeel

MPs Paternotte, Diertens and Bruins asked about aircraft transmission risks of COVID-19 (drawing on SARS-1 evidence), EASA/ECDC guidance, and whether the OMT should advise on flying. Minister De Jonge answered that protocols were drafted by the sector based on RIVM advice, measures are indefinite, evidence on in-flight transmission is limited, and the OMT has not been asked but RIVM has advised twice.
On the basis of existing literature, no sound comparison can be made between transmission of SARS-CoV-1 and SARS-CoV-2 on aircraft.
Er kan op basis van bestaande literatuur geen goed vergelijk worden gemaakt tussen overdracht van SARS-CoV-1 en SARS-CoV-2 in vliegtuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat vliegtuigpassagiers van bron- en contactonderzoek worden uitgezonderd

An MP asked why air passengers were exempted from source and contact tracing for COVID-19 and whether this left a gap in controlling the virus. The minister answered that the exemption was based on RIVM advice, reduced air traffic by about 95%, and would end as traffic recovers, with contact tracing for all positive cases including passengers from 1 June 2020.
The current exception will be lifted because air passenger traffic is expected to increase again in the coming period.
De huidige uitzondering komt te vervallen omdat het personenluchtverkeer in de komende periode weer zal gaan toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de berichten dat KLM weer wil gaan vliegen op diverse Europese steden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether KLM's plan to resume flights to European cities, including COVID-19 hotspots, was sensible given travel restrictions, and about cabin safety, masks and staff protection. The minister answered that entry rules, RIVM-based airline protocols, travel advice and mask guidance address the risks, and that KLM had not consulted RIVM or the OMT.
As far as I am aware, KLM has not held consultations with the RIVM and OMT about expanding flights to European cities.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft KLM geen overleg gevoerd met het RIVM en OMT over uitbreiding van vluchten naar Europese steden.
Antwoord op van het lid Postma over certificering zeegaande zeilvaart

CDA MP Postma asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) refusing to issue certificates to Dutch sailing vessels that were inspected under EU Directive 2009/45/EC, and whether the ILT should be pressed to reverse course. The minister answers that the ILT lacks a legal basis after the directive was amended in late 2019 to exclude sailing passenger ships, that a structural regulatory fix and a short-term solution (temporary declarations applying the directive's rules) are being worked on.
In the short term I will ask the ILT to issue temporary declarations, pending regulatory changes, applying the directive's requirements.
Voor de korte termijn zal ik de ILT verzoeken om, vooruitlopend op aanpassingen in de regelgeving, tijdelijke verklaringen af te geven waarbij de voorschriften van de richtlijn worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van der Graaf over de bevindingen van de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) dat containerschepen vaak nog steeds de veiligheidsregels niet naleven

MPs Schonis and Van der Graaf asked why ILT inspection reports on container ships' non-compliance with safety rules were not shared with parliament and whether protective measures for the Wadden Sea would follow. The minister explained the report was delayed, promised to incorporate the findings into policy responses to the MSC Zoe investigations, and said closing the southern shipping route requires IMO proposal and consultation with Germany and Denmark.
I will incorporate the findings from the ILT report into my policy response to the outcomes of the relevant investigations into the MSC Zoe accident.
Ik zal de bevindingen uit het ILT-rapport betrekken in mijn beleidsreactie op de uitkomsten van de relevante onderzoeken naar aanleiding van het ongeval met de MSC Zoe
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Postma over het artikel 'Binnenring A10 Oost weer vrijgegeven na beschadiging spoorviaduct'

MPs Schonis and Postma asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the damage to a rail viaduct on the A10 Oost inner ring, its maintenance history, the cause investigation, and the wider maintenance backlog. The minister said the failed wall panels were a fitting error with no structural problem, that a similar case will be repaired later this year, and that the growing backlog of deferred maintenance will be considered in a wider review.
What we learn from this is that the construction of these wall panels should have been inspected in recent years.
Wat we hier van leren is dat de constructie van deze wandplaten in de afgelopen jaren wel geïnspecteerd had moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de richtlijnen voor reizen per vliegtuig in coronatijd

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the ministers why aviation COVID-19 rules differ from those for public transport, hospitality and culture, and how the rules are enforced, along with related questions on refunds, EASA guidance and whether the sector is left to self-regulate. The minister answered that sector-specific risk assessments, RIVM advice, airline protocols, and enforcement by airports, safety regions and the Marechaussee justify the approach, while largely deferring details to earlier letters.

If in the view of the chair of the Safety Region insufficient measures are taken or irresponsible health situations arise, additional restrictive measures can be imposed, such as closing parts of certain locations.

Als naar het oordeel van de voorzitter van de Veiligheidsregio onvoldoende maatregelen worden getroffen of er vanuit oogpunt van gezondheidszorg onverantwoorde situaties ontstaan, kunnen aanvullende beperkende maatregelen getroffen worden, zoals het sluiten van delen van bepaalde locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Alkaya over de berichtgeving dat KLM-piloten aan belastingontwijking doen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether they would stop KLM pilots living abroad (reportedly Spain) from avoiding Dutch income tax, given state aid to KLM, and asked for data on how many such pilots there are and the revenue lost. The minister said he would raise the matter with KLM, that the data is not systematically available, and that state support will come with conditions on pay and bonuses, with details still to follow.
Conditions will be set, among other things, on working conditions and bonuses.
Er zullen o.a. voorwaarden worden gesteld op het gebied van arbeidsvoorwaarden en bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Bruins over een mogelijke Europese ‘NASA’ waarin onderzoekinstituten op het gebied van luchtvaart nauwer samenwerken

MPs Amhaouch and Bruins asked the minister about a proposed European 'NASA' for aviation research institutes and related funding, decarbonisation and hydrogen engines. The minister answered that existing cooperation (ACARE, EREA, Horizon programmes) suffices, sees no need for a merged European institute, and outlined funding and innovation expectations without concrete new commitments.
I currently see no reason to pursue within Europe a merger of all those research institutes into one organisation.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om binnen Europa in te zetten op een samenvoeging van al die onderzoekinstituten in één organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het aantal vliegbewegingen vanaf Schiphol

The MP asks whether night flights from Schiphol are increasing again, why night flights are allowed when daytime capacity exists, and what preventive and enforcement measures apply to flights against COVID-19 spread. The minister replies that operations are limited and monitored, that Schiphol's 24-hour status and the 32,000 night-flight cap under slot rules are maintained, that noise-reduction instruments are being pursued, and that airport and airline protocols, enforced by safety regions and the Marechaussee, apply.
My ministry does not keep track of this percentage.
Mijn ministerie houdt dit percentage niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Esch over de berichtgeving over het niet tot uitvoering brengen van de pilot in de IJssel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers why the plastic-catching bubble barrier pilot in the IJssel was cancelled as too expensive, and whether environmental costs, polluters, or the Rijk itself would cover the shortfall. The minister confirmed the budget of 400,000 was insufficient, explained that extra funding was sought without success, and said the decision was carefully taken and that lessons from the pilot will be reported.
It was therefore decided not to start this pilot.
Er is daarom besloten deze pilot niet te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de diverse OMT adviezen met betrekking tot luchtvaart

An MP asked whether commercial parties such as KLM were involved in OMT advice on aviation during the coronavirus crisis, why a KLM Health doctor sat on the OMT, how conflicts of interest were guarded against, and how aircraft ventilation and transmission risks were assessed. The minister replied that a KLM doctor attended only the 24 January OMT meeting under a signed declaration of interests, that the 12 June advice came from RIVM with no commercial parties, that OMT members serve in personal capacity with published declarations, and that the questions could not be answered in time for the committee debate.
To be transparent and prevent conflicts of interest, every member completes a declaration of interests for each OMT.
Om transparant te zijn en belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen, vult elk lid voor een OMT een belangenverklaring in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over watertekort op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the ministers about water shortages on Sint Eustatius, including how long the drinking water supply problems were known, whether pipeline materials were unsuitable, rationing information and storage, and financial relief during COVID-19. The government answered that subsidies and new pipelines and storage are being put in place, rationing has been eased, and water tariffs were set to zero for eight months, though it did not fully answer several historical questions.
From 8 June 2020 rationing has been eased and drinking water comes from the tap from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Met ingang van 8 juni 2020 is de rantsoenering versoepeld en komt er van 5 uur ’s ochtends tot 20 uur ’s avonds drinkwater uit de kraan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Stoffer en Postma over het bericht 'Onzekere toekomst voor gebruik oldtimer openbare weg'

MPs Dijkstra, Stoffer and Postma asked the ministers about the future of historic vehicles (oldtimers) on public roads, including a national register of mobile heritage, definitions, innovative fuels and export of cultural goods. The government says it supports a sector-led register with Mondriaan Fund funding, that heritage is defined under the Heritage Act, and that it will engage on fuels and export protection through a planned commission.
I have asked the RCE to continue supporting this process with knowledge and advice.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd om blijvend dit proces te ondersteunen met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van der Graaf over het bericht dat de Minister geen haast heeft met het aanpakken van de N35

MPs Postma and Van der Graaf asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that she was in no hurry to tackle the N35 road, including whether a bilateral meeting with Overijssel province on planning and financing had taken place and whether it was being postponed. The Minister said the meeting had not occurred, that the province's co-financing offer is taken seriously but is not the only criterion, and that traffic research shows rising volumes with acceptable travel times and a lower-than-average accident risk, while promising to discuss findings at a later MIRT meeting and to inform the House.
At the autumn BO MIRT meeting I will then discuss the outcomes, after which I will inform you of the result.
Op het BO MIRT van dit najaar bespreek ik dan de uitkomsten, waarna ik u informeer over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins en Van Raan over het basisjaar van CORSIA

Four MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether moving CORSIA's baseline year to 2019, possibly delaying offsetting obligations until 2023, is desirable given climate goals, and what the Dutch position is. The Minister answered that Netherlands prefers keeping the current baseline, treats baseline change as a fallback, that the Council decision is only a negotiating mandate, and that the 2019 baseline would be evaluated in 2022.
The starting point for the Netherlands is preserving the current ambition.
Het uitgangspunt voor Nederland is behoud van de huidige ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Bruins, Van Raan en Stoffer over het basisjaar voor CORSIA

MPs from GroenLinks, D66, ChristenUnie, PvdD and SGP asked whether the Netherlands agreed to move the CORSIA baseline to 2019, how that fits earlier ambitious commitments, and why the government did not follow a motion requiring coordination with the House. The minister denied agreeing to a baseline change, saying the EU instruction only allows adjustment if needed to preserve global support, and promised to inform the House of further developments.
Of course I will keep the House continuously informed about new developments.
Uiteraard zal ik de Kamer blijvend informeren over nieuwe ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Schonis over het uitreiken van 'coronavouchers' door reisorganisaties en het bericht 'Europese Commissie handhaaft recht op geld terug bij annulering'

MPs Paternotte and Schonis asked whether consumers must still pay travel-operator deposits and accept vouchers instead of refunds for cancelled trips, and whether the minister's instruction to the ILT not to enforce refund rules for airline vouchers conflicts with EU law. The minister answered that consumers keep a legal refund right enforceable in court, that the ILT's instruction was withdrawn so Regulation 261/2004 is enforced again, and that the government supports voucher attractiveness and a possible EU voucher guarantee while promising further letters.
A passenger has a statutory right to a refund and can enforce it through the court, possibly with help from a claims bureau.
Een passagier heeft een wettelijk recht op terugbetaling en kan dat afdwingen via de rechtbank, eventueel met hulp van een claimbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over strenge voorwaarden aan staatssteun voor de luchtvaartsector in het perspectief van een sector die stevig moet krimpen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers why state aid to KLM is not conditioned on shrinking aviation to within climate limits, and about stranded assets, Lelystad Airport, job losses and the closed briefing on state holdings. The government answered that conditions for KLM aid are still under negotiation, that climate targets and noise measures will be pursued regardless of aid, that the state's Air France-KLM shares lost value, and that the closed briefing was justified by the company's listed status.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de risico’s op botsingen met vogels als gevolg van de opening van Lelystad Airport

An MP asks the government whether a new bird-radar study showing higher-altitude and night-time bird movements undermines the bird-strike risk assessment in the updated environmental impact report for Lelystad Airport, and whether the report should be re-tested or redone. The minister answers that the new method does not change the conclusions, that the same radar data was used, that the risk assessment remains valid, and that no guarantee against bird strikes can be given, but declines to commit to a new or independent review.
No. The relevant scientific article by Kranstauber and others does not concern Lelystad Airport.
Nee. Het betreffende wetenschappelijke artikel van Kranstauber en anderen gaat niet over Lelystad Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Schonis en De Groot over het bericht 'Vergeten diesels blijken ernstige vervuilers'

MPs Schonis and De Groot asked whether a news report that diesel machines on construction sites emit far more nitrogen oxides than assumed is correct, and whether models like AERIUS underestimate deposition. The government confirms measured emissions of four machine types exceeded type-approval norms by 25% to 350%, has raised the emission factor and promised further measurements, but says full model impacts are not yet known.
I find it undesirable that emissions from mobile machinery in practice are higher than the official norm.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat de emissies van mobiele werktuigen in de praktijk hoger zijn dan de officiële norm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over aanhoudende droogte en natuurbranden

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of reports on the drought and large forest fires in the Deurnese Peel, what additional measures are planned, how water boards and the monitoring of vulnerable nature areas have responded, and for a timeline of drought and fire-prevention actions. The minister answered substantively, pointing to existing drought recommendations, Deltaprogramma funding, priority water supply for category 1 nature areas, and the coordinating role of the regional and national bodies, while stating that fire ignition is hard to prevent.
The Netherlands is becoming more resilient to drought through implementation of the 46 recommendations of the Drought Policy Table.
Nederland wordt beter weerbaar tegen droogte met de realisatie van de 46 aanbevelingen van de Beleidstafel droogte
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sienot over de aanhoudende droogte, natuurbranden en het verband met het snel opwarmende klimaat

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about recurring drought, forest and nature fires in the Netherlands and Europe, their link to rapid warming, economic damage, prevention measures and whether the climate targets should be tightened. The minister answered that fire statistics only exist since 2017, that drought risk grows with warming, that prevention runs through regional fire-risk programmes and drought and adaptation policy, that the Copernicus report confirmed known trends without prompting a new European meeting, and that the Netherlands supports a higher EU 2030 target.
The Copernicus report has not given rise to organising a European meeting or to accelerating climate measures.
Het Copernicus-rapport is geen aanleiding geweest voor het organiseren van een Europees overleg of klimaatmaatregelen versneld kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over verdroging in Nederland

An MP from D66 asks the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about drought and groundwater lowering (verdroging) in the Netherlands, including irrigation by farmers, the influence of agriculture on water governance, the composition of water board boards, and follow-up on Beleidstafel Droogte recommendations. The minister responds that drought measures are in place, structural programmes are under way, and several studies (flexibilising groundwater permits, drinking water restrictions) will report in 2021, while stating that the question of guaranteed agricultural seats is left to an advisory commission.
I will send this advice to your House once the commission has presented it to me.
Ik zal dit advies, zodra de commissie het aan mij heeft aangeboden, aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het kabinet met miljarden komt voor KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a planned state rescue package of up to 4 billion euros for KLM, including its share price, asset and debt values, state aid compliance, bank comparisons, conditions on climate and safety, and timing of answers before a debate. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the support as liquidity via guarantees and a loan, citing EU temporary aid rules, and saying conditions were still being finalised before any payment.
The support will only be provided once everything is settled, including the conditions.
De steun wordt pas verstrekt wanneer alles rond is, waaronder de voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Schonis over het toetsingsadvies van de commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage over A27/A12 ring Utrecht

MPs Kröger and Schonis asked the minister about the environmental assessment committee's critical review of the A27/A12 Utrecht ring road project, including delays, corona-related traffic changes, construction method risks, nitrogen permits and housing priority. The minister answered that the tracébesluit will be adopted after summer 2020 with a renewed committee review, that nitrogen effects will be handled via a project-specific assessment and the speed reduction, and that further studies on noise and construction are underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de stikstofberekeningen inzake Lelystad Airport

Three MPs (Van Raan, Kröger, Laçin) asked 28 questions about stikstof (nitrogen) calculations for Lelystad Airport, including why new calculations were commissioned after the Council of State ruling against the PAS, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the MER 2018 was complete. The minister answered that the new work follows the PAS annulment, that the Chamber was informed in September 2019 and February 2020, that results are not yet final, and that the Commission for the MER and RIVM advice was obtained, while declining to share the commissioning assignments citing commercial confidentiality.
It is not customary to share commissioning assignments with the House of Representatives because of their commercially confidential nature.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om opdrachtverstrekkingen te delen met de Tweede Kamer vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het niet naleven van coronavoorschriften op vliegveld Eindhoven

Two SP MPs asked whether Eindhoven Airport charter flights carrying Eastern European workers were ignoring corona rules, whether this was an economic offence, and why the flights were not halted. The minister answered that the flights cannot be refused under EU free movement, that the airline and airport have taken measures such as multilingual information and extra staff, and that no economic offence applies.
There are no restrictions on air traffic from European member states, and therefore the flights to Eindhoven are not refused.
Er zijn geen beperkingen voor het vliegverkeer vanuit Europese lidstaten en daardoor worden de vluchten naar Eindhoven niet geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Amhaouch inzake de voorspelling over toe- en afname van files en mogelijke verschuivingen naar individueel vervoer

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about forecasts of traffic congestion and a shift from public to individual transport after the COVID-19 lockdown, including foreign data, scenario modelling, working from home and parking. The Minister answered that forecasts are not comparable, that scenario modelling is ongoing with monthly-level updates and a promised report before summer, and that advice from the Denktank Coronacrisis and planning agencies is expected on 1 June.
I will inform your House before the summer about the main outcomes.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de belangrijkste uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Laçin over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten voert betaald parkeren in’

MPs Futselaar and Laçin asked ministers whether they would intervene in or discuss with Natuurmonumenten its plan to introduce paid parking at its nature reserves, and whether it would reduce access or cause spillover parking and affect its financial health. The minister replied that the government has no view on the parking charge, that Natuurmonumenten sets its own parking policy, that no contact or talks are planned, and declined to assess the organisation's finances.
It is not for the cabinet to pass judgement on the financial management of the Natuurmonumenten association.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel uit te spreken over de financiële huishouding van de vereniging Natuurmonumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bonus voor de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Air France-KLM tied its CEO's bonus to securing state aid and whether Dutch support would be conditional on bonus, dividend, buyback and sustainability limits, with retroactive effect. The minister said a bonus increase does not fit the crisis, that aid conditions (no bonuses or dividends while aid is outstanding, emissions and night-flight commitments) are being negotiated, and that the Dutch state learned of the bonus proposal only when the AGM documents were published.
Thus the cabinet wants that, if the company receives aid, no bonuses and dividends are paid out as long as the aid has not yet been repaid.
Zo wil het kabinet indien de onderneming steun ontvangt dat er geen bonussen en dividenden worden uitgekeerd zolang de steun aan de onderneming nog niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over veilig schoolverkeer

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister how school traffic can be made safe as schools reopen under the 1.5-metre rule, covering extra space for cyclists and pedestrians, public transport capacity, local government support and good practices. The minister replied that a protocol for urban mobility, communication campaigns and temporary measures such as school streets have been prepared with local authorities and CROW, with decisions left to local road managers.
A guide has been prepared for road managers to take measures suited to the local situation.
Voor wegbeheerders is een handreiking gemaakt om maatregelen te treffen passend bij de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de beheersing van legionellarisico’s in verband met de opstart van bedrijven en instellingen na de coronacrisis

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how public buildings reopening after COVID-19 closures will prevent Legionella contamination in water systems, and what agreements and communication channels exist. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has informed priority and non-priority sectors, that responsibility lies with owners and operators, and that communication will continue.
It is the responsibility of the owners and operators of the locations to control the risk of Legionella contamination.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaren en exploitanten van de locaties om het risico op legionellabesmetting te beheersen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over de leefbaarheid rondom AWACS-basis Geilenkirchen

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence about noise nuisance from AWACS flights at Geilenkirchen, including the promised livability fund, flight timing, flight statistics and quieter engines. The State Secretary answered that noise is declining and flight counts have halved since 2004, that a livability fund is still under discussion with the region and will be revisited after COVID-19 measures are lifted, and that engine replacement is not pursued because the business case has weakened.
I will also send these to you.
Ik zal u deze ook doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de planning van het onderzoek budgetneutrale overstap WLTP

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked why the results of the study on budget-neutral WLTP transition would only be shared in July 2020, who would conduct it, and how independence is guaranteed, following a motion requesting an independent review by early summer. The state secretary answers that the timing was an estimate of the time needed, names Prof. C. Koopmans (SEO, VU) as independent second-opinion reviewer, and sets out the research questions, including macro and top-ten-car budget neutrality, with a request to complete it before 1 June 2020.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans will carry out an independent review, in the form of a second opinion, of the budget-neutral conversion of the bpm table to CO2 emissions under the WLTP test method.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans zal in de vorm van een second opinion een onafhankelijke toets uitvoeren op de budgettair neutrale omzetting van de bpm-tabel naar de CO 2 -uitstoot volgens de WLTP-testmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het gevolgde en te volgen protocol bij coronarepatriëringsvluchten uit niet-brandhaarden

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether a COVID-19 repatriation flight from Kuala Lumpur was overcrowded and whether quarantine or protocol changes were planned for such flights. The minister could not independently confirm the footage, said the flight carried 285 passengers and 13 crew under EASA and RIVM guidance, and stated no new measures were being considered for now.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering new measures, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet geen nieuwe maatregelen, maar we monitoren de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het openhouden van vliegroutes van en naar Spanje ondanks snelle toename aantal besmettingen

D66 MPs asked why flight routes from Spain stayed open while infection numbers rose quickly, comparing this with the ban on flights from Italy and asking for a stricter flight ban and monitoring. The minister answered that multiple factors inform flight restrictions, pointed to EASA high-risk country measures and RIVM advice, and said monitoring continues without committing to a ban on Spain.
We are continuously monitoring and advising on whether additional measures for air traffic are needed.
Wij zijn continu bezig met het monitoren en advies of er aanvullende maatregelen voor het luchtverkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over luchtvaart tijdens de Coronacrisis

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked the ministers about aviation crew and passenger safety during COVID-19, including RIVM distancing compliance, empty middle seats, service restrictions, crew hotel conditions, arrival advice, flight bans and Schiphol rent relief. The ministers largely answered by pointing to EASA guidance, airline responsibility and existing measures, committing only to monitoring the crew hotel situation.
Airlines are best placed themselves to organise maximum spacing in aircraft, and it does not seem wise for us to determine which specific seats may or may not be occupied.

Luchtvaartmaatschappijen zijn zelf het beste in staat om maximale spreiding in vliegtuigen te organiseren en het lijkt ons niet verstandig dat wij gaan bepalen welke specifieke stoelen wel of niet bezet kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Vewin: Indicatieve Niveaus voor Ernstige Verontreiniging voor PFAS bieden onvoldoende bescherming voor drinkwater’

An MP asked the minister whether the RIVM's higher indicative serious-contamination levels (INEVs) for PFAS in groundwater, which exceed drinking water standards, were justified and whether they undermine drinking water protection. The state secretary replied that INEVs and drinking water standards serve different protection goals, that the INEVs will be revised after EFSA's evaluation, and that a hotspot inventory and action plan are underway with results promised by year-end.
I will share the outcomes with you before the end of the year, together with the definitive PFAS action framework and the agreements with decentralised governments on possible financial consequences.
De uitkomsten hiervan deel ik voor het einde van het jaar met u gelijktijdig met het definitieve handelingskader PFAS en de afspraken met decentrale overheden over eventuele financiële consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Luchtverkeersleiding met juridische stappen dreigt tegen NH Nieuws

MP Van Raan asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that air traffic control (LVNL) threatened legal action against NH Nieuws and NOS over broadcasting radio transmissions of a runway incident at Schiphol, and about the incident itself, including sixteen landings on a closed runway and a go-around. The minister answers that LVNL asked the media to stop rebroadcasting, that LVNL dropped legal steps, that the incident is under LVNL and OVV investigation with published reports, and that the procedural failure has been addressed by a system update.
LVNL has indicated that indeed it has not objected to all online fragments with R/T.
LVNL heeft aangegeven dat inderdaad niet tegen alle fragmenten met R/T die online staan bezwaar is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grote stukken strand door de storm Ciara zijn weggeslagen

An MP asked the ministers about storm Ciara washing away large parts of the Walcheren beach, sand nourishment delays caused by nitrogen rules, and whether Natura 2000 rules should be waived for urgent sand nourishment. The minister confirmed awareness, said an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is planned before autumn 2020, and declined any exemption from Natura 2000 and ADC rules as unnecessary.
For the Dishoek location on Walcheren, an accelerated sand nourishment is currently being prepared for water safety reasons, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over formule 1 wil coureurs door zeehondenreservaat laten pendelen

Two PvdA MPs asked whether F1 teams should be shuttled over the beach past a seal reserve, questioning the nature, safety and municipal regulation of the plan. The minister replied that the Grand Prix was postponed due to Covid-19 and the beach route dropped, so no negative effects are expected, and said the province is the competent authority for nature.
The organiser has also announced that the Formula 1 teams will not drive over the beach from Noordwijk to the circuit in Zandvoort during the Grand Prix.
Ook heeft de organisator bekendgemaakt dat de Formule 1-teams tijdens de Grand Prix niet over het strand van Noordwijk naar het circuit in Zandvoort gaan rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe toestemming heeft gegeven voor het afschieten van tientallen diersoorten op Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about reports that the province of Drenthe permitted culling dozens of animal species at Groningen Airport Eelde, and whether the permit was justified, lawful, effective and transparent. The minister replied that the province is the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, that the permit was granted for aviation safety, that the government cannot intervene in provincial decisions, and that the matter can be taken to court.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions of the provinces, nor to intervene in the course of justice.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten van de provincies, noch om te interveniëren in de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht 'Afhandelaars Schiphol eisen steunpakket van 25,5 miljoen euro'

Two SP MPs asked why five ground-handling companies at Schiphol, facing 3,000 possible layoffs, were not helped by the NOW wage subsidy, and whether the government would investigate market structure and wages in ground handling. The minister said NOW conditions prohibit layoffs for economic reasons, that losses may be too small and January payroll is used as reference, and declined a separate study of ground handling, citing the ongoing EU review of Directive 96/67.
Question 5: Are you willing to investigate the organisation of ground handling at Schiphol?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om onderzoek te doen naar de inrichting van grondafhandeling op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het vervroegde luchtvaartadvies van de commissie Remkes en de gebrekkige rapportage van stikstofuitstoot op grote hoogte

An MP asked the ministers about the early aviation advice of the Remkes committee and whether nitrogen emissions above 3,000 feet from aviation are fully reported, including whether they are placed under 'abroad'. The government answered that the Adviescollege recommends bringing emissions above 3,000 feet into view, that Dutch airport emissions above that height are not counted as 'abroad', and that reporting to the EU will be adjusted following the advice.
With the follow-up to the Remkes committee's advice, the reporting to the European Commission will be adjusted on this point.
Met de opvolging van het advies van de commissie Remkes zal op dit punt de rapportage naar de Europese Commissie worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over het bericht dat grote stukken strand op Walcheren zijn weggeslagen door storm Ciara

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported beach erosion on Walcheren after storm Ciara, the damage assessment, and why sand nourishment at Dishoek was delayed, including whether the nitrogen (PAS) ruling affected it. The minister answered that only a small stretch needed urgent action, that an accelerated sand nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for completion before autumn 2020, that talks with the province and municipalities are ongoing, and that the PAS ruling delayed the nourishment programme.

At present an accelerated sand nourishment is being prepared for the Dishoek location on Walcheren for reasons of water safety, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van den Berg over het verlies van het strand bij Zoutelande

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about coastal erosion at Zoutelande after storm Ciara, including whether the periodic sand nourishment approach is adequate, whether the nourishment was delayed by the nitrogen (PAS) ruling, and whether the Spoedwet stikstof could help. The minister answered that the programmatic approach is adequate and climate-resilient, that an accelerated nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for the 2020 storm season, and that the Spoedwet does not address this situation.
Along the coast of Walcheren, particularly near Dishoek, there was such coastal retreat that an accelerated sand nourishment before the start of the 2020/2021 storm season is necessary.
Langs de kust van Walcheren, met name nabij Dishoek, was sprake van dusdanige kustafslag dat een versnelde zandsuppletie voor aanvang van het stormseizoen 2020/2021 noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het signaal dat de nieuwe Merwedebruggen veel te laag dreigen te worden

MP Stoffer asks whether the new Merwede bridges may be built lower than the existing one, and whether the minister will keep navigation clearance at least equal to today's. The minister confirms extra research is underway on the bridges' clearance height, with a decision expected before summer 2020 and consultation with shipping organisations via existing channels.
Yes, a decision on the exact height of the new Merwede bridges is expected to be taken before the summer.
Ja, besluitvorming over de exacte hoogte van de nieuwe Merwedebruggen zal naar verwachting voor de zomer plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over de uitgifte van vouchers door luchtvaartmaatschappijen bij vluchtannuleringen vanwege Covid-19

MPs Schonis and Paternotte asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about airline vouchers issued instead of refunds for Covid-19 cancellations, including validity periods, credit card chargebacks, insolvency protection and whether non-enforcement by the ILT deviates from EU rules. The minister answered that vouchers are valid at least twelve months with refund available after six months on request, that enforcement is waived by directive, that she is pursuing an EU guarantee scheme and a fund, and that she has informed the Commission and transport ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over tolheffing bij de Westerscheldetunnel in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An MP asked the minister about toll collection at the Westerscheldetunnel during the COVID-19 crisis, whether it should be toll-free, and about cross-border emergency care and ambulance passage at the Liefkenshoek tunnel. The minister answered that the Westerscheldetunnel remains the access route and that toll decisions rest with the province and the tunnel directorate, while describing existing rules for emergency vehicles and cross-border care.
The Provincial States of Zeeland, as shareholder of the Westerscheldetunnel, decides on the toll framework.
Provinciale staten van de Provincie Zeeland besluit als aandeelhouder van de Westerscheldetunnel over het tolheffingskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor keuringen bij de RDW en het CBR

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the COVID-19 crisis affects APK vehicle inspections at the RDW and driving licence renewals at the CBR, including temporary leniency for expired inspections and licences and the handling of imported cars. The minister answered that inspections continue with reduced RDW services, that expired APKs may not be driven except to the garage, and that temporary coulance applies to licences expiring until 1 June 2020 while a longer-term alternative (possibly an emergency decree) is being developed.
For the reasons above, temporary leniency currently applies to all driving licence holders whose licence expires in the period 16 March 2020 through 1 June 2020.
Om bovenstaande redenen is een tijdelijke coulance momenteel van kracht voor alle rijbewijshouders wier rijbewijs verloopt in de periode 16 maart 2020 tot en met 1 juni 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de werkzaamheden bij het CBR en de medische keuringen tijdens het coronavirus

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the coronavirus affects CBR driving-licence medical assessments and renewals for vital-occupation drivers, and what is being done about delays. The minister confirmed the delays, pointed to a temporary grace arrangement allowing expired licences to be used until 1 June, and said longer-term alternatives such as an emergency decree and EU consultation are being explored, though the answers largely restate measures without firm dates.
That is why a grace arrangement is now in force as described in the answer to question 2.
Daarom is nu een coulanceregeling van kracht zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Britse Hof van Beroep heeft geoordeeld dat uitbreidingsplannen voor London Heathrow Airport strijdig zijn met de klimaatdoelstellingen uit het Parijsakkoor

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether aviation can still ignore the Paris Agreement after a UK Court of Appeal ruled Heathrow expansion plans unlawful, and how Dutch airport plans such as Schiphol growth and Lelystad Airport fit with climate goals. The government answers that aviation emissions are addressed through ICAO and national sector agreements, that the UK ruling concerns UK planning law, and that Dutch airport decisions require environmental impact assessments which are still pending, without committing to halt the projects.
The government's aim is to achieve CO2 reductions based on the measures described in my letter on aviation climate policy of 27 March 2019.
Het streven van het kabinet is om CO 2 -reducties te realiseren op basis van de maatregelen die zijn beschreven in mijn brief over het klimaatbeleid voor de luchtvaart van 27 maart 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk en Bruins over het bericht in The Guardian ‘Heathrow third runway ruled illegal over climate change’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the UK Court of Appeal ruling that Heathrow's third runway plan was unlawful under climate commitments affects Dutch aviation policy, including CO2 assessment in environmental impact reports for Schiphol and Lelystad Airport and progress on the sector's emissions targets. The minister answered that the Netherlands is bound by the Paris Agreement, that the UK ruling concerns UK law and is not for the Dutch government to judge, that CO2 from landing and take-off cycles is assessed in the Lelystad and Schiphol reports, and that the sector's targets and the Sustainable Aviation Roundtable process are still being developed.
It is not for me to form a judgement on the ruling of the British judge and on whether it is appropriate and desirable.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vormen over de uitspraak van de Britse rechter en in hoeverre deze al dan niet passend en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Taxibedrijven kunnen fluiten naar 4.000 euro tegemoetkoming’

An SP MP asked the ministers about the COVID-19 impact on the taxi sector, including whether a ban on taxi travel should apply, payment of school and medical transport, support for self-employed drivers, and protective equipment. The State Secretary answered most questions in substance, referring some to municipalities and health insurers, and said the answer to question 11 could not be given by the 7 April deadline.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat vrachtwagenchauffeurs nergens meer van voorzieningen gebruik kunnen maken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that truck drivers could no longer use toilets and washing facilities during the COVID-19 period, and whether service stations, distribution centres and roadside restaurants would be asked to open them. The minister said he had repeatedly called on businesses to keep facilities available, noted that some still refused drivers, pointed to EU Green Lanes guidance, and said talks with sector parties were ongoing without committing to a specific new measure.
I have called on various platforms to keep these available to drivers and will continue to do so.
Ik heb op verschillende fora opgeroepen deze beschikbaar te blijven stellen aan chauffeurs en zal dat ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat een schippersechtpaar op de intensive care is beland na vergiftiging door lading

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Dutch skipper couple hospitalised after exposure to fumigant gas from their cargo, asking about incident frequency, victim compensation, liability, port procedures, odour warnings and international bans on phosphine. The minister answered that the investigation is with the Public Prosecution Service, that compensation is a civil court matter, that port notification and procedure changes will be discussed in the Rijkshavenmeesteroverleg, and that no odour additive or international ban will be pursued.
At the time of writing, investigation into the accident is still being carried out by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Op het moment van dit schrijven wordt nog steeds onderzoek gedaan naar het ongeval door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Nieuwe coronavirus aangetroffen in rioolwater‘

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of the new coronavirus found in sewage, including worker protection, water treatment, and whether wastewater plants were classed as vital infrastructure. The minister answered that existing protective measures apply, that there is no evidence of transmission via water, and that wastewater plants were not designated vital after a vitality assessment, with further RIVM research requested.
To confirm this and gain more certainty, I have asked the RIVM to conduct research on this.
Om dit te bevestigen en meer zekerheid te krijgen heb ik het RIVM gevraagd om onderzoek hier naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘In levensgevaar door ladinggas’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported fosfine poisoning incident on a Dutch inland vessel and related questions on detection, the number of affected people, inspection roles and redress.
