The minister answered largely by referring to other answers and an investigation report, providing general information on inspection responsibilities, shipment numbers and a planned harmonisation effort with port masters.
My Ministry will provide expertise in cooperation with SZW.
Mijn Ministerie zal in samenwerking met SZW expertise verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de e-laadinfrastructuur voor vrachtwagens

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether the lack of public charging infrastructure for electric trucks along motorways would delay the transition to electric freight, and whether subsidies or a sound business case could speed up roll-out. The state secretary acknowledged the gap, pointed to existing logistics charging provisions in the Klimaatakkoord and national agenda, and to the DKTI and MIA/VAMIL schemes, while stating that the business case and RED2 implications will be reviewed.
With the implementation of RED2, the impact on the business case for charging infrastructure will be reviewed again.
Bij de implementatie van de RED2 wordt opnieuw gekeken naar de impact op de business case van laadinfrastructuur
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘FNV: ‘Luxe Schiphol-lounge met buffet nog open‘’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why a Schiphol airport lounge was still open and serving buffet food after restaurants were closed, who is responsible for it, and what protections exist for workers with fever. The government answered that the local safety region enforced the closure of buffets, that lounge operators (not Schiphol) are responsible for their activities, and it listed worker protection measures and a moral appeal to employers.
On 19 March the Kennemerland safety region received signals that a buffet was still being offered in lounges at Schiphol.
Bij de veiligheidsregio Kennemerland zijn op 19 maart jl. signalen binnengekomen dat er in lounges op Schiphol nog een buffet werd aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Bosman over het bericht ‘Lagere ticketprijzen tussen eilanden laten nog wel even op zich wachten’

MPs Kuiken and Bosman asked why no concrete measures had been taken on the expert group's advice to partly compensate inter-island ticket prices in the Caribbean Netherlands, and when measures would follow. The government answered that a proposal is being developed with the Caribbean islands and ministries, to be tested for legal, financial and organisational feasibility, but it cannot yet give a timeline.
Therefore, at this stage it cannot yet be stated within what timeframe measures can be taken.
Er kan daarom in dit stadium nog niet aangegeven worden binnen welke termijn er maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het bericht ‘ Einde voor Strandrups Noordwijk: Het is te gek voor woorden‘

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Noordwijk beach vehicle (Strandrups), which faces a ban because it does not meet vehicle safety requirements, and whether a licence or municipal decision could allow it to continue. The minister answered that safety comes first, the vehicle cannot be approved under current EU rules or alternative categories, and the minister will meet the foundation again to explore a solution without asking the RDW to admit non-compliant vehicles.

Although I am willing to think along with the Foundation Outdoor4disabled in searching for a solution, I want to emphasise that I am not willing to ask the RDW to nevertheless admit vehicles that do not meet the admission rules.

Hoewel ik bereid ben mee te denken met de Stichting Outdoor4disabled in het zoeken naar een oplossing, wil ik benadrukken dat ik niet bereid ben om de RDW te verzoeken om voertuigen die niet voldoen aan de toelatingsregels toch toe te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebruik van MANPADS in de Syrische provincie Idlib en de risico’s voor de burgerluchtvaart

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure whether Turkey or Turkish-backed groups used MANPADS in Idlib, whether Turkey's policy was being raised, and what the risks to civil aviation were. The government said it could not confirm who operated the systems, that the matter was raised diplomatically with Turkey, and that Dutch airlines avoid Syrian airspace so no further investigation was needed.
The cabinet does not make public statements about which groups have or have not received NLA support from the Netherlands.
229 ) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de groepen die al-dan-niet NLA-steun hebben ontvangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht “Hoe moeten verplegers nu naar hun werk?’’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how public transport can keep essential workers moving during the COVID-19 crisis, questioning reduced timetables by operators Keolis and others, the need for profit to yield to essential-worker transport, and whether bus drivers who report misconduct can be dismissed. The minister replies that regional authorities decide service levels with operators, that a weekend timetable was adopted to match demand and absenteeism, that the government consults operators weekly on the sector, and that employees may criticize business management without fearing dismissal unless it harms the employer.
The decentralised authorities, which are responsible for regional public transport, are best placed to determine which transport offer suits the region, including under current crisis conditions.

De decentrale overheden, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het regionale openbaar vervoer, kunnen het beste bepalen welk vervoeraanbod passend is voor de regio, ook onder de huidige crisisomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat platformmedewerkers op Schiphol geen longonderzoek krijgen

An SP MP asks the Minister whether platform workers at Schiphol can be included in the RIVM study of ultrafine particle health risks and whether a separate health study for them is possible. The Minister replies that existing registries cannot isolate these workers, that a separate study is being discussed with the RIVM with a Parliament update promised in Q3 2020, and that Schiphol will carry out measurements.
That is why I am consulting with the RIVM to examine whether a separate health study for platform workers can be set up.
Daarom ben ik in overleg met het RIVM om te bezien of een apart gezondheidsonderzoek voor platformmedewerkers kan worden opgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sienot over het bericht “CO2-compensatie is misleidend en ‘nattevingerwerk’” gepubliceerd in Trouw van 13 februari 2020

MPs Paternotte and Sienot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that CO2 offsetting is misleading and unreliable, and whether this distorts aviation emissions claims and consumer choices. The minister answered that CORSIA's internationally set eligibility criteria and the Technical Advisory Board govern certificate quality, that the voluntary market is not supervised, and referred consumer and voluntary-market questions to a separate letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
No supervision takes place over the quality of certificates that airlines voluntarily buy on the market.
Op de kwaliteit van certificaten die luchtvaartmaatschappijen vrijwillig kopen in de markt vindt geen toezicht plaats
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen, Wilders, Krol, Van der Staaij en Baudet over COVID-19 patiënten aan boord van vluchten uit coronabrandhaard New York

Five MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Health about the lack of temperature checks and symptom screening for passengers on flights from COVID-19-affected New York, and whether the government should ban such flights. The answer is a referral: the questions are answered in a separate letter on tourism during Easter and the May holiday and measures for New York flights, with the answers to questions 15-19 due on 8 April 2020.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Countering tourism during Easter and the May holiday; measures for flights from New York'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Tegengaan toerisme tijdens Pasen en de meivakantie; maatregelen voor vluchten uit New York»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Reisorganisaties annuleren vakanties voor deze maand: geen reizen bij Corendon, Sunweb Group, TUI en Prijsvrij’

An SP MP asked whether travellers whose package holidays were cancelled due to the coronavirus are entitled to a refund under the Civil Code, and whether travel organisers issuing vouchers instead comply with the law. The Staatssecretaris confirmed the refund right but encouraged acceptance of vouchers given exceptional circumstances, noting ANVR promises of some direct refunds and that the ACM monitors and will intervene if consumer rights are insufficiently respected.
The ACM will not hesitate to intervene if consumer rights are insufficiently respected.
De ACM zal niet aarzelen om in te grijpen als de rechten van consumenten onvoldoende worden gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Agressie tegen verkeersregelaars in Twente neemt toe: we zijn tandeloze tijgers’

An MP asked ministers whether aggression against traffic controllers is rising and whether they fall under the joint police-prosecution agreements on violence against public-task workers, and whether they should get enforcement powers. The minister answers that no registration data exists, that traffic controllers are covered by the agreements, but that giving them special investigative-officer status is not appropriate under the current division of tasks.
There are no registration figures available for the occupational group of traffic controllers on aggression and violence in their sector.
Er zijn geen registratiecijfers beschikbaar van de beroepsgroep verkeersregelaars over agressie en geweld in hun branche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de gevolgen van de nieuwe coronamaatregelen voor rijschoolhouders en rij-instructeurs

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the effects of new COVID-19 measures on driving schools, including the reported closure of most schools and the sector's survival prospects. The minister confirmed a ban on driving lessons for all vehicle types from 25 March to 28 April 2020, pointed to existing financial support schemes, and said the conditions of one scheme were under review.
From 25 March 2020 a ban on driving instruction applies to all types of vehicles.
Met ingang van 25 maart 2020 geldt een rijinstructieverbod voor alle typen voertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de vergunning voor het storten van granuliet in het gebied ‘Over de Maas’ is uitgebreid

An SP MP asked whether the permit for dumping granulite at 'Over de Maas' was expanded from 250,000 to 750,000 tonnes, how it was decided, why it proceeds before parliamentary debate, and what will be done about residents' anger. The minister replied that the Soil Quality Decree works with notifications rather than permits, so no objectionable decision exists; Rijkswaterstaat found the material compliant, and she will commission a review of granulite's environmental quality and take extra sampling.
There is no decision within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act against which objection can be lodged directly.
Er is geen sprake van een besluit in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht, waartegen rechtstreeks bezwaar kan worden aangetekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Wantijbrug en de Botlekbrug

An MP from the VVD asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat renovated the Wantijbrug and Botlekbrug simultaneously, why transport firms were not consulted beforehand, whether an engineering firm was at fault, and whether affected businesses can claim compensation. The minister acknowledged the overlap was unintended and caused extra detours, promised more frequent contact with TLN, and pointed affected firms to the compensation scheme, though it expects no qualifying turnover loss.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore maintain more frequent contact at administrative level and will soon discuss with TLN how information provision in such situations can be improved in both directions.
Rijkswaterstaat zal daarom frequenter contact onderhouden op bestuurlijk niveau en binnenkort met TLN bespreken, hoe de informatievoorziening in dit soort situaties over en weer verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota

An MP asked the minister when the draft Aviation Policy Document (ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota) would be available and whether it would precede the Lelystad airport decree. The minister answered that the draft is expected this spring, subject to possible delays from COVID-19, and that it will precede the Lelystad decree.

I aim to present the decision-making on the draft Aviation Policy Document, the approach for Schiphol, and information for the pre-consultation procedure for the amendment of the Lelystad Airport decree to the House of Representatives this spring.

Ik streef ernaar om dit voorjaar de besluitvorming over de ontwerp-Luchtvaartnota, de aanpak voor Schiphol, en informatie voor de voorhangprocedure voor de wijziging van het Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad aan de Tweede Kamer voor te kunnen leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Logistieke sector krijgt steeds meer last van coronavirus’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that COVID-19 is hitting the logistics sector, including container volumes from Asia, Rotterdam port impacts, and risks for small transport firms and foreign drivers. The minister answered with figures from the Port of Rotterdam and the sector, stated that exact capacity numbers are not available for commercial confidentiality reasons, and outlined existing measures and possible contingency steps.
Exact figures cannot yet be given. This concerns commercially sensitive information.
Exacte cijfers zijn (nog) niet te geven. Het gaat hier om bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Aalst en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat asielzoekers buschauffeurs intimideren en reizigers bestelen

PVV MPs asked why asylum seekers who intimidate bus drivers and rob passengers are allowed to continue, and whether they should be expelled or jailed. The state secretary answered that overlast by asylum seekers is a serious but relatively small group problem, cited cooperation with transport partners, a landelijk convenant and Top-X lists, and said such behaviour leads to lik-op-stuk measures.
For nuisance behaviour the starting point is that, regardless of the person, this is not tolerated and leads to firm enforcement measures.
Bij overlastgevend gedrag is het vertrekpunt dat, ongeacht de persoon, dit niet wordt getolereerd en dit leidt tot lik-op-stuk maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de flinke toename van het aantal gestolen of vermiste kentekenplaten

MP Postma asked the ministers about the sharp rise in stolen or missing number plates, including whether duplicated plates should be treated like stolen ones, whether Amsterdam should align with the CJIB, and the status of RFID plate pilots and Danish-style fastening. The minister acknowledged the concern, stated that existing law already covers duplication, described RDW oversight of plate makers, promised a letter to parliament on RFID and fastening, and said the Amsterdam issue is being addressed by the municipality.
Currently I am examining together with the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW whether RFID number plates could be a solution to combat plate fraud.
Momenteel bekijk ik samen met de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW, of de RFID-kentekenplaten een oplossing kunnen zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Postma over het mogelijk maken van het enkelvoudig in- en uitchecken in de treinketen

MPs Amhaouch and Postma asked why the government limits single check-in/check-out to a national app with location, despite a motion asking for broader solutions, and criticised privacy costs and the Ombudsman's concerns about the system. The minister answered that cost-benefit research found single check-in not worthwhile, that new payment methods and an app will be phased in, that privacy is legally protected, and promised a further update via the NOVB progress report.
I am pleased with the work of the public transport ombudsman because it helps individual travellers with incidental cases and increases travel and payment convenience for all travellers.
Ik ben blij met het werk van de OV ombudsman omdat het individuele reizigers helpt bij incidentele voorvallen en het reis- en betaalgemak van alle reizigers verhoogt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over brandgevaar in parkeergarages en onder woningen

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked ministers about fire risks from charging electric vehicles in underground car parks and under homes, and the government replied that NEN is drafting a new fire-safety standard for car parks (expected 2021), that no electric car or charger is known to have caused a car park fire in the Netherlands, and that it will update guidance and consider further measures without committing to specific Building Decree changes now. Several questions (sprinklers, mandatory fire detectors, charger placement) were deferred to the pending NEN standard.
The Dutch Normalisation Institute (NEN), at my request, is working on a new NEN standard for the integrated fire safety of car parks, expected to be ready in 2021.
Het Nederlandse Normalisatie Instituut (hierna NEN) werkt op mijn verzoek aan een nieuwe NEN-norm voor de integrale brandveiligheid van parkeergarage, die naar verwachting in 2021 gereed is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het nieuws dat de politie extra auto’s aanschaft om de pakkans op snelheidsovertredingen te vergroten

Two PVV MPs asked whether police buying extra unmarked cars to catch speeders after the speed limit change is a waste of taxpayer money, and what it costs. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the cars replace existing radar vehicles already in the police budget, involve no extra investment, and need no extra capacity, and that enforcement continues as before.
This replacement was already provided for in the police budgets. It is therefore not an extra investment.
Deze vervanging was reeds voorzien in de budgetten van de politie. Het gaat dus niet om een extra investering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘KLM weigerde Lili en Howick te vervoeren‘

MPs Becker and Remco Dijkstra asked whether KLM, partly state-owned, cancelled the flight of two deported children (Lili and Howick) at the last moment, what agreements exist with KLM on removals, whether airlines can be sanctioned for frustrating deportation policy, and whether the state should talk to KLM. The State Secretary confirmed KLM's decision, said the captain bears final responsibility for safe flight operation, declined to examine KLM's risk assessment, and stated that no sanctions exist and that KLM's independent decision is separate from the government's decision on the children.

I respect the decision KLM made to not transport these passengers on grounds of safe flight operation, and given KLM's professionalism and long-standing good cooperation, I see no reason to inquire into the risk assessment in this specific case.

Ik respecteer de beslissing die de KLM heeft genomen om uit hoofde van een veilige vluchtuitvoering deze passagiers niet te vervoeren en gelet op de professionaliteit van de KLM en de jarenlange goede samenwerking, zie ik geen aanleiding om navraag te doen naar de risico inschatting in deze specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Ladingen afgekeurd wegens inklimmers‘

MPs Dijkstra and Becker asked the ministers about reports that cargo was rejected because stowaways were found, including the size of the damage, the numbers and nationalities of stowaways and what happens to them, and what measures are taken against smuggling networks. The government answered that it has no overview of the damage or of rejected cargo, outlined expulsion and prosecution practice, listed border measures and cooperation with the UK and Belgium, and said smuggling is investigated where signals exist.
The government has no insight into the extent of the damage suffered in the transport sector from rejected cargo due to stowaways.
De overheid heeft geen inzicht in de omvang van de schade die wordt geleden in de transportsector door het afkeuren van ladingen vanwege inklimmers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Steeds vaker file voor Leidsche Rijntunnel'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising traffic jams at the Leidsche Rijn tunnel, tunnel metering, incidents, lane markings and sprinkler systems. The minister answered that metering moves queues out of the tunnel for safety, that tunnel metering frequency has fallen since 2015, that no significant rise in incidents exists, and that a water mist system is not cost-effective.
The effects will be examined again this spring.
De effecten worden dit voorjaar weer onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven  over het artikel ‘Autosector voldoet niet aan strenge privacynorm’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the minister whether the car sector complies with the GDPR, including whether it processes special personal data, opt-out data sharing and dealer bonuses for data sharing. The minister answered that compliance varies by manufacturer, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is taking targeted steps and that most responsibility lies with manufacturers and dealers, while promising further consumer information work and an exploration with the sector.
Towards the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the sector, efforts are therefore being directed on this issue.
Richting de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP), Autoriteit Consument & Markt (ACM) en de sector wordt hier dan ook op ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Veldman over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid ook voor hulpdiensten omlaag: ‘Dit kan mensenlevens kosten’'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the lower daytime speed limit on motorways (100 km/h) would also apply to emergency services and, if so, how this affects response times and the OGS 2009 rules. The minister replied that emergency vehicles may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, that effects on response times are expected to be negligible, that no amendment is planned, and that the effects will be monitored with the ambulance sector and the knowledge centre, with a promise to inform parliament if problems arise.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on the response times of emergency services are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Van Aalst over het bericht dat hulpdiensten in de knel komen door de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid

Two MPs from the PVV asked the minister whether lowering the daytime speed limit to 100 km/h would lengthen emergency response times and endanger people in need, and whether the government would protect emergency services. The minister answered that the effects are expected to be small to negligible, that emergency services may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, and that the effects will be monitored with the Kenniscentrum Voorrangsvoertuigen and adjusted if bottlenecks emerge.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on emergency service response times are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schonis over het bericht ‘Kosten verlaging maximumsnelheid twee keer hoger dan verwacht’

MPs Dik-Faber and Schonis asked whether the costs of lowering the motorway speed limit were twice the expected amount and why Rijkswaterstaat would place extra 130 km/h signs and why EV charging-point signs were not added. The minister confirmed the extra signs, said budget and time were allocated for the urgent nitrogen-driven speed reduction, and committed to combining charging-point signage with the work where cost-efficient.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that it will prepare a schedule including a cost estimate for this after completing the placement of the current signs.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven hiervoor een planning inclusief een kostenraming te maken na afronding van het plaatsen van de huidige borden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Nijkerken-de Haan en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Limburg vreest verlies duizenden banen door luchtvrachttaks'

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the national aviation tax would cost jobs and traffic at Maastricht Aachen Airport and whether further research and consultation with Limburg had taken place. The government answered that no airport-specific analysis was made, that national effects show a small emissions decline and limited job effects, and that the EU-level alternative remains uncertain.
No specific research was conducted into the position of Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Er is geen specifiek onderzoek gedaan naar de positie van Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Consumentenorganisaties: hef 25 cent per vliegticket voor garantiefonds'

MPs Paternotte and Gijs van Dijk asked whether Dutch consumers have legal guarantees when buying flight tickets compared with package holidays, and whether a Danish-style guarantee fund should be introduced. The minister answered that package travel is legally protected against insolvency while loose flight tickets are not, pointed to private protections such as credit cards, insurance and rescue fares, and declined for now to investigate a guarantee fund.
I see no reason for now to examine a guarantee fund for flight tickets in the Netherlands further.
Zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een garantiefonds vliegtickets in Nederland nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins en Voordewind over het bericht ‘F-35 mag straks laagvliegen over oostelijk Fryslân’

MPs Bruins and Voordewind asked whether the government will reopen the Linkroute-10A low-flying route over eastern Friesland for F-35s, whether Friesland was involved, whether a nature permit is needed and whether alternatives were studied. The State Secretary for Defence answered that there is currently no reason to reopen the route, that a permit and ecological analysis are still being prepared, that alternatives abroad are being examined, and promised a decision by 1 June 2020.
At the consultation on 18 February I promised the House to provide clarity on the future of Linkroute-10A by 1 June 2020.
Tijdens het VAO op 18 februari heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd om voor 1 juni 2020 duidelijkheid te bieden over de toekomst van de Linkroute-10A.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over De stikstofdepositie van Schiphol

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's nitrogen deposition on Natura 2000 areas, including whether assessments had been made since 2004 and whether the emission limits and permits were adequate. The minister answered that Schiphol is making a new deposition calculation, that no absolute emission ceiling exists yet, and that several questions fall under the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality or are still under review.
The Ministry of LNV will, in the context of the enforcement requests, rule on whether, and if so when, Schiphol should have applied for a nature permit.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van de handhavingsverzoeken een uitspraak doen of, en zo ja, wanneer Schiphol een natuurvergunning had moeten aanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over een containerschip dat 5 containers boven Ameland verliest en een containerschip dat tijdens de storm Ciara de risicovolle route boven de Waddeneilanden vaart

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a container ship that lost seven containers above Ameland and a container ship that took the risky southern route past the Wadden islands during storm Ciara, asking about recovery, damage, the Kustwacht's warnings, the permanent closure motion and possible IMO proposals. The minister answered that the owner is responsible for recovery with Rijkswaterstaat as fallback, that the captain has final route authority, that a permanent closure cannot be imposed unilaterally and needs an IMO proposal with Germany, and that consultations with Germany will follow the OVV report.
The choice of route is ultimately the responsibility of the captain.
De keuze voor de route is uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de kapitein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Kröger over de berichten dat containerschepen ook tijdens de storm de zuidelijke Waddenzeeroute hebben genomen en containers hebben verloren

MPs Van der Graaf and Kröger asked whether warnings from the Dutch coastguard for large container ships on the southern Wadden Sea route apply only eastbound, whether Germany warns westbound ships, and whether a closure of the route in high waves is possible. The minister replied that Germany does not actively warn ships and awaits investigation outcomes, that a permanent closure cannot be imposed unilaterally and would require an IMO proposal, and that MARIN research on smaller ships and the MSC Zoë investigation results are expected in spring 2020.
In the short term I will contact my German counterpart to agree that, once the main investigations are completed, the Netherlands and Germany will discuss joint follow-up actions towards the IMO.

Op korte termijn zal ik contact opnemen met mijn Duitse ambtgenoot om met hem af te spreken dat na het gereedkomen van de belangrijkste onderzoeken Nederland en Duitsland gezamenlijke vervolgacties richting IMO zullen bespreken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Aalst over de berichten ‘Helmplicht voor snorfietser wordt geleidelijk ingevoerd’ en ‘Ook de snorfietser moet eraan geloven: een niet-coole helm op’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on a gradual helmet obligation for moped (snorfiets) riders, asking about safer alternatives, comparative risks, economic effects, relocation to the road, and how owners will be informed and can object. The Minister answered all ten questions on substance, explaining the planned helmet rule, the Arcadis study, the ongoing internet consultation, and that a communication campaign will follow if the rule is adopted.
The aim of this measure is to reduce the number of road deaths and injuries among moped riders, not to push the snorfiets off the streets.
Het doel van deze maatregel is om het aantal verkeersdoden en -gewonden onder snorfietsers te verminderen, niet om de snorfiets uit het straatbeeld te verdringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Haast geboden voor filetopper, A4 Den Haag-Burgerveen'

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the A4 Den Haag–Burgerveen congestion project cannot start sooner, whether budget can be shifted, and what can be done to ease the losses to transport firms. The minister answered that construction can only start in 2026 because of statutory procedures and planning, not budget, and that she will explore ways to start preparations earlier and work with the transport sector on mobility measures.
This means that at present construction cannot start before 2026.
Dit maakt dat op dit moment niet eerder dan in 2026 gestart kan worden met de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Sienot en Kröger over berichten dat containerschepen ook tijdens de storm de zuidelijke Waddenzeeroute hebben genomen en containers hebben verloren

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that container ships, including the OOCL Rauma during storm Ciara, took the southern Wadden Sea route and lost containers, and what the Coast Guard, liability and route closure options involved. The minister answered that the Coast Guard warned nine ships, that the owner was held liable for clean-up under the Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen, that the OVV and MARIN investigations are pending, and that closing the southern route requires IMO decision-making, with further steps to follow after the OVV report.
I will respond to the report as soon as possible and inform your House about it.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk reageren op het rapport en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de eerste cijfers met betrekking tot snorfietsen op de rijbaan in Amsterdam

An MP asked the minister about Amsterdam's moped-to-road measure, including falling registrations, shifts to cars, persistent non-compliance, the cost of 6 million euro and the lack of a full evaluation. The minister answered each question, defended the measure, and committed to a broad evaluation once several road authorities have implemented it.
I myself will carry out a broad evaluation, based on the evaluations carried out by municipalities, of the effects on traffic flow and road safety of allowing mopeds on the carriageway.
Zelf voer ik een brede evaluatie uit, op basis van de door gemeenten uitgevoerde evaluaties, naar de effecten op de doorstroming en verkeersveiligheid door het toestaan van snorfietsen op de rijbaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht ‘Contractors lay off 80 workers at Statia’s oil storage terminal’

Mr Van Dam (CDA) asked about reports that around 80 contract workers were laid off at the Statia oil terminal, its effect on the island's economy, and the ILT's enforcement against GTIS. The government answered that about 115 people were dismissed mostly by subcontractors for cost reasons, that the ILT started enforcement over late tank inspections and fire-fighting systems, and that the government is developing an economic strategy for the island.
Statistics Netherlands (CBS) cannot provide specific figures on GTIS for reasons of confidentiality.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) kan om redenen van vertrouwelijkheid geen specifieke cijfers over GTIS geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch en Bruins over ongewenste effecten van de werking van historische rechten op slots in relatie tot de disruptie veroorzaakt door het coronavirus (IATA r

MPs asked whether the minister would press the European Commission to suspend slot 'use-it-or-lose-it' rules for 2020 at the request of IATA, given coronavirus disruption to air travel and the risk of empty flights. The minister agreed in principle, said the Commission would be asked to extend the existing waiver for the summer season and widen it to all severely affected countries, but declined to provide load-factor data citing commercial confidentiality.

I have asked the European Commission to extend its current waiver of the slot rules for preserving historic rights for the IATA winter season 2019/2020 in connection with the coronavirus into the upcoming IATA summer season

Ik heb de Europese Commissie verzocht om haar huidige ontheffing van de slotregels ten behoeve van het behoud van historische rechten voor het IATA winterseizoen 2019/2020 in verband met het coronavirus te verlengen voor het aankomend IATA zomerseizoen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de EuroStar trein naar London

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked about the status of the four-country border control and security treaties for the Eurostar service to London, the reported shortage of Marechaussee capacity for a third daily train, remaining obstacles, implementation of their motions, and earlier commitments on capacity. The State Secretary replied that the treaties are concluded and due for signing by 30 April 2020, that Marechaussee capacity is being arranged for the extra trains, and that provisional application will proceed without blocking the direct service.
The aim is that the treaties will be signed by 30 April 2020 at the latest.
De inzet is dat de ondertekening van de verdragen in ieder geval voor 30 april 2020 zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de verjaringstermijn voor nadeelcompensatie naar aanleiding van het luchthavenbesluit voor de luchthaven Lelystad

MP Laçin (SP) asked whether claims for noise-related compensation from the Lelystad Airport decision would be time-barred from 1 April 2020 under the five-year period, how many claims had been received, and whether claimants could be given time given that the airport is not yet open to commercial aviation. The minister answered that the statutory five-year limitation period in the Wet luchtvaart applies, so late claims must be declined, but that claimants can prevent the limitation by sending interruption letters; about 2,290 letters had been received, mostly such interruption letters, and a claim can be filed from 1 April 2015 regardless of opening date.
Requests for compensation submitted after this period must, under the Aviation Act, be left unprocessed.
Aanvragen om nadeelcompensatie ingediend na deze termijn, dienen op grond van de Wet luchtvaart buiten behandeling gelaten te worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over ontwikkelingen coronavirus naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Two Beijing hospitals quarantined amid fears coronavirus infections will spike in the capital'

Two D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Health and of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising COVID-19 cases in Beijing, Chinese airlines still flying to Amsterdam, and KLM selling tickets on those routes, and whether they would restrict or withdraw air transport permits. The government answered that the case numbers do not compare to Wuhan, that airline restrictions are not currently at issue on WHO advice, that airlines are responsible for their schedules, and that it will reconsider only if WHO advice changes.
I have not currently taken any decisions that lead to restrictions on aviation.
Ik heb op dit moment geen besluiten genomen die leiden tot restricties voor de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over legionellapreventie bij afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about RIVM reports on Legionella spread from wastewater treatment plants, including whether measures, inspection and worker risks are adequate. The minister answers that prevention is primarily the responsibility of water boards and operators, that current measures and inspections are sufficient, that the Labour Inspectorate's risk-based planning did not rank Legionella highly, and that no binding new measures are planned.
It is up to the water boards and companies operating wastewater treatment plants themselves to determine which preventive measures are taken.
Het is aan de waterschappen en bedrijven met AWZI's zelf om te bepalen welke preventieve maatregelen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Dit zijn de gevaarlijkste (snelweg)kilometers op de Nederlandse wegen'

MPs Postma and Remco Dijkstra asked the minister about a Telegraaf report ranking the most dangerous motorway stretches, led by the A10 at the Coentunnel, and about follow-up on earlier recommendations, speed, and safety measures. The minister says the ranking uses different crash data than Rijkswaterstaat's BRON, so conclusions cannot yet be confirmed, and lists measures taken and planned for the A10, A8, A12, A1 and A16 locations.
At this moment I cannot yet say whether the conclusions are correct.
Op dit moment kan ik nog niet zeggen of de conclusies kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘85.000 senioren mogen niet meer met de auto naar het buitenland: ‘Dit is leeftijds- én regio-discriminatie’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports that around 85,000 seniors aged 75 and over cannot drive abroad due to backlogs at the CBR driving licence agency, and whether these people are being adequately helped. The minister confirmed the figures (over 100,000 covered by administrative extension by January), said exceptions exist for individual hardship with specified criteria, and refused to commit to faster processing for border-region seniors, deferring to a forthcoming appraisal of a motion.
As promised during this debate, I will send your House an appraisal of this motion before the votes on 3 March.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens dit VAO zal ik voor de stemmingen op 3 maart een appreciatie van deze motie naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht ‘AIVD blokkeert terugkeer tientallen Nederlandse piloten’

MP Paternotte asked whether Dutch pilots who worked more than four years in countries without an AIVD cooperation arrangement are effectively barred from working in the Netherlands, and whether the four-year rule and the security-clearance (VGB) policy will be revisited. The government answers that pilots, as crew of a Dutch aircraft, need a VGB, that the AIVD/MIVD cannot clear applicants when the assessment period is insufficiently verifiable, that the policy was loosened in 2018 and will be reviewed with a letter before Q1 2020, but that past decisions will not be reopened.
If the assessment period is insufficiently transparent, the UVO cannot assess whether the person poses a risk to national security.
Als de beoordelingsperiode onvoldoende inzichtelijk is, kan de UVO niet beoordelen of betrokkene een risico vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Amhaouch over tekortkomingen van Kustwachtwachthelikopters

MPs Van den Berg and Amhaouch asked about a safety report on the Dutch coast guard SAR helicopters, crew safety, the 2016 OVV findings, crew language skills, the contracting of the Belgian operator, airworthiness oversight and callout figures. The minister referred to the attached research report and response for most substantive points, said the contractor had been awarded the contract on lowest price, placed airworthiness oversight with the Belgian aviation authority, and gave callout numbers for 2017-2019.
I refer you to the research report that I have sent you today.
Ik verwijs u naar het onderzoeksrapport dat ik u heden heb toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht over de slechte staat van bruggen op de A44

An MP asked the minister about weight and width restrictions imposed on heavy and bus traffic on four structures on the A44 due to deteriorated bridges. The minister confirmed the restrictions, said they extend the structures' lifespan, and gave a planned replacement or renovation around 2025.
Until replacement or renovation, the width restriction and the weight restriction remain in force.
Tot aan vervanging of renovatie blijven de breedtebeperking en de gewichtsbeperking van kracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht over geannuleerde vluchten op Eindhoven Airport wegens mist

An MP asked the government about flight cancellations and delays at Eindhoven Airport caused by fog, including who bears the damage, whether the fog counts as force majeure, and why no higher-category ILS landing system was installed. The state secretary answered that 156 civil flights were affected in 2019, that damage is for airlines and the airport, that fog is force majeure, and that Defence is responsible for the ILS, with any upgrade initiative lying with the airport and possibly timed for the 2024/2025 runway works.
Eindhoven Airport states that it currently does not have this data available.
Eindhoven Airport laat weten momenteel niet over deze gegevens te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het nieuws dat het hervatten van het rangeren met gevaarlijke stoffen op Waalhaven Zuid opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the repeated postponement of shunting dangerous goods at Waalhaven Zuid, and about the economic damage and why the fire-suppression system does not cover the whole yard. The minister confirmed the delay, said the authorities allowed resumption only under conditions, and promised to inform parliament once the timeline and measures for extending fire protection are clear.
Once there is clarity about the necessary measures and the timeline, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over de benodigde maatregelen en het tijdpad, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Laçin en Kröger over Emissieregistratie

MPs Bruins, Laçin and Kröger asked whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported as a memo item under the NEC Directive, and whether the Netherlands has reported them. The minister answered that such emissions fall outside the Directive's scope and need not be reported, so the Netherlands has complied.
The Netherlands has not reported aviation emissions above 3,000 feet, which the Directive also does not require.
Nederland heeft de emissies van de luchtvaart boven de 3.000 voet niet gerapporteerd, hetgeen op grond van de richtlijn ook niet verplicht is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Laçin over de berichten dat Ryanair passagiers toch een schadevergoeding moet betalen

MPs Paternotte and Laçin asked the minister about reports that Ryanair must still pay compensation to passengers, and about the ILT's role in enforcing EU Regulation 261/2004, including whether it can act on systematic refusal of claims. The minister confirmed the ILT is responsible for enforcement against systematic violations, explained that after the Ruijssenaars ruling it no longer rules on individual complaints (passengers go to civil courts), gave complaint statistics for Ryanair, and declined to share airline delay data from third parties as confidential.
Following the Ruijssenaars ruling, the ILT is not permitted to enforce on individual passenger complaints about compensation.
Het is de ILT als gevolg van de Ruijssenaars-uitspraak niet toegestaan te handhaven op individuele passagiersklachten over compensatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de snelle verbinding tussen Amsterdam en Berlijn

The MP asks whether the omission of Bad Bentheim and Rheine stations was improperly influenced by German cities, and what the minister will do to speed up the Amsterdam–Berlin train. The minister denies involvement in the Overijssel-led regional study, reports contact with the province which rejects influence claims, and commits to a half-hour time gain by timetable 2024 with a further letter to parliament.
I did ask the Province of Overijssel for information following the media reports.
Ik heb de Provincie Overijsel wel om informatie gevraagd naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Van Helvert over beperken van geluidsoverlast A79 Valkenburg aan de Geul

Two MPs from the CDA asked the minister about noise nuisance from the A79 at Valkenburg aan de Geul, including responsibility of Rijkswaterstaat, delays in the resurfacing and MJPG noise measures, and consultation with residents. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is responsible, that resurfacing is planned for 2021 with no further delay expected, and that noise measures remain in MJPG phase two, though some questions were answered only partly or in general terms.
I do not expect any further delay for these works.
Ik verwacht geen verder uitstel voor deze werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over het initiatief van scholen en ondernemers op Terschelling en Vlieland om een veerdienst tussen beide eilanden te onderzoeken

MPs asked the minister whether she knows of and will support an initiative for a direct ferry between Terschelling and Vlieland, including via the concession for the West Frisian ferries. The minister acknowledged the initiative and the travel-time benefits, but said the ferry is a matter for local parties and that she has no role beyond the concession for mainland links, which the current operator also partly serves.
These parties are currently investigating the feasibility. I have no role in this.
Deze partijen onderzoeken momenteel de haalbaarheid. Ik heb hier geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het ontsporen van de Hoekse Lijn over de kosten die gemoeid zijn met de ombouw van de spoorweg Schiedam Centrum – Hoek van Holland tot metroverbinding

MPs asked the minister how the cost overrun and delays of the Hoekse Lijn conversion could have been checked by elected representatives, and asked for a full cost overview, audit reports and the role of the regional audit office. The minister replied that since 2017 responsibility lies with the municipality of Rotterdam and the Metropoolregio Rotterdam Den Haag, that the Rijk was not involved in the works, costs or audits, and referred the MPs to the regional body and municipalities.
From 3 April 2017 the Rijk therefore bears no responsibility whatsoever for the so-called 'Hoekse Lijn'.
Vanaf 3 april 2017 draagt het Rijk dus geen enkele verantwoordelijkheid meer voor de zogenaamde «Hoekse Lijn».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over de nieuwe dienstregeling van de NS

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about the new NS timetable from December 2019, including shorter Alkmaar connections, intercity service during peak hours, rolling stock and overcrowding at Beverwijk. The minister answered that travel times improved, that NS sets the timetable within the concession and that it will introduce newer rolling stock in 2021, while regretting the overcrowding.
NS is responsible for drawing up the timetable on the main rail network, including weighing sprinters against intercity services or a direct connection.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen van de dienstregeling op het hoofdrailnet, inclusief de afweging tussen het rijden van sprinters of intercity's of het rijden van een rechtstreekse verbinding.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de berichten “VOLE wil dat vliegveld Eelde wordt gestraft voor overtredingen” en “Rechter buigt zich over klachten sluitingstijden Groningen Airport Eelde”

An MP asked the minister about enforcement of night-time opening hours at Groningen Airport Eelde, the ILT's interpretation of the extension rules, and the airport's future. The minister answered that the ILT issued warnings, applies a strict interpretation endorsed by the court, and requested a plan of action, but did not yet provide its content or timing.
In addition, the ILT has requested a plan of action from GAE to secure long-term compliance.
Daarnaast heeft de ILT verzocht om een plan van aanpak van GAE om naleving op de lange termijn te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over overlast van vliegveld Luik-Bierset en het uitblijven van concrete actie ondanks een aangenomen motie

An MP asked the minister why a passed motion on noise nuisance from Liège-Bierset airport has produced no concrete improvement, and about the timing and scope of a Belgian-Dutch expert group. The minister answered that efforts continue, the expert group has met once and is analysing options, but gave no firm timeline and only vague benchmarks.
I am doing my utmost to reach a solution to the situation as quickly as possible and to remove the additional nuisance caused by the 2013 airspace change.
Ik doe mijn uiterste best om zo spoedig mogelijk tot een oplossing van de situatie te komen en de extra overlast als gevolg van de luchtruimwijziging in 2013 weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over recente ontwikkelingen met betrekking tot het gebruik van rubbergranulaat bij kunstgrasvelden

An MP asked the ministers about a Rotterdam court ruling convicting a sports club for spreading rubber granules from its artificial pitch, and about how clubs can meet the duty of care, including cheaper alternatives and support for volunteer-run clubs. The government said it takes note of the ruling, that duty-of-care measures are described in sector guidelines, that clubs can get 30% subsidy for spread-prevention measures, and that research on more environmentally friendly pitches is funded with results expected in early 2021.
It is up to the competent authority to assess whether the duty of care has been properly implemented.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om te beoordelen of sprake is van een juiste invulling van de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht ‘Vraag naar elektrische bouwmachines groeit, aanbod blijft nog achter’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether electric construction machinery can reduce nitrogen and greenhouse emissions, how tender procedures weigh e-machinery, and whether financial incentives exist. The minister answered that electrification helps air quality and emissions, that a roadmap to zero-emission machinery is being prepared, and that tax schemes (MIA/Vamil) and the DKTI subsidy support adoption.
The national government, together with construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers of construction equipment, is mapping the developments needed to speed up the pace.
Het Rijk brengt samen met bouwbedrijven, fabrikanten en leveranciers van bouwmaterieel de benodigde ontwikkelingen in kaart om het tempo op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het op te stellen milieueffectrapport voor Schiphol

MP Bruins asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the environmental impact report (MER) for Schiphol at 500,000 flight movements is being prepared and which reference situation and date should apply, given the last formally adopted LVB dates from 2002. The minister confirms work is ongoing, points to pending additional deposition research and an open enforcement request to LNV on the reference year, and refers to the NRD for scope without committing to the reference date the MP proposes.

In this regard, as also stated above, the reference year to be used for this calculation is the subject of the enforcement request regarding Schiphol that the Ministry of LNV, as competent authority under the Nature Conservation Act, has received.

Hierbij geldt, zoals hierboven ook staat aangegeven, dat het te hanteren referentiejaar voor deze berekening onderwerp is van het handhavingsverzoek met betrekking tot Schiphol dat het Ministerie van LNV, als bevoegd gezag voor de Wet natuurbescherming, heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Renovatie IJsselbruggen hard nodig, voorlopig tijdelijke maatregelen’

An MP asked the minister about the urgent renovation of the A12 IJssel bridges, traffic delays, permits, communication with transport firms, the A15 extension and nitrogen issues. The minister answered that the bridges can be renovated, one bridge stays closed at a time, delays are limited, and no nitrogen problems are expected.
This research, completed at the end of 2019, shows that the two steel bridges can be renovated.
Uit dit eind 2019 afgeronde onderzoek blijkt dat de twee stalen bruggen gerenoveerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat platformmedewerkers op Schiphol geen longonderzoek krijgen

An SP MP asked the minister why Schiphol ground workers are excluded from the RIVM ultrafine dust lung study given to nearby residents, and whether RIVM will be instructed to include them. The minister answered that the study targets the surrounding area, that workplace health is primarily the employer's responsibility under labour law, that RIVM says workers cannot be included without exposure data and registry categories, and that Schiphol will prepare an action plan and possibly a measurement programme.
RIVM has since indicated that it is not possible to include workers in the current design of the research programme.
Het RIVM heeft inmiddels aangegeven dat het niet mogelijk is om werknemers mee te nemen in de huidige opzet van het onderzoekprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Renkema over het AO 'Vliegen over Conflictgebieden'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked who decides on suspending flights to China, whether it is right that airlines make that call commercially, what information airlines use, the roles of the UK and German governments, when the Dutch state could suspend flights, whether KLM cut mainly unsold flights, and whether arriving passengers can be medically screened. The Minister answered that airlines decide under advice from RIVM, WHO, EU and ICAO and the foreign ministry travel advice, that the Minister of Medical Care could impose targeted emergency measures under the Public Health Act but no flight-ban is warranted now, and that entry screening is not effective.
Transport permits that airlines hold under aviation treaties can only be withdrawn when operators do not comply with national rules on the admission, stay and departure of passengers and cargo.

Vervoerstoestemmingen die luchtvaartmaatschappijen op grond van de luchtvaartverdragen hebben, kunnen alleen worden ingetrokken wanneer exploitanten de nationale voorschriften voor de toelating, verblijf en vertrek van passagiers en vracht niet opvolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het feit dat Italië alle vluchten tussen Italië en China heeft opgeschort

Four CDA MPs asked ministers about Italy suspending China flights, Chinese tourists with coronavirus in Italy, KLM suspending China flights, travel advice, EU coordination, quarantine of returnees, and international support for vulnerable countries. The government answered that Dutch procedures match Italy's, that EU health measures remain with member states, that it follows WHO advice against disproportionate restrictions, and that no additional Dutch funding seems necessary now.
Measures regarding health are reserved to the member states.
Maatregelen ten aanzien van de gezondheid zijn voorbehouden aan de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de ontspoorde trein bij Voorburg

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a derailed train at Voorburg, including reports of earlier faults, injuries, passenger care, and whether the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid would investigate. The minister reported two minor injuries, explained the passenger care, and said NS and ProRail are investigating the cause, with the Chamber to be informed on completion, but declined to pre-empt the findings on the reported faults.
This investigation is still ongoing and I do not want to anticipate its outcomes.
Dit onderzoek loopt momenteel nog en ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten ervan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen tot 8 januari over Irak en Iran bleven vliegen en over de opvolging van aanbe

MPs asked why Dutch airlines kept flying over Iran and Iraq until 8 January 2020, what information was shared, and how the OVV's MH17 conflict-zone recommendations have been implemented. The minister answered that KLM stopped flying there about 1.5 hours after the US FAA ban, that EASA and ICAO advisories were issued and the status of each OVV recommendation was described, while stating that airspace sovereignty and closure duties lie with states and promising further international and national follow-up.
Following the attack on the Iranian general on 2 January, the situation was actively monitored by the Netherlands (Expert Group of the Convenant on sharing threat information for civil aviation).
Naar aanleiding van de aanslag op de Iraanse generaal op 2 jan jl. is de situatie door Nederland (Expertgroep van het Convenant deling dreigingsinformatie burgerluchtvaart) actief gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht ‘Koraal Curaçao vernield door olieplatform’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that an oil platform damaged coral reef off Curaçao, and about the extent of damage, responsibility, recovery and prevention. The government acknowledged the irreversible damage, said Curaçao's ministry is investigating the cause, noted coral planting is possible but limited, and stated Curaçao itself is responsible for shipping safety rules.
Curaçao is itself responsible for making and enforcing regulations on shipping safety to prevent such incidents.
Curaçao is zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken en handhaven van voorschriften met betrekking tot de scheepvaartveiligheid om dergelijke incidenten te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de correspondentie tussen het KNMI en CLINTEL

The MP Baudet asked the minister whether the KNMI should continue its discussion with the CLINTEL group about climate science, what areas the KNMI finds its own expertise insufficient in, and whether KNMI public communication should reflect scientific uncertainty. The minister answered that the KNMI is willing to discuss peer-reviewed work, that climate advice rests on a broad international IPCC-based scientific foundation, and that KNMI communication already includes uncertainties.
Climate policy advice has a broad, internationally validated scientific basis.
De beleidsadvisering op het gebied van klimaat heeft een brede internationale gevalideerde wetenschappelijke basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘ProRail: spoor niet berekend op hevige regenbuien en extreme hitte’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Dutch rail network is prepared for extreme weather linked to climate change and what the risks and costs are. The minister acknowledged new risks, pointed to ProRail's commissioned stress tests and advice expected in late 2020 and end 2021, and listed vulnerable components with some incidental measures.
Pending this advice, I cannot yet make a statement about possible effects, risks and costs.
In afwachting van dit advies kan ik nog geen uitspraak doen over mogelijke effecten, risico's en kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Dam, Bosman, Diertens, Van der Graaf, Van Raak, Kuiken, Krol, Kuzu en Bisschop over de aanleg van wegen op Sint Eustatius

MPs asked why road works on Sint Eustatius (Cherry Tree Road) have barely progressed since 2018, whether tendering rules and European-style technical requirements excluded local contractors, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the delay, explains the tender chose a simplified international approach open to local bidders, and says the island's public works department will finish Cherry Tree itself, backed by about 9.5 million euro in funding.
For the Cherry Tree project, after the contract with the contractor was terminated, the public body chose to complete it itself.
In het geval van het project Cherry Tree heeft het openbaar lichaam er na beëindiging van het contract met de aannemer voor gekozen dit nu in eigen beheer af te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het Nieuwsuur-bericht van 22 december 2019  "Tuchtrechter tikt artsen die rijbewijskeuringen doen ‘opvallend vaak’ op de vingers"

An MP asked whether the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management recognises concerns about driving-licence medical assessors, including psychiatrists whose reports were revised at the CBR's request, nine disciplinary sanctions in two years, and links to a commercial bureau. The minister replied that CBR asks for revisions only for substantive clarity, that the sanctions are a small share of about 5,000 procedures, that no structural problem is seen, and that no separate investigation into revisions will be carried out.
I see no reason to ask the CBR to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om CBR te vragen hiernaar verder onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Schonis over de inzet van crashtestdummy’s

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether crash test dummies, which vary in stiffness and flexibility, reflect differences between men and women, and whether EU rules test cars on dummies representative of women. The minister confirmed the dummy differences and said EU type approval uses average 50th-percentile male-sized dummies, that Euro NCAP adds small-adult and child dummies, that the EU will broaden testing and introduce a 5th-percentile dummy from 2022, and that the Netherlands will keep pushing for representative and diverse dummies.

The Netherlands is already actively working within the European Union and Euro NCAP for the highest possible safety level, including through the use of as representative and diverse crash test dummies as possible.
Nederland zet zich binnen de Europese Unie en Euro NCAP al actief in voor een zo hoog mogelijk veiligheidsniveau, ook door het gebruik van zo representatief en divers mogelijke crashtestdummy's.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de berichten ‘VEH: Huishoudens betalen 'onredelijk veel' waterschapsbelasting’ en ‘Succesje voor honderden boze boeren: waterschapsbelasting minder fors omhoog’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that households pay an unreasonable share of water board levies and about the share of each user group in the watersystem levy. The minister gave detailed answers on cost shares, board representation and the 'polluter pays' principle, while stating that some figures cannot be determined and that a revision of the levy system is still under study.
This percentage cannot be determined, but may roughly be correct.
Dit percentage is niet te achterhalen, maar kan bij benadering kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after a correction letter on Lelystad Airport noise calculations, whether the noise appendices underlying the MER were externally validated, and how atmospheric attenuation and screening were handled. The minister answered that the appendices were not based on the original unvalidated 1990s versions, that external validation was done for Lelystad inputs by To70 and Adecs and a counter-expertise by dBvision, and refused to commission further independent validation of the appendices on attenuation and screening.
Findings are fed back by the validating firm to the NLR, which incorporates them into a definitive version of the (amended) appendices.
Bevindingen worden door het bureau dat de validatie uitvoert teruggekoppeld aan het NLR, dat de bevindingen vervolgens verwerkt in een definitieve versie van (de wijziging van) de appendices.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Raan, Laçin  en Kröger over de correctiebrief op de brief Luchtvaart van 15 oktober

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a correction letter on the validation of noise-calculation appendices for regional airports, including when the error was found, why the correction came late, and whether the appendices were externally validated. The minister answered that the error was discovered on 17 October 2019, that there was no legal basis or regulation requiring external validation before 2010, and that external validation was introduced from 2010 and formalised in 2018, while declining to commit to re-validating the appendices for shielding and atmospheric attenuation.
After receiving the email, I unfortunately had to establish that the word 'geen' had been dropped from the relevant sentence in the Verzamelbrief.
Na ontvangst van de mail heb ik helaas moeten constateren dat in de Verzamelbrief in de betreffende zin het woord «geen» is weggevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over luchtvracht en de afgifte van luchtvaartrechten

An MP asked the minister about Kenyan flower imports routed via Saudi Arabia because the bilateral air agreement lacks fifth-freedom rights, and whether this makes Dutch flower logistics vulnerable. The minister confirmed the routing, explained the treaty limits (only third and fourth freedoms), said KLM Cargo competes actively, and said no other EU state appears set to rival the Dutch auction, while giving no figures on turnover or jobs.
I do not have specific data available on the turnover, employees and volumes related to the import of flowers from Kenya.
Ik heb geen specifieke gegevens tot mijn beschikking over de omzet, medewerkers en aantallen gerelateerd aan de import van bloemen uit Kenia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: een op de drie vluchten vanaf Schiphol zou ook per trein kunnen’

Two D66 MPs asked about a report suggesting a third of flights from Schiphol could be replaced by train, about the role of tourism in flights, its economic value, and how to make rail more attractive. The minister says the report draws no conclusions, outlines an action plan with rail partners, cites tourism data and welfare estimates, and commits to talks with the travel industry and NS International.
I am aware of the study.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte en Bruins over het artikel 'Vliegveld Lelystad onveiliger door komst luchtverkeersleiding'

MPs Kröger, Paternotte and Bruins asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of two near-collisions at Lelystad Airport after air traffic control arrived, and whether aviation safety has worsened. The minister answered that the incidents are being investigated, that monitoring is ongoing, that the route design meets international standards, and that the airport will only open to commercial traffic once the break-in period is complete, without committing to new independent investigation.
There is no reason for additional investigation.
Er is dus geen aanleiding voor aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘IATA, slot op Schiphol kost Nederland banen’

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the minister about an IATA report claiming Schiphol's slot limit will cost Dutch jobs, and whether the findings and KLM's concerns are accurate. The minister said the IATA report was published without ministry involvement, pointed to forthcoming ministry-commissioned studies on Schiphol's economic importance, and promised to inform parliament later on the medium-term Schiphol decision.
These studies will be presented to the House shortly.
Deze studies worden binnenkort aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Kröger en Paternotte over het bericht 'Vliegers Lelystad slaan alarm'

MPs Bruins, Kröger and Paternotte asked about reports that general aviation firms at Lelystad Airport face job losses and forced flight cuts, and whether the cost-benefit analysis accounts for them. The minister denies that 300 jobs are at risk or that flights will be halved, says at most 30 jobs could move, and states the MKBA was done from a national perspective with job figures of about 2,000 direct jobs at the airport.
There is no question of halving the number of aircraft movements or of 300 jobs being at risk.
Van de halvering van het aantal vliegtuigbewegingen of 300 banen die op de tocht zouden staan is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automaatcode vervalt in Duitsland’

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch automatic-transmission driving licence codes would be affected by a German plan, whether similar changes were discussed in the Netherlands, and about exam volumes and CBR implementation capacity. The minister said the German plan does not remove the automatic code for automatic exams, that the EU directive does not allow deviation, and committed to raising the EU topic at the March committee and holding a consultation with the driving school sector.
I have therefore asked the European Commission to discuss this topic at the upcoming driving licence committee in March in Brussels.
Ik heb de Europese Commissie dan ook gevraagd om dit onderwerp op het eerstkomende rijbewijscomité in maart in Brussel te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat de ondergrond van treinen niet berekend is op snellere, langere en zwaardere treinen

CDA MP Amhaouch asked the minister whether ProRail's warning that rail subsoil cannot bear faster, longer and heavier trains is correct, and about investigations, maintenance, costs and urgency. The minister confirmed that some areas have weak subsoil, that safety is not currently at stake, and that a national track-stability study is expected by 2022, with a corridor-specific study due by summer 2020 and costs to be clarified mid-2020; many specifics were deferred.
I will inform your House about the outcomes and follow-up of both studies.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten en opvolging van beide onderzoeken informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Giessenbrug

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Giessenbrug bridge, which has not been opened for tall ships since 2017 and may remain unusable until a 2026 renovation, harming a nearby shipyard. The Minister confirmed Rijkswaterstaat decided to stop operating the bridge, that the waterway is effectively downgraded to 5.40 m clearance, and that no acceleration of the renovation is currently possible, though the government remains in talks with stakeholders.
At this moment I see no possibilities for accelerating the renovation of the bridge.
Op dit moment zie ik geen mogelijkheden tot versnelling van de renovatie van de brug.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de vertegenwoordigers van SATL en BTV zijn opgestapt uit het overleg van de klankbordgroep Luchtvaartnota 2020–2050

An MP asked the minister about reports that two resident groups (SATL and BTV) walked out of the Luchtvaartnota climate group, alleging a pre-cooked process, incomplete minutes and blocked statements. The minister rejected most criticisms, said the groups could speak and had their input considered, and offered to attach their statement to the minutes.
SATL and BTV were allowed to explain their statement but not to read it out in full at the climate group meeting of 26 November 2019.
SATL en BTV mochten hun verklaring wel toelichten maar niet integraal voorlezen tijdens de klankbordgroep van 26 november 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Van Toorenburg over legionella in afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about legionella at 81 wastewater treatment plants in Noord-Brabant, including who enforces, what has been done, whether the risk locations can be published, and whether companies protect workers. The minister answered that enforcement lies with municipalities and provinces via environmental services, that companies are expected to act, and that publication is the competent authorities' decision, with a model-letter process under way.

Whether enforcement actually takes place when companies do not voluntarily take measures is not known, because Omgevingsdienst NL has no view of the actions each individual environmental service has taken.

Of daadwerkelijk sprake is van handhaving indien bedrijven niet vrijwillig overgaan tot het nemen van maatregelen is niet bekend, omdat Omgevingsdienst NL geen zicht heeft op de acties die elke individuele omgevingsdienst heeft genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de berichten ‘Taxirijden op Schiphol, in ruil voor een envelop vol cash’ en ‘SchipholTaxi verliest kort geding tegen NRC’

MP Ziengs asked the ministers whether they knew of and found worrying press reports that Schiphol taxi drivers were pressured to pay cash for concessions, whether earlier complaints were handled, and whether investigation and safeguards against conflicts of interest are adequate. The ministers answered that Schiphol, as the responsible company, started its own investigation including the concession award, found no irregularities, and that the Marechaussee and Openbaar Ministerie are considering further steps.
