In consultation with the Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland, the Koninklijke Marechaussee is considering whether a preliminary investigation should be started based on the new information.
In overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland bekijkt de Koninklijke Marechaussee of er op basis van de nieuwe informatie een oriënterend onderzoek gestart dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat vrouwen meer kans hebben om bij een auto-ongeluk te overlijden

Labour MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a US study showing women face higher injury risk in car crashes applies to the Netherlands, and whether crash tests should be adapted to women. The minister answered that the US study cannot be directly applied to the Dutch situation, that existing tests already represent average women and smaller persons, and that the RDW is involved in regulation and dummy development.
The study is based on accident figures from the United States. That the conclusions are directly applicable to the Dutch situation cannot be said on the basis of this single American study.

Het onderzoek is gebaseerd op ongevalscijfers uit de Verenigde Staten. Dat de conclusies één op één toepasbaar zijn voor de Nederlandse situatie kan op basis van dit enkele Amerikaanse onderzoek niet worden gezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat en Gelderland botsen over bomenkap A28’

An SP MP asks the ministers about Rijkswaterstaat's plan to fell trees along the A28 on the Veluwe and whether municipalities and the province were surprised, with questions on the scale of felling, compensation, consultation and residents' input. The minister replies that the fire-corridor felling is postponed pending consultation with the municipalities, safety region and province, that only a limited set of trees is now being removed for traffic safety, that no direct consultation with residents took place as is usual for such maintenance projects, and that Parliament will be kept informed.
I will inform your House about the progress of the consultation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de voortgang van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Onderzoek: omrijden taxi en te veel rekenen is schering en inslag'

An MP asked the minister about a Taximonitor 2018 study of Amsterdam taxis showing frequent detours and overcharging, and about quality on the national taxi market. The minister replied that the Amsterdam findings are not representative nationally, that quality is primarily the industry's responsibility with local measures and enforcement improvements in preparation, and that approved taxi organisations are not given priority.
No comparable figures on the quality of taxi transport are available at national level.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen vergelijkbare cijfers beschikbaar over de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over de uitspraak van minister-president na afloop van de ministerraad op 29 november 2019 ‘de treinen rijden op steenkool, en ik ga dan vliegen’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about the Prime Minister's remark that trains run on coal while he flies, and whether the claim is accurate, plus the energy mix on the Den Haag–Madrid route and European high-speed rail coordination. The minister answered with 2017 Eurostat energy-mix figures for Belgium, France and Spain, said Dutch trains run on wind power, admitted other countries' electricity may partly be coal-based, and pledged to push international rail on the EU agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over emissieregistratie

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Dutch emissions register, including whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet are omitted from reporting and what this means for air quality and deposition figures. The minister answered that reporting follows the NEC Directive, which excludes aviation emissions outside the landing and take-off cycle, that the guidebook does not determine reporting scope, and deferred the exact emission amounts pending follow-up on a motion, while the answer to one question was delayed by third-party input.
On how I will implement this motion, I will inform you further.
Over de wijze waarop ik deze motie uitvoer, zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Postma over de dreigende hakbijl voor bomen in midden en zijbermen van A28 tussen Wezep en Nunspeet

MP De Pater-Postma (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about plans to clear trees along the A28 near Wezep and Nunspeet, including the 80-metre fire corridor and whether regional authorities were consulted. The Minister said the fire-corridor plans are postponed pending agreement with the municipalities, province and safety region, while urgent traffic-safety measures proceed.
Given the situation on the Veluwe, the Safety Region asked RWS for an 80-metre fire corridor.
Gezien de situatie op de Veluwe heeft de Veiligheidsregio RWS verzocht om een brandcorridor van 80 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Waterschap wil sterke visie op rivierverruiming na weer een afgeblazen project’

MP Van Brenk asked the minister why the Oosterhout dike relocation was dropped, what considerations drove that decision, and whether keeping a land reservation hinders area development. The minister explained the joint decision by the water board, province, municipality and the state to reinforce the existing dike, cited roughly 25 million euro extra cost and limited benefits, and said the reservation is kept for the long term with a Rijk-led river management programme under way.
Water board Rivierenland (project lead), the province of Gelderland, the municipality of Overbetuwe and the state jointly decided after the exploration to stick with reinforcing the current dike.

Het waterschap Rivierenland (trekker van het project), de provincie Gelderland, de gemeente Overbetuwe en het Rijk hebben na afronding van de verkenning gezamenlijk besloten om vast te houden aan het versterken van de huidige dijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer en Schonis over het bericht 'Veel meer ongevallen, veel minder politie op snelweg'

MPs Den Boer and Schonis asked ministers about a report linking reduced police presence on motorways to rising accidents, including the effectiveness of radar enforcement, the choice of enforcement locations, speed-trap apps, and seatbelt enforcement. The ministers acknowledged the rise in accidents and the importance of enforcement, but defended current enforcement practice, said no separate policy plan was needed, and promised modest follow-up such as the Analysetool Handhaving and trajectory controls.
The SWOV study 'Traffic enforcement on Dutch motorways' focuses on traffic enforcement.
Het onderzoek van SWOV «Verkeershandhaving op Nederlandse autosnelwegen» is gericht op de verkeershandhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het niet handhaven van het verbod op slapen in de vrachtwagen

An MP asks why the inspectorate (ILT) does not enforce the ban on truck drivers spending their weekly rest in the cabin, and asks about inspections, fines, staking orders and cabin standards. The minister answers that enforcement is structural since February 2018 but limited by evidence requirements, that no staking order can be issued for weekly rest in the cabin, and that cabin standards are not individually checked.
The ILT is exploring options to tackle the problem together with other parties.
De ILT verkent de mogelijkheden om het probleem samen met andere partijen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister, after reports that five other Dutch airports lack nature permits, how use permits relate to other required permits such as nature permits, and about the permitting history of Rotterdam, Lelystad and Maastricht airports. The minister answered that operators bear responsibility for obtaining other permits, that the ministry does not verify them, and that the Ministry of LNV is the competent authority for nature permits and handhavingsverzoeken, while promising to inform parliament further on the motion on high-altitude nitrogen emissions.
It is the responsibility of the operator to apply for these.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de exploitant om deze aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat 600 miljoen euro uit het Waddenfonds is uitgegeven zonder dat de natuur erop vooruit is gegaan

MP Wassenberg asked whether the Waddenfonds spent about 600 million euro on economic projects without measurable nature gains, and asked about monitoring, evaluation and reallocating remaining funds. The ministers answered that spending is balanced roughly 50/50 between nature and economy under the 2011 agreement, that nature indicators are still negative, and rejected a separate monitoring commission and new earmarking, while noting provinces may strengthen their oversight role.
Therefore there is no question of a payout of 600 million euros to economic projects.
Er is dus geen sprake van een uitkering van € 600 miljoen aan economische projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Het Waddenfonds als grabbelton’

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about press reports that the Waddenfonds lacks independent or central government oversight of subsidies and their results, and about possible conflicts of interest. The ministers answered that there is no direct central oversight because the fund is decentralised, that they stand by its policy, and that they will consider a specific grant mechanism via SiSa accountability to improve control.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) the provinces would then account to me annually for the spending charged to the specific grant.
Via SiSa (single information, single audit) leggen de provincies dan jaarlijks aan mij verantwoording af van de bestedingen ten laste van de specifieke uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over Het bericht ‘Vrachtwagenheffing op N264 blijft mogelijk als sluipverkeer toeneemt’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about residents' fears of more truck traffic on the N264 if a truck levy is introduced, and about the criteria, coordination and speed of adding roads to the levy network. The minister answers that no substantial diversion is expected on the N264, that roads are added based on model studies and regional consultation, that urgent additions can be made within days, and that consultation responses will be reported in mid-2020.
The truck levy bill is currently still in preparation.
Het wetsvoorstel vrachtwagenheffing is op dit moment nog in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over general aviation vanaf Lelystad Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the early opening of Lelystad Airport remains the government's aim, how users are kept informed, and about the status of a provincially led working track on relocating general aviation. The minister confirmed the opening plan, described monthly user consultations, and said the relocation question will be decided only after further capacity research, with the national government also having a role.
Only when these outcomes are available can it be determined whether, and if so which, agreements with general aviation are needed.
Pas wanneer deze uitkomsten beschikbaar zijn, kan worden bepaald of, en zo ja welke, afspraken met de GA nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht 'Boeren moeten het ontgelden, waterschapsbelasting omhoog'

MPs Dijkstra and Van den Bosch asked the ministers about a reported rise in water board taxes for farmers after a Supreme Court ruling on unpaved verges. The minister says water boards set their own rates democratically, that the ruling only redistributes costs within the unbuilt-property category, and that the ministers will inform parliament after the Unie van Waterschappen decides on further review.
The water boards will inform me about their decision-making.
De waterschappen zullen mij over hun besluitvorming informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “het uitgelekte marktonderzoek naar Lelystad Airport en de stelling van Wizz Air dat prijsvechters niet kunnen worden geweerd vanaf Lelystad Airport”

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked the minister about a leaked market study on Lelystad Airport and Wizz Air's claim that low-cost carriers cannot be excluded from it, and why the report was kept from parliament and leaked to the press. The minister answered that the study does not conclude that low-cost carriers will dominate, that EU rules prevent excluding non-Schiphol traffic, that the report was only finalised late and was sent to parliament at the same time as the letter, and that the government will push for revision of the EU slot regulation.
This report is now final and has been sent to the House of Representatives together with this letter.
Dit rapport is thans definitief en is tegelijkertijd met onderhavige brief aan de Tweede Kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Qatar Airways operates 9-minute flights between Maastricht and Liège’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported 9-minute Qatar Airways cargo flights between Maastricht and Liège and whether such short cargo flights should be banned. The minister confirmed the flights, said there are no other comparable cases, said the route choice is commercial, and stated that short cargo flights are undesirable from an environmental view but that no legal instrument to ban them exists, so the government will only encourage rail/road alternatives where realistic.
The Cabinet is working to encourage the use of ground transport as an alternative to air travel on routes where that is realistic.
Het Kabinet zet zich in om het gebruik van grondvervoer als alternatief voor luchtvaart te stimuleren op routes waarvoor dat reëel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over cargovluchten tussen Maastricht en Luik van 9 minuten

An MP asked the minister about Qatar Airways cargo flights between Maastricht and Liège lasting only 9 minutes and whether this is undesirable. The minister said such very short flights are undesirable from an environmental view, there is no legal instrument to ban them, the airline has confirmed it will stop them.
From an environmental point of view, I do not consider very short cargo flights desirable when good alternatives are available.
Vanuit het oogpunt van milieu vind ik zeer korte cargovluchten niet wenselijk wanneer er goede alternatieven voorhanden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Von Martels over mogelijk te hoge PFAS-waarden in strooizout

MPs De Pater-Postma and Von Martels asked whether PFAS contamination of road salt could endanger winter road gritting, whether expert follow-up research was planned, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that PFAS contamination of deep-mined salt is very unlikely, that current NEN standards do not include PFAS, that stocks for the coming winter are already purchased, and that no alternatives are needed.
As indicated in the answer to question 2, it is very unlikely that road salt, which is largely extracted from old and deep soil layers, is contaminated with PFAS.
Zoals bij het antwoord op vraag 2 is aangegeven, is het zeer onwaarschijnlijk dat strooizout dat veelal uit oude en diepe grondlagen wordt gewonnen, vervuild is met PFAS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'NS schrapt korting in de avondspits vanaf 2021'

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the minister about NS removing the evening-peak discount and changing senior rail subscriptions from 2021, arguing it worsens travel options and costs for older travellers. The minister replies that NS acts within its concession, that the 7 choice days for seniors are abolished for new customers and replaced by 3 flex days at EUR 39, and that the changes spread demand without disadvantaging one group.
Under the concession for the main rail network, NS has the responsibility to ensure a subscription offering that meets the wishes of different traveller groups.
Op grond van de concessie voor het hoofdrailnet heeft NS de verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor een abonnementenaanbod dat aansluit bij de wensen van verschillende reizigersgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘MSC Zoe: nog 2 containers en een regeling te gaan’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the shipping company MSC has paid only part of the cleanup and damage costs from the MSC Zoe container loss, nearly eleven months later, and when legal instruments would be used. The minister answered that roughly 2.86 million euros in claims has been filed, about 0.93 million has been paid, negotiations continue, no end date is committed to, and legal action is not yet warranted.
I think some time is still needed for this and I do not want to commit to an end date.
Ik denk dat hier nog enige tijd voor nodig is en wil mij niet vastleggen op een einddatum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over milieucriminaliteit

Two D66 MPs asked ministers about environmental crime, covering police expertise, illegal bird trapping and eel poaching, illegal waste transport, subsidy and manure fraud, and air-gun regulation. The government answered that police capacity is adequate, that some enforcement data are not registered or fall under provincial responsibility, and that a bill requiring permits for high-power air guns is nearly ready.
Control over bird trapping has been the responsibility of the provinces since 2017, so I will not give a picture or figures on this.
De controle op het vangen van vogels ligt sinds 2017 bij de provincies, daarom zal ik hier geen beeld of cijfers voor gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de mogelijkheid om de trein naar de klimaattop in Madrid te gaan

An MP asked the minister whether a special climate train could be organised to the Madrid climate summit, including a sleeper train option, and whether the obstacles could be mapped. The minister answered that a direct or reduced-transfer train was not feasible on this short notice, due to missing compatible rolling stock, Spain's different track gauge, and the operational complexity across four countries.
A direct train to Madrid turns out not to be possible, and a train with fewer transfers also brings such complex problems within this timeframe that, unfortunately, this is not feasible either.
Een directe trein naar Madrid blijkt niet mogelijk en ook een trein met minder overstappen brengt op deze termijn dusdanig complexe problemen met zich mee dat ook dit helaas niet uitvoerbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: ‘Ontgassen moet snel kunnen’

An MP asked the minister about the shortage of gas-venting installations for vessels, the ban on venting on the water in densely populated areas under the ADN, and how to enforce it and define the status of cargo vapours. The minister said a nationwide ban is desired via the CDNI amendment, enforcement applies in clearly densely populated areas, and a pragmatic treatment of vapours as residual products is being pursued pending a task force.
I share your view that a ban on venting should apply throughout the Netherlands.
Ik deel uw mening dat er in heel Nederland een verbod op ontgassen moet komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Sluis in Lith dicht door achterstallig onderhoud zeggen schippers die nu moeten omvaren’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the closure of a lock at Lith due to deferred maintenance, the detours for shipping, and the shortage of mooring places nationwide. The minister answered that an emergency repair is underway with completion planned for 29 January 2020, that mooring capacity is addressed via the MIRT and the NMCA, and that port quality is the responsibility of port managers, usually municipalities.
An emergency repair is currently being carried out on one of the two lock chambers of Lith lock.
Er wordt op dit moment een spoedreparatie uitgevoerd aan één van de twee sluiskolken van sluis Lith.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het schrappen van de korting in de avondspits door de NS

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS may unilaterally scrap the evening-peak discount on its off-peak subscription, and why rewards rather than penalties are not used to encourage off-peak travel. The minister replied that NS is responsible under the main rail concession for offering subscriptions suited to different traveller groups, that the change is offset by weekend and off-peak discounts, and that the minister sees no need to speak with NS again.
Given the commercial confidentiality of the relevant data, it is not possible to provide a numerical basis for the number of travellers.
Het is, gelet op de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de betreffende gegevens, niet mogelijk om een cijfermatige onderbouwing van de hoeveelheid reizigers te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat vogels doof en agressief worden van vliegvelden

An MP asked the ministers whether a study showing that aircraft noise may make wild birds near airports deaf and aggressive would be incorporated into noise limits, environmental impact assessments, Schiphol growth decisions and the decision to open Lelystad Airport, and whether a new assessment was needed. The minister replied that the study is limited and does not show large-scale harm, so its results will not be used in policy or environmental impact reports, and that the Lelystad Airport environmental assessment is sufficient and will not be redone.
As indicated in the answer to questions 4 to 7, this study gives no reason to include its results in new policy or in the environmental impact reports to be drawn up.
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op de vragen 4 t/m 7 geeft dit onderzoek geen aanleiding om resultaten te betrekken bij nieuw beleid of op te stellen milieueffectrapportages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘verzekeraar MSC Zoe weigert vervolgschade te betalen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the insurer of shipping company MSC refuses to pay for later-washed-ashore debris from the MSC Zoe, whether Rijkswaterstaat is closing its claims desk, and why its claims were reduced. The minister denied that MSC is frustrating settlement, said the company was already told it is liable, said the claims desk stays open until adequate agreements exist, and explained that a EUR 483,000 claim reduction followed an error over the Arca vessel's costs.
Yes, I informed the shipowner of this shortly after the disaster.
Ja, ik heb de reder dit kort na de ramp al laten weten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vismigratie barrières

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fish migration barriers, including whether only 35% of fish passage facilities work, whether maintenance is secured, and whether KRW targets for 2027 can be met. The Minister disputed the 35% figure, reported that 66% of evaluated facilities function well, said water managers handle testing and maintenance, and stated that not all barriers need removing for a healthy fish stock.
I do not recognise the figure of only 35% of fish migration facilities working.
Het getal van slechts 35% werkende vismigratievoorzieningen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over de berichten ‘Smith: Air France en KLM nog meer integreren’ en ‘France Hits Out at Dutch in Feud Over Air France-KLM Holdings’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about press reports that Air France-KLM's CEO wants further integration and about a French official's public demand that the Netherlands choose between its holding and KLM stakes, including how KLM's position, jobs, foundations and state guarantees are protected. The minister answered that the government will monitor the agreements and guarantees, that the Franch-Dutch working group is ongoing, and that he will not disclose talks or comment on specific operational matters because Air France-KLM is listed.
Beyond that, I will not go into the content of the talks, as in my view this does not serve the talks.
Verder ga ik niet in op de inhoud van de gesprekken in de werkgroep, dit komt mijns inziens de gesprekken niet ten goede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Een ongeluk waar je niets van leert’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a 2018 helicopter training accident involving the Coast Guard's SAR contractor, the unreported incident, and unclear inspection and safety responsibilities across ILT, Inspectie SZW and contractors. The government answered that the accident was reported by the worker, that an inspection into the employer's failure to report will be started, and that responsibilities are divided among several inspectorates, while rejecting claims of unacceptable shortcomings.
ISZW will launch an investigation into this.
Er wordt door ISZW een onderzoek hiernaar ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Giessenbrug 10 jaar dicht: schippers eisen reparatie’

An MP asked the minister why the Giessenbrug, closed to river traffic over 5.40 m since 2017, will not be renovated until 2026 and whether this can be accelerated, and what the economic and transport consequences are. The minister replied that the bridge cannot safely be operated, that renovation is programmed for 2026 with no acceleration possible for now, that economic effects are not precisely known, and that the government stays alert to accelerating the project.
Nevertheless, I remain alert to opportunities to accelerate implementation, should these present themselves.
Toch blijf ik alert op mogelijkheden om de uitvoering te versnellen, mochten deze zich aandienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over veranderingen voor het huidige vliegverkeer vanaf Lelystad Airport

An MP asked how general aviation users at Lelystad Airport would be affected by the arrival of holiday charter flights, including compensation, the new control zone rules from 7 November, flight plan requirements and consultation. The minister said forced relocation and compensation are not needed for now, that the airspace changes follow ICAO timelines, that control charges are deferred, and that the aviation sector was consulted and will be kept informed.
Regarding the increase in charges, I have decided for the time being not to levy a charge for tower services on users of Lelystad Airport.
Voor wat betreft de lastenverhoging heb ik besloten om vooralsnog géén heffing voor de (toren)dienstverlening in rekening te brengen bij de gebruikers van luchthaven Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Randstad bij vuilste gebieden Europa: 'Ik zou wonen in Amsterdam zeker niet aanraden''

MPs Paternotte asked whether residents near Schiphol face three times the health risk from air pollution and noise of residents in Groningen and Drenthe, what measures address this, and whether groei should wait for health measures and a clean-air action plan. The minister answered that the relative risk difference is about 1.6, outlined existing noise and emission criteria, the Hinderbeperking convenant, RIVM ultrafine dust research, and that growth is tied to demonstrable reduction of hindrance in the LVB-2 and an action plan expected by end 2019.
In addition, in 2017 the Ministry of IenW commissioned RIVM to carry out a research programme into the health effects of exposure to ultrafine particles from aviation.

Daarnaast heeft het Ministerie van IenW in 2017 aan het RIVM opdracht gegeven om een onderzoeksprogramma uit te voeren naar de gezondheidseffecten van blootstelling aan ultrafijn stof uit de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over niet meer kunnen blussen door een vrijwillige brandweerman vanwege extreme wachttijden Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP asked why a volunteer firefighter faces long CBR waiting times for license renewal, whether he must pay extra for an urgent procedure, and how many people receive such a fee letter. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that CDE holders get priority and that urgent applications cost about 35 euro at the municipality but can sometimes be reimbursed by the CBR; the CBR sends no such fee letter.
The CBR does not charge for the urgent procedure and does not send a letter about it.
Het CBR rekent geen kosten voor de spoedprocedure, en stuurt hier ook geen brief over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel ‘De e-truck komt, maar het duurt wel even voor hij zijn dieselneef inhaalt’

An MP from D66 asked the minister about an article and ING report saying electric trucks will only be cost-competitive with diesel around 2028, and asked about subsidies, the truck toll, hydrogen and biofuels. The government answered that the market is hard to predict, pointed to existing subsidies (DKTI), a EUR 94 million scheme to 2025, the planned truck toll with possible lower rates later, and a future hydrogen covenant, but made no binding commitments beyond ongoing work.
Of course I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van de Raad van State vragen ingediend over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het PAS

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she meant a legal 'trick' (list) to get around the Council of State's ruling on the PAS, and how this squares with respect for the judiciary. The minister says the government is researching how to implement the ruling within legal requirements, without intending to evade it, and refuses to retract the remark, calling it a popular expression not to be taken literally.
Within the framework of the Council of State's ruling, executive choices must be made that do justice to both the letter and the spirit of the ruling.
Binnen het kader van de uitspraak van de Raad van State zijn uitvoerende keuzes te maken die recht moeten doen aan zowel de letter als de geest van de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht “Supersnelle elektrische fietsen winnen snel aan populariteit”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising speed-pedelec popularity, accident numbers, expected growth, safety of mixed speeds on cycle paths and roads, and the rules applying to them. The minister answered with 2017-2018 accident counts, a commissioned SWOV deep-dive due in 2020, statistics on registrations, and that existing rules and consultations with stakeholders are being maintained, while no separate vehicle category is planned.
To gain more insight into the road safety of speed-pedelecs, I am having SWOV carry out an in-depth study of accidents involving speed-pedelecs.
Om meer inzicht in de verkeersveiligheid van speed-pedelecs te krijgen, laat ik SWOV een diepteonderzoek doen naar ongevallen met speed-pedelecs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Schiphol heeft al jaren geen natuurvergunning: '100.000 vluchten illegaal'’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked whether Schiphol lacks a nature permit under the Wet natuurbescherming, how NOx from flights is calculated, which Natura 2000 areas are unaffected, and whether a 2008 growth decision and flight increases required an appropriate assessment under the Habitats Directive. The minister answers that Schiphol has no Wnb permit because the framework predates the 2004 reference date, that a new nitrogen recalculation and MER are pending, and that the LVB procedure is ongoing, with the enforcement question referred to LNV.

The Ministry of LNV, as the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, received an enforcement request concerning Schiphol and the question of whether, and to what extent, Schiphol must hold a Wnb permit.

Het Ministerie van LNV heeft, als bevoegd gezag voor de Wet natuurbescherming, een handhavingsverzoek gekregen met betrekking tot Schiphol en de vraag of, en zo ja, in hoeverre Schiphol over een Wnb-vergunning dient te beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over het handhavingsverzoek van Mobilisation for the Environment met betrekking tot Schiphol en de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the minister about an enforcement request by Mobilisation for the Environment claiming Schiphol lacks a Wet natuurbescherming permit and that about 100,000 flights are illegal. The minister answered that Schiphol holds no Wnb permit, that the ministry of LNV, as competent authority, will assess the request, and that details on emissions and nitrogen deposition will follow via a new calculation and the MER for the revised airport decree.
In the context of the enforcement request, the Ministry of LNV will gather the necessary information and request views.
Het Ministerie van LNV zal in het kader van het handhavingsverzoek de benodigde informatie verzamelen en zienswijzen opvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger en Van Raan over het bericht dat provinciale staten van Overijssel zich niet serieus genomen voelen door de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdD asked whether air traffic from 7 November 2019 must use the B+ routes to and from Lelystad Airport, why these routes are opened before expansion is certain, and whether the minister will heed Overijssel's call to drop low-flying routes. The minister confirmed that an inregelperiode starts on 7 November for existing small aviation only, stressed the B+ routes are the least noisy option, and declined to postpone, pointing to consultations and planned route improvements.
The routes are not open to commercial traffic because the political decision-making on that has not yet been completed.
De routes zijn niet open voor handelsverkeer want de politieke besluitvorming daarover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Schiphol is niet de enige: ook 5 andere Nederlandse vliegvelden missen natuurvergunning’

MPs Bruins, Amhaouch and Paternotte asked whether five regional Dutch airports lack the nature permit (natuurvergunning) for their activities, and what that means for their operation. The minister answered that four of the airports have no Wnb permit while Groningen Eelde has a 2009 permit, that enforcement requests are pending at the Ministry of LNV, and that she will not anticipate those outcomes, referring to the environmental impact assessments and prior decisions for each airport.
These enforcement requests have been taken up by the Minister of LNV, the competent authority under the Wnb, and are being handled under the usual procedure.
Deze handhavingsverzoeken zijn door de Minister van LNV, het bevoegd gezag voor de Wnb, in behandeling genomen en worden volgens de gebruikelijke procedure afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht 'Seawatch3 alweer bijna bij Libië'

Two VVD MPs asked why the Sea-Watch 3 sailed again despite safety rules not being met, whether it could be blocked, and whether migrants would be accepted. The minister replied that the ship must meet the rules before rescuing, Sea-Watch is responsible for incidents, the ship was not informed in advance, Tunisia was the nearest safe port, and the Netherlands no longer takes over migrants from such ships.
I made a moral appeal to Sea-Watch to only sail again once the ship and crew meet the safety and crew requirements set out in the regulation.
Ik heb een moreel beroep gedaan op Sea-Watch om pas weer uit te varen als het schip en de bemanning voldoen aan de veiligheids- en bemanningseisen die zijn gesteld in de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Schonis over het bericht 'Mogelijk 14 miljard minder aan woningbouw en wegen door stikstofuitspraak'

MPs Van Eijs and Schonis asked about reports that the Council of State's PAS ruling could cost the construction sector billions, including whether provinces paused nature permits, how many homes are affected, and how the ADC test applies to housing. The minister answers that permitting has resumed step by step, that roughly 25,000 homes are affected though projects are not halted, and that an overview of affected infrastructure projects will follow.
The Minister of IenW will inform the House before the MIRT consultation about the consequences of the PAS ruling for national infrastructure projects.
De Minister van IenW zal de Kamer voorafgaand aan het Nota-overleg MIRT informeren over de gevolgen van de PAS-uitspraak voor de nationale infrastructuur projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Paternotte, Amhaouch en Remco Dijkstra over het gestaakte overleg tussen het ministerie en Noord-Veluwse gemeenten over vliegroutevarianten

MPs asked why the Noord-Veluwe municipalities stopped consultation on Lelystad Airport flight-route variants, and whether any variant avoids overflying the largest towns. The minister rejects the claim of a stopped consultation, says the variants do reduce overflown residents, and states a preference for route variant N for runway 23, though the document is cut off before its final answers are complete.
There is therefore no question of a halt to the consultation.
Van het staken van overleg is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over aan Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gerelateerde kosten van Nederlanders met een migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the government to quantify the infrastructure and water management costs attributable to (non-Western) immigrants, their share relative to population and revenues, and a breakdown over past, current and projected years. The minister replied that Infrastructure and Water Management does not classify costs by migration background, as in 2009, and referred to a covering letter for the sixth question.

In the answer to the questions of 17 July 2009 it was indicated that Infrastructure and Water Management does not apply a breakdown of costs by citizens with a (non-Western/Western) migration background.
In het antwoord op de vragen van 17 juli 2009 is aangegeven dat Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen indeling in kosten naar burgers met een (niet-westerse/westerse) migratieachtergrond hanteert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Schonis en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Italy holds Netherlands, EU ‘responsible’ for migrant boat’

MPs asked the government about Italy holding the Netherlands and the EU responsible for migrants aboard the Sea-Watch 3, about Dutch obligations under the SAR convention, and about progress on a structural EU solution for disembarkation. The minister answered that Netherlands requested a port and asked the Commission to coordinate, that primary SAR responsibility lies with the state of the rescue zone, that no structural solution has yet been found, and that the government keeps pressing for one.
The cabinet will continue to press for a mechanism in which as large a group as possible, if not all member states, takes its responsibility.
Het kabinet zal blijven aandringen op een mechanisme waarin een zo groot mogelijke groep, zo niet alle lidstaten, haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aan de gemeente Eijsden-Margraten vanwege de aanhoudende overlast van vliegveld Luik-Bierset

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the minister's visit to Eijsden-Margraten over noise from Liège-Bierset airport has not produced concrete relief, and presses on the 2013 airspace change, the Belgian air traffic control agreements and the Luchtvaartnota. The minister replies that an expert group with Belgian authorities will explore measures to return night-time noise near Eijsden toward pre-2013 levels, that a detailed analysis and monitoring show improvement but not yet stable results, and that reversing the airspace change is not feasible for safety reasons.
An agreement has been reached with the Belgian authorities to set up a joint expert group to explore and develop concrete options for improvement.
Met de Belgische autoriteiten is afgesproken om een gezamenlijke expertgroep te starten om concrete mogelijkheden voor verbetering te verkennen en uit te werken.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra inzake het nieuwsbericht ‘Drones van klimaatactivisten weigeren op te stijgen bij Heathrow’

An MP asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Justice about reports that climate-activist drones disrupted flights at Heathrow, and whether similar action could occur in the Netherlands and how it would be prevented and sanctioned. The minister answered that such actions cannot be ruled out, pointed to upcoming EU drone rules, registration and identification requirements, a counter-drone knowledge programme, existing fines up to 7,800 euro, and a commitment to keep the policy under review.
It cannot be ruled out that actions by climate activists with drones at and around airports could also take place in the Netherlands.
Het valt niet uit te sluiten dat er ook in Nederland acties van klimaatactivisten met drones op en rondom luchthavens kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en De Pater-Postma over de video 'CBR belt  politie voor vechtpartij en nu gaan we de mail van de directeur platleggen'

MPs Schonis and De Pater-Postma asked the minister about a video alleging CBR delays in medical fitness checks for young drivers, the one-year validity of theory certificates, and compensation. The minister said CBR assessments are legally required, the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing the list of conditions, compensation options are under study, and the theory certificate validity will not be extended.
I do not have exact figures.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Gijs van Dijk over een spoortunnel naar Ameland

An MP asked the minister whether a rail tunnel to Ameland is a serious option, why it is considered, and how residents and nature groups can influence ferry access, and whether a separate fast link for pedestrians and cyclists or baggage handling research is planned. The minister replied that a long-term vision after 2029 is being developed with regional parties, a first elaboration of three directions is due end 2019, a preferred scenario may be chosen around 2024, and no separate pedestrian link or baggage study is currently needed.
At the end of 2019 I will be presented with the first elaboration of the mentioned directions.
Eind 2019 wordt mij de eerste uitwerking van de genoemde denkrichtingen aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over het bericht 'Concrete aanpak stikstof kan maanden duren’

MPs Bromet and Kröger asked the government about a report that a concrete nitrogen (stikstof) plan could take months, and about speed limits, livestock farms near Natura 2000 areas, natural restoration measures, the AERIUS calculator and missing permits for airports. The ministers answered that a area-based approach and a threshold for small projects will be prepared, with a package by year-end, but gave few numbers and deferred several points (speed-limit effects, farm counts, airport permits, AERIUS scope) to later dates.
The cabinet will come by the end of the year with a worked-out package on the basis of which decision-making can take place at the start of the new year.
Het kabinet komt voor het einde van het jaar met een uitgewerkt pakket op basis waarvan in het begin van het nieuwe jaar besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken–de Haan over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid op de A79 bij Meerssen naar 90 km/u.'

MPs Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked why the speed limit on the A79 near Meerssen was reportedly lowered to 90 km/h, whether this reflected poor road maintenance, and how long it would last. The minister answered that no lasting speed reduction applies; a temporary 90 km/h decision was wrongly taken and will be withdrawn, a slippery-road sign was placed instead, and maintenance is scheduled for a specific night subject to weather.
This decision turns out to be incorrect and will be withdrawn.
Dit besluit blijkt onjuist en zal worden ingetrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over “de alternatieve luchtvaartnota van Natuur & Milieu, Greenpeace en Natuur en Milieufederatie Noord-Holland, waaruit blijkt dat krimp van de luchtvaart onvermijdelijk is.”

MP Van Raan asks the government whether it endorses the claims in an alternative aviation policy paper by environmental NGOs, including that aviation must shrink, that technical measures are insufficient, and that health and noise harms and nitrogen deposition require action. The minister answers that the government pursues a broad mix of climate instruments, will assess volumes via the PlanMER, does not endorse all claims (e.g., on economic importance), and will consider the paper's ideas in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota without committing to a shrinkage scenario.
The government's approach is primarily aimed at achieving the necessary emission reductions through this route.
De inzet van het kabinet is er primair op gericht om via deze weg de benodigde emissiereducties te realiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het uitblijven van een akkoord met de Franse Staat over het waarborgen van de Nederlandse publieke belangen na de aandelenaankoop van Air France-KLM

Two MPs (D66) asked why the agreed June 2019 target for a deal with the French state on guarantees and protecting Dutch public interests after the Air France-KLM share purchase was missed, and about the Aigle Azur bid and convertible bond. Minister Hoekstra replied that a working group is in place, talks are complex and confidential, the state exercises shareholder rights, it declined to discuss the Aigle Azur case as price-sensitive, and it did not subscribe to the convertible bond.
This may concern price-sensitive information, so the substance of this case cannot be addressed.
Dit betreft mogelijk koersgevoelige informatie, dus op de inhoud van deze casus kan niet worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over meer vaart maken met de veiligheid van industriecomplex Chemelot

An MP asked the minister why the Safety Board's 2018 recommendations on Chemelot industrial site safety had not yet been adopted and whether they would be implemented with a timeline. The government answered that it takes the recommendations seriously, has been in talks with the Safety Board, and will determine with the Board what legal changes are needed, linked to the Omgevingswet, without giving a firm date.
The recommendations of the Safety Board are very important to me and I certainly take them seriously.
De aanbevelingen van de Onderzoeksraad zijn voor mij zeer belangrijk en neem ik zeker serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Slecht wegdek: A77 van Rijkevoort richting Duitsland tot dinsdagochtend afgesloten, ook daarna hinder'

An MP asked the minister about the closure of the A77 towards Germany near Rijkevoort due to a defective expansion joint, its cause, repair timeline, and effects on residents, logistics and emergency services. The minister answered that the closure and detours were explained, the Gennep exit reopened on 23 September, and repairs are planned until around February 2020.
In the period until the end of November, the carriageway towards Germany will be repaired.
In de periode tot eind november zal de rijrichting richting Duitsland worden hersteld.
Antwoord op van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de geplande kap van gezonde bomen langs de A9

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked why thousands of healthy trees must be felled along the A9 for widening and a relocated fuel station, whether this fits climate and nitrogen rules, and about fuel station lease terms. The minister confirms awareness, explains the tree removal is tied to widening and the rest-stop relocation with one-for-one compensation planned, says the fuel station is a relocation not an addition, cites a 15-year lease, and states the nitrogen (PAS) rules do not apply because no Natura 2000 area lies along the route.
It has been demonstrated that widening the A9 has no effect on nitrogen deposition in Botshol.
Aangetoond is dat de verbreding van de A9 geen invloed heeft op de stikstofdepositie in Botshol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over de buitensporige subsidie van de luchtvaartsector

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked the government about claimed excessive subsidies to the aviation sector, including tax treatment of kerosene, Schiphol's accessibility costs, WTO rulings on Airbus and Boeing, and airport charges. The minister disputed the subsidy calculation, provided partial figures and data on Schiphol-related spending, and promised a forthcoming overview of external costs of aviation.
Question 2: Do you endorse the subsidy of 86.29 euros per person calculated in this article?
Vraag 2 Onderschrijft u de in dit artikel berekende subsidie van 86,29 euro per persoon
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat aan Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the minister's visit to Maastricht Aachen Airport, the handling of complaints, extended opening hours, runway length, and public funding. The minister answered that the visit was informal, that noise and night-flight effects are being assessed in the PlanMER, that there is no decision to extend opening hours, and that many matters are the responsibility of the province, the municipality or others.
This is a matter for the owner of the airport, i.e. the province of Limburg, and the operator.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van de eigenaar van de luchthaven i.c. de provincie Limburg en de exploitant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Tijdens vakantie gekochte e-step kan duur uitpakken, waarschuwen verzekeraars’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about electric scooters bought abroad that insurers say cannot be insured, and about their regulation and harmonisation with other countries. The minister acknowledged the insurance problem, pointed to the 2019 interim approval framework and a pending definitive one, and said Netherlands advocates EU-level harmonisation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de gevolgen van lachgas in het verkeer

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about rising nitrous oxide (lachgas) use among drivers, its effects, casualty figures, enforcement options and whether recreational use should be banned. The state secretary answered that casualty data are not available, that existing criminal and CBR administrative tools can already be used, that a risk assessment is pending, and that a youth awareness campaign is planned, but did not fully answer the deadline request.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen door Chemours

An MP asked the state secretary about Chemours' emissions of GenX, including whether permits should reflect the company's pledged 99 percent cut, whether residents can be blood-tested, whether Chemours should pay investigation costs, and whether national standards are needed to transport contaminated soil. The government answered that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority and has already lowered permitted GenX emissions, that blood testing was offered after a parliamentary motion, and that interim national soil standards were set in July 2019.
The competent authority for this company, the province of Zuid-Holland, has already lowered the permitted GenX emissions several times since 2017.
Het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, de provincie Zuid-Holland, heeft de vergunde uitstoot van GenX sinds 2017 al meerdere keren verlaagd.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco  Dijkstra over het bericht 'Natuurorganisaties willen weten: waar blijft de schadevergoeding voor de aangespoelde containers?’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why shipping company MSC has been slow to pay damages for the containers lost from the MSC Zoe and the cleanup costs, nine months after the loss. The minister answers that MSC must fully compensate the damage, that about 1.93 million euro in claims remain open, that negotiations are ongoing toward a settlement, and that legal instruments are the fallback if talks fail.
My preference still is to reach an amicable agreement with MSC.
Mijn voorkeur gaat nog steeds uit om er langs minnelijke weg met MSC uit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Omwonenden niet blij met gang van zaken rondom Paddepoelsterbrug’

An MP asked why a temporary replacement bridge for the Paddepoelsterbrug is taking so long, whether a temporary ferry or nearby bridge is considered, the safety assessment, and timing of a permanent bridge and public participation. The minister answered that agreement on a temporary high bridge was reached in June 2019 with €1.5 million, location is still being determined with residents, a ferry option is under review, and the MIRT process for a permanent solution will start with a preferred alternative expected in Q2 2021.
I am committed to running this process as quickly as possible.
Ik zet mij in om dit proces zo snel mogelijk te doorlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de race naar de bodem van beveiligers op Schiphol

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked whether Schiphol's security tender, split among seven companies and excluding the sector CAO, risks a race to the bottom on security guards' pay and whether the state as shareholder should intervene. The minister replied that Schiphol's management is responsible for operations and labour conditions, that he will not pressure Schiphol, and gave Schiphol's reasons for multiple contractors and quality-based awarding.
It is not for me to call Schiphol to account on this.
Het is niet aan mij om Schiphol hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de uitspraak van de Raad van State inzake het Tracébesluit A27/A12

MP Kröger asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Council of State's annulment of the A27/A12 route decision following the PAS ruling, including emission reduction, alternatives to road widening, the 80 km/h speed option, project costs and the fate of funds and other projects. The Minister confirms the annulment flows from the PAS ruling, says work will continue on a new route decision, rules out a safe 80 km/h option within the existing trench, and gives a partial account of costs and affected projects.

Within the project objectives and the requirements of nature legislation, work will therefore continue on a solution to the nitrogen problem for the Ring Utrecht, and I am preparing a new route decision.

Binnen de projectdoelstellingen en de eisen van de natuurwetgeving zal daarom verder gewerkt worden aan een oplossing voor de stikstofproblematiek voor de Ring Utrecht en bereid ik een nieuw Tracébesluit voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over aanrijdingen met wild

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about wildlife road collisions, including under-reporting, registration gaps across provinces, and whether provinces can improve reporting. The minister replied that estimates suggest about 10,000 collisions a year, that registration is fragmented and decentralised to provinces, and that she will consult provinces on improving reporting and include collisions in the wildlife management evaluation.
I will consult with the provinces to examine how reporting of wildlife collisions can be improved.
Ik zal mij met de provincies verstaan om te bezien hoe de aanmeldingen met aangereden wild kunnen worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dam over het bericht 'Sneek calls for speed-up of road-building project'

An MP asked about reports that the Cherry Tree Road renovation on Sint Eustatius is delayed and whether the road network will be maintained long-term. The government confirms a delay caused by a dispute over cement type, sets a new completion date of March 2020, and says a maintenance plan for 2020-2023 will follow in autumn.

Between the public body and the contractor, new agreements have also been made on the conditions under which the contractor may still complete the project, with a delayed completion date of March 2020 at the latest.

Tussen het openbaar lichaam en de aannemer zijn daarnaast nieuwe afspraken gemaakt over de voorwaarden waaronder de aannemer het project alsnog, met een vertraagde opleverdatum van uiterlijk maart 2020, mag afmaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de zandoverlast op de Markerwaarddijk

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about repeated closures of the Markerwaarddijk due to sand drifting, the choice to use sand in the dike reinforcement despite the known risk, alternatives considered, economic impact, and how closures will be prevented. The Minister acknowledged the problem, explained the cost, ecological and sustainability reasons for the mixed sand-stone design and the alternatives assessed in the environmental impact report, and said an extra layer of soil is being applied with completion expected in October.
The economic consequences of the road closure for the region are not known to me.
De economische gevolgen van de wegafsluiting voor de regio zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Roep om afschaffing CBR-keuring voor autisten: ‘Het is gewoon een verdienmodel’’

An MP asked the minister to respond to reports calling for abolishing the CBR medical fitness test for drivers with autism, which critics see as a revenue model. The minister explained that the test for first-time applicants with ASS stays under the Gezondheidsraad-based rules, that a broader review of the medical fitness system is underway with results expected mid-2020, and that she will engage with the Dutch autism association.
It is unknown how many people with ASS hold a driving licence.
Het is onbekend hoeveel mensen met ASS een rijbewijs hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether new PFAS rules for soil and dredged material would further delay road and housing projects, and how the government would address the concerns of municipalities and industry. The state secretary replied that the temporary framework adds clarity rather than new obligations, that the duty of care applies where PFAS is found, that she is consulting with regional authorities and will inform the House in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ’Volkerak-Zoommeer op de grens van Zeeland en Brabant wordt al vóór 2030 zout’

An MP asked the minister whether the Volkerak-Zoommeer will become saline before 2030, whether it is ecologically thriving, and what consultation and safeguards exist. The minister replied that no decision has been taken, that the lake is part of a PAGW long list still under discussion, and that a decision would only follow an environmental impact assessment and cost-benefit analysis with stakeholder involvement.

The decision on possibly making the Volkerak-Zoommeer saline again will not be taken by me until the costs and effects have been determined on the basis of an environmental impact assessment and a (social) cost-benefit analysis.

Het besluit over het eventueel weer zout maken van het Volkerak-Zoommeer zal ik niet eerder nemen dan nadat op basis van een milieueffectrapportage en een (maatschappelijke) kosten-batenanalyse de kosten en effecten hiervan zijn bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat Schiphol deals sluit met omliggende gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Schiphol's agreements with neighbouring municipalities on noise and environmental nuisance were a divide-and-rule strategy that sidelined other municipalities. The minister replied that Schiphol was asked to work on a noise-reduction plan and an Omgevingsfonds with its surroundings, that the ministry is not involved in Schiphol's commitments to municipalities, and that it cannot judge their legal validity, promising to inform parliament later in the autumn.
My ministry is not involved in commitments that Schiphol does or does not make to the municipalities in the surroundings in that context.
Mijn ministerie is niet betrokken bij toezeggingen die Schiphol in dat kader al dan niet doet aan de gemeenten in de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Brexit-alarm: koop svp inwisselbaar vliegticket'

Member Paternotte (D66) asked the minister whether travellers around the Brexit date should be advised to buy refundable tickets, what a no-deal Brexit would mean for passengers, whether a bilateral aviation agreement is needed, and about preparations and information provision. The minister declined to advise refundable tickets, pointed to EU contingency regulation and existing passenger refund rights, said no bilateral aviation treaty is needed, and left traveller information to the travel sector.
Your House has been informed several times about the contingency measures taken at EU level and by the Netherlands.
Uw Kamer is verschillende malen geïnformeerd over de contingency maatregelen die in EU-verband en door Nederland zijn getroffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht dat er weer een frontale botsing op de N36 heeft plaatsgevonden

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether she shares the view that measures taken on the N36 are inadequate after another head-on collision, and whether she will act quickly and ask the province of Overijssel to contribute. The minister answers that one year is too short to judge the effect of the road-layout measures, that Rijkswaterstaat will review accident data over three years, and that a behavioural campaign is being developed with the regional road safety body.
A period of one year is therefore too short for me to make well-founded statements at this time about the effect of the measures taken on the road layout.
De periode van een jaar vind ik daarom te kort om op dit moment gefundeerde uitspraken te doen over het effect van de genomen maatregelen voor de weginrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Smalle A7 bij Marum zorgt voor hachelijke situaties’

An MP asked the minister whether the narrowed A7 near Marum, with two-way traffic on one lane, is dangerous, how many accidents occurred, and whether the design followed Rijkswaterstaat guidelines. The minister answered that nine accidents occurred in the period, causation could not yet be established, the CROW guideline was followed, and the works finished on schedule at the end of August.
At this moment it cannot be established whether there is a link between the accidents and the works.
Op dit moment is niet vast te stellen of er een verband is tussen de ongevallen en de werkzaamheden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over de berichten ‘Havengebied dreigt een warzone te worden’, ‘Wordt ruimte straks de grote uitdaging voor Amsterdam?’ en ‘Kock wil verzelfstandiging havenbedrijf

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports on tensions between the Amsterdam port and housing plans, and about the municipality's 100% ownership of the port company. The minister answered that the port is of national importance, that the municipality as sole shareholder is responsible for its ownership, and that Rijk and region coordinate on infrastructure and housing without committing to a concrete new step.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam, as 100% shareholder, to give proper form to its ownership of Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam als 100% aandeelhouder om op een goede manier invulling te geven aan haar eigenaarschap van het Havenbedrijf Amsterdam N.V.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht in het Noord-Hollands Dagblad op 9 juli 2019  ‘Vernieuwing Leeghwaterbrug opnieuw maanden vertraagd’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported months of delay in replacing the Leeghwater bridge in Alkmaar, covering the cause, safety, damages to businesses and when the bridge will be finished. The minister said the province of Noord-Holland is responsible and the municipality is permit-giver and supervisor, that a province letter will largely answer the questions, and that the ministry will be kept informed.
This bridge and the works on this bridge fall under the responsibility of the province of Noord-Holland.
Deze brug en de werkzaamheden aan deze brug vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Noord Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de dreigende hakbijl voor bomen in middenberm van A28 tussen Wezep en Nunspeet

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether felling trees and shrubs in the A28 central reservation between Wezep and Nunspeet is necessary for road safety, and what alternatives and consultations exist. The minister answers that no extra measures beyond current works are needed, that felling of conifers is required for fire-spread risk in line with a regional approach, that small deciduous trees are kept, and that compensation and stakeholder consultation will follow.
Primarily, all conifers on this stretch of the A28 must be removed over a width of 80 metres, due to the high risk of fire spreading.
Primair dienen op dit traject van de A28 alle naaldbomen verwijderd te worden, ter breedte van 80 meter, in verband met het grote risico op brandoverslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over bericht "75-plussers blijven in onzekerheid: mag ik nu wel of niet autorijden?"

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about uncertainty for over-75s whose driving licences expire due to long CBR processing times, including insurers' lenient stance, a planned administrative extension, and equal treatment. The Minister confirmed the problem, said an AMvB for an administrative licence extension is being prepared with a target of 1 December 2019 (subject to Council of State review), and rejected a short-term coulance arrangement while stating that driving on an invalid licence remains punishable.
The aim is to introduce the AMvB on 1 December 2019.
Gestreefd wordt naar een invoering van de AMvB op 1 december 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Schonis en Remco Dijkstra over de grote problemen bij het CBR

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about data leaks at the CBR, where medical documents of one client were viewable in another's file, including how many cases there were, when they were reported, and whether affected people were informed. The minister reported 71 cases in January to June 2019 and 5 in 2018, said procedures and GDPR obligations were followed, and agreed to share monthly progress reports with the Chamber.
Yes, I am willing to share with the Chamber the monthly report that the CBR sends me within the framework of enhanced oversight.
Ja, ik ben bereid om de rapportage die het CBR maandelijks aan mij doet toekomen in het kader van het aangescherpt toezicht te delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries hebben vragen gesteld over het bericht “Oefenen voor een no deal Brexit”

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about a report on no-deal Brexit preparations, the lack of a Border Inspection Point on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg in Rotterdam, its consequences, responsibility, financing and EU approval. The minister answered by referring to earlier letters and briefings, said talks on an inspection post for live animals are ongoing, and mentioned a possible subsidy and guarantee under strict state aid conditions.
For a detailed explanation and answer to your questions, I refer you to several relevant letters.
Voor een uitgebreide toelichting en antwoord op uw vragen verwijs ik u naar enkele relevante brieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Pater-Postma en Palland over de berichten inzake de Ketelbrug

Two MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about recurring malfunctions of the Ketelbrug bridge reported by De Stentor, including the cause, data transfer, communication with shipping, and prevention. The minister answered that the faulty frequency-regulator parts were replaced, the bridge was monitored for a week without new faults, communication ran through standard channels, and Rijkswaterstaat is open to talks with affected shipping groups but cannot guarantee no future faults.
Rijkswaterstaat is also open to a conversation to consider what can reasonably and within its tasks and responsibilities be additionally done to limit or prevent the inconvenience for shipping.

Rijkswaterstaat staat daarnaast open voor een gesprek om te bezien wat redelijkerwijs en binnen zijn taken en verantwoordelijkheden extra gedaan kan worden om de hinder voor de scheepvaart te beperken c.q. te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Verkoop personenauto’s zakt flink in eerste halfjaar 2019’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported 10% drop in new passenger car sales in the first half of 2019, the rise in BPM revenue despite fewer sales, and whether the BPM tables will be adjusted for the WLTP test procedure. State Secretary Snel answers that sales fluctuations are normal, that BPM revenue rose because cars became heavier and more CO2-intensive, and that the BPM will switch to WLTP-based tables from 1 July 2020 with compensating adjustments.
As described in the answer to question 3, such fluctuations in the number of new car sales are not unusual.
Zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3 zijn dergelijke fluctuaties in het aantal nieuwverkochte auto's niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over slimme oplossingen voor het tekort aan parkeerplaatsen

An MP asked the minister about a German technology that increases truck parking capacity, and about the shortfall of secure truck parking along Dutch freight corridors. The minister reports a forecast shortfall of 2,400 spaces, about 800 planned spaces for 2020-2022, a full overview expected mid-2020, and a visit to Germany to explore the technology.
A complete overview can be expected to be provided around mid-2020.
Een totaaloverzicht kan naar verwachting medio 2020 worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het lekken en illegaal verhandelen van persoonsgegevens uit het kentekenregister

An MP asked whether the government knows of illegal trade in confidential license-plate register data, how it could happen despite stricter privacy rules, who has access, and what will be done. The minister confirms awareness, says a police investigation with the RDW and LIV is underway, describes the legal framework and list of access categories, and says an external review of extra safeguards has been commissioned.
The investigation must establish where the data came from and whether there has been misuse.
Het onderzoek moet uitwijzen waar de gegevens vandaan komen en of er sprake is van misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Actieve handel in privégegevens uit kentekenregister: ‘Schokkend en gevaarlijk’’

An MP asked the ministers about an RTL Nieuws report that vehicle register data including names and home addresses was being sold online, and how the leak occurred, who can access the data, and what is being done. The minister answered that the RDW had no prior knowledge of misuse, a police investigation and an external review of extra safeguards are underway, and the RDW logs access and audits its security annually.
Until the outcomes of that investigation are known, I cannot make any statements about it.
Totdat de uitkomsten daarvan bekend zijn, kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de actieve handel in privégegevens uit het kentekenregister

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that private data from the vehicle registration register was being traded actively, and whether a large-scale investigation into alleged corruption at the RDW would be held by an independent party. The minister answered that a police investigation with the RDW and LIV is underway after an RDW criminal complaint, that the RDW has commissioned an external review of structural safeguards, and that measures will be decided once findings are available.
The RDW filed a criminal complaint with the police, who then started an investigation in cooperation with the RDW (and the LIV).
De RDW heeft aangifte gedaan bij de politie die daarop in samenwerking met de RDW (en het LIV) een onderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het  bericht ‘De Ketelbrug stond vast, moet  oplossing voor komen’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about a July 2019 breakdown of the Ketelbrug bridge, its maintenance history, emergency access, and whether shipping would stay blocked. The minister explained the fault was a frequency controller, listed 16 shipping and 7 road disruptions since the 2013 renovation, said emergency services are alerted via the joint control room, and stated the bridge was back on regular operation from 1 August with no backlog maintenance.
From 1 August the bridge is operated again according to the regular operating regime.
Vanaf 1 augustus wordt de brug weer bediend conform regulier bedieningsregime.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de brandstofstoring bij Aircraft Fuel Supply (AFS)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the chaos at Schiphol caused by the July 2019 fuel supply failure, including communication with travellers, Schiphol's liability, passenger care and compensation. The minister answered that an independent TNO investigation is under way, that Schiphol will evaluate crisis communication and passenger care with sector parties, and that liability and compensation questions depend on the cause still unknown.
My ministry is in contact with AFS and Schiphol about this and is closely following developments.
Mijn ministerie staat hierover in contact met AFS en Schiphol en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over antwoorden van de Europese Commissie op het bericht ‘Tegengaan bureaucratie exceptioneel transport’

An MP asked the minister about EU-level differences and increasing refusals of permits for exceptional transport in countries such as France and Italy, and whether the issue could be raised in EU harmonisation of the weights and dimensions directive. The minister answered that national rules legitimately differ due to infrastructure, that exceptional vehicles fall outside the directive, and that she will explore finding allies in Europe for harmonisation.
I am willing to explore whether I can find allies in Europe to advocate for harmonisation.
Ik ben bereid om te verkennen of ik in Europa medestanders kan vinden om voor harmonisatie te pleiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het doordrukken van groei op Schiphol terwijl krimp nodig is om binnen de grenzen van klimaat, leefomgeving en veiligheid van mens en dier te blijven

Van Raan (PvdD) asks the minister why Schiphol growth is being pushed through despite the need for shrinkage within environmental, climate and safety limits, and whether the government respects participation, trust and motions requiring broader environmental standards. The minister rejects the claims of improper governance, says growth is conditional on verifiable noise reduction and safety, and promises a hinder-reduction plan, an Omgevingsfonds and a Luchtvaartnota with a PlanMER examining normative options.
Only after verifiable noise reduction has been achieved can Schiphol earn growth.
Pas nadat er sprake is van aantoonbare hinderbeperking kan Schiphol groei verdienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over duizenden gedupeerden door het faillissement van de Zoetermeerse verkeersschool Aalbregt
