An MP asked the minister about thousands of pupils left out of pocket by the bankruptcy of a Zoetermeer driving school, whether a guarantee fund exists, whether exams can proceed, and whether driving school quality rules should be tightened. The minister said bankruptcy is a private matter with a curator handling refunds, no guarantee fund exists, exams proceed where capacity allows, and quality measures are under discussion with the sector and CBR.
A bankruptcy is first and foremost a matter of private law. The government has no role in it.
Een faillissement is eerst en vooral een privaatrechtelijke aangelegenheid. De overheid heeft hier geen rol in.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de artikelen ‘Failliete rijschoolhouder blijkt spoorloos’, ‘Rijschoolhouder Ferry A. failliet’ en ‘Verdwenen rijschoolhouder neemt onbetaald personeel verschrikkelijk in

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about news reports of a bankrupt driving school owner who disappeared, including whether he can be extradited, how driving schools can be barred, whether the CBR and Tax Office supervise them, and how victims can claim damages. The minister declined to comment on the individual criminal case, pointed to a revocation procedure under the WRM, said the CBR does not supervise driving schools and the Tax Office only checks them incidentally, and said talks with the sector on quality improvement are ongoing.
I will not go into individual persons and criminal matters.
Ik ga niet in op individuele personen en strafrechtelijke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de flinke groei CO2 Luchtvaart terwijl reductie van de uitstoot van CO2 nodig is

An MP asks the minister why aviation CO2 emissions in the Netherlands grew sharply despite the need for reductions, and whether aviation's non-CO2 climate effects, international aviation's place in national targets, and ETS impacts are adequately addressed. The minister acknowledges that aviation emissions have grown, says a 2030 reduction below 1990 levels is unrealistic, commits to a 2030 target equal to 2005 levels for international aviation, and states that non-CO2 effects cannot yet be reliably quantified, with further research and a forthcoming aviation policy note pending.
International aviation has grown so strongly over the past 30 years that a reduction in 2030 compared with 1990 CO2 emissions is hardly realistic.
De internationale luchtvaart is de afgelopen 30 jaar dermate sterk gegroeid dat een reductie in 2030 ten opzichte van de CO 2 emissies in 1990 weinig realistisch is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de toename van agressie tegen weginspecteurs

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about rising aggression against road inspectors and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a campaign, higher prison penalties and ongoing work with the Justice Minister, but did not commit to a new concrete measure of its own.
I also see that the working conditions of road inspectors are becoming increasingly dangerous.
Ook ik zie dat de werkomstandigheden van de weginspecteurs steeds gevaarlijker worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de impact van de vernietiging van de PAS door de Raad van State op de besluitvorming omtrent Lelystad Airport

MPs Van Raan, Laçin and Kröger asked the minister how the Council of State's annulment of the PAS nitrogen programme affects the status of Lelystad Airport as a priority project, the required permitting and studies, and whether new research is needed before any decision. The minister answered that the reserved development space for Lelystad has lapsed, that the Wet Natuurbescherming now applies and consequences are still being examined, and that careful study is needed, so opening in April 2020 is no longer feasible.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform the House.
Zodra hierover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Transporteurs boos over dure Nederlandse tachokaart: ‘In buitenland veel goedkoper’

MPs asked why Dutch hauliers pay substantially higher prices for tachograph cards than in neighbouring countries and whether this disadvantages Dutch SMEs. The minister acknowledged price differences, said a benchmark study will be sent to parliament after the summer, and promised a revised, more transparent tariff scheme that may lower prices.
This study will be sent to your House after the summer.
Dit onderzoek zal na de zomer naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

MPs Bruins and Paternotte asked the minister about the Lelystad Airport MER update, including the use of Doc29 versus the Dutch NRM noise model, noise-table conditions, and whether the MER is conservative enough. The minister answered each question, arguing that NRM is the statutory method for regional airports, that Doc29 is not yet implemented there, and that the MER uses realistic assumptions with sensitivity and worst-case analyses, without committing to changes.
The ANP database contains noise data for a large number of aircraft, including most of the Boeing and Airbus fleet.
De ANP-database bevat geluidsgegevens voor een groot aantal toestellen, waaronder het grootste deel van de vloot van Boeing en Airbus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport straffeloos het afgesproken aantal nachtvluchten kan overschrijden

An MP asked the minister whether the Rotterdam The Hague Airport exceeds its agreed night-flight limit of 849 without enforcement, and what remedies residents have. The minister acknowledges the overrun (around 1,300 night flights, mainly driven by trauma helicopter use), says enforcement applies to the total permitted capacity via the ILT, and commits to examining a binding night-flight maximum in the new airport decree.
I will therefore seriously consider this option.
Ik zal deze optie dan ook serieus bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over de berichten ‘De schrikbarende stijging die niemand kan verklaren’ en ‘Verkeersanalyse provincie nutteloos door Privacywet’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Gent asked whether the GDPR (AVG) prevents provinces from analysing traffic accidents, after reports that the increase in road deaths in Brabant could not be explained. The minister acknowledged that special personal data cannot currently be supplied due to a missing legal basis, that a bill is expected early next year, and pointed to aggregated data, in-depth studies and data sharing as alternatives.
However, special personal data cannot currently be supplied.
Bijzondere persoonsgegevens kunnen op dit moment echter niet worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gevolgen van de vernietiging van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof voor biomassacentrales

An MP from PvdD asked ministers whether the Council of State's annulment of the Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) affects pending permits for biomass plants, including Nuon's plant in Diemen, and whether new nitrogen assessments are needed. Minister Schouten answered that pending permits can no longer rely on the PAS and need an appropriate assessment, that the Diemen permit did not use the PAS, and that no new nitrogen study is required.
Pending permit applications can no longer be granted under the PAS.
Lopende vergunningaanvragen kunnen niet meer via het PAS worden vergund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Pater-Postma over de wildgroei van creatieve uitspattingen op de rijbaan

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the spread of decorative paintings on road surfaces and the safety risks for motorcyclists and vulnerable road users, and whether municipalities should be pressed to restrain them. The minister agreed such markings should be limited to road-use purposes, pointed to existing rules and guidance and to an informal knowledge network, and said she would inform the VNG, while stating that she cannot enforce rules against municipalities because there is no hierarchical relationship.
I believe the existing guidelines and regulations provide sufficient clarity for the application of markings.
Ik meen dat de bestaande richtlijnen en regelgeving voldoende duidelijkheid bieden voor het aanbrengen van markeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Buitenlanders ontlopen parkeerboete, landen willen adressen niet geven’

Two VVD MPs asked why foreign drivers escape parking fines because some countries, notably Germany, no longer provide registered-keeper addresses, and what can be done. The minister acknowledged the problem (roughly tens of thousands of unpaid fines, at least EUR 1 million a year), explained that EU cross-border rules cover only traffic offences not parking, and committed to exploring bilateral data exchange, starting with Germany.

Together with my colleagues at the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, I will examine what options exist for reaching a similar exchange with other countries.

Ik zal, samen met mijn collega´s van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om met andere landen tot een soortgelijke uitwisseling te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Algemene voorwaarden en verzekering rijscholen niet altijd op orde”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about driving schools whose terms and insurance are not always in order, leaving pupils liable for fines or damage. The minister said no uninsured driving-school cars are known, that branch organisations check members yearly and expel non-compliant ones, and that no legal means exist to sanction individual schools, while a review with the sector is ongoing.
However, I am examining other options with the sector to organise this better.
Wel onderzoek ik in overleg met de branche andere mogelijkheden om dit beter te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat nachtvluchten op Maastricht Aachen Airport niet worden uitgesloten

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that night flights at Maastricht Aachen Airport are not excluded under a possible growth scenario in the draft Aviation Policy Note, and about refusing to disclose Belgian-related documents on overflights above Eijsden. The minister answered that scenarios are being assessed in a PlanMER process without final decisions, but withheld content of documents at Belgium's request and committed to publishing the independent detailed analysis.
I therefore cannot go into the content of these documents.
Ik kan daarom niet ingaan op de inhoud van deze documenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Van Aalst over het mensonterende voorval in Zeist

PVV MPs asked ministers about a degrading incident involving a regional taxi driver filmed on Facebook, and whether low tariffs in insurer tenders cause work pressure. The minister denied a link to tariffs, said the contract with the province of Utrecht sets realistic rates and quality requirements, and will ask the NZa to explore the issue with stakeholders.
For that reason he will ask the NZa to carry out an exploration by talking with all parties (insurers, taxi unions and patient associations) about the possible problems.
Om die reden zal hij aan de NZa vragen om een verkenning uit te voeren door met alle partijen (verzekeraars, taxibonden en patiëntenverenigingen) in gesprek te gaan over de mogelijke problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over de uitzending van Radar over drugsdumpingen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked ministers about drug waste dumpings on private land, including whether owners should be expected to take preventive measures, whether full compensation for clean-up costs is warranted, and whether convicted dumpers could fund a victims' fund. The government answered that owners need not take preventive measures, that full compensation for direct clean-up costs for private owners will be provided through provincial schemes and structural funding, and that a victims' fund and separate co-financing arrangements are still being explored by the intergovernmental working group.
In connection with drug dumpings, citizens who have committed no offence are not obliged to take measures to prevent the dumping of drug waste, nor to clean up dumped drug waste.

In samenhang met drugsdumpingen zijn burgers die geen overtreding hebben begaan, niet verplicht om maatregelen te nemen om dumping van drugsafval tegen te gaan en ook niet om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over illegale drugsdumpingen

Two SP MPs asked who is responsible for cleaning up illegal drug waste after the Raad van State ruled that landowners need not pay, and asked about the status of inter-governmental talks, funding, and urgency. The Minister answered that regional and local authorities bear responsibility, that the cabinet will provide EUR 1 million per year structurally for co-financing direct clean-up costs, and that proposals for a structural co-financing scheme will come before the summer recess.

The cabinet now makes available structurally EUR 1 million per year for the period 2019 through 2024 on the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security to (co)finance the direct costs of clean-up of drug dumping.
Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 mln. per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de problemen bij Boeing

Two MPs (Amhaouch, CDA, and Paternotte, D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Boeing knew of problems with the 737 MAX long before the crashes, whether regulators were informed, EASA versus FAA certification rules, and possible pressure on engineers and oversight of Boeing's 787 production. The minister answered that the reports could not be confirmed and that the US matters are for investigation there, pointed to existing ICAO and EU rules, EASA's stop of the 737 MAX, the ILT's and OVV's oversight powers, and that the ILT received no formal or informal signals.
This is a matter for further investigation in the United States.
Dit is een onderwerp voor nader onderzoek in de Verenigde Staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de noodzaak van de oeververbinding voor de Krimpenerwaard

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Krimpenerwaard bridge link is needed to relieve the Van Brienenoord bridge, and what steps and funding are planned. The minister answered that a new eastern river crossing is needed to relieve the A16 corridor, that the choice of location is for the regional authorities, and that the funding will be decided after the MIRT study, with EUR 200 million reserved for the A16 bottleneck.
It was agreed to start the MIRT exploration and to take the start decision in mid-2019.
Er is afgesproken om de MIRT-Verkenning te starten en medio 2019 de Startbeslissing te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over kerosineprojecten in Rotterdam en Delfzijl

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about public funding and sustainability of synthetic and bio-kerosene projects in Rotterdam and Delfzijl, including fraud risks, deforestation and aviation volume reduction. The minister answered that public funds support feasibility studies and an innovation programme, that the Delfzijl plant receives no public money, and that sustainability is assured through private auditors and advisory boards, while acknowledging limited public enforcement powers and deferring on volume reduction.
At present the ministry is in discussion with the Netherlands Emissions Authority (NEa) about various scenarios for public-law supervision and enforcement to limit fraud risks in the chain.

Op dit moment is het ministerie met de Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit (NEa) in gesprek om verschillende scenario's te bekijken voor publiekrechtelijk toezicht en handhaving om de frauderisico's in de keten te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de Youtube film ‘CBR haat zieke mensen en Marije krijgt een boete’

An MP asked the minister about a video on CBR driving-licence assessments, including the medical condition list, long phone waits and lost documents, and whether a leniency scheme would be introduced. The minister said the health council advises on the condition list, the CBR has clarified forms and prioritises expiry dates, and an extension study and plan of action are underway, with more information promised before the summer recess.
Before the summer recess, your House will receive more information on the findings of the research I am now conducting and the actions that follow from it.
Voor het zomerreces ontvangt uw Kamer meer informatie over de bevindingen van het onderzoek dat ik nu uitvoer en de acties die daaruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de openstelling van de Afsluitdijk voor fietsers

MPs Schonis (D66) and Von Martels (CDA) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why bicycle access to the Afsluitdijk is limited in 2020-2021 and whether alternatives such as closing the road or separating lanes were considered. The minister answered that construction makes safe openings very limited, that closing the A7 or splitting lanes is not feasible given its regional importance, and that only a bicycle bus and a possible incidental opening will be considered.
For 2020 and 2021 the opportunities for opening appear very limited, but in due course I will examine whether opportunities arise to let cyclists and walkers use the dike incidentally and safely.

Voor 2020 en 2021 lijken de mogelijkheden voor openstelling zeer beperkt, maar ik zal te zijner tijd bezien of zich dan ook kansen voordoen om fietsers en wandelaars incidenteel veilig van de dijk gebruik te laten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht 'Shell wil fundamenten olieplatforms in Noordzee na gebruik laten staan'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about Shell's plan to leave the concrete base of decommissioned North Sea platforms in place, including OSPAR rules, German objections, and the 11,000 tonnes of contaminated material remaining. The minister answered that the Netherlands has not yet taken a position, is commissioning an independent review and will submit a draft position to parliament first, while acknowledging that contaminated material would slowly enter the environment in the very long term.
I will submit this draft position to your House before adopting the final position toward the UK.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit conceptstandpunt voorleggen alvorens het definitieve standpunt richting het VK in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het voortijdig stoppen van de berging na de containerramp op de Waddenzee

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the salvage of containers lost from the MSC Zoe in the Wadden Sea was reportedly halted early, whether the operation is complete, and whether the shipping company is taking adequate responsibility, among other points. The minister answers that the operation is not yet finished, describes the survey and salvage method, says MSC remains responsible and that aftercare agreements are being negotiated, and declines to fully disclose some cargo information beyond what the Freedom of Information Act permits.
The salvage operation is not yet completed.
De bergingsoperatie is nog niet afgerond.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Van Aalst en Madlener over de acute zorg op Voorne-Putten met het oog op aankomende wegwerkzaamheden (en afsluitingen) en de wens in de regio om het Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum op t

PVV MPs asked the ministers about acute hospital care on Voorne-Putten, given road works and bridge closures, and about reopening the Spijkenisse Medisch Centrum as a full hospital with an emergency department, acute obstetrics and weekend stay. The minister replied that care should be provided in the right place, that the 45-minute norm is the relevant standard and is under study, that bridge disruptions are managed with contingency plans, and that the hospital is not a sensitive hospital and cannot be designated as a system hospital.
Before the summer I will inform you further about my vision on developments in the hospital landscape and my role in it.
Voor de zomer zal ik u nader informeren over mijn visie op de ontwikkelingen in het ziekenhuislandschap en mijn rol hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap, Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Venlo hotspot voor snelwegcrimineel’

MPs asked about rising cargo theft and mobile banditry targeting truck drivers near Venlo, including secure parking, EU action and prosecution of foreign suspects. The minister answered that incidents are falling, cited secure truck parking projects, joint task forces and prosecution measures, and committed to continued talks with the transport sector.
Compared with other European countries, the number of registered reports of transport crime in the Netherlands is relatively higher.
Vergeleken met andere Europese landen is het aantal geregistreerde meldingen van transportcriminaliteit in Nederland relatief hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Lege tank niet beboet’

Deputy Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether drivers who run out of fuel and stop on motorway hard shoulders should be fined, given that such stops are avoidable and the Leeuwarden court treated fuel shortage as an emergency. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no data on such stops or related accidents are registered, that running out of fuel is in principle avoidable but hard to prove negligence on, and that a fine reintroduction is not preferred, with Article 5 of the Road Traffic Act available for genuinely dangerous conduct.
No, that data is not known.
Nee, die gegevens zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Schiphol speelt tweede viool vrachtnet AF – KLM’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the decline of air cargo volume at Schiphol, slot scarcity, sector employment, the cargo-specific slot allocation, the aviation tax and US and Russian slot disputes. The minister answered in detail, citing data, committing to further studies on employment and the aviation tax, and noting the government's facilitating role.

That is why I am investigating with Schiphol, the slot coordinator ACNL and the sector all options to determine and allocate Schiphol's available capacity as optimally as possible within the EU slot regulation, including for cargo carriers.

Daarom onderzoek ik met Schiphol, de slotcoördinator ACNL, en de sector alle mogelijkheden om binnen de kaders van de EU slotverordening de beschikbare capaciteit van Schiphol zo optimaal mogelijk te laten vaststellen en te verdelen over alle gebruikers, waaronder de vrachtmaatschappijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Situatie zeehaventerminals fnuikend voor binnenvaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported congestion at Rotterdam container terminals harming inland shipping, the rail share of freight, and how inland shipping interests are weighed against sea shipping. The minister acknowledged the congestion problem, described bundling and digital/infrastructure measures already underway, denied that 20% of cargo could easily shift to rail, and said an overflow hub and further studies would follow, with more detail in the upcoming port memorandum.
I therefore expect that the share of rail transport in the Port of Rotterdam will increase.
Ik verwacht daarmee dat het aandeel van spoorvervoer in de Rotterdamse haven zal toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten 'Spijkenisserbrug weer open na storing' en 'Problemen met Spijkenisserbrug en Haringvlietbrug voorbij'

An MP asks the minister about repeated failures of the Spijkenisser bridge, the timing and feasibility of accelerating its renovation, extra capacity, and bridge opening times. The minister reports stoppage statistics, states the renovation cannot be accelerated because of the technical survey, describes flanking measures under study, and declines fixed opening hours to protect shipping priority.
The investigation into acceleration options has recently been completed.
Het onderzoek naar de versnellingsmogelijkheden is recent afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het bericht dat  KLM medeoprichter is van een maatschappij die vluchten tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil verzorgen

MPs Kröger and Snels asked whether the government knows KLM co-founded Air Antwerp, a Antwerp-London flight venture, and how this fits KLM's talks on phasing out short flights. The minister confirms awareness, says the Antwerp-London route falls outside the Dutch phase-out process, and promises to urge the sector to favour rail on short routes.
The fact that KLM holds a minority interest in the new airline Air Antwerp, which wants to (re)open the Antwerp-London route, does not detract from the above process.

Het feit dat de KLM een minderheidsbelang heeft in de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Air Antwerp – die de route tussen Antwerpen en Londen wil (her)openen – doet geen afbreuk aan het bovengenoemde proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Paternotte over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

Two opposition MPs (Bruins and Paternotte) asked the minister whether the Lelystad Airport noise assessments used an outdated calculation model (NRM rather than Doc29), questioning the commitment to the most current insights. The minister answered that the calculations used the legally prescribed method, that Doc29 is not yet legally available for regional airports, and that no new noise maps are required for Lelystad.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de artikelen 'Rivieren over de hele wereld vervuild met antibiotica' en 'Antibiotics found in some of the world’s rivers exceed 'safe' levels, global study finds'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that antibiotics pollute rivers worldwide, including the proposed remedies, Nederland's role, the Blue Deal, and the European approach to medicine residues. The minister answered that the problem is tackled internationally via WHO and a one-health approach, that the EU initiative is welcomed, and referred to existing programmes and to the Minister for medical care for further detail.
It is likely that discharges from production sites that do not operate in line with GMP guidelines (Good Manufacturing Practices) contribute to the problem.
Het is waarschijnlijk dat lozingen uit productielocaties die niet conform GMP guidelines werken (Good Manufacturing Practices), bijdragen aan het probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de aanbesteding van zware berging

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Rijkswaterstaat's open tender for heavy recovery services, including the reduction from 39 to 17 contracted lots, the cost of 24/7 availability, the risk of price wars and unsafe response times, and the possibility of a floor price. The Minister answered that the tender is on track, quality counts alongside price, and no floor price or revision of the tender rules is planned.
I have no insight into the number of vehicles towed by non-contracted companies.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal versleepte voertuigen door niet-gecontracteerde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over ongerustheid over een grote militaire oefenzone

MPs Van Raan, Kröger and Laçin asked about concerns over a large military exercise zone in the north of the Netherlands, its consultation, decision-making roles, environmental and Wadden Sea effects, and links to Lelystad Airport. The ministers answered that the zone is still being designed within the Luchtruimherziening programme, that participation and Plan-MER procedures will follow, and that the decision is due in 2020.
It is too early in the design process to give clarity on the positioning of the exercise area and the consequences for airspace use.
Het is te vroeg in het nog te doorlopen ontwerpproces om al duidelijkheid te geven over de positionering van het oefengebied en de gevolgen hiervan voor het luchtruimgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het artikel 'Paddepoelsterbrug: nog even geduld voor fietsforenzen richting Stad'

An MP asked about the closed Paddepoelster bridge and the cycling route into Groningen, and whether the ministry values inland shipping above slow traffic. The minister says Rijkswaterstaat is working with the municipalities on a joint solution, weighing navigation safety on a high-risk waterway against alternative routes, with a decision expected in summer 2019.
I expect to have the outcome of this in summer 2019.
Ik verwacht in de zomer 2019 hiervan de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over enkele onderwerpen met betrekking tot Lelystad Airport

An MP asks the minister to explain the partial rejection of a freedom-of-information request about the Schiphol-Lelystad traffic distribution rule, why legal advice and shared-vision commission advice are withheld, the cost-benefit analysis, and noise impacts for Noord-Veluwe municipalities. The minister defends withholding documents on grounds of protecting decision-making and third-party (Schiphol) interests, describes the commission's completed work, and promises an independent analysis and a later reply.
Both the interest in a careful and effective decision-making process and Schiphol's interest weigh, in my view, more heavily in this case than the public interest in disclosure.

Zowel het belang van een zorgvuldig en effectief proces van besluitvorming alsmede het belang van Schiphol wegen naar mijn overtuiging in dit geval zwaarder dan het publieke belang van openbaarmaking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over de ontheffing voor het doodschieten van onder andere de das, eekhoorn, haas, konijn, ree, wild zwijn, steenmarter, vos en 22 vogelsoorten op het terrein

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about a provincial exemption allowing the killing of protected animals (badger, hare, deer, fox and 22 bird species) at Twente Airport, and questioned oversight, the procedure, and whether the exemption should be withdrawn. The minister answered all 17 questions, largely stating that the province is the competent authority and declining to intervene, while confirming the province will withdraw the exemption at the applicant's request.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations the provinces make when taking those decisions.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen die de provincies bij het nemen van die beslissingen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Automobilisten hebben lak aan rode kruizen A16’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Remco Dijkstra asked about drivers ignoring red crosses on the A16, the legal basis for penalising them, and whether pilots and camera enforcement by road inspectors could be accelerated. The minister replied that ignoring red crosses is now criminal, that a bill would raise penalties, that enforcement staff and pilots are being expanded, and that camera enforcement on inspectors' vehicles was not pursued because of safety and role concerns.
Ignoring a red cross was transferred a few years ago from the administrative enforcement act for traffic rules to criminal law.
Het negeren van een rood kruis is een paar jaar geleden overgebracht van de Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften naar het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat Defensie zich nog geen raad weet met steeds kleinere drones

VVD MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs, among others, about the difficulty of countering increasingly small drones, expert recommendations, inter-ministerial coordination, and Defence's counter-drone research and industry cooperation. The ministers replied that research is ongoing with international partners, coordination with the police and Justice and Veiligheid exists, and Nederland is pursuing counter-drone categories in EDIDP, without committing to new checks on the executive.
The cabinet will return on this matter shortly in a letter that will be sent to the House soon.
Het kabinet komt op korte termijn ter zake in een brief die uw kamer spoedig zal toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Verhoeven over het artikel ‘Wie temt het datamonster in de auto-industrie?’

MPs Schonis and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about in-car data collection, privacy, independent oversight and consumer choice over shared data. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports EU data-driven road safety, pointed to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and RDW as oversight bodies, said privacy is protected under the GDPR, and promised further study and a response to a related motion, while declining to give a full overview of all vehicle data.
A complete overview of all data that all types of cars generate and store I cannot give.
Een volledig overzicht van alle gegevens die alle typen auto’s genereren en opslaan kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Groothuizen over het bericht ‘Reddingsschip Sea-Watch mag voorlopig weer uitvaren na winst rechtszaak’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government will handle the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship dispute after a court ruling, and whether it will negotiate a transition period and clarify the requirements. The minister answered that the court upheld the regulation, set a suspension until 15 August 2019 for this vessel, and that talks on clarifying the requirements are ongoing, with the government committing to provide clarity itself if talks fail.
The court ruled that the regulation for vessels that systematically take drowning people on board is lawful and remains in force.
De rechter heeft geoordeeld dat de regeling voor schepen die stelselmatig drenkelingen aan boord nemen rechtmatig is en in stand blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Emiel van Dijk en Van Aalst over het bericht dat Sea-Watch weer uit mag varen

Three PVV MPs asked why the government cannot keep NGO rescue ships like Sea-Watch in port, as Italy and Panama do, and called for a halt to asylum and the detention of the ship. The minister answered that Dutch flag and safety rules govern the ship, that the government supports rescue at sea but not operations that aid smugglers, and that it cannot impose an asylum stop because that would breach international obligations.
Regarding the asylum stop you propose, I refer you to the earlier answer from the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
Ten aanzien van de door u voorgestelde asielstop, verwijs ik u naar de eerdere beantwoording van de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht in de Telegraaf “kleine visser zit klem”

MPs asked the government about reports that small fishers are squeezed by offshore wind farms, including access rules, fines for approaching turbines, and the progress of a Noordzee future perspective. The minister answered that the ministries share responsibility, that no record was kept of a meeting with fishers, that wind farms were opened to vessels up to 24 metres from May 2018 under conditions, and that a Noordzee agreement process and a fishing-sector perspective are underway, with evaluation in 2020.
No report was made of the meeting referred to.
Van het gesprek waarnaar wordt verwezen is geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het rapport Actualisatie AEOLUS 2018 en geactualiseerde luchtvaartprognoses

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, in 17 questions, when and how noise calculations for Dutch aviation moved from the NRM model to ECAC Doc29, how the models differ, and what the effects are for Schiphol and Lelystad. The minister answered that Doc29 is used for the Schiphol MER, is not yet available for regional airports, that most questions are answered together, and that a corrected AEOLUS report is attached.
Once the Doc29 calculation model for Schiphol is legally implemented, it will be decided whether this calculation method will also be introduced for noise calculations for other civil airports.
Zodra het Doc29 rekenmodel voor Schiphol wettelijk is geïmplementeerd, zal worden besloten of dit rekenvoorschrift ook wordt ingevoerd voor geluidberekeningen voor andere burgerluchthavens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Schonis en Gijs van Dijk over het rondetafelgesprek inzake MSC Zoe

MPs Kröger, Schonis and Gijs van Dijk asked the minister about inspection of container ships, cargo securing, confidentiality of cargo manifests, shipping routes and container tracing after the MSC Zoe incident. The minister answered that inspections led to few detentions, that extra cargo-securing checks shift inspection effort from other topics, that certain cargo data is confidential under the Wob, and that international rule changes depend on investigation outcomes.
There has been contact between the Dutch police and Port of Sines in Portugal. This was the last port the MSC Zoe called at before the accident occurred.
Er is contact geweest tussen de Nederlandse politie en Port of Sines in Portugal. Dit was de laatste haven die de MSC Zoe aandeed voor het ongeval plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Geurts en Slootweg over de aanpak van knooppunt Hoevelaken

MPs of the CDA ask the minister about the stalled redevelopment of the Hoevelaken junction after the contract with BAM and Van Oord was reportedly terminated, including the delay to construction, traffic costs and possible coordination with the A1/A30 Barneveld project. The minister confirms the planned start of 2021 is now delayed to after the route decision (expected 2020), promises to inform the Chamber on re-tendering later, and gives partial answers on other points.
I will inform you at a later moment about how the realisation will be re-tendered.
Ik zal u op een later moment informeren over de wijze waarop de realisatie opnieuw wordt aanbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Nieuwe’ geul klaar maar werkt nog niet’

MPs asked about the newly dredged Vloedgeul channel on the Holwerd-Ameland ferry route, which was finished but still showed delays, asking about expected travel-time gains, monitoring, further measures and a second cut-off. The minister answered that the expected saving is 4 to 6 minutes but cannot yet be verified, that weekly soundings and a planned measurement campaign will monitor the channel, that quarterly punctuality data will be provided and reviewed in the 2020 transport plan, and that a second bend cut-off and a long-term vision are in preparation.
The information requested by your House is not available in time for the General Consultation on the Wadden of 26 June 2019.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde informatie is niet tijdig beschikbaar voor het Algemeen Overleg Wadden van 26 juni 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over vliegveiligheid en vogelaanvaringen

An MP asks the minister to justify why the De Bilt weather radar, with a 5–25 km range, can be treated as representative of broadfront bird migration around Lelystad Airport's connecting routes, and to share the KLu's assessment of the analysis. The minister maintains the radar is representative because broadfront migration is roughly even across Dutch territory, cites the 2012–2017 dataset and KLu validation, and says the KLu's assessment was not put in writing but is described in the report.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Aalst over het weer aanzetten van de verlichting langs de snelweg

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why motorway lighting switched off for night hours has not been restored despite the coalition agreement, and whether the lights can go back on. The minister replied that restoration is being pursued where it improves traffic safety, that she ordered a halt to further switching-off, and that Rijkswaterstaat is studying effects on protected species, with results expected by summer 2019 and no final decision yet.
I have immediately instructed that the switching off of additional lighting between 11pm and 5am be stopped
Ik heb direct opdracht gegeven te stoppen met het uitzetten van extra verlichting tussen 23h en 5h
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het opvoeren van elektrische fietsen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the tampering of electric bicycles to exceed 25 km/h, including its prevalence, causes, enforcement and software chips. The minister said tampering is not banned but illegal tuned bikes are dangerous, that the problem's size is unknown, that she is monitoring it with industry and cyclist groups, and that enforcement includes road tests.
I am not aware of how large the problem is.
Het is mij niet bekend hoe groot het probleem is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Von Martels over de coulanceregeling Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

Two MPs asked the minister whether drivers harmed by CBR delays can expect a temporary coulance (goodwill) arrangement, and why medically flagged drivers cannot get faster renewals and police cannot verify doctors' letters. The minister confirmed no short-term coulance will be granted, citing road safety and that the arrangement cannot be verified, while saying the situation is regrettable.
That is correct. I understand the wish of your House.
Dat klopt. Ik begrijp de wens van uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht ‘Olievlek drijft richting Waddeneilanden’

An MP asked ministers whether an oil slick drifting toward the Wadden islands, its cause, the response by authorities, and whether further protection of North Sea and Wadden nature was needed. The minister said the slick was not from offshore installations, described the Coast Guard and Rijkswaterstaat response, and pointed to existing directives and an upcoming North Sea agreement without committing to new measures.
The source of the oil pollution is so far not known.
De bron van de olieverontreiniging is vooralsnog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een nieuw onderzoek naar de impact van de ongekende veranderingen rond de Noordpool

MP Van Raan (PvdD) asked ministers about media reports on a new study of rapid Arctic change, including claims of a tipping point, sea-ice and ice-sheet loss, and whether Dutch climate policy has enough margin for setbacks toward the 1.5°C goal. The minister acknowledged the study's concerning picture and the need for ambitious climate policy, while stating the 49% 2030 target stands and that policy can be adjusted as new insights emerge.
Dutch climate policy aims for a 49% reduction in 2030 compared with 1990.
Het Nederlandse klimaatbeleid is gericht op een reductie van 49% in 2030 ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht ‘35 vissers willen lading MSC Zoe uit zee halen, maar ze mogen niet’

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why fishing vessels were reportedly barred from helping recover containers lost from the MSC Zoe and how quickly the recovery of the remaining containers would proceed. The minister replied that fishers may assist under conditions set by the ILT for safety and that the shipping company MSC is legally responsible for recovery, with Rijkswaterstaat monitoring progress.
However, this may not be a reason for shipowner MSC to not take its own responsibilities but to shift them onto others.
Het mag echter geen reden zijn dat reder MSC haar eigen verantwoordelijkheden niet op zich neemt maar afwentelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sneller over het verkrijgen van inzicht in de gevolgen van maximumsnelheden

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how the government gains insight into the effects of speed limits, including the 130 km/h motorway limit, on road safety, air quality, costs, liveability and congestion, and whether evaluation and cost-benefit analyses are adequate. The minister answered that effects are tracked in annual monitors, that road safety is a priority but the speed limits will be kept, that the Court of Audit has a study pending, and that a French-style study in the Netherlands is not needed.
If not, do you agree that it would be desirable to have these insights?
Zo nee, deelt u de mening dat het wenselijk zou zijn om wel over deze inzichten te beschikken?

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de berichten ‘Gewonden bij botsing cruiseschepen op de Nieuwe Maas’, ‘Cruiseschip geëvacueerd na botsing op de Waal’ en ‘Cruiseschip met 171 passagiers botst met tanker op West

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about three collisions involving river cruise ships in March and April 2019 and whether safety rules and emergency preparedness are adequate. The minister answered that the incidents appear coincidental without structural causes, referred the Westerschelde collision to the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid, and described existing regulations and regional emergency planning.
For the incident on the Westerschelde, the OVV is launching an investigation. The report that appears on this will of course be shared with the House.
Naar het incident op de Westerschelde stelt de OVV een onderzoek in. Het rapport dat daarover verschijnt wordt natuurlijk met de Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Becker over het bericht ‘Koppositie Schiphol als poort naar VS onder druk’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that US pressure threatens Schiphol's position and about the state of the pre-clearance negotiations, including costs, benefits and the government's role. The minister replied that there is no pressure, that the negotiations are ongoing, that any treaty must comply with Dutch, EU and international law and that parliament will approve the treaty after negotiations conclude.
Afterwards the treaty will be submitted to parliament for approval.
Daarna zal het verdrag ter goedkeuring aan het parlement worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Koerhuis over het bericht dat Amstelveen vasthoudt aan 2500 nieuwe studentenwoningen

MPs Dijkstra and Koerhuis asked whether Amstelveen's plan for 2,500 student dwellings under Schiphol flight paths risks residents' safety and health and circumvents Schiphol airspace rules. The minister answered that the plan is only a non-binding area vision, that the LIB rules restrict housing near flight paths and that consultation with the province and ministries will follow, but declined to judge the plan before a binding zoning plan exists.

In the short term, consultation will take place between representatives of the municipality, the province of Noord-Holland and the ministries of BZK and IenW to discuss how the area vision and the zoning plan still to be drawn up relate to the LIB rules.

Op korte termijn vindt nader overleg plaats tussen vertegenwoordigers van de gemeente, de provincie Noord-Holland en de ministeries van BZK en IenW om te bespreken hoe de Gebiedsvisie en het nog op te stellen bestemmingsplan zich verhouden tot de regels van het LIB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het Amsterdamse parkeervergunningenbeleid

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked why Amsterdam's parking permit policy excludes older vehicles such as classic cars, whether an emissions-class (RDW) system would be fairer, whether municipalities may regulate this, which Amsterdam streets still exceed the air quality norm, and what legal change would be needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set parking policy within the Gemeentewet, that Amsterdam chose registration-date cut-offs pending RDW emissions-class registration, that municipal autonomy permits such rules, that NO2 exceedances remained on several named streets in 2017, and that changing the Wegenverkeerswet was not appropriate.
Municipalities determine their parking permit policy within the framework of the Municipalities Act.
Gemeenten bepalen binnen de kaders van de Gemeentewet hun beleid ten aanzien van parkeervergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over de informele Transportraad van 26-27 maart 2019

MPs Dijkstra and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the EU heavy-duty and car CO2 standards adopted at the March 2019 informal Transport Council count toward the 7.3 Mton mobility target, and why NEV 2017 already assumed some of these standards. The Staatssecretaris answered that the heavy-vehicle standards contribute 0.9-1.4 Mton, explained the NEV 2017 assumptions, and said the new standards will be included in the KEV 2019.
The tightened CO2 standards for passenger, light commercial and heavy vehicles will also be included in the Climate and Energy Outlook (KEV) of 2019.
De aangescherpte CO 2 -normen voor personen-, bestel- en vrachtauto's zullen ook in de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning (KEV) van 2019 worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Ronnes en Omtzigt over de doorrekening van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving (PBL)

MPs Mulder, Ronnes and Omtzigt (CDA) asked the ministers about the PBL cost calculation of the draft Climate Agreement's building-sector measures, including the costs per tonne of CO2 and transparency of assumptions. The minister answered that the calculations use standard insulation assumptions, that PBL has explained its models, and that the Climate and Energy Outlook may incorporate new insights.
PBL strives for full transparency about its calculations.
PBL streeft naar volledige transparantie over zijn berekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Bergkamp over het artikel 'Vrouwen kunnen niet autorijden en dit is waarom'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a newspaper column claiming cars are designed for men and that women face higher injury risk, and whether test dummies and data gaps should be addressed. The minister disputed the figures, argued the data show a lower mortality risk for women largely due to driving less, said representative dummies are already used, and saw no reason for new measures.
I see no reason at this time to take measures.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Boetes voor verstoren natuur op Waddenzee worden niet meer uitgedeeld'

MP De Groot asks whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why, and whether monitoring of blackbox systems in shrimp fishing and speeding enforcement are adequate. The minister replies that enforcement continues through several bodies, that some blackbox systems still do not function properly and are being fixed, that enforcement capacity is considered sufficient, and that a Wadden Sea management authority decision and a review of disturbance enforcement will follow.
I am in consultation with the parties involved to arrive at an adequate solution.
Ik ben in overleg met de betrokken partijen om tot een adequate oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Bosman over het bericht 'Vlaketunnel uren dicht door storing: lange files'

MPs Dijkstra and Bosman asked the minister about a failure that closed the Vlaketunnel for hours, causing long traffic jams, and whether Zeeland's access and tunnel closures could be avoided. The minister explained the SCADA power-supply fault during maintenance, outlined detour routes and planned replacement of the control system, and said a change to the Tunnelwet is not needed.
Currently various actions are being taken. Among other things, replacement of the SCADA system is being prepared.
Momenteel worden er verschillende acties ondernomen. Onder andere wordt vervanging van het SCADA systeem voorbereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over de 40dB-contour

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a changed departure route near Wezep affects the 40dB contour used as the MER study area, and whether the sensitivity analysis can legitimately substitute for assessing alternatives. The Minister replied that the 40 dB(A) contour is shown for information only without spatial restrictions, that the route variants differ in location not height, and that the effects on inhabitants were compiled and published, though the government did not commit to a new MER assessment of the altered route.
The aim of a possible route change is that less built-up area is overflown.
Het doel van een mogelijke routewijziging is dat er minder over bebouwd gebied wordt gevlogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Ruim 39.000 klachten over Maastricht Aachen Airport’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sharp rise in noise and other complaints about Maastricht Aachen Airport, growth plans, property value effects, taxiing noise, air quality, provincial investment and the extra runway length. The minister answered that movements fell in 2018 while large cargo and passenger traffic rose, that the province has paused its growth plans pending a new licence application with a full environmental and economic assessment, and that the airport's compensation scheme and runway rules apply, while several questions (property values, the province's finances) were left to the province or not studied.
This is a matter for the province of Limburg and the airport operator, respectively.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van de provincie Limburg respectievelijk de exploitant van de luchthaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Boer over integriteitskwesties bij de waterschappen

Member Den Boer (D66) asked ministers about 103 integrity cases across the 21 Dutch water boards over four years, why water boards show more cases than provinces and municipalities, and what steps are taken to strengthen integrity, including model codes of conduct and the basic integrity scan for new board members. The minister answers that integrity is primarily the responsibility of officials and board members themselves, points to existing toolboxes, handbooks and codes, explains the high count at Waternet by its size, and promises an evaluation of the integrity scan in 2019.
In 2019 the handbook will be evaluated, after which a next (digital) version will be published.
In 2019 zal de handleiding overigens worden geëvalueerd waarna (digitaal) een volgende versie zal verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Actiegroepen tegen laagvliegen willen wel, maar kunnen niet naar de rechter’

An MP asked whether the government deliberately blocked court appeals against regional airport decisions such as Lelystad Airport, and whether this breaches EU EIA rules. The minister answers that appeal to the administrative court is excluded for Lelystad but civil courts remain open, that the EIA directive does not require administrative appeal, and that the Commission correspondence will be shared confidentially.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht 'Een woonwijk tussen dijk en rivier? 'Dan kun je net zo goed op ijs bouwen'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether planned riverside housing in Arnhem meets modern flood-safety norms, whether the Rhine design discharge should be raised to 22,000 m3/s, what the upstream and downstream effects are, and whether the municipality's climate stress test covered the project. The minister answered that the project meets the Rijn river-bed frameworks, that flood safety for riverside housing is the municipality's responsibility, that the design discharge of 18,000 m3/s is confirmed, and that the project was not included in the municipal stress test because it lies outside the dike.
For activities and buildings (such as housing) in the riverside area, no statutory safety standards apply for protection against high water.
Voor activiteiten en bebouwing (zoals woningen) in buitendijks gebied gelden geen wettelijke veiligheidsnormen voor bescherming tegen hoogwater.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht ‘Aantal klachten over Eindhoven Airport stijgt sterk’

MPs Paternotte and Bruins asked about the sharp rise in noise complaints about Eindhoven Airport, whether the environmental impact assessment's runway split was breached, how the government will reduce complaints and enforce the MER, and how complaints feed into the Eindhoven Airport pilot case. The State Secretary answered that complaints rose to about 45,000 in 2018, that the MER contains no enforceable norms (the enforceable standard is the 35 Ke noise contour in the airport decree), that 63 percent of departures went south in 2018 due to wind conditions, and that route adjustments and a pilot case are underway.
The percentage of 65 to 75 percent used is therefore not a legal norm, and there is accordingly no obligation to have aircraft take off and land according to this percentage from the MER.
Het gebruikte percentage van 65 à 75 procent is dus geen wettelijke norm en er bestaat dan ook geen verplichting om vliegtuigen te laten opstijgen en landen volgens dit percentage uit de m.e.r.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Belhaj over het bericht "Angst voor lekken giftige stoffen uit 30 miljoen kilo munitie in Oosterschelde: 'Er moet echt wat gebeuren'

MPs Schonis and Belhaj asked about fears that 30 million kilos of old wartime munitions dumped in the Oosterschelde and North Sea could leak toxic substances and harm the environment and public health. The State Secretary of Defence answered that monitoring studies since 1998 show the risk is very small, that monitoring will continue, and that a regional information session and a summary of past reports are planned.
Rijkswaterstaat and Defence will jointly prepare a summary overview of all research reports and letters previously submitted to the House of Representatives.
Rijkswaterstaat en Defensie zullen daartoe gezamenlijk een samenvattend overzicht maken van alle in het verleden aan de Tweede Kamer aangeboden onderzoeksrapporten en Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over bezorgdheid vanwege komst Uber Freight naar Nederland

An MP asked the minister how the arrival of Uber Freight in the Netherlands would be assessed, how a level playing field, road safety and driver exploitation would be ensured, and whether talks with Uber would take place beforehand. The minister answered that Uber Freight must comply with all rules and that the minister will talk with Uber Freight to verify sufficient safeguards before launch.
I will talk with Uber Freight to satisfy myself that the service builds in sufficient safeguards in advance so that carriers comply with laws and regulations.
Ik ga met Uber Freight in gesprek om mij ervan te vergewissen dat de dienst vooraf voldoende waarborgen inbouwt dat vervoerders zich houden aan wet en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Remco Dijkstra over de A16 Rotterdam

Rep. Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that the minister would consider 80 km/h on the A16 Rotterdam, and about design speed, environmental margins, opening date and mitigation for residents. The minister answered that the road is designed for 120 km/h but will have a 100 km/h limit for uniform traffic flow and junction reasons, that air quality and noise stay within limits, that opening is planned for 2024, and that construction-phase nuisance is mitigated.
The maximum speed will however be 100 km/h, as also described in the Tracébesluit.
De maximumsnelheid zal echter 100 kilometer per uur zijn, zoals ook is beschreven in het Tracébesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Meer geld naar veilige weg'

An MP asked the minister about a report calling for more road-safety investment, whether provinces and municipalities could be pushed to spend more on road infrastructure, and how much provinces spend on roads. The minister agreed investment in safety is needed, pointed to the Strategic Plan for Road Safety 2030 and a planned autumn consultation with IPO, VNG and transport regions, and gave provincial spending figures while noting motor-vehicle-tax revenues are general funds.
In the autumn I will discuss progress on implementing the SPV with IPO, VNG and the transport regions during an administrative consultation.
In het najaar spreek ik tijdens een bestuurlijk overleg met IPO, VNG en de vervoersregio's over de voortgang van de uitvoering van het SPV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Die gevaarlijke pijnstiller uitbannen lukt maar niet’

MPs De Groot and Dik-Faber asked about a study and news report on pharmaceutical residues (diclofenac) in water, including EU priority substance listing, waterboard monitoring, province and Rijkswaterstaat action, hospital wastewater treatment and the Green Deal Duurzame Zorg. The minister agrees on the urgency, notes the EU has postponed revising the priority list, points to the chain approach and biomonitoring experiments, says hospital treatment depends on local circumstances, and promises to keep the Chamber informed on the Green Deal follow-up.
I will gladly keep you informed of the progress on both topics.
Ik zal u graag op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken op beide onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht ‘Franse staat koopt nieuwe aandelen Air France-KLM’

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether the French state was increasing its Air France-KLM stake, how the Dutch state protects its voting and governance position, and whether the stake purchase affects existing guarantees and cooperation arrangements. The minister answered that the French state is only participating in a convertible bond whose conversion would raise its stake by about 1%, that the Dutch state chose not to participate, and that no consequences follow for governance, guarantees or the 2003-2004 agreements, while cooperation talks are ongoing.
We cannot anticipate the outcomes of this.
Wij kunnen op de uitkomsten hiervan niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘VVD wil lozen van giftige resten in de Rotterdamse haven aanpakken.’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether a pilot area and a national ban on discharging toxic residues (vapour degassing) from ships in the Rotterdam port should be supported, and what restrictions exist. The minister supports the idea of gaining experience with degassing installations, refers the matter to the existing Taskforce and high-level group, and says a ban must come as soon as possible without fragmenting rules.
Of course, the emission of toxic vapour substances must be eliminated as quickly as possible, provided it is reasonably feasible to comply with the ban.
Natuurlijk moet zo snel mogelijk het uitstoten van dampvormige giftige stoffen uitbannen worden, onder voorwaarde dat het redelijkerwijs mogelijk is om aan het verbod te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht dat er afgelopen weekend zeecontainers in de Schelde terecht zijn gekomen

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether shipping containers blown into the Scheldt by storm winds threatened nature and environment in the Westerschelde, who is responsible and liable, and what steps would prevent pollution. The minister answered that the one container entered the Churchill dock on Flemish territory and was recovered, no pollution report was filed, and therefore no environmental harm occurred in the Westerschelde.
The container did not end up in the Scheldt.
De container is niet in de Schelde terecht gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Provinciaal ontgasverbod is een wassen neus’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that tankers illegally vent carcinogenic gas on the Waal and that provincial venting bans are ineffective, asking what powers the government has and what steps it will take with Rijkswaterstaat. The minister answered that the ADN convention does not ban venting outright, that the Scheepsafvalstoffenbesluit will be amended to ban venting in densely populated areas and near locks and bridges from late 2019, that a thematic enforcement action is being prepared, and that a nationwide ban is targeted for 2020 once legal basis exists.
However, based on the ADN the regulations in the Dangerous Substances Transport Act will be tightened.
Wel zal op basis van het ADN de regelgeving in de Wet vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Bruggen Afsluitdijk vol met gebreken: provinsje woest'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of defects in the Afsluitdijk bridges and the safety of their operation, and about maintenance status, reports, cost impact and timing of replacing the Kornwerderzand lock and bridges. The minister acknowledged the concerns, listed interim safety measures, gave a repair and replacement timeline, promised to send some reports later, and declined to answer the timing question on the cost options and the deadline for answers.
I will send you the relevant reports from 2016/2017 on the state of the bridges and the state of the locks, and the report from 2018 on the state of operation and control.

Ik zal u de relevante rapporten uit 2016/2017 over de staat van de bruggen respectievelijk de staat van de sluizen en het in 2018 verschenen rapport naar de staat van de bediening en de besturing doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Betsjinning brêgen en sluzen Ofslútdyk ûnbetrouber'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked why defects in the Afsluitdijk bridge and lock control systems were only investigated in 2018, what safety risks arose, and whether the cost and liability for the faulty installation would be pursued against the contractor. The minister answered that 15 related incidents occurred without accidents, extra staff and cameras were deployed, costs are about EUR 0.5 million, and Rijkswaterstaat will report on liability before summer.
Rijkswaterstaat will prepare a factual account before summer to determine the degree of liability and take a position on it.
Rijkswaterstaat maakt voor de zomer een feitenrelaas om de mate van aansprakelijkheid te bepalen en daar een positie over in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat er een vliegshow is georganiseerd boven Amsterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether the aerial display over Amsterdam followed safety procedures, stayed above the minimum altitude, and why residents were not informed in advance, along with emissions, noise, and climate questions. The minister replied that the permit and safety rules were followed, the minimum altitude was respected, the event was not secret but deliberately not widely advertised to avoid crowds, and emissions will be offset while the government is pursuing aviation sustainability.
There is no question of secrecy regarding the aerial display.
Er is geen sprake van geheimhouding van de luchtvaartvertoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Afsluitdijk dicht ook Fietsersbond baalt'

MPs asked the minister about the closure of the Afsluitdijk to cyclists for three years, the protests from cycling organisations, and whether temporary measures could keep the route open during high season. The minister confirmed the closure is needed for large construction works, pointed to a replacement bike bus, said temporary openings in summer are being investigated, and committed to sending the reply to the cycling organisations to the Chamber.
I am investigating whether temporary measures could make cycling over the Afsluitdijk safely possible on some days in high season.
Ik onderzoek of met tijdelijke voorzieningen op een aantal dagen in het hoogseizoen fietsen over de Afsluitdijk veilig mogelijk kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over duurzame luchtvaart

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about KLM's emissions-trading costs, airport and government charges, the Dutch aviation tax, and biokerosene policy. The minister gave substantive answers on the costs, referred to a benchmark sent to parliament, and referred to a separate policy letter for biokerosene incentives.
Furthermore, I have no information on possible passing-on of costs in those countries.
Verder heb ik geen informatie over mogelijke terugsluizing van kosten in die landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Sea-Watch 3 op last van Nederland aan ketting gelegd'

MPs Kröger and Van Ojik asked why the Dutch government requested Italy to detain the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship, whether this conflicted with earlier assurances to NGOs, and about rescue capacity in the Mediterranean. The minister answered that the ILT inspection followed Italian port-state findings, that safety comes first, that the inspection was not caused by foreign pressure, and that the ship is not chained, while largely refusing to explain policy-change timing and deferring to the letter for detailed conclusions.
The Netherlands asked Italy not to grant the ship permission to sail while the investigation was ongoing.
Nederland heeft Italië verzocht het schip geen toestemming te verlenen om uit te varen zolang het onderzoek liep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Kiwa Register start ‘veel te laat’ met uitgifte nieuwe tachokaarten’

MPs Dijkstra (VVD) and Stoffer (SGP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about delays in issuing smart tachograph cards, which may leave lorries unable to operate after 15 June 2019. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to capacity shortages at card producer Idemia, said the ILT assesses overmacht case by case rather than suspending fines, and stated that further solutions depend on talks with other member states and the European Commission.
The delay is caused by a shortage of capacity at card producer Idemia.
De vertraging wordt veroorzaakt door tekort aan capaciteit bij kaartproducent Idemia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het schrappen van tolheffing Westerscheldetunnel voor een betere bereikbaarheid Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister whether toll charges on the Westerscheldetunnel should be abolished to improve accessibility for Zeeuws-Vlaanderen, raising costs for commuters, competition concerns and population decline. The minister answered that the tunnel replaced ferries, tolls are needed to finance it, Zeeland province has agreed to cut tariffs about 20% from 2020, and the province is responsible for the foot-and-bicycle ferry.
I have no insight into that.
Ik heb daar geen inzicht in.
Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about Boeing 737 MAX certification, FAA oversight, EASA's flight-ban exceptions for ferry flights, and TUI aircraft returns after the two crashes. The minister's follow-up answer corrects an earlier error about whether a grounded TUI aircraft returned to the Netherlands, confirming one returned from Las Palmas while the other remains in Sofia.
The information on which the answer was based turns out, on closer inspection, not to be correct.
De informatie waarop het antwoord is gebaseerd, blijkt bij nader inzien niet te kloppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Laçin en Kröger over de wijze waarop zal worden omgegaan met de constateringen van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol in het toekomstige luchtvaartbeleid

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how she will take into account the Schiphol Environmental Council's finding that there is no support for further growth before improvements are made, how she reconciles public statements about growth and Lelystad with that advice, and how safety, climate and the 50-50 noise/growth rule will be handled in the upcoming Luchtvaartnota. The minister answered that she is pursuing two amendments to the Schiphol airport traffic decree (one to legally anchor the 500,000 movement cap, one for post-2020 development), will send the Chamber a response before summer, and that safety and climate will be addressed through the planMER process with a draft Luchtvaartnota after summer.
In preparation, I will send the Chamber a response to the chair's report of the ORS before summer, including a proposal for how this LVB will be shaped and how the environment will be involved.

Ter voorbereiding daarop zal ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een reactie op het verslag van de voorzitter van de ORS sturen, inclusief een voorstel voor de manier waarop dit LVB wordt vormgegeven en de omgeving wordt betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de brief van Schiphol aan omwonenden

An MP asked the minister about Schiphol's letter to 1.5 million residents over runway maintenance, including how the area was defined, the permits required, and why flights were not reduced. The minister answered that the letter reflects Schiphol's wider information ambition, that the exemption followed the normal legal and expert review process, and that the schedule must stay continuous within environmental limits.
Sending the letter has no effect on this procedure, and questions or reports arising from the letter are handled in the same way.
Het versturen van de brief heeft geen effect op deze werkwijze en vragen of meldingen naar aanleidingen van de brief worden op overeenkomstige wijze in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Geen boetes voor verstoren natuur in de Waddenzee’

An MP asked whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why enforcement is difficult under the Nature Conservation Act, and about capacity of the Wadden unit and closing areas to the public. The minister confirmed no disturbance fines were issued in the past year, described enforcement difficulties and ongoing consultation, and promised to inform parliament within half a year on outcomes and a decision on a Wadden management authority.
I expect to be able to inform your House within half a year about the outcomes of the consultation.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer binnen een half jaar kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Laan-Geselschap en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Tienduizenden boetes trajectcontrole A2-tunnel bij Maastricht zijn onterecht'

MPs asked whether unclear signage at the A2 tunnel near Maastricht made tens of thousands of average-speed fines invalid after a court ruling, and how affected drivers would be compensated. The minister replied that the signage met the rules, was clarified in late 2017, that the court only set one fine to zero on its facts, and that no collective correction is planned.
Rijkswaterstaat has indicated that the signage on the A2 meets the requirements for traffic signs. There is therefore no question of wrongly imposed fines.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft aangegeven dat de bebording op de A2 voldoet aan de eisen inzake verkeerstekens. Er is dan ook geen sprake van onterecht opgelegde boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de klimaatplannen van grote luchtvaartmaatschappijen falen, o.a. in relatie tot de recente aankoop van aandelen Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a Transition Pathway Initiative study showing airlines' climate plans fall short, and the Dutch state's purchase of Air France-KLM shares, are compatible with climate policy, and how the state as shareholder will act. The minister answered that the study's conclusions apply broadly but the government will pursue international aviation climate measures, rejects compensation-free assumptions, and states the shareholding serves public economic interests such as Schiphol's network rather than climate goals, with climate weighed in the forthcoming Luchtvaartnota.
Climate challenges have played no direct role.
Klimaatopgaven hebben geen directe rol gespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de Grote Kolksluis

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about plans to close the Grote Kolksluis permanently after the Meppelerdiep sluice was built, and about the impact on recreational boating, events and local businesses in Zwartsluis. The Minister confirmed the plan is being considered on cost grounds, saying the bridges will no longer be opened except for maintenance and events, and declined to designate the sluice as a national monument, saying that falls to another ministry.
Closing the movable bridges at the Grote Kolksluis lock complex does not come at the expense of safety.
Het afsluiten van de beweegbare bruggen bij het sluiscomplex de Grote Kolksluis gaat niet ten koste van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX
