MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the two Boeing 737 MAX crashes, the FAA's and EASA's grounding decisions, the Dutch airspace closure, certification and software-fix timelines, and passenger compensation. The minister answered that the Dutch closure followed EASA's binding order, that EASA and the Dutch decision do not differ substantively, and that the crash cause and software fix were still under review, with no firm timeline given.
Together with EASA it is being considered whether and when my decision to close Dutch airspace can be withdrawn.
Met EASA wordt afgestemd of en wanneer mijn besluit om het Nederlandse luchtruim te sluiten kan worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

An MP asked the minister why the Dutch airspace was closed immediately after the Boeing 737 MAX groundings without accommodating planes already en route, why no notification reached TUI earlier, whether the flights faced imminent danger, whether TUI's force majeure claim holds, and how quickly the ILT communicates. The minister answered that the closure was a precautionary national decision, that TUI was kept informed via a NOTAM and direct contact, that the diversions were TUI's own choice, that the situation may qualify as extraordinary circumstances for compensation to be decided by the court, and that the ILT stayed in close contact with EASA and TUI.
The decision to close the Dutch airspace as a precaution was taken by the Netherlands, not by EASA.
Het besluit om het Nederlandse luchtruim uit voorzorg te sluiten is niet door EASA maar door Nederland genomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Paternotte over de twee vliegtuigongelukken met de Boeing 737 MAX

MPs Amhaouch and Paternotte asked the minister about the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, including flawed FAA certification, the MCAS system, Boeing's role in certification, and the EASA ferry-flight exemption that let TUI aircraft return to the Netherlands. The minister answered that certification is primarily the FAA's and EASA's responsibility, that the Netherlands has no role or insight in it, that ferry flights were allowed under EASA rules, and that investigations are still ongoing.
Certification of Boeing aircraft is primarily the responsibility of the FAA.
Certificatie van Boeing-vliegtuigen is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de FAA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de stikstofdepositie bij luchthaven Lelystad

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked about nitrogen deposition from Lelystad Airport on Natura 2000 areas, why the AERIUS study was not published, whether construction and traffic emissions were included, and whether sufficient PAS deposition space is available. The ministers answered that the detailed calculations are available on request and a reader's guide was added, that construction and road traffic were assessed with negligible or no effect on sensitive areas, and that the project fits within reserved priority-project capacity via a notification.
This approach was chosen because the information is very extensive and technical in nature.
Er is gekozen voor deze werkwijze omdat de informatie zeer omvangrijk en technisch van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport alle vogels op de luchthaven wil en mag doden

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the province's permit allowing Rotterdam The Hague Airport to kill all wild bird species, including eggs and nests, goes beyond what is necessary, conflicts with Natura 2000 objectives, and whether the government will press the province to withdraw it and inform travellers about bird deaths. The minister replied that the province is primarily responsible for such permits, that the permit is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court, that it is not appropriate for the cabinet to judge this case, and that bird-strike control is a continuous process where killing is used only when other measures fail.
Primary responsibility for granting exemptions under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the provinces.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het verlenen van ontheffingen in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Von Martels over verbreding van de sluis bij Kornwerderzand

MPs Van der Graaf and Von Martels asked the minister about the widening of the Kornwerderzand lock, including the Prime Minister's statement that it will go ahead and how the remaining funding gap will be closed. The minister confirmed the statement, said no promises can be made on outcomes, and outlined work on cost optimisation, extra funding options with the region, and an employment-effects study.
With the regional administrators I made working agreements at the administrative consultation of 22 November, to look together for ways to close the financial gap that exists.
Met de regionale bestuurders heb ik in het bestuurlijk overleg van 22 november jl. werkafspraken gemaakt, om samen met hen op zoek te gaan naar manieren om het financiële gat, dat er is, te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the government had adequately studied bird strike risks around Lelystad Airport and why environmental NGOs' concerns had not been addressed. The minister rejected the critique, stated the bird research was thorough, and offered a further meeting with Vogelbescherming Nederland.
The Lelystad project within my ministry is willing to receive Vogelbescherming for an additional meeting.
Het project Lelystad binnen mijn ministerie is bereid om de Vogelbescherming te ontvangen voor een aanvullend gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the bird-impact research for Lelystad Airport was adequate, whether bird-scaring or killing measures are acceptable, and whether the airport decision should be suspended. The minister replied that the research (including a 2017-2018 baseline survey) shows no need for extra bird-scaring beyond the faunabeheerplan, that killing birds is a last resort, and that no defects justify suspending the decision.
No, I do not share that view. The bird research provides sufficient justification for a positive decision
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. Het vogelonderzoek geeft voldoende onderbouwing voor een positief besluit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Snels over het recente onderzoek ‘Taxing Aviation Fuels in the EU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about a CE Delft study on taxing aviation fuel in the EU, including legal obstacles, revenue estimates, CO2 effects and synthetic kerosene. The State Secretary answered that Chicago Convention and EU energy tax rules constrain a kerosene tax, estimated revenue of roughly 500-750 million euro, and said effects on demand depend on many factors requiring further study.
At the international conference on CO2 pricing and flight taxes that I am organising on 20 and 21 June, a kerosene tax will also be discussed.
Tijdens de internationale conferentie over CO 2 -beprijzing en vliegbelastingen die ik organiseer op 20 en 21 juni a.s. zal ook over een kerosinebelasting worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Amhaouch en Paternotte over ‘het verleggen van de laagvliegroute bij Hattemerbroek’

MPs asked the minister about a proposed rerouting of the low-flying departure route for Lelystad Airport near Hattemerbroek and Wezep, including its status, effects on the MER, affected municipalities and residents, and whether new housing was accounted for. The minister answered that no routing decision has been taken yet, that a limited route change would not affect the legal noise contours, that consultation with municipalities and residents' groups is ongoing, and that quantitative effects are still being assessed.
There is therefore no decision yet on a change of route.
Er is derhalve nog geen besluit tot een routewijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Kröger en Laçin over het bericht dat ‘de vliegroutes voor Lelystad Airport gewijzigd zijn tijdens de lopende zienswijzenprocedure’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why flight route changes for Lelystad Airport were made during an ongoing public comment procedure without involving municipalities such as Kampen, and whether residents' objections would be affected. The minister replied that the Wezep route is still only a proposal under consultation with neighbouring municipalities, that the amended MER already covers a possible route change without altering legal noise contours, and that no extension of the comment period is planned.
Partly on the basis of this advice, I will take a decision on a possible adjustment of the route.
Mede op basis van dit advies zal ik een besluit nemen over een mogelijke aanpassing van de route.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the government whether it promotes the 'Week zonder vlees' campaign, whether it will adjust ministry canteen meals and reduce meat consumption, and how it views external costs of meat. The government's answer refers to an earlier answer already given in parliament, leaving the substantive questions unaddressed.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03364, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03364 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'EU waarschuwt luchtvaart voor verlies vliegrechten bij Brexit zonder deal'

MPs Paternotte and Verhoeven asked whether Online Travel Agencies should warn consumers about no-deal Brexit effects on flights to and via the UK, and what the government would do about passenger rights and air connectivity. The minister said the EU proposal for contingency measures on basic air connectivity is supported, a provisional agreement was reached, a bilateral fallback is possible, EU passenger rights regulation 261/2004 still applies, and that OTAs' communication is not something the government can assess.
How communication between Online Travel Agencies and their customers proceeds, I cannot assess.
Hoe de communicatie tussen Online Travel Agencies en hun klanten verloopt, kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over de ongelukken op de A67

CDA MPs asked the minister about accidents on the A67 motorway, including recent accident figures for 2018 compared with 2017 and whether other sources than BRON are used, and which safety measures are being studied under the MIRT exploration. The minister says 2018 figures are not yet available in BRON pending quality checks, will only communicate validated BRON data, and lists short-term measures such as emergency lanes, better merging, and tyre-related incident prevention plus a capacity expansion in the Leenderheide-Zaarderheiken section.
Once the definitive figures are available, I will inform the House further about the accident situation on the A67.
Ik zal zodra de definitieve cijfers beschikbaar zijn de Kamer nader informeren over de ongevalssituatie op de A67.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht ‘Directeur probleemkind Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR) stopt ermee’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the departure of the CBR director, the tightened oversight of the CBR, the causes and remedies of its long processing times, and correspondence with the CBR. The minister answered that the director will not be reappointed, that oversight has been tightened and will stay so as long as needed, that the digitalisation project is the structural fix, and listed the correspondence shared with parliament.
The ministry's supervision of the CBR has recently been tightened by me and will remain tightened for as long as necessary.
Het toezicht door het ministerie op het CBR is onlangs door mij aangescherpt en zal aangescherpt blijven zolang dit nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het in het gevaar komen van de verkeersveiligheid nu een goede handhaving van de rij- en rusttijden niet meer kan worden gegarandeerd

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, following reports that the Inspectorate for Transport (ILT) cannot guarantee enforcement of driving and rest times due to sophisticated tachograph fraud and capacity limits, why capacity was not addressed instead of imposing levies on transport firms, and what concrete measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the fraud, denied new budget cuts, said the ILT prioritises via a risk analysis, and committed to tightening sanctions, including possible withdrawal of fitters' competence, with a further letter to parliament before summer.
I will inform your House further about the measures to be taken before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer verder informeren over de te treffen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de wens van het bedrijfsleven om vrachtvluchten op Twente Airport te laten vliegen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she knows of business demand for cargo flights at Twente Airport, whether this would help the Schiphol cargo slot shortage, and whether she will fund a quickscan. The minister replied that she knows of no concrete initiatives, that the province of Overijssel is responsible for Twente Airport, that regional airports will be considered in the upcoming Aviation Policy Note, and declined to commission a quickscan because the lead lies with the province.
Twente Airport is an airport of regional significance, for which the province of Overijssel holds competence.
Luchthaven Twente is een luchthaven van regionale betekenis, waarvoor de provincie Overijssel bevoegd gezag is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht 'Rechter: Biro moet van het fietspad'

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that the Biro vehicle must leave bicycle paths, including whether the verdict was in writing, whether municipalities are involved, and whether disabled users are disproportionately affected. The minister said the verdict was oral only and cannot be obtained in writing, that municipalities need not implement it, that the ruling does not cover adapted vehicles for disabled users, and that she will work with the consumer authority and other partners to clarify rules for such vehicles.
No, the verdict of the police judge was given orally only and has therefore not been put in writing.
Nee, het vonnis van de politierechter is alleen mondeling gedaan en is dus niet op schrift gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Van der Molen over de regelgeving voor verkeersregelaars

MPs Bruins Slot and Van der Molen ask why the 2017 amendment to the traffic controllers regulation makes it harder for volunteer event traffic controllers and their organisations, including the lack of substitution and individual-only e-instruction. The minister replies that the changes aimed to reduce administrative burden, that the process is supported digitally, that individual e-instruction is intentional, and that a meeting with SVNL is possible but no regulatory change is proposed.

I am always willing to talk with SVNL, but it is already possible to obtain appointment (after completing the e-instruction) as a volunteer event traffic controller for a period of one year per municipality.

Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met SVNL, alleen is het al mogelijk om de aanstelling (na het afronden van de e-instructie) tot vrijwillige evenementenverkeersregelaar voor een periode van een jaar per gemeente te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht 'Ontslag topambtenaar achtervolgt Dijkgraaf Klip'

An MP asked ministers about reports that a senior water board official's dismissal affected the dijkgraaf, including whether the general board was properly informed and whether confidentiality rules were followed. The minister answered that the general board itself must judge its conduct, that the province is the primary supervisor, and that the minister has no direct supervisory role over water boards.
Whether the right course was taken is up to the general board (AB) of the water board itself to assess.
Of er juist is gehandeld, is ter beoordeling van het algemeen bestuur (AB) van het waterschap zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Dik-Faber en Remco Dijkstra over de doorlooptijden bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

MPs asked why driving licence renewals at the CBR take so long, leaving people without valid licences and at risk of losing their jobs, and about poor communication and the four-week response standard. The minister acknowledged the delays, described CBR capacity expansion, priority handling for expiring licences and professional drivers, and extra information measures, but did not discuss specific cases.
The CBR must provide clarity on the renewal of the driving licence within four months. Unfortunately, this is currently not achieved in all cases by the CBR.
Het CBR dient binnen vier maanden duidelijkheid te geven over de vernieuwing van het rijbewijs. Dit wordt op dit moment helaas niet in alle gevallen gehaald door het CBR.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan en Laçin over de presentatie van het Rocky Mountain Institute (RMI) met betrekking tot luchtvaartemissies tijdens het World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos met het onderligg

MPs Kröger, Van Raan and Laçin asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the sector can meet its own aviation emissions targets, given RMI and European agency findings, and whether CORSIA, fuel options, emissions pricing, Lelystad Airport and growth plans are adequate. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the emissions trajectory depends on policy, defended CORSIA and ICAO processes, and said no decisions on Lelystad or future tax changes were pre-empted, while promising to raise the issue in ICAO and EU fora.
I am aware of both reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Politie zoekt getuigen van levensgevaarlijke rit over wielerparcours’

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked about police escort of cycling races, the legality of volunteer 'motards' directing traffic, and whether organisers should fund police presence. The minister answered that motards may not direct traffic while riding, that the police role is supervisory, and that the government will consult the KNWU and other parties on possible problems if police involvement is reduced.
Yes. I consider it important to get the possible problems clearly in view and to jointly explore possible solutions, including regarding the deployment of motards.
Ja. Ik vind het belangrijk om de mogelijke problemen goed in beeld te krijgen en gezamenlijk mogelijke oplossingen te verkennen, ook waar het gaat om de inzet van motards.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de verlopen vergunning voor medisch noodtransport vanaf Sint Eustatius

An MP asked about the lapsed permit that stopped the Sint Eustatius trauma helicopter from flying night medical missions, how it happened, and how to prevent recurrence. The government explained that a 2017 permit lapsed unnoticed, that no medical complications occurred, and that a temporary permit was issued in January 2019 with a formal review to follow, plus internal investigation and process reforms.
As for why no application was made after the ILT's first warning in December 2017, an internal investigation is underway at the public body of Sint Eustatius.
Naar de vraag waarom niet over is gegaan tot aanvraag na de eerste verwittiging van de ILT in december 2017 loopt intern onderzoek bij het openbaar lichaam Sint Eustatius.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over de radiouitzending 'Overheid is rem op vergroening'

The MP asks the Minister whether the Green Deal implements the Sienot motion on measuring emissions at the exhaust, whether old ship engines will force vessels out of service, how bankruptcy of inland shipping firms will be avoided, and how hydrogen engines are stimulated. The Minister says the motion is being implemented, the COBALD evaluation found on-board monitoring insufficient as an alternative to test-bench measurement, no old-engine norm is intended, financing options are being studied, and innovation is stimulated through a subsidy scheme.
I still see opportunities for measuring at the exhaust for the purposes of monitoring and signalling emissions.
Ik zie nog wel kansen voor meten aan de pijp ten behoeve van monitoring en signalering van emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Raan over de online omgevingsanalyse die is opgesteld in opdracht van de Omgevingsraad Schiphol (ORS)

MPs Laçin and Van Raan asked about an online environmental analysis commissioned by the Schiphol Environmental Council, its purpose, cost, and GDPR safeguards. The minister explains it was part of a broad public consultation on Schiphol's future, costing €45,375, and states that the ORS as a foundation must comply with the GDPR under supervision of the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
The Schiphol Environmental Council is a foundation and as such, like any other natural or legal person, must comply with the rules and obligations of the GDPR.
De Omgevingsraad Schiphol is een stichting en moet als zodanig net als iedere andere natuurlijke of rechtspersoon voldoen aan de regels en verplichtingen van de AVG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bezoek van de topman van Air France-KLM

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether ministers discussed declining public support for aviation, climate targets and possible aviation shrinkage with the Air France-KLM CEO during his January 2019 visit. The government confirmed the meeting covered the network, public interests and agreements, and said climate and safety were not discussed at group level but are raised regularly with KLM and Transavia.
These topics were not discussed at Air France-KLM group level in this meeting.
Deze onderwerpen zijn in dit gesprek op Air France-KLM groepsniveau niet aan de orde geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked the ministers about the large-scale sand extraction plans in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, covering alternative sites, drinking water effects, cumulative impacts on Natura 2000, the Habitats Directive ADC test, the Commission m.e.r. advice, and consistency with provincial plans. The minister answered that the chosen Gaasterland site was the most suitable after alternatives were considered, that drinking water effects are negligible, that no significant effects on Natura 2000 are expected so no ADC test is required, and that the municipality makes the final zoning decision.
This means that an important (final) assessment is left to the municipality De Fryske Marren.
Daarmee wordt een belangrijke (finale) afweging gelaten aan de gemeente De Fryske Marren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Bestuurslid luidt noodklok: 'Waterschap Rivierenland heeft straks een half miljard schuld'

MPs of the VVD asked the government about a report that water board Rivierenland faces a debt of half a billion euros, asking how financial positions of water boards are monitored, whether rising dike-reinforcement costs and interest rates threaten investment plans, and whether water boards keep to their core tasks. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answered that each water board is responsible for its own finances under oversight by its general board and the provinces (including the Wet FIDO interest-risk norm), that the cost trends are not yet a established trend and are being monitored, that dike safety planning is not in jeopardy, and that water boards' core tasks are legally limited with provinces supervising them.
Each water board is itself responsible for its own financial position.
Ieder waterschap is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de eigen financiële positie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de Merwedebrug nog maar 6 dagen restlevensduur had

An SP MP asked the minister how the inspection level of bridges can be guaranteed adequate after reports that the Merwedebrug had only six days of remaining service life, whether other bridges are in similar condition, whether funding for maintenance and replacement is sufficient, and whether inspections will be increased. The minister answered that safety standards keep risk very low though never zero, that other strategic bridges are under the regular inspection programme with no comparable cracking found, that budgets rise to around 350 million euros per year after 2020 with periodic updating, and that inspection regimes will be adjusted where needed.
Follow-up actions are carried out within the regular inspection and maintenance programme and within the Replacement and Renovation programme.
Vervolgacties worden uitgevoerd binnen het reguliere inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma en binnen het programma Vervanging en Renovatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug in 2016 bijna ingestort’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Merwedebrug nearly collapsed in 2016, and about bridge inspection quality and backlog maintenance risks. The minister denied a disaster was averted, explained the 2016 closure and inspection programmes, and said further measures are handled within existing programmes.
Oversight of the quality of the bridges has my full attention.
Het toezicht op de kwaliteit van de bruggen heeft mijn volle aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schonis over het bericht ‘Merwedebrug was bijna ingestort, Nederland aan ramp ontsnapt’

An MP from D66 asked the minister whether a remaining service life of six days for the Merwedebrug is safe, and what the threshold is for reinforcement, whether other bridges need review, and whether a long-term maintenance plan is needed. The minister answered that end-of-life still leaves the bridge structurally safe under wide margins, that a heightened inspection regime applies after that point, that strategic bridges were reviewed earlier, and that the existing Vervanging en Renovatie programme and inspection programme already cover maintenance.
This means that at the end of its service life the bridge is still structurally safe enough, but may over time no longer meet the safety standards.
Dit betekent dat de brug op het moment van einde levensduur constructief nog veilig genoeg is, maar dat de brug mogelijk op termijn niet meer aan de veiligheidsnormen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten dat prijsvechter Level vanaf Schiphol gaat vliegen en dat Ryanair stunt met prijzen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister about low-cost airline Level planning flights from Schiphol and Ryanair's €5 fares to London, including whether slot rules could prioritise mainport-serving and cleaner flights. The minister answered that slot allocation is the slot coordinator's responsibility, that current rules offer no way to prioritise such flights, and that a future air passenger tax and slot-rule changes are being pursued.

Because I consider it desirable that government gets more options to stimulate flights that strengthen Schiphol's (inter)continental network, I am working on creating additional possibilities for future steering.

Omdat ik het wenselijk vind dat de overheid meer mogelijkheden krijgt om vluchten die het (inter)continentale netwerk van Schiphol versterken te stimuleren, zet ik in op het creëren van aanvullende mogelijkheden voor toekomstige sturing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het artikel 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij duurzame aardwarmte'

MPs Van Brenk and Geleijnse asked about press reports that geothermal wells risk leakage, that three installations were already halted, and about contamination, monitoring and upcoming safety rules. The minister acknowledges the sector is young, says three operators voluntarily halted wells, notes no confirmed contamination yet, and promises new legislation, SodM requirements and forthcoming RIVM and SodM reports.
I therefore also endorse SodM's position that additional requirements for well design and monitoring must be implemented as soon as possible.
Ik onderschrijf daarom ook het standpunt van SodM dat extra eisen voor putontwerp en monitoring zo snel mogelijk geïmplementeerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de containers die overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden

Von Martels (CDA) asked the minister about the roughly 270 containers, some with toxic substances, lost overboard from MSC Zoe near the Wadden islands, covering liability, salvage, cooperation, causes, prior inspection follow-up, and tracking. The minister answered that the shipowner is liable and pays clean-up costs, a criminal investigation by the OM is ongoing, and tracking containers via chips is being explored but requires international agreements.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service must show whether criminal offences have been committed.
Uit het onderzoek van het OM moet blijken of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over het bericht dat 270 containers overboord geslagen zijn bij de Waddeneilanden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked ministers about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, including causes, health and environmental risks, liability of the shipowner, cooperation, lashing rules, container tracking and crisis coordination. The minister answered that causes are under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and foreign authorities, that the shipowner has been held liable and must clean up, that regional safety authorities coordinate the response, and that container chipping would need international agreement.
The cause of the containers going overboard is not yet known and is the subject of investigation by, among others, the Public Prosecution Service.
De oorzaak van het overboord slaan van de containers is nog niet bekend en onderwerp van onderzoek door o.a. het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot, Schonis, Bromet en Kröger over het bericht dat er 277 containers overboord zijn geslagen bij de Waddeneilanden, waarvan drie met benzoylperoxide

MPs asked how the government will protect nature and environment in the Wadden Sea after 277 containers, three holding benzoylperoxide, were lost overboard, and about responsibility, liability, tracing, monitoring, cleanup coordination and a future Wadden authority. The minister replied that retrieval is the priority, that Rijkswaterstaat and the Wadden Academy are studying the effects, that the shipping company is liable and has accepted cleanup costs, that the Veiligheidsregio Fryslân coordinates cleanup, and that the role of a future Wadden authority is still being decided.
The shipping company has been held directly liable on behalf of the State and obliged by Rijkswaterstaat to clean up under the Maritime Accidents Combating Act.
De reder is namens de Staat direct aansprakelijk gesteld en door Rijkswaterstaat tot opruiming verplicht op basis van de Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan de vissers Lauwersoog d.d. 6 januari 2019 en diverse berichten in de media over de overboord geslagen zeecontainers van

MPs from the VVD asked about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, its risks for fisheries and shipping, liability, recovery timelines, and container securing rules. The minister answered that the shipowner is held liable and must recover containers within a two-month expected timeframe, that investigations by the OM and OvV are underway, and that securing rules were tightened in 2016, but gave no exact compliance percentage.
At present no exact percentage is known of ships where cargo has been properly secured.
Op dit moment is geen exact percentage bekend van schepen waar op de juiste wijze lading vastgezet is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht in De Limburger ‘Fileleed A2 Weert-Eindhoven: snelle maatregelen laten op zich wachten’

MPs Remco Dijkstra and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why quick measures on the congested A2 Weert–Eindhoven route were delayed, including whether the 2017 traffic analysis still holds, what happened to a motion on innovative measures, and why road widening was not pursued. The minister replied that the 2017 picture remains current, listed the measures taken (a travel assistant, filesignalering, a lighting study) and the planned research, and explained that other regional bottlenecks were prioritised over widening, with a no-regret package being implemented.
The SmartwayZ.NL Programme Council has commissioned a feasibility study of additional measures from the 2017 MIRT research, excluding widening.
De Programmaraad SmartwayZ.NL heeft opdracht gegeven de haalbaarheid te onderzoeken van aanvullende maatregelen uit het MIRT onderzoek uit 2017, niet zijnde verbreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over legionellabesmettingen

Mr Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the minister about legionella risks from cooling towers and whether elderly residents of senior complexes and service flats are adequately protected, since such complexes fall outside the list of priority locations. The minister replied that a cooling tower map exists and oversight is adequate, but committed to amending regulations to add care dwellings to the priority list, instructed the ILT to act in the meantime, and to examine registration of housing types.
This means that I will shortly initiate a change in regulations to add such locations to the list of priority locations.
Dit betekent dat ik op korte termijn een wijziging van de regelgeving in gang zal zetten, om dergelijke locaties aan de lijst met prioritaire locaties toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

Member De Groot (D66) asked the ministers about the research on migratory fish near the Haringvliet sluices, the monitoring of bycatch, the failed voluntary fishing-restriction proposal and its financing, and the cost of the Kier decision. Minister Schouten answered that the study measures fishing impact on migratory species, that bycatch registration exists for relevant fisheries, that the current evidence shows limited impact so extra protection seems unnecessary pending results, and that the government did not take a passive role.
Individual catch records of fishers cannot be shared with third parties under the GDPR as business (economic) data.
Individuele vangstregistraties van vissers kunnen op grond van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG) als bedrijfs-(economische) gegevens niet met derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Uber opnieuw in opspraak: 'Het is wachten op de volgende dode''

An MP asks the state secretary about a fatal accident involving an Uber driver, whether Uber should be held responsible for driver rest times, whether ILT enforcement will be increased, and whether municipalities can limit taxi numbers. The government says the criminal investigation is ongoing, Uber has introduced a 10-hour offline rule and age/experience measures, ILT will run a taxi oversight programme in 2019, and it will study municipal volume-control options with municipalities.
I cannot anticipate the outcomes of the criminal investigation into the accident.
Op de uitkomsten van het strafrechtelijke onderzoek naar het ongeluk kan ik niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the government to respond to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, asking whether ministers agree with her criticism of climate policy, economic growth, and political inaction, and what concrete measures they will take (21 questions). The government's joint answer refers to the earlier answers to the questions and does not address the substance of the individual questions.
The written questions from MPs Van Raan and Teunissen (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24289, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen (beiden PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24289 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Remco Dijkstra, Van der Graaf, Von Martels, Gijs van Dijk, Van Aalst, Schonis en Laçin over de nieuwe prijsverhoging voor tachograafkaarten

MPs asked whether the government would accept a proposed 5% price rise for tachograph cards by Kiwa, how the Dutch price compares with neighbouring countries, and why the new fee system has not yet taken effect. The minister said the current card price stays at 95 euro while a new generation card is priced at 100 euro due to new EU requirements, promised a benchmark study and a letter later in the year, and refused to suspend the price increase despite a motion.
No, the tariffs for tachograph cards remain at the established price.
Nee, de tarieven voor de tachograafkaarten blijven op de vastgestelde prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over de chaos bij het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheidsbewijzen (CBR)

An MP from the PVV asks the minister about delays at the CBR (driving licence authority) that leave professional drivers out of work, and whether these will be resolved and who will compensate them. The minister acknowledges the delays, describes measures such as priority handling and a fast-track procedure, expects normal timelines by autumn 2019, and points to the CBR complaints procedure, the National Ombudsman and civil courts for compensation.
The CBR expects the processing times to be back in order by autumn 2019 at the latest.
Het CBR verwacht dat de doorlooptijden uiterlijk in het najaar van 2019 weer op orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Beroepschauffeurs werkloos door chaos bij CBR'

MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that professional drivers were left without work because of delays in medical assessments at the CBR, asking whether warnings existed, whether the backlog would be cleared, and how to prevent recurrence. The minister acknowledged the delays persist beyond expectations, said the CBR is helping affected drivers and that digitalisation should prevent future problems, and pointed to expedited procedures.
Last November I informed you that the processing times for medical assessments are still too long.
Afgelopen november heb ik u gemeld dat de doorlooptijden van medische beoordelingen nog steeds te lang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Die helm komt er, overal’

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Amsterdam's plan to move mopeds to the road and require helmets on busy bike paths, questioning its justification, evaluation timing, consistency across cities and enforcement. The minister answers that road managers must justify their traffic decisions, that the national government will monitor road safety effects and reconsider if negative side effects appear, and that the decision is decentralised within national frameworks.
If that monitoring shows that undesirable side effects on road safety occur, that is an important reason for me to reconsider my decision-making.
Als uit die monitoring blijkt dat ongewenste neveneffecten op de verkeersveiligheid optreden, dan is dat voor mij een belangrijke reden om mijn besluitvorming te heroverwegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Laçin over aanloopsteun voor luchtvaartmaatschappijen die opereren op luchthaven Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether state aid from northern provinces and municipalities to Groningen Airport Eelde (start-up aid and non-economic services costs) complies with EU state aid rules, including notification to the European Commission, discrimination between airports, and market economy investor tests. The Minister answered that responsibility for compliance lies with the airport's shareholders, declined to answer the substantive questions, and said the ministry would assess the economic basis when the airport applies for an airport decree.
Responsibility for compliance with and correct application of the state aid rules lies with the shareholders themselves.
De verantwoordelijk voor de naleving en correcte toepassing van de staatssteunregels ligt bij de aandeelhouders zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vliegveld Londen-Gatwick gesaboteerd met drones’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the drone disruption at London Gatwick airport and whether a similar situation could occur in the Netherlands, and what measures would be taken. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to existing drone bans and police enforcement, upcoming EU registration and identification rules expected in June 2019, and said consultation with other ministries and airports would follow on possible additional measures.
In the short term I will consult with the Ministry of Justice and Security and the various airports to see whether additional measures need to be taken.
Ik ga op korte termijn in overleg met het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de verschillende luchthavens om te bezien of er nog aanvullende maatregelen genomen moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Bodem zakt meer dan verwacht door droogte’

Two MPs asked the ministers about a report that Dutch soil is subsiding faster than expected because of drought, its causes, the expected costs, and who is liable for damage. The minister answered that drought and groundwater management cause the subsidence, that owners bear their own responsibility, that municipalities and water boards have a duty to weigh interests, and that insurers' coverage depends on policy terms.
If the damage is caused by unlawful action by the government, the injured party can hold the relevant government body liable through civil law.
Als de schade wordt veroorzaakt door onrechtmatig handelen door de overheid, dan kan de benadeelde het betreffende overheidsorgaan aansprakelijk stellen via de civielrechtelijke weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Veerstoep bij pontje moet beter beveiligd'

An MP asks the minister about reports that ferry landings (veerstoepen) are unsafe, with several deaths, and whether level crossing safety studies could include them. The minister says the local road manager and ferry owner are responsible, risk analyses will be done under the road safety plan, and the Chamber will be informed by year end.
Responsibility for the infrastructure lies with the municipality or the province, depending on where the ferry landing is located.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de infrastructuur ligt bij de gemeente, dan wel de provincie, afhankelijk van waar de veerstoep zich bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over de plannen voor grootschalige zandwinning in het IJsselmeer voor de kust van Friesland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a large-scale sand extraction plan in the IJsselmeer off Friesland, its effects on Natura 2000 nature, landscape, drinking water, restoration and whether less harmful locations were considered. The government answered that responsibilities are spread across Rijk, province, municipality and water boards, that environmental and appropriate assessments were carried out, and that no further talks with the province are planned.
In my view a careful weighing has taken place.
Naar mijn mening heeft een zorgvuldige afweging plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Overlast door bruiloftsstoet: de feiten’

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether wedding convoys disrupting traffic with antisocial manoeuvres, including a Rotterdam convoy throwing fireworks, are being tackled, how many such incidents occurred, and whether rental-car operators could be blacklisted. The minister replied that police act on reports and issue fines, that no separate registration exists, that investigation of the Rotterdam incidents is ongoing, and that no blacklist is considered necessary.
The police have informed me that no separate registration of these is kept.
De politie heeft mij laten weten dat hiervan geen aparte registratie wordt bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het vliegverkeer over de Buitenveldertbaan sterk is toegenomen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that daytime and night-time use of the Buitenveldertbaan at Schiphol had increased, and about measured noise exceeding modelled values. The minister answered that use rose about 24% by day but fell about 2% at night, attributed the increase to Kaagbaan maintenance and traffic growth, explained the preferential runway rules, acknowledged that measurements tend to exceed calculations, and announced a national programme to review noise measurement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Kröger over het bericht dat de Raad van State zich heeft laten misleiden door het ministerie van I&W

MPs Van Raan and Kröger asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Council of State was misled by the ministry about Schiphol noise norms, and whether the 10,000-homes norm was binding and required a PKB procedure to change. The minister answered that the criteria figures are outcomes of a calculation rather than absolute limits, that the actualisation was communicated to parliament and was lawful, that no PKB procedure or law change was needed, and that the norm still applies.
In this respect, therefore, no homes have been built that should not have been built according to the norm.
Er zijn in dit opzicht dus ook geen woningen gebouwd die volgens de norm niet gebouwd hadden mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan en Van Brenk over kritiek op motie Lelystad Airport

MPs Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan and Van Brenk asked whether completing the airspace redesign by 2023 is realistic, whether low-flying routes from Lelystad Airport will be gone by then, how low-flying routes are defined, and whether a plan MER is needed. The minister says the 2023 target stands, a start decision follows in spring 2019 and a preferred variant in 2020, but gives no guarantee that low-flying routes disappear by 2023, offers no definition, and leaves the plan MER question open.
As agreed in the Coalition Agreement, the Cabinet will implement the planned adjustment of the airspace by 2023.
Zoals is afgesproken in het Regeerakkoord gaat het Kabinet de voorgenomen aanpassing van het luchtruim per 2023 realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over de behandeling van assistentiehonden door luchtvaartmaatschappijen

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked the ministers how airlines such as KLM may verify and treat assistance dogs, including the lack of an official accreditation system and differences between hulphonden and emotional assistance dogs. The minister replied that Dutch law allows refusal only for disproportionate burden or safety reasons, that no accreditation system exists yet pending a European standardisation process, and that the government will remain involved in that process.
It is therefore not an absolute right.
Het is daarmee geen absoluut recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Spoor in plaats van vliegen kansloze missie’

An MP asked the Infrastructure Minister and State Secretary about cost comparisons between rail, road and aviation infrastructure, government spending and revenues by mode, and whether all costs should be weighed in modal choices. The government answered that it funds infrastructure mainly via the Infrastructure Fund, that full per-kilometre cost comparisons are complex, commissioned KiM research, and committed to outputs for the Mobility Fund in early 2019.
We will also use the outcomes of these studies when developing the Mobility Fund.
We zullen de uitkomsten van deze studies ook benutten bij de uitwerking van het Mobiliteitsfonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Lightyear in Helmond wil lage bijtelling zonne-auto’s'

MPs Sienot and Remco Dijkstra asked whether the government supports solar-powered cars such as Lightyear's, whether a workable legal definition is possible, and whether the zero-emission company-car tax exemption for hydrogen cars could be extended to them. The state secretary answered that the government supports the innovation through several channels, that a definition is feasible but needs further study, and that the tax treatment will be reviewed and reported to parliament by mid-2019.
It is too early to attach concrete criteria to this yet.
Het is te vroeg om hier nu al concrete criteria aan te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de voorbereidingen voor de aanbesteding en uitvoering van de A27 Lunetten Rijnsweerd

A GroenLinks MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about preparations for tendering the A27 Lunetten-Rijnsweerd widening, including technical risks to the tank and foil structure, groundwater and nearby nature, contractor interest, liability for damage, repair costs and lessons from the A4 leak. The minister answered that tendering is planned for the first half of 2019, that risks are manageable under contract requirements, that liability is allocated to the contractor, and that exact methods are not yet known.
The contractor is responsible for carrying out these measures.
De aannemer is verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het onderzoek naar de Lion Air-crash

An MP asked the minister about problems with Boeing 737 MAX software after the Lion Air crash, including which airlines fly the type to the Netherlands, whether Dutch aviation authorities know of technical problems, and whether procedures are adequate. The minister answered that no prior problems were known, that international and EU certification rules apply, that the ILT sees no reason for further action, and that procedures are in order without guaranteeing no future incidents.
The cause of the accident is still under investigation by the Indonesian authorities, in accordance with international treaties.
De oorzaak van het ongeval is nog in onderzoek bij de Indonesische autoriteiten, conform de internationale verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de recent gepubliceerde factsheet Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad Airport

An MP asked the minister whether Lelystad Airport really relieves Schiphol and its neighbours, given that freed capacity will be refilled with new, noisier intercontinental flights, and whether the factsheet was misleading. The minister explained the relief in terms of the 2008 Aldersakkoord framework and the freed slots for network flights, and agreed to revise the factsheet's wording.
Because, despite my explanation in the previous answer, the word 'relieve' evidently causes confusion, I have amended the factsheet on this point.
Omdat ondanks datgene dat ik in het voorgaande antwoord heb toegelicht het woord «ontlasten» blijkbaar voor onduidelijkheid zorgt, heb ik de factsheet op dit punt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘Roep om geluidsschermen langs snelwegen in 't Gooi: ‘Elke nacht wakker’’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise from the A1 motorway near Naarderbos in Gooi, a local news report on residents' complaints, and possible solar noise barriers. The minister answered that the site is in a sanitation backlog but not in the first phase of the noise programme, that a noise barrier is still under study, that solar panels can be considered, and that Rijkswaterstaat would meet residents and the municipality.
I therefore gladly want to consult with the residents about this.
Ik ga daarom graag met de bewoners hierover in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Het rode gevaar komt uit het westen’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the American crayfish harms Dutch waters, including its effects on biodiversity, extra dredging, EU water quality targets, and whether the Fisheries Act blocks effective control. The minister answered that species-specific risks are known, that fishing exemptions and water board contacts exist, that further research is with regional partners, and that recreational use of professional gear is not desirable.
It is up to the regional parties to determine whether further research is worthwhile.
Het is aan de regionale partijen om te bepalen of verder onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het lozen van giftige gassen door tankers in Gelderland

CDA MPs Von Martels and Geurts asked the government about tankers venting toxic gases in Gelderland, whether venting is legal, when it will be banned nationwide, and how enforcement is organised. The minister replied that venting by inland vessels is still permitted except for benzine, that a ban under the Scheepsafvalstoffenverdrag is being implemented around 2020, and that enforcement of provincial rules lies with the provinces, while promising to proceed with the ban.
Work is proceeding briskly on preparing the entry into force of the national venting ban, which is foreseen for 2020.
Er wordt voortvarend doorgewerkt aan de verdere voorbereiding van de inwerkingtreding van het nationale ontgassingsverbod, die voorzien is in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Tankers lozen elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas vanaf de Waal’

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that tankers illegally vent carcinogenic gas from the Waal every day, asking what steps will stop it and how enforcement works. The minister responded that a national ban on venting is planned for 2020 pending ratification of an international treaty amendment, that enforcement lies largely with the provinces, and that a taskforce has been set up to design enforcement.
I have, together with the provinces concerned, set up a taskforce led by the province of Noord-Holland to enable effective introduction of the venting ban in 2020.
Ik heb samen met de betrokken provincies een taskforce ingesteld onder leiding van de provincie Noord-Holland om een effectieve invoering van het ontgassingsverbod in 2020 mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Groot over het bericht 'Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken'

An MP asked whether fishing near the Haringvliet sluices threatens fish migration investments, including how much fishers earn, compensation, and whether fishing has increased. The minister answered that fishing has actually decreased near the sluices since 2011, that migratory species are largely not targeted, and that no large-scale problem requires additional restrictions.
The precise turnover of the various fishing activities taking place near the Haringvliet sluices is unknown.
De precieze omzet van de verschillende visserijvormen die in de omgeving van de Haringvlietsluizen plaatsvinden is onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over barrières voor Europese trekvissen

An MP asks the ministers about barriers to European migratory fish, the costs of fish passages, and whether fishing near migration hotspots such as Kornwerderzand, Den Oever and the Haringvliet should be banned. The minister answers that barriers are necessary for water safety, freshwater supply and shipping, that fishing impacts are limited, and refers to earlier answers on the fishing questions without a concrete new commitment.
All barriers are strictly necessary because of functions such as water safety, sufficient (fresh) water and shipping.
Alle barrières zijn strikt noodzakelijk vanwege functies als waterveiligheid, voldoende (zoet) water en scheepvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht ‘Gehandicapte in de kou door Brussel’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the EU exemption allowing heavier zero-emission vehicles on B licences covers goods transport but not school and disabled passenger transport, and what the government did to change that. The minister answered that Brussels rejected the extension on road-safety and passenger-volume grounds, that the exemption cannot be enforced nationally, and that conventional vehicles remain available, while talks with sector bodies continue.
Ultimately it was decided that an exemption for passenger transport will not come.
Uiteindelijk is besloten dat een ontheffing voor personenvervoer er niet komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oproep na vliegtuigincident: wissel zwarte lijsten uit’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about unruly airline passengers, the damage they cause, and why shared blacklists of banned passengers have not yet been implemented. The minister answered that incidents are reported to the ABL, that Dutch airlines are examining sharing blacklists with the Dutch data protection authority, and that international action will follow once national clarity exists.
At national and international level I am taking action so that airlines can share blacklists in order to exclude disruptive passengers.
Op nationaal en internationaal niveau onderneem ik actie zodat luchtvaartmaatschappijen zwarte lijsten kunnen uitwisselen om zo ordeverstorende passagiers te kunnen weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Rutte in gesprek met Alibaba over Europees distributiecentrum’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked about reports that the Prime Minister met Alibaba about a European distribution centre near Maastricht-Aachen Airport, with questions on jobs, environmental and noise impacts, the RLI mainport report, Belgian airspace arrangements and whether the government would reconsider. The minister declined to disclose details of the meeting as commercially confidential, called environmental effects a matter for future permit procedures, and reaffirmed general support for logistics investment.
It is not for the cabinet to disclose information from conversations with individual companies, as these are often commercially confidential in nature.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om informatie uit de gesprekken met individuele bedrijven openbaar te maken, omdat deze veelal bedrijfsvertrouwelijk van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Von Martels over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast Sluiskil

MPs Van den Berg and Von Martels asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the maintenance of the Gent-Terneuzen canal and groundwater flooding in Sluiskil, including follow-up to earlier questions, causes, responsibility and remedies. The minister listed completed and ongoing maintenance actions, attributed the moisture problem to high groundwater and pre-Bouwbesluit housing, denied shared responsibility with the municipality and North Sea Port, and said Rijkswaterstaat will not directly consult the parties but will help if maintenance recurs.
Rijkswaterstaat has agreed with North Sea Port and the municipality of Terneuzen that the municipality maintains contact with those involved.
Rijkswaterstaat heeft met North Sea Port en gemeente Terneuzen afgesproken dat de gemeente contact onderhoudt met betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Langer 100 km/u op A32 bij Heerenveen’

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked whether a Heerenveen newspaper report about keeping 100 km/h on the A32 implied noise-norm breaches, and whether speed limits should be lowered without noise, environmental or safety grounds. The minister replied that no noise norms are exceeded on the stretch, that the municipality may fund extra noise measures but has not announced any, and that speed limits will be reviewed periodically and published in a draft traffic decree.
The 2016 noise production ceiling compliance report shows that on this road section there is no exceedance or imminent exceedance of the established noise production ceilings.
Uit het nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016 blijkt dat er op dit wegvak geen overschrijding of dreigende overschrijding plaatsvindt van de vastgestelde geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in het Europese wegtransport

An MP asks the ministers about abuses in European road haulage, including the ease of obtaining driver certificates in other EU states, Polish control capacity, poor living conditions and low pay of non-EU drivers, enforcement of rest times, supply-chain liability, and applying the Posted Workers Directive to transport. The government answers that it lacks comparative data, cites enforcement figures (165 fine reports), explains existing supply-chain liability rules, and says it is pursuing equal pay for equal work through the EU Mobility Package.
As far as I have been able to ascertain, no comparative research has been carried out into the requirements that different member states impose on applications for certificates.
Er is, voor zover ik heb kunnen nagaan, geen vergelijkend onderzoek gedaan naar de eisen die in de verschillende lidstaten worden gesteld aan aanvragen van attesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de groeiplannen van Eindhoven Airport en de gevolgen voor de natuur

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Eindhoven Airport's growth scenarios would increase CO2, nitrogen and fine-particle emissions, conflict with Natura 2000 protection and the PAS, and whether a critical report was withheld. The government answered that the scenarios are analytical only, no decision has been taken, growth would be assessed as a priority project only later, and the report was not suppressed but published with a delay by the municipality.
The report concerned on nitrogen deposition was not withheld.
Het betreffende rapport over stikstofdepositie is niet achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht 'Trekkerrijbewijs zorgt voor uitsluiten buitenlandse stagiaires'

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the T-licence rule that reportedly excludes foreign interns from driving agricultural tractors on public roads. The minister confirmed the rule, explained the grandfathering for licences issued before 1 July 2015, and said interns can still operate tractors on private land and the rule is non-discriminatory and justified by road safety.
The requirement is non-discriminatory and applies to everyone, regardless of nationality.
De eis is non-discriminatoir en geldt voor iedereen, ongeacht nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Spanish cities grapple with invasion of electric scooters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about Spanish cities struggling with electric scooters and whether similar initiatives, safety rules and experimentation room exist in the Netherlands. The minister replied that electric steps are currently classed as special mopeds with rules being reviewed by SWOV, RDW and the Safety Board, that municipalities cannot themselves admit vehicles to public roads, and that the Strategic Road Safety Plan will take these developments into account.
Municipalities cannot independently decide to admit vehicles to the public road.
Gemeenten kunnen niet zelfstandig besluiten om voertuigen toe te laten tot de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Files en ongelukken op A50: 'Het is hard nodig dat stuk tussen Oss en Nijmegen wordt aangepakt'’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about traffic jams and accidents on the A50 between Oss and Nijmegen, including its place in national capacity analyses, freight and cost figures, and whether funding and regional cooperation could fix it. The minister answered that the A50 is not in the coalition agreement or the NMCA top 10 so it is not a current investment priority, but agreed to a joint regional study of causes and solutions to be discussed at the MIRT meeting of 21 November 2018.
Nevertheless, I am willing to work with the region to look at the causes and possible solutions for traffic obstruction on the A50.
Desondanks ben ik wel bereid om samen met de regio te kijken naar de oorzaken en mogelijke oplossingen voor verkeershinder op de A50.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Miljoenen nodig om tunnels brandbestendig te maken’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, following a press report, about the cost of making four recently completed tunnels and one under construction fire-resistant, whether the Rijkswaterstaat guidelines complied with fire-resistance rules, and whether pre-2008 tunnels are safe. The minister answered that repair costs are estimated at 105 to 135 million euros plus up to 100 million for the Gaasperdam contract, that contract requirements have been tightened, and that there is currently no reason to think older tunnels are insufficiently fire-resistant, with further research due in 2019.
I expect to be able to inform the House further about the results in 2019.
Over de resultaten zal ik de Kamer naar verwachting in 2019 nader kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht 'Minister geeft geen extra geld voor Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will honour the coalition agreement and earlier commitments on the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht and the Utrecht ring road, and why no extra funding is provided. The minister answered that the state contribution of 168 million euro is sufficient, that extra non-statutory measures must be financed by the region, and that the municipality has committed to implementing the existing plan in 2020-2025.
Since IenW already contributes substantially (168 million euro) to this municipal project, I have indicated that I see no further possibility to supplement this amount.
Aangezien IenW al substantieel bijdraagt (€ 168 mln) aan dit gemeentelijk project, heb ik aangegeven geen verdere mogelijkheid te zien om dit bedrag verder aan te vullen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de artikelen ‘Brandbrief na heftige ziektegevallen in Brabant: niemand controleert waterzuivering op legionella’ en ‘Man uit Boxtel doodziek door legionella uit een waterzuiv

An MP asked the minister whether municipalities and provinces have ordered inspections of biological wastewater treatment plants for Legionella after illnesses in Boxtel, and who is responsible for acting. The minister answered that no Legionella standards exist yet, that the competent authorities and companies are responsible and are acting, and that the omgevingsdiensten will start a risk study with RIVM.
In addition, the omgevingsdiensten, as indicated above, will shortly start a study into risk factors and approach.
Daarnaast zullen de omgevingsdiensten, zoals hierboven ook aangegeven, op korte termijn starten met een onderzoek naar risicofactoren en aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het gebrek aan toezicht op legionella afkomstig van afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

An MP asks ministers why wastewater treatment plants linked to legionella outbreaks at Vion and Rendac face no legionella controls, whether oversight is adequate and what will be done. The minister answers that the link was previously unknown, that local authorities acted correctly and that temporary measures are in place while permanent rules and further research are being prepared.
In addition, I will have the possibilities examined for including requirements on legionella for wastewater treatment as well.
Daarnaast laat ik in kaart brengen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om ook voor afvalwaterzuivering eisen op te nemen met betrekking tot Legionella.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de brandbrief van de gemeente Aalsmeer m.b.t. de nachtvluchten vanaf de Aalsmeerbaan

MP Kröger (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why night flights from the Aalsmeerbaan were permitted during the control tower renovation, whether affected municipalities were consulted, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The Minister answered that LVNL requested a temporary exemption, that the runway would be used only in exceptional situations with monitoring and notification, and that the exemption was published in the Staatscourant.
The ministry has agreed with LVNL that during the works the use of the Aalsmeerbaan will be monitored and that LVNL will report on the BAS website whenever the exemption is used.

Het ministerie heeft met LVNL afgesproken dat gedurende de werkzaamheden de inzet van de Aalsmeerbaan wordt gemonitord en dat LVNL op de website van het Bewonersaanspreekpunt Schiphol (BAS) melding maakt als er gebruik wordt gemaakt van de vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de vestiging van een fabriek voor bio kerosine

An MP asked the minister whether a decision on a biokerosene factory is imminent, when the House will be informed, what the CE Delft study implies, and about timing, jobs and location. The minister said the investment is a private decision, promised a letter on aviation sustainability including biokerosene availability at Schiphol by 2022, and referred the remaining questions to that answer.
I therefore cannot make statements about whether and when a final decision will be taken regarding the biokerosene factory.
Ik kan dus geen uitspraken doen over of en wanneer er een definitieve beslissing zal vallen inzake de fabriek voor biokerosine.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten “Frankrijk wil tolvignet voor vrachtwagens” en “Franse minister wil tolvignet voor buitenlandse vrachtwagens”

An MP asked the Infrastructure minister how France's proposed toll sticker for trucks, aimed at foreign lorries, fits EU policy, what it means for Dutch hauliers, and whether it can be discussed with France. The minister replied that such vignettes exist in several member states, that a national-only vignette for foreign vehicles would be discriminatory under EU law, that she will watch closely that Dutch transporters are not discriminated against, and that since France has no concrete plan yet, any discussion would most likely be bilateral.
If a French vignette is introduced, I will closely monitor that our Dutch transporters are not discriminated against.
Als een Frans vignet zal worden ingevoerd, zal ik er scherp op toezien dat onze Nederlandse transporteurs niet gediscrimineerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het interview ‘De Wending’ met Dhr. Leon Adegeest

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether ministry officials intimidated Leon Adegeest, a Lelystad Airport critic, and about contacts with him and other stakeholders. The minister denied recognizing the intimidation picture, described the stakeholder contacts as part of the MER and advisory process, and stated no known cases of pressuring critics.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the interview.
Het in het interview geschetste beeld herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘ministerie dendert door met vliegtaks’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers why the ministry is pushing ahead with an aviation tax, how it fits the three-track policy, and how the EU, sector and other countries are involved. The government answers that it is pursuing all three tracks in parallel, that a national aviation tax may be introduced from 2021 if the European and emissions/noise routes yield too little, and that consultation, bilateral contacts and a Brussels coordination effort are underway.
The cabinet will make a choice this autumn on which variant can be worked out in national legislation
Het kabinet maakt dit najaar een keuze welke variant in nationale wetgeving kan worden uitgewerkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de belemmering van de 'vaste laag' bij Nijmegen voor de binnenvaart

An SGP MP asked the minister whether the hard layer in the Waal near Nijmegen, which limits inland shipping depth during drought, should be removed, and about its costs, effects and expected droughts. The minister acknowledged the issue, said a study on riverbed erosion will soon be completed and will inform Parliament, and deferred substantive answers on the hard layer to that reaction.
How to deal with the hard layer near Nijmegen, the consequences of bed erosion and the possible solutions will be included in my response to the aforementioned study.
Hoe om te gaan met de vaste laag bij Nijmegen, de consequenties van bodemerosie en de mogelijke oplossingen zal ik meenemen in mijn reactie op het eerder genoemde onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Vis kan eindelijk door Haringvlietdam, maar daarachter wachten netten en fuiken’

MPs Weverling and Remco Dijkstra asked about the opening of the Haringvliet dam sluices (Kierbesluit), concerns over saltwater intrusion into freshwater supplies during drought, monitoring, and evaluation. The ministers answered that freshwater intakes were relocated, saltwater intrusion is avoided in low-Rhine-flow periods, monitoring and telemetry will follow the effects, and no evaluation conclusions can yet be drawn.
Work is done on a risk-controlled basis, starting with smaller openings and situations with relatively high Rhine discharge.
Er wordt risico-gestuurd gewerkt, waarbij gestart wordt met kleinere openingen en situaties met relatief veel Rijnafvoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Amhaouch over de halfjaarcijfers van NS

MPs Ronnes and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about NS half-year results, including the 1% net return, the normrendement band and its history, the gap with the 7% target, and a 400 million euro working-capital swing linked to student transport payments. The government answered that the normrendement is 4%-6% since 2017, that the working-capital swing is mainly timing of the OV-studentenkaart payment, and that the state keeps a watchful eye on NS's return on equity.
The timing of payment by the state is therefore partly determinative of NS's working capital.
Het moment van uitbetaling door het Rijk is dus medebepalend voor de hoogte van het werkkapitaal van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over de gevolgen van de Brexit voor de Nederlandse luchtvaart

MPs Paternotte and Jetten asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch aviation, including Airbus contingency plans, flight permissions, licences and a future air services agreement with the UK. The minister answered that companies are responsible for their own preparations, that the government will work with the EU and sector partners on contingency measures, and that aviation rights with the UK will be sought at EU level.
It is not the role of the cabinet, certainly not for individual companies, to speculate about the possible relocation of activities.
Het is niet de rol van het kabinet, zeker niet bij individuele bedrijven, om te speculeren over de mogelijke verplaatsing van activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over oliebedrijf Odfjell, die de rekening van de olieramp in de Rotterdamse haven wil doorschuiven naar de Nederlandse belastingbetaler

MP Wassenberg asked whether the Odfjell shipping and owner NCC should pay for the Rotterdam oil spill cleanup and whether Odfjell should be barred from the port if it refuses. The minister answered that total damage is not yet known, liability is being pursued under the Bunkers Convention with a liability-limitation request pending before the Rotterdam court, and that barring Odfjell would be disproportionate.
At this moment it is not yet known what the total extent of the damage is.
Op dit moment is nog niet bekend wat de totale omvang van de schade is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over veiligheid in tunnels

Von Martels (CDA) asked the Infrastructure Minister about a reported secret 'Pact van Houten' and fire-safety problems in recent tunnels, including whether results were withheld and whether the Chamber was informed. The minister denied any secret pact or concealment, acknowledged that concrete in four new tunnels does not meet fire requirements, and promised to inform the Chamber of measures within a month, though closures were not yet known.
On the measures I intend to take to bring the tunnels back into compliance with the requirements, I expect to inform you within a month.
Over de maatregelen, die ik van plan ben te nemen om de tunnels weer aan de eisen te laten voldoen, informeer ik u naar verwachting binnen een maand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over verplichte bijscholing voor ervaren chauffeurs

An MP asks why experienced older truck drivers must now take retraining to keep code 95 on their licence, what the costs are, and why the government does not allow automatic recording. The minister explains that the EU Commission required ending the exemption and automatic entry under the Driver Qualification Directive, promises consultation with the sector on costs and targeted information, and says the government has no facts on forged code 95 licences.
To prevent an infringement procedure at the Court of Justice of the European Union, a legislative process is being started to end the validity of these codes before then.
Om een infractieprocedure bij het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie te voorkomen wordt een wetgevingstraject ingezet teneinde de geldigheid van deze codes voor die tijd te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat liet vrijwilligers op eigen risico zwanen schoonmaken na olieramp’
