An MP asked the minister whether Rijkswaterstaat wrongly had volunteers sign waivers of damage claims and whether it would monitor long-term health and ecological effects of the Bow Jubail oil spill, and who bears long-term costs. The minister acknowledged the waiver form was wrong, said RIVM found irritant substances with temporary symptoms, reported no evidence of chemical admixture, and explained the shipowner is liable under international conventions, though a limitation procedure is pending.
That should not have been in there.
Dat had er niet moeten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Moerdijk vraagt hulp bij problemen met Albanese inklimmers’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Moerdijk needs help with Albanian stowaways climbing into lorries and ships, and whether the ministry would take a national lead, talk with the port authorities and promote awareness campaigns. The minister says controls at maritime border posts have been intensified, that several bodies are working on the problem, that outreach to drivers is underway, and that tailored solutions per location and secure truck parking are being pursued, without committing to new specific steps.
Various bodies are working on measures for the stowaway issue.
In diverse gremia wordt er gewerkt aan maatregelen voor het «inklimmersvraagstuk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘AirBridgeCargo verkiest Luik boven Schiphol als Europese hub’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about AirBridgeCargo shifting part of its European hub operations to Liège, cargo slot scarcity at Schiphol, job risks, and alternatives such as Maastricht Aachen Airport. The minister said AirBridgeCargo will keep operating via Schiphol, acknowledged that some cargo carriers moved operations due to slot shortages, announced further research and a possible revision of the local slot rule, but could not quantify job losses.
It is currently not possible to reliably quantify the potential damage.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om de potentiële schade op betrouwbare wijze te becijferen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘OM moet tienduizenden flitsboetes A29 terugbetalen’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the OM must refund tens of thousands of speeding fines on the A29 at Heinenoord, and when the OM knew of the doubts, whether the fines will be refunded and when, whether other locations are affected, and whether small-speed fine margins should change. The minister answered that the measurements were considered reliable until a court ruling of 16 July 2018, that the OM has appealed and is awaiting the outcome, that refunds will follow only if the appeal court finds the measurement unreliable, and that the fines policy will be addressed to parliament in autumn.
The OM has lodged an appeal. The outcome of this will first have to be awaited.
Het OM heeft hoger beroep ingesteld. De uitkomst hiervan zal eerst moeten worden afgewacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het artikel ’Vlag, volkslied, vliegveld; de toekomst van Schiphol’

An MP (Van Raan, PvdD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about critiques that the cost-benefit analysis for Schiphol growth fails criteria and contains errors, including on CO2 prices, discount rate, employment figures and the Rli advice on mainport policy. The minister defends the exploratory MKBA as a transparent, non-binding study, acknowledges a discount-rate issue that would raise climate costs by a factor 2-2.3 without changing conclusions, and promises a broader Luchtvaartnota with knowledge base and participation.
Therefore, but mainly because the main conclusions do not change, this exploratory MKBA will not be amended.
Daarom, maar vooral omdat de hoofdconclusies niet wijzigen, wordt deze verkennende MKBA niet aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht dat het spoor volgens ProRail vol begint te raken

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether ProRail's warning that the Dutch rail network is filling up, with a capacity problem possible within ten years, is accepted, and about capacity figures, the allocation process and whether extra track is useful. The state secretary answered that capacity cannot be stated as a single figure, pointed to planned measures (PHS, ERTMS, a future public transport outlook, and a review of the capacity allocation decree), and described the allocation procedure and complaint routes.
Capacity on the railway cannot be unambiguously expressed in a single figure.
De capaciteit op het spoor is niet eenduidig met een cijfer weer te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de veiligheid op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek in Zwijndrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about safety at the Kijfhoek shunting yard, including reports of ignored safety procedures and a claim that safety had been at risk for years. The state secretary acknowledged the seriousness of the incidents, said ILT has imposed intensified supervision and an independent external safety-culture investigation is being prepared, and rejected the claim of years-long unsafety.
In addition, the ILT has imposed intensified supervision regarding maintenance work on the rail infrastructure, for example in connection with fault repair.
Daarnaast heeft de ILT verscherpt toezicht ingesteld met betrekking tot de onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan de spoorweginfrastructuur in verband met bijvoorbeeld storingsherstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat stukken Arctische permafrost zelfs in de winter niet meer zijn bevroren

An MP asked the ministers whether reports that some Arctic permafrost no longer freezes even in winter, and possibly thaws faster than expected, should affect climate policy and CO2 reduction targets. The minister answered that the IPCC projects substantial permafrost loss, that the next IPCC special report will incorporate recent studies, and that it is too early to say what this means for ambition levels, while noting that current models can still support climate policy if the extra emissions are subtracted from the remaining carbon budget.
It is still too early to make a statement about the consequences of these insights for the level of ambition and reduction targets.
Het is nog te vroeg om een uitspraak te doen over de consequenties van deze inzichten voor het ambitieniveau en reductiedoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten 'Vliegboot Catalina uit de lucht door geldgebrek' en 'Catalina voortijdig aan de grond door motorpech'

An MP asked the minister about reports that the historic Catalina flying boat was grounded due to lack of funds and engine failure, and whether strict aviation rules and ILT certification delays are to blame. The minister said the Raad van State ruling restricting paid flights would be lifted by a new EU basic regulation, that the ILT issued the airworthiness certificate within the legal deadline, and that the culture ministry is open to support but only if other parties will operate the aircraft.
The ILT handles applications within the statutory deadlines and as quickly as possible.
De ILT behandelt de aanvragen binnen de wettelijke termijnen en zo snel als mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de luchtvaartsector wéér is gestegen

An opposition MP asked the ministers whether rising aviation CO2 emissions, the role of market-based schemes and the government's international ambitions are acceptable and what the government will do. The minister answered that aviation emissions must fall, pointed to ICAO, CORSIA, the EU ETS and the national Duurzame Luchtvaarttafel, and rejected the claim that aviation has a free pass under Paris.
Aviation CO2 emissions must be reduced.
De CO 2 uitstoot door de luchtvaart dient te worden gereduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het beëindigen van vluchten naar Teheran door KLM en de gevolgen van Amerikaanse secundaire sancties

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked whether KLM's halt of Tehran flights and the US secondary sanctions on Iran are related, and what the sanctions mean for Dutch firms. The ministers answered that KLM's decision was commercial, that Dutch firms face reputational, financial and legal risks from extraterritorial US sanctions, and that the Netherlands opposes such extraterritoriality while the EU has adopted countermeasures.
The Dutch government is not involved in internal considerations and motives regarding the business operations of Dutch companies.
De Nederlandse overheid is niet betrokken bij interne overwegingen en beweegredenen t.a.v. bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de storing in het communicatiesysteem van Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a communications failure at air traffic control LVNL on 15 August 2018, which diverted flights and raised questions about the back-up system, communication and the investigation. The minister answered that the back-up system was used to land aircraft safely, that a further system will be introduced in two years, that LVNL is investigating the cause and will report within three months.
LVNL has indicated that it will inform me within three months about the cause of the failure.
LVNL heeft aangegeven mij binnen drie maanden te zullen informeren over de oorzaak van de storing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over ‘Vierde keer in deze eeuw komt het droogte-crisisteam in actie’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why drought crisis measures were needed again after earlier reassurances, whether Dutch water policy neglects drought, and what will be done to anticipate dry and wet periods and to build larger freshwater reserves. The minister answered that a national actual water shortage now exists, the drought management plan is active, the Delta programme is preparing for dry and wet extremes, and an evaluation will follow only after the shortage ends.
I cannot now commit to sending you an evaluation of this drought period before the 2019 budget, because the water shortage is still in full swing.
Ik kan nu niet toezeggen om u voor de begroting van 2019 een evaluatie van deze droogteperiode toe te sturen, omdat op dit moment het watertekort nog volop speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over de berichten dat de Nederlandse natuur verschrompelt en een noodplan nodig is

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Van Raan asked whether the government shares concerns that prolonged drought is withering Dutch nature and threatening species, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the concerns, describes crisis coordination, water allocation rules, the Deltaplan Zoetwater and planned nature-network and climate-stress-test steps, but gives no new binding commitments beyond existing programmes.
I too am concerned about the consequences for nature of the ongoing drought.
Ik maak mij ook zorgen over de gevolgen voor de natuur van de aanhoudende droogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over stremming bij sluizen in het Twentekanaal

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the closure of the Delden lock in the Twente Canal, attributed to staff shortages, was properly weighed against inland shipping interests, and whether Rijkswaterstaat had long known of staffing problems. The minister answered that the closure resulted from a combination of drought workload, holidays and unexpected absences, that staff were redeployed to Eefde, that there is no structural shortage or vacancy, and that the situation was unique.
There is no question of a staff shortage.
Er is geen sprake van een personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de belevingsvlucht

An SP MP asked the minister about the evaluation of the Belevingsvlucht flight trial, the MER corrections for Lelystad and Schiphol, and the scope of environmental assessment, including whether measured noise deviated from modelled values. The minister deferred the substantive answers on the evaluation to a later letter, and gave assurances and procedural explanations on the MER work, denying any targeting of results.
I expect to be able to send this response to your House at the end of September.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer deze reactie eind september te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de belevingsvlucht

An MP from GroenLinks asked why the Lelystad Airport experience flight produced much more noise than the MER predicted, whether the MER and its noise profiles remain representative, and whether the project should be reconsidered. The minister deferred substantive answers to a forthcoming response, stated the MER meets legal requirements and was positively advised by the Commission for EIA, and said trend validation and expert advice on measurement versus calculation are underway.
I expect to be able to send this response to your House at the end of September.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer deze reactie eind september te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over uitbuiting van vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Laçin asked ministers about exploitation of truck drivers, including enforcement of the 45-hour weekend rest, the adequacy of ILT enforcement and fines, sham constructions with foreign subsidiaries, and truckers' hotel accommodation. The minister denies that the Netherlands has become Europe's parking lot, says enforcement is risk-based and targeted, defends the current fine policy, and refers to ongoing EU mobility package negotiations.
I do not consider it opportune to change the current fining policy.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om het huidige boetebeleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de sterke toename van het aantal ongelukken met vrachtwagens en de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the sharp rise in truck accidents in 2017 and the disproportionate involvement of foreign drivers, and whether research would be commissioned and whether phone use at the wheel should be made technically impossible. The minister acknowledged the STIMVA findings, said data sources are hard to compare and no complete picture of causes exists, pointed to the upcoming road safety strategy and agreed that hands-free phone use should be made technically impossible while referring sanctions to the Justice minister.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat buitenlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs oververtegenwoordigd zijn bij ongelukken en pechgevallen

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether foreign truck drivers are overrepresented in accidents and breakdowns, and what the causes, costs and measures are. The minister answered that the data cannot establish the nationality-linked causes or costs, that most incidents are technical or tyre-related, and that the new road safety plan will address freight transport risks.
To further specify the causes of the involvement of foreign drivers, detailed information on all incidents is necessary.
Om de oorzaken van de betrokkenheid van buitenlandse chauffeurs nader te specificeren is gedetailleerde informatie van alle incidenten noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over milieustickers in Franse steden

An MP asked the state secretary about French city environmental stickers that are hard for Dutch tourists to understand and obtain, and whether the Netherlands would push for EU-wide harmonisation. The state secretary acknowledged the difficulty, pointed Dutch drivers to ANWB advice and on-site information, and said she favours automatic number-plate recognition and alignment with Dutch harmonised zone rules.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het gebruik van de 4e baan op Schiphol, gedurende gebruiksjaar 2017

An MP asked the minister about use of Schiphol's fourth runway on 9 May 2018 and in 2016-2017, including flight-movement counts, overruns of the 80-movement limit, and general aviation slot numbers. The minister declined to provide the movement data for now because a related objection procedure and court ruling are pending, promising to inform parliament after a decision in early September, and gave general aviation slot figures for 2016/2017 and 2017/2018.
A decision still has to be taken in this objection procedure, so I cannot provide you with information relevant to this objection procedure.
Er moet nog een besluit worden genomen in deze bezwaarprocedure, daarom kan ik u geen informatie verstrekken die van belang is voor deze bezwaarprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de wijziging van het Tracébesluit voor de Ring Utrecht

An MP asked the minister why a 2018 amendment to the Ring Utrecht route decision was needed, why outdated 2016 data forced removal of 28 hectares of green, and why the amendment was not opened to objections and appeals as with other route decisions. The minister said the data error affected only a small part of the basis, the green will be fully compensated locally, and that appeal is possible for six weeks after publication of the amended decision.
To formally arrange compensation for the additional green, an amended route decision is therefore needed.
Voor het formeel regelen van de compensatie van het extra groen is daarom een wijzigingstracébesluit nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat grote groepen gehinderden geen bezwaar meer kunnen maken tegen luchtvaartherrie

An SP MP asked whether residents outside the immediate noise contours around Schiphol, who experience aircraft noise, can be denied standing to object to ILT enforcement decisions, and how the 48 dB contour is applied. The minister replied that anyone may file an enforcement request, but only stakeholders (typically residents inside the contours, case by case outside) may object under the Awb, and pointed to complaint desks, including a planned one for Lelystad Airport.
Under the General Administrative Law Act, only persons who qualify as interested parties can object to this.
Op grond van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht kan hiertegen alleen bezwaar worden gemaakt door personen die als belanghebbende kunnen worden gekwalificeerd.
Antwoord op van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar de groei van het vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt

An SP MP asked the minister to respond to reports that the cost-benefit analysis supporting Rotterdam The Hague Airport's expansion is flawed, and whether a second opinion, dialogue with critical economists, and changes to the airport-commissioned analysis are warranted. The minister defends the current process, says the airport will update its MKBA addressing existing counter-expertise, that the draft airport decision will be submitted to parliament for pre-consultation likely in 2019, and declines a second opinion and meetings with the economists for now.

I will await that application and at that point make a substantive assessment based on all information available, and then prepare a draft airport decision that will be submitted to your House for pre-consultation.

Ik wacht die aanvraag af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt en vervolgens een ontwerp luchthavenbesluit opstellen dat in voorhang aan uw Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar groei vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt’

An MP asks whether the cost-benefit analysis for Rotterdam The Hague Airport's growth underestimates health, climate, noise and employment effects and whether a new analysis should be commissioned. The Minister says the airport will update its MKBA under current guidelines, that the airport rather than government commissions such analyses, and declines to commission a new one now.
I have asked the management of RTHA to carry out the announced update of the MKBA based on the applicable guidelines, including for CO2 valuation.
Ik heb de directie van RTHA verzocht om de aangekondigde actualisatie van de MKBA uit voeren op basis van de geldende richtlijnen, zo ook voor CO2-waardering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘Onderzoek naar groei vliegveld Rotterdam rammelt’

An MP asked the minister whether the MKBA supporting growth at Rotterdam The Hague Airport was methodologically sound, whether it should be transparent, and how environmental and health costs, climate damage, compensation and local benefits are valued. The minister answered that the airport will update the MKBA incorporating prior critiques and publish its methods, that the ministry will review the economic underpinning before any airport decision, and that noise-related harm is valued through house price declines while residents may claim compensation, but gave only general answers on local benefits and declined to commit to a second opinion beyond existing reviews.
I am awaiting an application for an airport decision from the airport and will then make a substantive assessment based on all the information available.
Ik wacht een aanvraag voor een luchthavenbesluit van de luchthaven af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: "Bergers: 'Verloren tijd bij aanpak fileleed'" en het interview met de voorzitter van de Vereniging van Bergings- en Mobiliteitsspecialisten (VBM) in de Nat

An MP asked the minister about delays in positioning tow trucks at strategic locations, claimed time savings, the scope for expansion beyond 20 locations, heavy-goods corridors, and blue flashing lights for tow trucks. The minister answered that the contracts start 1 April 2019 with no delay, that trials showed about 5 minutes faster arrival, and that benefits fall with more locations, while the second traffic package will be presented later this year.
The definitive award of all districts follows on 1 October 2018.
De definitieve gunning van alle rayons volgt per 1 oktober 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Amhaouch over zware ongevallen A67

MPs Von Martels and Amhaouch asked the minister about serious accidents on the A67 motorway in 2018, their causes and casualties, truck involvement, and short- and long-term safety measures. The minister said 2018 accident data is not yet available, gave 2017 figures and traffic data, and pointed to a broadened MIRT study with possible safety measures to be decided this autumn.
I cannot say anything about this at the moment.
Hierover kan ik op dit moment nog geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Gemeenten zijn irritant zoemende drones zat’

RemcoDijkstra (VVD) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a news report on municipalities being fed up with drone noise, and whether a sector code of conduct is desirable. The minister supports a voluntary code as self-regulation alongside existing rules, notes KNVvL and a Flevoland environmental service are drafting one for drone flights over nature areas, and says rollout is for the sector and provinces, with the code to be raised with the IPO.
I will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the Interprovincial Consultation (IPO).
Ik zal deze gedragscode onder de aandacht brengen van het Interprovinciaal Overleg (IPO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over de terugkeer van het alcoholslot

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Kuiken asked whether the government will reconsider reintroducing the alcohol lock after the Council of State and Supreme Court rulings, and whether it will amend the law to do so. The ministers answered that the alcohol lock under administrative law is no longer feasible, that placing it in criminal law was examined and found costly and rarely applicable, and that they will not re-investigate or legislate now but await the results of the Alcoholmeter pilot.
The rulings mean that the alcohol lock programme as it was arranged is no longer possible, and that any new programme must take these rulings into account.
De uitspraken betekenen dat het ASP zoals dat was geregeld niet meer mogelijk is en dat bij het ontwerp van een nieuw ASP rekening met deze uitspraken moet worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over het bericht dat de EU 15.000 Interrailpassen weggeeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Aalst asked whether the Netherlands supported the EU DiscoverEU free Interrail pass pilot and whether its expansion for 2021-2027 is EU propaganda paid by Dutch taxpayers. Minister Blok answered that DiscoverEU is a European Parliament pilot included in the 2018 EU budget and referred to the BNC-fiche on the proposed Erasmus+ programme for the expansion questions, without giving a cost figure or a position on the propaganda charge.
For the cabinet's appraisal of this proposal, I refer you to the BNC-fiche on Erasmus sent to your House on 10 July.
Voor de kabinetsappreciatie van dit voorstel verwijs ik u graag naar het op 10 juli jl. aan uw Kamer verzonden BNC-fiche over Erasmus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een chauffeur 34 uur onderweg was zonder fatsoenlijke pauze

The SP MPs Laçin and Van Dijk asked the ministers whether a Dutch truck driver who drove 34 hours without a proper break reflects a wider problem with tachograph tampering and enforcement, and who bears responsibility. The minister calls it unacceptable, describes ILT and ISZW risk-based enforcement and cross-border cooperation, says such a case was not previously encountered, and places primary responsibility on the employer and driver.
Exceeding driving and rest times occurs more often, but the ILT has not previously encountered a driver who was 34 hours on the road without a proper break.
Overschrijdingen van de rij- en rusttijden komen vaker voor, maar een chauffeur die 34 uur onderweg is zonder fatsoenlijke pauze, is de ILT nog niet eerder tegengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over lichthinder bij de A27

An MP asked the minister about light pollution from 18-metre highway lamps on the widened A27 that stay on all night during construction, and whether this breaches agreements with residents and harms nocturnal badgers. The minister confirmed the lamps stay on at night during the works for safety, acknowledged communication should have been clearer, and said lights will be switched off between 23:00 and 05:00 once the road is open, but declined to lower the masts.
It was not discussed in advance that the lighting would remain on at night during the construction period.
Er is vooraf niet besproken dat de verlichting in de nacht tijdens de bouwperiode blijft branden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de met vervuild slib versterkte Westdijk bij Bunschoten

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the Westdijk at Bunschoten, reinforced with thermally cleaned soil (TGG) found contaminated with heavy metals, including who supplied it, how certification and oversight worked, and who bears the costs. The state secretary answered that the cause is not yet known, that the waterschap is pursuing the contractor and supplier for costs, that TGG use in primary dikes is now suspended, and that a review of TGG quality is underway.
Rijkswaterstaat and the Flood Protection Programme (including the water boards) will for now no longer permit the use of TGG.
Rijkswaterstaat en het Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma (met daarin de waterschappen) staan het toepassen van TGG voorlopig niet meer toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over Jumbojet op waterstof

An MP asked the minister about a press report on a hydrogen-powered jumbo jet and whether the government would pursue hydrogen aviation at EU level and with KLM. The minister answered that alternatives should be studied, that hydrogen is not an EU innovation priority, that NLR runs hydrogen aviation programmes, and that it would discuss support at European level without a specific KLM consultation.
I am willing to discuss at European level how this development can be supported and whether it could be given a place on the European innovation agenda.
Ik ben bereid om Europees te bespreken op welke wijze deze ontwikkeling kan worden ondersteund en een plaats zou kunnen krijgen op de Europese innovatie-agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Jasper van Dijk over het uitsluiten van vrachtwagenchauffeurs van gelijk loon voor gelijk werk en de verkeersveiligheid op de Nederlandse wegen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the EU Transport Committee's position excluding truck drivers from the posted workers directive and allowing longer driving-time flexibility threatens equal pay and road safety, and whether the Netherlands can still enforce posting rules. The minister answered that the exemption should be limited, that flexibilisation may endanger road safety, that the European Parliament had rejected the committee report as a negotiating basis, and that the Dutch enforcement position is unaffected.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management has consistently pointed out that too much flexibilisation can endanger road safety.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft steeds gewezen op het feit dat te veel flexibilisering de verkeersveiligheid in gevaar kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Ander reisgedrag vermindert files’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a report that changed commuting behaviour reduces traffic jams, including whether behaviour-change schemes like Low Car Diet are cheaper than infrastructure and how they are factored into budgeting and the NMCA. The state secretary answered that behaviour-change measures are a promising method, that further research is being explored, that Beter Benutten and employer programmes are being continued, and that alternative non-infrastructural solutions are considered in MIRT studies.
Yes, together with those involved I am currently exploring the possibilities for a follow-up to the CPB note.
Ja, samen met de betrokkenen onderzoek ik momenteel de mogelijkheden voor een vervolg op de notitie van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Risico op instorten bij zeker honderd bruggen en viaducten door achterstallig onderhoud’

An MP asked the minister whether reports of collapse risk for hundreds of bridges and viaducts due to deferred maintenance are accurate, and what is being done. The minister answered that there is no collapse danger, that the 14 flagged objects had their risks addressed by measures already taken, and pointed to the investment programme and budget documents.
There is no danger of collapse for bridges and viaducts.
Er is geen sprake van instortingsgevaar bij bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Onacceptabel risico' op instorten bruggen en viaducten in Noord-Holland

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about media reports of unacceptable risks and deferred maintenance on bridges and viaducts in Noord-Holland, and whether the situation is national and financed adequately. The minister answered that there is no collapse danger, that flagged risks were addressed, that some works are deferred within allowed bandwidths, and that the Kamer is informed annually through the budget and MIRT overview.
There is no danger of collapse for bridges and viaducts.
Er is geen sprake van instortingsgevaar bij bruggen en viaducten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht: 'Honderden appende vrachtwagenchauffeurs betrapt vanuit touringcar'

An MP asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports that 440 drivers, many of them professional truck drivers, were fined for phone use while driving, and about campaigns, enforcement and sentencing. The minister acknowledged the figures as worrying, described an upcoming public campaign and a voluntary convenant with industry, noted rising handheld-phone violations, and said a sentencing bill on dangerous phone use would go to the Council of State and then parliament.
I expect to be able to send the bill to your House after the summer.
Ik verwacht het wetsvoorstel vervolgens na de zomer aan uw Kamer te kunnen sturen.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht ‘Streep door 2500 studentenwoningen na ‘verraad’ ministerie’

An MP asked whether the national ministries had co-developed and then rejected a plan for 2,500 student dwellings at Uilenstede near Schiphol despite safety and health concerns, and whether the state was a reliable partner. The ministers answered that the plan was assessed under the airport zoning rules, the inspectorate refused the exemption on external safety and noise grounds, and the local objection is pending.
Because of the appeal to special circumstances, and recognising that this is a complex task, the ILT made a broader balancing of interests.
Vanwege het beroep op bijzondere omstandigheden, en het besef dat het een complexe opgave betreft, heeft de ILT een bredere belangenafweging gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Yesilgöz-Zegerius inzake het bericht 'Haven wil CO2 duurder maken'

MPs Dijkstra and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether a Northwest-European minimum CO2 price proposed by the Port of Rotterdam is realistic, how to avoid a Dutch go-it-alone, what investments a €50-70 price would bring, and how to keep chemical industry and the port competitive in the energy transition. The minister answered that the government seeks Northwest-European cooperation and flanking policy, is still studying a minimum CO2 price within the national Klimaatakkoord process, and has sector tables examining industrial investment projects.
The cabinet explicitly seeks cooperation with like-minded Northwest European countries.
Het kabinet zoekt nadrukkelijk samenwerking met gelijkgezinde Noordwest-Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Ook bij storm moet KLM passagiers compenseren

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a court ruling requiring KLM to compensate passengers for cancellations during a storm and whether EU passenger rights rules have gone too far. The minister referred to the court ruling, explained that a general air traffic capacity reduction is not an extraordinary circumstance excusing compensation, and said the EU passenger rights regulation should be revised, though no solution to the Gibraltar dispute is yet in sight.
That is why I consider a revision of the passenger rights regulation desirable and necessary.
Daarom vind ik een herziening van de passagiersrechtenverordening wenselijk en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het falen van de renovatie van de Julianabrug in Urmond

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water why maintenance on the Julianabrug in Urmond was halted and delayed, why residents bear the social and economic costs of a long partial closure, and whether the funding and timetable would be reconsidered. The minister answered that the bridge remains in service with restrictions, that the scope and closure period will be determined in a planning phase, that funding comes from the Infrastructure Fund, and that consultations with Rijkswaterstaat and the municipality have already taken place.
The bridge remains in operation, albeit with restrictions, until replacement or renovation.
De brug blijft, hetzij met beperkingen, tot vervanging/renovatie in bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over de berichten dat er snel hulp nodig is bij KLM en dat de Franse overheid niet van plan is Air France te redden

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the ministers about reports that KLM needs quick help and that the French government will not rescue Air France, probing leadership risks, French influence, possible transfer of KLM assets to Paris, and the possibility of splitting the group. The minister answered that the leadership crisis is being addressed, that the Dutch public interest is safeguarded through informal contacts and board representation, that transfer to Paris is unlikely, and that he does not share the French minister's stance on a bailout.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de Britse ambitie om binnen zeven jaar van overbodig plastic verpakkingsmateriaal af te zijn

An MP asks the government about a UK pledge by over forty companies to eliminate unnecessary plastic packaging within seven years, whether it is realistic, and whether it fits the motion on reducing packaging. The state secretary welcomes the initiative, explains Dutch recycling targets and EU packaging policy, and says the goals are broadly aligned with the motion without committing to new concrete targets.
I have committed to inform your House during the year about the ambition on this point.
Ik heb toegezegd uw Kamer in de loop van het jaar te informeren over de ambitie op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Dik-Faber over het kappen van oude bomenlanen langs provinciale wegen

MPs Van der Graaf and Dik-Faber asked the minister whether safety works on provincial roads would lead to mass felling of old tree-lined avenues, and whether maatwerk and cultural-historical value would be respected. The minister denied any expected mass felling, said only trees very close to the road might be removed case by case, and said provinces are expected to follow the same tailored approach used on national roads.
Given experience so far with verge improvements on national and provincial roads, there is no reason at all to expect mass tree felling.
Gezien de ervaringen tot nu toe met bermverbeteringen bij rijkswegen en provinciale wegen is er geen enkele aanleiding om «massale bomenkap» te verwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over eerlijke concurrentie in het vrachtvervoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about fair competition in freight transport: restricted-speed trucks on public roads near Rotterdam, enforcement of low-emission zones against foreign-plated trucks, chain liability for the minimum wage, comparison with neighbouring countries, and enforcement of weekend rest in truck cabs. The minister answered that police enforcement is not separately recorded, municipalities enforce low-emission zones and international data exchange is being pursued, chain liability applies since 2017, and ILT checks in 2018 led to 72 fines from 315 drivers checked.
No separate registration takes place of enforcement against the improper use of re-inspected tractors on public roads.
Er vindt geen afzonderlijke registratie plaats van de handhaving op het oneigenlijke gebruik van teruggekeurde trekkers op de openbare weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Jouw medicijnen worden straks misschien wel door een drone gebracht’

MPs Koopmans and Remco Dijkstra asked the ministers about news that drones may deliver medicines, and about drone innovation, timing of an integrated vision, privacy and airspace safety, miniaturised or camouflaged drones and drone swarms in private hands. The government answered that it keeps its drone policy course, that general privacy rules and EU safety regulation apply, that small camouflaged drones filming covertly may be criminal, and that swarm flights will need to meet safety requirements under forthcoming EU rules.
This cabinet maintains the course set earlier, as stated in the most recent progress letter on drone policy of 28 May 2018.
Dit kabinet houdt vast aan de eerder ingezette koers zoals verwoord in de meest recente voortgangsbrief dronebeleid van 28 mei 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over wetgeving voor particulier en professioneel dronegebruik

An MP from D66 asks the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Justice and Security about privacy violations by drones over Kinderdijk, the regulatory balance for drone innovation, geofencing and no-fly zones. The government says it cannot confirm or deny privacy violations in general, supports a safety-based approach with EU rules expected by 2019, and points to complaints to the Dutch data protection authority and civil suits as remedies.
If someone believes that processing personal data with a drone infringes this regulation, a complaint can be lodged with the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Wanneer iemand van mening is dat de verwerking van persoonsgegevens met behulp van een drone inbreuk op deze verordening maakt, kan een klacht worden ingediend bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Diertens over de stijging van water- en elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

MPs Jetten and Diertens asked the ministers about rising water and electricity tariffs on Bonaire and whether low-consumption households are unfairly burdened. The government answered that it has provided subsidies, is preparing a short-term amendment to the Wet elektriciteit en drinkwater BES to restore a discount for small consumers, and will examine tariff options, while stating that the subsidy does not imply dependence on the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de blusinstructie voor de brandweer bij vuurwerk en vuurwerkopslagplaatsen

An MP asked the Justice and Interior and Infrastructure ministers about firefighting instructions for fireworks fires, including whether water can extinguish burning fireworks, safety distances, sprinklers, blast venting, and warnings after the Culemborg and 2005 European container tests. The minister answered that the 2005 circular governs firefighter conduct, that fireworks storage rules in the Vuurwerkbesluit were not changed, and that the government sees no reason to amend the current rules.
I see no reason to amend the current Vuurwerkbesluit regarding the existing pressure-relief provision via the door.
Ik zie geen reden om het vigerende Vuurwerkbesluit aan te passen rond de huidige druk ontlastende voorziening via de deur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het kantelen van een vrachtwagen met 300 jonge kalfjes aan boord

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a truck carrying about 300 young calves that overturned on the A16, the calves' ages, transport duration and rest stops, drinking systems, and monitoring of calf mortality and disease during transport. The minister answered most questions on substance, explained the rest-stop rules and NVWA checks, but declined to register transport deaths or illness, saying it is not a statutory task, and committed to no new action beyond referring the Irish stop violation to Irish authorities.
It is not a statutory task of the NVWA to register road accidents involving animals and report on them.
Het is geen wettelijke taak van de NVWA om wegongevallen met dieren te registreren en daarover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels en Van der Molen over oesterbanken voor de haven van Terschelling

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Japanese oyster banks affecting currents and access to the Terschelling harbour, dredging and ferry berths, a possible sailing ban near seal sandbanks, and the addition of the grey seal to Wadden dune habitat designations. The minister confirmed monitoring of the oyster banks with results expected end of the year, said the banks lie outside the ferry channel and do not affect access, confirmed planned maintenance of ferry infrastructure from 2019, and explained the limited scope of the grey seal designation.
These oyster banks are scheduled to be re-measured by Wageningen Marine Research this spring.
Deze oesterbanken worden volgens de planning dit voorjaar opnieuw ingemeten door Wageningen Marine Research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Von Martels over het omgaan met de mogelijkheden om deelplatforms te kunnen onderwerpen aan nationale regels

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers whether a 2018 EU Court ruling allowing member states to regulate taxi platforms changes Dutch policy on regulating sharing-economy platforms and their enforcement. The government replied that the ruling does not extend member-state freedom beyond existing taxi rules, that platform regulation requires case-by-case assessment, and that it pursues dialogue with platforms, a regulatory review by the ATR due in Q3 2018, and improved fiscal enforcement.
There is no reason to impose new rules on taxi platforms in the Netherlands.
Voor het opleggen van nieuwe regels aan taxiplatforms in Nederland is geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Hiddema over het financiële fiasco rondom het Haagse Institute for Global Justice (IGJ)

MPs Baudet and Hiddema asked about the financial collapse of the Hague Institute for Global Justice (IGJ), its government subsidies, the oversight failures of its supervisory board chair Dick Benschop, and whether his nomination as Schiphol CEO should be suspended. The government answered that the subsidy was properly spent on the basis of accountability documents, that the Rijk is not liable for debts, that IGJ was declared bankrupt, and that it sees no reason for an investigation or to suspend Benschop's appointment.
Based on the accountability documents, there are no indications that the subsidy was not spent in accordance with its purpose and conditions.
Op basis van de verantwoordingsdocumenten zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat de subsidie niet conform het doel waarvoor en de voorwaarden waaronder deze verleend is, is besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over een mogelijke aanval van taxichauffeurs op het hoofdkantoor van Uber

An MP asked about a reported plan by taxi drivers to attack Uber's Amsterdam headquarters, prior warnings, illegal taxi complaints, and ILT inspection capacity and enforcement in Amsterdam. The government answered that police are alert, the ILT has 25 inspectors working on a risk-based approach, and cooperation with the municipality, police and prosecutors is set out in a convenant.
Do you think the ILT has sufficient capacity to ensure in Amsterdam that entrepreneurs and drivers in the taxi sector comply with the rules?
Bent u van mening dat de ILT voldoende capaciteit heeft om er in Amsterdam op toe te zien dat ondernemers en chauffeurs in de taxibranche de regels naleven?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht 'Ryanair reveals worst gender pay gap in airline industry'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about reports that Ryanair has a very large gender pay gap and whether KLM and Transavia, in which the state is a shareholder, have similar gaps. The minister said the Ryanair situation cannot be addressed specifically, offered to suggest a quick scan to KLM and Transavia, and said the government has no legal means to force gender balance across functions.
We do not have specific information about a gender pay gap at KLM and Transavia.
Wij beschikken niet over specifieke informatie over een loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen bij KLM en Transavia.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Omtzigt, Remco Dijkstra en Van der Graaf over de verkeersveiligheid op de N36

MPs from CDA, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the minister why the N36 would not be widened along two sections during this year's maintenance, despite a motion adopted by parliament, and whether the government would guarantee full widening. The minister confirmed awareness of the motion and the coalition agreement, outlined interim safety measures, and said the remaining sections are being studied with results due in the second half of 2018, but gave no guarantee of full widening.
Following the adopted motion, I am examining the added value of widening on the sections where major maintenance is not currently taking place.
Naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie onderzoek ik wat de meerwaarde is van verbreding op de delen waar groot onderhoud nu niet plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over nieuwe budgetvluchten naar New York

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about low-priced Norwegian flights from Amsterdam to New York, slot allocation linked to EU merger conditions, and whether sustainability criteria could be used in slot allocation. The minister answered that airlines may set fares freely under the EU-US aviation agreement, that KLM released slots under EU competition conditions, and that current EU rules do not permit environmental criteria in slot allocation, though the government will explore this further.
There are currently no possibilities for this within the existing European frameworks.
Hiervoor bestaan op dit moment binnen de huidige Europese kaders geen mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van de groeiende luchtvaart op de luchtkwaliteit rond Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about the air-quality effects of growing aviation around Schiphol, including RIVM projections of NO2 exceedances in 2030 and whether environmental impact assessments adequately cover health and climate effects. The minister answered that the exceedances stem from Schiphol-related traffic, pointed to planned measures and the ongoing ultrafine particle research, and defended the scope of the MERs as adequate, while committing to take the Commission's suggestion into a future aviation strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over het bericht dat er een wachtrij is voor het afleggen van een rijexamen

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the long waiting times for driving exams, asking whether the causes were foreseeable, whether the CBR's recovery plan will work, and whether poor driving schools should be named. The Minister acknowledges the problem, attributes it to both rising demand and examiner shortages, outlines CBR measures, and says publishing school pass rates is already done periodically, while declining to give separate waiting times by group beyond referring to the CBR website.
I have asked the CBR to provide clear information on its website to help people choose a driving school.
Ik heb het CBR gevraagd om op haar website duidelijke informatie te geven ten behoeve van het kiezen van een rijschool.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de dubbele petten van Pieter van Geel

An MP asked the minister whether Pieter van Geel, chair of the commission advising on the Oostvaardersplassen policy framework, had a conflict of interest through his supervisory board seat at LVNL and the link to Lelystad Airport expansion, and whether the advice should be independently reviewed. The minister saw no problem, said the Lelystad link had no effect on the commission's work, noted the side role was reported and cleared, and declined an independent review as the provincial states are responsible for the advice.
Finally, Mr Van Geel reported the side function to the supervisory board of LVNL, in accordance with the applicable rules.
Ten slotte heeft de heer Van Geel – conform de hiervoor geldende regels – de nevenfunctie gemeld bij de raad van toezicht van LVNL.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Remco Dijkstra over een werkbezoek aan Schouwen-Duiveland

MPs Bosman and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about tractor restrictions on the N59 on Schouwen-Duiveland, including why only part of the road is closed and whether the safety risks of alternative routes will be independently investigated. The Minister confirmed awareness of the municipality's concerns, explained the criteria in the Zeeland agricultural traffic network, and said she is willing to support a new, additional independent study if needed.
If necessary, I am willing to cooperate in a new and additional independent study.
Indien het nodig is ben ik bereid om mee te werken aan een nieuw en aanvullend onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over Schiphol en Lelystad Airport

MP Kröger (GreenLeft) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about enforcing the 10,000-movement cap at Lelystad Airport, the EU slot allocation rule, environmental impact assessment gaps, noise and cumulation calculations, route deviations, the transparency of Wob-withheld documents, and the balance between military and civil airspace use. The minister answered that the cap reflects airspace limits, that the MER update will be amended into the Luchthavenbesluit, that many numbers are not broken down by municipality, and that withheld Wob information is justified in the decision letter.
The inventory list that forms part of the decision indicates for each document which exemption grounds apply.
In de inventarislijst die deel uitmaakt van het besluit is per document aangegeven welke uitzonderingsgronden hierop van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven wil eigen vliegtaks invoeren’

MPs of the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Eindhoven's motion to introduce a local aviation tax, including its legality, effects on competitiveness and whether other municipalities might follow. The Minister of the Interior answered that the decision rests with the municipal council, that such a tax would be tested by courts if challenged, and that the government prefers a national or European aviation levy instead.
It is up to the democratically elected representative body of the municipality, the municipal council, to decide on the introduction and levying of a tax.
Het is aan het democratisch vertegenwoordigende orgaan van de gemeente, de gemeenteraad, om de beslissing te nemen over de invoering en heffing van een belasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht “Rotterdamse droogdok is al drie jaar besmet”

MPs Dijkstra and Wiersma asked about reports that Rotterdam dry-dock work on cruise ships has dropped since a 2014 Inspectie SZW fine, raising level-playing-field concerns. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, promised an inventory of rules and enforcement in neighbouring countries before summer, and declined to disclose details of the ongoing court case.
There is currently a court case ongoing and during that period I cannot make statements.
Er loopt op dit moment een rechtszaak en gedurende die periode kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over windenergie en luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asked ministers whether reopening Lelystad Airport for small aviation and its flight-path restrictions would obstruct planned wind parks in Flevoland and the Energy and Climate Agreements, and what the cost and compensation implications would be. The minister answered that the government is seeking spatial solutions for both aviation and wind energy, that exact routes and turbine heights are still under review, and that cost allocation is still being discussed without concrete figures.
I will keep you informed of the progress of this.
Over de voortgang hiervan zal ik u op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Belhaj over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about a court ruling that Schiphol must release about 2,500 slots, and about its consequences for passenger flows, border control queues, security and the 500,000-movement cap. The minister replied that the ruling has no policy consequences for the 2017/2018 season, that the cap through 2020 stands, and that Marechaussee capacity is being expanded, while declining to comment on Schiphol's reasoning.
I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the justification of this decision by Schiphol, because the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management is not a party in this case.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om commentaar te geven op de onderbouwing van dit besluit door Schiphol omdat het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat geen partij is in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht “Schiphol teruggefloten door rechter”

MP Amhaouch asked the minister about a court ruling against Schiphol and the airport's capacity to handle passenger flows, and what changes had been made since summer 2017. The minister confirmed awareness, listed extra staffing, e-gate improvements and additional border police capacity, and said the 500,000 flight-movement agreement through 2020 is not up for discussion.
Various measures at the airport are being continued, but with a view to possible congestion in the coming summer, additional measures are also being implemented.
Verschillende maatregelen op de luchthaven worden gecontinueerd, maar met het oog op de mogelijke drukte in de komende zomer worden ook aanvullende maatregelen doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een ernstig veiligheidsincident op Schiphol

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a near mid-air collision at Schiphol, its consequences, and when the government would consider safety compromised. The minister declined to speculate on consequences, said conclusions await the OVV and ILT investigations, and pointed to a letter of 25 April 2018 and promised to send the To70 study once received.
Only when all facts are known and the investigations have been completed can conclusions be drawn about the seriousness of the incident.
Pas wanneer alle feiten bekend zijn en de onderzoeken zijn uitgevoerd, kunnen conclusies worden getrokken over de ernst van het voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de nieuwe spoorbrug bij Weener

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about delays to the Friesenbrücke rail bridge at Weener, including whether repairs could last until 2030 and what the cross-border travel burden is. The state secretary replied that German partners report the project is on schedule for 2024, that the Dutch side keeps pressing for speedy repair at official level, that about 255,000 cross-border travellers are affected by a bus substitute adding roughly 20 minutes, and that delays stem from German planning procedures.
In various high-level official contacts, the German partners are urged to speed up the repair.
In diverse hoogambtelijke contacten wordt richting de Duitse partners aangedrongen op spoedig herstel
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Agnes Mulder over de enorme stijging van elektriciteitstarieven op Bonaire

CDA MPs asked why electricity tariffs on Bonaire rose about 24% from January 2018, whether they are cost-covering, and whether there is protection for vulnerable consumers. The minister said tariffs were previously kept artificially low by a subsidy funded by Dutch taxpayers, that the rise is mainly due to oil prices and network costs, that a subsidy will lower network tariffs and a bill for drinking water is being prepared, and that a usage-independent tariff is introduced on 1 April.
I am in discussion with WEB about how to deploy the subsidy.
Ik ben in gesprek met WEB over hoe de subsidie in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de drang naar groei binnen de luchtvaartsector

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Schiphol's new pier, capacity growth, the OVV safety advice, Lelystad Airport flight routes, enforcement, environmental assessment independence, climate and bird-strike risks, and the Crisis- en Herstelwet. The minister confirmed the pier investment, said growth is possible only if demonstrably safe, promised a monitoring-based enforcement policy rule and further research, but gave largely policy-restating answers and did not address the dual-role concern in substance.
I take the OVV's recommendations seriously.
Ik neem de aanbevelingen van de OVV serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het dumpen van vervuild slib uit het buitenland in een Nederlandse recreatieplas

MP Dik-Faber asked the minister whether foreign contaminated sludge dumped in a Dutch recreational lake meets Dutch standards, how it is monitored, and whether Rijkswaterstaat can enforce it. The State Secretary replied that foreign material must meet the same Besluit bodemkwaliteit standards, that Rijkswaterstaat and water boards supervise and inspect via notification and sampling, and that the framework will be carried into the Omgevingswet.
I intend to incorporate this assessment framework into the Environment and Planning Act through general rules.
Ik heb het voornemen om dit toetsingskader in de Omgevingswet op te nemen door middel van algemene regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het afscheidsinterview van de president-directeur van Schiphol

An MP asked the ministers about the outgoing Schiphol CEO's farewell interview on airport capacity, connectivity, selectivity policy, Ryanair, Lelystad Airport and a flight tax. The minister answered that data on the economic value of connectivity are limited to existing studies, pointed to planned selectivity measures and a future Luchtvaartnota, and said a flight tax is being prepared for 2021.
I have no information on what specifically the increase in direct connectivity since 2009 has yielded.
Ik heb geen informatie over wat specifiek de sinds 2009 toegenomen directe connectiviteit heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de aanbesteding van de Afsluitdijk

An MP asked whether the Kornwerderzand bridges can be made reliable for their remaining life, and whether the €81 million tender windfall on the Afsluitdijk project could fund a wider lock and bridge replacement now. The minister answered that maintenance is planned, that adding the bridges and lock to the Afsluitdijk tender is not possible for legal, funding and delay reasons, and that a regional financing proposal is still being worked out with an update promised mid-year.
It is therefore not yet possible to give a general update on the financing proposal before the spring memorandum.
Het is daarom nog niet mogelijk voorafgaand aan de voorjaarsnota een algemene stand van zaken te geven over het financieringsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de juridische eigendomsrechten van slots

An MP asked the ministers about passenger growth at Schiphol in early 2018 and the legal status of airport slots, including whether slots can be withdrawn and how their number can be reduced. The minister replied that slots are permissions under EU Regulation 95/93, not property or landing rights, that they can be withdrawn only on specific legal grounds, and that the slot cap is set through capacity declarations and environmental rules.
Slots are not the same as landing rights.
Slots zijn niet hetzelfde als landingsrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Alarm om haast vliegtaks'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked why the ministry is already preparing an aviation tax, given the coalition agreement's European-route-first approach, and questioned its timing, effects and lessons from the 2008 tax. The State Secretary replied that parallel work on three tracks (European, emissions/noise levy, per-ticket charge) is needed to meet the 2021 budget target, with a letter to parliament before summer and an internet consultation, while answering most sub-questions on process and effects in general terms.
In my fiscal policy agenda I announced that I would send parliament a letter on the three tracks under investigation before summer.
In mijn fiscale beleidsagenda heb ik aangekondigd nog voor de zomer een brief over de drie te onderzoeken sporen naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Na ongelukken onnodig lang in de file door procedures’

An MP asked the minister whether breakdown and accident procedures on Dutch motorways unnecessarily prolong traffic jams, and what would be done to change them. The minister denied that procedures cause unnecessary delay, said safety comes first, and pointed to planned measures such as blue lights for weginspecteurs and a review of two-recovery-vehicle working arrangements.
I will, as said earlier, equip all road inspectors with blue lights so that they can reach incidents more quickly.
Wel zal ik, zoals eerder gezegd, alle weginspecteurs met blauw licht uitrusten zodat ze sneller bij incidenten aanwezig kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Jetten over een mogelijk 'klimaatakkoord' voor de luchtvaart

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the ICAO CORSIA aviation emissions scheme, including its effectiveness, transparency, enforcement, offset quality, biofuel sustainability criteria, participation and Dutch lobbying. The government answered every question on substance, acknowledged concerns on offset quality and biofuel criteria, and committed to raising them in future EU and ICAO evaluations.
The Netherlands will use these and other evaluation moments to further improve the system on sustainability, effectiveness and environmental integrity.
Nederland zal van deze en andere evaluatiemomenten gebruik maken om het systeem verder te verbeteren op punten als duurzaamheid, effectiviteit en milieu-integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over het bericht ‘Verhoging geluidswal langs A20 bij Maassluis in zicht’

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked about persistent noise nuisance from the A20 near Maassluis, whether Rijkswaterstaat's compliance calculations account for the 130 km/h limit, and why no mitigation has been taken. The minister answers that noise stays within the statutory production ceilings based on prescribed calculations validated by RIVM, that the municipality owns the noise wall and must initiate raising it, and that Rijkswaterstaat will then cooperate.
If the municipality takes the initiative to raise the noise wall, Rijkswaterstaat will cooperate with it.
Indien de gemeente het initiatief neemt om de geluidswal op te hogen zal Rijkswaterstaat medewerking hieraan verlenen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over files bij de Afsluitdijk door herhaaldelijke storingen bij de draaibruggen bij Kornwerderzand en reactie een op vraag van het lid Remco Dijkstra over een snellere omleidi

An MP asked the minister about recurring breakdowns of the Kornwerderzand bridges on the Afsluitdijk causing traffic jams, and what Rijkswaterstaat will do about them. The minister acknowledges the failures, explains the causes, describes maintenance and replacement planning, and commits to faster diversion measures and cooperation with the provinces.
Therefore the guardrail will be adjusted so that the emergency crossing is available sooner and traffic can be diverted more quickly.
Daarom zal de vangrail zodanig worden aangepast dat de calamiteitendoorsteek sneller beschikbaar is en het verkeer sneller kan worden omgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de werkwijze van het Centraal Bureau Rijvaardigheid

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why processing of health declarations for license renewal by people aged 75+ at the CBR takes so long, and whether it will be shortened. The minister explains that medical or driving tests can extend processing beyond four weeks, notes that people are advised to apply early, and states that performance agreements and investments in capacity and systems are expected to help.
I have made performance agreements with the CBR.
Ik heb met het CBR prestatieafspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over geluidsoverlast door verouderde geluidsschermen langs de A28 bij Harderwijk

An MP asked about noise and fine-particle nuisance from the A28 at Harderwijk, including whether noise ceilings are exceeded, why new barriers must be much higher than old ones, and whether replacement can happen sooner and be coordinated with local authorities. The minister said ceilings are not exceeded, explained the different legal regimes, said replacement is planned after 2020 at the same height pending a sanering study, and offered to consult with the municipality and province while the MIRT study focuses first on traffic issues.
Furthermore, I am certainly willing to think along with the municipality and province about the local situation.
Verder ben ik zeker bereid om mee te denken met de gemeente en provincie over de lokale situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over geluidshinder van de A50 in Niftrik

MPs Jetten and Sienot (D66) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about long-standing noise nuisance from the A50 at Niftrik, including road surface, expansion joint design, noise-production ceilings and whether measurements should replace calculations. The minister answered that RWS is compliant with the noise production ceilings based on calculations, sees no reason for new surfacing or joints or new measurements now, and makes no commitment to action.
Because no exceedance of the noise production ceilings is expected in the short term, there is no reason to consider measures.
Omdat er op korte termijn nog geen overschrijding van de GPP's wordt verwacht is er geen aanleiding om maatregelen te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de geluidsoverlast van de A50 voor Ravenstein en Oss

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise nuisance from the A50 motorway for Ravenstein and Oss, including why no noise measures are planned there despite exceedance warnings and reports. The minister answered in detail that no exceedance of noise production ceilings is expected within five years at these locations, so no additional measures are planned, while citing the legal framework and planned measures elsewhere.
Because no exceedance of the noise production ceilings is expected in the short term, there is no reason to take (additional) noise measures.
Omdat er op korte termijn geen overschrijding van de GPP’s wordt verwacht, is er geen aanleiding om (aanvullende) geluidmaatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Schiphol laat capaciteit bewust onbenut'

An MP asked the minister why Schiphol decided not to transfer about 2,000 unused daytime winter slots to the busier summer season, and whether Schiphol had the legal power to decide this without consultation, given summer congestion. The minister replied that Schiphol, after failing to agree a capacity declaration with other parties, set it itself and will transfer about 835 night slots but not the daytime slots, citing expected peak congestion, and announced an amendment to the slot allocation decree.
To put an end to this unclear situation around the adoption of the capacity declaration, I am working on an amendment to the Slot Allocation Decree.
Om aan deze onduidelijke situatie rond de vaststelling van de capaciteitsdeclaratie een eind te maken, werk ik aan een aanpassing van het Besluit slotallocatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Schiphol Deliveroo inzet voor bezorging aan de gate

An MP asked the government whether Schiphol's partnership with Deliveroo for gate food delivery is desirable given concerns about Deliveroo's worker constructions, and what consequences follow if Deliveroo must abandon its self-employed model. The minister answered that Schiphol's board is responsible for operations and the state as shareholder sees no reason to intervene, and declined to comment on individual taxpayers.
As shareholder, I am not involved in the operational management of Schiphol.
Ik ben als aandeelhouder niet betrokken bij de operationele bedrijfsvoering van Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Gemeentes moeten zich beter voorbereiden op klimaatverandering’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about municipalities' preparedness for climate change, including climate stress tests and financial incentives. The minister answered that stress tests are a voluntary administrative commitment due by end 2019, with no legal obligation planned, and that standardisation and financial-incentive work are underway.
A statutory obligation is in my view not necessary.
Een wettelijke verplichting is mijn inziens niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Campina en Unilever willen bereikbaar zijn in Wageningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about business access to Wageningen after a newspaper report, questioning whether car access to the town is under pressure and whether firms like Campina, TNO and Unilever suffer. The minister answered that the national motorways around Wageningen function adequately, and that responsibility for the local road network lies with the municipality and province.
Responsibility for that – insofar as it concerns the local road network – lies with the municipality and the province.
De verantwoordelijkheid daarvoor – voor zover het gaat om het onderliggend wegennet – ligt bij de gemeente en de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Lange ochtendfile op A9 vanwege gesloten spitsstrook en ongeval’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why A9 peak-hour lanes stayed closed during a morning jam, whether they can be upgraded to regular lanes, and when Parliament will be informed. The minister attributed the closure to display faults, said a broader study on opening peak lanes will be sent around summer, and stated the Heiloo junction does not affect speed limits or lane upgrades.
Around the summer, your House will be informed about this.
Rond de zomer wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over potentiële gevaren bij de nieuwe vliegroutes Lelystad

An MP asked the ministers about staffing shortages at the military air traffic control station, whether it can safely handle extra traffic from Lelystad Airport, bird strike risks and flight routes, and who is responsible for airspace safety. The government answered that staffing gaps exist but traffic will be managed within a year, that bird-strike monitoring and studies are underway, and that the two ministers share responsibility with the air traffic service providers and the inspectorate.
To this end, already qualified and trained air traffic controllers will initially be deployed.
Daartoe zullen in eerste instantie reeds gekwalificeerde en getrainde verkeersleiders worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de vaarweg naar Ameland geen karrenspoor moet worden

MPs Von Martels and Van der Molen asked the minister about reports that the ferry route to Ameland should not become a 'cart track', about the reliability of the ferry connection due to low water, and whether the island could become unreachable. The minister answered that short-term measures are underway with Wagenborg, a long-term solution process starts after 2029, and there are no indications the island will become unreachable before then.
At the same time, under the direction of RWS and in line with the OPP advice, a process starts to reach a long-term solution for Ameland's accessibility beyond 2029.

Tegelijkertijd start onder regie van RWS – in overeenstemming met het OPP advies – een proces om te komen tot een lange termijn oplossing voor de bereikbaarheid van Ameland op de langere termijn (na 2029).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de slechte bereikbaarheid van Ameland via de veerverbinding Holwerd-Ameland

An MP asked about poor ferry reliability between Holwerd and Ameland, including progress on the short-term measures agreed in the Open Plan Process and a permanent solution after 2029.
