The minister replied that the measures are being implemented, with the bend cut expected in 2019, the second bend study delayed to Q2 2018, and a long-term options study still pending.
RWS expects the study and any decision on next steps to be completed in the second quarter of 2018.
RWS verwacht dat het onderzoek en het eventuele besluit over de te nemen vervolgstappen in het tweede kwartaal van 2018 worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Lange files Rotterdam door storing Spijkenisserbrug'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about frequent failures of the Spijkenisser and Botlek bridges causing traffic jams around Rotterdam, their causes, accelerating the Spijkenisser bridge renovation, and contact with the Nissewaard municipality. The minister answered that failures were counted and remedial measures taken, that renovation is planned for 2021-2022 with acceleration being examined but limited, and that cooperation with the municipality is being intensified.
Rijkswaterstaat does not record data on economic damage.
Rijkswaterstaat registreert geen gegevens over economische schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over luchthaven Lelystad

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the cap of 45,000 flight movements at Lelystad Airport, how the usable capacity is set and enforced by the ILT, noise measurement and the 60,000-movement sensitivity calculation, and whether the limits will be legally anchored. The Minister answered that the 45,000 maximum will be written into the forthcoming amendment of the Luchthavenbesluit, that the ILT enforces noise limits at handhavingspunten, that a 10,000 large-commercial-traffic ceiling will also be fixed in agreements, and that an evaluation at 7,000 movements is planned, while declining to give some answers in time for the debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de handhaving van het aantal vliegbewegingen op Schiphol

MP Van Raan asks the minister how the ILT rejects enforcement requests against exceeding Schiphol's flight-movement cap, whether the minister knew of the letter sent in her name, and how this fits her earlier statement that enforcement takes place. The minister explains that the Wet luchtvaart gives the Inspector-General sole enforcement power, that the 500,000 cap is not in the regulations, and that enforcement against the cap is not currently applied, only anticipatory enforcement on noise limits.
Within the ILT it is determined whether there is an exceedance and whether a measure must be imposed.
Binnen de ILT wordt bepaald of er al dan niet sprake is van een overschrijding en of er een maatregel moet worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de heffing van tol op de Westerscheldetunnel van en naar Zeeuws Vlaanderen

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Zeeuws-Vlaanderen residents must pay toll on the Westerscheldetunnel and whether the toll will be reconsidered. The minister answers that the toll was needed to finance the tunnel, that the province of Zeeland as manager sets the tariffs, and refuses to reconsider, pointing to other regional investments.
This concerns an existing connection for which, as usual, agreements on financing were made.
Het gaat hier om een bestaande verbinding waarover zoals gebruikelijk afspraken zijn gemaakt over de financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het bericht ‘Rotterdam wil af van steenkool in de haven’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked whether the government will support Rotterdam's motion to phase out coal handling at the port, use its shareholder powers and tariffs to curb coal transshipment, and support similar phase-outs in Amsterdam. The minister answered that the coal contract is a matter between the port company and private operators, that restricting coal handling would only shift flows to German and Belgian ports, and that the state will oversee sound financial decisions by the port company as shareholder.
Restricting coal handling in Rotterdam does not lead to a reduction in CO2 emissions, unlike a ban on coal use for electricity production, which does.
Het beperken van de op- en overslag van kolen in Rotterdam leidt niet tot vermindering van de CO 2 -uitstoot, zoals een verbod op het gebruik van kolen voor elektriciteitsproductie dat wel doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sneller over het bericht 'Kabinet huurt tijdelijk regeringstoestel'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the government's temporary leased aircraft after a news report, questioning the ad-hoc availability and quality, the operator's security compliance, possible links to royal family use, and funding. The minister answered that KLM arranged a third party to operate a permanently available, suitably equipped aircraft, that the 6.7 million euro budget may be exceeded with details to follow in the Voorjaarsnota, and denied any link between lease costs and royal use.
As indicated in the earlier letter to your House, I will further inform your House about the additional costs and their coverage within the IenW budget at the Spring Memorandum.
Zoals aangegeven in de eerdere brief aan uw Kamer zal ik uw Kamer ten aanzien van de additionele kosten en de dekking daarvan binnen de begroting van IenW nader informeren bij de Voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Heerenveen wil stil asfalt op snelweg A32'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about residents' noise complaints near the A32 motorway at Heerenveen and whether noise ceilings were being respected. The minister answered that noise levels remain below the applicable production ceilings, outlined planned works and mitigation measures, and said she is already consulting the municipality.
Based on the most recent compliance report on noise production ceilings for 2016, the noise level along the A32 at Heerenveen is below the applicable noise production ceilings.
Op basis van het meest recente nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016, ligt het geluidsniveau langs de A32 ter hoogte van Heerenveen onder de geldende geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over de berichten ‘Universiteit Leiden wil geen concurrerende milieusite’ en ‘Dit gaan ze niet leuk vinden, Rik’

An MP asked the minister about differing methods for measuring pesticide quality in Dutch surface water, Leiden University's stance on a competing environmental website, and open data access. The minister explained that the WFD and national monitoring networks use methods suited to different purposes, saw no reason to change the assessment, affirmed open access to measurements, and declined to intervene in the website's availability.
I am not responsible for whether the website in question stays online.
Ik ga niet over het wel of niet in de lucht houden van de betreffende website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over eenzijdig Chinees optreden bij instellen van vliegroutes over de Straat van Taiwan

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the government shares US concern over China's unilateral setting of new flight routes over the Taiwan Strait and whether this endangers Dutch flights. The minister answered that the government and the EU call for a peaceful dialogue solution, that Dutch airlines do not use these routes so there is no reason to engage, and that Nederland and the EU will keep urging both sides toward constructive dialogue.
Dutch airlines, however, do not use the routes. The cabinet therefore sees no reason to enter into consultation on this.
Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen maken echter geen gebruik van de routes. Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanleiding hierover in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Doorgetrokken streep helpt tegen ongelukken’

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether a continuous lane marking at the Feijenoord slip road of the Van Brienenoord bridge could reduce accidents, and what measures could improve safety on the A1 near Barneveld. The minister answered that a blokkenlijn was added in 2017, that its effects will be evaluated around summer 2018, and that a MIRT study on the A1/A30 Barneveld stretch will be completed in June 2018.
Around the summer I want to evaluate the measure and determine whether additional measures are necessary.
Rond de zomer wil ik de maatregel evalueren en bepalen of er aanvullende maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over bewegwijzering voor het opladen van elektrische auto’s langs de autosnelweg

An MP from D66 asked the minister why Rijkswaterstaat would not add charging-station signs for electric cars to motorway signage, whether budget considerations limit replacement, and how existing signs could be updated. The state secretary answered that a single alternative-fuel pictogram is being introduced via CROW, that only new or regularly replaced signs will carry it at about EUR 600,000 for 80 locations, and that operators may pay for their own logo signs.
Rijkswaterstaat has decided to introduce a separate pictogram so that road users can clearly see at which locations along the national roads alternative fuels are available besides fossil fuels.

Rijkswaterstaat heeft besloten een apart pictogram in te voeren zodat voor weggebruikers duidelijk is op welke locaties langs de rijkswegen naast fossiele brandstoffen ook alternatieve brandstoffen zijn te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het mogelijk schrappen van de belangrijke afslag Goudse Poort op de A12 bij Gouda

An MP asked the minister whether the Goudse Poort exit on the A12 near Gouda, which may be closed as an option in the A20 widening project, would harm Gouda's accessibility, and asked how affected parties would be involved. The minister confirmed the closure is an alternative under study for road-safety and traffic-flow reasons, not yet decided, and said Gouda and business representatives take part in the consultation process.
These concerns are known to both Rijkswaterstaat and the province of Zuid-Holland.
Deze zorgen zijn bekend bij zowel Rijkswaterstaat als de provincie Zuid-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de berichten in de media “GenX aangetroffen in afvalwater ATM Moerdijk” en “Bron GenX op zuivering Bath gevonden”

An MP asked about media reports that GenX was found in wastewater from ATM Moerdijk and at the Bath treatment plant, asking when ATM reported it, whether it may continue discharging, whether air and soil research is done, sanctions, worker protection and Chemours' disclosure of recipients. The minister answered that concentrations were very small, ATM voluntarily stopped accepting Chemours waste, the permit allows discharge, air/soil research is underway elsewhere, and the ILT requested Chemours' data.
The competent authority sees no reason to prohibit ATM from using this permit.
Het bevoegd gezag ziet geen aanleiding om ATM te verbieden gebruik te maken van deze vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Lacin over het bericht 'Chauffeurs moesten tijdens storm de weg op'

MPs Van Dijk and Lacin asked whether employers forced truck drivers onto the road during the January 2018 storm, whether sanctions, bans and fines should apply, and whether non-Dutch-speaking drivers were properly informed of the code red weather alert. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, said employers must inform drivers and that responsibility is shared, and promised to discuss measures with the transport sector and inform the House shortly, without committing to bans, fines or counting the affected drivers.
I immediately took the initiative to sit down with the transport and logistics sector to consider which measures could be taken in (expected) extreme weather conditions.
Ik heb meteen het initiatief genomen om met de transport- en logistieke sector om tafel te gaan om te bezien welke maatregelen bij (verwachte) extreme weersomstandigheden genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat Nederlandse infrastructuren onvoldoende zijn gedimensioneerd op het transport van zwaar militair materiaal

An MP asked whether Dutch infrastructure is still dimensioned for heavy military transport, and whether the Commander of the Armed Forces' warning about mobility risks is accepted. The ministers answered that current standards suffice for military transport, that bottlenecks are being mapped, and that EU and NATO initiatives are underway, but gave no firm national inventory timeline.
Currently it is being examined which infrastructural, legal and regulatory obstacles exist in the Netherlands.
Momenteel wordt onderzocht welke infrastructurele, juridische en regelgevende belemmeringen in Nederland precies gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie dat Uber een taxibedrijf is

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the EU Court of Justice ruling that Uber is a taxi company means Uber must follow Dutch taxi rules, whether Uber acts as an employer of its drivers, and whether the government will enforce against disguised self-employment. The minister answered that the ruling changes nothing for Dutch taxi regulation, that enforcement targets individual licensed drivers, that independent research on the gig economy is underway, and that tax authorities do not comment on individual cases.
It is for the tax inspector, and if disagreement persists for a judge, to assess the facts and circumstances of an individual case.
Het is aan de belastinginspecteur en bij blijvend verschil van mening aan een rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van een individueel geval te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts, Omtzigt, Von Martels en Slootweg over transparantie regionaal BO van 18 december 2017 en Alderstafel Lelystad Airport

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about transparency of the regional administrative consultation of 18 December 2017, whether minutes and agenda would be public, the remaining steps before the environmental impact report, and the evaluation of the Schiphol advisory council. The Minister confirmed the importance of transparency but declined to publish the minutes of the 18 December consultation for now, citing confidential input from provincial officials, and promised further consultation and a letter to parliament in early February.
Therefore I will not yet make the minutes of the administrative consultation of 18 December 2017 public at this time.
Derhalve zal ik het verslag van het bestuurlijk overleg van 18 december 2017 op dit moment nog niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over omgewaaide vrachtwagens als gevolg van de westerstorm van 18 januari 2018

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how transport firms and truck drivers are informed about weather conditions, how many accidents involving overturned trucks occurred during the January 2018 storm, and whether the government will consult the sector, make agreements on responsible conduct, and commission research into freight risks in strong winds. The minister answered that information reaches road users through several channels, reported 66 truck-related incidents on national roads that day, said talks with the sector are ongoing with a letter to follow, and saw no reason to repeat the German insurer study.
I will shortly inform your House about this by letter.
Binnenkort informeer ik uw Kamer hierover per brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sienot over protocollen op de werkvloer na meldingen van seksuele intimidatie

MPs Sjoerdsma and Sienot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how Rijkswaterstaat handles reports of sexual harassment and bullying, including protocols, protection of reporters, sick-leave practices, data sanctions and use of external parties. The minister answered by describing existing integrity and complaints procedures, prevention policy and general rules, mostly without addressing specific cases or giving concrete new commitments.
The starting point is that an employee who makes a report suffers no adverse consequences from the report (Protocol Integrity Investigations Rijkswaterstaat).
Uitgangspunt is dat een medewerker die een melding doet geen nadelige gevolgen van zijn melding ondervindt (Protocol Integriteitonderzoeken Rijkswaterstaat).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over winterweer op het spoor

An MP asked the minister about around 60 switch failures caused by winter weather on the Dutch rail network, the winter measures ProRail can take, the effectiveness of measures taken, the rollout of heated switches, the Gouda and Amersfoort disruptions, and why reduced timetables and trains were not extended. The state secretary answered that ProRail was not ready in time for the winter season, that about 50 to 70 heated switch failures occurred, that the omission will be addressed in the annual evaluation which will be shared with parliament, and that reduced timetables and train lengthening were applied as explained.
I will also share this evaluation with your House.
Deze evaluatie zal ik ook met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over Sweatshop Schiphol

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about reports of precarious 'sweatshop' conditions at Schiphol, including rotating workers between contracts to avoid permanent employment, and the government's role. Minister Koolmees answered that such practices are undesirable but that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to planned contract-cost measures and existing research, and declined to take shareholder action or to answer in time for the committee debate.
I cannot make a statement about the situation at an individual company.
Over de situatie bij een individueel bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het bericht 'Rolstoelgebruikers hekelen gebrekkige assistentie op vliegvelden'

MPs Bergkamp and Paternotte asked about reports that wheelchair users criticise poor assistance at airports, the rising demand for assistance, liability for compensation, rules on carrying mobility aids, and the funding of assistance. The minister acknowledges problems at Schiphol, states that airports bear primary responsibility under EU Regulation 1107/2006, notes the ILT supervises through inspections and complaints, and explains that the per-passenger PRM charge applies to departing passengers only.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de brandbrief aan de directie van de Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL)

MP Amhaouch asked the minister about a letter from air traffic controllers to the LVNL management raising concerns, and whether safety and implementation of OVV recommendations are at stake. The minister answered that it is primarily an internal LVNL matter, that safety is not currently in question according to LVNL, the Gilde and ILT supervision, and that the minister monitors the situation and will keep parliament informed.
I regard this primarily as an internal matter at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL).
Ik beschouw dit primair als een interne aangelegenheid bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over berichten in de media die het rapport “Veiligheid Vliegverkeer Schiphol” van de Onderzoeksraad voor de veiligheid (OVV) bevestigen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about media reports confirming an OVV report on Schiphol flight safety, including air traffic controllers' warnings, bird strike risks near new Lelystad routes, and the role of the Alderstafel. The minister answered that the safety of operations is not at issue, pointed to internal LVNL matters, defended the routes and the planned environmental assessment, and said growth beyond 500,000 movements would first be analysed and advised on by the ORS.
The safety of the operation is not at issue, see the answers to questions 3 and 5.
De veiligheid van de operatie is niet in geding, zie daartoe de antwoorden op de vragen 3 en 5.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Stormachtig begin’

MPs Heerema and Dijkstra asked the minister whether the storm damage to the beach near Camperduin, where a beach pavilion closed, shows a risk to coastal safety, and whether Rijkswaterstaat should intervene against contractor Boskalis. The minister answered that sand loss is part of the dynamic coast, coastal safety is not endangered, Rijkswaterstaat monitors the coast annually, and sand nourishment will occur in spring 2018, so no intervention is needed now.
For this reason, the contractor will nourish sand in spring 2018 to maintain the coastline at Camperduin for the coming years as well.
Om deze reden zal de aannemer in het voorjaar van 2018 wel zand suppleren om de kustlijn ter hoogte van Camperduin ook voor de komende jaren te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Jasper van Dijk over het afsluiten van gas, water en licht

Two SP MPs asked whether households failing to pay energy bills will be cut off less quickly now that suppliers must first refer them to debt assistance, and how that works, plus questions on water cut-offs, health risks and a similar water rule. The minister confirmed the referral duty, described the winter-period procedure, said a summer extension is planned, and committed to amending the water cut-off regulation with the VNG and Vewin.
I am willing to draw up a similar kind of regulation.
Ik ben bereid eenzelfde soort regeling op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Remco Dijkstra over uitstel verruiming Twentekanalen

MPs Ten Broeke and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a regional call to speed up the Twentekanalen widening, why the tender was withdrawn, and how to avoid the 18-month delay. The minister confirmed regular consultation with the region, explained the tender was withdrawn due to groundwater risks, and said the delay cannot be avoided, though some measures such as traffic restrictions and acceleration options are being explored.
Following this, the tender has been withdrawn in its current form.
Hierop is de aanbesteding in de huidige vorm ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Raan over het MAA-besluit

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Raan asked the minister about the Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) decision to allow more cargo flights, including the effects on residents, noise and air quality, compensation for planning damage, and whether residents were misled about flight numbers and should get a new objection period. The minister answered that the corrected noise inputs will be assessed in an amended procedure with a new m.e.r. notice and a draft amendment placed before parliament, that damage claims will be handled under the existing compensation policy, and that residents were correctly informed about annual flight numbers, so no new objection period is planned.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het uitstempelen van zeevarenden in de haven van Rotterdam

An MP asked whether stamping departing non-EU seafarers' documents in Rotterdam harbour, after a practice change in 2016, distorts the level playing field for the maritime repair sector and whether it is in line with the Schengen Border Code given a 2017 court ruling. The State Secretary answered that the Schengen Code applies uniformly across member states, that exit stamps are only placed when departure is imminent, and that the government is appealing the court ruling and negotiating working arrangements with the sector.
In my view this ruling does not do justice to the provisions of the Schengen Border Code. I have therefore lodged an appeal against the ruling of the Hague District Court, Rotterdam sitting.

Naar mijn mening doet deze uitspraak geen recht aan de bepalingen van de Schengengrenscode. Ik heb daarom tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag, zittingsplaats Rotterdam, hoger beroep ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat asbest is vrijgekomen bij een brand in Goeree Overflakkee

An SP MP asked about asbestos released by a warehouse fire in Melissant, the extent of spread, the municipal information efforts, demolition and sanitation, national registration of asbestos fires, and whether high costs of certified asbestos roof removal could cause evasion. The government said the spread was limited, the municipality followed guidelines and is supervising demolition, no national registration exists, and it does not share the fear of evasion given municipal enforcement powers and a subsidy scheme.
Such a national overview is not available.
Een dergelijk landelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Douane

Van Raak (SP) asked why customs (Douane) is not designated to use blue lights and sirens, despite earlier commitments and promises to align with the shop floor. The ministers answered that the application was rejected under the criteria because use would be too infrequent to guarantee safe driving, and that a speed-limit exemption and police cooperation are sufficient.
Based on assessment against the criteria used for this, however, this application was rejected.
Op basis van toetsing aan de criteria die hiervoor worden gehanteerd is deze aanvraag echter afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Kent en Lacin over werklozen die bij de NS met levensgevaarlijke chroomverf moesten werken

Three SP MPs asked the ministers about unemployed Tilburg workers exposed to chromium-6 paint in an NS-linked re-integration project, including whether authorities intervened, whether victims get compensation, and whether a damages fund should be set up. The government said the Tilburg municipality remains ultimately responsible, an independent RIVM investigation is underway with results expected August 2018, and it will decide on compensation after that, while also tightening REACH and exposure rules.
I would first like to await the results of this investigation; these are expected at the end of August 2018.
Ik wil graag eerst de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten; deze worden eind augustus 2018 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over het artikel 'Nuclear accident sends 'harmless' radioactive cloud over Europe'

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked whether the government knows who was responsible for a radioactive ruthenium-106 release over Europe, whether Russia or Kazakhstan violated early-notification duties, and what risks follow. The minister says the source is not known with certainty but likely the southern Urals, that the Netherlands raised the matter at the IAEA board, and that the national radiation monitoring network can detect such releases.
The Netherlands, together with several other European countries, asked the other IAEA member states for clarification at the recent IAEA board meeting.

Nederland heeft, tezamen met een aantal andere Europese landen, tijdens de afgelopen bestuursraad van de Internationaal Atoomenergieagentschap (IAEA) opheldering gevraagd aan de andere IAEA-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het RIVM-onderzoek naar GenX in het drinkwater

An MP asked the minister about the RIVM finding of a possible additional source of GenX contamination, what measures are being taken to trace it, whether DuPont/Chemours is involved, which other firms use GenX technology, and when the Chamber will get results on bioaccumulation and a surface water quality standard. The minister answered that drinking water is safe, source investigations are ongoing with results expected early 2018, the Chamber will be informed, and a bioaccumulation study was approved with RIVM advice to follow.
At the legislative consultation of 27 November I indicated that the results of the further source investigation are expected in early 2018.
Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg van 27 november heb ik aangegeven dat de uitkomsten van het nadere onderzoek naar de bron(nen) begin 2018 worden verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Kröger en Van der Lee over de berichten 'CO2-uitstoot auto's in EU met een derde omlaag in 2030' en ‘Autokoper gaat weer voor groot en zwaar’

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about the EU proposal for tighter CO2 standards for new cars from 2025 and 2030, the rise in average CO2 emissions of new cars after the Autobrief II tax changes, and whether a ban on fossil-fuel car imports is planned. The state secretary answered that a detailed position will follow in a BNC-fiche, that emissions may temporarily rise but are expected to fall as zero-emission car sales grow, and that an import ban would conflict with the EU treaty on free movement.
You will shortly receive the BNC-fiche containing the cabinet position and the Dutch negotiating stance for the upcoming negotiations.
U ontvangt op korte termijn het bnc-fiche met daarin het kabinetsstandpunt en de Nederlandse inzet voor de aankomende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over Maastricht Aachen Airport

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Maastricht Aachen Airport's inability to fully use its runway for loaded cargo flights, the risk of cargo airlines diverting to other airports, and the division of responsibilities. The minister answered that a decision allowing full runway length for departing cargo is taken in the short term, referred to a letter sent the same day, and set out the roles of the Rijk, the province, the ILT and the concessionaire.

This has led, among other things, to the agreement that the airport, together with the air cargo sector, will explore to what extent it can offer a solution to preserve and where possible strengthen the Dutch cargo market.

Dat heeft onder andere tot de afspraak geleid dat de luchthaven te samen met de luchtvrachtsector verkent in hoeverre zij een oplossing biedt om de vrachtmarkt voor Nederland te behouden en waar mogelijk te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over giftige dampen aan boord van vliegtuigen

An MP asks the minister about a ZEMBLA broadcast on toxic cabin air in aircraft, the reporting duties of airlines, the independence of the advisory group NAC, and whether the government took the problem seriously enough. The minister replies that no causal link has been proven, that pilots are responsible for declaring unfitness, that the NAC was set up and EASA research is ongoing, and that a further NAC advisory report is awaited before any additional action.
The NAC has also been tasked with advising on taking any additional actions. I am awaiting that report.
De NAC heeft ook de opdracht gekregen te adviseren over het nemen van eventuele aanvullende acties. Ik wacht deze rapportage af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat het kabinet zwicht voor chantage van Russen

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the cabinet gave in to Russian pressure, linking KLM's Siberian overflight rights to AirBridgeCargo's slot shortage at Schiphol, and asked about the operational agreement, the government's role, and possible local slot rules. The minister answered that the government was not party to the KLM-ABC agreement, that no link exists between overflight rights and slots, and that a local rule for Schiphol and cargo measures are being explored, with some items deferred to later information.
I am not a party to the agreement myself and do not know its precise content.
Ik ben zelf geen partij bij de overeenkomst en ken de precieze inhoud daarvan niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de voorgenomen sluiting van een grote truckparking bij Venlo en het gebrek aan goede alternatieven

An MP asked the minister about the planned closure of the De Keulse Barrière truck parking near Venlo and the lack of free or affordable alternatives for drivers, which may push drivers toward rest-time violations. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat is working with municipalities and others under a 2015 convenant, a private paid truck park has opened in Venlo, a court ruling requires partial weekday opening of De Keulse Barrière, and the ILT can read rest times from tachographs, while committing to talks and a programme approach on corridor parking.
Whether and to what extent Eastern European drivers receive a reimbursement to use paid facilities is not known to me.
Of en in welke mate Oost-Europese chauffeurs een vergoeding krijgen om gebruik te maken van betaalde voorzieningen is bij mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht 'Nieuw peilbesluit IJsselmeer negatief voor watersport'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported negative impact of the new IJsselmeer water-level decision on watersports, including whether the 10 cm lowering is needed for nature or climate goals, the basis for the reported economic losses, compensation, and whether the minister will talk with the sector. The minister answered that the lowering serves water storage and Natura 2000 goals, that the MER found no significant effects requiring compensation, that the economic estimates come from the sector and cannot be verified, and that talks with municipalities and the sector are ongoing with the decision expected around summer 2018.
The cost estimate for possible adverse economic effects on the watersports sector comes from the sector itself and cannot be verified by the ministry.
De kostenraming over mogelijke nadelige economische effecten voor de watersportsector is afkomstig van de sector zelf en is door het ministerie niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Paternotte, Remco Dijkstra, Bruins en Kröger over Lelystad

Five MPs asked the minister about press reports that former state secretary Dijksma criticised the ministry's capacity to handle the complex Lelystad Airport dossier, including the environmental impact assessment (MER). The minister acknowledged the reports, said the ministry has capable staff but needs extra expertise, and said the remarks do not affect the planned new MER assessment.
The ministry has competent and committed staff.
Het ministerie beschikt over kundige en betrokken medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van Helvert over uitstel van verbreding van de ‘dodenweg’ N50 bij Kampen

MPs Bruins and Van Helvert asked the minister why widening the N50 near Kampen may be delayed to 2023 despite safety and congestion concerns, and whether the start decision and the motion on the N50 are being implemented. The minister answered that the N50 is not a bottleneck in the national market and capacity analysis, that personnel capacity is reserved for the existing MIRT programme, that EUR 5 million has been reserved and a start decision is expected soon.
The N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid does not emerge as a bottleneck in the NMCA (National Market and Capacity Analysis).
De N50 Kampen–Kampen Zuid komt niet als knelpunt naar voren in de NMCA
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ”Kinderen kunnen voortaan – zonder medisch dossier – slecht rijgedrag van ouders melden”.

A 50PLUS MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether unverified reports of bad driving, including by children about parents, can lead to suspension of a driving licence without evidence, and whether this risks arbitrariness and misuse. The minister answered that the CBR assesses reports against statutory criteria and filters them substantively before any investigation, and that the procedure serves road safety, but gave limited detail on the criteria, the source relationship and the protections.
The CBR is responsible for checking whether the information submitted in a report gives substantive and legal grounds to further investigate suitability or driving competence.
Het CBR heeft de verantwoordelijkheid om te toetsen of de aangedragen informatie in de melding inhoudelijk en juridisch aanleiding geeft om de geschiktheid of rijvaardigheid nader te onderzoeken

m: Motie van de leden Haage en Westerveld over ook onderwijs aan jongeren in de jeugdzorg meenemen in de Staat van het Onderwijs
Asks the government to ask the Inspectorate of Education to include education for youth in youth care in its annual State of Education report.
requests the government to ask the Inspectorate of Education to annually include education for youth in youth care in the State of Education
verzoekt de regering om aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs te vragen voortaan ook onderwijs aan jongeren in de jeugdzorg jaarlijks mee te nemen in de Staat van het Onderwijs
Motie van het lid Haage over kernindicatoren omtrent kansengelijkheid
Asks the government to agree cross-sector core indicators on equal opportunities so that developments and its measures against educational inequality can be monitored and evaluated over time.
requests the government to agree on a set of cross-sector core indicators on equal opportunities
verzoekt de regering om sectoroverstijgend een aantal kernindicatoren omtrent kansengelijkheid af te spreken
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Amends the education budget to reverse planned cuts of about €1.6 billion per year, funded by offsetting measures.
This amendment therefore completely reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Reverses planned education, culture and science budget cuts of about 1.6 billion euros per year by increasing spending across many articles of the education budget.
This amendment therefore fully reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Amendement van het lid Stultiens c.s. over middelen voor het terugdraaien van bezuinigingen
Amendment restoring about 1.6 billion euro per year in education, culture, science and related budget lines by reversing planned cuts.
This amendment therefore fully reverses these cuts.
Dit amendement maakt deze bezuinigingen daarom volledig ongedaan.
Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over de zorgen rond communicatie en transparantie rond het invaarbesluit wegnemen
Asks the government to address concerns about communication and transparency around the pension fund invaarbesluit before the committee debate.

requests the government to do its utmost, within the Future Pensions Act framework and with proposals if needed, to remove concerns about communication and transparency around the invaarbesluit before the 14 May committee debate

verzoekt de regering om voor het commissiedebat van 14 mei binnen de kaders van de Wet toekomst pensioenen zich maximaal in te zetten om, zo nodig met voorstellen, de zorgen rond communicatie en transparantie rond het invaarbesluit weg te nemen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Six Dijkstra en Haage ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een voorhangbepaling
Adds a four-week waiting period before proposing certain Customs Decree (AMvB) changes on data sharing, so both chambers receive the draft first, a light voorhang for parliament.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be adopted under the fifth paragraph, parts a, d or e, will not be made until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het vijfde lid, onderdelen a, d of e, vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Haage over het bij AMvB stellen van nadere regels over het voorkomen van discriminatie
Adds to the general administrative order powers the ability to set rules preventing discrimination on grounds of nationality, ethnicity or other grounds when government data are shared.
prevention of discrimination on grounds of nationality, ethnicity or any other ground when the data are provided
voorkoming van discriminatie op grond van nationaliteit, etniciteit of op welke grond dan ook bij de verstrekking van de gegevens
Amendement van de leden Six Dijkstra en Haage ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een jaarlijkse monitoring van de gegevensdeling
Requires the Finance Minister to monitor and report annually to both Houses on customs data shared without criminal suspicion, given privacy risks.
monitors the data provided under articles 1:39 and 1:40 of the General Customs Act and annually sends the results of this monitor to both Chambers within five years

monitort de gegevens die worden verstrekt als bedoeld in de artikelen 1:39 en 1:40 van de Algemene douanewet en zendt binnen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding van deze wet jaarlijks de resultaten van deze monitor aan beide Kamers
Amendement van de leden Six Dijkstra en Haage ter vervanging van nr. 7 over een voorhangbepaling
Requires that the draft general administrative order on customs data sharing be submitted to parliament for four weeks before it is adopted.
Since this general administrative order (AMvB) greatly influences how the provisions of this bill will be applied, parliamentary involvement is desirable.
Aangezien deze algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) van grote invloed is op de manier waarop de bepalingen in dit wetsvoorstel gaan worden toegepast, is parlementaire betrokkenheid gewenst.
Amendement van de leden Haage en Six Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het bij AMvB stellen van nadere regels over het voorkomen van discriminatie
Amendment has the AMvB on data sharing also set rules to prevent discrimination based on nationality, ethnicity or other grounds in data provision.
to also set further rules by general administrative order on countering possible (algorithmic) discrimination
om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur tevens nadere regels te stellen ten aanzien van het tegengaan van mogelijke (algoritmische) discriminatie
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haage en Westerveld over ' Scholen gaan zelf boeken maken: 'Beter, goedkoper, en duurzamer'

MPs Haage and Westerveld asked the state secretary for Education about a plan by Neon, a non-profit initiative for schools to produce cheaper, better and more sustainable textbooks, and about its cost gap with current publisher prices. The state secretary welcomed the initiative, said schools are free in their choice of materials and that a KPMG study on textbook prices is underway, and promised a letter with the status of the motions before the budget debate.
I will inform your House about that before the budget debate.
Ik zal uw Kamer daar voor de begrotingsbehandeling over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Haage over het besluit van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs judolessen niet langer te erkennen als volwaardige invulling van het bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Mohandis and Haage asked whether the Inspectorate's decision that judo lessons at a Dalton school no longer count as full physical education, despite a qualified teacher, is justified, and whether the ministries will talk to the Judo Bond and what the end of the physical-education subsidy means. The state secretary defended the Inspectorate's position that structural judo cannot meet the core goals alone, declined a direct meeting with one provider, and said ending the subsidy will not reduce physical-education hours.
By structurally offering judo lessons as part of physical education, a school cannot meet the implementation of the core goals.
Met het structureel aanbieden van judolessen als onderdeel van het bewegingsonderwijs kan een school niet voldoen aan de uitvoering van de kerndoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Haage over de achterstanden van kinderen van Europese arbeidsmigranten en de financiering van scholen

MPs Patijn and Haage ask the government about funding shortfalls for schools with many children of Eastern European labour migrants, whose weighting under the disadvantage-funding model is seen as inadequate, and about reviewing the model. The State Secretary says the CBS is recalibrating the disadvantage indicator, expected to be in use in 2027, and that the funding model is not the solution for family instability caused by economic hardship.
It illustrates the need to periodically recalibrate the indicator used for educational disadvantage.
Het illustreert de noodzaak om de gebruikte indicator voor onderwijsachterstanden periodiek te herijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haage en Westerveld over de gevolgen van de Asielnoodmaatregelenwet op het onderwijs

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Education whether the Asylum Emergency Measures Act (Asielnoodmaatregelenwet) would create uncertainty and harm for schools, staff, children and parents without valid residence status, and whether it conflicts with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government answered that all children in the Netherlands keep the right to education, that the Minister for Asylum has asked the Council of State for advice on the criminal liability of humanitarian helpers, and that the matter will be debated with parliament after that advice arrives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Haage over het bericht ‘Bij de hulporganisatie voor toeslagenouders heerst een onveilig werkklimaat’

MPs Dijk and Haage asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report of an unsafe work climate at the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT), including shouting, discrimination, unwanted advances, and derogatory remarks about affected parents. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems as unacceptable, described the Berenschot investigation and follow-up measures such as team sessions and workshops, but declined to extend the investigation to other UHT locations.
I deeply regret that in some situations there may have been hurtful talk about the childcare benefits affair and/or the parents concerned.
Ik betreur het zeer dat in enkele situaties mogelijk op een kwetsende wijze is gesproken over de toeslagenaffaire en/of de betreffende ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haage over EHBO-certificering in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the State Secretary about replacing the list of approved child first-aid certificates in childcare with end-attainment criteria, and whether quality can be guaranteed. The State Secretary confirmed the list will be dropped to reduce regulatory burden, that no government quality control or practical verification will apply, and that an alternative sector proposal for stricter certifier requirements will not be adopted, though the sector may introduce its own keurmerk.
This concerns a change at the level of a ministerial regulation, for which the law does not provide for parliamentary involvement.
Het betreft een wijziging op het niveau van een ministeriële regeling, waarvoor de wet niet in parlementaire betrokkenheid voorziet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over het Raad van State-advies ten aanzien van het amendement van het lid Joseph c.s. op het wetsvoorstel voor de verlenging van de transitieperiod

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State's critical advice on the Joseph amendment, which would make non-transfer the default in the pension transition, and its consequences for members, implementation, social partners and courts. The minister answered that the amendment weakens intergenerational solidarity, risks compulsory participation, causes transition delays and legal conflict, conflicts with ILO conventions on collective bargaining, and that he considers it undesirable and will address this in the government's response.
From my administrative responsibility for compliance with the Pension Agreement, orderly legislation and predictability for implementation, I consider this undesirable.
Vanuit mijn bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid voor de naleving van afspraken uit het Pensioenakkoord, ordentelijke wetgeving en voorspelbaarheid voor de uitvoering acht ik dit niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk, en Haage over het bericht ‘Minister Van Hijum kraakt plan pensioenreferendum van zijn eigen partij: kritisch advies in concept-brief’

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a critical draft advisory note on a pension referendum amendment was real and why supporting documents had not been published. The minister confirmed awareness, said underlying departmental notes will be published with the cabinet response before the plenary debate, and explained that advice is withheld until a ministerial decision is made.
All underlying departmental notes from SZW and Finance used in decision-making will be made public at the same time as the cabinet response.
Alle onderliggende departementale nota's van SZW en van Financiën die zijn gebruikt bij de besluitvorming, zullen tegelijk met de kabinetsreactie openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Hirsch, Van der Lee, Thijssen, Patijn, Haage en Kathmann over de gevolgen van Trumps handelsoorlog voor Nederland

Members of GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the economic and financial risks of Trump's tariff war for the Netherlands, including market volatility, Chinese import diversion, sector support, employment, pensions, purchasing power, dependence on US digital services and strategic dependencies. The minister answered that financial institutions are sound and monitored, that CPB will update its impact study, that no direct support to firms is planned, and that the government favours EU unity and diversification while declining to speculate on further measures.
Question 22: Do you have a picture of which undesirable strategic dependencies the Netherlands has on the US?
Vraag 22 Heeft u in beeld welke ongewenste strategische afhankelijkheden we in Nederland hebben ten aanzien van de VS?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk en Haage over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland ECLI:NL:RBGEL:2024:7601 en het bericht op LinkedIn van 16 januari 2024

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Gelderland court ruling that a toeslagen victim is entitled to free legal aid for broad support, and why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand appealed. The State Secretary confirmed the ruling, said the Raad filed a pro forma appeal to clarify the legal question, and argued that gemeentelijke brede ondersteuning falls under the normal Wrb income criteria.

On appeal, the question is whether there is an entitlement to free legal aid, regardless of income or assets, under the Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

In hoger beroep staat ter discussie of er aanspraak bestaat op kosteloze rechtsbijstand, ongeacht inkomen of vermogen, op grond van de Subsidieregeling pakket rechtsbijstand herstelregelingen kinderopvangtoeslag 2023.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Ceder, Inge van Dijk en Haage over de memo in handen van RTL aangaande het ingediende amendement Joseph c.s. over een referendum over het invaren van pensioenfondsen

MPs from D66, ChristenUnie, CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA asked whether the government would publish a leaked ministry memo on the budgetary cost of the NSC-backed Joseph amendment on a pension-fund referendum, and whether an MP had access to cabinet-internal documents. The minister confirmed the memo exists and attached it, denied it was a cabinet-internal document shared with the MP, and committed to publish the advice and appreciation of the amended amendment when the cabinet appreciation is issued.

As requested by the standing parliamentary committee on Social Affairs and Employment, the amended amendment will be accompanied by a cabinet appreciation, advice from the Council of State, and views from supervisors, the Tax Authority, pension administrators and social partners.

Zoals door de vaste Kamercommissie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid gevraagd, wordt het gewijzigde amendement voorzien van een kabinetsappreciatie, advies van de Raad van State, en zienswijzen van onder andere de toezichthouders, Belastingdienst, pensioenuitvoerders en sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verouden, Kouwenhoven en Saris over de ingreep bij Nexperia

MPs Verouden, Kouwenhoven and Saris asked Minister Karremans about the government's intervention at Nexperia under the Goods Availability Act, including legal advice, timing, consultation with Europe and China, and information provision to parliament. The minister largely referred to earlier letters and a timeline, withheld advice and documents citing confidentiality and company information, and defended the intervention as necessary to protect supply security.
Because of the classified nature of this file, the cabinet cannot make these advices public.
Vanwege het geclassificeerde karakter van dit dossier kan het kabinet deze adviezen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verouden over nationale toepassing staatssteunregels bij scale-ups (OIM problematiek)

MP Verouden asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the national application of EU state aid rules to scale-ups, specifically the 'undertaking in difficulty' (OIM) definition that excludes many young firms from subsidies, and whether national rules are stricter. The minister answered that the problem stems from EU rules and CBb case law, that Dutch practice is not stricter, that the EU definition should be revised, and that the Netherlands submitted proposals to the Commission in its consultation.
Adjusting Dutch rules offers unfortunately no solution.
Aanpassing van de Nederlandse regels biedt helaas geen oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verouden over de berichtgeving van de ACM dat boodschappen in Nederlandse supermarkten duurder zijn dan in omringende landen

MP Verouden asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the ACM investigation into higher supermarket prices than in neighbouring countries, including territorial supply restrictions, market concentration, and whether New Competition Tool-style monitoring is desirable. Minister Karremans answered that the ACM investigates independently, that the government is pushing for EU action on territorial supply restrictions, is exploring a New Competition Tool with a letter to follow, and that Dutch food prices were below the EU and eurozone averages in 2023.
The ACM, as an independent supervisor, carries out the investigation independently. The ministry plays no role in it.
De ACM voert als onafhankelijke toezichthouder het onderzoek zelfstandig uit. Het ministerie speelt daarin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moinat over het krantenartikel 'Inspectie is helemaal klaar met bedrijven: statiegeld op flesjes moet fors omhoog, anders megaboete'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the inspectorate's push to raise the bottle deposit to 30 cents, and its penalties on Verpact, shift costs onto consumers instead of fixing machine failures first. The state secretary answered that raising the deposit is undesirable, that Verpact must improve the system and prefers positive incentives, and that Verpact's new package offers rewards for returns instead of a higher deposit.
Verpact has received an adjusted order from the ILT for this purpose.
Verpact heeft daarvoor een aangepaste last van de ILT ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moinat over het krantenartikel ‘Aanbesteding Twente Airport vertraagd: provincie niet op tijd met besluit’ van 12 november 2025 in Tubantia

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the future of Twente Airport, drone innovation, PBN approval and the airport's regional role after a newspaper report on a delayed tender. The minister answered that the airport is an independent enterprise under provincial authority, that the ministry will talk with the airport about defence-related drone testing, and that PBN procedures are approved but implementation is unlikely before 2029/2030 due to limited air traffic control capacity.
The ministry is willing to talk with Twente Airport about how it can support, together with Defence, the further development and testing of unmanned aircraft, such as cargo drones and exercises.

Het ministerie is bereid om met Twente Airport in gesprek te gaan op welke manier het in samenwerking met Defensie kan ondersteunen bij het doorontwikkelen en (het testen van) van onbemande luchtvaarttuigen, zoals cargodrones en oefeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Straatman over het bericht 'Tabakssmokkel en nepsigaretten schaden Nederlandse verkopers'

MPs Krul and Straatman (CDA) asked about reports of rising illegal cigarette trade, smuggling, illegal production, online sales and excise policy. The government answered with survey data, enforcement measures and EU excise harmonisation plans, but made no firm commitments on new accijns increases.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide on changes to the excise duty.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om te besluiten over te gaan tot wijzigingen ten aanzien van de accijns.
